contexts.paragraph_english: The repair cabinet contains one tagged clamp set and one fixed reserve connector for this station. Record their tags when collecting them. These are local maintenance items. The reserve connector fits the station's existing backup seat; it is not a tower backup pack, the Glimmer's battery or personal crafting scrap. The clamp is kept for this inspection and may be repositioned while the conveyor remains isolated.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 检修料柜有一套带标签夹具和一个本站固定备用连接头。领取时记录标签。二者均是地方检修物件。连接头适配本站既有备用源座，不是塔站备用包、微光号电池或个人制作零件。夹具留给这次检修，输送器隔离时可以重置位置。

contexts.paragraph_english: For the present local work segment, the cabinet notice rates the tested reserve at six load units. The kitchen branch needs four units and the wash pump three. These are the station's own fictional planning units; they are not hours of fuel or a conversion into personal marks. Each branch can be served within the limit. A simultaneous request for both would total seven units. The selector has an alternating position as well as individual A and B positions.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 当前地方工作段备用源能力列为六个负荷单位。厨房需要四，洗水泵需要三。这是虚构设施的规划单位，不是燃料小时，也不能折算刻币。各支路单独运行均在限制内；同时运行两条则合计七。选择器设交替档以及独立A、B档。

entries.english_definition: Restricted to particular people rather than open to everyone.

contexts.paragraph_english: Leave the Glimmer at the marked berth while the landing clerk checks your vessel record and the cross-district commission. Registering here establishes an arrival and a route back to this landing. It does not give access to private rooms or restricted names.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 请把微光号停在标记泊位，由接驳员核对船只记录与跨区核查委托。此处登记记录一次实际到港，并建立返回这个接驳站的路线。私人房间与受限姓名另有访问范围。

contexts.paragraph_english: When I said the group was complete, I meant that the kitchen had prepared the full number of portions. If you need the order of arrival, please compare the receiving record. I can tell you what happened at this counter. I cannot explain who changed the official labels, and I have not agreed to have my private address placed on a notice.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 我说“组员齐了”时，指的是厨房按全部人数备了饭。要核查抵达次序，请比较接收记录。我能说明这个台前发生的事，不能解释是谁改了官方标签，也没有同意把私人地址写到告示上。

contexts.paragraph_english: These figures count portions, not independent sightings of twenty-four people. A neighbour may collect for someone who is resting. The residential porch check records voluntary confirmation of residence separately. Please retain both types of record; correcting a register does not require publishing a resident's private name.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 这些数字计算口粮份数，并非二十四次独立见到本人。有人休息时，邻居可能代领。住区门廊查验另外记录本人自愿确认的居住情况。请保留两类记录；更正名册无需公开私人姓名。

contexts.paragraph_english: Accommodation index for the same local group: A has eight assigned places, B ten and C six. The index uses public room codes rather than private street addresses. Each assignment states where a place was offered; the porch visit states whether its resident currently confirms living here.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 同一地方住区组的安置索引：A区八个安置位，B区十个，C区六个。索引使用公开房间代码，不列私人街道住址。安置记录说明曾提供的位置；门廊走访说明当事人现在是否确认住在此处。

entries.english_definition: A person responsible for keeping something safe.

contexts.paragraph_english: The public path leads to the priory courtyard. June can arrange a meeting there and direct visitors to the residential porches. Please use the public room codes when making notes. Residents may speak for themselves, ask a custodian to relay a request, or decline an interview.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 公共通路通往修院庭院。琼可在那里安排会面，并引导访客前往住区门廊。做笔记时请使用公开房间代码。住民可以亲自说明、请保管人转达请求，也可以拒绝访谈。

contexts.paragraph_english: The later assignment does not tell us why an official entry says moved away. Those labels came from another register. I can let the custodian check my room codes and this observation for the local inquiry. Please keep the exact record version with the statement. A retelling of what I said will still come from me; it will not become another independent witness.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 较晚分配房间不能解释官方记录为何写迁出；那些标签来自另一份名册。我可以让保管人为地方调查核对房间代码与这次观察。请把准确版本和陈述保存在一起。别人转述我的话，来源仍是我，不会变成另一个独立证人。

contexts.paragraph_english: For a restricted attachment, name the record version, the fields required, the recipient and the intended use. June acts as custodian of the room. She can arrange controlled inspection and record an authorised handover. Holding the key to an attachment does not make her the person entitled to consent on behalf of every individual named there. Consent to publish a person's identity must be given by that person for the specified recipient and use.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 申请受限附页时，请说明版本、必要字段、接收方和用途。琼是阅览室保管人，可以安排受控查验、记录获准交付，但持有钥匙并未使她有权代所有当事人同意。公开某人的身份须由本人对具体接收方与用途明确同意。

contexts.paragraph_english: The public work register remains open if an identity request is declined. You may request a redacted copy, arrange an inspection through the custodian, or pause the identity request and continue the public inquiry. Reviewers must still be able to check material public facts and the records supporting them. Private details should be separated from that route rather than used to prevent all scrutiny.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 身份申请被拒后，公共工作记录仍开放。可以申请脱敏副本、经保管人安排查验，或暂缓身份申请后继续公共调查。必要公共事实及支持记录仍须能被审查；私人细节应与这条核查路径分开。

entries.english_definition: A document or detail used for checking information.

contexts.paragraph_english: Copies retain the source reference of their original. A departure entry copied into a ledger remains the departure officer's record. An arrival written by the receiving officer at the receiving site has its own source. Keep the two references visible when describing what has been checked.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 副本沿用原稿来源。出发记录抄入总账后仍是出发记录员的记录；接收员在接收现场写下的到达记录另有来源。说明查验结果时，应保留两个来源标识。

contexts.paragraph_english: Workshop custodian: The source reference on the copy leads back to the instrument sheet, MC-2.instrument.I@1. Its retained-copy identity is MC-2.retained.I@1. Both record checks zero five and zero six as incomplete. I checked that the transcription preserves those fields. That is a copying check, rather than a new observation of the machine. The final form, MC-2.acceptance@3, marks all six accepted. We should compare the exact fields and the work they describe, rather than treating a large stamp as more reliable than a small handwritten line.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 工坊保管人：副本来源指向MC-2.instrument.I@1，留存副本身份为MC-2.retained.I@1。两页均把05、06项列为未完成。我核对抄录保留了这些字段；这是抄录检查，并非对机器的新观察。最终表MC-2.acceptance@3把六项全部列为合格。应比较具体字段与对应工作，不能因大印章就认为比小手写条目可靠。

contexts.paragraph_english: Transfer TR-D1-7, version 1. Controlled extract from the receiving officer's custody handover record. The record is dated D−1 relative to the opening blackout. It identifies Mara Venn by the protected identification reference checked at the archive desk. The receiving officer recorded her as alive when custody was handed over. The destination is written as facility code F-17. No public site name or current address is supplied on this extract.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 转移TR-D1-7，第1版。接收员看管交接原稿的受控摘录，日期为开场熄灯前一天D−1。摘录用阅览台核对过的受保护身份索引识别玛拉·维恩。接收员记下她在看管交接时仍然活着。目的地写作设施代码F-17，本摘录没有公开地点名称或现行地址。

contexts.paragraph_english: M-12, the separate local transfer used in the ordering exercise, has its own reference and receiving desk. It concerns another transfer. Keep those files separate even when the same worksheet is used to practise distinguishing departure, arrival and copying. The archive has supplied copies for examination; these copies preserve their original sources rather than adding new witnesses.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 用于排序练习的地方转移M-12另有编号和接收台，记录另一件转移。即使共用练习工作表，也应把两套文件分开。档案提供查验副本，副本保留原始来源，不增加证人数量。

entries.english_definition: The range of matters an action or permission covers.

contexts.paragraph_english: The greenhouse corridor is open to visitors. The inspection stair below it remains a work area. A patrol credential identifies your role; the local maintenance request specifies the equipment you may handle. Ask for that scope before entering the stair.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 温室外廊向访客开放，其下方的检修梯仍是工作区域。巡灯凭证说明职业身份；地方检修请求说明允许操作的设备。进入检修梯前请先取得这项范围。

contexts.paragraph_english: The D−1 custody extract is a separate file. We will inspect its identifier and its dated receiving entry under the scope you requested. It records Mara's condition at that handover and uses a facility code for the destination. Later files would be needed to establish what happened after that point. None are included in this extract.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: D−1看管摘录是另一文件。我们会按所申请范围核查编号和有日期的接收条目。它记录玛拉在那次交接时的状态，以设施代码表示目的地。此后发生什么需要后续文件，本摘录不含那些记录。

contexts.paragraph_english: June also requests inspection of the greenhouse supply stair. This permits the local handles, fixed repair cabinet and transfer-station circuits described in the maintenance notice. It does not authorise changing the tower's central interlock. Bring back a factual difference report and the equipment boundary before asking the local desk to issue the next work scope.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 琼还请求检查温室供给检修梯。允许范围是告示列明的地方手柄、固定料柜和转供站回路，未包括改动塔站中央联锁。请把实际差异与设备边界带回地方工作台，再申请下一步工作范围。

contexts.paragraph_english: The columns describe different measures: an administrative classification and a dated residence check. The figures do not explain the original reasons for classification. Record the mismatch, the scope of this group and the limit on interpretation. Preserve the evidence references for later review.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 两列衡量不同对象：行政分类与有日期的居住核查。数字没有解释最初分类原因。应记录差异、住区组范围和解释限制，并保留证据来源。

entries.english_definition: A named category of information in a record.

contexts.paragraph_english: This permit covers the duty layer, the marked inspection stands and the return passage. The operator will compare the current isolation indicators, protected access and duty register with the local-station test receipt. Record what is inspected here rather than copying the machine-room result into a tower-safety field.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 许可覆盖值守层、标记查验站位与返程通道。当班操作员对照地方支站试验回执，核查当前隔离指示、防护通路与值班记录。应记下塔站实际检查内容，不能把机房结果抄成塔站安全状态。

contexts.paragraph_english: Please separate a decision about a person's identity from a decision about those claims. If the person gives explicit consent for a particular identity field to be published to a particular recipient, record that scope and version. Do not treat an archive reading permit or a custodian's signature as personal consent. If the requested permission is missing, revise the fields or request another scope before sending. The basic reading room will remain open while you do that.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 请把个人身份决定与这些公共陈述分开。本人若明确同意向特定接收方公开某项身份字段，应记录范围与版本。阅读许可或保管人签字不能代替个人同意。缺少所需许可时，发送前修改字段或申请新范围；基础阅览室仍开放。

contexts.paragraph_english: The extract reproduces the administrative status that this roll currently carries. Its issue date precedes the present porch visits. It has no field confirming who is at the priory today. A duplicate in the room index has the same register source.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 摘录复制的是名册当前行政状态，签发日期在本次门廊走访之前，没有确认今日谁在修院的字段。住区索引中的重复内容仍与名册同源。

contexts.paragraph_english: Sending-end record, custody transfer TR-D1-7, version 1. On D−1 the sending officer handed the person identified by protected reference MV to the named receiving duty. The sending observation records Mara Venn as alive at departure. The destination field contains facility code F-17. The public extract carries the transfer identifier and record version; the identity comparison is available under controlled review.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 发送端记录，看管转移TR-D1-7，第1版。D−1，发送员将受保护索引MV指明的人移交给具名接收岗位。发送观察记录玛拉·维恩出发时活着，目的地字段为设施代码F-17。公共摘录保留转移编号与版本，身份比对可按受控范围查验。

entries.english_definition: Formal agreement that work meets specified requirements.

contexts.paragraph_english: The index links local interlock plate IL-2 to maintenance batch MC-2 at the bell-mine workshop. It records a destination for checking the batch's original instrument sheets and acceptance versions. The priory copy contains the batch reference and a dispatch acknowledgement, not the workshop's complete technical file.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本地联锁标牌IL-2在索引中关联沉钟矿区工坊检修批次MC-2，指明应到何处核对该批次原始仪表页与验收版本。修院副本只有批次索引与发件确认，没有工坊完整技术档案。

contexts.paragraph_english: Pera: Before we decide what to send, I want the three records kept on the table. The instrument sheet describes the local check at stage I. The workshop copy follows that sheet, and the final acceptance is version three. People have been calling them three separate witnesses. That wording worries me. We have three documents, but one repeats another. Please explain what each can establish, and keep the current rescue apart from the earlier acceptance. The workers need to come home whether or not they want to discuss who signed a form.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 佩拉：决定送什么之前，我希望三份记录都留在台上。仪表页记阶段I检查，工坊副本承接该页，最终验收是第三版。有人把它们叫三名独立证人，这个说法让我担心。我们有三份文件，其中一份复述另一份。请说明各自能核实什么，把当前救援与早验收分开；工人无论是否愿意谈签章，都需要回家。

contexts.paragraph_english: For the controlled batch records, apply at the workshop comparison stand to the local record desk, R3-local-record-desk. The available fields are check_status, acceptance_status, signatory_scope and version_source. The recipient is patrol_technician; the purpose is verify_original_instruments_and_acceptance; the requested source set is MC2-current-source-set. The desk must issue this actual scoped permission before the protected pages are opened. A mine work assignment does not grant unrelated names or a private interview.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 受控批次记录须到工坊比较站位向地方记录台R3-local-record-desk申请。可用字段为check_status、acceptance_status、signatory_scope、version_source；接收方patrol_technician，用途verify_original_instruments_and_acceptance，请求来源集合MC2-current-source-set。保护页开启前，记录台须实际签发这项有限许可；矿井委托不会开放无关姓名或私人访谈。

contexts.paragraph_english: Document identity: MC-2.instrument.I@1. Original check sheet, batch MC-2, inspection stage I. Six listed checks belong to this local batch. Four are marked complete. Checks MC-2-05 and MC-2-06, covering the safety bypass, are marked incomplete. The sheet records the test configuration and the observing instrument. A later official acceptance must be compared with this version; a recently repaired bypass cannot change what this earlier sheet recorded.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 文书身份：MC-2.instrument.I@1。原始检查页，批次MC-2，检查阶段I。本地批次列六项检查，四项完成。涉及安全旁路的MC-2-05与MC-2-06标为未完成。页面记录测试配置及观察仪表，应与后来的正式验收版本比较；近日修好的旁路不能改变早页记录。

entries.english_definition: An activity done to achieve a practical result.

contexts.paragraph_english: Bridge observation copy — times use the same ship clock. 21:14:10: the tower light disappeared from view while the heading indicator still showed the assigned course. 21:16:00: the helmsman reported a course deviation. 21:17:40: contact with the reef was felt. The entries describe what the crew observed; they do not identify a switch operator or establish the reason for the loss of light. The ship clock has not yet been compared with a shore instrument. Preserve this copy and compare it with an independent record when the rescue work allows it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 桥台抄记使用同一船钟。21:14:10，塔灯消失，当时航向指示仍显示规定航向。21:16:00，舵手报告偏航。21:17:40，船体触礁。记录只说明船员观察到的先后，不识别开关操作者，也不证明熄灯原因。船钟尚未与岸上仪器核对；先保留副本，完成救援后再找独立记录。

contexts.paragraph_english: Electrician: That distinction matters. Do not look for a replacement beacon when what you need is a replacement bracket. There is a suitable bracket in the west workshop. Access to the workshop has to be dealt with locally, so this recording is not permission to walk through a restricted work area.

To the new technician, from Mara. If a record is marked for destruction, first ask who issued the instruction, which version it concerns and what other record can be used to check it. A tidy report may leave out the circumstances that made its conclusion seem convincing. I have enclosed a request to compare the public maintenance record with an independent source. Deal with immediate rescue work before following it. This letter was placed in the inspection post before your journey; it cannot tell you where I am when you read it. Do not treat my concerns as proof. Preserve what you actually find, including anything that does not support the explanation you expected.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 玛拉给新检修员的留言：遇到要求销毁的记录，先核对指令签发者、所指版本和可独立核验的来源。整齐报告可能省略形成结论的条件。附上公共检修记录比对请求，但眼前救援优先。信件在旅程前寄存，不能说明阅读时玛拉所在。疑虑不是证明，应保留实际找到的资料，包括不支持预期解释的部分。

contexts.paragraph_english: Arrival record — rescue passage from the stranded coast. The public arrival berth receives the technician and four registered survivors. Record their arrival before requesting further harbour work; a person carried here is not automatically signed onto another vessel's crew. Two different berths are shown on the quay plan. The civil ferry is awaiting maintenance and a safe departure arrangement. The stored patrol boat has no handover authorisation on this arrival record. A harbour officer may review a limited maintenance request at the public dispatch desk. Bring the rescue acknowledgement and your inspection appointment, and consult the current closure order rather than assuming that rescue passage suspends it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 搁浅海岸救援入港记录：接应泊位接收检修员和四名已登记幸存者。先登记到港，再申请后续港口工作；接应入港不自动成为另一船的船员。码头显示不同泊位：民用渡轮待检修与安全撤离方案；封存巡灯船没有在此记录中授权移交。公共调度台可审查有限检修申请，须携救援回执及任职凭证，并查现行封港令。

entries.english_definition: A change from one arrangement or state to another.

contexts.paragraph_english: Under time_limited_transition, extraction may use one to three units, with the total never above ten. The window lasts one declared work shift. Two different local duty people must actually accept the operating and safety-watch posts. A feasible allocation is shelter two, retrofit one and production support three. It preserves limited output for transfer work, with less immediate improvement elsewhere. An open-ended continuation is outside the safe arrangement.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: time_limited_transition允许抽取一至三单位，总量不超过十，窗口仅一班明确工作。两名不同本地人员须实际承接操作和安全观察岗。安置二、改造一、生产支持三是一例：保留有限产出用于转移工作，同时减少其他方面的即时改善。无限期延续超出安全安排。

contexts.paragraph_english: Stores clerk: Every extra package has one local identifier. If four go to shelter and two to retrofit, all six are allocated and none remain for production support. That is a feasible early-reduction distribution. Two to shelter, one to retrofit and three to production also meets the allocation limits. It supports a limited transition with less immediate improvement in the other two uses. We can consider a different distribution within the same limits. What I cannot sign is a list of seven packages, or a list which sends the same package to two groups.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 库管员：每个额外工包有独立地方编号。安置四、改造二就用完六包，不剩生产支持，这是一种可行早降载分配。安置二、改造一、生产三也符合限制，可支持有限过渡，但其他两项即时改善较少。还可考虑同限额内的别种分配。我不能签七包清单，也不能把同一包送给两个组。

contexts.paragraph_english: At the dispatch duty stand, close_transition_shift performs the handover and sets extraction back to zero before the next shift. This is a world-work boundary, not a countdown while someone reads or writes. A load change invalidates the previous configuration test. Recheck the actual new setting. The tower handover needs a current bounded policy, real duty records and the relevant test; saving the policy text alone does none of those jobs.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 在调度值守站位，close_transition_shift实际交班，并在下一班前把抽取降回零。这是世界工作边界，不是阅读或写作时的倒计时。负荷变更使旧配置测试失效，应复查新设置。塔站交接需要当前受限政策、真实值守和对应测试；仅保存政策文字没有完成这些工作。

contexts.paragraph_english: A limited transition may preserve enough output to support a particular transfer. It can be useful when the equipment and people must move in an order that cannot be changed at once. Its conditions are more demanding than the words 'for a short time' suggest. The load must have a cap, the window must have an end and two real people must accept the operating and safety-watch posts. There must also be a usable response when a check fails. Without those details, the temporary arrangement can quietly become ordinary production under a more reassuring name.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 有限过渡可能保留完成特定转移所需的产出，适用于设备与人员必须按难以立即改变的顺序移动时。其条件比“短时间”四个字更严格：负荷有上限，窗口有终点，两名真实人员承接操作与安全观察岗，检查失败时也有可用处置。缺少这些细节，临时安排可能悄悄以更令人放心的名称变为日常生产。

entries.english_definition: A route through or between enclosed places.

contexts.paragraph_english: The centre of the cabin floor is cracked. A person may appear to cross it successfully while the damaged boards continue to move underneath. Do not use that as a load test. The emergency cabinet beside the port wall contains a hand tool and a short rescue line; both belong to this vessel's rescue kit. A loose gangboard is stored along the intact side of the cabin. Secure it across the damaged section, keeping its ends on sound supports, before directing anybody towards the shore exit. The reef path begins beyond that exit. This note describes the cabin passage, not the safety of the landing place outside. Check the shore notice before choosing an approach for the rescue boat.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 船舱中央地板已经开裂。有人一度踩过去，不能证明受损板材可承重。左舷救援柜存有手工具和一根救援索，均属于本船救援包。沿完好的侧壁放着一块踏板。先把踏板两端固定在可靠支承上，再安排人员走向岸边出口。出口外才是礁岸路径；本说明不能证明岸上接应点安全，需要另查岸边告示。

contexts.paragraph_english: When the small station runs within its recorded limit, the kitchen crew can check their feed. We can then request an onsite visit to the tower duty layer. You will inspect the tower there, with its operator. Leave the return passage usable and record the equipment and load boundaries on the final receipt.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 小站在记录限制内运行后，厨房人员可以验收回路。随后可申请到塔站值守层现场查验，须与塔站操作员一起在那里检查。保持返程通路，最终回执记清设备与负荷边界。

contexts.paragraph_english: Coast pickup acknowledgement. Four people registered at the sheltered assembly point will be collected, together with the technician. The receiving route is the northern reach; the southern steps remain unavailable. Wait at the shelter's marked boarding point. The receiving crew will carry everyone to the public arrival berth at Saltmist Harbour. This acknowledgement permits that rescue passage only. It is not a general sailing licence, a maintenance commission or the handover of a patrol vessel. Take the coast records with you, keeping their source and time labels.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 接应回执：接走避风棚登记的四名幸存者和检修员，经北段上船，南台阶仍不可用。在棚外登记登船点等接应，前往盐雾港公共接应泊位。这只允许本次救援通行，不是一般航行许可、检修委托或巡灯船移交。带走资料并保留来源、时间标签。

contexts.paragraph_english: Arrival record — rescue passage from the stranded coast. The public arrival berth receives the technician and four registered survivors. Record their arrival before requesting further harbour work; a person carried here is not automatically signed onto another vessel's crew. Two different berths are shown on the quay plan. The civil ferry is awaiting maintenance and a safe departure arrangement. The stored patrol boat has no handover authorisation on this arrival record. A harbour officer may review a limited maintenance request at the public dispatch desk. Bring the rescue acknowledgement and your inspection appointment, and consult the current closure order rather than assuming that rescue passage suspends it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 搁浅海岸救援入港记录：接应泊位接收检修员和四名已登记幸存者。先登记到港，再申请后续港口工作；接应入港不自动成为另一船的船员。码头显示不同泊位：民用渡轮待检修与安全撤离方案；封存巡灯船没有在此记录中授权移交。公共调度台可审查有限检修申请，须携救援回执及任职凭证，并查现行封港令。

entries.english_definition: Help or equipment that makes an activity possible.

contexts.paragraph_english: To the new technician, from Mara. If a record is marked for destruction, first ask who issued the instruction, which version it concerns and what other record can be used to check it. A tidy report may leave out the circumstances that made its conclusion seem convincing. I have enclosed a request to compare the public maintenance record with an independent source. Deal with immediate rescue work before following it. This letter was placed in the inspection post before your journey; it cannot tell you where I am when you read it. Do not treat my concerns as proof. Preserve what you actually find, including anything that does not support the explanation you expected.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 玛拉给新检修员的留言：遇到要求销毁的记录，先核对指令签发者、所指版本和可独立核验的来源。整齐报告可能省略形成结论的条件。附上公共检修记录比对请求，但眼前救援优先。信件在旅程前寄存，不能说明阅读时玛拉所在。疑虑不是证明，应保留实际找到的资料，包括不支持预期解释的部分。

contexts.paragraph_english: Coast team to the stranded crew. We first marked the south steps as a possible receiving point. That instruction is withdrawn: a fresh inspection found the lower steps separated from their support. Use the northern reach beyond the low wall instead. There are four survivors waiting for assistance, apart from the technician carrying this message. Keep the rescue line clear of the broken steps. Once everyone is under shelter, send your position, the number of people needing collection and the approach restriction. Do not ask the boat to follow the southern marker merely because it is easier to see. We will acknowledge the request through the coast relay.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 海岸队更正原先南台阶方案：现场复查发现下段台阶脱离支承，撤回旧指示。改用矮墙外的北段。有四名幸存者需要接应，不含传递消息的检修员。索具避开破损台阶。人员进入棚内后，发送位置、接应人数和进路限制，接应船不会因南标记显眼就改走那里。通过海岸中继确认求援。

contexts.paragraph_english: Comparison envelope for the coast recorder collected after the shore rescue. The original instrument label reports loss of the observed light signal at 21:14:12. Its last routine comparison with the ship clock had an uncertainty of approximately two seconds. The harbour control event is labelled 21:14:10 on a different clock. The handover copy reports a separate control-to-ship comparison within one second. The combined comparisons therefore allow a three-second interval between the two labelled clocks. These readings are consistent within that recorded interval; they are not evidence that every clock displayed an identical second. Together with the approved window and the duty handover, the records support a planned interruption with a required protection removed. Keep the original extract attached. Nothing in this envelope certifies the sender of the inspection mail as currently alive, safe or present at a particular destination.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 救援后实际取得的海岸记录器副本保留原标21:14:12，与船钟最近比对约有两秒不确定。控制钟21:14:10与其在已记不确定范围内相符，不是所有钟秒数完全一致；不证明导师当前存活、安全或去向。 值班记录另证控制钟与船钟相差一秒以内；合并两次比对界限允许两仪器标签有三秒差。

contexts.paragraph_english: Dispatcher: Before you collect any parts, there is a correction to the earlier message. We were told that the spare navigation beacon had been destroyed. The inspection does not support that account. The beacon itself still works; the damaged part is the bracket that holds it in place.

entries.english_definition: Examining things together to identify differences.

contexts.paragraph_english: Coast recorder extract. Instrument clock: 21:14:12, light signal lost at the observed tower channel. Further gaps occur in the same recording window, but the extract does not contain a complete network diagnosis. The shore clock and ship clock differ by approximately two seconds in their last routine comparison. Taken with the ship observation copy, this extract supports the order of light loss followed by course deviation. It does not name the person responsible, explain why every gap occurred or establish that the outage was deliberate. Keep the original time labels attached when making a later comparison.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 海岸记录器摘录：仪器钟21:14:12，所观测塔台信号消失；同一窗口还有其他缺口，摘录并非完整网络诊断。最近一次常规比对中，岸钟与船钟相差约两秒。结合船上抄记，资料支持先熄灯后偏航，不识别责任人，不解释每个缺口，也不证明故意断供。后续比对保留原始时间标签。

contexts.paragraph_english: For the comparison report, use the local group table and the residence checks together. Describe what the columns measure and what the check can support. The room codes are enough for the public table. If you want an identity attachment, ask for that specific version and purpose at the scope desk. We can keep the public inquiry moving while such a request is considered.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 比较报告请结合地方住区表和居住核查，说明两列衡量的内容及查验能够支持什么。公共表使用房间代码即可。查看身份附页时，请在范围台申请具体版本与用途。申请审议期间，公共调查仍可继续。

contexts.paragraph_english: Evening duty handover, retained copy. At 21:05 on D0, a later work instruction removed the second traffic check from this test. The receiving operator recorded the change rather than marking the check as completed. A routine comparison at 20:40 placed the control clock within one second of the ship clock. The local control event copy lists the output interruption at 21:14:10, on the control clock. The instruction identifier and its issuing office are retained for further examination. This copy is not sufficient to establish what every officer knew or intended. The output event and the removed check should be recorded as separate findings: one concerns what the equipment did, the other concerns which protection was omitted. The independent coast clock was not set from this control clock.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: D0 21:05的后续工作指令移除了第二次人船复核，接班者没有把它标作已做。控制钟记录21:14:10断供；签发标识保留待后续核验，不能据此判定所有人员的知情与意图。 20:40常规比对记控制钟与船钟相差不超过一秒。

contexts.paragraph_english: Comparison envelope for the coast recorder collected after the shore rescue. The original instrument label reports loss of the observed light signal at 21:14:12. Its last routine comparison with the ship clock had an uncertainty of approximately two seconds. The harbour control event is labelled 21:14:10 on a different clock. The handover copy reports a separate control-to-ship comparison within one second. The combined comparisons therefore allow a three-second interval between the two labelled clocks. These readings are consistent within that recorded interval; they are not evidence that every clock displayed an identical second. Together with the approved window and the duty handover, the records support a planned interruption with a required protection removed. Keep the original extract attached. Nothing in this envelope certifies the sender of the inspection mail as currently alive, safe or present at a particular destination.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 救援后实际取得的海岸记录器副本保留原标21:14:12，与船钟最近比对约有两秒不确定。控制钟21:14:10与其在已记不确定范围内相符，不是所有钟秒数完全一致；不证明导师当前存活、安全或去向。 值班记录另证控制钟与船钟相差一秒以内；合并两次比对界限允许两仪器标签有三秒差。

entries.english_definition: The reason for doing something.

contexts.paragraph_english: Limited maintenance exception. Havel, the dispatch officer, may commission inspection and repair of the civil ferry's navigation equipment and the local workshop arrangements needed to obtain its replacement parts. State that the purpose is evacuation assistance and identify those work areas in the request. Harbour main-generator operation is outside this exception: its safety isolation has not been confirmed. A commission allows local preparation; the ferry remains at the quay until a tested current configuration and an explicitly confirmed departure plan are available. Neither a fee nor a language score is required to request the commission. Crew recruitment, patrol-boat use and access to retained accident records are separate decisions and must not be inferred from this document.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 有限检修例外：调度负责人哈文可委托民用渡轮导航设备检修及为取替换件所需的本地工坊操作。申请写明协助撤离及这些范围。主发电机安全隔离尚未确认，操作它不在例外内。委托只允许准备；当前配置测试与明确离港方案确认完成前，渡轮留港。申请不需费用或英语分数；招募、巡灯船及事故记录调阅均另行授权。

contexts.paragraph_english: For the comparison report, use the local group table and the residence checks together. Describe what the columns measure and what the check can support. The room codes are enough for the public table. If you want an identity attachment, ask for that specific version and purpose at the scope desk. We can keep the public inquiry moving while such a request is considered.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 比较报告请结合地方住区表和居住核查，说明两列衡量的内容及查验能够支持什么。公共表使用房间代码即可。查看身份附页时，请在范围台申请具体版本与用途。申请审议期间，公共调查仍可继续。

contexts.paragraph_english: Begin at the public porches for rooms A, B and C. Record the people who voluntarily confirm that they live there. The ration sheet reports portions prepared and collected. The room index reports where this group is accommodated. Neither sheet alone proves that a particular person is present. Compare them with the witnessed visits and the current register, retaining the date and purpose of each record.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 请到A、B、C区公共门廊，记录自愿确认居住于此的人。口粮页记的是准备和领取份数，房间索引记的是这组人被安置在哪里。任何一张表都不能单独证明某人实际在场。把两表、现场走访和现行名册相互比较，并保留各记录日期和用途。

contexts.paragraph_english: Basic archive access may be registered for this check. Names in protected attachments require a separate request, a stated purpose and a permitted recipient. Keep the public room codes in your working summary. No resident has agreed to publication merely by accepting a meal or answering a question.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本次查验可以登记基础档案访问。受保护附页中的姓名须另外申请，说明用途与接收方。工作摘要使用公开房间代码。领取饭食或回答问题均未构成同意公开身份。

entries.english_definition: A record confirming that a particular transaction occurred.

contexts.paragraph_english: Both methods retain the greenhouse beds and leave a checkable result at the valves. Sampling secures the affected root section while its reaction is controlled; mechanical treatment secures the return and clears the external winding. Merely selecting a method does not produce a clearance receipt. The actual encounter or work procedure must reach its safe objective, after which the branch stands can be inspected again.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 两种方法均保留种植床，并在阀处留下可核查结果。取样方法在控制反应时固定根段；机械方法固定回流并清除外部缠绕。选择方法本身不产生回执。实际遭遇或工作程序达到安全目标后，方可重新检查支路。

contexts.paragraph_english: When the small station runs within its recorded limit, the kitchen crew can check their feed. We can then request an onsite visit to the tower duty layer. You will inspect the tower there, with its operator. Leave the return passage usable and record the equipment and load boundaries on the final receipt.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 小站在记录限制内运行后，厨房人员可以验收回路。随后可申请到塔站值守层现场查验，须与塔站操作员一起在那里检查。保持返程通路，最终回执记清设备与负荷边界。

contexts.paragraph_english: This permit covers the duty layer, the marked inspection stands and the return passage. The operator will compare the current isolation indicators, protected access and duty register with the local-station test receipt. Record what is inspected here rather than copying the machine-room result into a tower-safety field.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 许可覆盖值守层、标记查验站位与返程通道。当班操作员对照地方支站试验回执，核查当前隔离指示、防护通路与值班记录。应记下塔站实际检查内容，不能把机房结果抄成塔站安全状态。

contexts.paragraph_english: Review desk: You have brought the transfer records, the residence check and the station boundary receipt. We can receive them in more than one form. A public summary can use room codes, dates and source references, while the protected originals remain available for controlled review. A delegated review package can instead go to a named review desk under its stated purpose. In either arrangement, the important public claims need a route by which someone can check the supporting records.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 审查台：你带来了转移记录、居住核查和支站边界回执。可以用多种形式交付。公共摘要可用房间代码、日期和来源索引，受保护原稿保留受控查验；受托审查包也可按用途交给指定审查台。无论哪种安排，重要公共陈述都需要可检查支持记录的路径。

entries.english_definition: A device with parts that perform mechanical work.

contexts.paragraph_english: Tidegate maintenance procedure. The tower unit is separate from the west workshop machine and from the civil ferry supply. Confirm the local supply indication at the tower base before entering the control level. During the encounter, the left cooling valve is worked from the left front position and the right valve from the right front position. Either valve may be closed first. Local supply isolation is operated from the left rear position after both valves are closed. The interlock refuses an early isolation request without spending its operating allowance. Each person may operate one work point in a personal turn. Reducing the unit to its last reserve of stopping progress does not establish safety: both valves, isolation and a controlled threat are all required. Ordinary shields and cleansing cannot substitute for this sequence.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 潮门塔机械独立于工坊及民用渡轮。进控制层前在塔基查本地供给。左前左阀、右前右阀，次序不限；左后隔离需双阀完成，每人每个人回合最多一个现场操作。打至最低制止进度不等于安全，仍需两阀、隔离和制止。

contexts.paragraph_english: Local operator: Before we open the machine-room work zone, show me the upper-floor checks. The isolation handle must still be in the state you inspected. We also need the stopped conveyor record, the fixed external clamp and the dry-route reading. A successful action from an older configuration will not cover a change you made afterwards. We can repeat the affected check without throwing away the clamp or drawing a second unique connector from the cabinet.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 地方检修员：开放机房工作区前，请出示上层检查。隔离手柄必须保持核查时状态，还需要输送器停转记录、固定外部夹具和干燥通路读数。旧配置下的成功动作不能涵盖后来改动。可以重做受影响检查，不必丢掉夹具，也不用从料柜再领唯一连接头。

contexts.paragraph_english: Keep the greenhouse beds intact where a safe sample or mechanical clearance permits work. The kitchen feed will need a later load test from the machine room. Opening the stair establishes a route for inspection; it does not establish local power, tower safety or permission to change the central interlock.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 安全取样或机械清理可以完成工作时，应保留种植床。厨房回路还须由机房完成负荷试验。打开检修梯只建立查验路线，未证明本地供能或塔站安全，也未许可改动中央联锁。

contexts.paragraph_english: The older drawing shows a local reserve source feeding two branches through a hand selector. Branch A serves the kitchen lamps and serving counter. Branch B serves the greenhouse wash pump. The reserve source is protected by the original local cut-off. Its operating labels are still attached to the machine-room seat and must be checked there before a test.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 旧图画出一个地方备用源，经手动选择器为两支路供能。A支路服务厨房照明与供餐台，B支路服务温室洗水泵。备用源保留原有地方切断装置，源座上的运行标签须在机房现场核对后才能试验。

entries.english_definition: People who operate a vessel or equipment together.

contexts.paragraph_english: Bridge observation copy — times use the same ship clock. 21:14:10: the tower light disappeared from view while the heading indicator still showed the assigned course. 21:16:00: the helmsman reported a course deviation. 21:17:40: contact with the reef was felt. The entries describe what the crew observed; they do not identify a switch operator or establish the reason for the loss of light. The ship clock has not yet been compared with a shore instrument. Preserve this copy and compare it with an independent record when the rescue work allows it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 桥台抄记使用同一船钟。21:14:10，塔灯消失，当时航向指示仍显示规定航向。21:16:00，舵手报告偏航。21:17:40，船体触礁。记录只说明船员观察到的先后，不识别开关操作者，也不证明熄灯原因。船钟尚未与岸上仪器核对；先保留副本，完成救援后再找独立记录。

contexts.paragraph_english: Coast team to the stranded crew. We first marked the south steps as a possible receiving point. That instruction is withdrawn: a fresh inspection found the lower steps separated from their support. Use the northern reach beyond the low wall instead. There are four survivors waiting for assistance, apart from the technician carrying this message. Keep the rescue line clear of the broken steps. Once everyone is under shelter, send your position, the number of people needing collection and the approach restriction. Do not ask the boat to follow the southern marker merely because it is easier to see. We will acknowledge the request through the coast relay.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 海岸队更正原先南台阶方案：现场复查发现下段台阶脱离支承，撤回旧指示。改用矮墙外的北段。有四名幸存者需要接应，不含传递消息的检修员。索具避开破损台阶。人员进入棚内后，发送位置、接应人数和进路限制，接应船不会因南标记显眼就改走那里。通过海岸中继确认求援。

contexts.paragraph_english: Coast pickup acknowledgement. Four people registered at the sheltered assembly point will be collected, together with the technician. The receiving route is the northern reach; the southern steps remain unavailable. Wait at the shelter's marked boarding point. The receiving crew will carry everyone to the public arrival berth at Saltmist Harbour. This acknowledgement permits that rescue passage only. It is not a general sailing licence, a maintenance commission or the handover of a patrol vessel. Take the coast records with you, keeping their source and time labels.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 接应回执：接走避风棚登记的四名幸存者和检修员，经北段上船，南台阶仍不可用。在棚外登记登船点等接应，前往盐雾港公共接应泊位。这只允许本次救援通行，不是一般航行许可、检修委托或巡灯船移交。带走资料并保留来源、时间标签。

contexts.paragraph_english: Arrival record — rescue passage from the stranded coast. The public arrival berth receives the technician and four registered survivors. Record their arrival before requesting further harbour work; a person carried here is not automatically signed onto another vessel's crew. Two different berths are shown on the quay plan. The civil ferry is awaiting maintenance and a safe departure arrangement. The stored patrol boat has no handover authorisation on this arrival record. A harbour officer may review a limited maintenance request at the public dispatch desk. Bring the rescue acknowledgement and your inspection appointment, and consult the current closure order rather than assuming that rescue passage suspends it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 搁浅海岸救援入港记录：接应泊位接收检修员和四名已登记幸存者。先登记到港，再申请后续港口工作；接应入港不自动成为另一船的船员。码头显示不同泊位：民用渡轮待检修与安全撤离方案；封存巡灯船没有在此记录中授权移交。公共调度台可审查有限检修申请，须携救援回执及任职凭证，并查现行封港令。

Record what is inspected here rather than copying the machine-room result into a tower-safety field.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 许可覆盖值守层、标记查验站位与返程通道。当班操作员对照地方支站试验回执，核查当前隔离指示、防护通路与值班记录。应记下塔站实际检查内容，不能把机房结果抄成塔站安全状态。

entries.english_definition: Related to the practical operation of specialised equipment.

contexts.paragraph_english: The index links local interlock plate IL-2 to maintenance batch MC-2 at the bell-mine workshop. It records a destination for checking the batch's original instrument sheets and acceptance versions. The priory copy contains the batch reference and a dispatch acknowledgement, not the workshop's complete technical file.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本地联锁标牌IL-2在索引中关联沉钟矿区工坊检修批次MC-2，指明应到何处核对该批次原始仪表页与验收版本。修院副本只有批次索引与发件确认，没有工坊完整技术档案。

contexts.paragraph_english: If the local load has changed since the record was made, keep both the old observation settings and the current configuration. Do not alter the earlier numbers to make the package look consistent. Say which relationship is being tested and which questions remain. The present data can direct a technical inquiry without pretending that it has already found the whole cause.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 记录完成后地方负荷若变动，请同时保留旧观察设置与当前配置。不要为资料看起来一致而修改旧数值。说明待试验的关系与余下问题；当前数据可以引导技术调查，无需假装已经查明全部原因。

contexts.paragraph_english: The two incomplete checks describe a safety function that had not been restored at stage I. Keep that scope in a finding. This sheet alone does not name every decision maker, explain the later supply quota, or resolve the wider cause of dangerous changes. Those questions require additional records and technical review.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 两项未完成检查说明，阶段I的安全功能尚未恢复。核查结论保留这个范围。仅此页尚未识别全部决策者，无法解释后来供给配额，也未解决危险变化的广泛原因；那些问题需要更多记录与技术核验。

contexts.paragraph_english: The records themselves need suitable access. A public finding can describe the batch, incomplete function and signed decision while unnecessary household details remain protected. A controlled reviewer may need the full technical fields and a route to the original. These arrangements should specify a recipient, purpose and version. They should also explain how a challenge can reach the reviewer. A promise that evidence exists is of little help if the promised source cannot be inspected or if an old permission has been stretched to cover a new use.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 记录需要合适访问范围。公共结论可以说明批次、未完成功能与签章决定，同时保护无关住户信息。受控复核人也许需要完整技术字段及查原稿的通路。这些安排应注明接收方、用途、版本，并说明如何提出质疑。若承诺来源无法查阅，或把旧许可扩成新用途，仅声称有证据并没有多大帮助。

entries.english_definition: A written or visible sign used to identify something.

contexts.paragraph_english: At the layout stand, mark the chosen beds and ask the growers to check the available space. Saving an allocation note preserves a proposal. Actual planting, once authorised and carried out, leaves a dated work record. Until there is an agreed allocation and that record, the trial remains planned. This work is optional and does not block the transfer investigation or require publishing anyone's identity.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 在布局台标床位，由种植者核对空间。保存分配稿只留下提案；获准并实际种植后才有日期工作记录。未有共识与实际记录时，试种仍计划中。此工作可选，不阻断转移调查，也不要求公开身份。

contexts.paragraph_english: The last call used the codes W1, W2 and W3. I heard all three reply, but I was at this station, not beside them. I can confirm the call and the route instruction. The rescue team must confirm the people at the shelter, and the receiving desk must confirm their arrival. Do not mark those later steps from my message.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 上一呼叫用了W1、W2、W3代号，我听到三人回应，但我在此站，没有站在他们身旁。我能确认呼叫与通路指示。救援队须到避护处确认本人，接收台须确认到达；不能用我的消息填写后来步骤。

contexts.paragraph_english: Current shift board: W1, W2 and W3 were assigned to the cutting face. Their return boxes remain blank. A blank box means that this desk has not confirmed their return; it is not a death record. The signal clerk received a call from the cutting-face shelter after the lower route became blocked. Mark a return only when the receiving desk sees the person or verifies an actual escorted handover.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本班工作板：W1、W2、W3分派至采掘面，返程栏仍空白。空白表示此台尚未确认返回，并非死亡记录。下层通路受阻后，信号员接到采掘面避护处呼叫。接收台实际见到本人或核对护送交接后，才能登记返回。

contexts.paragraph_english: The calibration room contains the installed island-trial controller C, a local reserve module and two labelled channels. Channel Z is the zero reference; channel R is the fixed reference mark. Check Z at 0 and R at 10 before recording a calibration. These are local instrument marks, not tower operating units. Both checks must belong to the current instrument revision. Changing the channel connection or bypassing its isolation invalidates the previous check.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 校准间已装孤网控制器C、本地储备模块和两标记通道。Z为零参考，R为固定参考标。记录校准前，Z应为0、R应为10；它们是本地仪表标记，不是塔运行单位。两检查都应属于当前仪表版本，改连接或绕隔离令旧检查失效。

entries.english_definition: A place providing protection from danger or weather.

contexts.paragraph_english: The shore winch has its own small reserve; it is not supplied by the harbour generator or by a ship battery. Switch its local power off and isolate the drive before seating the displaced cable. Secure the rescue line at the marked anchor, then set the receiving direction. The cable and line may be prepared in either order while the drive is isolated. Restore local power only after both are secure. Run the tension check with no people on the line. A check belongs to that configuration: moving the receiving direction, reseating the cable or changing power cancels its validity. The nearby animals must be kept away from the receiving path before the line carries people. If a check fails, keep people in the protected assembly area and inspect the preparation again; taking time to read this card does not change the number of survivors. The shelter retains a working short-range distress set for the shore receiving team. It can send the registered rescue request before the separate coast-to-harbour relay is restored. Harbour pickup is confirmed through that relay later; a saved draft at the shelter has not yet sent a request.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 岸边绞盘使用自己的储备，和港口发电机、船电池无关。关闭本地电源并隔离驱动后，重新落座移位的钢缆。救援索固定在标记锚点，设置接应方向；隔离状态下，钢缆与索具可按任意先后准备。两者固定后才能恢复本地电源，先空载检查张力。证书只对应当次配置；改方向、缆线或电源均使旧检查失效。承载前须制止接应路径附近的动物威胁。检查失败时人员留在保护集合处，阅读不会减少幸存者。 救援棚有可用的短距求援台，能先向岸上接应队发送已登记求援；海岸至港口的独立中继另行恢复，之后才能确认港口接应。发送台保存稿件还没有发送请求。

contexts.paragraph_english: Coast team to the stranded crew. We first marked the south steps as a possible receiving point. That instruction is withdrawn: a fresh inspection found the lower steps separated from their support. Use the northern reach beyond the low wall instead. There are four survivors waiting for assistance, apart from the technician carrying this message. Keep the rescue line clear of the broken steps. Once everyone is under shelter, send your position, the number of people needing collection and the approach restriction. Do not ask the boat to follow the southern marker merely because it is easier to see. We will acknowledge the request through the coast relay.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 海岸队更正原先南台阶方案：现场复查发现下段台阶脱离支承，撤回旧指示。改用矮墙外的北段。有四名幸存者需要接应，不含传递消息的检修员。索具避开破损台阶。人员进入棚内后，发送位置、接应人数和进路限制，接应船不会因南标记显眼就改走那里。通过海岸中继确认求援。

contexts.paragraph_english: This relay records signals locally even when its outgoing link is unavailable. The independent recorder and the outgoing transmitter are separate parts of the station. Before touching the displaced outgoing lead, switch the local transmitter off and isolate it. Seat the lead, restore the station's own reserve and run a link check. The test confirms this lead and power configuration only. If either changes, repeat it before requesting a boat. A successful link test is not evidence that a distant tower is safe. The postal locker may be opened for the named technician after the shore rescue has been completed. Its contents are correspondence, not a certificate about the sender's present whereabouts. The rear latch can be opened from this room to provide a shorter route back to the rescue shelter.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 中继站外发链路中断时仍可本地记录；独立记录器与外发设备是两个部件。检修移位接线前关闭并隔离本地发送设备，再落座接线，恢复本站储备，做当前配置链路检查。改变接线或电源须重新检查；成功不证明远方塔站安全。救援完成后，具名检修员才可领取邮务柜通信，它不证明寄信人目前所在或状态。后门内闩可从站内打开，缩短返回救援棚的路线。

contexts.paragraph_english: Coast pickup acknowledgement. Four people registered at the sheltered assembly point will be collected, together with the technician. The receiving route is the northern reach; the southern steps remain unavailable. Wait at the shelter's marked boarding point. The receiving crew will carry everyone to the public arrival berth at Saltmist Harbour. This acknowledgement permits that rescue passage only. It is not a general sailing licence, a maintenance commission or the handover of a patrol vessel. Take the coast records with you, keeping their source and time labels.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 接应回执：接走避风棚登记的四名幸存者和检修员，经北段上船，南台阶仍不可用。在棚外登记登船点等接应，前往盐雾港公共接应泊位。这只允许本次救援通行，不是一般航行许可、检修委托或巡灯船移交。带走资料并保留来源、时间标签。

entries.english_definition: A formal instruction authorising a particular piece of work.

contexts.paragraph_english: Coast pickup acknowledgement. Four people registered at the sheltered assembly point will be collected, together with the technician. The receiving route is the northern reach; the southern steps remain unavailable. Wait at the shelter's marked boarding point. The receiving crew will carry everyone to the public arrival berth at Saltmist Harbour. This acknowledgement permits that rescue passage only. It is not a general sailing licence, a maintenance commission or the handover of a patrol vessel. Take the coast records with you, keeping their source and time labels.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 接应回执：接走避风棚登记的四名幸存者和检修员，经北段上船，南台阶仍不可用。在棚外登记登船点等接应，前往盐雾港公共接应泊位。这只允许本次救援通行，不是一般航行许可、检修委托或巡灯船移交。带走资料并保留来源、时间标签。

contexts.paragraph_english: For the reserve test, keep the source isolated while seating the connector. The selector has positions for the kitchen, the wash pump and an alternating cycle. Read the load labels and trace the later interlock plate as well as the old drawing. We are not changing the tower outlet under this commission. If a trial is rejected, return the source to isolation, correct the selector and try again. The reserve is a fixed local facility, so this procedure does not take a tower provision pack from your account.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 试验备用源时，应在隔离状态下座好连接头。选择器有厨房、洗水泵和交替档。阅读负荷标签，同时对照后加联锁牌与旧图。委托不包括改变塔站出口。试验被拒时，恢复隔离、修正档位再试。备用源是固定地方设施，本程序不从工程账扣塔站保障包。

contexts.paragraph_english: Inspection appointment. The bearer is a trainee technician assigned to public navigation maintenance. The appointment establishes a role, not unrestricted access to every power installation. Local harbour work must be commissioned by the officer responsible for the site. Follow the conditions on that commission and keep separate records for each device. A civil ferry's navigation lamp, a workshop's independent controller and the harbour main generator are not interchangeable authorisations. This appointment was carried on the inspection vessel. It does not certify language performance, membership of a faction or the present location of the technician's mentor.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 随检修船携带的任职凭证：持有人为公共导航检修见习员。身份不等于任意电力设施访问权；地方工作须由现场负责人委托，并按设备分别记录。民用渡轮导航灯、工坊独立控制器、港口主发电机不是通用授权。凭证不证明英语表现、组织成员身份或导师目前位置。

contexts.paragraph_english: Harbour closure order — current copy. General departures are suspended while the navigation restrictions are reviewed. Rescue arrivals continue at the public receiving berth. An arrival under that provision does not grant a vessel permission to depart. The dispatch office may issue a limited local maintenance commission where the work supports a specific safe evacuation arrangement. The commission must name its work area and power boundary. It does not itself clear a route, approve an untested navigation lamp or transfer ownership of a vessel. A later departure instruction must be checked against the route notices and the vessel's current configuration. The public consultation desk remains accessible during the closure; restricted records and equipment require their own authorisation.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 现行封港令：一般出港暂停，公共泊位仍接收救援入港；允许入港不等于允许出港。调度室可为明确安全撤离工作签发有限地方检修委托，写明作业范围和供电边界。委托本身不开放航道、不认可未经测试导航灯、不移交船产权。出港另需按航道资料及船舶当前配置核对。公共咨询区开放，受限记录与设备需各自授权。

entries.english_definition: A boat or ship used for travel on water.

contexts.paragraph_english: The centre of the cabin floor is cracked. A person may appear to cross it successfully while the damaged boards continue to move underneath. Do not use that as a load test. The emergency cabinet beside the port wall contains a hand tool and a short rescue line; both belong to this vessel's rescue kit. A loose gangboard is stored along the intact side of the cabin. Secure it across the damaged section, keeping its ends on sound supports, before directing anybody towards the shore exit. The reef path begins beyond that exit. This note describes the cabin passage, not the safety of the landing place outside. Check the shore notice before choosing an approach for the rescue boat.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 船舱中央地板已经开裂。有人一度踩过去，不能证明受损板材可承重。左舷救援柜存有手工具和一根救援索，均属于本船救援包。沿完好的侧壁放着一块踏板。先把踏板两端固定在可靠支承上，再安排人员走向岸边出口。出口外才是礁岸路径；本说明不能证明岸上接应点安全，需要另查岸边告示。

contexts.paragraph_english: Freight clerk: Bring the sample to the actual packing stand, with the observation stage and the three document versions. I can acknowledge the authorised outgoing package and keep its custody reference. I cannot acknowledge a sample which has only been named in a draft. The academic receiving desk will still need to inspect what reaches it, and the voyage requires its own vessel and route checks.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 货运员：请带样本到真实包装站位，附观察阶段与三份文书版本。我能确认获准发出包，保留保管索引，不能确认仅写在稿中的样本。学城接收台仍要查实际收到什么，航行也另需船只与航路检查。

contexts.paragraph_english: Coast pickup acknowledgement. Four people registered at the sheltered assembly point will be collected, together with the technician. The receiving route is the northern reach; the southern steps remain unavailable. Wait at the shelter's marked boarding point. The receiving crew will carry everyone to the public arrival berth at Saltmist Harbour. This acknowledgement permits that rescue passage only. It is not a general sailing licence, a maintenance commission or the handover of a patrol vessel. Take the coast records with you, keeping their source and time labels.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 接应回执：接走避风棚登记的四名幸存者和检修员，经北段上船，南台阶仍不可用。在棚外登记登船点等接应，前往盐雾港公共接应泊位。这只允许本次救援通行，不是一般航行许可、检修委托或巡灯船移交。带走资料并保留来源、时间标签。

contexts.paragraph_english: Arrival record — rescue passage from the stranded coast. The public arrival berth receives the technician and four registered survivors. Record their arrival before requesting further harbour work; a person carried here is not automatically signed onto another vessel's crew. Two different berths are shown on the quay plan. The civil ferry is awaiting maintenance and a safe departure arrangement. The stored patrol boat has no handover authorisation on this arrival record. A harbour officer may review a limited maintenance request at the public dispatch desk. Bring the rescue acknowledgement and your inspection appointment, and consult the current closure order rather than assuming that rescue passage suspends it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 搁浅海岸救援入港记录：接应泊位接收检修员和四名已登记幸存者。先登记到港，再申请后续港口工作；接应入港不自动成为另一船的船员。码头显示不同泊位：民用渡轮待检修与安全撤离方案；封存巡灯船没有在此记录中授权移交。公共调度台可审查有限检修申请，须携救援回执及任职凭证，并查现行封港令。

entries.english_definition: A matter requiring attention or a decision.

contexts.paragraph_english: Harbour closure order — current copy. General departures are suspended while the navigation restrictions are reviewed. Rescue arrivals continue at the public receiving berth. An arrival under that provision does not grant a vessel permission to depart. The dispatch office may issue a limited local maintenance commission where the work supports a specific safe evacuation arrangement. The commission must name its work area and power boundary. It does not itself clear a route, approve an untested navigation lamp or transfer ownership of a vessel. A later departure instruction must be checked against the route notices and the vessel's current configuration. The public consultation desk remains accessible during the closure; restricted records and equipment require their own authorisation.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 现行封港令：一般出港暂停，公共泊位仍接收救援入港；允许入港不等于允许出港。调度室可为明确安全撤离工作签发有限地方检修委托，写明作业范围和供电边界。委托本身不开放航道、不认可未经测试导航灯、不移交船产权。出港另需按航道资料及船舶当前配置核对。公共咨询区开放，受限记录与设备需各自授权。

contexts.paragraph_english: You asked whether I could give you an exact minute for the authorisation. I can show you the sheet, including the damaged part of its time box, and the statement that it was checked before departure. I cannot read a reliable issue minute from that box. A report may state that a detail remains unknown. There is no need to fill the gap with a plausible-looking number.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 你问能否给出授权的准确分钟。我可以展示时间框破损的原页，以及出发前核查过授权的陈述；无法从时间框读出可靠分钟。报告可以写某项细节仍未知，不必用貌似合理的数字填空。

contexts.paragraph_english: Draft contingency notice, prepared on D0 at 20:50. This copy was stored with the evening dispatch papers; its issue box is blank. The text describes a possible interruption of the harbour light and tells receiving crews to wait for a revised route message. A handwritten heading calls it an accident notice, but the heading does not identify a cause. Preparing a notice in advance may indicate planning for a risk. It does not, by itself, show that somebody intended a grounding. Preserve the draft label and the empty issue box when citing this document. The approval and execution records are held separately. Do not replace them with a conclusion drawn from the title.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: D0 20:50准备、尚未签发的应急通知。事故字样不说明原因，预先准备通知不能单独证明故意搁浅；引用时保留草稿标签及空白签发栏，另查批准与执行记录。

contexts.paragraph_english: June also requests inspection of the greenhouse supply stair. This permits the local handles, fixed repair cabinet and transfer-station circuits described in the maintenance notice. It does not authorise changing the tower's central interlock. Bring back a factual difference report and the equipment boundary before asking the local desk to issue the next work scope.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 琼还请求检查温室供给检修梯。允许范围是告示列明的地方手柄、固定料柜和转供站回路，未包括改动塔站中央联锁。请把实际差异与设备边界带回地方工作台，再申请下一步工作范围。

entries.english_definition: A collection of records kept for future reference.

contexts.paragraph_english: Harbour loan and cross-region inspection terms. Once the Tidegate local safety record has been verified, return to the receiving berth to acknowledge the loan of the sealed inspection vessel Glimmer. Its watch officer maintains the basic ship service; accepting a companion invitation is not a condition of using the vessel. The deck, archive cabin and shared maintenance compartment are three spaces of this one ship, not separate ships at each harbour. The loan does not transfer the civil ferry or its installed equipment. The next inspection commission points to the grove receiving records. It does not certify the current whereabouts of the missing mentor. Basic sailing along an opened route does not require a fuel ticket. The vessel still needs its ordinary gradual repairs; the handover does not turn it into a fully upgraded ship.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 塔站实际安全核验后回接应泊位明确接收封存旧巡灯船微光号及跨区核查委托。船务值守不依赖接受莉娜邀请，三空间是同一船。民用渡轮及船上设备不转移，不证明导师当前去向，不收死锁燃料门票。

contexts.paragraph_english: Archive clerk: We have laid out the local M-12 papers on two stands. Start with either one, but keep the references attached when you make your notes. The departure officer's page and the receiving officer's page describe different observations. The ledger was prepared from those records later. If the departure entry appears twice, count its source once. The second copy is useful when a page cannot be handled; it does not add another person who saw the vehicle leave.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 阅览台员：M-12地方文件摆在两个站位，可以从任一处开始，但记笔记时要保留来源编号。出发记录员和接收员记的是不同观察，总账稍后由这些记录编成。出发条目即使出现两次，来源也只算一次。另一份副本有助于无法触摸原页时查阅，没有增加看到车辆离开的人。

contexts.paragraph_english: Basic archive access may be registered for this check. Names in protected attachments require a separate request, a stated purpose and a permitted recipient. Keep the public room codes in your working summary. No resident has agreed to publication merely by accepting a meal or answering a question.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本次查验可以登记基础档案访问。受保护附页中的姓名须另外申请，说明用途与接收方。工作摘要使用公开房间代码。领取饭食或回答问题均未构成同意公开身份。

contexts.paragraph_english: Transfer TR-D1-7, version 1. Controlled extract from the receiving officer's custody handover record. The record is dated D−1 relative to the opening blackout. It identifies Mara Venn by the protected identification reference checked at the archive desk. The receiving officer recorded her as alive when custody was handed over. The destination is written as facility code F-17. No public site name or current address is supplied on this extract.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 转移TR-D1-7，第1版。接收员看管交接原稿的受控摘录，日期为开场熄灯前一天D−1。摘录用阅览台核对过的受保护身份索引识别玛拉·维恩。接收员记下她在看管交接时仍然活着。目的地写作设施代码F-17，本摘录没有公开地点名称或现行地址。

entries.english_definition: A separate continuation from a shared earlier state.

contexts.paragraph_english: The older drawing shows a local reserve source feeding two branches through a hand selector. Branch A serves the kitchen lamps and serving counter. Branch B serves the greenhouse wash pump. The reserve source is protected by the original local cut-off. Its operating labels are still attached to the machine-room seat and must be checked there before a test.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 旧图画出一个地方备用源，经手动选择器为两支路供能。A支路服务厨房照明与供餐台，B支路服务温室洗水泵。备用源保留原有地方切断装置，源座上的运行标签须在机房现场核对后才能试验。

contexts.paragraph_english: At the branch valves, we will identify the two blocked returns before choosing a procedure. The sample procedure and the mechanical procedure both have a safe objective. I will work with the local crew if your travelling companions stay outside. Please read the visible hazard plan before entering. A method written in your notebook is a proposal until the actual work is carried out and its result is accepted.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 在支路阀处，我们先识别两处受阻回流，再选择程序。取样和机械程序均有安全目标。若旅行同伴留在外面，我会与地方班组协作。进入前请读可见危险计划。笔记里选了方法，仍只是提案；须实际执行，取得被接受的结果。

contexts.paragraph_english: For the present local work segment, the cabinet notice rates the tested reserve at six load units. The kitchen branch needs four units and the wash pump three. These are the station's own fictional planning units; they are not hours of fuel or a conversion into personal marks. Each branch can be served within the limit. A simultaneous request for both would total seven units. The selector has an alternating position as well as individual A and B positions.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 当前地方工作段备用源能力列为六个负荷单位。厨房需要四，洗水泵需要三。这是虚构设施的规划单位，不是燃料小时，也不能折算刻币。各支路单独运行均在限制内；同时运行两条则合计七。选择器设交替档以及独立A、B档。

contexts.paragraph_english: Record which branch was tested, the selector revision and the observed load. A successful test supports operation at that configuration and scope. Changing the selector or reserve connection requires a fresh test. The drawing demonstrates a local arrangement that can be inspected; it does not list the equipment, crew or supply needed to convert the modern tower.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 记录所测试支路、选择器修订状态与实际负荷。成功试验只支持对应配置与范围；改动档位或备用接线后须重新试验。旧图提供地方运行结构，没有列出现代塔站改造所需设备、人员与供给。

entries.english_definition: A boundary beyond which something is not permitted or possible.

contexts.paragraph_english: Route B may be used only while the auxiliary pump is running and only by vessels with a draught of no more than 1.2 metres. Both conditions apply. The pump controls water in the dock facilities; it does not alter the draught limit printed in this notice.

When the small station runs within its recorded limit, the kitchen crew can check their feed. We can then request an onsite visit to the tower duty layer. You will inspect the tower there, with its operator. Leave the return passage usable and record the equipment and load boundaries on the final receipt.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 小站在记录限制内运行后，厨房人员可以验收回路。随后可申请到塔站值守层现场查验，须与塔站操作员一起在那里检查。保持返程通路，最终回执记清设备与负荷边界。

contexts.paragraph_english: The columns describe different measures: an administrative classification and a dated residence check. The figures do not explain the original reasons for classification. Record the mismatch, the scope of this group and the limit on interpretation. Preserve the evidence references for later review.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 两列衡量不同对象：行政分类与有日期的居住核查。数字没有解释最初分类原因。应记录差异、住区组范围和解释限制，并保留证据来源。

contexts.paragraph_english: For the present local work segment, the cabinet notice rates the tested reserve at six load units. The kitchen branch needs four units and the wash pump three. These are the station's own fictional planning units; they are not hours of fuel or a conversion into personal marks. Each branch can be served within the limit. A simultaneous request for both would total seven units. The selector has an alternating position as well as individual A and B positions.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 当前地方工作段备用源能力列为六个负荷单位。厨房需要四，洗水泵需要三。这是虚构设施的规划单位，不是燃料小时，也不能折算刻币。各支路单独运行均在限制内；同时运行两条则合计七。选择器设交替档以及独立A、B档。

entries.english_definition: A route through which information or a signal passes.

contexts.paragraph_english: Coast recorder extract. Instrument clock: 21:14:12, light signal lost at the observed tower channel. Further gaps occur in the same recording window, but the extract does not contain a complete network diagnosis. The shore clock and ship clock differ by approximately two seconds in their last routine comparison. Taken with the ship observation copy, this extract supports the order of light loss followed by course deviation. It does not name the person responsible, explain why every gap occurred or establish that the outage was deliberate. Keep the original time labels attached when making a later comparison.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 海岸记录器摘录：仪器钟21:14:12，所观测塔台信号消失；同一窗口还有其他缺口，摘录并非完整网络诊断。最近一次常规比对中，岸钟与船钟相差约两秒。结合船上抄记，资料支持先熄灯后偏航，不识别责任人，不解释每个缺口，也不证明故意断供。后续比对保留原始时间标签。

contexts.paragraph_english: Electrician: Exactly. The route still has to be selected from the current notices and the ferry particulars. I am confirming the equipment arrangement, not saying that every channel is suitable. Write down the route, the restrictions that ruled out the alternatives, and what the crew must do before leaving. If you are not sure what an instruction means, ask for clarification rather than treating a guess as approval.

All departures remain subject to the current navigation restrictions. Route A is closed until further notice. A previous journey through that channel is not evidence that it is safe to use today, and an older chart should not be treated as permission to enter it.

A separate notice at the dispatch desk sets out the conditions for Route B. Crews should compare those conditions with the particulars of their own vessel rather than assume that a channel available to one boat is available to every boat. The departure plan must identify the chosen route and explain any equipment arrangements on which it depends.

entries.english_definition: The act of making equipment or a system work.

contexts.paragraph_english: Limited maintenance exception. Havel, the dispatch officer, may commission inspection and repair of the civil ferry's navigation equipment and the local workshop arrangements needed to obtain its replacement parts. State that the purpose is evacuation assistance and identify those work areas in the request. Harbour main-generator operation is outside this exception: its safety isolation has not been confirmed. A commission allows local preparation; the ferry remains at the quay until a tested current configuration and an explicitly confirmed departure plan are available. Neither a fee nor a language score is required to request the commission. Crew recruitment, patrol-boat use and access to retained accident records are separate decisions and must not be inferred from this document.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 有限检修例外：调度负责人哈文可委托民用渡轮导航设备检修及为取替换件所需的本地工坊操作。申请写明协助撤离及这些范围。主发电机安全隔离尚未确认，操作它不在例外内。委托只允许准备；当前配置测试与明确离港方案确认完成前，渡轮留港。申请不需费用或英语分数；招募、巡灯船及事故记录调阅均另行授权。

contexts.paragraph_english: Safety watcher: I can accept the separate watch post and record the checks for the current configuration. If a connection or load setting changes, the earlier pass does not remain current. A fault needs a safe response, and the fixed return route must stay usable. The written handover should identify me and the operator, the setting tested and the window's end. It can acknowledge uncertainty about the wider disturbance pattern. Our work establishes a local bounded operation; it does not certify the cause of every mine hazard or authorise a future central-network policy.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 安全观察员：我可承接独立观察岗，记录当前配置检查。接线或负荷变化后，旧通过不能继续算当前有效。故障须有安全处置，固定返程保持可用。书面交接应列我与操作员、受检设置和窗口终点，也可说明广泛扰动模式仍不确定。我们建立本地有界运行，尚未认证所有危险原因，也未授权未来中央政策。

contexts.paragraph_english: An instruction to start the pump therefore concerns the operation of the facilities, not permission for a particular vessel to enter the channel. For this evacuation, use the vessel particulars recorded for the approved load. A change to that load is not an authorised alternative within the present operation. Keep this restriction with the departure record.

Record which branch was tested, the selector revision and the observed load. A successful test supports operation at that configuration and scope. Changing the selector or reserve connection requires a fresh test. The drawing demonstrates a local arrangement that can be inspected; it does not list the equipment, crew or supply needed to convert the modern tower.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 记录所测试支路、选择器修订状态与实际负荷。成功试验只支持对应配置与范围；改动档位或备用接线后须重新试验。旧图提供地方运行结构，没有列出现代塔站改造所需设备、人员与供给。

entries.english_definition: A scheduled period during which someone monitors conditions.

contexts.paragraph_english: Harbour loan and cross-region inspection terms. Once the Tidegate local safety record has been verified, return to the receiving berth to acknowledge the loan of the sealed inspection vessel Glimmer. Its watch officer maintains the basic ship service; accepting a companion invitation is not a condition of using the vessel. The deck, archive cabin and shared maintenance compartment are three spaces of this one ship, not separate ships at each harbour. The loan does not transfer the civil ferry or its installed equipment. The next inspection commission points to the grove receiving records. It does not certify the current whereabouts of the missing mentor. Basic sailing along an opened route does not require a fuel ticket. The vessel still needs its ordinary gradual repairs; the handover does not turn it into a fully upgraded ship.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 塔站实际安全核验后回接应泊位明确接收封存旧巡灯船微光号及跨区核查委托。船务值守不依赖接受莉娜邀请，三空间是同一船。民用渡轮及船上设备不转移，不证明导师当前去向，不收死锁燃料门票。

contexts.paragraph_english: Local operator: I can take the operating post for the declared transition shift, if another person accepts the safety-watch post. Those must be different occupants. Extraction can be set from one to three units while the basic seven remain. Three reaches the total capacity of ten; four would exceed it. My acceptance covers this shift, not a permanent permission to keep the machine at the highest setting. At handover we will close the window and lower extraction to zero before the next shift begins. The changed setting will require a new test.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 地方操作员：若另一人承接安全观察岗，我可承担这班明确过渡的操作岗，两岗须是不同人员。保留基本七单位时，抽取可以为一至三；三恰达总容量十，四就超量。我的承诺只覆盖本班，没有永久允许机器保持最高设置。交班时我们结束窗口，在下一班前把抽取降到零，并重新测试变更设置。

contexts.paragraph_english: Under time_limited_transition, extraction may use one to three units, with the total never above ten. The window lasts one declared work shift. Two different local duty people must actually accept the operating and safety-watch posts. A feasible allocation is shelter two, retrofit one and production support three. It preserves limited output for transfer work, with less immediate improvement elsewhere. An open-ended continuation is outside the safe arrangement.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: time_limited_transition允许抽取一至三单位，总量不超过十，窗口仅一班明确工作。两名不同本地人员须实际承接操作和安全观察岗。安置二、改造一、生产支持三是一例：保留有限产出用于转移工作，同时减少其他方面的即时改善。无限期延续超出安全安排。

contexts.paragraph_english: A limited transition may preserve enough output to support a particular transfer. It can be useful when the equipment and people must move in an order that cannot be changed at once. Its conditions are more demanding than the words 'for a short time' suggest. The load must have a cap, the window must have an end and two real people must accept the operating and safety-watch posts. There must also be a usable response when a check fails. Without those details, the temporary arrangement can quietly become ordinary production under a more reassuring name.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 有限过渡可能保留完成特定转移所需的产出，适用于设备与人员必须按难以立即改变的顺序移动时。其条件比“短时间”四个字更严格：负荷有上限，窗口有终点，两名真实人员承接操作与安全观察岗，检查失败时也有可用处置。缺少这些细节，临时安排可能悄悄以更令人放心的名称变为日常生产。

entries.english_definition: A change that puts an error right.

contexts.paragraph_english: Our present work has a limited end. The residence check can support a correction to local planning. A dated handover can support a statement about a person's condition at that handover. A small-station test can support a particular local load arrangement. Each result is useful when its scope is preserved. When we send the next package, we should leave its recipient able to inspect what happened, question our interpretation and see what remains open. That is how a record can carry an inquiry forward without carrying every part of a person's life with it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本次工作有有限终点。居住查验可以支持更正地方规划；有日期交接可以支持交接时状态；小支站试验可以支持特定地方负荷配置。保留范围时，每项结果都有用。下一资料包应让接收方能够查验发生的事、质疑解释，并看见仍待解决的部分。这样，记录才带着调查前进，同时为个人生活保留空间。

contexts.paragraph_english: Dispatcher: Before you collect any parts, there is a correction to the earlier message. We were told that the spare navigation beacon had been destroyed. The inspection does not support that account. The beacon itself still works; the damaged part is the bracket that holds it in place.

Stores clerk: I have one further correction to the draft. It says the auxiliary alarm parts will come out of these six packages. They will not. The workshop offers a separate repair pack for that invited job, and the engineering ledger holds different tower components. Please keep the three accounts named. A repair can be useful without being a tower upgrade. If the proposed recipients change before delivery, show me the new distribution and check the stock again. If the packages have already moved, start from their actual current ownership instead of the old reservation.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 库管员：草稿还需更正一处：它说辅助警报器零件来自这六包，实际并非如此。工坊为获邀工作另备维修包，工程账又有不同塔部件，请分列三账。维修可以有用，无需把它叫成塔升级。交付前接收方改变时，请带新分配复查库存；已经转移后，从当前归属开始，不从旧预留开始。

contexts.paragraph_english: The shared study room has two course notices for the same afternoon. The original notice places instrument practice in room Cedar at 14:00. A dated correction moves that practice to room Birch at 14:00 because Cedar is reserved for the archive workshop. Keep both notices, identify what the correction changes and ask the course desk for clarification if you intend to attend both. The correction concerns a room, not cancellation of a course.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 共学室有同日下午两课程通知。原通知仪表练习14:00在Cedar，标日期更正改为14:00在Birch，因为Cedar留给档案工作坊。应保留两件，说明更正哪项，想参加两课则向课程台澄清。更正的是房间，不是取消课程。

entries.english_definition: The work or consequence for which someone is accountable.

contexts.paragraph_english: The final recommendation retained the extra wait after the busiest train and made responsibility for the lift checks explicit. It also proposed another review during the college term, when travel patterns might differ. Some residents regarded the continued review as unnecessary caution; others welcomed the acknowledgement that a useful arrangement could still need adjustment. The case suggests that a timetable is best understood as a statement of an intended service, rather than a guarantee that every person can make every connection. Assessing that service requires attention to the journey around the scheduled departure as well as to the time printed beside it.

Voss: I knew that sustained high load carried a long-term risk. Your retained failures must be part of the discussion. I still require a plan for the first week: who maintains protection, where the transition supply comes from, and who accepts responsibility between districts. A ten-minute local result cannot supply those fields. I propose delaying public release while the central system continues to coordinate.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 沃斯：我知道持续高负荷有长期风险，你保留的失败必须进入讨论。但第一周仍需计划：谁维护保护、过渡供给来自哪里、各区之间谁承责。十分钟本地结果填不出这些字段。我主张延后公开，同时由中央继续协调。

contexts.paragraph_english: The custodian can verify that this extract comes from the stated page. Determining the scope of each contributor's responsibility requires the original scheme, related meeting records and later changes. A signature identifies a link to examine; it does not supply those missing records.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 保管人可核查摘录来自标明页面。判断各参与者具体责任范围，需要原方案、相关会议记录和后来变更。签名提供待查关联，没有补齐缺失文件。

contexts.paragraph_english: The register establishes what changed in presentation and when it entered this packet. It does not by itself identify every authorising official or validate a replacement scheme. Later supervised field work cannot rewrite this earlier publication difference. Wider responsibility will need additional original records.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 册证明此包呈现内容怎样改变以及何时进入，单凭此册尚未识别全部授权人，也未验证替代方案。后来有监督的现场工作不能改写早先发行差异，较广责任需更多原始记录。

entries.english_definition: Something a person or system does.

contexts.paragraph_english: Use the existing hand-operated drain after checking that the conveyor is isolated. The water gauge is read at the upper-floor stand. A drain action and a safe gauge reading are separate records. If the conveyor supply or clamp position changes, repeat the affected safety check before crossing the wet floor. Returning along a route already made safe does not require collecting another clamp.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 确认输送器隔离后，使用既有手动排水装置。积水表须在上层站位读取。排水动作与安全读数分别记录。输送器供电或夹具位置改变后，跨越湿区前应重做受影响检查。沿已安全路线返程，无需再领夹具。

contexts.paragraph_english: Local operator: Before we open the machine-room work zone, show me the upper-floor checks. The isolation handle must still be in the state you inspected. We also need the stopped conveyor record, the fixed external clamp and the dry-route reading. A successful action from an older configuration will not cover a change you made afterwards. We can repeat the affected check without throwing away the clamp or drawing a second unique connector from the cabinet.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 地方检修员：开放机房工作区前，请出示上层检查。隔离手柄必须保持核查时状态，还需要输送器停转记录、固定外部夹具和干燥通路读数。旧配置下的成功动作不能涵盖后来改动。可以重做受影响检查，不必丢掉夹具，也不用从料柜再领唯一连接头。

contexts.paragraph_english: A signature also has a scope. It can identify the person who accepted a particular version, without showing that this person invented every instruction attached to the wider system. Equally, uncertainty about wider instructions does not make the signature disappear.
