A signatory can explain a deadline, a shortage or pressure from a supervisor, and that explanation may help a review. It should remain separate from the check of what was signed. Otherwise an account of difficult circumstances can quietly replace the evidence of an action which still needs to be addressed.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 签名也有范围：它可识别某一版本的验收者，未必说明此人设计了整个系统的所有指示。对于广泛指示的未知，也不会让签名消失。签章人可以说明期限、短缺或主管压力，帮助核查；这些说明应与签了什么分开。否则，关于困难处境的叙述可能悄悄替换仍需处理的行动证据。

contexts.paragraph_english: Oren: If a public statement is requested, agree its fields and purpose with me. I can speak about my own action, including the signature, without guessing the intentions of people whose later decisions I did not see. A supervised repair followed by a statement is another arrangement, and a regional review is also possible. Please do not call a delayed statement a missing signature. The verified record remains. Joining a travelling crew is a further decision, and I can decline that invitation without taking the workshop file away from the inquiry.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 奥伦：若要求公共证言，请与我商定字段和用途。我能说明本人行动，包括签名，不能猜测后来未亲见决定的动机。也可以先做监督维修再补证言，或交地区核查。请勿把延后陈述说成签名不存在。已核验记录仍在；加入出行队是另一决定，我拒绝邀请也不会拿走工坊档案。

entries.english_definition: The act of bringing goods or information to a recipient.

contexts.paragraph_english: Keep the destination as the next inquiry direction. A file reference is not an authority to operate the mine, a delivery of engineering components or proof that the Glimmer has sailed there.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 这是一条下一步方向。档案编号不会赋予矿井操作权，不交付工程组件，也不证明微光号已经航行到那里。

contexts.paragraph_english: Pera: The delivery is the point at which the packages move from the store to the named work. Before that, a draft may be revised while the stock remains. Afterwards we must retain the real destination and whatever has already been used. A new paragraph cannot return installed material. The town's emergency wage voucher is also separate from the travelling commission's reward. I will not ask someone to fund the agreed basic protection from personal upgrade parts, and I will not describe the six-tower cargo as if it were already in this store.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 佩拉：交付使工包从库内转到具名工作。此前，库存仍在时可以改草稿；此后须保留真实去向及已用材料，新段落不能返还已安装物资。矿镇应急工资凭据也与出行委托奖励分开。我不会要求用个人改件零件填已约定基本保障，也不会把六塔货物说成已在本库。

contexts.paragraph_english: If a present-stage visit disagrees with this classification, retain both records and state their purposes. The extract has no recorded explanation of motive. A request to correct delivery planning may cite the disagreement without releasing the protected attachment.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 当前走访若与分类冲突，应保留两记录并说明用途。摘录未记录动机解释。申请更正配送规划可以引用差异，无需公开受保护附页。

contexts.paragraph_english: Document identity: MC-2.acceptance@3. Formal acceptance, MC-2 version 3: all six listed checks are marked accepted, including the safety-bypass entries 05 and 06. The authorised signatory field bears Oren's signature. The workshop custodian retains the signature reference and the version used for delivery. Compare these fields with the stage-I check sheet and its retained copy.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 文书身份：MC-2.acceptance@3。正式验收，MC-2版本3：六项列为合格，包括安全旁路05、06项。授权签章栏为奥伦签名，工坊保管人留有签名索引与交付版本。请与阶段I检查页及留存副本比较这些字段。

entries.english_definition: A group of items supplied together.

contexts.paragraph_english: A delegated review is another arrangement. The package goes to a specified desk for a stated purpose, and the receipt records the fields and versions that were delivered. This can allow a detailed check without immediately distributing personal details to everyone. It has costs. The reviewer may work slowly, or the public may have less opportunity to challenge an error. Keeping a short public account alongside a controlled package can make the process easier to question, provided neither account pretends that a pending review has already resolved the matter.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 受托审查是另一种安排：资料交给指定工作台用于约定用途，回执记清交付字段与版本。这能支持详细核查，无需立即把私人细节分给所有人。它也有代价：审阅可能较慢，公众纠错机会可能较少。受控包旁保留简短公共说明，有助于对过程提出问题；两者均应保留审查尚未结束的状态。

contexts.paragraph_english: Review desk: You have brought the transfer records, the residence check and the station boundary receipt. We can receive them in more than one form. A public summary can use room codes, dates and source references, while the protected originals remain available for controlled review. A delegated review package can instead go to a named review desk under its stated purpose. In either arrangement, the important public claims need a route by which someone can check the supporting records.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 审查台：你带来了转移记录、居住核查和支站边界回执。可以用多种形式交付。公共摘要可用房间代码、日期和来源索引，受保护原稿保留受控查验；受托审查包也可按用途交给指定审查台。无论哪种安排，重要公共陈述都需要可检查支持记录的路径。

contexts.paragraph_english: Sometimes a person wants to be named. Their decision deserves the same care as a decision to remain private. Ask what they agree to release, to whom, for what use and in which version. A broad permission inferred from an earlier conversation may not fit a new publication. Equally, choosing the smallest possible package in every situation can remove the very detail that the person wants included or that the authorised review needs. Appropriate scope depends on the purpose and the permission, as well as on the risk of disclosure.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 有时本人希望具名。这个决定与保持私密同样需要认真对待。请问清允许发布什么、给谁、为何使用及对应版本。旧交谈推断出的宽泛许可可能不适合新发布。每次都机械选择最少字段，也可能删去本人希望保留的内容，或获准审查真正需要的细节。适当范围取决于用途、许可和公开风险。

contexts.paragraph_english: Our present work has a limited end. The residence check can support a correction to local planning. A dated handover can support a statement about a person's condition at that handover. A small-station test can support a particular local load arrangement. Each result is useful when its scope is preserved. When we send the next package, we should leave its recipient able to inspect what happened, question our interpretation and see what remains open. That is how a record can carry an inquiry forward without carrying every part of a person's life with it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本次工作有有限终点。居住查验可以支持更正地方规划；有日期交接可以支持交接时状态；小支站试验可以支持特定地方负荷配置。保留范围时，每项结果都有用。下一资料包应让接收方能够查验发生的事、质疑解释，并看见仍待解决的部分。这样，记录才带着调查前进，同时为个人生活保留空间。

entries.english_definition: One item entered in a list or record.

contexts.paragraph_english: Copies retain the source reference of their original. A departure entry copied into a ledger remains the departure officer's record. An arrival written by the receiving officer at the receiving site has its own source. Keep the two references visible when describing what has been checked.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 副本沿用原稿来源。出发记录抄入总账后仍是出发记录员的记录；接收员在接收现场写下的到达记录另有来源。说明查验结果时，应保留两个来源标识。

contexts.paragraph_english: The later assignment does not tell us why an official entry says moved away. Those labels came from another register. I can let the custodian check my room codes and this observation for the local inquiry. Please keep the exact record version with the statement. A retelling of what I said will still come from me; it will not become another independent witness.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 较晚分配房间不能解释官方记录为何写迁出；那些标签来自另一份名册。我可以让保管人为地方调查核对房间代码与这次观察。请把准确版本和陈述保存在一起。别人转述我的话，来源仍是我，不会变成另一个独立证人。

contexts.paragraph_english: The receiving desk recorded the vehicle’s arrival at 14:40. The entry was made by the receiving officer when the vehicle reached the site. At 16:05 the same day, an archive clerk copied the movement and arrival entries into the central ledger. The later ledger stamp marks the copying, not a second journey or a later physical arrival.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 接收台记录车辆于14:40到达。这条记录由接收员在车辆抵达现场时写下。同日下午16:05，档案员把行程与到达条目抄入中央总账。较晚总账戳记标记的是抄录，并非第二次旅程或较晚的实际到达。

contexts.paragraph_english: A duplicate of the departure entry was attached to the ledger. It is a copy of the departure officer’s record, not another observer’s account. Nothing in these documents states what the central office knew before departure or why its ledger was updated later.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 总账附有一份出发条目副本。它复制出发记录员记录，并非另一位观察者陈述。这些文件没有说明中央办公室在出发前知道什么，也没有解释为何较晚更新总账。

entries.english_definition: An instruction requiring something to be done.

contexts.paragraph_english: The shore winch has its own small reserve; it is not supplied by the harbour generator or by a ship battery. Switch its local power off and isolate the drive before seating the displaced cable. Secure the rescue line at the marked anchor, then set the receiving direction. The cable and line may be prepared in either order while the drive is isolated. Restore local power only after both are secure. Run the tension check with no people on the line. A check belongs to that configuration: moving the receiving direction, reseating the cable or changing power cancels its validity. The nearby animals must be kept away from the receiving path before the line carries people. If a check fails, keep people in the protected assembly area and inspect the preparation again; taking time to read this card does not change the number of survivors. The shelter retains a working short-range distress set for the shore receiving team. It can send the registered rescue request before the separate coast-to-harbour relay is restored. Harbour pickup is confirmed through that relay later; a saved draft at the shelter has not yet sent a request.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 岸边绞盘使用自己的储备，和港口发电机、船电池无关。关闭本地电源并隔离驱动后，重新落座移位的钢缆。救援索固定在标记锚点，设置接应方向；隔离状态下，钢缆与索具可按任意先后准备。两者固定后才能恢复本地电源，先空载检查张力。证书只对应当次配置；改方向、缆线或电源均使旧检查失效。承载前须制止接应路径附近的动物威胁。检查失败时人员留在保护集合处，阅读不会减少幸存者。 救援棚有可用的短距求援台，能先向岸上接应队发送已登记求援；海岸至港口的独立中继另行恢复，之后才能确认港口接应。发送台保存稿件还没有发送请求。

contexts.paragraph_english: When I said the group was complete, I meant that the kitchen had prepared the full number of portions. If you need the order of arrival, please compare the receiving record. I can tell you what happened at this counter. I cannot explain who changed the official labels, and I have not agreed to have my private address placed on a notice.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 我说“组员齐了”时，指的是厨房按全部人数备了饭。要核查抵达次序，请比较接收记录。我能说明这个台前发生的事，不能解释是谁改了官方标签，也没有同意把私人地址写到告示上。

contexts.paragraph_english: Coast recorder extract. Instrument clock: 21:14:12, light signal lost at the observed tower channel. Further gaps occur in the same recording window, but the extract does not contain a complete network diagnosis. The shore clock and ship clock differ by approximately two seconds in their last routine comparison. Taken with the ship observation copy, this extract supports the order of light loss followed by course deviation. It does not name the person responsible, explain why every gap occurred or establish that the outage was deliberate. Keep the original time labels attached when making a later comparison.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 海岸记录器摘录：仪器钟21:14:12，所观测塔台信号消失；同一窗口还有其他缺口，摘录并非完整网络诊断。最近一次常规比对中，岸钟与船钟相差约两秒。结合船上抄记，资料支持先熄灯后偏航，不识别责任人，不解释每个缺口，也不证明故意断供。后续比对保留原始时间标签。

contexts.paragraph_english: Arrival record — rescue passage from the stranded coast. The public arrival berth receives the technician and four registered survivors. Record their arrival before requesting further harbour work; a person carried here is not automatically signed onto another vessel's crew. Two different berths are shown on the quay plan. The civil ferry is awaiting maintenance and a safe departure arrangement. The stored patrol boat has no handover authorisation on this arrival record. A harbour officer may review a limited maintenance request at the public dispatch desk. Bring the rescue acknowledgement and your inspection appointment, and consult the current closure order rather than assuming that rescue passage suspends it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 搁浅海岸救援入港记录：接应泊位接收检修员和四名已登记幸存者。先登记到港，再申请后续港口工作；接应入港不自动成为另一船的船员。码头显示不同泊位：民用渡轮待检修与安全撤离方案；封存巡灯船没有在此记录中授权移交。公共调度台可审查有限检修申请，须携救援回执及任职凭证，并查现行封港令。

entries.english_definition: Goods carried by a vessel or vehicle.

contexts.paragraph_english: The town's emergency stock provides twelve meal portions, three first-aid packs and one declared shift of wage cover. Take and deliver these local supplies through the receiving desk; a draft request cannot create them. Their use is part of basic protection. Extra workshop packages will be allocated separately after the rescue. Personal equipment parts and the six-tower engineering cargo remain in their own accounts.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 矿镇应急库存提供十二份暖食、三包急救用品与一班工资保障凭据。应通过接收台实际领取和交付，写申请不能生成物资。这是基本保障；救援后另行分配额外工包。个人装备零件和六塔工程货仍在各自账内。

contexts.paragraph_english: Pera: The delivery is the point at which the packages move from the store to the named work. Before that, a draft may be revised while the stock remains. Afterwards we must retain the real destination and whatever has already been used. A new paragraph cannot return installed material. The town's emergency wage voucher is also separate from the travelling commission's reward. I will not ask someone to fund the agreed basic protection from personal upgrade parts, and I will not describe the six-tower cargo as if it were already in this store.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 佩拉：交付使工包从库内转到具名工作。此前，库存仍在时可以改草稿；此后须保留真实去向及已用材料，新段落不能返还已安装物资。矿镇应急工资凭据也与出行委托奖励分开。我不会要求用个人改件零件填已约定基本保障，也不会把六塔货物说成已在本库。

contexts.paragraph_english: The six-tower ledger has different cargo and later work orders. Local packages do not satisfy TWR-R3's isolator, backup source, provision or enhanced-control requirements. The auxiliary alarm repair also uses its own workshop parts. Keep all three accounts distinct when describing a feasible plan.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 六塔工程账有不同货物和后续工单。地方工包不能满足TWR-R3隔离器、备用源、供给或增强控制需求；辅助警报器又使用自己的工坊零件。可行方案应保留这三项独立账目。

contexts.paragraph_english: After Q-304 and the agreed A2 commitment, the workshop can release repair pack AUX-R3-A2 for the invited job. Its connection part is held for this auxiliary device and is separate from personal upgrade parts, the six local extra packages and the tower engineering cargo. The part must actually move from its pack to the device. A saved promise cannot install it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: Q-304及A2约定承诺之后，工坊可为获邀工作释放AUX-R3-A2维修包。接线件归此辅助设备专用，与个人改件零件、六地方工包和塔工程货分开。零件须实际从包转到装置；保存承诺不能安装。

entries.english_definition: A plan describing how something is to be made or organised.

contexts.paragraph_english: This record does not disclose Mara's current medical condition or establish her present life status. It identifies a place for a lawful investigation. Unrelated personal fields are excluded from the public finding. The original design's historical responsibilities remain for their own later evidence review.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 此记录不公开玛拉当前医疗情况，也没有证明目前生死，只提供合法查验地点。公共核查排除无关私人字段。原始设计的历史责任留待其后相应证据核验。

contexts.paragraph_english: Custodian: Before we start, this is a bounded review, not an election for the future system. We have the old design, the later revision and correction note, the policy and test authorisations, the executive orders and the station register. The copies remain labelled as copies. Personal addresses and unrelated identities are excluded. Each claim will have a source version and each responding party will have a chance to challenge its scope. If a channel declines to answer, I will record the decline. It will not become an admission simply because someone in this room wishes it were.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 保管人：这是一场有限审查，不是未来制度选举。已有旧设计、后续修订和纠正、政策及测试授权、执行令、北站登记；副本标副本，住址和无关身份排除。每条主张有来源版、各方有质疑范围机会。拒答按拒答登记，不因厅里有人希望便成认罪。

contexts.paragraph_english: The local record custodian offers the rescued patrol a bounded review of OC-D18.design@1, OC-D14.revision@2, OC-D30.correction@1, VQ-D90.policy@1, VT-D7.authorization@1 and RK-D6.override@2 with RK-D3.detention@1. The fields are design_limits, correction_history, policy_authorization, execution_order and version_source. Recipient: patrol_technician. Purpose: distinguish_design_policy_execution_responsibility. Scope version: OC-responsibility-set@1. Personal addresses and unrelated case identities stay sealed. A protected review or an emergency public review can use the same redacted evidence and give each affected party a recorded opportunity to dispute a cited claim. Presence in this hall does not itself grant the scope.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 当地保管人向获救后的巡灯人提供限定审阅：OC-D18.design@1、OC-D14.revision@2、OC-D30.correction@1、VQ-D90.policy@1、VT-D7.authorization@1、RK-D6.override@2、RK-D3.detention@1。字段为 design_limits、correction_history、policy_authorization、execution_order、version_source；接收人 patrol_technician，用途 distinguish_design_policy_execution_responsibility，版本 OC-responsibility-set@1。住址和无关身份封存。受保护或紧急公开审查都使用脱敏证据，给各方记录反证机会；进入厅不等于获得范围。

contexts.paragraph_english: OC-D18.design@1 bears Mara Venn’s verified design signature eighteen years before D0. It authorised short emergency synchronisation during a severe supply crisis. The measure helped services survive that crisis, but the written exit and independent-review safeguards were weak: continuation could be approved without a firm stopping test or a separately scheduled review. The signed limits did not authorise every later increase in quota or an indefinite detention. An execution copy labelled OC-D18.execution-copy@1 reproduces this design; it is not another independent witness. Preserve both identities and their common source root. A useful original can still contain a serious design fault.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: OC-D18.design@1 经核验有玛拉于 D0 前十八年的设计签名，在严重供给危机中授权短期强制同步；它帮助服务渡过危机，但退出和独立复核保障薄弱，继续运行缺坚定停止检验及另排复核。原限制不授权后来全部配额提高或无限扣押。OC-D18.execution-copy@1 复制该设计，不是第二独立证人。保留两份身份和同源关系；有用的原方案仍可有严重设计缺陷。

entries.english_definition: The place or act of arriving on shore.

contexts.paragraph_english: The centre of the cabin floor is cracked. A person may appear to cross it successfully while the damaged boards continue to move underneath. Do not use that as a load test. The emergency cabinet beside the port wall contains a hand tool and a short rescue line; both belong to this vessel's rescue kit. A loose gangboard is stored along the intact side of the cabin. Secure it across the damaged section, keeping its ends on sound supports, before directing anybody towards the shore exit. The reef path begins beyond that exit. This note describes the cabin passage, not the safety of the landing place outside. Check the shore notice before choosing an approach for the rescue boat.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 船舱中央地板已经开裂。有人一度踩过去，不能证明受损板材可承重。左舷救援柜存有手工具和一根救援索，均属于本船救援包。沿完好的侧壁放着一块踏板。先把踏板两端固定在可靠支承上，再安排人员走向岸边出口。出口外才是礁岸路径；本说明不能证明岸上接应点安全，需要另查岸边告示。

contexts.paragraph_english: Tess: I will also show you the inner patrol latch. Inspect it from the station and check the two landing stands before registering the return route. That return remains useful after the present hazard is controlled. It is not the same as receiving the ridge cargo later. The four base components will need a manifest, two protected segments and a tower receiving check of their own. I would prefer a report that openly says the cargo has not moved yet to one that combines a safe survey route and an unexecuted delivery in a single cheerful sentence.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 泰丝：还会指出内侧巡检闩，从测站检查并核两个落点，再登记返程。处置后返程有用，却不等于后面的风脊货物收货。四份基础件另需货单、两保护段和塔站接收。我宁可报告明确说货物未走，也不把安全调查路和未执行交付合成一句好听话。

contexts.paragraph_english: Two markers are visible from the reef path. The southern marker stands near the broken steps. It identifies the old landing place but does not confirm that the steps remain usable after a surge. The northern reach is beyond the low stone wall. Its approach is narrow, so a rescue boat must wait for a clear signal rather than following the first moving light it sees. The winch line can guide people towards either marker. Choose the receiving direction before loading the line, and repeat the tension check whenever that direction changes. A raised hand lamp may help people find the path; it does not replace the line or repair the steps.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 礁岸可见两个标记。南标记位于破损台阶旁，标出旧接应点，并不保证浪涌后台阶仍能用。北段在矮石墙外，入口狭窄，救援船应等明确接应信号。绞盘索可朝两边接应；承载前须选方向，改向后须重新检查张力。手灯帮助辨路，不替代救援索，也不修复台阶。

contexts.paragraph_english: Leave the Glimmer at the marked berth while the landing clerk checks your vessel record and the cross-district commission. Registering here establishes an arrival and a route back to this landing. It does not give access to private rooms or restricted names.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 请把微光号停在标记泊位，由接驳员核对船只记录与跨区核查委托。此处登记记录一次实际到港，并建立返回这个接驳站的路线。私人房间与受限姓名另有访问范围。

entries.english_definition: A person's function in an arrangement.

contexts.paragraph_english: Inspection appointment. The bearer is a trainee technician assigned to public navigation maintenance. The appointment establishes a role, not unrestricted access to every power installation. Local harbour work must be commissioned by the officer responsible for the site. Follow the conditions on that commission and keep separate records for each device. A civil ferry's navigation lamp, a workshop's independent controller and the harbour main generator are not interchangeable authorisations. This appointment was carried on the inspection vessel. It does not certify language performance, membership of a faction or the present location of the technician's mentor.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 随检修船携带的任职凭证：持有人为公共导航检修见习员。身份不等于任意电力设施访问权；地方工作须由现场负责人委托，并按设备分别记录。民用渡轮导航灯、工坊独立控制器、港口主发电机不是通用授权。凭证不证明英语表现、组织成员身份或导师目前位置。

contexts.paragraph_english: Voss: Preserving services is not a reason to preserve my exclusive control. I can provide supervised technical help if that is the agreed arrangement. If I am suspended from the role, keep an operation channel through the appointed local staff. My understanding of the network does not turn an incomplete preparation list into a completed one. Ada: That choice must not decide which future policy the patrol is allowed to consider. We can hold you responsible for the old decisions while still asking a bounded technical question, or assign the task elsewhere without inventing a simpler network.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 沃斯：保服务不等于保我独控。可同意受监督技术帮助；若停职，通过当地指定人员维持操作渠道。我的网络知识不把缺项清单变成完成。阿妲：此选择不决定巡灯人可考虑哪种未来政策。可究旧责仍问有限技术，也可另派工作，不编造更简单网络。

contexts.paragraph_english: The greenhouse corridor is open to visitors. The inspection stair below it remains a work area. A patrol credential identifies your role; the local maintenance request specifies the equipment you may handle. Ask for that scope before entering the stair.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 温室外廊向访客开放，其下方的检修梯仍是工作区域。巡灯凭证说明职业身份；地方检修请求说明允许操作的设备。进入检修梯前请先取得这项范围。

contexts.paragraph_english: Oren may give a statement, undertake supervised repair or join a travelling crew after the batch finding. Those choices do not appoint him to two simultaneous posts. A local replacement must be accepted before a duty occupant departs. The later ROLE-R3-OP and ROLE-R3-REP protocol mandates also have separate operating and representative scopes; this current shift does not sign them automatically.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 批次核查后，奥伦可作证、承担监督维修或加入出行队伍。这些选择不能同时占两岗。值守人员离开前须有获准接替。后来ROLE-R3-OP与ROLE-R3-REP协议又有独立操作和代表范围，本班不会自动签署那些委托。

entries.english_definition: The condition of something at a particular time.

contexts.paragraph_english: Limited maintenance exception. Havel, the dispatch officer, may commission inspection and repair of the civil ferry's navigation equipment and the local workshop arrangements needed to obtain its replacement parts. State that the purpose is evacuation assistance and identify those work areas in the request. Harbour main-generator operation is outside this exception: its safety isolation has not been confirmed. A commission allows local preparation; the ferry remains at the quay until a tested current configuration and an explicitly confirmed departure plan are available. Neither a fee nor a language score is required to request the commission. Crew recruitment, patrol-boat use and access to retained accident records are separate decisions and must not be inferred from this document.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 有限检修例外：调度负责人哈文可委托民用渡轮导航设备检修及为取替换件所需的本地工坊操作。申请写明协助撤离及这些范围。主发电机安全隔离尚未确认，操作它不在例外内。委托只允许准备；当前配置测试与明确离港方案确认完成前，渡轮留港。申请不需费用或英语分数；招募、巡灯船及事故记录调阅均另行授权。

contexts.paragraph_english: You asked whether I could give you an exact minute for the authorisation. I can show you the sheet, including the damaged part of its time box, and the statement that it was checked before departure. I cannot read a reliable issue minute from that box. A report may state that a detail remains unknown. There is no need to fill the gap with a plausible-looking number.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 你问能否给出授权的准确分钟。我可以展示时间框破损的原页，以及出发前核查过授权的陈述；无法从时间框读出可靠分钟。报告可以写某项细节仍未知，不必用貌似合理的数字填空。

contexts.paragraph_english: Local operator: Before we open the machine-room work zone, show me the upper-floor checks. The isolation handle must still be in the state you inspected. We also need the stopped conveyor record, the fixed external clamp and the dry-route reading. A successful action from an older configuration will not cover a change you made afterwards. We can repeat the affected check without throwing away the clamp or drawing a second unique connector from the cabinet.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 地方检修员：开放机房工作区前，请出示上层检查。隔离手柄必须保持核查时状态，还需要输送器停转记录、固定外部夹具和干燥通路读数。旧配置下的成功动作不能涵盖后来改动。可以重做受影响检查，不必丢掉夹具，也不用从料柜再领唯一连接头。

contexts.paragraph_english: You may argue for wider public scrutiny, a controlled review, or a combination with a public summary and retained originals. State the practical benefits, the risks and the arrangement you intend to carry out. I will not infer that choice from a saved essay. At this desk, you will confirm the fields, the recipient, the purpose and the version, inspect the proposed handover, then explicitly send it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 你可以主张更广公开、受控审查，或公共摘要与保留原稿结合。请说明实际益处、风险与所选安排。保存文章不会让我推断交付选择。你须在此确认字段、接收方、用途和版本，查看交接预览，再明确发送。

entries.english_definition: A person who lives in a particular place.

contexts.paragraph_english: Basic archive access may be registered for this check. Names in protected attachments require a separate request, a stated purpose and a permitted recipient. Keep the public room codes in your working summary. No resident has agreed to publication merely by accepting a meal or answering a question.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本次查验可以登记基础档案访问。受保护附页中的姓名须另外申请，说明用途与接收方。工作摘要使用公开房间代码。领取饭食或回答问题均未构成同意公开身份。

contexts.paragraph_english: Resident representative: The warmer shelter matters now, but so does the transfer which some households are waiting for. I would like the proposal to say which work is postponed under each distribution. If we choose the transition, when will the materials used for production support become unavailable for shelter improvement? If we reduce immediately, who will replace the expected output in the transfer plan? We should be able to disagree about those costs without losing the meals and wage cover already agreed. Please record the conditions, rather than writing that every resident shares one preference.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 住民代表：更暖的安置处现在重要，一些住户等待的转移也重要。我希望提案说明各分配推迟什么工作。选择过渡后，生产支持物资何时不再可用于安置？立刻减产时，转移计划的预期产出由什么替代？讨论这些代价不应失去已约定暖食和工资保障。请记条件，不写所有住民同一偏好。

contexts.paragraph_english: These figures count portions, not independent sightings of twenty-four people. A neighbour may collect for someone who is resting. The residential porch check records voluntary confirmation of residence separately. Please retain both types of record; correcting a register does not require publishing a resident's private name.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 这些数字计算口粮份数，并非二十四次独立见到本人。有人休息时，邻居可能代领。住区门廊查验另外记录本人自愿确认的居住情况。请保留两类记录；更正名册无需公开私人姓名。

contexts.paragraph_english: Accommodation index for the same local group: A has eight assigned places, B ten and C six. The index uses public room codes rather than private street addresses. Each assignment states where a place was offered; the porch visit states whether its resident currently confirms living here.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 同一地方住区组的安置索引：A区八个安置位，B区十个，C区六个。索引使用公开房间代码，不列私人街道住址。安置记录说明曾提供的位置；门廊走访说明当事人现在是否确认住在此处。

entries.english_definition: Information establishing who a person or what an object is.

contexts.paragraph_english: The reading room offers a basic set of public records for the registered priory check. It includes room codes, record dates, duties and version references. Permission to read this set is tied to the purpose recorded at the access desk. A later request to publish or to inspect a protected identity is a separate decision.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 阅览室为已登记的修院查验提供一组公共记录，包含房间代码、记录日期、职能和版本来源。阅读许可对应访问台登记的用途。后续公开资料或查看受保护身份，需要另作决定。

contexts.paragraph_english: For the comparison report, use the local group table and the residence checks together. Describe what the columns measure and what the check can support. The room codes are enough for the public table. If you want an identity attachment, ask for that specific version and purpose at the scope desk. We can keep the public inquiry moving while such a request is considered.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 比较报告请结合地方住区表和居住核查，说明两列衡量的内容及查验能够支持什么。公共表使用房间代码即可。查看身份附页时，请在范围台申请具体版本与用途。申请审议期间，公共调查仍可继续。

contexts.paragraph_english: For a restricted attachment, name the record version, the fields required, the recipient and the intended use. June acts as custodian of the room. She can arrange controlled inspection and record an authorised handover. Holding the key to an attachment does not make her the person entitled to consent on behalf of every individual named there. Consent to publish a person's identity must be given by that person for the specified recipient and use.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 申请受限附页时，请说明版本、必要字段、接收方和用途。琼是阅览室保管人，可以安排受控查验、记录获准交付，但持有钥匙并未使她有权代所有当事人同意。公开某人的身份须由本人对具体接收方与用途明确同意。

contexts.paragraph_english: The public work register remains open if an identity request is declined. You may request a redacted copy, arrange an inspection through the custodian, or pause the identity request and continue the public inquiry. Reviewers must still be able to check material public facts and the records supporting them. Private details should be separated from that route rather than used to prevent all scrutiny.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 身份申请被拒后，公共工作记录仍开放。可以申请脱敏副本、经保管人安排查验，或暂缓身份申请后继续公共调查。必要公共事实及支持记录仍须能被审查；私人细节应与这条核查路径分开。

entries.english_definition: An organised attempt to discover or verify information.

contexts.paragraph_english: The public work register remains open if an identity request is declined. You may request a redacted copy, arrange an inspection through the custodian, or pause the identity request and continue the public inquiry. Reviewers must still be able to check material public facts and the records supporting them. Private details should be separated from that route rather than used to prevent all scrutiny.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 身份申请被拒后，公共工作记录仍开放。可以申请脱敏副本、经保管人安排查验，或暂缓身份申请后继续公共调查。必要公共事实及支持记录仍须能被审查；私人细节应与这条核查路径分开。

contexts.paragraph_english: The later assignment does not tell us why an official entry says moved away. Those labels came from another register. I can let the custodian check my room codes and this observation for the local inquiry. Please keep the exact record version with the statement. A retelling of what I said will still come from me; it will not become another independent witness.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 较晚分配房间不能解释官方记录为何写迁出；那些标签来自另一份名册。我可以让保管人为地方调查核对房间代码与这次观察。请把准确版本和陈述保存在一起。别人转述我的话，来源仍是我，不会变成另一个独立证人。

contexts.paragraph_english: Keep the destination as the next inquiry direction. A file reference is not an authority to operate the mine, a delivery of engineering components or proof that the Glimmer has sailed there.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 这是一条下一步方向。档案编号不会赋予矿井操作权，不交付工程组件，也不证明微光号已经航行到那里。

contexts.paragraph_english: For the comparison report, use the local group table and the residence checks together. Describe what the columns measure and what the check can support. The room codes are enough for the public table. If you want an identity attachment, ask for that specific version and purpose at the scope desk. We can keep the public inquiry moving while such a request is considered.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 比较报告请结合地方住区表和居住核查，说明两列衡量的内容及查验能够支持什么。公共表使用房间代码即可。查看身份附页时，请在范围台申请具体版本与用途。申请审议期间，公共调查仍可继续。

entries.english_definition: A place or system provided for a particular activity.

contexts.paragraph_english: Transfer TR-D1-7, version 1. Controlled extract from the receiving officer's custody handover record. The record is dated D−1 relative to the opening blackout. It identifies Mara Venn by the protected identification reference checked at the archive desk. The receiving officer recorded her as alive when custody was handed over. The destination is written as facility code F-17. No public site name or current address is supplied on this extract.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 转移TR-D1-7，第1版。接收员看管交接原稿的受控摘录，日期为开场熄灯前一天D−1。摘录用阅览台核对过的受保护身份索引识别玛拉·维恩。接收员记下她在看管交接时仍然活着。目的地写作设施代码F-17，本摘录没有公开地点名称或现行地址。

contexts.paragraph_english: The D−1 custody extract is a separate file. We will inspect its identifier and its dated receiving entry under the scope you requested. It records Mara's condition at that handover and uses a facility code for the destination. Later files would be needed to establish what happened after that point. None are included in this extract.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: D−1看管摘录是另一文件。我们会按所申请范围核查编号和有日期的接收条目。它记录玛拉在那次交接时的状态，以设施代码表示目的地。此后发生什么需要后续文件，本摘录不含那些记录。

contexts.paragraph_english: This record provides a dated observation. When writing about it, retain the date, the source and the point at which the observation was made. The extract contains no later release, interview or live message from Mara. The facility code is a direction for further investigation, not a verified present location.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 这是有日期的现场观察。写作时应保留日期、来源和观察环节。摘录没有玛拉此后的获释记录、访谈或实时消息。设施代码为进一步调查提供方向，尚不能确认目前所在地点。

contexts.paragraph_english: For the reserve test, keep the source isolated while seating the connector. The selector has positions for the kitchen, the wash pump and an alternating cycle. Read the load labels and trace the later interlock plate as well as the old drawing. We are not changing the tower outlet under this commission. If a trial is rejected, return the source to isolation, correct the selector and try again. The reserve is a fixed local facility, so this procedure does not take a tower provision pack from your account.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 试验备用源时，应在隔离状态下座好连接头。选择器有厨房、洗水泵和交替档。阅读负荷标签，同时对照后加联锁牌与旧图。委托不包括改变塔站出口。试验被拒时，恢复隔离、修正档位再试。备用源是固定地方设施，本程序不从工程账扣塔站保障包。

entries.english_definition: Involving actual objects, movement, or bodily presence.

contexts.paragraph_english: The drawing's former tower outlet is crossed out on the inspection copy. The later interlock plate identifies that outlet as outside the current local work scope. Trace both drawings at the actual selector; choose only the local branches authorised for this inspection. A correct sketch does not change the physical selector.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 查验副本中旧塔站出口已划去。后加联锁标牌将它列在本次范围之外。应在实际选择器处对照两图，仅选择获准的地方支路。画对草图不会改变真实档位。

contexts.paragraph_english: Please draw the process with calibration before entry, physical output preparation before execution, and observations before acceptance. If the configuration changes, we check it again. We keep previous runs as previous runs. A safe stop is a recorded failure in that condition, and a stable interval is evidence for that interval. Neither is a referendum on every future policy.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 流程图把校准放在进入前、实体输出准备放在执行前、观察放在接受前。配置变更须重查，旧运行仍是旧运行。安全停止是该条件下的失败，稳定时段是该时段证据，两者都不是关于未来所有政策的公投。

contexts.paragraph_english: The machine room has an inner latch leading back to the residential passage. Open it from this side once the local route is safe. This gives another physical way home. A valid local test, a tower work permit and a current tower inspection remain distinct records, all of which can be reviewed before the chapter's safety report is issued.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 机房内闩通向住区。地方路线安全后，从本侧打开可增加实际返程路线。地方有效试验、塔站工作许可和塔站当前安全检查仍是三份不同记录，均可在签发章节安全报告前复核。

contexts.paragraph_english: The receiving desk recorded the vehicle’s arrival at 14:40. The entry was made by the receiving officer when the vehicle reached the site. At 16:05 the same day, an archive clerk copied the movement and arrival entries into the central ledger. The later ledger stamp marks the copying, not a second journey or a later physical arrival.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 接收台记录车辆于14:40到达。这条记录由接收员在车辆抵达现场时写下。同日下午16:05，档案员把行程与到达条目抄入中央总账。较晚总账戳记标记的是抄录，并非第二次旅程或较晚的实际到达。

entries.english_definition: A position where a person performs assigned duties.

contexts.paragraph_english: To the new technician, from Mara. If a record is marked for destruction, first ask who issued the instruction, which version it concerns and what other record can be used to check it. A tidy report may leave out the circumstances that made its conclusion seem convincing. I have enclosed a request to compare the public maintenance record with an independent source. Deal with immediate rescue work before following it. This letter was placed in the inspection post before your journey; it cannot tell you where I am when you read it. Do not treat my concerns as proof. Preserve what you actually find, including anything that does not support the explanation you expected.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 玛拉给新检修员的留言：遇到要求销毁的记录，先核对指令签发者、所指版本和可独立核验的来源。整齐报告可能省略形成结论的条件。附上公共检修记录比对请求，但眼前救援优先。信件在旅程前寄存，不能说明阅读时玛拉所在。疑虑不是证明，应保留实际找到的资料，包括不支持预期解释的部分。

contexts.paragraph_english: Local operator: I can take the operating post for the declared transition shift, if another person accepts the safety-watch post. Those must be different occupants. Extraction can be set from one to three units while the basic seven remain. Three reaches the total capacity of ten; four would exceed it. My acceptance covers this shift, not a permanent permission to keep the machine at the highest setting. At handover we will close the window and lower extraction to zero before the next shift begins. The changed setting will require a new test.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 地方操作员：若另一人承接安全观察岗，我可承担这班明确过渡的操作岗，两岗须是不同人员。保留基本七单位时，抽取可以为一至三；三恰达总容量十，四就超量。我的承诺只覆盖本班，没有永久允许机器保持最高设置。交班时我们结束窗口，在下一班前把抽取降到零，并重新测试变更设置。

contexts.paragraph_english: An invitation to join your travelling crew can be discussed after this batch finding is complete. Accepting, declining or delaying that invitation leaves the documents available under the inspection assignment. I cannot work a local duty post and take a travelling combat position at the same time.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 这项批次核查完成后，可以另谈加入出行队伍的邀请。接受、拒绝或暂缓都保留委托范围内的文件。本人不能同时占用本地当班岗位与出行战斗位置。

contexts.paragraph_english: A decision can be revised, but revision has physical limits. Before delivery, the team can change the distribution while the packages remain available. After a connection has been installed or supplies used, a new plan must acknowledge that state. Writing a different destination does not return the old package to the store. The same principle applies to duty. A person who leaves for a travelling assignment needs a local replacement before taking a new post. Clear revision rules let people change their minds without pretending that completed work and existing commitments vanish with the previous draft.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 决定可以修改，修改也有物理边界。交付前，物资仍在时可改分配；接线已安装或用品已消耗后，新计划应承认现状。另写目的地不能让旧工包回库。值守同理：某人离开参加出行工作前，需要本地接替。清楚的修订规则允许改变主意，也无需假装完成工作和已有承诺随旧稿消失。

entries.english_definition: The place where something is situated.

contexts.paragraph_english: Inspection appointment. The bearer is a trainee technician assigned to public navigation maintenance. The appointment establishes a role, not unrestricted access to every power installation. Local harbour work must be commissioned by the officer responsible for the site. Follow the conditions on that commission and keep separate records for each device. A civil ferry's navigation lamp, a workshop's independent controller and the harbour main generator are not interchangeable authorisations. This appointment was carried on the inspection vessel. It does not certify language performance, membership of a faction or the present location of the technician's mentor.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 随检修船携带的任职凭证：持有人为公共导航检修见习员。身份不等于任意电力设施访问权；地方工作须由现场负责人委托，并按设备分别记录。民用渡轮导航灯、工坊独立控制器、港口主发电机不是通用授权。凭证不证明英语表现、组织成员身份或导师目前位置。

contexts.paragraph_english: Sian: Supply concerns are real, but they do not justify removing unfavourable results or denying an independent review. We can record the limits and practical preparation while retaining public scrutiny. You may agree with a technical concern and refuse the proposed information restriction. Those decisions are separate. The location records should also pass through their bounded verification; a holding-facility code does not tell us Mara's present condition.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 西安：供给担忧确实存在，但不能据此删除不利结果或拒绝独立复核。可以记录限制及实际准备，同时保留公共查验。你可赞同技术担忧并拒绝信息限制，两决定分别保存。地点记录也按限定范围核验；扣押设施代码不说明玛拉目前情况。

contexts.paragraph_english: Record a disagreement between sources as a disagreement. A voluntary conversation at the public porch can establish present residence for this check. It cannot establish someone's location throughout the intervening years, the whereabouts of another family member, or consent to release a protected attachment.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 不同来源的矛盾应按矛盾记录。公共门廊的自愿交谈可以确认本次查验的当前居住情况，不能说明此前多年每一阶段去向、其他亲属位置或公开受保护附页的同意。

contexts.paragraph_english: This record provides a dated observation. When writing about it, retain the date, the source and the point at which the observation was made. The extract contains no later release, interview or live message from Mara. The facility code is a direction for further investigation, not a verified present location.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 这是有日期的现场观察。写作时应保留日期、来源和观察环节。摘录没有玛拉此后的获释记录、访谈或实时消息。设施代码为进一步调查提供方向，尚不能确认目前所在地点。

entries.english_definition: The point separating one area or permitted range from another.

contexts.paragraph_english: Harbour closure order — current copy. General departures are suspended while the navigation restrictions are reviewed. Rescue arrivals continue at the public receiving berth. An arrival under that provision does not grant a vessel permission to depart. The dispatch office may issue a limited local maintenance commission where the work supports a specific safe evacuation arrangement. The commission must name its work area and power boundary. It does not itself clear a route, approve an untested navigation lamp or transfer ownership of a vessel. A later departure instruction must be checked against the route notices and the vessel's current configuration. The public consultation desk remains accessible during the closure; restricted records and equipment require their own authorisation.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 现行封港令：一般出港暂停，公共泊位仍接收救援入港；允许入港不等于允许出港。调度室可为明确安全撤离工作签发有限地方检修委托，写明作业范围和供电边界。委托本身不开放航道、不认可未经测试导航灯、不移交船产权。出港另需按航道资料及船舶当前配置核对。公共咨询区开放，受限记录与设备需各自授权。

contexts.paragraph_english: Review desk: You have brought the transfer records, the residence check and the station boundary receipt. We can receive them in more than one form. A public summary can use room codes, dates and source references, while the protected originals remain available for controlled review. A delegated review package can instead go to a named review desk under its stated purpose. In either arrangement, the important public claims need a route by which someone can check the supporting records.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 审查台：你带来了转移记录、居住核查和支站边界回执。可以用多种形式交付。公共摘要可用房间代码、日期和来源索引，受保护原稿保留受控查验；受托审查包也可按用途交给指定审查台。无论哪种安排，重要公共陈述都需要可检查支持记录的路径。

contexts.paragraph_english: June also requests inspection of the greenhouse supply stair. This permits the local handles, fixed repair cabinet and transfer-station circuits described in the maintenance notice. It does not authorise changing the tower's central interlock. Bring back a factual difference report and the equipment boundary before asking the local desk to issue the next work scope.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 琼还请求检查温室供给检修梯。允许范围是告示列明的地方手柄、固定料柜和转供站回路，未包括改动塔站中央联锁。请把实际差异与设备边界带回地方工作台，再申请下一步工作范围。

contexts.paragraph_english: The greenhouse supplies the priory kitchen and the public wash taps through two small local circuits. Water from the inspection stair has entered the upper transfer floor. Roots have also grown around the stopped conveyor. The public corridor remains usable. The stair may be opened for the locally commissioned inspection once the root-route threat is controlled and the stair boundary has been checked on site.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 温室通过两条小型地方回路供应修院厨房与公共洗水龙头。检修梯的水已流入转供站上层，根系缠住了停转的输送器。公共外廊仍可使用。根道威胁实际处置、检修梯边界现场核对后，地方检修委托可以开放下行。

entries.english_definition: The carrying out of a plan or instruction.

contexts.paragraph_english: Draft contingency notice, prepared on D0 at 20:50. This copy was stored with the evening dispatch papers; its issue box is blank. The text describes a possible interruption of the harbour light and tells receiving crews to wait for a revised route message. A handwritten heading calls it an accident notice, but the heading does not identify a cause. Preparing a notice in advance may indicate planning for a risk. It does not, by itself, show that somebody intended a grounding. Preserve the draft label and the empty issue box when citing this document. The approval and execution records are held separately. Do not replace them with a conclusion drawn from the title.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: D0 20:50准备、尚未签发的应急通知。事故字样不说明原因，预先准备通知不能单独证明故意搁浅；引用时保留草稿标签及空白签发栏，另查批准与执行记录。

contexts.paragraph_english: Review officer: I have the present configuration sheet, not a promise of its outcome. The operator starts Controller C only when the execution output has its current TEST route check. At minute five, we retain an intermediate observation. At minute ten, we retain the final result. The controller clock advances when you take those declared observations; the reader does not have to hurry.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 复核员：我持当前配置页，不是结果承诺。执行机输出取得当前TEST检查后，操作员才启动C。第5分钟留中间观察，第10分钟留末次结果。取声明观察时控制器钟才推进，阅读者不用赶。

contexts.paragraph_english: The trial field may be entered once both prior reports and this current preparation are ready. You will still need to inspect the field's output route and control its execution machine. A calibration receipt proves the present measuring setup; it does not prove that the unexecuted ten-minute trial will succeed, that an untested load is safe, or that another district is prepared.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 两份前报告及当前准备成立后可进入试验场，仍须检查输出通路并制止执行机。校准回执证明当前测量设置，不证明尚未执行的十分钟试验会成功、未测负荷安全或外区已准备。

contexts.paragraph_english: Controller C will run a small local circuit at load 40 with the installed reserve connected, local isolation checked and limited contact enabled. The two current trial posts must be assigned and the reference channels checked. The execution machine must be controlled and its output connected to the labelled test route. A battle result establishes the device's safety; it is not a trial observation. Saving this configuration is a preparation step.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: C控制器将在40负荷、已接本地储备、已查隔离及有限联络下运行小回路。应安排两个当前试验岗位，检查参考通道，制止执行机并把输出接到标记测试通路。战斗结果证明设备安全，不是试验观察。保存此配置属于准备。

entries.english_definition: What a machine or process produces.

contexts.paragraph_english: Controlled copy of the interruption schedule. Approval was entered on D-1 at 18:00. The specified window begins at 21:14 on D0 and lasts only for the locally declared interval. The schedule requires a second check of traffic still within the affected approach before the output is interrupted. A completion box records whether that check was carried out; it is not a decorative signature. This schedule establishes that an interruption had been planned before the accident. It does not establish which later instruction was followed. Compare the actual control log, the duty handover and the independent instrument record. Keep the scheduled window distinct from the time at which the coast instrument first recorded a missing signal.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: D-1 18:00批准，D0 21:14开始的局部断供测试计划，要求断供前第二次检查受影响进场区的人船。计划证明动作预定，不独自证明后来实际执行何种指令。

contexts.paragraph_english: Resident representative: The warmer shelter matters now, but so does the transfer which some households are waiting for. I would like the proposal to say which work is postponed under each distribution. If we choose the transition, when will the materials used for production support become unavailable for shelter improvement? If we reduce immediately, who will replace the expected output in the transfer plan? We should be able to disagree about those costs without losing the meals and wage cover already agreed. Please record the conditions, rather than writing that every resident shares one preference.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 住民代表：更暖的安置处现在重要，一些住户等待的转移也重要。我希望提案说明各分配推迟什么工作。选择过渡后，生产支持物资何时不再可用于安置？立刻减产时，转移计划的预期产出由什么替代？讨论这些代价不应失去已约定暖食和工资保障。请记条件，不写所有住民同一偏好。

contexts.paragraph_english: Evening duty handover, retained copy. At 21:05 on D0, a later work instruction removed the second traffic check from this test. The receiving operator recorded the change rather than marking the check as completed. A routine comparison at 20:40 placed the control clock within one second of the ship clock. The local control event copy lists the output interruption at 21:14:10, on the control clock. The instruction identifier and its issuing office are retained for further examination. This copy is not sufficient to establish what every officer knew or intended. The output event and the removed check should be recorded as separate findings: one concerns what the equipment did, the other concerns which protection was omitted. The independent coast clock was not set from this control clock.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: D0 21:05的后续工作指令移除了第二次人船复核，接班者没有把它标作已做。控制钟记录21:14:10断供；签发标识保留待后续核验，不能据此判定所有人员的知情与意图。 20:40常规比对记控制钟与船钟相差不超过一秒。

contexts.paragraph_english: Choose a load policy explicitly. Under early_reduce, set extraction to zero and retain the seven basic service units. More of the extra packages can then go directly to shelter and retrofit, though the present extraction output is lost. A feasible example allocates four packages to shelter, two to retrofit and none to production support. Other allocations within the public limits can be proposed.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 请明确选择负荷政策。early_reduce把抽取设为零，保留七单位基本服务；更多工包可立即用于安置与改造，代价是失去当前抽取产出。可行例为安置四、改造二、生产支持零；也可提出满足公开约束的其他分配。

entries.english_definition: The place to which something is being sent.

contexts.paragraph_english: Comparison envelope for the coast recorder collected after the shore rescue. The original instrument label reports loss of the observed light signal at 21:14:12. Its last routine comparison with the ship clock had an uncertainty of approximately two seconds. The harbour control event is labelled 21:14:10 on a different clock. The handover copy reports a separate control-to-ship comparison within one second. The combined comparisons therefore allow a three-second interval between the two labelled clocks. These readings are consistent within that recorded interval; they are not evidence that every clock displayed an identical second. Together with the approved window and the duty handover, the records support a planned interruption with a required protection removed. Keep the original extract attached. Nothing in this envelope certifies the sender of the inspection mail as currently alive, safe or present at a particular destination.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 救援后实际取得的海岸记录器副本保留原标21:14:12，与船钟最近比对约有两秒不确定。控制钟21:14:10与其在已记不确定范围内相符，不是所有钟秒数完全一致；不证明导师当前存活、安全或去向。 值班记录另证控制钟与船钟相差一秒以内；合并两次比对界限允许两仪器标签有三秒差。

contexts.paragraph_english: The D−1 custody extract is a separate file. We will inspect its identifier and its dated receiving entry under the scope you requested. It records Mara's condition at that handover and uses a facility code for the destination. Later files would be needed to establish what happened after that point. None are included in this extract.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: D−1看管摘录是另一文件。我们会按所申请范围核查编号和有日期的接收条目。它记录玛拉在那次交接时的状态，以设施代码表示目的地。此后发生什么需要后续文件，本摘录不含那些记录。

contexts.paragraph_english: Transfer TR-D1-7, version 1. Controlled extract from the receiving officer's custody handover record. The record is dated D−1 relative to the opening blackout. It identifies Mara Venn by the protected identification reference checked at the archive desk. The receiving officer recorded her as alive when custody was handed over. The destination is written as facility code F-17. No public site name or current address is supplied on this extract.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 转移TR-D1-7，第1版。接收员看管交接原稿的受控摘录，日期为开场熄灯前一天D−1。摘录用阅览台核对过的受保护身份索引识别玛拉·维恩。接收员记下她在看管交接时仍然活着。目的地写作设施代码F-17，本摘录没有公开地点名称或现行地址。

contexts.paragraph_english: The index links local interlock plate IL-2 to maintenance batch MC-2 at the bell-mine workshop. It records a destination for checking the batch's original instrument sheets and acceptance versions. The priory copy contains the batch reference and a dispatch acknowledgement, not the workshop's complete technical file.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本地联锁标牌IL-2在索引中关联沉钟矿区工坊检修批次MC-2，指明应到何处核对该批次原始仪表页与验收版本。修院副本只有批次索引与发件确认，没有工坊完整技术档案。

entries.english_definition: A scheduled period of work for a group of people.

contexts.paragraph_english: The current shift has two duty posts. Their presence in today's register describes today's coverage. Future operation under a changed protocol requires a separate mandate, reservation and accountable handover. Inspection visitors cannot assign those posts by signing their own worksheet.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本班有两个值守岗位。今日到岗登记仅描述今日覆盖。改换协议后的运行另需委托、岗位预留与可问责交接，访客不能自行签字便分配岗位。

contexts.paragraph_english: Oren: I signed that final form. I had seen the unfinished entries, and I should have refused to accept the bypass as complete. There was pressure to release the equipment for the next shift. I can give an account of that pressure and the instructions I received, but I will keep it separate from my signature. I cannot make the earlier check complete by repairing the device today. If I undertake a repair now, its parts, test and reviewer must be entered as new work, while the signed form remains available.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 奥伦：最终表是我签的。我看到了未完成条目，本该拒绝把旁路验收为完成。当时受到放行设备给下一班的压力。我会说明压力与收到的指示，但要把这些与本人签名分开。今天修理不能完成早先检查。若现在承接维修，应把零件、测试和复核人记成新工作，同时保留旧签章表。

contexts.paragraph_english: The town's emergency stock provides twelve meal portions, three first-aid packs and one declared shift of wage cover. Take and deliver these local supplies through the receiving desk; a draft request cannot create them. Their use is part of basic protection. Extra workshop packages will be allocated separately after the rescue. Personal equipment parts and the six-tower engineering cargo remain in their own accounts.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 矿镇应急库存提供十二份暖食、三包急救用品与一班工资保障凭据。应通过接收台实际领取和交付，写申请不能生成物资。这是基本保障；救援后另行分配额外工包。个人装备零件和六塔工程货仍在各自账内。

contexts.paragraph_english: Current shift board: W1, W2 and W3 were assigned to the cutting face. Their return boxes remain blank. A blank box means that this desk has not confirmed their return; it is not a death record. The signal clerk received a call from the cutting-face shelter after the lower route became blocked. Mark a return only when the receiving desk sees the person or verifies an actual escorted handover.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本班工作板：W1、W2、W3分派至采掘面，返程栏仍空白。空白表示此台尚未确认返回，并非死亡记录。下层通路受阻后，信号员接到采掘面避护处呼叫。接收台实际见到本人或核对护送交接后，才能登记返回。

entries.english_definition: The recorded sequence of earlier events.

contexts.paragraph_english: Controlled extract, temporary supply scheme TS-18, initial signature page. The page bears the name and signature reference of Mara Venn among its contributors. The title describes a temporary compulsory synchronisation arrangement during an earlier supply crisis. The preserved page is an early version; the archive also holds later references which have not yet been assembled into a complete change history here.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 临时供给方案TS-18初始签名页的受控摘录。参与者列含玛拉·维恩姓名与签名索引。标题说明这是早期供给危机期间的临时强制同步安排。保留页面属于早期版本；档案还有后续索引，本地尚未整理出完整变更历史。

contexts.paragraph_english: The historical signature page also needs its limit recorded. Its early version is evidence of a connection to examine, and the missing change history remains part of the question. The mining batch index gives the next destination for checking that history. Our acknowledgement will state exactly what we received and what is still unverified; it will not report a mine visit that has not happened.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 历史签名页也须保留限制。早期版本提供待查关联，缺失变更史仍是问题的一部分。矿区批次索引给出下一处核查方向。我们的确认会写明收到什么、哪些内容未核实，不会写成尚未发生的矿区访问。

contexts.paragraph_english: The first list on our kitchen wall was made to count meals. It had room letters and the number of portions to prepare. When a resident asked why the public register still said she had moved away, that kitchen list became useful for a different purpose. It showed a practical disagreement worth investigating. It did not tell us the whole history of her movements, and it did not turn a request for supper into an agreement to publish her name.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 厨房墙上最初的名单用来数饭食，写着房间字母和应准备的份数。一位住民问，为什么公共名册仍说她迁出了，这张厨房名单便对另一用途有了帮助：它指出值得核查的实际差异。它没有叙述她全部迁移经历，也没有把领晚饭的请求变成同意公开姓名。

contexts.paragraph_english: Custodian: The four-batch table can help us present the records, as long as we state its denominator. Each batch has six listed checks. The incomplete counts are zero, two, one and zero; the official accepted counts are six, six, five and six. Those are two different measures of the same twenty-four entries. The table makes MC-2 worth examining closely. It does not tell us the history of every machine, or prove that every observed disturbance came from the same cause. The original fields are still needed for the particular finding.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 保管人：四批表可以帮助呈现记录，前提是保留分母。每批六项，未完成数为零、二、一、零；正式合格数为六、六、五、六。两列衡量同一组二十四项的不同方面。表格提示细查MC-2，但没有叙述全部机器历史，也未证明所有扰动来自同一原因。具体结论仍需要原字段。

entries.english_definition: A decision accepted by the people involved.

contexts.paragraph_english: W-04 agrees to let the priory review desk check the observation time, the witness's duty and the version reference for a local note. The purpose is to verify that note's account. The agreement is for version W04-v1. It does not include a private address or general publication of identity.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: W-04同意修院审查台核对一份地方便条的观察时间、证人职能和版本索引，用途为核验陈述。协议限定版本W04-v1，未包括私人地址或普遍公开身份。

contexts.paragraph_english: This local note is separate from the chapter's essential evidence. Mira has offered a private invitation to consider the arrangement after the main archive agreement. The offer may be declined or left for another visit. The main transfer inquiry remains available.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 这份便条与章节必需证据分开。米拉在主线档案协议完成后提供私人邀请，讨论该安排。可以拒绝或留待回访，主线转移核查仍可继续。

contexts.paragraph_english: The first list on our kitchen wall was made to count meals. It had room letters and the number of portions to prepare. When a resident asked why the public register still said she had moved away, that kitchen list became useful for a different purpose. It showed a practical disagreement worth investigating. It did not tell us the whole history of her movements, and it did not turn a request for supper into an agreement to publish her name.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 厨房墙上最初的名单用来数饭食，写着房间字母和应准备的份数。一位住民问，为什么公共名册仍说她迁出了，这张厨房名单便对另一用途有了帮助：它指出值得核查的实际差异。它没有叙述她全部迁移经历，也没有把领晚饭的请求变成同意公开姓名。

contexts.paragraph_english: Team B took its own readings with instrument IB-2 during W-1. At the priory's lower-load station it recorded local load 40 and indicator 3. At the mine's higher-load station it recorded local load 70 and indicator 8. The mine readings come from a second field visit and instrument; they are not a transcription of team A. Keep that independence distinct from agreement between the two numbers.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: B队在W-1窗口以IB-2独立记录。修院较低档为本地负荷40、指标3；矿区较高档为70、指标8。矿区记录来自另一次现场访问与仪表，不是A队抄录。来源独立与两个数字相近是不同事项。

entries.english_definition: An action or statement made after a request or event.

contexts.paragraph_english: Extraction and disturbance rose together in this short record. Pump operation, nearby machines and sampling conditions also need checking. The sheet provides a traceable question for the academic review: which factors can explain the pattern, and under what conditions could it be reproduced? It cannot by itself show that mining created the mist, that every district has the same response, or that a shutdown will clear the weather immediately.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 这份短记录里，抽取与扰动同时上升。泵房运作、附近机械和采样条件也需核查。资料为学城提出可追查问题：哪些因素能够解释此模式，怎样的条件下可以复现？仅凭它尚不能说明开采创造了雾海、每个地区反应相同，或停机会立即放晴。

contexts.paragraph_english: Pera: My response to a repair can stay narrower than forgiveness. I can accept a tested alarm and still object to the way the old equipment was delivered. Another qualified person can repeat the test if the arrangement is agreed; the repairer cannot sign both the work and its independent review. We should give residents a result they can use and a way to report a new fault. No one has to write that everyone is satisfied before the safety work can be recorded. The disagreement deserves its own line.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 佩拉：我对维修的回应可以小于原谅。我能接受受检警报器，仍反对早先交付方式。安排获准后，可请另一合格人员重复测试；维修者不能同时签工作及独立复核。住民应得到可用结果和报告新故障的途径。安全工作登记无需先写所有人满意；分歧自有一栏。

contexts.paragraph_english: A limited transition may preserve enough output to support a particular transfer. It can be useful when the equipment and people must move in an order that cannot be changed at once. Its conditions are more demanding than the words 'for a short time' suggest. The load must have a cap, the window must have an end and two real people must accept the operating and safety-watch posts. There must also be a usable response when a check fails. Without those details, the temporary arrangement can quietly become ordinary production under a more reassuring name.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 有限过渡可能保留完成特定转移所需的产出，适用于设备与人员必须按难以立即改变的顺序移动时。其条件比“短时间”四个字更严格：负荷有上限，窗口有终点，两名真实人员承接操作与安全观察岗，检查失败时也有可用处置。缺少这些细节，临时安排可能悄悄以更令人放心的名称变为日常生产。

contexts.paragraph_english: Safety watcher: I can accept the separate watch post and record the checks for the current configuration. If a connection or load setting changes, the earlier pass does not remain current. A fault needs a safe response, and the fixed return route must stay usable. The written handover should identify me and the operator, the setting tested and the window's end. It can acknowledge uncertainty about the wider disturbance pattern. Our work establishes a local bounded operation; it does not certify the cause of every mine hazard or authorise a future central-network policy.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 安全观察员：我可承接独立观察岗，记录当前配置检查。接线或负荷变化后，旧通过不能继续算当前有效。故障须有安全处置，固定返程保持可用。书面交接应列我与操作员、受检设置和窗口终点，也可说明广泛扰动模式仍不确定。我们建立本地有界运行，尚未认证所有危险原因，也未授权未来中央政策。

entries.english_definition: One part of a larger machine or system.

contexts.paragraph_english: The local supply has a capacity of ten load units. Basic protection uses seven: two for drainage, two for ventilation, two for the warm room and one for signals. Keep those services available after the rescue. Extraction uses a separate setting of zero to three additional units. At three, the combined load reaches ten. The unit is a local planning measure, not an engineering component or a currency.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 地方供电容量为十负荷单位。基本保障用七：排水二、通风二、暖房二、信号一。救援后继续保留这些服务。抽取设置另为零至三附加单位；设为三时总负荷达十。单位用于地方规划，并非工程组件或货币。

contexts.paragraph_english: Finn: Match the four protected serials against the manifest. The cart driver and cargo watch travel under this local commission. A recruited guide may help, but does not create another component.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 芬：对四件保护序号。车司机与货守依本次地方委托执行。同伴向导可以帮助，却不创造另一件组件。

contexts.paragraph_english: The bench stops safely when its recorded failure condition is reached. It does not destroy a main-line component. Save the failed run and the configuration before resetting the local apparatus. A reset removes local preparation and current tests; it preserves sources, historical runs, the sample deposit and other districts' progress. No waiting in real time is required: the inspection controls advance the declared simulation clock.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 试验台达到记录的失败条件时安全停止，不毁主线部件。局部复位前，保存失败运行与配置。复位清当前准备和测试，保留来源、历史运行、样本交接及外区进展。无需实时等待，由检查操作推进声明的模拟时钟。

contexts.paragraph_english: A confirmed work order reserves every required component and all posts together. The next actions are transport, delivery, installation and verification. Execute each declared step through the communication desk or its physical site; menus, sleep and reloading advance nothing. A component already installed stays installed after cancellation. A completed base order preserves present local service and assigns two actual watches. It does not install the enhanced controller or pass its trial.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 确认工程单时，所需材料和全部岗位一起预留。接着实际推进运输、交付、安装、核验，可从通信台或现场执行规定步骤；菜单、睡眠、读档不推进。已经安装的组件在取消后仍保持安装。完成基础单保全现有地方服务并登记两个真实值守，不会顺带安装增强控制器或通过试运行。

entries.english_definition: The final outcome of a sequence of events.

contexts.paragraph_english: A comparison note may propose what another observer should record next, such as the instrument, pump state and stage. Do not write that this extra sheet proves the final cause of the mist or unlocks a hidden ending condition. The necessary chapter samples and instrument evidence remain on the main route whether this point is visited or not.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 比较便条可以提出下一观察要记录什么，例如仪表、泵状态与阶段。不能写这页证明雾的最终原因或开启隐藏结局条件。无论访问此点与否，必需章节样本和仪表证据均在主路。

contexts.paragraph_english: Tess: The ridge packet has only four base components. The first escort starts at the transfer shed after the actual manifest is checked. The outer escort begins through the paired route after its first segment is controlled. At the tower we control the field device, protect the present cargo and deal with the platform, then perform isolation and receipt. Pressure against the platform does not sign the receiving sheet. The optional five-box supplement is a different consignment. If it is declined, those choices must not take the basic packet or an eventual ending direction away.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 泰丝：风脊基础只有四件，中转棚核实货单后首段护送，处置首段后沿配对路进入外线。到塔先制护场器、护货、制平台，再隔离和收货。平台压强不签收货表。可选五箱另批，拒绝不能撤基础工包或后续结局方向。

contexts.paragraph_english: Write a formal inquiry that names the two notices, the relevant time and the question you need answered. You may save it before deciding whether to send. This local activity is about ordinary study arrangements. It does not hide a network order or supply an essential ending condition. Its independent optional contract and reward remain to be approved; saving an inquiry alone will not issue a completion receipt.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 正式询问信注明两通知、相关时间与待答问题，可先保存再决定交付。这是普通学习安排，未藏网络命令或必需结局条件。独立可选合同及奖励待核定，存询问本身不出完成回执。

contexts.paragraph_english: For this private local coordination task, the existing transfer-shed receiver ROLE-R6-SHED-RECEIVER accepts complete labelled boxes against the present manifest; the ridge receiver ROLE-R6-RIDGE-RECEIVER accepts them after a safe segment arrival and checks the same version. Confirm both contacts and those receiving conditions with Tess’s current invitation. These are two existing main-route receiving functions, not hidden settlements needed for an ending. The task can be deferred without taking their protected basic supplies away.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本人邀请下的地方协调涉及既有中转棚接收岗ROLE-R6-SHED-RECEIVER和风脊接收岗ROLE-R6-RIDGE-RECEIVER。前者依现行货单接受整箱标记货物，后者在安全段抵达后核同一版本。明确两名联系人及收货条件；它们是两处已有主线路径岗位，不是结局必须隐藏聚落。暂缓此项不撤走基础供给。

entries.english_definition: A way along which someone can move.

contexts.paragraph_english: The centre of the cabin floor is cracked. A person may appear to cross it successfully while the damaged boards continue to move underneath. Do not use that as a load test. The emergency cabinet beside the port wall contains a hand tool and a short rescue line; both belong to this vessel's rescue kit. A loose gangboard is stored along the intact side of the cabin. Secure it across the damaged section, keeping its ends on sound supports, before directing anybody towards the shore exit. The reef path begins beyond that exit. This note describes the cabin passage, not the safety of the landing place outside. Check the shore notice before choosing an approach for the rescue boat.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 船舱中央地板已经开裂。有人一度踩过去，不能证明受损板材可承重。左舷救援柜存有手工具和一根救援索，均属于本船救援包。沿完好的侧壁放着一块踏板。先把踏板两端固定在可靠支承上，再安排人员走向岸边出口。出口外才是礁岸路径；本说明不能证明岸上接应点安全，需要另查岸边告示。

contexts.paragraph_english: Two markers are visible from the reef path. The southern marker stands near the broken steps. It identifies the old landing place but does not confirm that the steps remain usable after a surge. The northern reach is beyond the low stone wall. Its approach is narrow, so a rescue boat must wait for a clear signal rather than following the first moving light it sees. The winch line can guide people towards either marker. Choose the receiving direction before loading the line, and repeat the tension check whenever that direction changes. A raised hand lamp may help people find the path; it does not replace the line or repair the steps.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 礁岸可见两个标记。南标记位于破损台阶旁，标出旧接应点，并不保证浪涌后台阶仍能用。北段在矮石墙外，入口狭窄，救援船应等明确接应信号。绞盘索可朝两边接应；承载前须选方向，改向后须重新检查张力。手灯帮助辨路，不替代救援索，也不修复台阶。

contexts.paragraph_english: The shore winch has its own small reserve; it is not supplied by the harbour generator or by a ship battery. Switch its local power off and isolate the drive before seating the displaced cable. Secure the rescue line at the marked anchor, then set the receiving direction. The cable and line may be prepared in either order while the drive is isolated. Restore local power only after both are secure. Run the tension check with no people on the line. A check belongs to that configuration: moving the receiving direction, reseating the cable or changing power cancels its validity. The nearby animals must be kept away from the receiving path before the line carries people. If a check fails, keep people in the protected assembly area and inspect the preparation again; taking time to read this card does not change the number of survivors. The shelter retains a working short-range distress set for the shore receiving team. It can send the registered rescue request before the separate coast-to-harbour relay is restored. Harbour pickup is confirmed through that relay later; a saved draft at the shelter has not yet sent a request.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 岸边绞盘使用自己的储备，和港口发电机、船电池无关。关闭本地电源并隔离驱动后，重新落座移位的钢缆。救援索固定在标记锚点，设置接应方向；隔离状态下，钢缆与索具可按任意先后准备。两者固定后才能恢复本地电源，先空载检查张力。证书只对应当次配置；改方向、缆线或电源均使旧检查失效。承载前须制止接应路径附近的动物威胁。检查失败时人员留在保护集合处，阅读不会减少幸存者。 救援棚有可用的短距求援台，能先向岸上接应队发送已登记求援；海岸至港口的独立中继另行恢复，之后才能确认港口接应。发送台保存稿件还没有发送请求。

contexts.paragraph_english: The public path leads to the priory courtyard. June can arrange a meeting there and direct visitors to the residential porches. Please use the public room codes when making notes. Residents may speak for themselves, ask a custodian to relay a request, or decline an interview.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 公共通路通往修院庭院。琼可在那里安排会面，并引导访客前往住区门廊。做笔记时请使用公开房间代码。住民可以亲自说明、请保管人转达请求，也可以拒绝访谈。

entries.english_definition: An explanation of why something happened or should happen.

contexts.paragraph_english: Bridge observation copy — times use the same ship clock. 21:14:10: the tower light disappeared from view while the heading indicator still showed the assigned course. 21:16:00: the helmsman reported a course deviation. 21:17:40: contact with the reef was felt. The entries describe what the crew observed; they do not identify a switch operator or establish the reason for the loss of light. The ship clock has not yet been compared with a shore instrument. Preserve this copy and compare it with an independent record when the rescue work allows it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 桥台抄记使用同一船钟。21:14:10，塔灯消失，当时航向指示仍显示规定航向。21:16:00，舵手报告偏航。21:17:40，船体触礁。记录只说明船员观察到的先后，不识别开关操作者，也不证明熄灯原因。船钟尚未与岸上仪器核对；先保留副本，完成救援后再找独立记录。

contexts.paragraph_english: The most common reason given on the forms was the need for a quiet place to work. Access to specialist materials was mentioned less often. That finding led one member of the team to suggest opening a supervised study room instead of the whole library. It might meet much of the demand at a lower staffing cost. But another member pointed out that a less common need can still be important. A small group may depend on equipment or collections that cannot be moved into an ordinary room.

There is also a danger in using protection as a reason to keep every difficult fact out of reach. If an official label prevents food from reaching people who are here, a polite assurance that the files are private does not correct the problem. Someone must be able to check the classification and the evidence that challenges it. A custodian therefore has two kinds of work: keep unnecessary personal details within their agreed scope, and maintain a usable route for examining public decisions. The two duties require different records and sometimes different recipients.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 以保护为由封闭所有难以面对的事实，也有危险。官方标签若使在此生活的人收不到食物，礼貌地说“档案私密”不能纠正问题。必须有人能检查分类及与之冲突的证据。保管人的工作包含两项：将不必要私人细节留在约定范围内，也为公共决定保留可用的检查途径。两项职责需要不同记录，有时需要不同接收方。

contexts.paragraph_english: Before sending anyone through, tell us which return route was inspected and whether the wet pump area has a current safety check. If a check fails, keep the group at the safe shelter and repair the local fault. There is no reason to erase the town's earlier receipts or ask people to return below after they have already been received.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 派人通过前，请说明哪条返程路已检查、潮湿泵房区域是否有当前安全记录。检查失败时，让人员留在安全避护处，修复本地故障。无需删除矿镇先前回执，也不能要求已接收的人重新下井。

entries.english_definition: Information or a person that helps someone find or perform something.

contexts.paragraph_english: Sian: Start with what the sheets actually record. Two teams made field visits; a report office copied selected rows. Those are different kinds of source. Please name a condition that your explanation has not yet controlled.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 西安：从纸页实际记录出发。两队做现场访问，报告办公室选抄部分行，两者是不同来源。曲线可以引导问题，无需先定结论。灯署的主张和你的主张遵循同一核验。请列你解释尚未控制的一项条件。

contexts.paragraph_english: The local inspection assignment permits this batch comparison. It does not permit the release of unrelated household details or the alteration of priory records. If the original instrument remains temporarily inaccessible, the retained copy can guide preparation, while the final finding keeps the missing inspection explicit.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本地查验委托允许这项批次比较，没有许可发布无关住户细节或改写修院记录。原仪表暂时无法到达时，可用副本准备工作；最终结论仍明确缺少哪项现场查验。

contexts.paragraph_english: Finn authorises the present survey from the distribution desk. The declared basic protective kit, guide markers and return-line notes belong to this field commission. Check the kit and obtain the forecast before leaving for the pass. Tess can offer local guidance without joining the party. Her formal invitation follows the completed survey. Nobody needs to endorse a distributed policy to get a safe route or a necessary record.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 芬在集散台签发本次调查。基础防护包、向导标记和返程说明属于这项现场委托，出发前核对实物并取得预报。泰丝可以作为当地向导提供帮助，正式同行邀请在测站核查后提出。获得安全路和必要记录不要求赞成分布式政策。

entries.english_definition: Energy supplied to make equipment operate.
