contexts.paragraph_english: Signal clerk: I first told the surface desk that the freight lift could carry the return group. Please change that note. The lift branch has not been tested from the cutting-face side, so it is not our present exit. The fixed inspection ladder beside the main lift is the route we can check now. It stays available when the power setting changes.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 信号员：我最初向地面台说，货运升降支路能运送返程人员。请更正这条便条。采掘面一侧尚未完成支路测试，所以它目前不是出口。现在可检查主升降机旁的固定梯道；供电设置变化后，这条路仍在。

contexts.paragraph_english: This relay records signals locally even when its outgoing link is unavailable. The independent recorder and the outgoing transmitter are separate parts of the station. Before touching the displaced outgoing lead, switch the local transmitter off and isolate it. Seat the lead, restore the station's own reserve and run a link check. The test confirms this lead and power configuration only. If either changes, repeat it before requesting a boat. A successful link test is not evidence that a distant tower is safe. The postal locker may be opened for the named technician after the shore rescue has been completed. Its contents are correspondence, not a certificate about the sender's present whereabouts. The rear latch can be opened from this room to provide a shorter route back to the rescue shelter.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 中继站外发链路中断时仍可本地记录；独立记录器与外发设备是两个部件。检修移位接线前关闭并隔离本地发送设备，再落座接线，恢复本站储备，做当前配置链路检查。改变接线或电源须重新检查；成功不证明远方塔站安全。救援完成后，具名检修员才可领取邮务柜通信，它不证明寄信人目前所在或状态。后门内闩可从站内打开，缩短返回救援棚的路线。

contexts.paragraph_english: Inspection appointment. The bearer is a trainee technician assigned to public navigation maintenance. The appointment establishes a role, not unrestricted access to every power installation. Local harbour work must be commissioned by the officer responsible for the site. Follow the conditions on that commission and keep separate records for each device. A civil ferry's navigation lamp, a workshop's independent controller and the harbour main generator are not interchangeable authorisations. This appointment was carried on the inspection vessel. It does not certify language performance, membership of a faction or the present location of the technician's mentor.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 随检修船携带的任职凭证：持有人为公共导航检修见习员。身份不等于任意电力设施访问权；地方工作须由现场负责人委托，并按设备分别记录。民用渡轮导航灯、工坊独立控制器、港口主发电机不是通用授权。凭证不证明英语表现、组织成员身份或导师目前位置。

entries.english_definition: A written record containing information.

contexts.paragraph_english: Limited maintenance exception. Havel, the dispatch officer, may commission inspection and repair of the civil ferry's navigation equipment and the local workshop arrangements needed to obtain its replacement parts. State that the purpose is evacuation assistance and identify those work areas in the request. Harbour main-generator operation is outside this exception: its safety isolation has not been confirmed. A commission allows local preparation; the ferry remains at the quay until a tested current configuration and an explicitly confirmed departure plan are available. Neither a fee nor a language score is required to request the commission. Crew recruitment, patrol-boat use and access to retained accident records are separate decisions and must not be inferred from this document.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 有限检修例外：调度负责人哈文可委托民用渡轮导航设备检修及为取替换件所需的本地工坊操作。申请写明协助撤离及这些范围。主发电机安全隔离尚未确认，操作它不在例外内。委托只允许准备；当前配置测试与明确离港方案确认完成前，渡轮留港。申请不需费用或英语分数；招募、巡灯船及事故记录调阅均另行授权。

contexts.paragraph_english: Freight clerk: Bring the sample to the actual packing stand, with the observation stage and the three document versions. I can acknowledge the authorised outgoing package and keep its custody reference. I cannot acknowledge a sample which has only been named in a draft. The academic receiving desk will still need to inspect what reaches it, and the voyage requires its own vessel and route checks.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 货运员：请带样本到真实包装站位，附观察阶段与三份文书版本。我能确认获准发出包，保留保管索引，不能确认仅写在稿中的样本。学城接收台仍要查实际收到什么，航行也另需船只与航路检查。

contexts.paragraph_english: Draft contingency notice, prepared on D0 at 20:50. This copy was stored with the evening dispatch papers; its issue box is blank. The text describes a possible interruption of the harbour light and tells receiving crews to wait for a revised route message. A handwritten heading calls it an accident notice, but the heading does not identify a cause. Preparing a notice in advance may indicate planning for a risk. It does not, by itself, show that somebody intended a grounding. Preserve the draft label and the empty issue box when citing this document. The approval and execution records are held separately. Do not replace them with a conclusion drawn from the title.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: D0 20:50准备、尚未签发的应急通知。事故字样不说明原因，预先准备通知不能单独证明故意搁浅；引用时保留草稿标签及空白签发栏，另查批准与执行记录。

contexts.paragraph_english: This is a historical document. It contains no present message from its signatories and gives no current location for Mara. Include its version and the remaining verification in any factual summary sent for review.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 这是历史文书，没有签名人的当前消息，也没有玛拉目前的位置。提交事实摘要时应保留版本和待核查范围。

entries.english_definition: The movement of people or goods between places.

contexts.paragraph_english: The transport office initially looked for mistakes in the timetable. None were found. The difficulty was that the ten-minute connection had been measured from the arrival of the train at the platform to the departure of the bus from its stop. It did not include the time passengers might need to leave a crowded carriage, reach the footbridge and collect a bicycle or a large bag. What looked like a generous interval on paper was not necessarily a usable interval for everyone.

Local representative: A tower that is safe to approach still needs its conservation work. I want the overview to show that difference. When the crew reserves an order, it holds the whole packet and the posts together. It then carries out transport, delivery, installation and verification as distinct actions. One crew has one current installation capacity. If someone cancels an unused reservation, we can release it. If the component is already installed, a cancellation cannot produce another component. The next crew must be able to find the actual item and the earlier work receipt.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 地方代表：可安全接近的塔仍需保全工作，视图要显示区别。预留单把工包岗位一起占住，再分别运输、交付、安装、核验。一班组同期容量一。未用可释放，装好的取消不制造另一件。接班人必须找到实物与旧工作回执。

contexts.paragraph_english: At the end of the trial, fewer complaints had been received. The transport office treated this as encouraging rather than decisive. A complaint count depends not only on the number of problems but also on whether passengers know where to report them and believe that reporting is worthwhile. The number of rail passengers had also varied during the trial. The office therefore compared complaints with observed missed connections and passenger numbers. It did not publish the lower complaint count as proof that every user had benefited.

Early reduction has a clear attraction. It removes the extra extraction load immediately and leaves more work supplies available for shelter and retrofit. Residents can see improvements begin, while the mine team checks what a lower setting changes. The cost is also real. Output expected from the current work period will be absent, and a transfer which depended on that output needs another arrangement. A responsible argument for early reduction should explain that substitution. It should not imply that stopping one process automatically provides transport, different employment or every part needed for a future tower conversion.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 尽早降载有明显吸引力：立即撤去额外抽取负荷，留下更多作业物资用于安置和改造。住民可看到改善开始，矿队同时检查低设置的变化。代价也真实：本工作期预期产出缺失，依赖该产出的转移需要替代安排。支持早降载的论证应说明如何替代，不能暗示停一道工序就自动提供运输、新工作和后续塔改造所有部件。

entries.english_definition: The act of going from one place to another.

contexts.paragraph_english: The final recommendation retained the extra wait after the busiest train and made responsibility for the lift checks explicit. It also proposed another review during the college term, when travel patterns might differ. Some residents regarded the continued review as unnecessary caution; others welcomed the acknowledgement that a useful arrangement could still need adjustment. The case suggests that a timetable is best understood as a statement of an intended service, rather than a guarantee that every person can make every connection. Assessing that service requires attention to the journey around the scheduled departure as well as to the time printed beside it.

Custodian: We will not count silence as proof. The three opportunities to respond are now recorded, with the answers and their limits attached. The summary will retain Mara’s design and delayed-correction responsibility, Voss’s policy, testing and suppression responsibility, and Rook’s review cancellation and detention responsibility. The transfer question is a next-stage action, not an event that has already happened because we discussed it. The originals will remain available under the temporary custody arrangement. A redacted summary can travel onward, but its readers must still know which claims rest on independent records and which reproduce the same source.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 保管人：沉默不计证明。三方反证机会及回应限制已记录；摘要保留玛拉设计与迟延纠正、沃斯政策测试压制、鲁克取消复核扣押责任。移交是下一阶段动作，不因讨论便发生。原件留临时保管，脱敏摘要可继续送，但读者须知道哪些独立、哪些同源复制。

contexts.paragraph_english: Records travel farther than their writers expect. A room code on a kitchen sheet may be harmless among people who already know the building. Add a private address, a family relationship and a public announcement, and the same account can expose someone to attention they never agreed to receive. Removing those details need not remove the events. A review can still retain an observation date, the duty of the observer, the version of a record and a route to the protected original. These fields let a reader ask whether the account has support.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 记录会传得比作者预想更远。厨房页的房间代码，在熟悉建筑的人之间可能没有什么风险。加上私人住址、亲属关系和公共通告，同一陈述却可能让人受到从未同意的关注。去掉这些细节，无需去掉事件。审查仍可保留观察日期、记录员职能、版本及通向受保护原稿的查验路径，让读者判断陈述有无支持。

contexts.paragraph_english: Keep the finding at the location level until the next investigation has direct access. Knowing where a facility is does not authorise its rescue in advance, make a returned person appear here, or settle the designer's historical part in the network. Follow the next commission through actual travel and legal entry.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 下一查验直接进入前，把核查限于地点。知道设施位置不会提前完成救援，不会令被接回者出现在这里，也没有裁定设计者历史作用。下一委托仍需实际旅行与合法进入。

entries.english_definition: A short account of the main information.

contexts.paragraph_english: Basic archive access may be registered for this check. Names in protected attachments require a separate request, a stated purpose and a permitted recipient. Keep the public room codes in your working summary. No resident has agreed to publication merely by accepting a meal or answering a question.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本次查验可以登记基础档案访问。受保护附页中的姓名须另外申请，说明用途与接收方。工作摘要使用公开房间代码。领取饭食或回答问题均未构成同意公开身份。

contexts.paragraph_english: Review desk: You have brought the transfer records, the residence check and the station boundary receipt. We can receive them in more than one form. A public summary can use room codes, dates and source references, while the protected originals remain available for controlled review. A delegated review package can instead go to a named review desk under its stated purpose. In either arrangement, the important public claims need a route by which someone can check the supporting records.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 审查台：你带来了转移记录、居住核查和支站边界回执。可以用多种形式交付。公共摘要可用房间代码、日期和来源索引，受保护原稿保留受控查验；受托审查包也可按用途交给指定审查台。无论哪种安排，重要公共陈述都需要可检查支持记录的路径。

contexts.paragraph_english: This is a historical document. It contains no present message from its signatories and gives no current location for Mara. Include its version and the remaining verification in any factual summary sent for review.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 这是历史文书，没有签名人的当前消息，也没有玛拉目前的位置。提交事实摘要时应保留版本和待核查范围。

contexts.paragraph_english: You may argue for wider public scrutiny, a controlled review, or a combination with a public summary and retained originals. State the practical benefits, the risks and the arrangement you intend to carry out. I will not infer that choice from a saved essay. At this desk, you will confirm the fields, the recipient, the purpose and the version, inspect the proposed handover, then explicitly send it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 你可以主张更广公开、受控审查，或公共摘要与保留原稿结合。请说明实际益处、风险与所选安排。保存文章不会让我推断交付选择。你须在此确认字段、接收方、用途和版本，查看交接预览，再明确发送。

entries.english_definition: A book or record listing transactions.

contexts.paragraph_english: Copies retain the source reference of their original. A departure entry copied into a ledger remains the departure officer's record. An arrival written by the receiving officer at the receiving site has its own source. Keep the two references visible when describing what has been checked.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 副本沿用原稿来源。出发记录抄入总账后仍是出发记录员的记录；接收员在接收现场写下的到达记录另有来源。说明查验结果时，应保留两个来源标识。

contexts.paragraph_english: Archive clerk: We have laid out the local M-12 papers on two stands. Start with either one, but keep the references attached when you make your notes. The departure officer's page and the receiving officer's page describe different observations. The ledger was prepared from those records later. If the departure entry appears twice, count its source once. The second copy is useful when a page cannot be handled; it does not add another person who saw the vehicle leave.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 阅览台员：M-12地方文件摆在两个站位，可以从任一处开始，但记笔记时要保留来源编号。出发记录员和接收员记的是不同观察，总账稍后由这些记录编成。出发条目即使出现两次，来源也只算一次。另一份副本有助于无法触摸原页时查阅，没有增加看到车辆离开的人。

contexts.paragraph_english: The rear work point is available for recording future preservation requirements. Its labels list one base isolator, one local backup pack and two base provision packs for this tower. These labels describe required supplies, not items already delivered. Stable access and a local dinner feed do not fill the work point or the engineering ledger.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 后部工作点可登记以后保全需求：一个基础隔离件、一个本地备用包、两个基础保障包。这是需求，不是已交付库存。安全通路与地方晚餐回路均未填充此工作点或工程账。

contexts.paragraph_english: The receiving desk recorded the vehicle’s arrival at 14:40. The entry was made by the receiving officer when the vehicle reached the site. At 16:05 the same day, an archive clerk copied the movement and arrival entries into the central ledger. The later ledger stamp marks the copying, not a second journey or a later physical arrival.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 接收台记录车辆于14:40到达。这条记录由接收员在车辆抵达现场时写下。同日下午16:05，档案员把行程与到达条目抄入中央总账。较晚总账戳记标记的是抄录，并非第二次旅程或较晚的实际到达。

entries.english_definition: Information arranged in rows and columns.

contexts.paragraph_english: The table concerns the twenty-four entries checked in this priory, not all evacuees. The first column groups entries by the label on the current official roll. The second records voluntary confirmation at the public porches in the present chapter stage. Grouping uses room codes so that the comparison can be reviewed without names.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本表限于修院核查过的二十四项记录，并非所有转移人员。第一列按现行官方名册标签分组，第二列记录本章节阶段在公共门廊自愿确认居住的人数。比较使用房间代码，可以不具名审阅。

contexts.paragraph_english: For the comparison report, use the local group table and the residence checks together. Describe what the columns measure and what the check can support. The room codes are enough for the public table. If you want an identity attachment, ask for that specific version and purpose at the scope desk. We can keep the public inquiry moving while such a request is considered.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 比较报告请结合地方住区表和居住核查，说明两列衡量的内容及查验能够支持什么。公共表使用房间代码即可。查看身份附页时，请在范围台申请具体版本与用途。申请审议期间，公共调查仍可继续。

contexts.paragraph_english: MC-2 has two incomplete on-site checks although its acceptance form marks all six accepted. MC-3 leaves one official acceptance open alongside an incomplete check. To explain the MC-2 discrepancy, inspect its particular fields, source versions and signature. The aggregate table helps locate a disagreement; it cannot identify the cause of every accident from a total alone.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: MC-2有两项现场未完成，验收表却把六项全部列为合格。MC-3的一项正式验收与未完成检查均仍待处理。解释MC-2差异须查具体字段、来源版本和签章。汇总表帮助定位冲突，不能仅凭总数识别每次事故的原因。

contexts.paragraph_english: Pera: Before we decide what to send, I want the three records kept on the table. The instrument sheet describes the local check at stage I. The workshop copy follows that sheet, and the final acceptance is version three. People have been calling them three separate witnesses. That wording worries me. We have three documents, but one repeats another. Please explain what each can establish, and keep the current rescue apart from the earlier acceptance. The workers need to come home whether or not they want to discuss who signed a form.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 佩拉：决定送什么之前，我希望三份记录都留在台上。仪表页记阶段I检查，工坊副本承接该页，最终验收是第三版。有人把它们叫三名独立证人，这个说法让我担心。我们有三份文件，其中一份复述另一份。请说明各自能核实什么，把当前救援与早验收分开；工人无论是否愿意谈签章，都需要回家。

entries.english_definition: One side of a sheet or one section of a document.

contexts.paragraph_english: Isolate the conveyor at its existing handle before touching the external winding, using the manual drain or removing a guard. Check the stopped mechanism and the water gauge at the marked stands. A page in the archive cannot perform those checks.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 接触外部缠绕、使用手动排水或拆护罩前，应在既有手柄处隔离输送器，并在标记站位检查停转机构与积水表。档案文字不能代替现场检查。

contexts.paragraph_english: Archive clerk: We have laid out the local M-12 papers on two stands. Start with either one, but keep the references attached when you make your notes. The departure officer's page and the receiving officer's page describe different observations. The ledger was prepared from those records later. If the departure entry appears twice, count its source once. The second copy is useful when a page cannot be handled; it does not add another person who saw the vehicle leave.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 阅览台员：M-12地方文件摆在两个站位，可以从任一处开始，但记笔记时要保留来源编号。出发记录员和接收员记的是不同观察，总账稍后由这些记录编成。出发条目即使出现两次，来源也只算一次。另一份副本有助于无法触摸原页时查阅，没有增加看到车辆离开的人。

contexts.paragraph_english: Controlled extract, temporary supply scheme TS-18, initial signature page. The page bears the name and signature reference of Mara Venn among its contributors. The title describes a temporary compulsory synchronisation arrangement during an earlier supply crisis. The preserved page is an early version; the archive also holds later references which have not yet been assembled into a complete change history here.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 临时供给方案TS-18初始签名页的受控摘录。参与者列含玛拉·维恩姓名与签名索引。标题说明这是早期供给危机期间的临时强制同步安排。保留页面属于早期版本；档案还有后续索引，本地尚未整理出完整变更历史。

contexts.paragraph_english: The custodian can verify that this extract comes from the stated page. Determining the scope of each contributor's responsibility requires the original scheme, related meeting records and later changes. A signature identifies a link to examine; it does not supply those missing records.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 保管人可核查摘录来自标明页面。判断各参与者具体责任范围，需要原方案、相关会议记录和后来变更。签名提供待查关联，没有补齐缺失文件。

entries.english_definition: The practical design and operation of machines and structures.

contexts.paragraph_english: The local selector can be tested without releasing the central tower lock. A successful small-station test will support a request to visit the tower duty layer for a current safety inspection. It will not certify the modern tower for independent operation, allocate a conversion crew or fill any six-tower engineering account.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 地方选择器可以在不解除塔站中央锁定的情况下试验。小支站成功试验后，可申请前往塔站值守层核查当前安全；此结果没有认证现代塔站独立运行，没有分配改造班组，也不填入六塔工程账。

contexts.paragraph_english: Stores clerk: I have one further correction to the draft. It says the auxiliary alarm parts will come out of these six packages. They will not. The workshop offers a separate repair pack for that invited job, and the engineering ledger holds different tower components. Please keep the three accounts named. A repair can be useful without being a tower upgrade. If the proposed recipients change before delivery, show me the new distribution and check the stock again. If the packages have already moved, start from their actual current ownership instead of the old reservation.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 库管员：草稿还需更正一处：它说辅助警报器零件来自这六包，实际并非如此。工坊为获邀工作另备维修包，工程账又有不同塔部件，请分列三账。维修可以有用，无需把它叫成塔升级。交付前接收方改变时，请带新分配复查库存；已经转移后，从当前归属开始，不从旧预留开始。

contexts.paragraph_english: The rear work point is available for recording future preservation requirements. Its labels list one base isolator, one local backup pack and two base provision packs for this tower. These labels describe required supplies, not items already delivered. Stable access and a local dinner feed do not fill the work point or the engineering ledger.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 后部工作点可登记以后保全需求：一个基础隔离件、一个本地备用包、两个基础保障包。这是需求，不是已交付库存。安全通路与地方晚餐回路均未填充此工作点或工程账。

contexts.paragraph_english: Keep the destination as the next inquiry direction. A file reference is not an authority to operate the mine, a delivery of engineering components or proof that the Glimmer has sailed there.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 这是一条下一步方向。档案编号不会赋予矿井操作权，不交付工程组件，也不证明微光号已经航行到那里。

entries.english_definition: The assignment of available resources to particular uses.

contexts.paragraph_english: The kitchen would welcome early leaves, while the store keeper wants a stronger later reserve. Neither request removes the other need. The group may choose either complete arrangement and record the trade-off, or ask for an agreed revision before planting. A proposal which uses more than six beds is not yet a feasible allocation.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 厨房希望早有叶菜，仓管希望增强晚期储备。两类需求同时存在。可选任一完整配置并记录取舍，也可种植前申请共识修改。超过六床的提议尚不可执行。

contexts.paragraph_english: Stores clerk: Every extra package has one local identifier. If four go to shelter and two to retrofit, all six are allocated and none remain for production support. That is a feasible early-reduction distribution. Two to shelter, one to retrofit and three to production also meets the allocation limits. It supports a limited transition with less immediate improvement in the other two uses. We can consider a different distribution within the same limits. What I cannot sign is a list of seven packages, or a list which sends the same package to two groups.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 库管员：每个额外工包有独立地方编号。安置四、改造二就用完六包，不剩生产支持，这是一种可行早降载分配。安置二、改造一、生产三也符合限制，可支持有限过渡，但其他两项即时改善较少。还可考虑同限额内的别种分配。我不能签七包清单，也不能把同一包送给两个组。

contexts.paragraph_english: At the layout stand, mark the chosen beds and ask the growers to check the available space. Saving an allocation note preserves a proposal. Actual planting, once authorised and carried out, leaves a dated work record. Until there is an agreed allocation and that record, the trial remains planned. This work is optional and does not block the transfer investigation or require publishing anyone's identity.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 在布局台标床位，由种植者核对空间。保存分配稿只留下提案；获准并实际种植后才有日期工作记录。未有共识与实际记录时，试种仍计划中。此工作可选，不阻断转移调查，也不要求公开身份。

contexts.paragraph_english: Before confirmation, an allocation can be revised while the packages remain in the store. After actual delivery, record their current destination and any work already done. Revising a draft cannot pull installed material back out or print a second copy of a spent package. An arrangement that needs a package no longer available must be changed or supplied through a lawful new source.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 确认前，工包仍在库内时可以修改分配。实际交付后，要保留当前位置及已做工作。改草稿不能拔回安装材料，或复制已使用工包。新安排若需要已不存在的工包，须修改方案或通过合法新来源补足。

entries.english_definition: A group of items made or processed together.

contexts.paragraph_english: The index links local interlock plate IL-2 to maintenance batch MC-2 at the bell-mine workshop. It records a destination for checking the batch's original instrument sheets and acceptance versions. The priory copy contains the batch reference and a dispatch acknowledgement, not the workshop's complete technical file.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本地联锁标牌IL-2在索引中关联沉钟矿区工坊检修批次MC-2，指明应到何处核对该批次原始仪表页与验收版本。修院副本只有批次索引与发件确认，没有工坊完整技术档案。

contexts.paragraph_english: The historical signature page also needs its limit recorded. Its early version is evidence of a connection to examine, and the missing change history remains part of the question. The mining batch index gives the next destination for checking that history. Our acknowledgement will state exactly what we received and what is still unverified; it will not report a mine visit that has not happened.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 历史签名页也须保留限制。早期版本提供待查关联，缺失变更史仍是问题的一部分。矿区批次索引给出下一处核查方向。我们的确认会写明收到什么、哪些内容未核实，不会写成尚未发生的矿区访问。

contexts.paragraph_english: A chapter handover should name the batch, the material already checked and the questions still open. The mining workshop can inspect its own originals. Neither the index nor this acknowledgement establishes who was responsible for a missing safety step.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 章节交接应注明批次、已核对材料与仍未解决问题。矿区工坊可检查自己的原稿。索引与发件确认均未证明缺失安全步骤的责任人。

contexts.paragraph_english: The priory index names maintenance batch MC-2. Its destination is this district's workshop. Pera, the mine forewoman, can define a local inspection and rescue assignment. The documents already carried from the priory remain useful as references, but they do not contain the workshop's original checks or a completed finding about its signatory.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 修院索引指向检修批次MC-2，目的地是本区工坊。矿区领班佩拉可说明本地查验与救援工作范围。带来的修院文件可以作为索引，却没有工坊原始检查，也没有关于签章人的完整核查结论。

entries.english_definition: Keeping someone in a place under imposed restriction.

contexts.paragraph_english: People still live behind the names missing from your chart. Twelve years ago subsidence closed the central bridge span; later the district was removed from the current place register. The residents remember the streets and have maintained other passages. Ada can confirm local routes, not the present condition of a person inside a locked detention room. The mission desk supplies one basic inspection kit, one lamp and one safety line for this local work. They are mission equipment, not personal upgrade parts or six-tower supplies. Either current credential checking or the existing service tunnel can reach the duty hall. No named companion is required.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 航图上消失的名字背后仍住着人。十二年前沉降封闭中央桥跨，后来地区被从现行名录移除；住民仍记得道路并维护其他通路。阿妲能确认地方路线，不能证实扣押室内某人的当前状态。当地委托提供一套基础检修工具、一盏灯和一条安全索，均为任务装备，不是个人零件或六塔物资。当前证件核查与既有隧道均可到值守厅，不要求指定同伴。

contexts.paragraph_english: Station channel: The orders were issued as emergency protection. Custodian: You may contest a reading of the order. Please identify the version and the field you dispute. The station register records detention being carried out, and the override removes independent review during the test window. The present rescue is separately recorded. Station channel: I do not have an instruction to accept a transfer of command. Ada: Then record that reply without pretending it answers every claim. We have to make the local facility safe, and people must be able to leave this review without losing lawful evidence.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 北站渠道：这些令以应急保护签发。保管人：可反驳解释，请指版本字段。北站登记记录扣押实施，取消令撤测试窗口独立复核，当前救援另记。渠道：我没有接受指挥权移交的指示。阿妲：记录回覆，别假装它回答所有主张；设施须安全，退出审查不应丧合法证据。

contexts.paragraph_english: OC-MAP-HIST@1 shows the former central bridge from the checkpoint towards North Station. Its route identity is HIST-CENTRAL-SPAN. That span is closed and has no present navigation port. OC-PASSAGE-CURRENT@1 identifies CHECKPOINT-DUTY-PASSAGE, a different route with similar large-scale endpoints. It remains available after current inspection credentials are checked. TUNNEL-SERVICE-PASSAGE runs from the checkpoint through the existing tunnel to the duty hall once its obstruction and local hazard are dealt with. Drawing either line does not perform the work. Both current routes end at the duty hall, not the detention rooms. Retain the old map as historical evidence rather than deleting its inconvenient line.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: OC-MAP-HIST@1 的 HIST-CENTRAL-SPAN 是昔日中央桥跨，已经关闭，没有现行导航端口。OC-PASSAGE-CURRENT@1 的 CHECKPOINT-DUTY-PASSAGE 与旧桥大尺度端点相近，却是另一条路线，须核验当前检修身份。TUNNEL-SERVICE-PASSAGE 经既有隧道到值守厅，须实际处理阻碍和危险。画线不能代替工作，两条当前路线都不直接进入扣押室。保留旧图作为历史证据，不删除不方便的旧桥线。

contexts.paragraph_english: The controlled passage accepts the patrol technician named in the current Glasshaven regional commission. Check the commission basis Q-404:resolution, its destination R5 and its purpose verify_north_station_and_legal_access against the actual landing register. Check the physical passage separately: the signed inspection identifies CHECKPOINT-DUTY-PASSAGE and explicitly excludes HIST-CENTRAL-SPAN. The checkpoint officer may verify these fields without granting detention-room access. If checking cannot be completed, use the basic service route. A copied historical credential or an unrelated action receipt cannot substitute for this current local check.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 核查通道接受当前学城跨区委托中的巡灯检修人。比对 Q-404:resolution、R5、verify_north_station_and_legal_access 与实际登陆登记；另检查实体通道，明确 CHECKPOINT-DUTY-PASSAGE 不含 HIST-CENTRAL-SPAN。核查员可验证这些字段，却不授扣押室权限。暂不能完成核查时有基础隧道解法。历史证件副本和无关动作回执不能代替当次检查。

entries.english_definition: A device or record showing time.

contexts.paragraph_english: Bridge observation copy — times use the same ship clock. 21:14:10: the tower light disappeared from view while the heading indicator still showed the assigned course. 21:16:00: the helmsman reported a course deviation. 21:17:40: contact with the reef was felt. The entries describe what the crew observed; they do not identify a switch operator or establish the reason for the loss of light. The ship clock has not yet been compared with a shore instrument. Preserve this copy and compare it with an independent record when the rescue work allows it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 桥台抄记使用同一船钟。21:14:10，塔灯消失，当时航向指示仍显示规定航向。21:16:00，舵手报告偏航。21:17:40，船体触礁。记录只说明船员观察到的先后，不识别开关操作者，也不证明熄灯原因。船钟尚未与岸上仪器核对；先保留副本，完成救援后再找独立记录。

contexts.paragraph_english: Review officer: I have the present configuration sheet, not a promise of its outcome. The operator starts Controller C only when the execution output has its current TEST route check. At minute five, we retain an intermediate observation. At minute ten, we retain the final result. The controller clock advances when you take those declared observations; the reader does not have to hurry.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 复核员：我持当前配置页，不是结果承诺。执行机输出取得当前TEST检查后，操作员才启动C。第5分钟留中间观察，第10分钟留末次结果。取声明观察时控制器钟才推进，阅读者不用赶。

contexts.paragraph_english: Coast recorder extract. Instrument clock: 21:14:12, light signal lost at the observed tower channel. Further gaps occur in the same recording window, but the extract does not contain a complete network diagnosis. The shore clock and ship clock differ by approximately two seconds in their last routine comparison. Taken with the ship observation copy, this extract supports the order of light loss followed by course deviation. It does not name the person responsible, explain why every gap occurred or establish that the outage was deliberate. Keep the original time labels attached when making a later comparison.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 海岸记录器摘录：仪器钟21:14:12，所观测塔台信号消失；同一窗口还有其他缺口，摘录并非完整网络诊断。最近一次常规比对中，岸钟与船钟相差约两秒。结合船上抄记，资料支持先熄灯后偏航，不识别责任人，不解释每个缺口，也不证明故意断供。后续比对保留原始时间标签。

contexts.paragraph_english: Evening duty handover, retained copy. At 21:05 on D0, a later work instruction removed the second traffic check from this test. The receiving operator recorded the change rather than marking the check as completed. A routine comparison at 20:40 placed the control clock within one second of the ship clock. The local control event copy lists the output interruption at 21:14:10, on the control clock. The instruction identifier and its issuing office are retained for further examination. This copy is not sufficient to establish what every officer knew or intended. The output event and the removed check should be recorded as separate findings: one concerns what the equipment did, the other concerns which protection was omitted. The independent coast clock was not set from this control clock.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: D0 21:05的后续工作指令移除了第二次人船复核，接班者没有把它标作已做。控制钟记录21:14:10断供；签发标识保留待后续核验，不能据此判定所有人员的知情与意图。 20:40常规比对记控制钟与船钟相差不超过一秒。

entries.english_definition: The possibility of an unwanted outcome.

contexts.paragraph_english: Draft contingency notice, prepared on D0 at 20:50. This copy was stored with the evening dispatch papers; its issue box is blank. The text describes a possible interruption of the harbour light and tells receiving crews to wait for a revised route message. A handwritten heading calls it an accident notice, but the heading does not identify a cause. Preparing a notice in advance may indicate planning for a risk. It does not, by itself, show that somebody intended a grounding. Preserve the draft label and the empty issue box when citing this document. The approval and execution records are held separately. Do not replace them with a conclusion drawn from the title.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: D0 20:50准备、尚未签发的应急通知。事故字样不说明原因，预先准备通知不能单独证明故意搁浅；引用时保留草稿标签及空白签发栏，另查批准与执行记录。

contexts.paragraph_english: Voss: I knew that sustained high load carried a long-term risk. Your retained failures must be part of the discussion. I still require a plan for the first week: who maintains protection, where the transition supply comes from, and who accepts responsibility between districts. A ten-minute local result cannot supply those fields. I propose delaying public release while the central system continues to coordinate.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 沃斯：我知道持续高负荷有长期风险，你保留的失败必须进入讨论。但第一周仍需计划：谁维护保护、过渡供给来自哪里、各区之间谁承责。十分钟本地结果填不出这些字段。我主张延后公开，同时由中央继续协调。

contexts.paragraph_english: Sometimes a person wants to be named. Their decision deserves the same care as a decision to remain private. Ask what they agree to release, to whom, for what use and in which version. A broad permission inferred from an earlier conversation may not fit a new publication. Equally, choosing the smallest possible package in every situation can remove the very detail that the person wants included or that the authorised review needs. Appropriate scope depends on the purpose and the permission, as well as on the risk of disclosure.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 有时本人希望具名。这个决定与保持私密同样需要认真对待。请问清允许发布什么、给谁、为何使用及对应版本。旧交谈推断出的宽泛许可可能不适合新发布。每次都机械选择最少字段，也可能删去本人希望保留的内容，或获准审查真正需要的细节。适当范围取决于用途、许可和公开风险。

contexts.paragraph_english: Survey team A used indicator IA-4 at the harbour and the mine during window W-1. The harbour station was in its declared lower-load band, with a local load reading of 40 and indicator reading 2. The mine station was in its higher-load band, with local load 70 and indicator reading 7. The instrument sheets retain their sampling window and location plates. Indicator readings describe the declared risk marker, not a forecast of an individual person's safety.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 调查A队在W-1窗口使用IA-4记录港口与矿区。港口处于声明的较低负荷档，本地负荷40、指标2；矿区处于较高负荷档，负荷70、指标7。仪表页保留窗口和地点标牌。指标反映声明的风险标志，不预测某个人是否安全。

entries.english_definition: The way equipment or settings are arranged.

contexts.paragraph_english: The shore winch has its own small reserve; it is not supplied by the harbour generator or by a ship battery. Switch its local power off and isolate the drive before seating the displaced cable. Secure the rescue line at the marked anchor, then set the receiving direction. The cable and line may be prepared in either order while the drive is isolated. Restore local power only after both are secure. Run the tension check with no people on the line. A check belongs to that configuration: moving the receiving direction, reseating the cable or changing power cancels its validity. The nearby animals must be kept away from the receiving path before the line carries people. If a check fails, keep people in the protected assembly area and inspect the preparation again; taking time to read this card does not change the number of survivors. The shelter retains a working short-range distress set for the shore receiving team. It can send the registered rescue request before the separate coast-to-harbour relay is restored. Harbour pickup is confirmed through that relay later; a saved draft at the shelter has not yet sent a request.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 岸边绞盘使用自己的储备，和港口发电机、船电池无关。关闭本地电源并隔离驱动后，重新落座移位的钢缆。救援索固定在标记锚点，设置接应方向；隔离状态下，钢缆与索具可按任意先后准备。两者固定后才能恢复本地电源，先空载检查张力。证书只对应当次配置；改方向、缆线或电源均使旧检查失效。承载前须制止接应路径附近的动物威胁。检查失败时人员留在保护集合处，阅读不会减少幸存者。 救援棚有可用的短距求援台，能先向岸上接应队发送已登记求援；海岸至港口的独立中继另行恢复，之后才能确认港口接应。发送台保存稿件还没有发送请求。

contexts.paragraph_english: Local operator: Before we open the machine-room work zone, show me the upper-floor checks. The isolation handle must still be in the state you inspected. We also need the stopped conveyor record, the fixed external clamp and the dry-route reading. A successful action from an older configuration will not cover a change you made afterwards. We can repeat the affected check without throwing away the clamp or drawing a second unique connector from the cabinet.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 地方检修员：开放机房工作区前，请出示上层检查。隔离手柄必须保持核查时状态，还需要输送器停转记录、固定外部夹具和干燥通路读数。旧配置下的成功动作不能涵盖后来改动。可以重做受影响检查，不必丢掉夹具，也不用从料柜再领唯一连接头。

contexts.paragraph_english: This relay records signals locally even when its outgoing link is unavailable. The independent recorder and the outgoing transmitter are separate parts of the station. Before touching the displaced outgoing lead, switch the local transmitter off and isolate it. Seat the lead, restore the station's own reserve and run a link check. The test confirms this lead and power configuration only. If either changes, repeat it before requesting a boat. A successful link test is not evidence that a distant tower is safe. The postal locker may be opened for the named technician after the shore rescue has been completed. Its contents are correspondence, not a certificate about the sender's present whereabouts. The rear latch can be opened from this room to provide a shorter route back to the rescue shelter.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 中继站外发链路中断时仍可本地记录；独立记录器与外发设备是两个部件。检修移位接线前关闭并隔离本地发送设备，再落座接线，恢复本站储备，做当前配置链路检查。改变接线或电源须重新检查；成功不证明远方塔站安全。救援完成后，具名检修员才可领取邮务柜通信，它不证明寄信人目前所在或状态。后门内闩可从站内打开，缩短返回救援棚的路线。

contexts.paragraph_english: Harbour closure order — current copy. General departures are suspended while the navigation restrictions are reviewed. Rescue arrivals continue at the public receiving berth. An arrival under that provision does not grant a vessel permission to depart. The dispatch office may issue a limited local maintenance commission where the work supports a specific safe evacuation arrangement. The commission must name its work area and power boundary. It does not itself clear a route, approve an untested navigation lamp or transfer ownership of a vessel. A later departure instruction must be checked against the route notices and the vessel's current configuration. The public consultation desk remains accessible during the closure; restricted records and equipment require their own authorisation.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 现行封港令：一般出港暂停，公共泊位仍接收救援入港；允许入港不等于允许出港。调度室可为明确安全撤离工作签发有限地方检修委托，写明作业范围和供电边界。委托本身不开放航道、不认可未经测试导航灯、不移交船产权。出港另需按航道资料及船舶当前配置核对。公共咨询区开放，受限记录与设备需各自授权。

entries.english_definition: Responsibility for keeping a person or object secure.

contexts.paragraph_english: Transfer TR-D1-7, version 1. Controlled extract from the receiving officer's custody handover record. The record is dated D−1 relative to the opening blackout. It identifies Mara Venn by the protected identification reference checked at the archive desk. The receiving officer recorded her as alive when custody was handed over. The destination is written as facility code F-17. No public site name or current address is supplied on this extract.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 转移TR-D1-7，第1版。接收员看管交接原稿的受控摘录，日期为开场熄灯前一天D−1。摘录用阅览台核对过的受保护身份索引识别玛拉·维恩。接收员记下她在看管交接时仍然活着。目的地写作设施代码F-17，本摘录没有公开地点名称或现行地址。

contexts.paragraph_english: The D−1 custody extract is a separate file. We will inspect its identifier and its dated receiving entry under the scope you requested. It records Mara's condition at that handover and uses a facility code for the destination. Later files would be needed to establish what happened after that point. None are included in this extract.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: D−1看管摘录是另一文件。我们会按所申请范围核查编号和有日期的接收条目。它记录玛拉在那次交接时的状态，以设施代码表示目的地。此后发生什么需要后续文件，本摘录不含那些记录。

contexts.paragraph_english: Sending-end record, custody transfer TR-D1-7, version 1. On D−1 the sending officer handed the person identified by protected reference MV to the named receiving duty. The sending observation records Mara Venn as alive at departure. The destination field contains facility code F-17. The public extract carries the transfer identifier and record version; the identity comparison is available under controlled review.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 发送端记录，看管转移TR-D1-7，第1版。D−1，发送员将受保护索引MV指明的人移交给具名接收岗位。发送观察记录玛拉·维恩出发时活着，目的地字段为设施代码F-17。公共摘录保留转移编号与版本，身份比对可按受控范围查验。

contexts.paragraph_english: An outgoing receipt establishes custody of the stated package at this work boundary. It does not mean that the Glimmer has sailed, that the academic team has completed a test, or that the disturbance has been explained. Record the lawful next inquiry direction without claiming those later results. This package gives no current location or present condition for Mara.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 发出回执说明此工作边界的具名资料保管，不表示微光号已航行、学城已完成试验或扰动已解释。记录合法下一方向，不宣称后来结果。这份资料没有玛拉当前所在或目前状态。

entries.english_definition: The greatest amount a system can safely handle.

contexts.paragraph_english: The local supply has a capacity of ten load units. Basic protection uses seven: two for drainage, two for ventilation, two for the warm room and one for signals. Keep those services available after the rescue. Extraction uses a separate setting of zero to three additional units. At three, the combined load reaches ten. The unit is a local planning measure, not an engineering component or a currency.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 地方供电容量为十负荷单位。基本保障用七：排水二、通风二、暖房二、信号一。救援后继续保留这些服务。抽取设置另为零至三附加单位；设为三时总负荷达十。单位用于地方规划，并非工程组件或货币。

contexts.paragraph_english: Local operator: I can take the operating post for the declared transition shift, if another person accepts the safety-watch post. Those must be different occupants. Extraction can be set from one to three units while the basic seven remain. Three reaches the total capacity of ten; four would exceed it. My acceptance covers this shift, not a permanent permission to keep the machine at the highest setting. At handover we will close the window and lower extraction to zero before the next shift begins. The changed setting will require a new test.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 地方操作员：若另一人承接安全观察岗，我可承担这班明确过渡的操作岗，两岗须是不同人员。保留基本七单位时，抽取可以为一至三；三恰达总容量十，四就超量。我的承诺只覆盖本班，没有永久允许机器保持最高设置。交班时我们结束窗口，在下一班前把抽取降到零，并重新测试变更设置。

contexts.paragraph_english: The current bounded arrangement retains seven basic-service units within a local capacity of ten. With early_reduce, extraction is zero. With time_limited_transition, extraction is one to three only during the one declared shift, and two distinct local people must actually hold the operating and safety-watch posts. Check the applied setting, not just the policy saved at the dispatch desk.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 当前有界安排在容量十内保留七单位基本服务。early_reduce抽取零；time_limited_transition仅在一班明确窗口内允许抽取一至三，并由两名不同本地人员实际承担操作与安全观察。检查已应用设置，而非只查调度台保存的政策。

contexts.paragraph_english: The future work list requires one base isolator, one local backup and two base provisions, with two operator posts and installation capacity one. Enhanced preparation additionally lists one controller, two couplers, three transition crates and one trial fixture. Those are requirements rather than delivered stock. Do not borrow the laboratory's installed fixture into the account. Actual reservation, transport, delivery, installation, operation and agreement remain separate work.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 未来清单需一基础隔离件、一地方备用、二基础供给、两值守岗位及一安装容量。增强再需一控制器、二耦合件、三过渡箱、一试验器材。它们是需求，不是已交库存，不能把实验室已装器材借进账。预留、运输、交付、安装、操作和协议仍分别执行。

entries.english_definition: A large organised settlement.

contexts.paragraph_english: The retained facility index maps custody code F-17 to the north-station holding facility in the old city. The code appears on the dated transfer reference already used in the priory investigation. This index provides a location mapping, not a new examination of the transferred person. Compare it with the supply destination and guard register before entering a location finding.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 留存设施索引把扣押代码F-17对应旧都北站扣押设施。代码曾出现于修院已查日期转移索引。此索引提供地点映射，没有对被转移者做新检查。应与物资目的地和看守册比较后形成地点核验。

contexts.paragraph_english: Finn: We have the old city's handover, including the direct confirmation of Mara's rescue. Keep that with the earlier responsibility findings. Today's station visit has a narrower job: find out what the present overload is doing to essential service and whether our return route can remain usable. I do not want a report that promises to explain every fog bank. If you use an earlier observation, identify its place and instrument. Similar-looking trouble in two places is a reason to compare the records carefully, rather than a reason to replace one record with the other.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 芬：旧都交接已到，包括玛拉获救直接确认，与早前责任核查一起保留。今天任务更窄：查看当前过载对基本服务的影响和返程能否保留，不要承诺解释所有雾。引用旧观察要写地点仪表；两地问题相似是认真比较的理由，不是互换记录的理由。

contexts.paragraph_english: The supply register uses destination F-17 and names the old-city north station as the receiving facility. It records custody provision for that destination, separate from the laboratory's local trial materials. The delivery clerk kept this record independently of the facility index. Check the code and receiving-place fields; a delivery reference does not tell us a detainee's current condition.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 物资册以F-17为目的地，接收设施写旧都北站，记录该处扣押保障供给，与实验室本地材料分账。交付员独立于设施索引保留此册。应查代码及接收地点；供给索引不说明被扣者当前情况。

contexts.paragraph_english: The watch register places the custody post for code F-17 at the old-city north station. Its post and location fields are retained for verification. The record was kept by the custody office, separately from the supply clerk's delivery book. It supports the facility mapping alongside those other sources. It is a duty record, not a current interview with the held person.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 看守册把F-17扣押岗位列在旧都北站，保留岗位及地点供核验。扣押办公室独立于供给交付册保存此记录，与其他来源共同支持设施映射。它是岗位记录，不是与被扣者的当前面谈。

entries.english_definition: A level of a building or the surface people stand on.

contexts.paragraph_english: The centre of the cabin floor is cracked. A person may appear to cross it successfully while the damaged boards continue to move underneath. Do not use that as a load test. The emergency cabinet beside the port wall contains a hand tool and a short rescue line; both belong to this vessel's rescue kit. A loose gangboard is stored along the intact side of the cabin. Secure it across the damaged section, keeping its ends on sound supports, before directing anybody towards the shore exit. The reef path begins beyond that exit. This note describes the cabin passage, not the safety of the landing place outside. Check the shore notice before choosing an approach for the rescue boat.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 船舱中央地板已经开裂。有人一度踩过去，不能证明受损板材可承重。左舷救援柜存有手工具和一根救援索，均属于本船救援包。沿完好的侧壁放着一块踏板。先把踏板两端固定在可靠支承上，再安排人员走向岸边出口。出口外才是礁岸路径；本说明不能证明岸上接应点安全，需要另查岸边告示。

contexts.paragraph_english: Local operator: Before we open the machine-room work zone, show me the upper-floor checks. The isolation handle must still be in the state you inspected. We also need the stopped conveyor record, the fixed external clamp and the dry-route reading. A successful action from an older configuration will not cover a change you made afterwards. We can repeat the affected check without throwing away the clamp or drawing a second unique connector from the cabinet.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 地方检修员：开放机房工作区前，请出示上层检查。隔离手柄必须保持核查时状态，还需要输送器停转记录、固定外部夹具和干燥通路读数。旧配置下的成功动作不能涵盖后来改动。可以重做受影响检查，不必丢掉夹具，也不用从料柜再领唯一连接头。

contexts.paragraph_english: The greenhouse supplies the priory kitchen and the public wash taps through two small local circuits. Water from the inspection stair has entered the upper transfer floor. Roots have also grown around the stopped conveyor. The public corridor remains usable. The stair may be opened for the locally commissioned inspection once the root-route threat is controlled and the stair boundary has been checked on site.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 温室通过两条小型地方回路供应修院厨房与公共洗水龙头。检修梯的水已流入转供站上层，根系缠住了停转的输送器。公共外廊仍可使用。根道威胁实际处置、检修梯边界现场核对后，地方检修委托可以开放下行。

contexts.paragraph_english: Use the existing hand-operated drain after checking that the conveyor is isolated. The water gauge is read at the upper-floor stand. A drain action and a safe gauge reading are separate records. If the conveyor supply or clamp position changes, repeat the affected safety check before crossing the wet floor. Returning along a route already made safe does not require collecting another clamp.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 确认输送器隔离后，使用既有手动排水装置。积水表须在上层站位读取。排水动作与安全读数分别记录。输送器供电或夹具位置改变后，跨越湿区前应重做受影响检查。沿已安全路线返程，无需再领夹具。

entries.english_definition: An assigned place for a vessel to lie alongside a shore structure.

contexts.paragraph_english: Coast pickup acknowledgement. Four people registered at the sheltered assembly point will be collected, together with the technician. The receiving route is the northern reach; the southern steps remain unavailable. Wait at the shelter's marked boarding point. The receiving crew will carry everyone to the public arrival berth at Saltmist Harbour. This acknowledgement permits that rescue passage only. It is not a general sailing licence, a maintenance commission or the handover of a patrol vessel. Take the coast records with you, keeping their source and time labels.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 接应回执：接走避风棚登记的四名幸存者和检修员，经北段上船，南台阶仍不可用。在棚外登记登船点等接应，前往盐雾港公共接应泊位。这只允许本次救援通行，不是一般航行许可、检修委托或巡灯船移交。带走资料并保留来源、时间标签。

contexts.paragraph_english: Tess: Review the current promises as carefully as the supplies. Cargo still moving needs actual receipt or safe deposit. An accepted promise that requires attendance needs a safe handover or explicit suspension. A previous empty register cannot describe a branch where new work was accepted. Save the handover and preserve the named pre-final checkpoint before sealing preparation. Then reach the chart aboard the same Glimmer and confirm the frontier berth and destination landing. The final departure moves that vessel once; it does not finish the central program or choose the final policy for us.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 泰丝：核供给也核现承诺。运输货要真实收货或安全托管，须到场承诺需安全交接或明确暂缓。旧空表不能描述后来接新工作的分支。保存交接、保留命名保护档、封存准备，再到同船海图核边境泊位与目的落点。最终出发只移同一船一次，不完成中央程序或替我们选政策。

contexts.paragraph_english: Arrival record — rescue passage from the stranded coast. The public arrival berth receives the technician and four registered survivors. Record their arrival before requesting further harbour work; a person carried here is not automatically signed onto another vessel's crew. Two different berths are shown on the quay plan. The civil ferry is awaiting maintenance and a safe departure arrangement. The stored patrol boat has no handover authorisation on this arrival record. A harbour officer may review a limited maintenance request at the public dispatch desk. Bring the rescue acknowledgement and your inspection appointment, and consult the current closure order rather than assuming that rescue passage suspends it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 搁浅海岸救援入港记录：接应泊位接收检修员和四名已登记幸存者。先登记到港，再申请后续港口工作；接应入港不自动成为另一船的船员。码头显示不同泊位：民用渡轮待检修与安全撤离方案；封存巡灯船没有在此记录中授权移交。公共调度台可审查有限检修申请，须携救援回执及任职凭证，并查现行封港令。

contexts.paragraph_english: Harbour closure order — current copy. General departures are suspended while the navigation restrictions are reviewed. Rescue arrivals continue at the public receiving berth. An arrival under that provision does not grant a vessel permission to depart. The dispatch office may issue a limited local maintenance commission where the work supports a specific safe evacuation arrangement. The commission must name its work area and power boundary. It does not itself clear a route, approve an untested navigation lamp or transfer ownership of a vessel. A later departure instruction must be checked against the route notices and the vessel's current configuration. The public consultation desk remains accessible during the closure; restricted records and equipment require their own authorisation.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 现行封港令：一般出港暂停，公共泊位仍接收救援入港；允许入港不等于允许出港。调度室可为明确安全撤离工作签发有限地方检修委托，写明作业范围和供电边界。委托本身不开放航道、不认可未经测试导航灯、不移交船产权。出港另需按航道资料及船舶当前配置核对。公共咨询区开放，受限记录与设备需各自授权。

entries.english_definition: A particular location where work takes place.

contexts.paragraph_english: Inspection appointment. The bearer is a trainee technician assigned to public navigation maintenance. The appointment establishes a role, not unrestricted access to every power installation. Local harbour work must be commissioned by the officer responsible for the site. Follow the conditions on that commission and keep separate records for each device. A civil ferry's navigation lamp, a workshop's independent controller and the harbour main generator are not interchangeable authorisations. This appointment was carried on the inspection vessel. It does not certify language performance, membership of a faction or the present location of the technician's mentor.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 随检修船携带的任职凭证：持有人为公共导航检修见习员。身份不等于任意电力设施访问权；地方工作须由现场负责人委托，并按设备分别记录。民用渡轮导航灯、工坊独立控制器、港口主发电机不是通用授权。凭证不证明英语表现、组织成员身份或导师目前位置。

contexts.paragraph_english: Copies retain the source reference of their original. A departure entry copied into a ledger remains the departure officer's record. An arrival written by the receiving officer at the receiving site has its own source. Keep the two references visible when describing what has been checked.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 副本沿用原稿来源。出发记录抄入总账后仍是出发记录员的记录；接收员在接收现场写下的到达记录另有来源。说明查验结果时，应保留两个来源标识。

contexts.paragraph_english: Transfer TR-D1-7, version 1. Controlled extract from the receiving officer's custody handover record. The record is dated D−1 relative to the opening blackout. It identifies Mara Venn by the protected identification reference checked at the archive desk. The receiving officer recorded her as alive when custody was handed over. The destination is written as facility code F-17. No public site name or current address is supplied on this extract.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 转移TR-D1-7，第1版。接收员看管交接原稿的受控摘录，日期为开场熄灯前一天D−1。摘录用阅览台核对过的受保护身份索引识别玛拉·维恩。接收员记下她在看管交接时仍然活着。目的地写作设施代码F-17，本摘录没有公开地点名称或现行地址。

contexts.paragraph_english: The greenhouse supplies the priory kitchen and the public wash taps through two small local circuits. Water from the inspection stair has entered the upper transfer floor. Roots have also grown around the stopped conveyor. The public corridor remains usable. The stair may be opened for the locally commissioned inspection once the root-route threat is controlled and the stair boundary has been checked on site.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 温室通过两条小型地方回路供应修院厨房与公共洗水龙头。检修梯的水已流入转供站上层，根系缠住了停转的输送器。公共外廊仍可使用。根道威胁实际处置、检修梯边界现场核对后，地方检修委托可以开放下行。

entries.english_definition: A place where administrative work is carried out.

The dispatch office may issue a limited local maintenance commission where the work supports a specific safe evacuation arrangement. The commission must name its work area and power boundary. It does not itself clear a route, approve an untested navigation lamp or transfer ownership of a vessel. A later departure instruction must be checked against the route notices and the vessel's current configuration. The public consultation desk remains accessible during the closure; restricted records and equipment require their own authorisation.

contexts.paragraph_english: Sian: Start with what the sheets actually record. Two teams made field visits; a report office copied selected rows. Those are different kinds of source. A curve can guide a question without settling it. I will apply the same test to a claim made by the Authority and to a claim made by you. Please name a condition that your explanation has not yet controlled.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 西安：从纸页实际记录出发。两队做现场访问，报告办公室选抄部分行，两者是不同来源。曲线可以引导问题，无需先定结论。灯署的主张和你的主张遵循同一核验。请列你解释尚未控制的一项条件。

contexts.paragraph_english: Evening duty handover, retained copy. At 21:05 on D0, a later work instruction removed the second traffic check from this test. The receiving operator recorded the change rather than marking the check as completed. A routine comparison at 20:40 placed the control clock within one second of the ship clock. The local control event copy lists the output interruption at 21:14:10, on the control clock. The instruction identifier and its issuing office are retained for further examination. This copy is not sufficient to establish what every officer knew or intended. The output event and the removed check should be recorded as separate findings: one concerns what the equipment did, the other concerns which protection was omitted. The independent coast clock was not set from this control clock.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: D0 21:05的后续工作指令移除了第二次人船复核，接班者没有把它标作已做。控制钟记录21:14:10断供；签发标识保留待后续核验，不能据此判定所有人员的知情与意图。 20:40常规比对记控制钟与船钟相差不超过一秒。

contexts.paragraph_english: The transport office initially looked for mistakes in the timetable. None were found. The difficulty was that the ten-minute connection had been measured from the arrival of the train at the platform to the departure of the bus from its stop. It did not include the time passengers might need to leave a crowded carriage, reach the footbridge and collect a bicycle or a large bag. What looked like a generous interval on paper was not necessarily a usable interval for everyone.

entries.english_definition: Intended to last for a limited period.

contexts.paragraph_english: Controlled extract, temporary supply scheme TS-18, initial signature page. The page bears the name and signature reference of Mara Venn among its contributors. The title describes a temporary compulsory synchronisation arrangement during an earlier supply crisis. The preserved page is an early version; the archive also holds later references which have not yet been assembled into a complete change history here.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 临时供给方案TS-18初始签名页的受控摘录。参与者列含玛拉·维恩姓名与签名索引。标题说明这是早期供给危机期间的临时强制同步安排。保留页面属于早期版本；档案还有后续索引，本地尚未整理出完整变更历史。

contexts.paragraph_english: Custodian: We will not count silence as proof. The three opportunities to respond are now recorded, with the answers and their limits attached. The summary will retain Mara’s design and delayed-correction responsibility, Voss’s policy, testing and suppression responsibility, and Rook’s review cancellation and detention responsibility. The transfer question is a next-stage action, not an event that has already happened because we discussed it. The originals will remain available under the temporary custody arrangement. A redacted summary can travel onward, but its readers must still know which claims rest on independent records and which reproduce the same source.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 保管人：沉默不计证明。三方反证机会及回应限制已记录；摘要保留玛拉设计与迟延纠正、沃斯政策测试压制、鲁克取消复核扣押责任。移交是下一阶段动作，不因讨论便发生。原件留临时保管，脱敏摘要可继续送，但读者须知道哪些独立、哪些同源复制。

contexts.paragraph_english: A limited transition may preserve enough output to support a particular transfer. It can be useful when the equipment and people must move in an order that cannot be changed at once. Its conditions are more demanding than the words 'for a short time' suggest. The load must have a cap, the window must have an end and two real people must accept the operating and safety-watch posts. There must also be a usable response when a check fails. Without those details, the temporary arrangement can quietly become ordinary production under a more reassuring name.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 有限过渡可能保留完成特定转移所需的产出，适用于设备与人员必须按难以立即改变的顺序移动时。其条件比“短时间”四个字更严格：负荷有上限，窗口有终点，两名真实人员承接操作与安全观察岗，检查失败时也有可用处置。缺少这些细节，临时安排可能悄悄以更令人放心的名称变为日常生产。

contexts.paragraph_english: Send the bounded transfer demand to Rook’s executive channel and preserve the recorded reply. He refuses to transfer command and enters the Seventh Tower to start forced normalisation. This fixed event moves the inquiry into crisis work; a favourable relationship does not prevent it, and sending the demand is not stopping the central machinery. The temporary joint emergency authority permits travel to the frontier for current network risk, basic preservation and preparation. It does not select central limited operation, orderly disconnection or a distributed system. The region R6 must still be reached by the same vessel through an actual verified route and berth. Keep the original case in its selected custody, with a redacted working extract for onward inquiry.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 向鲁克执行渠道发送限定移交要求并保留回覆；他拒交指挥权，先入第七塔启动强制归一。固定事件让调查进入危机，关系良好不避免；发送要求也不停止中央机组。临时共同应急授权允许前往边境核当前网络风险、基础保全与准备，不选中央受限、有序断联或分布式政策。仍须同一船、真实核验航路和泊位实际到 R6。原件箱保留所选保管，后续仅带脱敏工作摘录。

entries.english_definition: An organised plan for carrying out work.

contexts.paragraph_english: Controlled extract, temporary supply scheme TS-18, initial signature page. The page bears the name and signature reference of Mara Venn among its contributors. The title describes a temporary compulsory synchronisation arrangement during an earlier supply crisis. The preserved page is an early version; the archive also holds later references which have not yet been assembled into a complete change history here.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 临时供给方案TS-18初始签名页的受控摘录。参与者列含玛拉·维恩姓名与签名索引。标题说明这是早期供给危机期间的临时强制同步安排。保留页面属于早期版本；档案还有后续索引，本地尚未整理出完整变更历史。

contexts.paragraph_english: The custodian can verify that this extract comes from the stated page. Determining the scope of each contributor's responsibility requires the original scheme, related meeting records and later changes. A signature identifies a link to examine; it does not supply those missing records.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 保管人可核查摘录来自标明页面。判断各参与者具体责任范围，需要原方案、相关会议记录和后来变更。签名提供待查关联，没有补齐缺失文件。

contexts.paragraph_english: Sian's brief asks you to compare observations before proposing an explanation. The mine has documented dangerous changes and a high extraction setting. Those observations matter, but an association does not alone identify the mechanism or establish that a replacement control scheme is safe. The same requirement applies to the Lamp Authority and to visitors who favour local control. Personal trust in a designer cannot replace the missing checks.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 西安要求先比较观察，再提出解释。矿区记录了危险变化及高抽取设置，这些观察有意义，但关联不能单独识别机制，也不能证明替代控制方案安全。灯署和支持本地控制的访客遵循同一要求。对设计者的私人信任不能替代缺少的检查。

contexts.paragraph_english: Both teams observed a higher indicator at the mine than at their lower-load comparison station. They did not hold every location condition constant, and their indicator scales share a declared reference rather than identical precision. The dataset supports a testable association. The controlled trial must examine the proposed mechanism and preserve a result that might contradict the proposed replacement scheme.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 两队均观察到矿区指标高于各自低负荷比较站。它们没有固定所有地点条件，指标尺度使用声明参考而非完全相同精度。数据支持可检验关联。受控试验还须检验拟议机制，并保留可能反驳替代方案的结果。

entries.english_definition: A person or device that protects something.

contexts.paragraph_english: Isolate the conveyor at its existing handle before touching the external winding, using the manual drain or removing a guard. Check the stopped mechanism and the water gauge at the marked stands. A page in the archive cannot perform those checks.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 接触外部缠绕、使用手动排水或拆护罩前，应在既有手柄处隔离输送器，并在标记站位检查停转机构与积水表。档案文字不能代替现场检查。

contexts.paragraph_english: Technician: The controller is isolated at the outer switch. Do not take a silent machine as evidence that its reserve socket is connected. We kept the socket plate and guard inspection separate. Please control the debris enclosure, then use the manual reserve procedure or the separate maintenance encounter. I will keep the return corridor clear while you inspect.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 技术员：控制器在外开关隔离。机器安静不证明储备插座已接，我们分别留插座标记和护罩检查。先制止残件，再用备用段手动步骤或独立维护遭遇，我会在检查时保留返程走廊。

contexts.paragraph_english: Controller A is installed in the old hall. Check isolation, secure its external guard and inspect the labelled reserve socket before changing a load. The failure reconstruction uses the recorded T2 condition: load 70, reserve connected, ten minutes. Confirm the apparatus plate as A. This trial scale is the apparatus's own scale; do not calculate a town's supply from it or replace the record with a different controller.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: A控制器装在旧厅。改负荷前检查隔离、固定外护罩并查看储备插座标记。失败复原使用T2条件：负荷70、连接储备、十分钟；确认装置标牌为A。单位属于此台，不能据此计算城镇供给，也不能换另一控制器冒充同记录。

contexts.paragraph_english: The execution machine has a labelled output socket and two route selectors. Route TEST returns through the isolated local measuring loop. Route NETWORK would join an unchecked wider line and is outside this permit. Inspect the sockets from the protected stand before control. After the machine is controlled, isolate its output, seat the installed coupler in TEST, secure the guard and inspect the present route. A selected label without these actions is not a connection.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 执行机有带标输出插座和两通路选择。TEST经过隔离本地测量环；NETWORK接未经检查的广泛线路，超出许可。制止前从安全站查插座。制止后隔离输出，把已装耦合件座入TEST，固定护罩并核查当前通路。只选择标记不是连接。

entries.english_definition: The smaller facts that make an account precise.

contexts.paragraph_english: The public work register remains open if an identity request is declined. You may request a redacted copy, arrange an inspection through the custodian, or pause the identity request and continue the public inquiry. Reviewers must still be able to check material public facts and the records supporting them. Private details should be separated from that route rather than used to prevent all scrutiny.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 身份申请被拒后，公共工作记录仍开放。可以申请脱敏副本、经保管人安排查验，或暂缓身份申请后继续公共调查。必要公共事实及支持记录仍须能被审查；私人细节应与这条核查路径分开。

contexts.paragraph_english: Records travel farther than their writers expect. A room code on a kitchen sheet may be harmless among people who already know the building. Add a private address, a family relationship and a public announcement, and the same account can expose someone to attention they never agreed to receive. Removing those details need not remove the events. A review can still retain an observation date, the duty of the observer, the version of a record and a route to the protected original. These fields let a reader ask whether the account has support.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 记录会传得比作者预想更远。厨房页的房间代码，在熟悉建筑的人之间可能没有什么风险。加上私人住址、亲属关系和公共通告，同一陈述却可能让人受到从未同意的关注。去掉这些细节，无需去掉事件。审查仍可保留观察日期、记录员职能、版本及通向受保护原稿的查验路径，让读者判断陈述有无支持。

contexts.paragraph_english: There is also a danger in using protection as a reason to keep every difficult fact out of reach. If an official label prevents food from reaching people who are here, a polite assurance that the files are private does not correct the problem. Someone must be able to check the classification and the evidence that challenges it. A custodian therefore has two kinds of work: keep unnecessary personal details within their agreed scope, and maintain a usable route for examining public decisions. The two duties require different records and sometimes different recipients.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 以保护为由封闭所有难以面对的事实，也有危险。官方标签若使在此生活的人收不到食物，礼貌地说“档案私密”不能纠正问题。必须有人能检查分类及与之冲突的证据。保管人的工作包含两项：将不必要私人细节留在约定范围内，也为公共决定保留可用的检查途径。两项职责需要不同记录，有时需要不同接收方。

contexts.paragraph_english: A delegated review is another arrangement. The package goes to a specified desk for a stated purpose, and the receipt records the fields and versions that were delivered. This can allow a detailed check without immediately distributing personal details to everyone. It has costs. The reviewer may work slowly, or the public may have less opportunity to challenge an error. Keeping a short public account alongside a controlled package can make the process easier to question, provided neither account pretends that a pending review has already resolved the matter.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 受托审查是另一种安排：资料交给指定工作台用于约定用途，回执记清交付字段与版本。这能支持详细核查，无需立即把私人细节分给所有人。它也有代价：审阅可能较慢，公众纠错机会可能较少。受控包旁保留简短公共说明，有助于对过程提出问题；两者均应保留审查尚未结束的状态。

entries.english_definition: A gap through which someone or something can pass.

contexts.paragraph_english: Transfer TR-D1-7, version 1. Controlled extract from the receiving officer's custody handover record. The record is dated D−1 relative to the opening blackout. It identifies Mara Venn by the protected identification reference checked at the archive desk. The receiving officer recorded her as alive when custody was handed over. The destination is written as facility code F-17. No public site name or current address is supplied on this extract.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 转移TR-D1-7，第1版。接收员看管交接原稿的受控摘录，日期为开场熄灯前一天D−1。摘录用阅览台核对过的受保护身份索引识别玛拉·维恩。接收员记下她在看管交接时仍然活着。目的地写作设施代码F-17，本摘录没有公开地点名称或现行地址。

contexts.paragraph_english: Good afternoon. Today I want to explain how our college evaluated a trial of later library opening. You may have seen the announcement saying that the trial was successful. That description needs a little care. The library was used more often in the evening, but that does not answer every question about whether the change should become permanent. I will go through what changed, what we measured and what we still need to find out.

The most common reason given on the forms was the need for a quiet place to work. Access to specialist materials was mentioned less often. That finding led one member of the team to suggest opening a supervised study room instead of the whole library. It might meet much of the demand at a lower staffing cost. But another member pointed out that a less common need can still be important. A small group may depend on equipment or collections that cannot be moved into an ordinary room.

We also compared the two evenings. Thursday was usually busier than Tuesday, but the difference became smaller after the deadline for a major course assignment had passed. We cannot assume that students always prefer Thursday. Nor can we say that later opening improved examination results: the trial did not measure them. Increased use is useful evidence about access, not direct evidence about academic achievement. When you read the short report, keep that distinction in mind.

entries.english_definition: Carried out while a responsible person watches and checks.

contexts.paragraph_english: You may request a public statement within an agreed scope, a supervised period of specific repair followed by a statement, or a regional review. None of those arrangements deletes the signed record. If you ask me to repair something, identify the equipment, supplies, person checking it and end of the assignment. An apology cannot fill those fields.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 可以要求在约定范围公开证言，安排有监督的具体限期维修后补交说明，或交由地区核查。这些安排均不删除签章记录。若让我修理，应列设备、物资、复核人和工作结束边界；一句道歉填不出这些条件。

contexts.paragraph_english: The most common reason given on the forms was the need for a quiet place to work. Access to specialist materials was mentioned less often. That finding led one member of the team to suggest opening a supervised study room instead of the whole library. It might meet much of the demand at a lower staffing cost. But another member pointed out that a less common need can still be important. A small group may depend on equipment or collections that cannot be moved into an ordinary room.

Our recommendation is to keep the two late evenings for one more term while testing a supervised study room on another day. This is a proposed next step, not an approved timetable, so students should not arrive next Monday expecting the new room to be open. Before it starts, the college needs to confirm staffing and access arrangements. We will compare costs, types of use and the experience of students who need specialist resources. We also plan to ask people who did not attend the trial, because a service can look popular while still failing to reach some of those it was intended to help. That wider review should give us a better basis for a permanent decision.

Oren: If a public statement is requested, agree its fields and purpose with me. I can speak about my own action, including the signature, without guessing the intentions of people whose later decisions I did not see. A supervised repair followed by a statement is another arrangement, and a regional review is also possible. Please do not call a delayed statement a missing signature. The verified record remains. Joining a travelling crew is a further decision, and I can decline that invitation without taking the workshop file away from the inquiry.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 奥伦：若要求公共证言，请与我商定字段和用途。我能说明本人行动，包括签名，不能猜测后来未亲见决定的动机。也可以先做监督维修再补证言，或交地区核查。请勿把延后陈述说成签名不存在。已核验记录仍在；加入出行队是另一决定，我拒绝邀请也不会拿走工坊档案。

entries.english_definition: Something noticed or measured directly.

contexts.paragraph_english: Bridge observation copy — times use the same ship clock. 21:14:10: the tower light disappeared from view while the heading indicator still showed the assigned course. 21:16:00: the helmsman reported a course deviation. 21:17:40: contact with the reef was felt. The entries describe what the crew observed; they do not identify a switch operator or establish the reason for the loss of light. The ship clock has not yet been compared with a shore instrument. Preserve this copy and compare it with an independent record when the rescue work allows it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 桥台抄记使用同一船钟。21:14:10，塔灯消失，当时航向指示仍显示规定航向。21:16:00，舵手报告偏航。21:17:40，船体触礁。记录只说明船员观察到的先后，不识别开关操作者，也不证明熄灯原因。船钟尚未与岸上仪器核对；先保留副本，完成救援后再找独立记录。

contexts.paragraph_english: The later assignment does not tell us why an official entry says moved away. Those labels came from another register. I can let the custodian check my room codes and this observation for the local inquiry. Please keep the exact record version with the statement. A retelling of what I said will still come from me; it will not become another independent witness.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 较晚分配房间不能解释官方记录为何写迁出；那些标签来自另一份名册。我可以让保管人为地方调查核对房间代码与这次观察。请把准确版本和陈述保存在一起。别人转述我的话，来源仍是我，不会变成另一个独立证人。

contexts.paragraph_english: To investigate, staff observed the route between the platform and the bus stop over five evenings. They also invited passengers to describe their journeys. The two sources did not provide identical information. Observation showed where groups slowed down, whereas the written accounts explained why some people needed to stop. A parent reported waiting for a child to use the station facilities; another passenger avoided the footbridge because the lift was unreliable. These were not errors in reading the timetable. They were conditions that the timetable alone did not reveal.

entries.english_definition: Kept safe from a specified danger or unauthorised use.

contexts.paragraph_english: The shore winch has its own small reserve; it is not supplied by the harbour generator or by a ship battery. Switch its local power off and isolate the drive before seating the displaced cable. Secure the rescue line at the marked anchor, then set the receiving direction. A check belongs to that configuration: moving the receiving direction, reseating the cable or changing power cancels its validity. The nearby animals must be kept away from the receiving path before the line carries people. If a check fails, keep people in the protected assembly area and inspect the preparation again; taking time to read this card does not change the number of survivors. The shelter retains a working short-range distress set for the shore receiving team. It can send the registered rescue request before the separate coast-to-harbour relay is restored. Harbour pickup is confirmed through that relay later; a saved draft at the shelter has not yet sent a request.

contexts.paragraph_english: Review desk: You have brought the transfer records, the residence check and the station boundary receipt. We can receive them in more than one form. A public summary can use room codes, dates and source references, while the protected originals remain available for controlled review. A delegated review package can instead go to a named review desk under its stated purpose. In either arrangement, the important public claims need a route by which someone can check the supporting records.
