contexts.paragraph_english: Basic archive access may be registered for this check. Names in protected attachments require a separate request, a stated purpose and a permitted recipient. Keep the public room codes in your working summary. No resident has agreed to publication merely by accepting a meal or answering a question.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本次查验可以登记基础档案访问。受保护附页中的姓名须另外申请，说明用途与接收方。工作摘要使用公开房间代码。领取饭食或回答问题均未构成同意公开身份。

contexts.paragraph_english: Record a disagreement between sources as a disagreement. A voluntary conversation at the public porch can establish present residence for this check. It cannot establish someone's location throughout the intervening years, the whereabouts of another family member, or consent to release a protected attachment.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 不同来源的矛盾应按矛盾记录。公共门廊的自愿交谈可以确认本次查验的当前居住情况，不能说明此前多年每一阶段去向、其他亲属位置或公开受保护附页的同意。

entries.english_definition: Present and able to be used when needed.

contexts.paragraph_english: Limited maintenance exception. Havel, the dispatch officer, may commission inspection and repair of the civil ferry's navigation equipment and the local workshop arrangements needed to obtain its replacement parts. State that the purpose is evacuation assistance and identify those work areas in the request. Harbour main-generator operation is outside this exception: its safety isolation has not been confirmed. A commission allows local preparation; the ferry remains at the quay until a tested current configuration and an explicitly confirmed departure plan are available. Neither a fee nor a language score is required to request the commission. Crew recruitment, patrol-boat use and access to retained accident records are separate decisions and must not be inferred from this document.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 有限检修例外：调度负责人哈文可委托民用渡轮导航设备检修及为取替换件所需的本地工坊操作。申请写明协助撤离及这些范围。主发电机安全隔离尚未确认，操作它不在例外内。委托只允许准备；当前配置测试与明确离港方案确认完成前，渡轮留港。申请不需费用或英语分数；招募、巡灯船及事故记录调阅均另行授权。

contexts.paragraph_english: The aim was not simply to increase the total number of visits. Students on placement had told us that they often returned to campus too late to use specialist materials. Other students said their accommodation was too noisy for concentrated work. Those are different needs. A student might require access to a particular collection, or might only need a quiet desk. We wanted to know which need the extra hours were actually meeting before deciding how to use the available staff and space.

A separate notice at the dispatch desk sets out the conditions for Route B. Crews should compare those conditions with the particulars of their own vessel rather than assume that a channel available to one boat is available to every boat. The departure plan must identify the chosen route and explain any equipment arrangements on which it depends.

The rear work point is available for recording future preservation requirements. Its labels list one base isolator, one local backup pack and two base provision packs for this tower. These labels describe required supplies, not items already delivered. Stable access and a local dinner feed do not fill the work point or the engineering ledger.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 后部工作点可登记以后保全需求：一个基础隔离件、一个本地备用包、两个基础保障包。这是需求，不是已交付库存。安全通路与地方晚餐回路均未填充此工作点或工程账。

entries.english_definition: Regular work that keeps equipment in usable condition.

contexts.paragraph_english: To the new technician, from Mara. If a record is marked for destruction, first ask who issued the instruction, which version it concerns and what other record can be used to check it. A tidy report may leave out the circumstances that made its conclusion seem convincing. I have enclosed a request to compare the public maintenance record with an independent source. Deal with immediate rescue work before following it. This letter was placed in the inspection post before your journey; it cannot tell you where I am when you read it. Do not treat my concerns as proof. Preserve what you actually find, including anything that does not support the explanation you expected.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 玛拉给新检修员的留言：遇到要求销毁的记录，先核对指令签发者、所指版本和可独立核验的来源。整齐报告可能省略形成结论的条件。附上公共检修记录比对请求，但眼前救援优先。信件在旅程前寄存，不能说明阅读时玛拉所在。疑虑不是证明，应保留实际找到的资料，包括不支持预期解释的部分。

contexts.paragraph_english: Technician: The controller is isolated at the outer switch. Do not take a silent machine as evidence that its reserve socket is connected. We kept the socket plate and guard inspection separate. Please control the debris enclosure, then use the manual reserve procedure or the separate maintenance encounter. I will keep the return corridor clear while you inspect.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 技术员：控制器在外开关隔离。机器安静不证明储备插座已接，我们分别留插座标记和护罩检查。先制止残件，再用备用段手动步骤或独立维护遭遇，我会在检查时保留返程走廊。

contexts.paragraph_english: Coast pickup acknowledgement. Four people registered at the sheltered assembly point will be collected, together with the technician. The receiving route is the northern reach; the southern steps remain unavailable. Wait at the shelter's marked boarding point. The receiving crew will carry everyone to the public arrival berth at Saltmist Harbour. This acknowledgement permits that rescue passage only. It is not a general sailing licence, a maintenance commission or the handover of a patrol vessel. Take the coast records with you, keeping their source and time labels.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 接应回执：接走避风棚登记的四名幸存者和检修员，经北段上船，南台阶仍不可用。在棚外登记登船点等接应，前往盐雾港公共接应泊位。这只允许本次救援通行，不是一般航行许可、检修委托或巡灯船移交。带走资料并保留来源、时间标签。

contexts.paragraph_english: Arrival record — rescue passage from the stranded coast. The public arrival berth receives the technician and four registered survivors. Record their arrival before requesting further harbour work; a person carried here is not automatically signed onto another vessel's crew. Two different berths are shown on the quay plan. The civil ferry is awaiting maintenance and a safe departure arrangement. The stored patrol boat has no handover authorisation on this arrival record. A harbour officer may review a limited maintenance request at the public dispatch desk. Bring the rescue acknowledgement and your inspection appointment, and consult the current closure order rather than assuming that rescue passage suspends it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 搁浅海岸救援入港记录：接应泊位接收检修员和四名已登记幸存者。先登记到港，再申请后续港口工作；接应入港不自动成为另一船的船员。码头显示不同泊位：民用渡轮待检修与安全撤离方案；封存巡灯船没有在此记录中授权移交。公共调度台可审查有限检修申请，须携救援回执及任职凭证，并查现行封港令。

entries.english_definition: An explanation or record of events.

A successful small-station test will support a request to visit the tower duty layer for a current safety inspection. It will not certify the modern tower for independent operation, allocate a conversion crew or fill any six-tower engineering account.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 地方选择器可以在不解除塔站中央锁定的情况下试验。小支站成功试验后，可申请前往塔站值守层核查当前安全；此结果没有认证现代塔站独立运行，没有分配改造班组，也不填入六塔工程账。

contexts.paragraph_english: Dispatcher: Before you collect any parts, there is a correction to the earlier message. We were told that the spare navigation beacon had been destroyed. The reserve is a fixed local facility, so this procedure does not take a tower provision pack from your account.

contexts.paragraph_english: Harbour closure order — current copy. General departures are suspended while the navigation restrictions are reviewed. Rescue arrivals continue at the public receiving berth. An arrival under that provision does not grant a vessel permission to depart. The dispatch office may issue a limited local maintenance commission where the work supports a specific safe evacuation arrangement. The commission must name its work area and power boundary. It does not itself clear a route, approve an untested navigation lamp or transfer ownership of a vessel. A handwritten heading calls it an accident notice, but the heading does not identify a cause. Preparing a notice in advance may indicate planning for a risk. It does not, by itself, show that somebody intended a grounding. Preserve the draft label and the empty issue box when citing this document. The approval and execution records are held separately. Do not replace them with a conclusion drawn from the title.

A completion box records whether that check was carried out; it is not a decorative signature. This schedule establishes that an interruption had been planned before the accident. Keep the scheduled window distinct from the time at which the coast instrument first recorded a missing signal.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: D-1 18:00批准，D0 21:14开始的局部断供测试计划，要求断供前第二次检查受影响进场区的人船。计划证明动作预定，不独自证明后来实际执行何种指令。

contexts.paragraph_english: At the branch valves, we will identify the two blocked returns before choosing a procedure. The sample procedure and the mechanical procedure both have a safe objective. A method written in your notebook is a proposal until the actual work is carried out and its result is accepted.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 在支路阀处，我们先识别两处受阻回流，再选择程序。取样和机械程序均有安全目标。若旅行同伴留在外面，我会与地方班组协作。进入前请读可见危险计划。笔记里选了方法，仍只是提案；须实际执行，取得被接受的结果。

contexts.paragraph_english: Two markers are visible from the reef path. The southern marker stands near the broken steps. It identifies the old landing place but does not confirm that the steps remain usable after a surge. The northern reach is beyond the low stone wall. Its approach is narrow, so a rescue boat must wait for a clear signal rather than following the first moving light it sees. The winch line can guide people towards either marker. Choose the receiving direction before loading the line, and repeat the tension check whenever that direction changes. A raised hand lamp may help people find the path; it does not replace the line or repair the steps.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 礁岸可见两个标记。南标记位于破损台阶旁，标出旧接应点，并不保证浪涌后台阶仍能用。北段在矮石墙外，入口狭窄，救援船应等明确接应信号。绞盘索可朝两边接应；承载前须选方向，改向后须重新检查张力。手灯帮助辨路，不替代救援索，也不修复台阶。

contexts.paragraph_english: Limited maintenance exception. Havel, the dispatch officer, may commission inspection and repair of the civil ferry's navigation equipment and the local workshop arrangements needed to obtain its replacement parts. State that the purpose is evacuation assistance and identify those work areas in the request. Harbour main-generator operation is outside this exception: its safety isolation has not been confirmed. A commission allows local preparation; the ferry remains at the quay until a tested current configuration and an explicitly confirmed departure plan are available. Neither a fee nor a language score is required to request the commission. Crew recruitment, patrol-boat use and access to retained accident records are separate decisions and must not be inferred from this document.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 有限检修例外：调度负责人哈文可委托民用渡轮导航设备检修及为取替换件所需的本地工坊操作。申请写明协助撤离及这些范围。主发电机安全隔离尚未确认，操作它不在例外内。委托只允许准备；当前配置测试与明确离港方案确认完成前，渡轮留港。申请不需费用或英语分数；招募、巡灯船及事故记录调阅均另行授权。

contexts.paragraph_english: Archive clerk: We have laid out the local M-12 papers on two stands. Start with either one, but keep the references attached when you make your notes. contexts.paragraph_chinese: 阅览台员：M-12地方文件摆在两个站位，可以从任一处开始，但记笔记时要保留来源编号。出发记录员和接收员记的是不同观察，总账稍后由这些记录编成。出发条目即使出现两次，来源也只算一次。另一份副本有助于无法触摸原页时查阅，没有增加看到车辆离开的人。

contexts.paragraph_english: To investigate, staff observed the route between the platform and the bus stop over five evenings. They also invited passengers to describe their journeys. A parent reported waiting for a child to use the station facilities; another passenger avoided the footbridge because the lift was unreliable. These were not errors in reading the timetable. They were conditions that the timetable alone did not reveal.

The columns describe different measures: an administrative classification and a dated residence check. The figures do not explain the original reasons for classification. Record the mismatch, the scope of this group and the limit on interpretation. Preserve the evidence references for later review.

entries.english_definition: To state a decision or fact explicitly.

These are trial posts only; they do not occupy or grant permanent six-tower operator posts.

contexts.paragraph_english: Under time_limited_transition, extraction may use one to three units, with the total never above ten. The window lasts one declared work shift. contexts.paragraph_english: Pera: My response to a repair can stay narrower than forgiveness. I can accept a tested alarm and still object to the way the old equipment was delivered. Another qualified person can repeat the test if the arrangement is agreed; the repairer cannot sign both the work and its independent review. We should give residents a result they can use and a way to report a new fault. No one has to write that everyone is satisfied before the safety work can be recorded. The disagreement deserves its own line.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 佩拉：我对维修的回应可以小于原谅。我能接受受检警报器，仍反对早先交付方式。安排获准后，可请另一合格人员重复测试；维修者不能同时签工作及独立复核。住民应得到可用结果和报告新故障的途径。安全工作登记无需先写所有人满意；分歧自有一栏。

contexts.paragraph_english: A limited transition may preserve enough output to support a particular transfer. Tidegate maintenance procedure. The tower unit is separate from the west workshop machine and from the civil ferry supply. Confirm the local supply indication at the tower base before entering the control level. During the encounter, the left cooling valve is worked from the left front position and the right valve from the right front position. Either valve may be closed first. Local supply isolation is operated from the left rear position after both valves are closed. The interlock refuses an early isolation request without spending its operating allowance. Each person may operate one work point in a personal turn. Reducing the unit to its last reserve of stopping progress does not establish safety: both valves, isolation and a controlled threat are all required. Ordinary shields and cleansing cannot substitute for this sequence.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 潮门塔机械独立于工坊及民用渡轮。进控制层前在塔基查本地供给。左前左阀、右前右阀，次序不限；左后隔离需双阀完成，每人每个人回合最多一个现场操作。打至最低制止进度不等于安全，仍需两阀、隔离和制止。

contexts.paragraph_english: Begin at the public porches for rooms A, B and C. Record the people who voluntarily confirm that they live there. The ration sheet reports portions prepared and collected. Compare them with the witnessed visits and the current register, retaining the date and purpose of each record.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 请到A、B、C区公共门廊，记录自愿确认居住于此的人。口粮页记的是准备和领取份数，房间索引记的是这组人被安置在哪里。任何一张表都不能单独证明某人实际在场。把两表、现场走访和现行名册相互比较，并保留各记录日期和用途。

entries.english_definition: To make something necessary.

contexts.paragraph_english: Harbour closure order — current copy. General departures are suspended while the navigation restrictions are reviewed. Rescue arrivals continue at the public receiving berth. An arrival under that provision does not grant a vessel permission to depart. The dispatch office may issue a limited local maintenance commission where the work supports a specific safe evacuation arrangement. The commission must name its work area and power boundary. It does not itself clear a route, approve an untested navigation lamp or transfer ownership of a vessel. A later departure instruction must be checked against the route notices and the vessel's current configuration. The public consultation desk remains accessible during the closure; restricted records and equipment require their own authorisation.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 现行封港令：一般出港暂停，公共泊位仍接收救援入港；允许入港不等于允许出港。调度室可为明确安全撤离工作签发有限地方检修委托，写明作业范围和供电边界。委托本身不开放航道、不认可未经测试导航灯、不移交船产权。出港另需按航道资料及船舶当前配置核对。公共咨询区开放，受限记录与设备需各自授权。

contexts.paragraph_english: The aim was not simply to increase the total number of visits. Students on placement had told us that they often returned to campus too late to use specialist materials. Other students said their accommodation was too noisy for concentrated work. Those are different needs. A student might require access to a particular collection, or might only need a quiet desk. We wanted to know which need the extra hours were actually meeting before deciding how to use the available staff and space.

Harbour loan and cross-region inspection terms. Once the Tidegate local safety record has been verified, return to the receiving berth to acknowledge the loan of the sealed inspection vessel Glimmer. Its watch officer maintains the basic ship service; accepting a companion invitation is not a condition of using the vessel. The deck, archive cabin and shared maintenance compartment are three spaces of this one ship, not separate ships at each harbour. The loan does not transfer the civil ferry or its installed equipment. The next inspection commission points to the grove receiving records. It does not certify the current whereabouts of the missing mentor. Basic sailing along an opened route does not require a fuel ticket. The vessel still needs its ordinary gradual repairs; the handover does not turn it into a fully upgraded ship.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 塔站实际安全核验后回接应泊位明确接收封存旧巡灯船微光号及跨区核查委托。船务值守不依赖接受莉娜邀请，三空间是同一船。民用渡轮及船上设备不转移，不证明导师当前去向，不收死锁燃料门票。

contexts.paragraph_english: Basic archive access may be registered for this check. Names in protected attachments require a separate request, a stated purpose and a permitted recipient. contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本次查验可以登记基础档案访问。受保护附页中的姓名须另外申请，说明用途与接收方。工作摘要使用公开房间代码。领取饭食或回答问题均未构成同意公开身份。

contexts.paragraph_english: The custodian can verify that this extract comes from the stated page. Baseline reserve equipment, additional controllers, transition supplies and later field trials remain separate work. Ada: Put that distinction in the onward extract. We have had enough documents that look complete because missing work was described confidently. State what has actually been done and what the frontier team still needs to verify.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 操作员：负荷、隔离、岗位变，旧测试失效，不抹已发生测试，只叫后队别混历史与当前。今日可签有限塔安全，基础备用、额外控制器、过渡补给、现场试运行另属工作。阿妲：摘录写明，缺工作却自信描述的完整文件够多了，写已做与边境仍须核验。

contexts.paragraph_english: W-04 agrees to let the priory review desk check the observation time, the witness's duty and the version reference for a local note. contexts.paragraph_english: For the controlled batch records, apply at the workshop comparison stand to the local record desk, R3-local-record-desk. The recipient is patrol_technician; the purpose is verify_original_instruments_and_acceptance; the requested source set is MC2-current-source-set. The desk must issue this actual scoped permission before the protected pages are opened. A mine work assignment does not grant unrelated names or a private interview.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 受控批次记录须到工坊比较站位向地方记录台R3-local-record-desk申请。可用字段为check_status、acceptance_status、signatory_scope、version_source；接收方patrol_technician，用途verify_original_instruments_and_acceptance，请求来源集合MC2-current-source-set。保护页开启前，记录台须实际签发这项有限许可；矿井委托不会开放无关姓名或私人访谈。

entries.english_definition: To examine something carefully for condition or accuracy.

contexts.paragraph_english: The shore winch has its own small reserve; it is not supplied by the harbour generator or by a ship battery. Switch its local power off and isolate the drive before seating the displaced cable. Secure the rescue line at the marked anchor, then set the receiving direction. The cable and line may be prepared in either order while the drive is isolated. Restore local power only after both are secure. Run the tension check with no people on the line. A check belongs to that configuration: moving the receiving direction, reseating the cable or changing power cancels its validity. The nearby animals must be kept away from the receiving path before the line carries people. If a check fails, keep people in the protected assembly area and inspect the preparation again; taking time to read this card does not change the number of survivors. The shelter retains a working short-range distress set for the shore receiving team. It can send the registered rescue request before the separate coast-to-harbour relay is restored. Harbour pickup is confirmed through that relay later; a saved draft at the shelter has not yet sent a request.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 岸边绞盘使用自己的储备，和港口发电机、船电池无关。关闭本地电源并隔离驱动后，重新落座移位的钢缆。救援索固定在标记锚点，设置接应方向；隔离状态下，钢缆与索具可按任意先后准备。两者固定后才能恢复本地电源，先空载检查张力。证书只对应当次配置；改方向、缆线或电源均使旧检查失效。承载前须制止接应路径附近的动物威胁。检查失败时人员留在保护集合处，阅读不会减少幸存者。 救援棚有可用的短距求援台，能先向岸上接应队发送已登记求援；海岸至港口的独立中继另行恢复，之后才能确认港口接应。发送台保存稿件还没有发送请求。

contexts.paragraph_english: The D−1 custody extract is a separate file. We will inspect its identifier and its dated receiving entry under the scope you requested. It records Mara's condition at that handover and uses a facility code for the destination. Later files would be needed to establish what happened after that point. None are included in this extract.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: D−1看管摘录是另一文件。我们会按所申请范围核查编号和有日期的接收条目。它记录玛拉在那次交接时的状态，以设施代码表示目的地。此后发生什么需要后续文件，本摘录不含那些记录。

contexts.paragraph_english: The reading room offers a basic set of public records for the registered priory check. It includes room codes, record dates, duties and version references. Permission to read this set is tied to the purpose recorded at the access desk. A later request to publish or to inspect a protected identity is a separate decision.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 阅览室为已登记的修院查验提供一组公共记录，包含房间代码、记录日期、职能和版本来源。阅读许可对应访问台登记的用途。后续公开资料或查看受保护身份，需要另作决定。

contexts.paragraph_english: Inspect the two branch valves from their marked outer stands. The root core surrounds their shared return and may move when the conveyor restarts. Before entering the treatment zone, keep the conveyor isolated, identify both blocked branches and choose the stated sample or mechanical procedure. The local crew can assist under the inspection commission whether or not Mira has joined your travelling party.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 在标记外侧站位检查两条支路阀。缠根核心围住共同回流处，输送器重启时可能活动。进入处置区前应保持输送器隔离，识别两条受阻支路，并选用告示列明的取样或机械程序。地方委托可以提供协作，米拉是否加入旅行队伍均不影响这项协作。

entries.english_definition: To disconnect equipment from the source of danger or energy.

Switch its local power off and isolate the drive before seating the displaced cable. Secure the rescue line at the marked anchor, then set the receiving direction. contexts.paragraph_english: Electrician: Keep it off. The inspection team has not finished isolating the flooded cables. The ferry has its own charged backup battery, with enough reserve for the beacon during this evacuation. That supply is separate from the workshop equipment. Once the new bracket is fitted and the battery connected, check the beacon on the boat. A working light on a bench is not the same as a checked installation.

This relay records signals locally even when its outgoing link is unavailable. The independent recorder and the outgoing transmitter are separate parts of the station. Before touching the displaced outgoing lead, switch the local transmitter off and isolate it. Seat the lead, restore the station's own reserve and run a link check. The test confirms this lead and power configuration only. If either changes, repeat it before requesting a boat. A successful link test is not evidence that a distant tower is safe. The postal locker may be opened for the named technician after the shore rescue has been completed. Its contents are correspondence, not a certificate about the sender's present whereabouts. The rear latch can be opened from this room to provide a shorter route back to the rescue shelter.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 中继站外发链路中断时仍可本地记录；独立记录器与外发设备是两个部件。检修移位接线前关闭并隔离本地发送设备，再落座接线，恢复本站储备，做当前配置链路检查。改变接线或电源须重新检查；成功不证明远方塔站安全。救援完成后，具名检修员才可领取邮务柜通信，它不证明寄信人目前所在或状态。后门内闩可从站内打开，缩短返回救援棚的路线。

contexts.paragraph_english: The repair cabinet contains one tagged clamp set and one fixed reserve connector for this station. Record their tags when collecting them. These are local maintenance items. The reserve connector fits the station's existing backup seat; it is not a tower backup pack, the Glimmer's battery or personal crafting scrap. The clamp is kept for this inspection and may be repositioned while the conveyor remains isolated.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 检修料柜有一套带标签夹具和一个本站固定备用连接头。领取时记录标签。二者均是地方检修物件。连接头适配本站既有备用源座，不是塔站备用包、微光号电池或个人制作零件。夹具留给这次检修，输送器隔离时可以重置位置。

entries.english_definition: To place and connect equipment so it can be used.

contexts.paragraph_english: After Q-304 and the agreed A2 commitment, the workshop can release repair pack AUX-R3-A2 for the invited job. Its connection part is held for this auxiliary device and is separate from personal upgrade parts, the six local extra packages and the tower engineering cargo. The part must actually move from its pack to the device. A saved promise cannot install it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: Q-304及A2约定承诺之后，工坊可为获邀工作释放AUX-R3-A2维修包。接线件归此辅助设备专用，与个人改件零件、六地方工包和塔工程货分开。零件须实际从包转到装置；保存承诺不能安装。

contexts.paragraph_english: Technical reviewer: The academy retained unsuccessful runs as well as a bounded successful one. The current preparation issue states the controller, tested load, reserve, isolation and limited contact used in that successful arrangement. It gives us something specific to install and examine. It does not certify six unvisited towers. For an enhanced tower, we still need the actual controller and couplers, transition supply, qualified duty and a current field trial. Replacing an installation makes its old trial historical. Keep the old trial visible, then check the changed arrangement rather than copying its old result.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 技术复核岗：学城保留失败和受限成功。准备稿写成功安排的控制器、负荷、备用、隔离和有限联系，给出可安装检查的具体对象，不认证六处未访塔。增强仍需实物、过渡供给、合格值守和当前现场测试。换安装后旧测试成为历史，要保留但重检，不复制结果。

contexts.paragraph_english: A confirmed work order reserves every required component and all posts together. The next actions are transport, delivery, installation and verification. Execute each declared step through the communication desk or its physical site; menus, sleep and reloading advance nothing. A component already installed stays installed after cancellation. A completed base order preserves present local service and assigns two actual watches. It does not install the enhanced controller or pass its trial.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 确认工程单时，所需材料和全部岗位一起预留。接着实际推进运输、交付、安装、核验，可从通信台或现场执行规定步骤；菜单、睡眠、读档不推进。已经安装的组件在取消后仍保持安装。完成基础单保全现有地方服务并登记两个真实值守，不会顺带安装增强控制器或通过试运行。

contexts.paragraph_english: The reusable preparation issue technical-d3-v1 follows the academy’s retained failures, current bounded successful configuration and public handover. Controller C, checked reserve, local isolation and qualified duty supported a limited circuit at the tested load. The issue records how to install and inspect that bounded arrangement; it is not a measurement of all six towers. Each district must still inspect its real installation, receive transition supplies, obtain a local trial permit and run the current configuration. Keep the old failed and successful observations.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 可复用准备稿technical-d3-v1继承学城保留反例、当前有限成功配置和公开交接。控制器C、受检备用、当地隔离及合格岗位支持已测试负荷下的有限回路。该稿说明如何安装检查这个受限安排，不是六塔全网测量。各地还须检查实际安装、取得过渡供给和地方试验许可，并按当前配置试运行；保留旧成功和失败观察。

entries.english_definition: To put another item in the place of an existing one.

contexts.paragraph_english: Two markers are visible from the reef path. The southern marker stands near the broken steps. It identifies the old landing place but does not confirm that the steps remain usable after a surge. The northern reach is beyond the low stone wall. Its approach is narrow, so a rescue boat must wait for a clear signal rather than following the first moving light it sees. The winch line can guide people towards either marker. Choose the receiving direction before loading the line, and repeat the tension check whenever that direction changes. A raised hand lamp may help people find the path; it does not replace the line or repair the steps.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 礁岸可见两个标记。南标记位于破损台阶旁，标出旧接应点，并不保证浪涌后台阶仍能用。北段在矮石墙外，入口狭窄，救援船应等明确接应信号。绞盘索可朝两边接应；承载前须选方向，改向后须重新检查张力。手灯帮助辨路，不替代救援索，也不修复台阶。

contexts.paragraph_english: Resident representative: The warmer shelter matters now, but so does the transfer which some households are waiting for. I would like the proposal to say which work is postponed under each distribution. If we choose the transition, when will the materials used for production support become unavailable for shelter improvement? If we reduce immediately, who will replace the expected output in the transfer plan? We should be able to disagree about those costs without losing the meals and wage cover already agreed. Please record the conditions, rather than writing that every resident shares one preference.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 住民代表：更暖的安置处现在重要，一些住户等待的转移也重要。我希望提案说明各分配推迟什么工作。选择过渡后，生产支持物资何时不再可用于安置？立刻减产时，转移计划的预期产出由什么替代？讨论这些代价不应失去已约定暖食和工资保障。请记条件，不写所有住民同一偏好。

contexts.paragraph_english: Draft contingency notice, prepared on D0 at 20:50. This copy was stored with the evening dispatch papers; its issue box is blank. The text describes a possible interruption of the harbour light and tells receiving crews to wait for a revised route message. A handwritten heading calls it an accident notice, but the heading does not identify a cause. Preparing a notice in advance may indicate planning for a risk. It does not, by itself, show that somebody intended a grounding. Preserve the draft label and the empty issue box when citing this document. The approval and execution records are held separately. Do not replace them with a conclusion drawn from the title.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: D0 20:50准备、尚未签发的应急通知。事故字样不说明原因，预先准备通知不能单独证明故意搁浅；引用时保留草稿标签及空白签发栏，另查批准与执行记录。

contexts.paragraph_english: The collection sheet was written at the kitchen desk. A copy filed in the reading room has the same source. It may replace an unavailable copy for access, but it does not supply a second witness.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 领取页原稿写于厨房台。阅览室存档副本与它同源，可以作为查阅副本，不能增加一名证人。

entries.english_definition: To take something away from its present position.

contexts.paragraph_english: Route C remains open, but a vessel may enter it only if its navigation beacon is operational. The beacon must be checked in its installed configuration before departure. Permission to work on a vessel does not remove this requirement, nor does the fact that another vessel has already left the harbour.

Voss: My policy kept the high quota after the long-term warning entered internal discussion. The circulation limit was also my decision. I considered immediate interruption more dangerous than the risk of continuing, but the patrol has shown why that comparison was not enough to close review. I authorised the branch test. The executive cancellation of review was a distinct act, and the distinction should remain in the record. Custodian: We will keep both levels. Separating an executive order does not remove your responsibility for authorisation, known risk or suppression of unfavourable information.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 沃斯：长期警报进入内部讨论后，我仍保高配额，限制传播也是我的决定。我认为即刻中断更危险，巡灯人证明该比较不足以取消复核。我授权支路测试，但执行层取消复核是另一行为，记录应分开。保管人：两层均保留，分开执行令不除授权、已知风险、压制不利信息责任。

contexts.paragraph_english: Records travel farther than their writers expect. A room code on a kitchen sheet may be harmless among people who already know the building. Add a private address, a family relationship and a public announcement, and the same account can expose someone to attention they never agreed to receive. Removing those details need not remove the events. A review can still retain an observation date, the duty of the observer, the version of a record and a route to the protected original. These fields let a reader ask whether the account has support.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 记录会传得比作者预想更远。厨房页的房间代码，在熟悉建筑的人之间可能没有什么风险。加上私人住址、亲属关系和公共通告，同一陈述却可能让人受到从未同意的关注。去掉这些细节，无需去掉事件。审查仍可保留观察日期、记录员职能、版本及通向受保护原稿的查验路径，让读者判断陈述有无支持。

contexts.paragraph_english: Sometimes a person wants to be named. Their decision deserves the same care as a decision to remain private. Ask what they agree to release, to whom, for what use and in which version. A broad permission inferred from an earlier conversation may not fit a new publication. Equally, choosing the smallest possible package in every situation can remove the very detail that the person wants included or that the authorised review needs. Appropriate scope depends on the purpose and the permission, as well as on the risk of disclosure.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 有时本人希望具名。这个决定与保持私密同样需要认真对待。请问清允许发布什么、给谁、为何使用及对应版本。旧交谈推断出的宽泛许可可能不适合新发布。每次都机械选择最少字段，也可能删去本人希望保留的内容，或获准审查真正需要的细节。适当范围取决于用途、许可和公开风险。

entries.english_definition: To take items to the person or place entitled to receive them.

contexts.paragraph_english: The town's emergency stock provides twelve meal portions, three first-aid packs and one declared shift of wage cover. Take and deliver these local supplies through the receiving desk; a draft request cannot create them. Their use is part of basic protection. Extra workshop packages will be allocated separately after the rescue. Personal equipment parts and the six-tower engineering cargo remain in their own accounts.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 矿镇应急库存提供十二份暖食、三包急救用品与一班工资保障凭据。应通过接收台实际领取和交付，写申请不能生成物资。这是基本保障；救援后另行分配额外工包。个人装备零件和六塔工程货仍在各自账内。

contexts.paragraph_english: Custodian: Then the outgoing package should retain the stage-I instrument reference, its copying chain and the acceptance version. Add the current environment readings with their settings and sampling conditions. List what this local comparison establishes and what the academic team still needs to test. The receiving desk must acknowledge the actual package and sample; an address written at the top of a draft does not deliver them. We can carry the inquiry forward while leaving the later cause, wider instructions and current whereabouts of people outside this inspection explicitly open.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 保管人：送出包应保留阶段I仪表索引、抄录链和验收版本，再附当前环境读数、设置与取样条件。列明地方比较核实什么、学城仍需试验什么。接收台应确认实际资料与样本；在草稿顶写地址并未完成交付。调查能够继续，同时把后来原因、广泛指示与此查验之外人物现址保留为未知。

contexts.paragraph_english: Six extra packages, LOCAL-R3-01 to LOCAL-R3-06, are held in the dispatch store for this assignment. They contain local work supplies rather than personal upgrade parts. Each package must have one recorded owner or receiving work group at a time. Reserving a package for an agreed arrangement does not deliver it, and the same package cannot be listed against both shelter and production.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 六个额外工包LOCAL-R3-01至06由调度库为本委托保管，内为地方作业用品，不是个人改件零件。每包同一时刻只有一项归属或接收工作组。为约定安排预留尚未交付，同包不能同时列于安置和生产。

contexts.paragraph_english: At the freight desk, pack the actual sample and authorised fields, name the academic receiving desk and obtain an outgoing handover receipt. A prepared draft does not create a sample or deliver it. Do not attach unrelated household details or copy a private repair conversation without its scope. Keep the original references so that the next reviewer can request the protected sources.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 到货运台实际包装样本及获准字段，列学城接收台并取得发出交接回执。准备好草稿不会生成样本或完成交付。不要附无关住户细节，也不要无范围复制私人维修谈话。保留原索引，让下一复核人可申请受保护来源。

entries.english_definition: To hold and move something from one place to another.

contexts.paragraph_english: Coast pickup acknowledgement. Four people registered at the sheltered assembly point will be collected, together with the technician. The receiving route is the northern reach; the southern steps remain unavailable. Wait at the shelter's marked boarding point. The receiving crew will carry everyone to the public arrival berth at Saltmist Harbour. This acknowledgement permits that rescue passage only. It is not a general sailing licence, a maintenance commission or the handover of a patrol vessel. Take the coast records with you, keeping their source and time labels.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 接应回执：接走避风棚登记的四名幸存者和检修员，经北段上船，南台阶仍不可用。在棚外登记登船点等接应，前往盐雾港公共接应泊位。这只允许本次救援通行，不是一般航行许可、检修委托或巡灯船移交。带走资料并保留来源、时间标签。

contexts.paragraph_english: You may argue for wider public scrutiny, a controlled review, or a combination with a public summary and retained originals. State the practical benefits, the risks and the arrangement you intend to carry out. I will not infer that choice from a saved essay. At this desk, you will confirm the fields, the recipient, the purpose and the version, inspect the proposed handover, then explicitly send it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 你可以主张更广公开、受控审查，或公共摘要与保留原稿结合。请说明实际益处、风险与所选安排。保存文章不会让我推断交付选择。你须在此确认字段、接收方、用途和版本，查看交接预览，再明确发送。

contexts.paragraph_english: In the official register, three entries in this group carry a death label and five a moved-away label. Sixteen have no such label. The administrative labels were copied into the current roll before this visit. The index does not establish why those labels were applied.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 官方名册中，这组人有三项死亡标签、五项迁出标签，其余十六项没有这两类标签。行政标签在本次走访前抄入了现行名册。索引没有记载为什么加上这些标签。

contexts.paragraph_english: The departure officer checked the authorisation before allowing the vehicle to leave at 14:10. The authorisation sheet does not carry a reliable issue time. It establishes that approval existed before departure, but it does not justify assigning an exact minute to that approval.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 出发记录员在允许车辆于14:10离开之前核对了授权。授权页没有可靠签发时间。它说明出发前已经获准，但不足以为授权指定准确分钟。

entries.english_definition: To bring separate items or information together.

contexts.paragraph_english: The transport office initially looked for mistakes in the timetable. None were found. The difficulty was that the ten-minute connection had been measured from the arrival of the train at the platform to the departure of the bus from its stop. It did not include the time passengers might need to leave a crowded carriage, reach the footbridge and collect a bicycle or a large bag. What looked like a generous interval on paper was not necessarily a usable interval for everyone.

Dispatcher: Before you collect any parts, there is a correction to the earlier message. We were told that the spare navigation beacon had been destroyed. The inspection does not support that account. The beacon itself still works; the damaged part is the bracket that holds it in place.

These figures count portions, not independent sightings of twenty-four people. A neighbour may collect for someone who is resting. The residential porch check records voluntary confirmation of residence separately. Please retain both types of record; correcting a register does not require publishing a resident's private name.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 这些数字计算口粮份数，并非二十四次独立见到本人。有人休息时，邻居可能代领。住区门廊查验另外记录本人自愿确认的居住情况。请保留两类记录；更正名册无需公开私人姓名。

contexts.paragraph_english: Copies are often necessary. An instrument sheet may remain underground while a surface team needs to arrange supplies. A carefully referenced transcription lets that team work without carrying away the only original. Yet two copies of a single observation do not make the observation independent. Counting documents can conceal this weakness. A stronger comparison identifies the original, follows the copying path and then seeks a genuinely different record, such as the acceptance decision. The purpose is to understand what each source contributes, rather than to collect the largest pile of paper.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 副本常有必要：仪表页可能留在井下，地面人员却要安排供给。有清楚索引的抄录让团队开展工作，也避免拿走唯一原稿。不过，同一观察的两份副本没有使观察变为独立。数文件容易掩盖这一点。更稳妥的比较会识别原稿、追溯抄录路径，再查真正不同的记录，例如验收决定；目的在于理解各来源的作用。

entries.english_definition: To go or send something back to an earlier place.

contexts.paragraph_english: Harbour loan and cross-region inspection terms. Once the Tidegate local safety record has been verified, return to the receiving berth to acknowledge the loan of the sealed inspection vessel Glimmer. Its watch officer maintains the basic ship service; accepting a companion invitation is not a condition of using the vessel. The deck, archive cabin and shared maintenance compartment are three spaces of this one ship, not separate ships at each harbour. The loan does not transfer the civil ferry or its installed equipment. The next inspection commission points to the grove receiving records. It does not certify the current whereabouts of the missing mentor. Basic sailing along an opened route does not require a fuel ticket. The vessel still needs its ordinary gradual repairs; the handover does not turn it into a fully upgraded ship.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 塔站实际安全核验后回接应泊位明确接收封存旧巡灯船微光号及跨区核查委托。船务值守不依赖接受莉娜邀请，三空间是同一船。民用渡轮及船上设备不转移，不证明导师当前去向，不收死锁燃料门票。

contexts.paragraph_english: For the reserve test, keep the source isolated while seating the connector. The selector has positions for the kitchen, the wash pump and an alternating cycle. Read the load labels and trace the later interlock plate as well as the old drawing. We are not changing the tower outlet under this commission. If a trial is rejected, return the source to isolation, correct the selector and try again. The reserve is a fixed local facility, so this procedure does not take a tower provision pack from your account.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 试验备用源时，应在隔离状态下座好连接头。选择器有厨房、洗水泵和交替档。阅读负荷标签，同时对照后加联锁牌与旧图。委托不包括改变塔站出口。试验被拒时，恢复隔离、修正档位再试。备用源是固定地方设施，本程序不从工程账扣塔站保障包。

contexts.paragraph_english: Inspect the two branch valves from their marked outer stands. The root core surrounds their shared return and may move when the conveyor restarts. Before entering the treatment zone, keep the conveyor isolated, identify both blocked branches and choose the stated sample or mechanical procedure. The local crew can assist under the inspection commission whether or not Mira has joined your travelling party.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 在标记外侧站位检查两条支路阀。缠根核心围住共同回流处，输送器重启时可能活动。进入处置区前应保持输送器隔离，识别两条受阻支路，并选用告示列明的取样或机械程序。地方委托可以提供协作，米拉是否加入旅行队伍均不影响这项协作。

contexts.paragraph_english: Both methods retain the greenhouse beds and leave a checkable result at the valves. Sampling secures the affected root section while its reaction is controlled; mechanical treatment secures the return and clears the external winding. Merely selecting a method does not produce a clearance receipt. The actual encounter or work procedure must reach its safe objective, after which the branch stands can be inspected again.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 两种方法均保留种植床，并在阀处留下可核查结果。取样方法在控制反应时固定根段；机械方法固定回流并清除外部缠绕。选择方法本身不产生回执。实际遭遇或工作程序达到安全目标后，方可重新检查支路。

entries.english_definition: To depart from a place.

contexts.paragraph_english: To the new technician, from Mara. If a record is marked for destruction, first ask who issued the instruction, which version it concerns and what other record can be used to check it. A tidy report may leave out the circumstances that made its conclusion seem convincing. I have enclosed a request to compare the public maintenance record with an independent source. Deal with immediate rescue work before following it. This letter was placed in the inspection post before your journey; it cannot tell you where I am when you read it. Do not treat my concerns as proof. Preserve what you actually find, including anything that does not support the explanation you expected.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 玛拉给新检修员的留言：遇到要求销毁的记录，先核对指令签发者、所指版本和可独立核验的来源。整齐报告可能省略形成结论的条件。附上公共检修记录比对请求，但眼前救援优先。信件在旅程前寄存，不能说明阅读时玛拉所在。疑虑不是证明，应保留实际找到的资料，包括不支持预期解释的部分。

contexts.paragraph_english: Archive clerk: We have laid out the local M-12 papers on two stands. Start with either one, but keep the references attached when you make your notes. The departure officer's page and the receiving officer's page describe different observations. The ledger was prepared from those records later. If the departure entry appears twice, count its source once. The second copy is useful when a page cannot be handled; it does not add another person who saw the vehicle leave.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 阅览台员：M-12地方文件摆在两个站位，可以从任一处开始，但记笔记时要保留来源编号。出发记录员和接收员记的是不同观察，总账稍后由这些记录编成。出发条目即使出现两次，来源也只算一次。另一份副本有助于无法触摸原页时查阅，没有增加看到车辆离开的人。

contexts.paragraph_english: The transport office initially looked for mistakes in the timetable. None were found. The difficulty was that the ten-minute connection had been measured from the arrival of the train at the platform to the departure of the bus from its stop. It did not include the time passengers might need to leave a crowded carriage, reach the footbridge and collect a bicycle or a large bag. What looked like a generous interval on paper was not necessarily a usable interval for everyone.

Leave the Glimmer at the marked berth while the landing clerk checks your vessel record and the cross-district commission. Registering here establishes an arrival and a route back to this landing. It does not give access to private rooms or restricted names.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 请把微光号停在标记泊位，由接驳员核对船只记录与跨区核查委托。此处登记记录一次实际到港，并建立返回这个接驳站的路线。私人房间与受限姓名另有访问范围。

entries.english_definition: To move into a place or add information to a record.

contexts.paragraph_english: All departures remain subject to the current navigation restrictions. Route A is closed until further notice. A previous journey through that channel is not evidence that it is safe to use today, and an older chart should not be treated as permission to enter it.

Receiver: We have prepared the street shelter, but preparation is not arrival. Do not enter Mara as received while she is still behind the station door. Ada: The inner evacuation passage comes out here. After the bolt and stepping strip have been checked, bring her through that passage. Receiver: I will record the direct handover and her present condition. Keep the older D-1 record dated D-1; today’s contact does not change what that earlier paper meant. Ada: If the guard attempt fails, return to the station work point and try again. The shelter and your documents remain available. There is no need to hurry through the instructions to keep someone alive.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 接应人：街区棚已准备好，但准备不等于到达，她还在扣押门后时不能登记接收。阿妲：内侧撤离便道出口在这里，开闩、核验踏步带后从便道带她回来。接应人：我会记录直接交接及当前状况；D-1 仍是 D-1 的旧记录，今日接触不改变旧纸含义。阿妲：看守尝试失败可回操作点重试，棚和文献保留；不必抢读说明来保命。

contexts.paragraph_english: Route C remains open, but a vessel may enter it only if its navigation beacon is operational. The beacon must be checked in its installed configuration before departure. Permission to work on a vessel does not remove this requirement, nor does the fact that another vessel has already left the harbour.

An instruction to start the pump therefore concerns the operation of the facilities, not permission for a particular vessel to enter the channel. For this evacuation, use the vessel particulars recorded for the approved load. A change to that load is not an authorised alternative within the present operation. Keep this restriction with the departure record.

entries.english_definition: To arrive at a place or attain a required state.

contexts.paragraph_english: Two markers are visible from the reef path. The southern marker stands near the broken steps. It identifies the old landing place but does not confirm that the steps remain usable after a surge. The northern reach is beyond the low stone wall. Its approach is narrow, so a rescue boat must wait for a clear signal rather than following the first moving light it sees. The winch line can guide people towards either marker. Choose the receiving direction before loading the line, and repeat the tension check whenever that direction changes. A raised hand lamp may help people find the path; it does not replace the line or repair the steps.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 礁岸可见两个标记。南标记位于破损台阶旁，标出旧接应点，并不保证浪涌后台阶仍能用。北段在矮石墙外，入口狭窄，救援船应等明确接应信号。绞盘索可朝两边接应；承载前须选方向，改向后须重新检查张力。手灯帮助辨路，不替代救援索，也不修复台阶。

contexts.paragraph_english: Coast team to the stranded crew. We first marked the south steps as a possible receiving point. That instruction is withdrawn: a fresh inspection found the lower steps separated from their support. Use the northern reach beyond the low wall instead. There are four survivors waiting for assistance, apart from the technician carrying this message. Keep the rescue line clear of the broken steps. Once everyone is under shelter, send your position, the number of people needing collection and the approach restriction. Do not ask the boat to follow the southern marker merely because it is easier to see. We will acknowledge the request through the coast relay.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 海岸队更正原先南台阶方案：现场复查发现下段台阶脱离支承，撤回旧指示。改用矮墙外的北段。有四名幸存者需要接应，不含传递消息的检修员。索具避开破损台阶。人员进入棚内后，发送位置、接应人数和进路限制，接应船不会因南标记显眼就改走那里。通过海岸中继确认求援。

contexts.paragraph_english: Coast pickup acknowledgement. Four people registered at the sheltered assembly point will be collected, together with the technician. The receiving route is the northern reach; the southern steps remain unavailable. Wait at the shelter's marked boarding point. The receiving crew will carry everyone to the public arrival berth at Saltmist Harbour. This acknowledgement permits that rescue passage only. It is not a general sailing licence, a maintenance commission or the handover of a patrol vessel. Take the coast records with you, keeping their source and time labels.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 接应回执：接走避风棚登记的四名幸存者和检修员，经北段上船，南台阶仍不可用。在棚外登记登船点等接应，前往盐雾港公共接应泊位。这只允许本次救援通行，不是一般航行许可、检修委托或巡灯船移交。带走资料并保留来源、时间标签。

contexts.paragraph_english: The transport office initially looked for mistakes in the timetable. None were found. The difficulty was that the ten-minute connection had been measured from the arrival of the train at the platform to the departure of the bus from its stop. It did not include the time passengers might need to leave a crowded carriage, reach the footbridge and collect a bicycle or a large bag. What looked like a generous interval on paper was not necessarily a usable interval for everyone.

entries.english_definition: To take possession of something sent or offered.

contexts.paragraph_english: Records travel farther than their writers expect. A room code on a kitchen sheet may be harmless among people who already know the building. Add a private address, a family relationship and a public announcement, and the same account can expose someone to attention they never agreed to receive. Removing those details need not remove the events. A review can still retain an observation date, the duty of the observer, the version of a record and a route to the protected original. These fields let a reader ask whether the account has support.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 记录会传得比作者预想更远。厨房页的房间代码，在熟悉建筑的人之间可能没有什么风险。加上私人住址、亲属关系和公共通告，同一陈述却可能让人受到从未同意的关注。去掉这些细节，无需去掉事件。审查仍可保留观察日期、记录员职能、版本及通向受保护原稿的查验路径，让读者判断陈述有无支持。

contexts.paragraph_english: Review desk: You have brought the transfer records, the residence check and the station boundary receipt. We can receive them in more than one form. A public summary can use room codes, dates and source references, while the protected originals remain available for controlled review. A delegated review package can instead go to a named review desk under its stated purpose. In either arrangement, the important public claims need a route by which someone can check the supporting records.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 审查台：你带来了转移记录、居住核查和支站边界回执。可以用多种形式交付。公共摘要可用房间代码、日期和来源索引，受保护原稿保留受控查验；受托审查包也可按用途交给指定审查台。无论哪种安排，重要公共陈述都需要可检查支持记录的路径。

contexts.paragraph_english: Visitors must receive the mine safety briefing and the available basic kit before entering. The fixed ladder is listed separately from the powered lift. Tell the surface desk which route has been checked, and leave its access clear while any worker remains below.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 访客进入前应取得矿井安全说明与可领取的基础装备。固定梯道与电动升降机分列登记。请向地面台说明实际检查的通路；地下仍有人时保持出口畅通。

contexts.paragraph_english: W1, W2 and W3 are waiting at the cutting-face shelter. Locate each person and agree the return arrangement at the work stand. The shelter call describes where help is needed; it does not confirm a surface arrival. The lower-track escort must actually bring the group to the receiving route, and the town desk must receive them before the rescue report can be closed.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: W1、W2、W3在采掘面避护处等候。到工作站位逐一确认，并商定返程。求援呼叫说明哪里需要帮助，没有确认地面到达。下层轨道护送应实际把三人带到接收路线，矿镇台接收后，救援报告才能收束。

entries.english_definition: To move an item or responsibility from one holder to another.

contexts.paragraph_english: Harbour closure order — current copy. General departures are suspended while the navigation restrictions are reviewed. Rescue arrivals continue at the public receiving berth. An arrival under that provision does not grant a vessel permission to depart. The dispatch office may issue a limited local maintenance commission where the work supports a specific safe evacuation arrangement. The commission must name its work area and power boundary. It does not itself clear a route, approve an untested navigation lamp or transfer ownership of a vessel. A later departure instruction must be checked against the route notices and the vessel's current configuration. The public consultation desk remains accessible during the closure; restricted records and equipment require their own authorisation.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 现行封港令：一般出港暂停，公共泊位仍接收救援入港；允许入港不等于允许出港。调度室可为明确安全撤离工作签发有限地方检修委托，写明作业范围和供电边界。委托本身不开放航道、不认可未经测试导航灯、不移交船产权。出港另需按航道资料及船舶当前配置核对。公共咨询区开放，受限记录与设备需各自授权。

A delegated review package can instead go to a named review desk under its stated purpose. In either arrangement, the important public claims need a route by which someone can check the supporting records.
