contexts.paragraph_english: Harbour loan and cross-region inspection terms. Once the Tidegate local safety record has been verified, return to the receiving berth to acknowledge the loan of the sealed inspection vessel Glimmer. Its watch officer maintains the basic ship service; accepting a companion invitation is not a condition of using the vessel. The deck, archive cabin and shared maintenance compartment are three spaces of this one ship, not separate ships at each harbour. The loan does not transfer the civil ferry or its installed equipment. The next inspection commission points to the grove receiving records. It does not certify the current whereabouts of the missing mentor. Basic sailing along an opened route does not require a fuel ticket. The vessel still needs its ordinary gradual repairs; the handover does not turn it into a fully upgraded ship.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 塔站实际安全核验后回接应泊位明确接收封存旧巡灯船微光号及跨区核查委托。船务值守不依赖接受莉娜邀请，三空间是同一船。民用渡轮及船上设备不转移，不证明导师当前去向，不收死锁燃料门票。

contexts.paragraph_english: June also requests inspection of the greenhouse supply stair. This permits the local handles, fixed repair cabinet and transfer-station circuits described in the maintenance notice. It does not authorise changing the tower's central interlock. Bring back a factual difference report and the equipment boundary before asking the local desk to issue the next work scope.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 琼还请求检查温室供给检修梯。允许范围是告示列明的地方手柄、固定料柜和转供站回路，未包括改动塔站中央联锁。请把实际差异与设备边界带回地方工作台，再申请下一步工作范围。

entries.english_definition: To remove a restriction that keeps someone or something held.

contexts.paragraph_english: Record a disagreement between sources as a disagreement. A voluntary conversation at the public porch can establish present residence for this check. It cannot establish someone's location throughout the intervening years, the whereabouts of another family member, or consent to release a protected attachment.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 不同来源的矛盾应按矛盾记录。公共门廊的自愿交谈可以确认本次查验的当前居住情况，不能说明此前多年每一阶段去向、其他亲属位置或公开受保护附页的同意。

contexts.paragraph_english: Oren: I signed that final form. I had seen the unfinished entries, and I should have refused to accept the bypass as complete. There was pressure to release the equipment for the next shift. I can give an account of that pressure and the instructions I received, but I will keep it separate from my signature. I cannot make the earlier check complete by repairing the device today. If I undertake a repair now, its parts, test and reviewer must be entered as new work, while the signed form remains available.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 奥伦：最终表是我签的。我看到了未完成条目，本该拒绝把旁路验收为完成。当时受到放行设备给下一班的压力。我会说明压力与收到的指示，但要把这些与本人签名分开。今天修理不能完成早先检查。若现在承接维修，应把零件、测试和复核人记成新工作，同时保留旧签章表。

contexts.paragraph_english: This record provides a dated observation. When writing about it, retain the date, the source and the point at which the observation was made. The extract contains no later release, interview or live message from Mara. The facility code is a direction for further investigation, not a verified present location.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 这是有日期的现场观察。写作时应保留日期、来源和观察环节。摘录没有玛拉此后的获释记录、访谈或实时消息。设施代码为进一步调查提供方向，尚不能确认目前所在地点。

contexts.paragraph_english: Sometimes a person wants to be named. Their decision deserves the same care as a decision to remain private. Ask what they agree to release, to whom, for what use and in which version. A broad permission inferred from an earlier conversation may not fit a new publication. Equally, choosing the smallest possible package in every situation can remove the very detail that the person wants included or that the authorised review needs. Appropriate scope depends on the purpose and the permission, as well as on the risk of disclosure.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 有时本人希望具名。这个决定与保持私密同样需要认真对待。请问清允许发布什么、给谁、为何使用及对应版本。旧交谈推断出的宽泛许可可能不适合新发布。每次都机械选择最少字段，也可能删去本人希望保留的内容，或获准审查真正需要的细节。适当范围取决于用途、许可和公开风险。

entries.english_definition: To make something ready for a later activity.

contexts.paragraph_english: The first list on our kitchen wall was made to count meals. It had room letters and the number of portions to prepare. When a resident asked why the public register still said she had moved away, that kitchen list became useful for a different purpose. It showed a practical disagreement worth investigating. It did not tell us the whole history of her movements, and it did not turn a request for supper into an agreement to publish her name.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 厨房墙上最初的名单用来数饭食，写着房间字母和应准备的份数。一位住民问，为什么公共名册仍说她迁出了，这张厨房名单便对另一用途有了帮助：它指出值得核查的实际差异。它没有叙述她全部迁移经历，也没有把领晚饭的请求变成同意公开姓名。

contexts.paragraph_english: Custodian: In either option, we will keep the original versions and append later corrections. A redacted public finding is the minimum public account. The wider redacted option also includes technical conditions and limits, so readers can see how far the current test goes. Neither option releases medical notes, unrelated identities or home addresses. If we prepare a second working copy, its source label must still point to the same originals. A second copy can make access more resilient; it cannot supply an independent witness simply by being stored in another room.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 保管人：都保原版并追加纠正。脱敏结果是最低公开，较宽版本另给技术条件和限制，让读者明白当前测试范围。都不发医疗、无关身份或住址。另作工作副本也标同一原件来源；双副本可增访问韧性，不因另一房保管便成为独立证人。

contexts.paragraph_english: The retained group has three duty entries: two observer roles and one service role. The source identity key remains sealed. Prepare a derived review copy with those counts and its original source reference, then deliver it to this desk for this purpose. The copy is not an independent witness. If a later recipient asks for identities, seek each person's applicable permission; this request has not granted it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 保留组有三职务条目：两观察岗位、一服务岗位，来源身份键仍封存。应制角色数量及原来源索引的审阅副本，再为此用途交此台。副本不是独立见证；后来接收方请求身份，须取得每人适用许可，本请求没有授予。

entries.english_definition: To select one option from the available alternatives.

contexts.paragraph_english: Two markers are visible from the reef path. The southern marker stands near the broken steps. It identifies the old landing place but does not confirm that the steps remain usable after a surge. The northern reach is beyond the low stone wall. Its approach is narrow, so a rescue boat must wait for a clear signal rather than following the first moving light it sees. The winch line can guide people towards either marker. Choose the receiving direction before loading the line, and repeat the tension check whenever that direction changes. A raised hand lamp may help people find the path; it does not replace the line or repair the steps.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 礁岸可见两个标记。南标记位于破损台阶旁，标出旧接应点，并不保证浪涌后台阶仍能用。北段在矮石墙外，入口狭窄，救援船应等明确接应信号。绞盘索可朝两边接应；承载前须选方向，改向后须重新检查张力。手灯帮助辨路，不替代救援索，也不修复台阶。

contexts.paragraph_english: Resident representative: The warmer shelter matters now, but so does the transfer which some households are waiting for. I would like the proposal to say which work is postponed under each distribution. If we choose the transition, when will the materials used for production support become unavailable for shelter improvement? If we reduce immediately, who will replace the expected output in the transfer plan? We should be able to disagree about those costs without losing the meals and wage cover already agreed. Please record the conditions, rather than writing that every resident shares one preference.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 住民代表：更暖的安置处现在重要，一些住户等待的转移也重要。我希望提案说明各分配推迟什么工作。选择过渡后，生产支持物资何时不再可用于安置？立刻减产时，转移计划的预期产出由什么替代？讨论这些代价不应失去已约定暖食和工资保障。请记条件，不写所有住民同一偏好。

contexts.paragraph_english: The drawing's former tower outlet is crossed out on the inspection copy. The later interlock plate identifies that outlet as outside the current local work scope. Trace both drawings at the actual selector; choose only the local branches authorised for this inspection. A correct sketch does not change the physical selector.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 查验副本中旧塔站出口已划去。后加联锁标牌将它列在本次范围之外。应在实际选择器处对照两图，仅选择获准的地方支路。画对草图不会改变真实档位。

contexts.paragraph_english: Inspect the two branch valves from their marked outer stands. The root core surrounds their shared return and may move when the conveyor restarts. Before entering the treatment zone, keep the conveyor isolated, identify both blocked branches and choose the stated sample or mechanical procedure. The local crew can assist under the inspection commission whether or not Mira has joined your travelling party.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 在标记外侧站位检查两条支路阀。缠根核心围住共同回流处，输送器重启时可能活动。进入处置区前应保持输送器隔离，识别两条受阻支路，并选用告示列明的取样或机械程序。地方委托可以提供协作，米拉是否加入旅行队伍均不影响这项协作。

entries.english_definition: To make a situation or reason understandable.

contexts.paragraph_english: Coast recorder extract. Instrument clock: 21:14:12, light signal lost at the observed tower channel. Further gaps occur in the same recording window, but the extract does not contain a complete network diagnosis. The shore clock and ship clock differ by approximately two seconds in their last routine comparison. Taken with the ship observation copy, this extract supports the order of light loss followed by course deviation. It does not name the person responsible, explain why every gap occurred or establish that the outage was deliberate. Keep the original time labels attached when making a later comparison.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 海岸记录器摘录：仪器钟21:14:12，所观测塔台信号消失；同一窗口还有其他缺口，摘录并非完整网络诊断。最近一次常规比对中，岸钟与船钟相差约两秒。结合船上抄记，资料支持先熄灯后偏航，不识别责任人，不解释每个缺口，也不证明故意断供。后续比对保留原始时间标签。

contexts.paragraph_english: Good afternoon. Today I want to explain how our college evaluated a trial of later library opening. You may have seen the announcement saying that the trial was successful. That description needs a little care. The library was used more often in the evening, but that does not answer every question about whether the change should become permanent. I will go through what changed, what we measured and what we still need to find out.

A separate notice at the dispatch desk sets out the conditions for Route B. Crews should compare those conditions with the particulars of their own vessel rather than assume that a channel available to one boat is available to every boat. The departure plan must identify the chosen route and explain any equipment arrangements on which it depends.

The columns describe different measures: an administrative classification and a dated residence check. The figures do not explain the original reasons for classification. Record the mismatch, the scope of this group and the limit on interpretation. Preserve the evidence references for later review.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 两列衡量不同对象：行政分类与有日期的居住核查。数字没有解释最初分类原因。应记录差异、住区组范围和解释限制，并保留证据来源。

entries.english_definition: To give an account of an event or finding.

contexts.paragraph_english: To the new technician, from Mara. If a record is marked for destruction, first ask who issued the instruction, which version it concerns and what other record can be used to check it. A tidy report may leave out the circumstances that made its conclusion seem convincing. I have enclosed a request to compare the public maintenance record with an independent source. Deal with immediate rescue work before following it. This letter was placed in the inspection post before your journey; it cannot tell you where I am when you read it. Do not treat my concerns as proof. Preserve what you actually find, including anything that does not support the explanation you expected.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 玛拉给新检修员的留言：遇到要求销毁的记录，先核对指令签发者、所指版本和可独立核验的来源。整齐报告可能省略形成结论的条件。附上公共检修记录比对请求，但眼前救援优先。信件在旅程前寄存，不能说明阅读时玛拉所在。疑虑不是证明，应保留实际找到的资料，包括不支持预期解释的部分。

contexts.paragraph_english: Dispatcher: So the earlier report needs to be corrected, but we are not yet issuing a departure instruction.

At the end of the trial, fewer complaints had been received. The transport office treated this as encouraging rather than decisive. A complaint count depends not only on the number of problems but also on whether passengers know where to report them and believe that reporting is worthwhile. The number of rail passengers had also varied during the trial. The office therefore compared complaints with observed missed connections and passenger numbers. It did not publish the lower complaint count as proof that every user had benefited.

For eight weeks, the team recorded entrances during the extra hours. They also asked visitors to complete a short form when they left. I should stress that the entrance figures were visits, not separate individuals. Someone who came on six evenings appeared six times in the total. It would therefore be misleading to report the total as the number of students who had benefited. The forms helped us see patterns of use, although not everyone chose to complete one.

entries.english_definition: To make information available to an audience.

contexts.paragraph_english: At the end of the trial, fewer complaints had been received. The transport office treated this as encouraging rather than decisive. A complaint count depends not only on the number of problems but also on whether passengers know where to report them and believe that reporting is worthwhile. The number of rail passengers had also varied during the trial. The office therefore compared complaints with observed missed connections and passenger numbers. It did not publish the lower complaint count as proof that every user had benefited.

The reading room offers a basic set of public records for the registered priory check. It includes room codes, record dates, duties and version references. Permission to read this set is tied to the purpose recorded at the access desk. A later request to publish or to inspect a protected identity is a separate decision.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 阅览室为已登记的修院查验提供一组公共记录，包含房间代码、记录日期、职能和版本来源。阅读许可对应访问台登记的用途。后续公开资料或查看受保护身份，需要另作决定。

contexts.paragraph_english: For a restricted attachment, name the record version, the fields required, the recipient and the intended use. June acts as custodian of the room. She can arrange controlled inspection and record an authorised handover. Holding the key to an attachment does not make her the person entitled to consent on behalf of every individual named there. Consent to publish a person's identity must be given by that person for the specified recipient and use.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 申请受限附页时，请说明版本、必要字段、接收方和用途。琼是阅览室保管人，可以安排受控查验、记录获准交付，但持有钥匙并未使她有权代所有当事人同意。公开某人的身份须由本人对具体接收方与用途明确同意。

contexts.paragraph_english: The first list on our kitchen wall was made to count meals. It had room letters and the number of portions to prepare. When a resident asked why the public register still said she had moved away, that kitchen list became useful for a different purpose. It showed a practical disagreement worth investigating. It did not tell us the whole history of her movements, and it did not turn a request for supper into an agreement to publish her name.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 厨房墙上最初的名单用来数饭食，写着房间字母和应准备的份数。一位住民问，为什么公共名册仍说她迁出了，这张厨房名单便对另一用途有了帮助：它指出值得核查的实际差异。它没有叙述她全部迁移经历，也没有把领晚饭的请求变成同意公开姓名。

entries.english_definition: To put one's identifying mark on a document.

contexts.paragraph_english: Oren: I signed the MC-2 acceptance. The check sheet beside it still said that the safety bypass was incomplete. I should have refused to sign it as complete. I can describe the pressure during that handover, and I will answer questions about my own actions. My account should be compared with the instrument, workshop copy and formal version rather than used in their place.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 奥伦：MC-2验收是我签的，旁边的检查页仍写安全旁路未完成。我本该拒绝签为完成。我可以说明交接时受到的压力，也会回答关于本人行动的问题。请把陈述与仪表、工坊副本和正式版本比较，而不要拿它代替那些记录。

contexts.paragraph_english: Pera: My response to a repair can stay narrower than forgiveness. I can accept a tested alarm and still object to the way the old equipment was delivered. Another qualified person can repeat the test if the arrangement is agreed; the repairer cannot sign both the work and its independent review. We should give residents a result they can use and a way to report a new fault. No one has to write that everyone is satisfied before the safety work can be recorded. The disagreement deserves its own line.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 佩拉：我对维修的回应可以小于原谅。我能接受受检警报器，仍反对早先交付方式。安排获准后，可请另一合格人员重复测试；维修者不能同时签工作及独立复核。住民应得到可用结果和报告新故障的途径。安全工作登记无需先写所有人满意；分歧自有一栏。

contexts.paragraph_english: Stores clerk: Every extra package has one local identifier. If four go to shelter and two to retrofit, all six are allocated and none remain for production support. That is a feasible early-reduction distribution. Two to shelter, one to retrofit and three to production also meets the allocation limits. It supports a limited transition with less immediate improvement in the other two uses. We can consider a different distribution within the same limits. What I cannot sign is a list of seven packages, or a list which sends the same package to two groups.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 库管员：每个额外工包有独立地方编号。安置四、改造二就用完六包，不剩生产支持，这是一种可行早降载分配。安置二、改造一、生产三也符合限制，可支持有限过渡，但其他两项即时改善较少。还可考虑同限额内的别种分配。我不能签七包清单，也不能把同一包送给两个组。

contexts.paragraph_english: Oren may give a statement, undertake supervised repair or join a travelling crew after the batch finding. Those choices do not appoint him to two simultaneous posts. A local replacement must be accepted before a duty occupant departs. The later ROLE-R3-OP and ROLE-R3-REP protocol mandates also have separate operating and representative scopes; this current shift does not sign them automatically.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 批次核查后，奥伦可作证、承担监督维修或加入出行队伍。这些选择不能同时占两岗。值守人员离开前须有获准接替。后来ROLE-R3-OP与ROLE-R3-REP协议又有独立操作和代表范围，本班不会自动签署那些委托。

entries.english_definition: To allow a specified action.

contexts.paragraph_english: The machine room has an inner latch leading back to the residential passage. Open it from this side once the local route is safe. This gives another physical way home. A valid local test, a tower work permit and a current tower inspection remain distinct records, all of which can be reviewed before the chapter's safety report is issued.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 机房内闩通向住区。地方路线安全后，从本侧打开可增加实际返程路线。地方有效试验、塔站工作许可和塔站当前安全检查仍是三份不同记录，均可在签发章节安全报告前复核。

contexts.paragraph_english: Please separate a decision about a person's identity from a decision about those claims. If the person gives explicit consent for a particular identity field to be published to a particular recipient, record that scope and version. Do not treat an archive reading permit or a custodian's signature as personal consent. If the requested permission is missing, revise the fields or request another scope before sending. The basic reading room will remain open while you do that.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 请把个人身份决定与这些公共陈述分开。本人若明确同意向特定接收方公开某项身份字段，应记录范围与版本。阅读许可或保管人签字不能代替个人同意。缺少所需许可时，发送前修改字段或申请新范围；基础阅览室仍开放。

contexts.paragraph_english: This permit covers the duty layer, the marked inspection stands and the return passage. The operator will compare the current isolation indicators, protected access and duty register with the local-station test receipt. Record what is inspected here rather than copying the machine-room result into a tower-safety field.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 许可覆盖值守层、标记查验站位与返程通道。当班操作员对照地方支站试验回执，核查当前隔离指示、防护通路与值班记录。应记下塔站实际检查内容，不能把机房结果抄成塔站安全状态。

contexts.paragraph_english: The local inspection assignment permits this batch comparison. It does not permit the release of unrelated household details or the alteration of priory records. If the original instrument remains temporarily inaccessible, the retained copy can guide preparation, while the final finding keeps the missing inspection explicit.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本地查验委托允许这项批次比较，没有许可发布无关住户细节或改写修院记录。原仪表暂时无法到达时，可用副本准备工作；最终结论仍明确缺少哪项现场查验。

entries.english_definition: To keep someone or something safe from danger.

contexts.paragraph_english: The policy record about ninety days before D0 presents a further issue. Voss knew that prolonged high load carried long-term risk, yet retained high quotas and limited the circulation of unfavourable findings. She argued that sudden loss of supply would cause immediate harm. That argument deserves to be recorded accurately because current emergency work still has to protect essential services. It does not cancel the duty to disclose relevant risk or justify treating criticism as unavailable evidence. A choice can address one real danger while remaining responsible for increasing another.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 约 D0 前九十天政策记录提出另一问题：沃斯知道长期高负荷风险，仍保留高配额、限制不利结果传播，理由是骤然失供即刻伤害。这论辩应准确保留，当下应急仍需保护服务；但不取消披露相关风险的责任，也不让批评失去证据资格。决定可应对一种真实危险，仍承担增加另一危险的责任。

contexts.paragraph_english: Ada: Then let us choose a workable temporary arrangement and leave the larger argument open. Keep the originals available, protect the people whose names are not needed, and give the next team the limits as well as the findings. I cannot promise that every resident will agree with my choice. I can promise that the record will show what I accepted, who else accepted a duty and how a correction can be requested. Our street was removed from a register once. This time, being entered in a record should give people a way to question it, rather than another reason they cannot be heard.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 阿妲：先选可行临时安排，保留更大讨论。原件可查，保护非必要身份，给后队限制和结果。我不保证每住民同意，但记录我接受什么、谁接受哪岗、如何请求纠正。街曾被名录抹掉，这次登记应给质疑渠道，不能成为又一无法发声理由。

contexts.paragraph_english: The platform consists of a main unit and a field device. From the external stand, disconnect_field_input, fix_external_brake and verify_zero_field_energy in that order. Protect the current cargo segment, then isolate the platform after its main threat is controlled. Pressure may reduce the main unit’s impact; it cannot sign a cargo receipt or perform the isolation action. The protected packet reaches the receiving stand only through the actual paired route. Inspect the local return and present configuration before issuing tower safety.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 平台由主体和护场器组成。先在外侧工位依次断输入disconnect_field_input、固定制动fix_external_brake、核零能verify_zero_field_energy；再保护本次货载段，主体威胁控制后再实际隔离平台。压强可以减弱主体冲击，不能代签货物回执或执行隔离。受保护工包沿实际成对通路到接收站，核对地方返程和当前配置后才签塔站安全。

contexts.paragraph_english: Finn: Control the field device, protect this packet and stop the platform. Then isolate it and inspect the return. Only the current configuration can support the tower safety record. The baseline order consumes the received components later; an enhanced controller is a separate item.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 芬：制护场器、护本批、停平台，再隔离核返程。只有当前配置支持安全记录。基础单之后才消耗已接组件，增强控制器另算。

entries.english_definition: To fasten or safeguard something against movement or loss.

contexts.paragraph_english: The centre of the cabin floor is cracked. A person may appear to cross it successfully while the damaged boards continue to move underneath. Do not use that as a load test. The emergency cabinet beside the port wall contains a hand tool and a short rescue line; both belong to this vessel's rescue kit. A loose gangboard is stored along the intact side of the cabin. Secure it across the damaged section, keeping its ends on sound supports, before directing anybody towards the shore exit. The reef path begins beyond that exit. This note describes the cabin passage, not the safety of the landing place outside. Check the shore notice before choosing an approach for the rescue boat.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 船舱中央地板已经开裂。有人一度踩过去，不能证明受损板材可承重。左舷救援柜存有手工具和一根救援索，均属于本船救援包。沿完好的侧壁放着一块踏板。先把踏板两端固定在可靠支承上，再安排人员走向岸边出口。出口外才是礁岸路径；本说明不能证明岸上接应点安全，需要另查岸边告示。

contexts.paragraph_english: Ada: Start with the street people use now, not the straight line on the old sheet. At the checkpoint you have two choices. The inspected passage avoids the broken span, although both appear to lead north. Have your present commission checked there. Or go through the service tunnel with the basic kit; isolate the drive, secure the panel and inspect the cleared route. Neither choice tells us whether Mara is alive today. I know where the duty hall is and where the residents can receive someone coming back. I will not turn an old movement record into a current medical report. Bring the rescue team to the street when the inner return passage is open.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 阿妲：从大家现在走的街开始，别只看旧纸上的直线。检查点有两种选择：核查通道绕开断桥，须查当次委托；或者用基础工具走隧道，隔离驱动、固定面板、清路检查。两种路线都不能说明玛拉今天是否活着。我知道值守厅位置和住民接应处，不会把旧转移记录当成当前医疗报告。内侧便道打开后，把救援队带回街区。

contexts.paragraph_english: The shore winch has its own small reserve; it is not supplied by the harbour generator or by a ship battery. Switch its local power off and isolate the drive before seating the displaced cable. Secure the rescue line at the marked anchor, then set the receiving direction. The cable and line may be prepared in either order while the drive is isolated. Restore local power only after both are secure. Run the tension check with no people on the line. A check belongs to that configuration: moving the receiving direction, reseating the cable or changing power cancels its validity. The nearby animals must be kept away from the receiving path before the line carries people. If a check fails, keep people in the protected assembly area and inspect the preparation again; taking time to read this card does not change the number of survivors. The shelter retains a working short-range distress set for the shore receiving team. It can send the registered rescue request before the separate coast-to-harbour relay is restored. Harbour pickup is confirmed through that relay later; a saved draft at the shelter has not yet sent a request.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 岸边绞盘使用自己的储备，和港口发电机、船电池无关。关闭本地电源并隔离驱动后，重新落座移位的钢缆。救援索固定在标记锚点，设置接应方向；隔离状态下，钢缆与索具可按任意先后准备。两者固定后才能恢复本地电源，先空载检查张力。证书只对应当次配置；改方向、缆线或电源均使旧检查失效。承载前须制止接应路径附近的动物威胁。检查失败时人员留在保护集合处，阅读不会减少幸存者。 救援棚有可用的短距求援台，能先向岸上接应队发送已登记求援；海岸至港口的独立中继另行恢复，之后才能确认港口接应。发送台保存稿件还没有发送请求。

contexts.paragraph_english: The uncontrolled extraction machine has a moving feed and an unsecured lifting arm. Stop the feed at the marked intake point, then physically secure the arm before dealing with the main machine. Pressure can weaken the machine's impact; it cannot fasten an arm which has not been secured. The portable clamp earned after this commission is not needed to complete it: this work stand provides the declared fixed brace interface and local securing equipment.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 失控开采机有活动送料与未固定吊臂。先在标记入口停送料，再实际固定吊臂，随后制止主机。压力可以减弱冲击，无法自动固定没有固定的吊臂。本委托之后获得的便携固定钳不是完成前置；站位提供已声明的固定接口和本地固定设备。

entries.english_definition: To return something to an earlier usable condition.

contexts.paragraph_english: The shore winch has its own small reserve; it is not supplied by the harbour generator or by a ship battery. Switch its local power off and isolate the drive before seating the displaced cable. Secure the rescue line at the marked anchor, then set the receiving direction. The cable and line may be prepared in either order while the drive is isolated. Restore local power only after both are secure. Run the tension check with no people on the line. A check belongs to that configuration: moving the receiving direction, reseating the cable or changing power cancels its validity. The nearby animals must be kept away from the receiving path before the line carries people. If a check fails, keep people in the protected assembly area and inspect the preparation again; taking time to read this card does not change the number of survivors. The shelter retains a working short-range distress set for the shore receiving team. It can send the registered rescue request before the separate coast-to-harbour relay is restored. Harbour pickup is confirmed through that relay later; a saved draft at the shelter has not yet sent a request.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 岸边绞盘使用自己的储备，和港口发电机、船电池无关。关闭本地电源并隔离驱动后，重新落座移位的钢缆。救援索固定在标记锚点，设置接应方向；隔离状态下，钢缆与索具可按任意先后准备。两者固定后才能恢复本地电源，先空载检查张力。证书只对应当次配置；改方向、缆线或电源均使旧检查失效。承载前须制止接应路径附近的动物威胁。检查失败时人员留在保护集合处，阅读不会减少幸存者。 救援棚有可用的短距求援台，能先向岸上接应队发送已登记求援；海岸至港口的独立中继另行恢复，之后才能确认港口接应。发送台保存稿件还没有发送请求。

contexts.paragraph_english: Cargo watch: After the first hazard is controlled, confirm departure into the outer segment. We will not skip that confirmation while the notice is open. On withdrawal, preserve the earlier source inspection and restore this attempt to its recorded entry.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 货守：首段危险控制后明确外线出发，打开通知时不跳过确认。撤回保留较早来源检查，并把本次尝试恢复入口。

contexts.paragraph_english: This relay records signals locally even when its outgoing link is unavailable. The independent recorder and the outgoing transmitter are separate parts of the station. Before touching the displaced outgoing lead, switch the local transmitter off and isolate it. Seat the lead, restore the station's own reserve and run a link check. The test confirms this lead and power configuration only. If either changes, repeat it before requesting a boat. A successful link test is not evidence that a distant tower is safe. The postal locker may be opened for the named technician after the shore rescue has been completed. Its contents are correspondence, not a certificate about the sender's present whereabouts. The rear latch can be opened from this room to provide a shorter route back to the rescue shelter.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 中继站外发链路中断时仍可本地记录；独立记录器与外发设备是两个部件。检修移位接线前关闭并隔离本地发送设备，再落座接线，恢复本站储备，做当前配置链路检查。改变接线或电源须重新检查；成功不证明远方塔站安全。救援完成后，具名检修员才可领取邮务柜通信，它不证明寄信人目前所在或状态。后门内闩可从站内打开，缩短返回救援棚的路线。

contexts.paragraph_english: This charged battery has sufficient reserve for the beacon during the planned evacuation. It is not intended to restore the harbour supply or power workshop machinery. Connect it to the repaired beacon and check the installed equipment before departure. If the connection is changed after that check, test the equipment again. The battery remains with the ferry once the evacuation begins.

entries.english_definition: To make an amount or demand smaller.

contexts.paragraph_english: Choose a load policy explicitly. Under early_reduce, set extraction to zero and retain the seven basic service units. More of the extra packages can then go directly to shelter and retrofit, though the present extraction output is lost. A feasible example allocates four packages to shelter, two to retrofit and none to production support. Other allocations within the public limits can be proposed.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 请明确选择负荷政策。early_reduce把抽取设为零，保留七单位基本服务；更多工包可立即用于安置与改造，代价是失去当前抽取产出。可行例为安置四、改造二、生产支持零；也可提出满足公开约束的其他分配。

contexts.paragraph_english: Resident representative: The warmer shelter matters now, but so does the transfer which some households are waiting for. I would like the proposal to say which work is postponed under each distribution. If we choose the transition, when will the materials used for production support become unavailable for shelter improvement? If we reduce immediately, who will replace the expected output in the transfer plan? We should be able to disagree about those costs without losing the meals and wage cover already agreed. Please record the conditions, rather than writing that every resident shares one preference.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 住民代表：更暖的安置处现在重要，一些住户等待的转移也重要。我希望提案说明各分配推迟什么工作。选择过渡后，生产支持物资何时不再可用于安置？立刻减产时，转移计划的预期产出由什么替代？讨论这些代价不应失去已约定暖食和工资保障。请记条件，不写所有住民同一偏好。

contexts.paragraph_english: The request to reduce extraction reached the town while the rescue desk was still preparing its receiving space. It sounded simple from a distance: stop the dangerous work and send everyone home. At the desk, several questions followed. Which room would be warm? How would water be kept out of the lower route? Who would cover the next wage shift, and where would the supplies for a different kind of work come from? Those questions did not make safety less urgent. They described the work required to make a safer decision possible.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 减抽取请求来到矿镇时，救援台仍在准备接收空间。从远处听，事情似乎简单：停危险工作，让大家回家。台前却接着出现问题：哪间屋能保暖？如何防止下层通路进水？谁保障下一班工资？另一类工作的物资从哪里来？这些问题没有降低安全紧迫性，它们说明让更安全决定成为可能的实际工作。

contexts.paragraph_english: The current bounded arrangement retains seven basic-service units within a local capacity of ten. With early_reduce, extraction is zero. With time_limited_transition, extraction is one to three only during the one declared shift, and two distinct local people must actually hold the operating and safety-watch posts. Check the applied setting, not just the policy saved at the dispatch desk.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 当前有界安排在容量十内保留七单位基本服务。early_reduce抽取零；time_limited_transition仅在一班明确窗口内允许抽取一至三，并由两名不同本地人员实际承担操作与安全观察。检查已应用设置，而非只查调度台保存的政策。

entries.english_definition: To carry on an activity already started.

contexts.paragraph_english: The centre of the cabin floor is cracked. A person may appear to cross it successfully while the damaged boards continue to move underneath. Do not use that as a load test. The emergency cabinet beside the port wall contains a hand tool and a short rescue line; both belong to this vessel's rescue kit. A loose gangboard is stored along the intact side of the cabin. Secure it across the damaged section, keeping its ends on sound supports, before directing anybody towards the shore exit. The reef path begins beyond that exit. This note describes the cabin passage, not the safety of the landing place outside. Check the shore notice before choosing an approach for the rescue boat.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 船舱中央地板已经开裂。有人一度踩过去，不能证明受损板材可承重。左舷救援柜存有手工具和一根救援索，均属于本船救援包。沿完好的侧壁放着一块踏板。先把踏板两端固定在可靠支承上，再安排人员走向岸边出口。出口外才是礁岸路径；本说明不能证明岸上接应点安全，需要另查岸边告示。

contexts.paragraph_english: Tess: The outer segment needs its own actual result before the paired tower entrance opens. If we cannot continue, use the present safe return or deposit the packet with its named cart keeper. Do not take a moving cargo group into ordinary sea travel.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 泰丝：外线要自己的结果才开配对塔口。不能继续时走安全返程或交指定车守托管，不能把移动货组带入普通航海。

contexts.paragraph_english: Harbour closure order — current copy. General departures are suspended while the navigation restrictions are reviewed. Rescue arrivals continue at the public receiving berth. An arrival under that provision does not grant a vessel permission to depart. The dispatch office may issue a limited local maintenance commission where the work supports a specific safe evacuation arrangement. The commission must name its work area and power boundary. It does not itself clear a route, approve an untested navigation lamp or transfer ownership of a vessel. A later departure instruction must be checked against the route notices and the vessel's current configuration. The public consultation desk remains accessible during the closure; restricted records and equipment require their own authorisation.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 现行封港令：一般出港暂停，公共泊位仍接收救援入港；允许入港不等于允许出港。调度室可为明确安全撤离工作签发有限地方检修委托，写明作业范围和供电边界。委托本身不开放航道、不认可未经测试导航灯、不移交船产权。出港另需按航道资料及船舶当前配置核对。公共咨询区开放，受限记录与设备需各自授权。

contexts.paragraph_english: The public work register remains open if an identity request is declined. You may request a redacted copy, arrange an inspection through the custodian, or pause the identity request and continue the public inquiry. Reviewers must still be able to check material public facts and the records supporting them. Private details should be separated from that route rather than used to prevent all scrutiny.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 身份申请被拒后，公共工作记录仍开放。可以申请脱敏副本、经保管人安排查验，或暂缓身份申请后继续公共调查。必要公共事实及支持记录仍须能被审查；私人细节应与这条核查路径分开。

entries.english_definition: To end movement or an activity.

contexts.paragraph_english: The transport office initially looked for mistakes in the timetable. None were found. The difficulty was that the ten-minute connection had been measured from the arrival of the train at the platform to the departure of the bus from its stop. It did not include the time passengers might need to leave a crowded carriage, reach the footbridge and collect a bicycle or a large bag. What looked like a generous interval on paper was not necessarily a usable interval for everyone.

You can reconstruct the high-load stop without losing the installed fixture. At five minutes take the first observation, then take the second at ten. Record the configured condition as well as the final outcome. Resetting afterwards leaves that failed run in the archive. A positive run later may support another condition; it cannot make the earlier stop cease to have occurred.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 可以复原高负荷停止而不丢已装器材。五分钟取第一观察，十分钟取第二次。记录配置与末次结果。后来复位仍把失败运行留档；之后正例可支持另一条件，不能令早停止从历史消失。

contexts.paragraph_english: To investigate, staff observed the route between the platform and the bus stop over five evenings. They also invited passengers to describe their journeys. The two sources did not provide identical information. Observation showed where groups slowed down, whereas the written accounts explained why some people needed to stop. A parent reported waiting for a child to use the station facilities; another passenger avoided the footbridge because the lift was unreliable. These were not errors in reading the timetable. They were conditions that the timetable alone did not reveal.

Workers have practical reasons to want a repair accepted quickly. A closed route may stop wages, delay a meal delivery or leave a household waiting for someone to return. Treating every request for continued production as greed misses those conditions. Accepting an unsafe system without a limit can expose the same people to another danger. A responsible repair plan therefore needs more than a declaration of good intention: it needs a usable exit, a real supply arrangement, people assigned to the work and a point at which its conditions will be checked again.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 工人有实际理由希望迅速完成验收。通路关闭可能影响工资、拖延供餐，也让住户等不到家人回来。把每项继续生产请求都解释为贪婪，会漏掉这些条件；无限制接受不安全系统，又会把同一批人置于危险。负责的维修方案需要可用出口、实际供给、明确人员和再次核查边界，而非只有善意宣言。

entries.english_definition: To keep something in a particular position or state.

contexts.paragraph_english: The current bounded arrangement retains seven basic-service units within a local capacity of ten. With early_reduce, extraction is zero. With time_limited_transition, extraction is one to three only during the one declared shift, and two distinct local people must actually hold the operating and safety-watch posts. Check the applied setting, not just the policy saved at the dispatch desk.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 当前有界安排在容量十内保留七单位基本服务。early_reduce抽取零；time_limited_transition仅在一班明确窗口内允许抽取一至三，并由两名不同本地人员实际承担操作与安全观察。检查已应用设置，而非只查调度台保存的政策。

contexts.paragraph_english: Voss: Preserving services is not a reason to preserve my exclusive control. I can provide supervised technical help if that is the agreed arrangement. If I am suspended from the role, keep an operation channel through the appointed local staff. My understanding of the network does not turn an incomplete preparation list into a completed one. Ada: That choice must not decide which future policy the patrol is allowed to consider. We can hold you responsible for the old decisions while still asking a bounded technical question, or assign the task elsewhere without inventing a simpler network.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 沃斯：保服务不等于保我独控。可同意受监督技术帮助；若停职，通过当地指定人员维持操作渠道。我的网络知识不把缺项清单变成完成。阿妲：此选择不决定巡灯人可考虑哪种未来政策。可究旧责仍问有限技术，也可另派工作，不编造更简单网络。

contexts.paragraph_english: Both teams observed a higher indicator at the mine than at their lower-load comparison station. They did not hold every location condition constant, and their indicator scales share a declared reference rather than identical precision. The dataset supports a testable association. The controlled trial must examine the proposed mechanism and preserve a result that might contradict the proposed replacement scheme.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 两队均观察到矿区指标高于各自低负荷比较站。它们没有固定所有地点条件，指标尺度使用声明参考而非完全相同精度。数据支持可检验关联。受控试验还须检验拟议机制，并保留可能反驳替代方案的结果。

contexts.paragraph_english: The option display must name each missing qualification now, using the sealed version and current physical safety. Choosing a preferred description does not install a device or make a different protocol current. If the distributed work is incomplete, central and island remain legitimate prepared decisions when the base and central safety conditions hold. Revisiting the protected pre-final adventure later may produce another result, but it cannot change the ending snapshot that has already been committed.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 方案显示应按封存版本和当前实体安全列出每个缺项。选择偏好说明不会安装装置，也不会使另一协议成为当前。分布工作未齐时，只要基础及中央安全成立，中央与孤网仍是正当准备方向。后来回访终局前冒险可另产结果，不能改已提交结局快照。

entries.english_definition: To formally end a planned action or permission.

contexts.paragraph_english: The policy record about ninety days before D0 presents a further issue. Voss knew that prolonged high load carried long-term risk, yet retained high quotas and limited the circulation of unfavourable findings. She argued that sudden loss of supply would cause immediate harm. That argument deserves to be recorded accurately because current emergency work still has to protect essential services. It does not cancel the duty to disclose relevant risk or justify treating criticism as unavailable evidence. A choice can address one real danger while remaining responsible for increasing another.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 约 D0 前九十天政策记录提出另一问题：沃斯知道长期高负荷风险，仍保留高配额、限制不利结果传播，理由是骤然失供即刻伤害。这论辩应准确保留，当下应急仍需保护服务；但不取消披露相关风险的责任，也不让批评失去证据资格。决定可应对一种真实危险，仍承担增加另一危险的责任。

contexts.paragraph_english: Tess: Keep the original next-watch contact and add the backup contact. Both must see the same present delivery sheet. Ask for the actual receiving confirmation rather than assuming that a sent message was received. My preference for a distributed arrangement does not cancel your completed work or take your other policy choices away.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 泰丝：保留原下一班联系人并加备用，二者看同当前交付表。要真实接收确认，不以发送推已收。我的分布式偏好不取消已做工作或其他政策选择。

entries.english_definition: To take back an invitation, permission, or commitment.

contexts.paragraph_english: W1, W2 and W3 must be received after the real escort. Confirm the checked exit, receiving person and basic provisions. Extra work packages remain unallocated until this protection is in place. A later change in production may alter the extra arrangement, but it does not withdraw meals or send received workers below again.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: W1、W2、W3须在实际护送后接收。核对受检出口、接收人和基本物资。保障成立前，额外工包仍待分配；后来生产变更可以改变额外安排，但不能撤回暖食或让已接收工人再次下井。

contexts.paragraph_english: Finn: Secure the guide markers before dealing with the pass obstruction. Once that obstruction is controlled, use the actual paired entrance into the station. A map symbol does not move the team there. The station defence is a separate piece of work, and controlling it will not calibrate the instrument. We have deliberately kept these results apart so the receiving watch can identify a missing step. If a fight goes badly, withdraw to its recorded entry. Your source reading and saved explanation remain available; the retreat is not a reason to award a result that did not occur.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 芬：先固定向导标记，再处置山口阻断，随后沿配对入口进测站。地图符号不搬人。测站防卫另算，控制它不校准仪表。分开结果便于接班人查缺步骤。遭遇不利可撤回记录入口，来源阅读和正文保留，撤退不奖励未发生的结果。

entries.english_definition: To accept a proposal or share a view.

contexts.paragraph_english: Sometimes a person wants to be named. Their decision deserves the same care as a decision to remain private. Ask what they agree to release, to whom, for what use and in which version. A broad permission inferred from an earlier conversation may not fit a new publication. Equally, choosing the smallest possible package in every situation can remove the very detail that the person wants included or that the authorised review needs. Appropriate scope depends on the purpose and the permission, as well as on the risk of disclosure.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 有时本人希望具名。这个决定与保持私密同样需要认真对待。请问清允许发布什么、给谁、为何使用及对应版本。旧交谈推断出的宽泛许可可能不适合新发布。每次都机械选择最少字段，也可能删去本人希望保留的内容，或获准审查真正需要的细节。适当范围取决于用途、许可和公开风险。

contexts.paragraph_english: Oren: If a public statement is requested, agree its fields and purpose with me. I can speak about my own action, including the signature, without guessing the intentions of people whose later decisions I did not see. A supervised repair followed by a statement is another arrangement, and a regional review is also possible. Please do not call a delayed statement a missing signature. The verified record remains. Joining a travelling crew is a further decision, and I can decline that invitation without taking the workshop file away from the inquiry.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 奥伦：若要求公共证言，请与我商定字段和用途。我能说明本人行动，包括签名，不能猜测后来未亲见决定的动机。也可以先做监督维修再补证言，或交地区核查。请勿把延后陈述说成签名不存在。已核验记录仍在；加入出行队是另一决定，我拒绝邀请也不会拿走工坊档案。

contexts.paragraph_english: W1, W2 and W3 are waiting at the cutting-face shelter. Locate each person and agree the return arrangement at the work stand. The shelter call describes where help is needed; it does not confirm a surface arrival. The lower-track escort must actually bring the group to the receiving route, and the town desk must receive them before the rescue report can be closed.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: W1、W2、W3在采掘面避护处等候。到工作站位逐一确认，并商定返程。求援呼叫说明哪里需要帮助，没有确认地面到达。下层轨道护送应实际把三人带到接收路线，矿镇台接收后，救援报告才能收束。

contexts.paragraph_english: This distinction matters when an inspection has several stages. One person observes the instrument, another makes a workshop copy, and a signatory accepts the delivered work. Those actions are connected, but they have different responsibilities. The observer records a condition under stated settings. The copy preserves that observation and its source. The acceptance records a decision about whether the work meets a requirement. Placing the three pages together makes it possible to ask where their claims agree and where a decision went beyond the evidence available at that stage.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 检查有多个阶段时，这一区分格外有用。一人观察仪表，另一人抄成工坊副本，签章人验收交付。行动相连，职责各异：观察者在注明设置下记状态；副本保存观察及来源；验收页记录工作是否符合要求的判断。并列三页，就能比较主张在哪些地方一致、何处决定超出了当时证据。

entries.english_definition: To decide not to accept an offer or request.

contexts.paragraph_english: The public path leads to the priory courtyard. June can arrange a meeting there and direct visitors to the residential porches. Please use the public room codes when making notes. Residents may speak for themselves, ask a custodian to relay a request, or decline an interview.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 公共通路通往修院庭院。琼可在那里安排会面，并引导访客前往住区门廊。做笔记时请使用公开房间代码。住民可以亲自说明、请保管人转达请求，也可以拒绝访谈。

contexts.paragraph_english: Oren: If a public statement is requested, agree its fields and purpose with me. I can speak about my own action, including the signature, without guessing the intentions of people whose later decisions I did not see. A supervised repair followed by a statement is another arrangement, and a regional review is also possible. Please do not call a delayed statement a missing signature. The verified record remains. Joining a travelling crew is a further decision, and I can decline that invitation without taking the workshop file away from the inquiry.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 奥伦：若要求公共证言，请与我商定字段和用途。我能说明本人行动，包括签名，不能猜测后来未亲见决定的动机。也可以先做监督维修再补证言，或交地区核查。请勿把延后陈述说成签名不存在。已核验记录仍在；加入出行队是另一决定，我拒绝邀请也不会拿走工坊档案。

contexts.paragraph_english: Private work invitation, auxiliary alarm A2. The alarm serves two workshop residential rooms. After the main batch finding, Oren may invite help to inspect its damaged connection and define a repair commitment. Accept, decline or pause the invitation; it may later be withdrawn. Accepting an invitation is distinct from permission to publish a conversation or from a decision to recruit him.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 私人工作邀请：辅助警报器A2，服务工坊住区两房。主线批次核查后，奥伦可邀请协助检查损坏接线，并界定维修承诺。可接受、拒绝或暂缓，后来也可撤回；接受邀请与发布谈话许可、招募决定各不相同。

contexts.paragraph_english: Choose emergency_public_redacted or protected_review. In either form, list the claim, the cited source version, the responding party and the response or explicit decline. Provide Mara, Voss and the station executive channel an opportunity to challenge claims separately. No response is not proof of innocence or guilt. Disputed interpretation remains noted alongside the fixed documents. The custodian checks that confidential identities are excluded and records that all three response opportunities were offered. A submitted essay cannot perform these invitations, overwrite a signature or turn a majority preference into a new historical fact. The resulting summary separates design and delayed correction, known-risk policy and testing, and cancelled review with detention.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 可选 emergency_public_redacted 或 protected_review。两种均逐条列主张、来源版本、回应方以及回应或明确拒绝；玛拉、沃斯、北站执行渠道分别获得反证机会。不回应不是无罪或有罪证明。争议解释与固定文献并存；保管人检查身份脱敏，登记三方均获机会。作文不会自动邀请、改签名或用多数偏好制造历史事实。摘要分开设计及迟延纠正、已知风险政策与测试、取消复核及扣押。

entries.english_definition: To show that information or a message has been received.

contexts.paragraph_english: Harbour loan and cross-region inspection terms. Once the Tidegate local safety record has been verified, return to the receiving berth to acknowledge the loan of the sealed inspection vessel Glimmer. Its watch officer maintains the basic ship service; accepting a companion invitation is not a condition of using the vessel. The deck, archive cabin and shared maintenance compartment are three spaces of this one ship, not separate ships at each harbour. The loan does not transfer the civil ferry or its installed equipment. The next inspection commission points to the grove receiving records. It does not certify the current whereabouts of the missing mentor. Basic sailing along an opened route does not require a fuel ticket. The vessel still needs its ordinary gradual repairs; the handover does not turn it into a fully upgraded ship.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 塔站实际安全核验后回接应泊位明确接收封存旧巡灯船微光号及跨区核查委托。船务值守不依赖接受莉娜邀请，三空间是同一船。民用渡轮及船上设备不转移，不证明导师当前去向，不收死锁燃料门票。

contexts.paragraph_english: Coast team to the stranded crew. We first marked the south steps as a possible receiving point. That instruction is withdrawn: a fresh inspection found the lower steps separated from their support. Use the northern reach beyond the low wall instead. There are four survivors waiting for assistance, apart from the technician carrying this message. Keep the rescue line clear of the broken steps. Once everyone is under shelter, send your position, the number of people needing collection and the approach restriction. Do not ask the boat to follow the southern marker merely because it is easier to see. We will acknowledge the request through the coast relay.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 海岸队更正原先南台阶方案：现场复查发现下段台阶脱离支承，撤回旧指示。改用矮墙外的北段。有四名幸存者需要接应，不含传递消息的检修员。索具避开破损台阶。人员进入棚内后，发送位置、接应人数和进路限制，接应船不会因南标记显眼就改走那里。通过海岸中继确认求援。

contexts.paragraph_english: Custodian: Then the outgoing package should retain the stage-I instrument reference, its copying chain and the acceptance version. Add the current environment readings with their settings and sampling conditions. List what this local comparison establishes and what the academic team still needs to test. The receiving desk must acknowledge the actual package and sample; an address written at the top of a draft does not deliver them. We can carry the inquiry forward while leaving the later cause, wider instructions and current whereabouts of people outside this inspection explicitly open.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 保管人：送出包应保留阶段I仪表索引、抄录链和验收版本，再附当前环境读数、设置与取样条件。列明地方比较核实什么、学城仍需试验什么。接收台应确认实际资料与样本；在草稿顶写地址并未完成交付。调查能够继续，同时把后来原因、广泛指示与此查验之外人物现址保留为未知。

contexts.paragraph_english: A decision can be revised, but revision has physical limits. Before delivery, the team can change the distribution while the packages remain available. After a connection has been installed or supplies used, a new plan must acknowledge that state. Writing a different destination does not return the old package to the store. The same principle applies to duty. A person who leaves for a travelling assignment needs a local replacement before taking a new post. Clear revision rules let people change their minds without pretending that completed work and existing commitments vanish with the previous draft.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 决定可以修改，修改也有物理边界。交付前，物资仍在时可改分配；接线已安装或用品已消耗后，新计划应承认现状。另写目的地不能让旧工包回库。值守同理：某人离开参加出行工作前，需要本地接替。清楚的修订规则允许改变主意，也无需假装完成工作和已有承诺随旧稿消失。

entries.english_definition: To offer a plan for consideration.

contexts.paragraph_english: The trial ground has six covered beds available for this work segment. The growers propose two arrangements. These are estimates for the fictional local trial, not a forecast for every winter or a promise of a fixed harvest. Both keep one walkway open and use the same existing tools.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本工作段试种地有六个覆棚床位，两种配置均保留通道、使用既有工具。数字是虚构地方试种估算，不代表每年预测或保证固定收成。

contexts.paragraph_english: Voss: I knew that sustained high load carried a long-term risk. Your retained failures must be part of the discussion. I still require a plan for the first week: who maintains protection, where the transition supply comes from, and who accepts responsibility between districts. A ten-minute local result cannot supply those fields. I propose delaying public release while the central system continues to coordinate.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 沃斯：我知道持续高负荷有长期风险，你保留的失败必须进入讨论。但第一周仍需计划：谁维护保护、过渡供给来自哪里、各区之间谁承责。十分钟本地结果填不出这些字段。我主张延后公开，同时由中央继续协调。

contexts.paragraph_english: These local choices do not settle the whole network's future. They create a safer present stage and supply evidence for the next inquiry. The academic team will still need to examine how load, extraction and observed disturbance relate under controlled conditions. Residents should be able to inspect the local costs without being asked to endorse a technical conclusion that has not been tested. A good arrangement leaves them with protection, an accountable receiving chain and an honest explanation of the work which remains. Its value comes from those results, not from the elegance of the argument used to propose it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 地方选择尚未决定整个网络未来，而是建立更安全的当前阶段，并为下一调查提供证据。学城仍需在受控条件下核查负荷、抽取和扰动的关系。住民应能查地方代价，无需被要求认可尚未试验的技术结论。好的安排留下保障、可追责接收链，以及对未完成工作的诚实说明；价值来自结果，而非提案论证的漂亮程度。

contexts.paragraph_english: A comparison note may propose what another observer should record next, such as the instrument, pump state and stage. Do not write that this extra sheet proves the final cause of the mist or unlocks a hidden ending condition. The necessary chapter samples and instrument evidence remain on the main route whether this point is visited or not.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 比较便条可以提出下一观察要记录什么，例如仪表、泵状态与阶段。不能写这页证明雾的最终原因或开启隐藏结局条件。无论访问此点与否，必需章节样本和仪表证据均在主路。

entries.english_definition: To assign resources to particular people or uses.

contexts.paragraph_english: The local selector can be tested without releasing the central tower lock. A successful small-station test will support a request to visit the tower duty layer for a current safety inspection. It will not certify the modern tower for independent operation, allocate a conversion crew or fill any six-tower engineering account.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 地方选择器可以在不解除塔站中央锁定的情况下试验。小支站成功试验后，可申请前往塔站值守层核查当前安全；此结果没有认证现代塔站独立运行，没有分配改造班组，也不填入六塔工程账。

entries.english_definition: To enter details in an official or organised record.

contexts.paragraph_english: There are people eating here whose current official entries say that they have died or moved away. A label in the register has affected deliveries, although the kitchens still have to serve the people who arrive. June requests a limited check of the difference. The work covers this priory's twenty-four-person residential group during the present chapter stage; it is not a census of the forest or proof that every missing person has been found.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 这里有人正在吃饭，现行官方名册却给他们标注了死亡或迁出。名册标签影响配送，厨房仍须为实际来到的人供餐。琼请求核查两者的差异。范围限于本章节阶段住在修院的二十四人住区组；这不是全林人口普查，也不能证明所有失踪者都已找到。

contexts.paragraph_english: The later assignment does not tell us why an official entry says moved away. Those labels came from another register. I can let the custodian check my room codes and this observation for the local inquiry. Please keep the exact record version with the statement. A retelling of what I said will still come from me; it will not become another independent witness.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 较晚分配房间不能解释官方记录为何写迁出；那些标签来自另一份名册。我可以让保管人为地方调查核对房间代码与这次观察。请把准确版本和陈述保存在一起。别人转述我的话，来源仍是我，不会变成另一个独立证人。

contexts.paragraph_english: Begin at the public porches for rooms A, B and C. Record the people who voluntarily confirm that they live there. The ration sheet reports portions prepared and collected. contexts.paragraph_chinese: 请到A、B、C区公共门廊，记录自愿确认居住于此的人。口粮页记的是准备和领取份数，房间索引记的是这组人被安置在哪里。任何一张表都不能单独证明某人实际在场。把两表、现场走访和现行名册相互比较，并保留各记录日期和用途。

contexts.paragraph_english: These figures count portions, not independent sightings of twenty-four people. A neighbour may collect for someone who is resting. The residential porch check records voluntary confirmation of residence separately. Please retain both types of record; correcting a register does not require publishing a resident's private name.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 这些数字计算口粮份数，并非二十四次独立见到本人。有人休息时，邻居可能代领。住区门廊查验另外记录本人自愿确认的居住情况。请保留两类记录；更正名册无需公开私人姓名。

entries.english_definition: The process of storing an event, measurement, or sound.

contexts.paragraph_english: Coast recorder extract. Instrument clock: 21:14:12, light signal lost at the observed tower channel. Further gaps occur in the same recording window, but the extract does not contain a complete network diagnosis. The shore clock and ship clock differ by approximately two seconds in their last routine comparison. Taken with the ship observation copy, this extract supports the order of light loss followed by course deviation. It does not name the person responsible, explain why every gap occurred or establish that the outage was deliberate. Keep the original time labels attached when making a later comparison.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 海岸记录器摘录：仪器钟21:14:12，所观测塔台信号消失；同一窗口还有其他缺口，摘录并非完整网络诊断。最近一次常规比对中，岸钟与船钟相差约两秒。结合船上抄记，资料支持先熄灯后偏航，不识别责任人，不解释每个缺口，也不证明故意断供。后续比对保留原始时间标签。

contexts.paragraph_english: Electrician: That distinction matters. Do not look for a replacement beacon when what you need is a replacement bracket. There is a suitable bracket in the west workshop. Access to the workshop has to be dealt with locally, so this recording is not permission to walk through a restricted work area.

The rear work point is available for recording future preservation requirements. Its labels list one base isolator, one local backup pack and two base provision packs for this tower. These labels describe required supplies, not items already delivered. Stable access and a local dinner feed do not fill the work point or the engineering ledger.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 后部工作点可登记以后保全需求：一个基础隔离件、一个本地备用包、两个基础保障包。这是需求，不是已交付库存。安全通路与地方晚餐回路均未填充此工作点或工程账。

contexts.paragraph_english: The end of a transition should be an action people can recognise. The duty team hands over, extraction falls to the agreed lower setting and the changed configuration is checked again. There is no benefit in making that boundary a penalty for reading slowly. It belongs to the actual work schedule. Recording its result gives the next shift something more useful than a statement that the plan once sounded reasonable. The safety route stays open, and the basic services continue while the team decides whether further work can be authorised.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 过渡终点应成为人们能辨认的行动：值守组交班，抽取降至约定低设置，再检查变更配置。把边界变成慢读惩罚毫无帮助，它属于实际工作安排。记录结果，才能让下一班获得比“计划曾听来合理”更有用的信息。安全返程继续开放，基本服务继续运行，再决定是否可授权后续工作。

entries.english_definition: To find an amount using a specified method or instrument.

contexts.paragraph_english: The local supply has a capacity of ten load units. Basic protection uses seven: two for drainage, two for ventilation, two for the warm room and one for signals. Keep those services available after the rescue. Extraction uses a separate setting of zero to three additional units. At three, the combined load reaches ten. The unit is a local planning measure, not an engineering component or a currency.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 地方供电容量为十负荷单位。基本保障用七：排水二、通风二、暖房二、信号一。救援后继续保留这些服务。抽取设置另为零至三附加单位；设为三时总负荷达十。单位用于地方规划，并非工程组件或货币。

contexts.paragraph_english: We also compared the two evenings. Thursday was usually busier than Tuesday, but the difference became smaller after the deadline for a major course assignment had passed. We cannot assume that students always prefer Thursday. Nor can we say that later opening improved examination results: the trial did not measure them. Increased use is useful evidence about access, not direct evidence about academic achievement. When you read the short report, keep that distinction in mind.

For the comparison report, use the local group table and the residence checks together. Describe what the columns measure and what the check can support. The room codes are enough for the public table. If you want an identity attachment, ask for that specific version and purpose at the scope desk. We can keep the public inquiry moving while such a request is considered.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 比较报告请结合地方住区表和居住核查，说明两列衡量的内容及查验能够支持什么。公共表使用房间代码即可。查看身份附页时，请在范围台申请具体版本与用途。申请审议期间，公共调查仍可继续。

contexts.paragraph_english: Controller C adds a practical test of the proposed alternative. Its local circuit operates at a finite load, with checked isolation, reserve, limited contact and assigned duty. The execution machine is first made safe and its output physically returned through the test route. Observations at five and ten minutes then record that arrangement. This sequence matters: a configured console is not a running circuit, and controlling an enemy device does not measure the trial output. The accepted interval belongs to the current revision. Changing a connector requires another check even if the earlier run remains a valid historical observation.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: C增加替代方案实体核验：有限负荷、受检隔离、储备、有限联络与岗位。先制止执行机，将输出实际送回测试环，再以五及十分钟观察记录安排。顺序重要：控制台配置不是运行回路，制止敌装置没有测实验输出。接受时段属于当前版本；改连接须重查，即使早运行仍是有效历史观察。

entries.english_definition: To make a machine or system work.

contexts.paragraph_english: Tidegate maintenance procedure. The tower unit is separate from the west workshop machine and from the civil ferry supply. Confirm the local supply indication at the tower base before entering the control level. During the encounter, the left cooling valve is worked from the left front position and the right valve from the right front position. Either valve may be closed first. Local supply isolation is operated from the left rear position after both valves are closed. The interlock refuses an early isolation request without spending its operating allowance. Each person may operate one work point in a personal turn. Reducing the unit to its last reserve of stopping progress does not establish safety: both valves, isolation and a controlled threat are all required. Ordinary shields and cleansing cannot substitute for this sequence.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 潮门塔机械独立于工坊及民用渡轮。进控制层前在塔基查本地供给。左前左阀、右前右阀，次序不限；左后隔离需双阀完成，每人每个人回合最多一个现场操作。打至最低制止进度不等于安全，仍需两阀、隔离和制止。

contexts.paragraph_english: Duty officer: Before we release the corridor, please identify the vessel and the scope of this visit. I can receive the temporary intervention authorisation and its actual preparation references. I cannot sign for all six districts or choose what they should operate after the dangerous programme is stopped. The corridor release covers this passage only. It is not an instruction to disconnect the city's rescue communication.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 值守：放开走廊前，请确认船和本次范围。我可接收临时处置授权及实际准备索引，不能代六地签字，也不能决定停止危险程序后的运行安排。走廊放行仅覆盖这条通道，不是断开城市救援通信的命令。

contexts.paragraph_english: Keep the destination as the next inquiry direction. A file reference is not an authority to operate the mine, a delivery of engineering components or proof that the Glimmer has sailed there.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 这是一条下一步方向。档案编号不会赋予矿井操作权，不交付工程组件，也不证明微光号已经航行到那里。

contexts.paragraph_english: Berth the Glimmer at the marked landing and let the freight clerk check the vessel-use record, the completed priory handover and your commission. Register the arrival here before entering the mine. This desk keeps the route back to the vessel available; it does not issue permission to operate underground machinery.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 请把微光号停在标记泊位，让货运员核对船只使用记录、已完成的修院交接与核查委托。进入矿井前在此登记到港。此台保留返回船只的通路；地下设备操作另需许可。

entries.english_definition: To join parts so that they can work together.

contexts.paragraph_english: This charged battery has sufficient reserve for the beacon during the planned evacuation. It is not intended to restore the harbour supply or power workshop machinery. Connect it to the repaired beacon and check the installed equipment before departure. If the connection is changed after that check, test the equipment again. The battery remains with the ferry once the evacuation begins.

The mine comparison has a useful, limited end. It can establish that an unrestored safety bypass was accepted as completed work and connect that decision to a verified signature. It can also preserve the observed changes in extraction and disturbance for further testing. The academic review will need to examine settings, instruments and other possible explanations before making a broader technical claim. Carrying forward those open questions does not weaken the local finding. It gives the next team a clear account of what is supported, what has changed and what still needs evidence.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 矿区比较具有有限而有用的终点：它能核实未修好的安全旁路曾按完成验收，并把决定与已核验签章联系起来，也能保留抽取和扰动变化供进一步试验。学城须查设置、仪表与其他解释，再形成广泛技术主张。带着未解决问题继续调查，不会削弱地方结论，而会让下一队知道哪些有依据、哪些改变了、哪些仍缺证据。

contexts.paragraph_english: Residents disagree about how names should return. Some want the earlier street names restored because those names connect public space to the lives omitted from the current register. Others have used new names for years and would find a complete restoration confusing. Ada argues that neither view should be dismissed as a failure to remember. The community has not collectively lost its past. It has lived through change. A small sign workshop can compare proposals and identify who will maintain a chosen sign, but it cannot settle every property claim or speak for all six regions.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 居民对恢复名称有分歧。有人希望恢复旧名，把公共空间连回现行名录遗漏的生活；有人多年使用新名，全面恢复反而混乱。阿妲认为两者都不是记忆失败。社区没有集体遗忘，而是经历变化。小路牌工坊可比较提案和维护人，却不解决所有产权，也不代表六地区。

entries.english_definition: To separate a device from its connection or supply.

contexts.paragraph_english: The platform consists of a main unit and a field device. From the external stand, disconnect_field_input, fix_external_brake and verify_zero_field_energy in that order. Protect the current cargo segment, then isolate the platform after its main threat is controlled. Pressure may reduce the main unit’s impact; it cannot sign a cargo receipt or perform the isolation action. The protected packet reaches the receiving stand only through the actual paired route. Inspect the local return and present configuration before issuing tower safety.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 平台由主体和护场器组成。先在外侧工位依次断输入disconnect_field_input、固定制动fix_external_brake、核零能verify_zero_field_energy；再保护本次货载段，主体威胁控制后再实际隔离平台。压强可以减弱主体冲击，不能代签货物回执或执行隔离。受保护工包沿实际成对通路到接收站，核对地方返程和当前配置后才签塔站安全。

contexts.paragraph_english: Duty officer: Before we release the corridor, please identify the vessel and the scope of this visit. I can receive the temporary intervention authorisation and its actual preparation references. I cannot sign for all six districts or choose what they should operate after the dangerous programme is stopped. The corridor release covers this passage only. It is not an instruction to disconnect the city's rescue communication.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 值守：放开走廊前，请确认船和本次范围。我可接收临时处置授权及实际准备索引，不能代六地签字，也不能决定停止危险程序后的运行安排。走廊放行仅覆盖这条通道，不是断开城市救援通信的命令。

entries.english_definition: To carry out a procedure that checks performance or condition.

contexts.paragraph_english: The centre of the cabin floor is cracked. A person may appear to cross it successfully while the damaged boards continue to move underneath. Do not use that as a load test. The emergency cabinet beside the port wall contains a hand tool and a short rescue line; both belong to this vessel's rescue kit. A loose gangboard is stored along the intact side of the cabin. Secure it across the damaged section, keeping its ends on sound supports, before directing anybody towards the shore exit. The reef path begins beyond that exit. This note describes the cabin passage, not the safety of the landing place outside. Check the shore notice before choosing an approach for the rescue boat.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 船舱中央地板已经开裂。有人一度踩过去，不能证明受损板材可承重。左舷救援柜存有手工具和一根救援索，均属于本船救援包。沿完好的侧壁放着一块踏板。先把踏板两端固定在可靠支承上，再安排人员走向岸边出口。出口外才是礁岸路径；本说明不能证明岸上接应点安全，需要另查岸边告示。

contexts.paragraph_english: For the reserve test, keep the source isolated while seating the connector. The selector has positions for the kitchen, the wash pump and an alternating cycle. Read the load labels and trace the later interlock plate as well as the old drawing. We are not changing the tower outlet under this commission.
