The nearby animals must be kept away from the receiving path before the line carries people. If a check fails, keep people in the protected assembly area and inspect the preparation again; taking time to read this card does not change the number of survivors. The shelter retains a working short-range distress set for the shore receiving team. It can send the registered rescue request before the separate coast-to-harbour relay is restored. Harbour pickup is confirmed through that relay later; a saved draft at the shelter has not yet sent a request.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 岸边绞盘使用自己的储备，和港口发电机、船电池无关。关闭本地电源并隔离驱动后，重新落座移位的钢缆。救援索固定在标记锚点，设置接应方向；隔离状态下，钢缆与索具可按任意先后准备。两者固定后才能恢复本地电源，先空载检查张力。证书只对应当次配置；改方向、缆线或电源均使旧检查失效。承载前须制止接应路径附近的动物威胁。检查失败时人员留在保护集合处，阅读不会减少幸存者。 救援棚有可用的短距求援台，能先向岸上接应队发送已登记求援；海岸至港口的独立中继另行恢复，之后才能确认港口接应。发送台保存稿件还没有发送请求。

contexts.paragraph_english: This relay records signals locally even when its outgoing link is unavailable. The independent recorder and the outgoing transmitter are separate parts of the station. Before touching the displaced outgoing lead, switch the local transmitter off and isolate it. Seat the lead, restore the station's own reserve and run a link check. The test confirms this lead and power configuration only. If either changes, repeat it before requesting a boat. A successful link test is not evidence that a distant tower is safe. The postal locker may be opened for the named technician after the shore rescue has been completed. Its contents are correspondence, not a certificate about the sender's present whereabouts. The rear latch can be opened from this room to provide a shorter route back to the rescue shelter.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 中继站外发链路中断时仍可本地记录；独立记录器与外发设备是两个部件。检修移位接线前关闭并隔离本地发送设备，再落座接线，恢复本站储备，做当前配置链路检查。改变接线或电源须重新检查；成功不证明远方塔站安全。救援完成后，具名检修员才可领取邮务柜通信，它不证明寄信人目前所在或状态。后门内闩可从站内打开，缩短返回救援棚的路线。

entries.english_definition: A connected path through which electric current can flow.

contexts.paragraph_english: Inspect the external dead circuit before opening the old case. The debris enclosure must be controlled through the actual encounter. For the reserve segment, either use the isolated manual service procedure—open, clear, secure and inspect—or control its separate maintenance threat. The physical result must be recorded before the connection is checked. Read instructions from the protected work stand; no action requires a rare talent or a particular companion.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 打开旧外壳前，从外侧检查断路。残件围护须实际遭遇制止。备用段可以用隔离手动步骤：打开、清理、固定、检查；也可处理其独立维护威胁。核对连接前须记录物理结果。在安全工作站读说明，无需稀有天赋或特定同伴。

contexts.paragraph_english: Controller C will run a small local circuit at load 40 with the installed reserve connected, local isolation checked and limited contact enabled. The two current trial posts must be assigned and the reference channels checked. The execution machine must be controlled and its output connected to the labelled test route. A battle result establishes the device's safety; it is not a trial observation. Saving this configuration is a preparation step.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: C控制器将在40负荷、已接本地储备、已查隔离及有限联络下运行小回路。应安排两个当前试验岗位，检查参考通道，制止执行机并把输出接到标记测试通路。战斗结果证明设备安全，不是试验观察。保存此配置属于准备。

contexts.paragraph_english: The duty officer will accept a specific current configuration. Inspect the protection return, secure the local isolation enclosure and physically verify the safe return stand. Record the readings after the chosen reduction, and repeat them if any load or connection changes. A proposal cannot reduce a live circuit. An old check cannot certify a new load. The result is current tower safety, not completion of a baseline or enhanced conversion.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 值守员接受特定当前配置。检查保护回路、固定本地隔离围护，实际核查安全返程站。所选降载后记录读数，改负荷或连接须重查。提议不能降低现场回路，旧检查不能认证新负荷。结果是当前塔安全，不是基础或增强改造完成。

contexts.paragraph_english: Controller C adds a practical test of the proposed alternative. Its local circuit operates at a finite load, with checked isolation, reserve, limited contact and assigned duty. The execution machine is first made safe and its output physically returned through the test route. Observations at five and ten minutes then record that arrangement. This sequence matters: a configured console is not a running circuit, and controlling an enemy device does not measure the trial output. The accepted interval belongs to the current revision. Changing a connector requires another check even if the earlier run remains a valid historical observation.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: C增加替代方案实体核验：有限负荷、受检隔离、储备、有限联络与岗位。先制止执行机，将输出实际送回测试环，再以五及十分钟观察记录安排。顺序重要：控制台配置不是运行回路，制止敌装置没有测实验输出。接受时段属于当前版本；改连接须重查，即使早运行仍是有效历史观察。

entries.english_definition: A fixed opening into which a connector fits.

contexts.paragraph_english: Controller A is installed in the old hall. Check isolation, secure its external guard and inspect the labelled reserve socket before changing a load. The failure reconstruction uses the recorded T2 condition: load 70, reserve connected, ten minutes. Confirm the apparatus plate as A. This trial scale is the apparatus's own scale; do not calculate a town's supply from it or replace the record with a different controller.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: A控制器装在旧厅。改负荷前检查隔离、固定外护罩并查看储备插座标记。失败复原使用T2条件：负荷70、连接储备、十分钟；确认装置标牌为A。单位属于此台，不能据此计算城镇供给，也不能换另一控制器冒充同记录。

contexts.paragraph_english: Technician: The controller is isolated at the outer switch. Do not take a silent machine as evidence that its reserve socket is connected. We kept the socket plate and guard inspection separate. Please control the debris enclosure, then use the manual reserve procedure or the separate maintenance encounter. I will keep the return corridor clear while you inspect.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 技术员：控制器在外开关隔离。机器安静不证明储备插座已接，我们分别留插座标记和护罩检查。先制止残件，再用备用段手动步骤或独立维护遭遇，我会在检查时保留返程走廊。

contexts.paragraph_english: The execution machine has a labelled output socket and two route selectors. Route TEST returns through the isolated local measuring loop. Route NETWORK would join an unchecked wider line and is outside this permit. Inspect the sockets from the protected stand before control. After the machine is controlled, isolate its output, seat the installed coupler in TEST, secure the guard and inspect the present route. A selected label without these actions is not a connection.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 执行机有带标输出插座和两通路选择。TEST经过隔离本地测量环；NETWORK接未经检查的广泛线路，超出许可。制止前从安全站查插座。制止后隔离输出，把已装耦合件座入TEST，固定护罩并核查当前通路。只选择标记不是连接。

entries.english_definition: A component that joins two mechanical or electrical parts.

contexts.paragraph_english: The execution machine has a labelled output socket and two route selectors. Route TEST returns through the isolated local measuring loop. Route NETWORK would join an unchecked wider line and is outside this permit. Inspect the sockets from the protected stand before control. After the machine is controlled, isolate its output, seat the installed coupler in TEST, secure the guard and inspect the present route. A selected label without these actions is not a connection.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 执行机有带标输出插座和两通路选择。TEST经过隔离本地测量环；NETWORK接未经检查的广泛线路，超出许可。制止前从安全站查插座。制止后隔离输出，把已装耦合件座入TEST，固定护罩并核查当前通路。只选择标记不是连接。

contexts.paragraph_english: The retained outputs do not establish safe permanent service for six towers. Each tower still needs its actual base changes, transition supply, common protocol and field trial. Moving a coupler at this installed laboratory fixture does not deliver one to a regional work order or grant that district's representative consent.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 保留输出不证明六塔永久安全供给。各塔仍需实际基础改造、过渡供给、共同协议及现场试运行。移动此实验器材上的耦合件，不会向地区工作单交付一件，也不会取得代表同意。

entries.english_definition: A device that grips and holds a part firmly.

contexts.paragraph_english: The repair cabinet contains one tagged clamp set and one fixed reserve connector for this station. Record their tags when collecting them. These are local maintenance items. The reserve connector fits the station's existing backup seat; it is not a tower backup pack, the Glimmer's battery or personal crafting scrap. The clamp is kept for this inspection and may be repositioned while the conveyor remains isolated.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 检修料柜有一套带标签夹具和一个本站固定备用连接头。领取时记录标签。二者均是地方检修物件。连接头适配本站既有备用源座，不是塔站备用包、微光号电池或个人制作零件。夹具留给这次检修，输送器隔离时可以重置位置。

contexts.paragraph_english: Local operator: Before we open the machine-room work zone, show me the upper-floor checks. The isolation handle must still be in the state you inspected. We also need the stopped conveyor record, the fixed external clamp and the dry-route reading. A successful action from an older configuration will not cover a change you made afterwards. We can repeat the affected check without throwing away the clamp or drawing a second unique connector from the cabinet.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 地方检修员：开放机房工作区前，请出示上层检查。隔离手柄必须保持核查时状态，还需要输送器停转记录、固定外部夹具和干燥通路读数。旧配置下的成功动作不能涵盖后来改动。可以重做受影响检查，不必丢掉夹具，也不用从料柜再领唯一连接头。

contexts.paragraph_english: Use the existing hand-operated drain after checking that the conveyor is isolated. The water gauge is read at the upper-floor stand. A drain action and a safe gauge reading are separate records. If the conveyor supply or clamp position changes, repeat the affected safety check before crossing the wet floor. Returning along a route already made safe does not require collecting another clamp.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 确认输送器隔离后，使用既有手动排水装置。积水表须在上层站位读取。排水动作与安全读数分别记录。输送器供电或夹具位置改变后，跨越湿区前应重做受影响检查。沿已安全路线返程，无需再领夹具。

contexts.paragraph_english: The fixed ladder links the lift station and the lower rail landing. Its support brackets and resting platform require a physical check. This inspection uses the installed ladder and the mine's basic safety kit; the optional portable clamp is not needed to reach the mine. Close the gate beside the moving lift while checking, and keep the ladder entry open to returning workers.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 固定梯道连接升降站和下层轨道平台，应现场检查支架及休息台。检查使用已装梯道和矿区基础安全装备，无需可选便携固定钳才能进入。检查时关闭活动升降机旁的门，给返程工人保留梯道入口。

entries.english_definition: A raised or level surface used for work or access.

contexts.paragraph_english: The transport office initially looked for mistakes in the timetable. None were found. The difficulty was that the ten-minute connection had been measured from the arrival of the train at the platform to the departure of the bus from its stop. It did not include the time passengers might need to leave a crowded carriage, reach the footbridge and collect a bicycle or a large bag. What looked like a generous interval on paper was not necessarily a usable interval for everyone.

We need a route, a receiving person and the supplies at the far end. A faster lift would help if its present test is complete. If it is not, use the fixed ladder and the checked rest platform. Please tell the receiving desk that three people are expected; the expectation must stay open until it sees us arrive.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 我们需要通路、接收人和另一端的物资。如果货运升降支路当前测试完成，它能帮忙省力；否则请使用固定梯道和受检休息台。请通知接收台预计有三人，实际见到到达前保留待接收状态。

contexts.paragraph_english: To investigate, staff observed the route between the platform and the bus stop over five evenings. They also invited passengers to describe their journeys. The two sources did not provide identical information. Observation showed where groups slowed down, whereas the written accounts explained why some people needed to stop. A parent reported waiting for a child to use the station facilities; another passenger avoided the footbridge because the lift was unreliable. These were not errors in reading the timetable. They were conditions that the timetable alone did not reveal.

The fixed ladder links the lift station and the lower rail landing. Its support brackets and resting platform require a physical check. This inspection uses the installed ladder and the mine's basic safety kit; the optional portable clamp is not needed to reach the mine. Close the gate beside the moving lift while checking, and keep the ladder entry open to returning workers.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 固定梯道连接升降站和下层轨道平台，应现场检查支架及休息台。检查使用已装梯道和矿区基础安全装备，无需可选便携固定钳才能进入。检查时关闭活动升降机旁的门，给返程工人保留梯道入口。

entries.english_definition: A structure with steps used to climb between levels.

contexts.paragraph_english: Start with a return route that remains usable if electrical power is lost. Check the fixed inspection ladder at the lift station. A working lift may save effort, but the ladder is the basic exit. Then clear the rail route, isolate the damaged pump feed and lower the local water level. No one should be sent through an unchecked wet electrical area just because a message says that help is waiting beyond it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 先建立断电后仍可使用的返程路。到升降站检查固定检修梯。可用升降机能省力，梯道才是基本出口。随后清理轨道，隔离损坏的泵房供电并降低局部水位。不能因前方传来求援消息，就把人送进未经检查的潮湿电气区域。

contexts.paragraph_english: Signal clerk: I first told the surface desk that the freight lift could carry the return group. Please change that note. The lift branch has not been tested from the cutting-face side, so it is not our present exit. The fixed inspection ladder beside the main lift is the route we can check now. It stays available when the power setting changes.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 信号员：我最初向地面台说，货运升降支路能运送返程人员。请更正这条便条。采掘面一侧尚未完成支路测试，所以它目前不是出口。现在可检查主升降机旁的固定梯道；供电设置变化后，这条路仍在。

contexts.paragraph_english: Visitors must receive the mine safety briefing and the available basic kit before entering. The fixed ladder is listed separately from the powered lift. Tell the surface desk which route has been checked, and leave its access clear while any worker remains below.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 访客进入前应取得矿井安全说明与可领取的基础装备。固定梯道与电动升降机分列登记。请向地面台说明实际检查的通路；地下仍有人时保持出口畅通。

contexts.paragraph_english: The fixed ladder links the lift station and the lower rail landing. Its support brackets and resting platform require a physical check. This inspection uses the installed ladder and the mine's basic safety kit; the optional portable clamp is not needed to reach the mine. Close the gate beside the moving lift while checking, and keep the ladder entry open to returning workers.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 固定梯道连接升降站和下层轨道平台，应现场检查支架及休息台。检查使用已装梯道和矿区基础安全装备，无需可选便携固定钳才能进入。检查时关闭活动升降机旁的门，给返程工人保留梯道入口。

entries.english_definition: A narrow vertical passage or rotating machine rod.

contexts.paragraph_english: The formal passage and maintenance shaft meet at the takeover floor. A recognised temporary authorisation can change how you reach it, but it cannot settle the machine's operating condition. If a formal handover is unavailable, inspect the basic maintenance path. Access must not depend on expressing support for a faction, an English grade, or having recruited a particular companion. External travel remains suspended during this intervention.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 正式通道和检修竖井在接管层汇合。获认可的临时授权可改变进入方法，不能裁定机器状态。正式交接暂不可用时，请查基础检修路径。进入不能取决于阵营立场、英语分数或某位同伴是否招募。本次处置期间暂停外区旅行。

contexts.paragraph_english: Visitor: We will register the checkpoint and keep the source references. If the corridor cannot be accepted now, we will check the maintenance shaft rather than insist that a political preference opens the door. That route still requires its own physical checks. Reaching the takeover floor will establish our approach; it will not establish that Rook's command relay is released or that the central loop has stopped.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 访客：我们登记检查点并保留来源索引。走廊暂不接受时，就核验检修竖井，而不要求政治偏好开门。另路仍需实体检查。到接管层只建立接近结果，没有证明鲁克转接已解除或中央循环已停。

contexts.paragraph_english: Route F leads through the duty desk and formal corridor. The desk first checks the intervention's actual authorisation; the corridor stop must then be released at its own terminal. Route M uses the maintenance shaft, its installed handle and a checked return path. A coil sentry still controls the lower approach. Neither route leads straight to the dispatch console.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: F路经值守台与正式走廊，值守先核实际处置授权，走廊阻拦再由本地终端解除。M路经检修竖井、固定手柄与已查返程，下段仍有线圈哨卫。两路均不能直达调度台。

contexts.paragraph_english: The local devices are different objects. A corridor release is not the command relay at the takeover floor. A shaft isolation is not the central machine's restart bypass. Follow the labels and keep the completed result of each operation. Retracing a safe route does not collect another reward or refill the same battle attempt.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 这些是不同实体。走廊放行不是接管层指挥转接，竖井隔离也不是机组续启旁路。请按标牌保存每个操作结果。回走安全路线不会再发奖励，也不会回满同一战斗尝试。

entries.english_definition: An enclosed passage through ground or a structure.

contexts.paragraph_english: People still live behind the names missing from your chart. Twelve years ago subsidence closed the central bridge span; later the district was removed from the current place register. The residents remember the streets and have maintained other passages. Ada can confirm local routes, not the present condition of a person inside a locked detention room. The mission desk supplies one basic inspection kit, one lamp and one safety line for this local work. They are mission equipment, not personal upgrade parts or six-tower supplies. Either current credential checking or the existing service tunnel can reach the duty hall. No named companion is required.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 航图上消失的名字背后仍住着人。十二年前沉降封闭中央桥跨，后来地区被从现行名录移除；住民仍记得道路并维护其他通路。阿妲能确认地方路线，不能证实扣押室内某人的当前状态。当地委托提供一套基础检修工具、一盏灯和一条安全索，均为任务装备，不是个人零件或六塔物资。当前证件核查与既有隧道均可到值守厅，不要求指定同伴。

contexts.paragraph_english: Ada: Start with the street people use now, not the straight line on the old sheet. At the checkpoint you have two choices. The inspected passage avoids the broken span, although both appear to lead north. Have your present commission checked there. Or go through the service tunnel with the basic kit; isolate the drive, secure the panel and inspect the cleared route. Neither choice tells us whether Mara is alive today. I know where the duty hall is and where the residents can receive someone coming back. I will not turn an old movement record into a current medical report. Bring the rescue team to the street when the inner return passage is open.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 阿妲：从大家现在走的街开始，别只看旧纸上的直线。检查点有两种选择：核查通道绕开断桥，须查当次委托；或者用基础工具走隧道，隔离驱动、固定面板、清路检查。两种路线都不能说明玛拉今天是否活着。我知道值守厅位置和住民接应处，不会把旧转移记录当成当前医疗报告。内侧便道打开后，把救援队带回街区。

contexts.paragraph_english: OC-MAP-HIST@1 shows the former central bridge from the checkpoint towards North Station. Its route identity is HIST-CENTRAL-SPAN. That span is closed and has no present navigation port. OC-PASSAGE-CURRENT@1 identifies CHECKPOINT-DUTY-PASSAGE, a different route with similar large-scale endpoints. It remains available after current inspection credentials are checked. TUNNEL-SERVICE-PASSAGE runs from the checkpoint through the existing tunnel to the duty hall once its obstruction and local hazard are dealt with. Drawing either line does not perform the work. Both current routes end at the duty hall, not the detention rooms. Retain the old map as historical evidence rather than deleting its inconvenient line.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: OC-MAP-HIST@1 的 HIST-CENTRAL-SPAN 是昔日中央桥跨，已经关闭，没有现行导航端口。OC-PASSAGE-CURRENT@1 的 CHECKPOINT-DUTY-PASSAGE 与旧桥大尺度端点相近，却是另一条路线，须核验当前检修身份。TUNNEL-SERVICE-PASSAGE 经既有隧道到值守厅，须实际处理阻碍和危险。画线不能代替工作，两条当前路线都不直接进入扣押室。保留旧图作为历史证据，不删除不方便的旧桥线。

contexts.paragraph_english: Use the supplied basic kit and safety line. Isolate the tunnel maintenance drive at its local switch; this switch does not control the city or North Station. Brace the loose service panel before clearing the obstruction. The tunnel hazard can be dealt with by physical isolation, removal of the loose feed and a zero-motion check, or by the registered local encounter followed by the same passage inspection. A brace is still needed after a fight. Verify the dry stepping strip and mark the return line at the exit. No timed reading, rare key or strength threshold is required. The opened service passage remains available for safe return.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 使用已提供的基础工具和安全索。在当地开关隔离隧道维护驱动，它不控制城市或北站；先固定松动面板，再清理阻碍。可通过隔离、移除松动送料件并核验零运动处置危险，也可完成登记遭遇后检查通路；战斗后仍须固定。出口检查干燥踏步带并标返程线。不要求限时阅读、稀有钥匙或力量门槛；打开的检修通道保留安全返程。

entries.english_definition: A passage joining rooms or work areas.

contexts.paragraph_english: The greenhouse corridor is open to visitors. The inspection stair below it remains a work area. A patrol credential identifies your role; the local maintenance request specifies the equipment you may handle. Ask for that scope before entering the stair.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 温室外廊向访客开放，其下方的检修梯仍是工作区域。巡灯凭证说明职业身份；地方检修请求说明允许操作的设备。进入检修梯前请先取得这项范围。

contexts.paragraph_english: Technician: The controller is isolated at the outer switch. Do not take a silent machine as evidence that its reserve socket is connected. We kept the socket plate and guard inspection separate. Please control the debris enclosure, then use the manual reserve procedure or the separate maintenance encounter. I will keep the return corridor clear while you inspect.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 技术员：控制器在外开关隔离。机器安静不证明储备插座已接，我们分别留插座标记和护罩检查。先制止残件，再用备用段手动步骤或独立维护遭遇，我会在检查时保留返程走廊。

contexts.paragraph_english: The greenhouse supplies the priory kitchen and the public wash taps through two small local circuits. Water from the inspection stair has entered the upper transfer floor. Roots have also grown around the stopped conveyor. The public corridor remains usable. The stair may be opened for the locally commissioned inspection once the root-route threat is controlled and the stair boundary has been checked on site.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 温室通过两条小型地方回路供应修院厨房与公共洗水龙头。检修梯的水已流入转供站上层，根系缠住了停转的输送器。公共外廊仍可使用。根道威胁实际处置、检修梯边界现场核对后，地方检修委托可以开放下行。

contexts.paragraph_english: The old hall permit covers the external isolation switch, debris enclosure, reserve service segment and the fixed Controller A test bench. Keep the public return corridor usable. The debris and reserve segment have separate control records; resolving one does not resolve the other. Visitors receive access to the installed local trial fixture. Its parts are not an award of enhanced equipment for the six towers.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 旧厅许可包括外侧隔离开关、残件围护、储备服务段和固定A控制器试验台。应保留公共返程走廊。残件和备用段分别登记处置，完成一项不会完成另一项。访客使用已装的本地试验器材，不等于领取六塔增强设备。

entries.english_definition: A movable barrier controlling an entrance.

contexts.paragraph_english: NORTH-DUTY-D0@1 records a detention-room door kept under station control, a local guard group and an internal evacuation passage whose bolt can be opened from the detention side. Names and medical notes remain outside the public route sheet. The patrol may inspect door status, watch arrangement, return-route status and the source version for the rescue purpose only. Read the signed local restriction, isolate the door drive and clear the duty-hall obstruction. These checks grant a bounded safe approach to the guard work stand. They do not release anyone. The residents have agreed to receive the rescue party at the street reception point; the actual arrival there must still be recorded.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: NORTH-DUTY-D0@1 记载扣押门受北站控制、当地看守组和须内侧开闩的撤离便道。身份及医疗记录不进公开路线纸。救援用途只允许核验门、值守、返程通路及来源版本。读当地限制，隔离门驱动，清值守厅阻碍；这仅让看守操作点可安全到达，不释放任何人。住民同意在街区接应，但仍须实际抵达并登记。

contexts.paragraph_english: Receiver: We have prepared the street shelter, but preparation is not arrival. Do not enter Mara as received while she is still behind the station door. Ada: The inner evacuation passage comes out here. After the bolt and stepping strip have been checked, bring her through that passage. Receiver: I will record the direct handover and her present condition. Keep the older D-1 record dated D-1; today’s contact does not change what that earlier paper meant. Ada: If the guard attempt fails, return to the station work point and try again. The shelter and your documents remain available. There is no need to hurry through the instructions to keep someone alive.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 接应人：街区棚已准备好，但准备不等于到达，她还在扣押门后时不能登记接收。阿妲：内侧撤离便道出口在这里，开闩、核验踏步带后从便道带她回来。接应人：我会记录直接交接及当前状况；D-1 仍是 D-1 的旧记录，今日接触不改变旧纸含义。阿妲：看守尝试失败可回操作点重试，棚和文献保留；不必抢读说明来保命。

contexts.paragraph_english: The North Station guard group consists of one commander and two guards. Controlling them ends the local threat without creating an execution decision. It does not open the cell. Inspect the real detention door, release the mechanical latch with the basic kit and meet Mara directly. Only that contact can establish her present condition. Open the inner evacuation bolt and inspect the existing route to the inhabited street. Escort her over that opened route, then hand her to Ada and the local receiver. Do not drag her back through an uncleared high-risk approach. A failed attempt returns to the station checkpoint; time spent reading does not kill her in the background.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 北站看守组由一名指挥者和两名护卫组成，制服他们只解除当地威胁，不新增处决选择，也不开扣押门。须检查实体门，用基础工具开机械闩并直接见玛拉；只有此接触能核验当前状况。打开内侧撤离闩，检查通往住民街区的既有便道，实际护送后交阿妲与当地接应人。不能拖她反复走未清高危路。失败回北站检查点，阅读耗时不会在后台害死她。

contexts.paragraph_english: Residents have kept roads usable without restoring the city exactly as it appears on the earlier map. Some passages follow old service lines; others turn around buildings whose foundations have become unreliable. A remembered name may still identify the place where a family once lived, while the usable entrance now faces another lane. Local knowledge is valuable because it connects these changes with everyday use. It also has limits. Someone who repairs a street does not necessarily know the condition of a person behind a guarded door at North Station.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 居民维护道路，并未把城市原样复建。有的沿旧检修线，有的绕开地基不稳的楼。旧名仍指认家庭曾住处，能用入口却转到另一巷。地方知识把变化与日常使用连起，很有价值，但修街者不必知道北站看守门后某人的当前状况。

entries.english_definition: A fastening that keeps a door or cover closed.

contexts.paragraph_english: This relay records signals locally even when its outgoing link is unavailable. The independent recorder and the outgoing transmitter are separate parts of the station. Before touching the displaced outgoing lead, switch the local transmitter off and isolate it. Seat the lead, restore the station's own reserve and run a link check. The test confirms this lead and power configuration only. If either changes, repeat it before requesting a boat. A successful link test is not evidence that a distant tower is safe. The postal locker may be opened for the named technician after the shore rescue has been completed. Its contents are correspondence, not a certificate about the sender's present whereabouts. The rear latch can be opened from this room to provide a shorter route back to the rescue shelter.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 中继站外发链路中断时仍可本地记录；独立记录器与外发设备是两个部件。检修移位接线前关闭并隔离本地发送设备，再落座接线，恢复本站储备，做当前配置链路检查。改变接线或电源须重新检查；成功不证明远方塔站安全。救援完成后，具名检修员才可领取邮务柜通信，它不证明寄信人目前所在或状态。后门内闩可从站内打开，缩短返回救援棚的路线。

contexts.paragraph_english: Tess: I will also show you the inner patrol latch. Inspect it from the station and check the two landing stands before registering the return route. That return remains useful after the present hazard is controlled. It is not the same as receiving the ridge cargo later. The four base components will need a manifest, two protected segments and a tower receiving check of their own. I would prefer a report that openly says the cargo has not moved yet to one that combines a safe survey route and an unexecuted delivery in a single cheerful sentence.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 泰丝：还会指出内侧巡检闩，从测站检查并核两个落点，再登记返程。处置后返程有用，却不等于后面的风脊货物收货。四份基础件另需货单、两保护段和塔站接收。我宁可报告明确说货物未走，也不把安全调查路和未执行交付合成一句好听话。

contexts.paragraph_english: The machine room has an inner latch leading back to the residential passage. Open it from this side once the local route is safe. This gives another physical way home. A valid local test, a tower work permit and a current tower inspection remain distinct records, all of which can be reviewed before the chapter's safety report is issued.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 机房内闩通向住区。地方路线安全后，从本侧打开可增加实际返程路线。地方有效试验、塔站工作许可和塔站当前安全检查仍是三份不同记录，均可在签发章节安全报告前复核。

contexts.paragraph_english: The machine's safety record and the experiment's output record have separate owners. Record this route revision before starting the controller. Changing a route later invalidates the current test, and a failed test does not erase the earlier machine control. When the declared observations are saved, open the field's logistics latch from the inside. It adds a return loop to the courtyard while leaving the calibration route usable.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 机械安全与实验输出分别记录。启动前记录通路版本，后来改通路使当前测试失效；失败测试不删除早机械制止。声明观察保存后，从内侧打开后勤门，增加回中庭环路，校准通路仍可用。

entries.english_definition: A fixed bar guiding a vehicle or protecting an edge.

contexts.paragraph_english: At the end of the trial, fewer complaints had been received. The transport office treated this as encouraging rather than decisive. A complaint count depends not only on the number of problems but also on whether passengers know where to report them and believe that reporting is worthwhile. The number of rail passengers had also varied during the trial. The office therefore compared complaints with observed missed connections and passenger numbers. It did not publish the lower complaint count as proof that every user had benefited.

Worker W2: We are together in the marked shelter. W1 can walk with assistance, and W3 is keeping the return packs ready. The rail route was blocked when we came here. We have heard the pump fall quiet, but none of us has inspected its wet controls. Please check the water and the feed before asking us to move.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 工人W2：我们都在标记避护处。W1在帮助下能够行走，W3正整理返程用品。我们到这里时轨道受阻。听见泵停下来，但没人检查过潮湿控制器。请先查水位与线路，再安排我们移动。

contexts.paragraph_english: Start with a return route that remains usable if electrical power is lost. Check the fixed inspection ladder at the lift station. A working lift may save effort, but the ladder is the basic exit. Then clear the rail route, isolate the damaged pump feed and lower the local water level. No one should be sent through an unchecked wet electrical area just because a message says that help is waiting beyond it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 先建立断电后仍可使用的返程路。到升降站检查固定检修梯。可用升降机能省力，梯道才是基本出口。随后清理轨道，隔离损坏的泵房供电并降低局部水位。不能因前方传来求援消息，就把人送进未经检查的潮湿电气区域。

contexts.paragraph_english: The fixed ladder links the lift station and the lower rail landing. Its support brackets and resting platform require a physical check. This inspection uses the installed ladder and the mine's basic safety kit; the optional portable clamp is not needed to reach the mine. Close the gate beside the moving lift while checking, and keep the ladder entry open to returning workers.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 固定梯道连接升降站和下层轨道平台，应现场检查支架及休息台。检查使用已装梯道和矿区基础安全装备，无需可选便携固定钳才能进入。检查时关闭活动升降机旁的门，给返程工人保留梯道入口。

entries.english_definition: A prepared route guiding a rail vehicle.

contexts.paragraph_english: Scrap and an active feeder obstruct the lower track. Check the marked work area from the safe platform before engaging the threat. The rail clearance is a separate work result from the later escort: removing the obstruction does not mean that the waiting workers have travelled through the route. Keep the fixed ladder and its landing accessible throughout both jobs.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 下层轨道有废料和活动送料装置阻挡。处置威胁前，从安全平台检查标记区域。清障与稍后的护送是不同工作结果；清除障碍尚不表示工人已经通过。两项工作期间均保留固定梯道和平台通路。

contexts.paragraph_english: The pump-room inspection passage branches from this track. The bypass label is readable from the maintenance stand, but handling its machinery needs the local assignment. A copy of the gauge sheet placed here retains the gauge's source reference. It does not become a second independent measurement just because it has been moved to this board.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 泵房检修通路从轨道分出。可从维护站位读取旁路标签，操作设备需要本地委托。此板上的仪表页副本保留仪表来源；放到另一块板上，不会成为第二次独立测量。

contexts.paragraph_english: W1, W2 and W3 are waiting at the cutting-face shelter. Locate each person and agree the return arrangement at the work stand. The shelter call describes where help is needed; it does not confirm a surface arrival. The lower-track escort must actually bring the group to the receiving route, and the town desk must receive them before the rescue report can be closed.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: W1、W2、W3在采掘面避护处等候。到工作站位逐一确认，并商定返程。求援呼叫说明哪里需要帮助，没有确认地面到达。下层轨道护送应实际把三人带到接收路线，矿镇台接收后，救援报告才能收束。

entries.english_definition: A mechanism that carries material along a fixed route.

contexts.paragraph_english: The greenhouse supplies the priory kitchen and the public wash taps through two small local circuits. Water from the inspection stair has entered the upper transfer floor. Roots have also grown around the stopped conveyor. The public corridor remains usable. The stair may be opened for the locally commissioned inspection once the root-route threat is controlled and the stair boundary has been checked on site.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 温室通过两条小型地方回路供应修院厨房与公共洗水龙头。检修梯的水已流入转供站上层，根系缠住了停转的输送器。公共外廊仍可使用。根道威胁实际处置、检修梯边界现场核对后，地方检修委托可以开放下行。

contexts.paragraph_english: Local operator: Before we open the machine-room work zone, show me the upper-floor checks. The isolation handle must still be in the state you inspected. We also need the stopped conveyor record, the fixed external clamp and the dry-route reading. A successful action from an older configuration will not cover a change you made afterwards. We can repeat the affected check without throwing away the clamp or drawing a second unique connector from the cabinet.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 地方检修员：开放机房工作区前，请出示上层检查。隔离手柄必须保持核查时状态，还需要输送器停转记录、固定外部夹具和干燥通路读数。旧配置下的成功动作不能涵盖后来改动。可以重做受影响检查，不必丢掉夹具，也不用从料柜再领唯一连接头。

contexts.paragraph_english: The repair cabinet contains one tagged clamp set and one fixed reserve connector for this station. Record their tags when collecting them. These are local maintenance items. The reserve connector fits the station's existing backup seat; it is not a tower backup pack, the Glimmer's battery or personal crafting scrap. The clamp is kept for this inspection and may be repositioned while the conveyor remains isolated.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 检修料柜有一套带标签夹具和一个本站固定备用连接头。领取时记录标签。二者均是地方检修物件。连接头适配本站既有备用源座，不是塔站备用包、微光号电池或个人制作零件。夹具留给这次检修，输送器隔离时可以重置位置。

contexts.paragraph_english: Use the existing hand-operated drain after checking that the conveyor is isolated. The water gauge is read at the upper-floor stand. A drain action and a safe gauge reading are separate records. If the conveyor supply or clamp position changes, repeat the affected safety check before crossing the wet floor. Returning along a route already made safe does not require collecting another clamp.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 确认输送器隔离后，使用既有手动排水装置。积水表须在上层站位读取。排水动作与安全读数分别记录。输送器供电或夹具位置改变后，跨越湿区前应重做受影响检查。沿已安全路线返程，无需再领夹具。

entries.english_definition: A platform or device that raises people or loads.

contexts.paragraph_english: To investigate, staff observed the route between the platform and the bus stop over five evenings. They also invited passengers to describe their journeys. The two sources did not provide identical information. Observation showed where groups slowed down, whereas the written accounts explained why some people needed to stop. A parent reported waiting for a child to use the station facilities; another passenger avoided the footbridge because the lift was unreliable. These were not errors in reading the timetable. They were conditions that the timetable alone did not reveal.

Signal clerk: I first told the surface desk that the freight lift could carry the return group. Please change that note. The lift branch has not been tested from the cutting-face side, so it is not our present exit. The fixed inspection ladder beside the main lift is the route we can check now. It stays available when the power setting changes.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 信号员：我最初向地面台说，货运升降支路能运送返程人员。请更正这条便条。采掘面一侧尚未完成支路测试，所以它目前不是出口。现在可检查主升降机旁的固定梯道；供电设置变化后，这条路仍在。

contexts.paragraph_english: The town tried a more limited change. For six weeks, the first bus after the busiest train waited an additional five minutes. The other services kept their published departure times. Staff placed signs along the walking route and asked the station to check the lift before the evening peak. This trial combined a timetable change with improvements to the connection itself. Consequently, a reduction in missed buses would not, on its own, show which part of the trial had produced the improvement.

The final recommendation retained the extra wait after the busiest train and made responsibility for the lift checks explicit. It also proposed another review during the college term, when travel patterns might differ. Some residents regarded the continued review as unnecessary caution; others welcomed the acknowledgement that a useful arrangement could still need adjustment. The case suggests that a timetable is best understood as a statement of an intended service, rather than a guarantee that every person can make every connection. Assessing that service requires attention to the journey around the scheduled departure as well as to the time printed beside it.

entries.english_definition: A machine that winds a rope to move a load.

contexts.paragraph_english: Two markers are visible from the reef path. The southern marker stands near the broken steps. It identifies the old landing place but does not confirm that the steps remain usable after a surge. The northern reach is beyond the low stone wall. Its approach is narrow, so a rescue boat must wait for a clear signal rather than following the first moving light it sees. The winch line can guide people towards either marker. Choose the receiving direction before loading the line, and repeat the tension check whenever that direction changes. A raised hand lamp may help people find the path; it does not replace the line or repair the steps.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 礁岸可见两个标记。南标记位于破损台阶旁，标出旧接应点，并不保证浪涌后台阶仍能用。北段在矮石墙外，入口狭窄，救援船应等明确接应信号。绞盘索可朝两边接应；承载前须选方向，改向后须重新检查张力。手灯帮助辨路，不替代救援索，也不修复台阶。

contexts.paragraph_english: The shore winch has its own small reserve; it is not supplied by the harbour generator or by a ship battery. Switch its local power off and isolate the drive before seating the displaced cable. Secure the rescue line at the marked anchor, then set the receiving direction. The cable and line may be prepared in either order while the drive is isolated. Restore local power only after both are secure. Run the tension check with no people on the line. A check belongs to that configuration: moving the receiving direction, reseating the cable or changing power cancels its validity. The nearby animals must be kept away from the receiving path before the line carries people. If a check fails, keep people in the protected assembly area and inspect the preparation again; taking time to read this card does not change the number of survivors. The shelter retains a working short-range distress set for the shore receiving team. It can send the registered rescue request before the separate coast-to-harbour relay is restored. Harbour pickup is confirmed through that relay later; a saved draft at the shelter has not yet sent a request.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 岸边绞盘使用自己的储备，和港口发电机、船电池无关。关闭本地电源并隔离驱动后，重新落座移位的钢缆。救援索固定在标记锚点，设置接应方向；隔离状态下，钢缆与索具可按任意先后准备。两者固定后才能恢复本地电源，先空载检查张力。证书只对应当次配置；改方向、缆线或电源均使旧检查失效。承载前须制止接应路径附近的动物威胁。检查失败时人员留在保护集合处，阅读不会减少幸存者。 救援棚有可用的短距求援台，能先向岸上接应队发送已登记求援；海岸至港口的独立中继另行恢复，之后才能确认港口接应。发送台保存稿件还没有发送请求。

entries.english_definition: A heavy device holding a vessel or component in place.

contexts.paragraph_chinese: 岸边绞盘使用自己的储备，和港口发电机、船电池无关。关闭本地电源并隔离驱动后，重新落座移位的钢缆。救援索固定在标记锚点，设置接应方向；隔离状态下，钢缆与索具可按任意先后准备。两者固定后才能恢复本地电源，先空载检查张力。证书只对应当次配置；改方向、缆线或电源均使旧检查失效。承载前须制止接应路径附近的动物威胁。检查失败时人员留在保护集合处，阅读不会减少幸存者。 救援棚有可用的短距求援台，能先向岸上接应队发送已登记求援；海岸至港口的独立中继另行恢复，之后才能确认港口接应。发送台保存稿件还没有发送请求。

contexts.paragraph_english: Inspect the inner patrol latch from the station and check both safe landing stands before registering the return line to the distribution desk. The new connection remains usable after the present hazard is controlled. Opening it does not deliver the later ridge cargo. A safe return anchor is an actual reached place with a current inspection; an icon on the regional map is insufficient.

contexts.paragraph_chinese: 返程是调查的一部分，不是用词带来的奖励。从测站检查内侧门闩，核两端落点，再登记路线。处置后线路可以继续使用，却不交付后面的塔站货物。到达过的锚点与地图图标不同：前者有真实位置、安全站位和可追溯检查。

contexts.paragraph_english: The shaft's ordinary maintenance handle is installed at the marked stand. Inspect its coupling and the return landing, then secure the handle before approaching the lower coil sentry. A folding lever may provide a declared alternate grip; the ordinary handle and careful cooperation remain available. A route reel can mark a checked return anchor, but it does not reveal an unknown passage or make an unsafe floor safe.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 竖井常规手柄固定在标记站位。先查连接与返程落台，再固定手柄，随后接近下段线圈哨卫。折叠撬柄可提供声明的替代握点，普通手柄和协作仍可用。路径绳盘可标已查返程锚点，不能发现未知通道或使危险地面安全。

entries.english_definition: A floor surface on a vessel.

contexts.paragraph_english: Harbour loan and cross-region inspection terms. Once the Tidegate local safety record has been verified, return to the receiving berth to acknowledge the loan of the sealed inspection vessel Glimmer. Its watch officer maintains the basic ship service; accepting a companion invitation is not a condition of using the vessel. The deck, archive cabin and shared maintenance compartment are three spaces of this one ship, not separate ships at each harbour. The loan does not transfer the civil ferry or its installed equipment. The next inspection commission points to the grove receiving records. It does not certify the current whereabouts of the missing mentor. Basic sailing along an opened route does not require a fuel ticket. The vessel still needs its ordinary gradual repairs; the handover does not turn it into a fully upgraded ship.

contexts.paragraph_english: Dispatcher: And the main generator? Someone at the quay thought restarting it would make the repair easier.

Havel, the dispatch officer, may commission inspection and repair of the civil ferry's navigation equipment and the local workshop arrangements needed to obtain its replacement parts. A commission allows local preparation; the ferry remains at the quay until a tested current configuration and an explicitly confirmed departure plan are available. Neither a fee nor a language score is required to request the commission. Crew recruitment, patrol-boat use and access to retained accident records are separate decisions and must not be inferred from this document.

entries.english_definition: A sheltered area where vessels can stay safely.

contexts.paragraph_english: The shore winch has its own small reserve; it is not supplied by the harbour generator or by a ship battery. Switch its local power off and isolate the drive before seating the displaced cable. Secure the rescue line at the marked anchor, then set the receiving direction. A check belongs to that configuration: moving the receiving direction, reseating the cable or changing power cancels its validity. The nearby animals must be kept away from the receiving path before the line carries people. If a check fails, keep people in the protected assembly area and inspect the preparation again; taking time to read this card does not change the number of survivors. Do not use that as a load test. The emergency cabinet beside the port wall contains a hand tool and a short rescue line; both belong to this vessel's rescue kit. A loose gangboard is stored along the intact side of the cabin. Secure it across the damaged section, keeping its ends on sound supports, before directing anybody towards the shore exit. The reef path begins beyond that exit. This note describes the cabin passage, not the safety of the landing place outside. Check the shore notice before choosing an approach for the rescue boat.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 船舱中央地板已经开裂。有人一度踩过去，不能证明受损板材可承重。左舷救援柜存有手工具和一根救援索，均属于本船救援包。沿完好的侧壁放着一块踏板。先把踏板两端固定在可靠支承上，再安排人员走向岸边出口。出口外才是礁岸路径；本说明不能证明岸上接应点安全，需要另查岸边告示。

contexts.paragraph_english: Bridge observation copy — times use the same ship clock. 21:14:10: the tower light disappeared from view while the heading indicator still showed the assigned course. 21:16:00: the helmsman reported a course deviation. 21:17:40: contact with the reef was felt. The entries describe what the crew observed; they do not identify a switch operator or establish the reason for the loss of light. The ship clock has not yet been compared with a shore instrument. Preserve this copy and compare it with an independent record when the rescue work allows it.

contexts.paragraph_english: This relay records signals locally even when its outgoing link is unavailable. The independent recorder and the outgoing transmitter are separate parts of the station. Before touching the displaced outgoing lead, switch the local transmitter off and isolate it. Seat the lead, restore the station's own reserve and run a link check. The test confirms this lead and power configuration only. If either changes, repeat it before requesting a boat. A successful link test is not evidence that a distant tower is safe. The postal locker may be opened for the named technician after the shore rescue has been completed. Its contents are correspondence, not a certificate about the sender's present whereabouts. The rear latch can be opened from this room to provide a shorter route back to the rescue shelter.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 中继站外发链路中断时仍可本地记录；独立记录器与外发设备是两个部件。检修移位接线前关闭并隔离本地发送设备，再落座接线，恢复本站储备，做当前配置链路检查。改变接线或电源须重新检查；成功不证明远方塔站安全。救援完成后，具名检修员才可领取邮务柜通信，它不证明寄信人目前所在或状态。后门内闩可从站内打开，缩短返回救援棚的路线。

contexts.paragraph_english: Coast team to the stranded crew. We first marked the south steps as a possible receiving point. That instruction is withdrawn: a fresh inspection found the lower steps separated from their support. Use the northern reach beyond the low wall instead. There are four survivors waiting for assistance, apart from the technician carrying this message. Keep the rescue line clear of the broken steps. Once everyone is under shelter, send your position, the number of people needing collection and the approach restriction. Do not ask the boat to follow the southern marker merely because it is easier to see. We will acknowledge the request through the coast relay.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 海岸队更正原先南台阶方案：现场复查发现下段台阶脱离支承，撤回旧指示。改用矮墙外的北段。有四名幸存者需要接应，不含传递消息的检修员。索具避开破损台阶。人员进入棚内后，发送位置、接应人数和进路限制，接应船不会因南标记显眼就改走那里。通过海岸中继确认求援。

contexts.paragraph_english: Coast recorder extract. Instrument clock: 21:14:12, light signal lost at the observed tower channel. Further gaps occur in the same recording window, but the extract does not contain a complete network diagnosis. The shore clock and ship clock differ by approximately two seconds in their last routine comparison. Taken with the ship observation copy, this extract supports the order of light loss followed by course deviation. It does not name the person responsible, explain why every gap occurred or establish that the outage was deliberate. Keep the original time labels attached when making a later comparison.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 海岸记录器摘录：仪器钟21:14:12，所观测塔台信号消失；同一窗口还有其他缺口，摘录并非完整网络诊断。最近一次常规比对中，岸钟与船钟相差约两秒。结合船上抄记，资料支持先熄灯后偏航，不识别责任人，不解释每个缺口，也不证明故意断供。后续比对保留原始时间标签。

contexts.paragraph_chinese: 有限检修例外：调度负责人哈文可委托民用渡轮导航设备检修及为取替换件所需的本地工坊操作。申请写明协助撤离及这些范围。主发电机安全隔离尚未确认，操作它不在例外内。委托只允许准备；当前配置测试与明确离港方案确认完成前，渡轮留港。申请不需费用或英语分数；招募、巡灯船及事故记录调阅均另行授权。

entries.english_definition: A relatively small vessel for travelling on water.

contexts.paragraph_english: The centre of the cabin floor is cracked. A person may appear to cross it successfully while the damaged boards continue to move underneath. Do not use that as a load test. The emergency cabinet beside the port wall contains a hand tool and a short rescue line; both belong to this vessel's rescue kit. A loose gangboard is stored along the intact side of the cabin. Secure it across the damaged section, keeping its ends on sound supports, before directing anybody towards the shore exit. The reef path begins beyond that exit. This note describes the cabin passage, not the safety of the landing place outside. Check the shore notice before choosing an approach for the rescue boat.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 船舱中央地板已经开裂。有人一度踩过去，不能证明受损板材可承重。左舷救援柜存有手工具和一根救援索，均属于本船救援包。沿完好的侧壁放着一块踏板。先把踏板两端固定在可靠支承上，再安排人员走向岸边出口。出口外才是礁岸路径；本说明不能证明岸上接应点安全，需要另查岸边告示。

contexts.paragraph_english: Coast team to the stranded crew. We first marked the south steps as a possible receiving point. That instruction is withdrawn: a fresh inspection found the lower steps separated from their support. Use the northern reach beyond the low wall instead. There are four survivors waiting for assistance, apart from the technician carrying this message. Keep the rescue line clear of the broken steps. Once everyone is under shelter, send your position, the number of people needing collection and the approach restriction. Do not ask the boat to follow the southern marker merely because it is easier to see. We will acknowledge the request through the coast relay.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 海岸队更正原先南台阶方案：现场复查发现下段台阶脱离支承，撤回旧指示。改用矮墙外的北段。有四名幸存者需要接应，不含传递消息的检修员。索具避开破损台阶。人员进入棚内后，发送位置、接应人数和进路限制，接应船不会因南标记显眼就改走那里。通过海岸中继确认求援。

contexts.paragraph_english: Two markers are visible from the reef path. The southern marker stands near the broken steps. It identifies the old landing place but does not confirm that the steps remain usable after a surge. The northern reach is beyond the low stone wall. Its approach is narrow, so a rescue boat must wait for a clear signal rather than following the first moving light it sees. The winch line can guide people towards either marker. Choose the receiving direction before loading the line, and repeat the tension check whenever that direction changes. A raised hand lamp may help people find the path; it does not replace the line or repair the steps.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 礁岸可见两个标记。南标记位于破损台阶旁，标出旧接应点，并不保证浪涌后台阶仍能用。北段在矮石墙外，入口狭窄，救援船应等明确接应信号。绞盘索可朝两边接应；承载前须选方向，改向后须重新检查张力。手灯帮助辨路，不替代救援索，也不修复台阶。

contexts.paragraph_english: This relay records signals locally even when its outgoing link is unavailable. The independent recorder and the outgoing transmitter are separate parts of the station. Before touching the displaced outgoing lead, switch the local transmitter off and isolate it. Seat the lead, restore the station's own reserve and run a link check. The test confirms this lead and power configuration only. If either changes, repeat it before requesting a boat. A successful link test is not evidence that a distant tower is safe. The postal locker may be opened for the named technician after the shore rescue has been completed. Its contents are correspondence, not a certificate about the sender's present whereabouts. The rear latch can be opened from this room to provide a shorter route back to the rescue shelter.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 中继站外发链路中断时仍可本地记录；独立记录器与外发设备是两个部件。检修移位接线前关闭并隔离本地发送设备，再落座接线，恢复本站储备，做当前配置链路检查。改变接线或电源须重新检查；成功不证明远方塔站安全。救援完成后，具名检修员才可领取邮务柜通信，它不证明寄信人目前所在或状态。后门内闩可从站内打开，缩短返回救援棚的路线。

entries.english_definition: A large vessel used on water.

contexts.paragraph_english: Bridge observation copy — times use the same ship clock. 21:14:10: the tower light disappeared from view while the heading indicator still showed the assigned course. 21:16:00: the helmsman reported a course deviation. 21:17:40: contact with the reef was felt. The entries describe what the crew observed; they do not identify a switch operator or establish the reason for the loss of light. The ship clock has not yet been compared with a shore instrument. Preserve this copy and compare it with an independent record when the rescue work allows it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 桥台抄记使用同一船钟。21:14:10，塔灯消失，当时航向指示仍显示规定航向。21:16:00，舵手报告偏航。21:17:40，船体触礁。记录只说明船员观察到的先后，不识别开关操作者，也不证明熄灯原因。船钟尚未与岸上仪器核对；先保留副本，完成救援后再找独立记录。

contexts.paragraph_english: The shore winch has its own small reserve; it is not supplied by the harbour generator or by a ship battery. Switch its local power off and isolate the drive before seating the displaced cable. Secure the rescue line at the marked anchor, then set the receiving direction. The cable and line may be prepared in either order while the drive is isolated. Restore local power only after both are secure. Run the tension check with no people on the line. A check belongs to that configuration: moving the receiving direction, reseating the cable or changing power cancels its validity. The nearby animals must be kept away from the receiving path before the line carries people. If a check fails, keep people in the protected assembly area and inspect the preparation again; taking time to read this card does not change the number of survivors. The shelter retains a working short-range distress set for the shore receiving team. It can send the registered rescue request before the separate coast-to-harbour relay is restored. Harbour pickup is confirmed through that relay later; a saved draft at the shelter has not yet sent a request.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 岸边绞盘使用自己的储备，和港口发电机、船电池无关。关闭本地电源并隔离驱动后，重新落座移位的钢缆。救援索固定在标记锚点，设置接应方向；隔离状态下，钢缆与索具可按任意先后准备。两者固定后才能恢复本地电源，先空载检查张力。证书只对应当次配置；改方向、缆线或电源均使旧检查失效。承载前须制止接应路径附近的动物威胁。检查失败时人员留在保护集合处，阅读不会减少幸存者。 救援棚有可用的短距求援台，能先向岸上接应队发送已登记求援；海岸至港口的独立中继另行恢复，之后才能确认港口接应。发送台保存稿件还没有发送请求。

contexts.paragraph_english: Coast recorder extract. Instrument clock: 21:14:12, light signal lost at the observed tower channel. Further gaps occur in the same recording window, but the extract does not contain a complete network diagnosis. The shore clock and ship clock differ by approximately two seconds in their last routine comparison. Taken with the ship observation copy, this extract supports the order of light loss followed by course deviation. It does not name the person responsible, explain why every gap occurred or establish that the outage was deliberate. Keep the original time labels attached when making a later comparison.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 海岸记录器摘录：仪器钟21:14:12，所观测塔台信号消失；同一窗口还有其他缺口，摘录并非完整网络诊断。最近一次常规比对中，岸钟与船钟相差约两秒。结合船上抄记，资料支持先熄灯后偏航，不识别责任人，不解释每个缺口，也不证明故意断供。后续比对保留原始时间标签。

contexts.paragraph_english: Evening duty handover, retained copy. At 21:05 on D0, a later work instruction removed the second traffic check from this test. The receiving operator recorded the change rather than marking the check as completed. A routine comparison at 20:40 placed the control clock within one second of the ship clock. The local control event copy lists the output interruption at 21:14:10, on the control clock. The instruction identifier and its issuing office are retained for further examination. This copy is not sufficient to establish what every officer knew or intended. The output event and the removed check should be recorded as separate findings: one concerns what the equipment did, the other concerns which protection was omitted. The independent coast clock was not set from this control clock.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: D0 21:05的后续工作指令移除了第二次人船复核，接班者没有把它标作已做。控制钟记录21:14:10断供；签发标识保留待后续核验，不能据此判定所有人员的知情与意图。 20:40常规比对记控制钟与船钟相差不超过一秒。

entries.english_definition: Travel from one place to another.

contexts.paragraph_english: To the new technician, from Mara. If a record is marked for destruction, first ask who issued the instruction, which version it concerns and what other record can be used to check it. A tidy report may leave out the circumstances that made its conclusion seem convincing. I have enclosed a request to compare the public maintenance record with an independent source. Deal with immediate rescue work before following it. This letter was placed in the inspection post before your journey; it cannot tell you where I am when you read it. Do not treat my concerns as proof. Preserve what you actually find, including anything that does not support the explanation you expected.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 玛拉给新检修员的留言：遇到要求销毁的记录，先核对指令签发者、所指版本和可独立核验的来源。整齐报告可能省略形成结论的条件。附上公共检修记录比对请求，但眼前救援优先。信件在旅程前寄存，不能说明阅读时玛拉所在。疑虑不是证明，应保留实际找到的资料，包括不支持预期解释的部分。

contexts.paragraph_english: All departures remain subject to the current navigation restrictions. Route A is closed until further notice. A previous journey through that channel is not evidence that it is safe to use today, and an older chart should not be treated as permission to enter it.

When the town of Alder introduced a new evening bus service, the announcement promised a better connection between its railway station and three residential districts. The published timetable showed a bus leaving ten minutes after each of the main evening trains. For passengers who had previously faced a long walk or an expensive taxi journey, the arrangement appeared straightforward. Yet during the first month, complaints arrived from people who had missed their connection even though their train had reached the station on time.

One proposal was simply to delay every bus by another ten minutes. Several passengers supported it, but the bus operators raised a practical concern. The same vehicles continued beyond the three districts to serve a small college. A later departure from the station could make those passengers late for the final class of the evening. Changing one connection could improve a journey for one group while making another journey less reliable. The question was therefore not whether additional waiting time was useful, but where and under what conditions it should be introduced.

entries.english_definition: A journey made by water.

contexts.paragraph_english: Bring the sealed MC-2 sample and the mine's actual handover receipt to this desk. We will check the seal, batch, source versions and receiving purpose before registering custody. The sample has travelled; a voyage record does not establish its contents or a technical result. The original mine sheets remain with their custodians. Their references accompany the sample, and a copy retains its original source root.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 请把密封MC-2样本和矿区实际移交回执带到此台。登记保管前，核对封签、批次、来源版本和接收用途。样本已运来，航行记录却不证明样本内容或技术结论。矿区原件留在原保管处，索引随样本交接，副本保留原来源根。

contexts.paragraph_english: Freight clerk: Bring the sample to the actual packing stand, with the observation stage and the three document versions. I can acknowledge the authorised outgoing package and keep its custody reference. I cannot acknowledge a sample which has only been named in a draft. The academic receiving desk will still need to inspect what reaches it, and the voyage requires its own vessel and route checks.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 货运员：请带样本到真实包装站位，附观察阶段与三份文书版本。我能确认获准发出包，保留保管索引，不能确认仅写在稿中的样本。学城接收台仍要查实际收到什么，航行也另需船只与航路检查。

contexts.paragraph_english: The current chart labels this entire district as abandoned. The ferry crew uses that administrative label to identify the landing, not to certify that nobody lives here. Register the return berth and meet Ada Kane in the inhabited street before working at North Station. Your Glasshaven commission permits verification of the station location and lawful access. It does not authorise searching homes, opening every archive or deciding who should govern the city. Present the same vessel and current regional commission at the landing desk. A new district name on a screen is not evidence that a voyage occurred.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 现行航图把整片地区标为废弃区；船员用它辨认渡口，不是证明这里无人居住。登记返程泊位，先在住民街区见阿妲。学城委托只允许核验北站位置与合法入口，不授权搜住宅、开全部档案或决定城市治理。登记须使用同一真实船与当前跨区委托；屏幕换地区名不等于航行。

contexts.paragraph_english: Custodian: Once these local conditions are met, send the transfer demand through the executive channel and preserve its actual answer. contexts.paragraph_chinese: 保管人：满足当地条件后，实际向执行渠道发移交要求并保回覆；讨论可能拒绝不证明已发生。若拒交并转第七塔，共同授权让巡灯人去边境核当前风险准备。这是行程许可及有限委托，不是中央运行、断联、分布式最终决定。渡船仍须真航行，不因定目的地便记已到。

contexts.paragraph_english: Dispatcher: So the earlier report needs to be corrected, but we are not yet issuing a departure instruction.
