A later departure instruction must be checked against the route notices and the vessel's current configuration. The public consultation desk remains accessible during the closure; restricted records and equipment require their own authorisation.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 现行封港令：一般出港暂停，公共泊位仍接收救援入港；允许入港不等于允许出港。调度室可为明确安全撤离工作签发有限地方检修委托，写明作业范围和供电边界。委托本身不开放航道、不认可未经测试导航灯、不移交船产权。出港另需按航道资料及船舶当前配置核对。公共咨询区开放，受限记录与设备需各自授权。

contexts.paragraph_english: Limited maintenance exception. Havel, the dispatch officer, may commission inspection and repair of the civil ferry's navigation equipment and the local workshop arrangements needed to obtain its replacement parts. State that the purpose is evacuation assistance and identify those work areas in the request. Harbour main-generator operation is outside this exception: its safety isolation has not been confirmed. A commission allows local preparation; the ferry remains at the quay until a tested current configuration and an explicitly confirmed departure plan are available. Neither a fee nor a language score is required to request the commission. Crew recruitment, patrol-boat use and access to retained accident records are separate decisions and must not be inferred from this document.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 有限检修例外：调度负责人哈文可委托民用渡轮导航设备检修及为取替换件所需的本地工坊操作。申请写明协助撤离及这些范围。主发电机安全隔离尚未确认，操作它不在例外内。委托只允许准备；当前配置测试与明确离港方案确认完成前，渡轮留港。申请不需费用或英语分数；招募、巡灯船及事故记录调阅均另行授权。

entries.english_definition: A map or organised display used to understand an area or pattern.

contexts.paragraph_english: All departures remain subject to the current navigation restrictions. Route A is closed until further notice. A previous journey through that channel is not evidence that it is safe to use today, and an older chart should not be treated as permission to enter it.

Tess: Current moving cargo must arrive or be safely deposited. Accepted attendance promises need a real handover or explicit suspension. Preserve the protected checkpoint, seal the actual supplies and walk to the same Glimmer chart. Our final policy remains unselected, and the seventh tower still has dangerous work ahead.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 泰丝：现移动货须到或安全托管，到场承诺要交接或暂缓。留保护档、封实供、走同一微光海图。最终政策未选，第七塔危险工作仍在前方。

contexts.paragraph_english: The current chart labels this entire district as abandoned. The ferry crew uses that administrative label to identify the landing, not to certify that nobody lives here. Register the return berth and meet Ada Kane in the inhabited street before working at North Station. Your Glasshaven commission permits verification of the station location and lawful access. It does not authorise searching homes, opening every archive or deciding who should govern the city. Present the same vessel and current regional commission at the landing desk. A new district name on a screen is not evidence that a voyage occurred.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 现行航图把整片地区标为废弃区；船员用它辨认渡口，不是证明这里无人居住。登记返程泊位，先在住民街区见阿妲。学城委托只允许核验北站位置与合法入口，不授权搜住宅、开全部档案或决定城市治理。登记须使用同一真实船与当前跨区委托；屏幕换地区名不等于航行。

contexts.paragraph_english: People still live behind the names missing from your chart. Twelve years ago subsidence closed the central bridge span; later the district was removed from the current place register. The residents remember the streets and have maintained other passages. Ada can confirm local routes, not the present condition of a person inside a locked detention room. The mission desk supplies one basic inspection kit, one lamp and one safety line for this local work. They are mission equipment, not personal upgrade parts or six-tower supplies. Either current credential checking or the existing service tunnel can reach the duty hall. No named companion is required.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 航图上消失的名字背后仍住着人。十二年前沉降封闭中央桥跨，后来地区被从现行名录移除；住民仍记得道路并维护其他通路。阿妲能确认地方路线，不能证实扣押室内某人的当前状态。当地委托提供一套基础检修工具、一盏灯和一条安全索，均为任务装备，不是个人零件或六塔物资。当前证件核查与既有隧道均可到值守厅，不要求指定同伴。

entries.english_definition: A representation of places and their positions.

contexts.paragraph_english: OC-MAP-HIST@1 shows the former central bridge from the checkpoint towards North Station. Its route identity is HIST-CENTRAL-SPAN. That span is closed and has no present navigation port. OC-PASSAGE-CURRENT@1 identifies CHECKPOINT-DUTY-PASSAGE, a different route with similar large-scale endpoints. It remains available after current inspection credentials are checked. TUNNEL-SERVICE-PASSAGE runs from the checkpoint through the existing tunnel to the duty hall once its obstruction and local hazard are dealt with. Drawing either line does not perform the work. Both current routes end at the duty hall, not the detention rooms. Retain the old map as historical evidence rather than deleting its inconvenient line.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: OC-MAP-HIST@1 的 HIST-CENTRAL-SPAN 是昔日中央桥跨，已经关闭，没有现行导航端口。OC-PASSAGE-CURRENT@1 的 CHECKPOINT-DUTY-PASSAGE 与旧桥大尺度端点相近，却是另一条路线，须核验当前检修身份。TUNNEL-SERVICE-PASSAGE 经既有隧道到值守厅，须实际处理阻碍和危险。画线不能代替工作，两条当前路线都不直接进入扣押室。保留旧图作为历史证据，不删除不方便的旧桥线。

contexts.paragraph_english: Ada: And the map? Custodian: The historical sheet stays historical. Ada: Good. Let it show what used to be here without telling a visitor to walk across a broken span. Let the present sign show that people still live here without promising the street can never change. That is the kind of record we need from this hearing too: a dated account that can be checked, challenged and corrected. It will not make everyone agree about the future, but it can stop the future from being decided by documents nobody else is allowed to see.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 阿妲：地图呢？保管人：旧纸仍作历史。阿妲：好，让它记过去，却不叫访客走断桥；现牌显示还有人，不保证街永不变化。审查记录亦需有日期、可核验反驳纠正；不会让大家未来意见一致，却可阻止未来被无人可看的文书决定。

contexts.paragraph_english: Residents have kept roads usable without restoring the city exactly as it appears on the earlier map. Some passages follow old service lines; others turn around buildings whose foundations have become unreliable. A remembered name may still identify the place where a family once lived, while the usable entrance now faces another lane. Local knowledge is valuable because it connects these changes with everyday use. It also has limits. Someone who repairs a street does not necessarily know the condition of a person behind a guarded door at North Station.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 居民维护道路，并未把城市原样复建。有的沿旧检修线，有的绕开地基不稳的楼。旧名仍指认家庭曾住处，能用入口却转到另一巷。地方知识把变化与日常使用连起，很有价值，但修街者不必知道北站看守门后某人的当前状况。

contexts.paragraph_english: A map also needs to state where its authority stops. Reaching the station duty hall establishes a route to a public-facing work area. It does not open the detention rooms or show that a rescue has occurred. Confusing these stages makes a plan seem more complete than it is and can hide the people responsible for the next decision. The same error appears when a prepared shelter is entered as a successful arrival. Facilities, permissions and actual movements each have their own evidence. They should support one another without being allowed to stand in for one another.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 地图也须写权威止境。到值守厅只建立通往工作区路线，不开扣押室，也不证明救援。混淆阶段让计划显得完整，遮住下一决定责任者。把备好接应棚记成成功抵达也是同错。设施、许可、实际移动各有证据，彼此支持却不可替代。

entries.english_definition: The direction in which a vessel is pointing or travelling.

contexts.paragraph_english: Bridge observation copy — times use the same ship clock. 21:14:10: the tower light disappeared from view while the heading indicator still showed the assigned course. 21:16:00: the helmsman reported a course deviation. 21:17:40: contact with the reef was felt. The entries describe what the crew observed; they do not identify a switch operator or establish the reason for the loss of light. The ship clock has not yet been compared with a shore instrument. Preserve this copy and compare it with an independent record when the rescue work allows it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 桥台抄记使用同一船钟。21:14:10，塔灯消失，当时航向指示仍显示规定航向。21:16:00，舵手报告偏航。21:17:40，船体触礁。记录只说明船员观察到的先后，不识别开关操作者，也不证明熄灯原因。船钟尚未与岸上仪器核对；先保留副本，完成救援后再找独立记录。

contexts.paragraph_english: Draft contingency notice, prepared on D0 at 20:50. This copy was stored with the evening dispatch papers; its issue box is blank. The text describes a possible interruption of the harbour light and tells receiving crews to wait for a revised route message. A handwritten heading calls it an accident notice, but the heading does not identify a cause. Preparing a notice in advance may indicate planning for a risk. It does not, by itself, show that somebody intended a grounding. Preserve the draft label and the empty issue box when citing this document. The approval and execution records are held separately. Do not replace them with a conclusion drawn from the title.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: D0 20:50准备、尚未签发的应急通知。事故字样不说明原因，预先准备通知不能单独证明故意搁浅；引用时保留草稿标签及空白签发栏，另查批准与执行记录。

entries.english_definition: The atmospheric conditions at a particular time.

contexts.paragraph_english: Extraction and disturbance rose together in this short record. Pump operation, nearby machines and sampling conditions also need checking. The sheet provides a traceable question for the academic review: which factors can explain the pattern, and under what conditions could it be reproduced? It cannot by itself show that mining created the mist, that every district has the same response, or that a shutdown will clear the weather immediately.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 这份短记录里，抽取与扰动同时上升。泵房运作、附近机械和采样条件也需核查。资料为学城提出可追查问题：哪些因素能够解释此模式，怎样的条件下可以复现？仅凭它尚不能说明开采创造了雾海、每个地区反应相同，或停机会立即放晴。

contexts.paragraph_english: A current overload can amplify the network's difficulty in keeping essential circuits stable. This is a useful risk statement, but it has a limited object. The survey does not establish that the towers created every fog bank, nor does it predict the hour of a storm. Conditions beyond the tested local apparatus remain open to further investigation. The notice should name that boundary plainly, so a receiving crew can act on the observed danger without mistaking the notice for a complete explanation of the region's weather or the entire network's history.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 当前过载可能放大全网保持基本回路稳定的困难。这是有用但有限的风险判断，不能证明灯塔制造每片雾，也不预测风暴钟点。受检装置以外的条件仍待查。通知应明确边界，让接收班处理观察到的危险，而不会把它当作天气或网络历史的完整解释。

entries.english_definition: A period of severe wind and other dangerous weather.

contexts.paragraph_english: The survey instrument has a labelled zero channel Z and reference channel R. Check Z at 0 and R at 10 after isolating the local drive; these are instrument marks, not the load units used in other districts. Control the station defence, then verify the readings at the present revision. A reconnection or configuration change expires the check. The report concerns current overload risk and bounded essential supply in this survey window. It does not predict an exact storm hour or prove that all fog was created by the towers.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 测站仪表有零点Z通道和参考R通道。隔离本地驱动后，核对Z为0、R为10；这些是仪表标记，不与其他地区负荷单位通兑。处置测站防卫后按当前版本核验读数。连接或配置变动会使旧检查过期。报告说明本窗口的过载风险和受限基本供给，不预测准确风暴钟点，也不证明所有雾来自灯塔。

contexts.paragraph_english: Tess: The apparatus uses Z for the zero channel and R for the reference channel. Isolate the local drive, check zero at Z and ten at R, and retain the configuration revision. Those are the apparatus marks, not storm hours and not a shared currency for every district's load figures. If someone reconnects the drive, the earlier check becomes an earlier check. It stays in the archive, but we inspect the present condition again. This is how the next watch distinguishes a retained observation from a current permission to use the instrument.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 泰丝：装置Z是零点，R是参考。隔离驱动，核Z零与R十，保留配置版本。这是装置刻度，不是风暴钟点，也不是各地负荷的共同货币。重接后旧检查成为历史，档案还在，但要重检当前情况，让接班人区分旧观察与现行许可。

contexts.paragraph_english: A current overload can amplify the network's difficulty in keeping essential circuits stable. This is a useful risk statement, but it has a limited object. The survey does not establish that the towers created every fog bank, nor does it predict the hour of a storm. Conditions beyond the tested local apparatus remain open to further investigation. The notice should name that boundary plainly, so a receiving crew can act on the observed danger without mistaking the notice for a complete explanation of the region's weather or the entire network's history.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 当前过载可能放大全网保持基本回路稳定的困难。这是有用但有限的风险判断，不能证明灯塔制造每片雾，也不预测风暴钟点。受检装置以外的条件仍待查。通知应明确边界，让接收班处理观察到的危险，而不会把它当作天气或网络历史的完整解释。

entries.english_definition: Moving air that can affect travel or structures.

contexts.paragraph_english: Optional supplement PZ-Q603-LOAD has two trips of six spaces each. The whole boxes are tools3, fittings1, lighting4, wind_panels2 and archives2. Tools and fittings must arrive in a trip earlier than lighting; the panels and archives have no fixed order. Both qualified arrangements are accepted. This independent supplement is optional, earns no second parent reward and supplies neither protected base components nor enhanced transition crates. Declining it preserves the base route.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 可选PZ-Q603-LOAD共有两趟，每趟六格。整箱体积为tools三、fittings一、lighting四、wind_panels二、archives二。工具和安装件须在早于照明的一趟到达；面板与档案顺序不限。两种合格安排均接受。补充运输独立且可选，不重复发父任务奖励，不供基础组件或增强过渡箱，拒绝后基础路径仍完整。

entries.english_definition: The liquid being moved, supplied, or crossed.

contexts.paragraph_english: Route B may be used only while the auxiliary pump is running and only by vessels with a draught of no more than 1.2 metres. Both conditions apply. The pump controls water in the dock facilities; it does not alter the draught limit printed in this notice.

Worker W2: We are together in the marked shelter. W1 can walk with assistance, and W3 is keeping the return packs ready. The rail route was blocked when we came here. We have heard the pump fall quiet, but none of us has inspected its wet controls. Please check the water and the feed before asking us to move.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 工人W2：我们都在标记避护处。W1在帮助下能够行走，W3正整理返程用品。我们到这里时轨道受阻。听见泵停下来，但没人检查过潮湿控制器。请先查水位与线路，再安排我们移动。

contexts.paragraph_english: The greenhouse supplies the priory kitchen and the public wash taps through two small local circuits. Water from the inspection stair has entered the upper transfer floor. Roots have also grown around the stopped conveyor. The public corridor remains usable. The stair may be opened for the locally commissioned inspection once the root-route threat is controlled and the stair boundary has been checked on site.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 温室通过两条小型地方回路供应修院厨房与公共洗水龙头。检修梯的水已流入转供站上层，根系缠住了停转的输送器。公共外廊仍可使用。根道威胁实际处置、检修梯边界现场核对后，地方检修委托可以开放下行。

contexts.paragraph_english: Use the existing hand-operated drain after checking that the conveyor is isolated. The water gauge is read at the upper-floor stand. A drain action and a safe gauge reading are separate records. If the conveyor supply or clamp position changes, repeat the affected safety check before crossing the wet floor. Returning along a route already made safe does not require collecting another clamp.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 确认输送器隔离后，使用既有手动排水装置。积水表须在上层站位读取。排水动作与安全读数分别记录。输送器供电或夹具位置改变后，跨越湿区前应重做受影响检查。沿已安全路线返程，无需再领夹具。

entries.english_definition: The removal of water from an area.

contexts.paragraph_english: Pera's assignment covers the public mine route, the damaged drainage equipment, the three workers awaiting rescue and the checks needed to bring them back safely. The workers are identified on the work board as W1, W2 and W3. These are local rescue codes, not permission to publish their addresses or medical details. Record who has actually reached the receiving point.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 佩拉的委托包括矿井公共通路、受损排水设备、三名待救工人与安全返程检查。工作板以W1、W2、W3标记三人。这些是救援代号，公开住址或病情另需范围。应记录谁实际到了接收点。

contexts.paragraph_english: Pera: The receiving desk has confirmed the three workers and the basic provisions. We can now discuss the extra six packages. I want the discussion to start from what is in the store, rather than what we hope a later shipment may bring. The basic services use seven of the ten load units: drainage two, ventilation two, warm room two and signals one. Keep that line separate. Reducing extraction must leave those services and the inspected ladder available. We are choosing an extra arrangement, not reopening the question of whether rescued people receive first aid.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 佩拉：接收台已确认三名工人与基本物资，现在可以谈六个额外工包。请从实际库存开始，不从希望后来有的船货开始。基本服务占十单位中的七：排水二、通风二、暖房二、信号一。这一行独立保留。减抽取须保留这些服务和受检梯道；现在选择额外安排，不重新争论被救者能否领急救用品。

contexts.paragraph_english: The damaged feed supplies the pump-room drive. Identify that feed at the labelled isolation point and separate it from the wet work area. The isolation is local: it does not switch off the town's whole supply or the port generator. Deal with the threat at the pump entrance from the marked safe stand. A cleared entrance and an isolated feed are both required before the drainage controls may be handled.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 损坏线路给泵房驱动供电。应在标记隔离点确认这条线路，将它与潮湿作业区分离。该隔离只针对本地，不关闭整个矿镇供电或港口发电机。从安全站位处置泵房入口威胁；入口安全且线路隔离后才能操作排水控制。

contexts.paragraph_english: When drainage and the present safety check are complete, the route to the cutting face can open. Retreat through the checked rail-and-ladder path if a new fault is found. A failed attempt leaves the people already received in the town safe and preserves any unrelated repair; it does not refill the pump room so that the same rescue can pay again.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 排水与当前安全复查完成后，可开放前往采掘面的通路。发现新故障时，沿已检查轨道和梯道退回。尝试失败不会危及已接到矿镇的人，也不撤去无关修复，更不会重新注满泵房来重复领取救援奖励。

entries.english_definition: The force exerted over an area.

contexts.paragraph_english: Oren: I signed the MC-2 acceptance. The check sheet beside it still said that the safety bypass was incomplete. I should have refused to sign it as complete. I can describe the pressure during that handover, and I will answer questions about my own actions. My account should be compared with the instrument, workshop copy and formal version rather than used in their place.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 奥伦：MC-2验收是我签的，旁边的检查页仍写安全旁路未完成。我本该拒绝签为完成。我可以说明交接时受到的压力，也会回答关于本人行动的问题。请把陈述与仪表、工坊副本和正式版本比较，而不要拿它代替那些记录。

contexts.paragraph_english: Oren: I signed that final form. I had seen the unfinished entries, and I should have refused to accept the bypass as complete. There was pressure to release the equipment for the next shift. I can give an account of that pressure and the instructions I received, but I will keep it separate from my signature. I cannot make the earlier check complete by repairing the device today. If I undertake a repair now, its parts, test and reviewer must be entered as new work, while the signed form remains available.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 奥伦：最终表是我签的。我看到了未完成条目，本该拒绝把旁路验收为完成。当时受到放行设备给下一班的压力。我会说明压力与收到的指示，但要把这些与本人签名分开。今天修理不能完成早先检查。若现在承接维修，应把零件、测试和复核人记成新工作，同时保留旧签章表。

contexts.paragraph_english: A signature also has a scope. It can identify the person who accepted a particular version, without showing that this person invented every instruction attached to the wider system. Equally, uncertainty about wider instructions does not make the signature disappear. A signatory can explain a deadline, a shortage or pressure from a supervisor, and that explanation may help a review. It should remain separate from the check of what was signed. Otherwise an account of difficult circumstances can quietly replace the evidence of an action which still needs to be addressed.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 签名也有范围：它可识别某一版本的验收者，未必说明此人设计了整个系统的所有指示。对于广泛指示的未知，也不会让签名消失。签章人可以说明期限、短缺或主管压力，帮助核查；这些说明应与签了什么分开。否则，关于困难处境的叙述可能悄悄替换仍需处理的行动证据。

contexts.paragraph_english: The uncontrolled extraction machine has a moving feed and an unsecured lifting arm. Stop the feed at the marked intake point, then physically secure the arm before dealing with the main machine. Pressure can weaken the machine's impact; it cannot fasten an arm which has not been secured. The portable clamp earned after this commission is not needed to complete it: this work stand provides the declared fixed brace interface and local securing equipment.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 失控开采机有活动送料与未固定吊臂。先在标记入口停送料，再实际固定吊臂，随后制止主机。压力可以减弱冲击，无法自动固定没有固定的吊臂。本委托之后获得的便携固定钳不是完成前置；站位提供已声明的固定接口和本地固定设备。

entries.english_definition: A pulling force acting along a rope or part.

contexts.paragraph_english: Two markers are visible from the reef path. The southern marker stands near the broken steps. It identifies the old landing place but does not confirm that the steps remain usable after a surge. The northern reach is beyond the low stone wall. Its approach is narrow, so a rescue boat must wait for a clear signal rather than following the first moving light it sees. The winch line can guide people towards either marker. contexts.paragraph_english: When the town of Alder introduced a new evening bus service, the announcement promised a better connection between its railway station and three residential districts. The published timetable showed a bus leaving ten minutes after each of the main evening trains. For passengers who had previously faced a long walk or an expensive taxi journey, the arrangement appeared straightforward. Yet during the first month, complaints arrived from people who had missed their connection even though their train had reached the station on time.

First, the practical arrangement. Before the trial, the library closed at six on weekdays. During the trial it stayed open until eight, but only on Tuesdays and Thursdays. We did not add weekend hours. The original proposal had included Monday as well, and some early notices referred to three evenings. However, there were not enough trained staff to cover all three. Anyone using those early notices would have had the wrong information, so the final timetable was placed beside the entrance and sent to students.

The transport office initially looked for mistakes in the timetable. None were found. The difficulty was that the ten-minute connection had been measured from the arrival of the train at the platform to the departure of the bus from its stop. It did not include the time passengers might need to leave a crowded carriage, reach the footbridge and collect a bicycle or a large bag. What looked like a generous interval on paper was not necessarily a usable interval for everyone.

To investigate, staff observed the route between the platform and the bus stop over five evenings. They also invited passengers to describe their journeys. The two sources did not provide identical information. Observation showed where groups slowed down, whereas the written accounts explained why some people needed to stop. A parent reported waiting for a child to use the station facilities; another passenger avoided the footbridge because the lift was unreliable. These were not errors in reading the timetable. They were conditions that the timetable alone did not reveal.

entries.english_definition: An agreed time to meet someone.

contexts.paragraph_english: Arrival record — rescue passage from the stranded coast. The public arrival berth receives the technician and four registered survivors. Record their arrival before requesting further harbour work; a person carried here is not automatically signed onto another vessel's crew. Two different berths are shown on the quay plan. The civil ferry is awaiting maintenance and a safe departure arrangement. The stored patrol boat has no handover authorisation on this arrival record. A harbour officer may review a limited maintenance request at the public dispatch desk. Bring the rescue acknowledgement and your inspection appointment, and consult the current closure order rather than assuming that rescue passage suspends it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 搁浅海岸救援入港记录：接应泊位接收检修员和四名已登记幸存者。先登记到港，再申请后续港口工作；接应入港不自动成为另一船的船员。码头显示不同泊位：民用渡轮待检修与安全撤离方案；封存巡灯船没有在此记录中授权移交。公共调度台可审查有限检修申请，须携救援回执及任职凭证，并查现行封港令。

contexts.paragraph_english: Local operator: Our trial permission concerns this tower's present configuration. I can issue it when the enhanced installation, baseline protection and two local watches are checked. It is not a vote for a final network policy. The common protocol later requires both an operator and a representative in every region. We have different scopes and appointment instances. We will read the same terms on essential protection, bounded contact, mutual aid and independent review. An organisation's general position cannot stand in for six current regional signatures, and an old appointment cannot keep signing as the current one.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 地方操作岗：试验许可针对本塔当前配置，在增强、基础保护与两值守核实后签发，不是最终政策投票。共同协议每地另需操作方、代表方，范围任职不同，同阅基本保护、有限联系、互助、独立复核。组织立场不代六地签字，旧任职不继续充现任。

contexts.paragraph_english: Inspection appointment. The bearer is a trainee technician assigned to public navigation maintenance. The appointment establishes a role, not unrestricted access to every power installation. Local harbour work must be commissioned by the officer responsible for the site. Follow the conditions on that commission and keep separate records for each device. A civil ferry's navigation lamp, a workshop's independent controller and the harbour main generator are not interchangeable authorisations. This appointment was carried on the inspection vessel. It does not certify language performance, membership of a faction or the present location of the technician's mentor.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 随检修船携带的任职凭证：持有人为公共导航检修见习员。身份不等于任意电力设施访问权；地方工作须由现场负责人委托，并按设备分别记录。民用渡轮导航灯、工坊独立控制器、港口主发电机不是通用授权。凭证不证明英语表现、组织成员身份或导师目前位置。

contexts.paragraph_english: Protocol-d3-v1 preserves essential local protection, bounded contact, mutual aid and independent review. Every region supplies two different current appointment instances: its operator and representative. ROLE-Rn-OP acts within operate:Rn; ROLE-Rn-REP within represent:Rn. Neither appointment signs for another district or decides the player’s final policy. Local trial permission may be issued before final common acceptance, so testing and agreement do not wait for each other in a circle. Changed holders or terms require a current signature.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: protocol-d3-v1保留地方基本保护、受限联络、互助及独立复核。每地提供操作方与代表方两个不同的现行任职实例。ROLE-Rn-OP只在operate:Rn范围，ROLE-Rn-REP只在represent:Rn范围任职；不为其他地区签字，也不替玩家选终局政策。地方试验许可可先于最终共同接受，避免试验和协议互等。人员或条款改变须重新取得当前签名。

entries.english_definition: A request asking someone to take part or meet.

contexts.paragraph_english: Harbour loan and cross-region inspection terms. Once the Tidegate local safety record has been verified, return to the receiving berth to acknowledge the loan of the sealed inspection vessel Glimmer. Its watch officer maintains the basic ship service; accepting a companion invitation is not a condition of using the vessel. The deck, archive cabin and shared maintenance compartment are three spaces of this one ship, not separate ships at each harbour. It does not certify the current whereabouts of the missing mentor. Basic sailing along an opened route does not require a fuel ticket. contexts.paragraph_chinese: 塔站实际安全核验后回接应泊位明确接收封存旧巡灯船微光号及跨区核查委托。船务值守不依赖接受莉娜邀请，三空间是同一船。民用渡轮及船上设备不转移，不证明导师当前去向，不收死锁燃料门票。

contexts.paragraph_english: Oren: If a public statement is requested, agree its fields and purpose with me. I can speak about my own action, including the signature, without guessing the intentions of people whose later decisions I did not see. A supervised repair followed by a statement is another arrangement, and a regional review is also possible. Please do not call a delayed statement a missing signature. The verified record remains. Joining a travelling crew is a further decision, and I can decline that invitation without taking the workshop file away from the inquiry.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 奥伦：若要求公共证言，请与我商定字段和用途。我能说明本人行动，包括签名，不能猜测后来未亲见决定的动机。也可以先做监督维修再补证言，或交地区核查。请勿把延后陈述说成签名不存在。已核验记录仍在；加入出行队是另一决定，我拒绝邀请也不会拿走工坊档案。

contexts.paragraph_english: This local note is separate from the chapter's essential evidence. Mira has offered a private invitation to consider the arrangement after the main archive agreement. The offer may be declined or left for another visit. The main transfer inquiry remains available.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 这份便条与章节必需证据分开。米拉在主线档案协议完成后提供私人邀请，讨论该安排。可以拒绝或留待回访，主线转移核查仍可继续。

contexts.paragraph_english: The writer's note below the draft says: I want the invitation to write, but I am not ready to send this whole page. Please help me keep the meaning without turning it into a promise to visit. We can save a revised version for another day, or send a short acknowledgement after I have read it. The decision to send belongs to me.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 作者注明：想保留通信邀请，但还不准备寄整页。请保留意思，不要写成来访承诺。可以暂存修订稿，也可由我读过后寄简短确认。是否寄出由我决定。

entries.english_definition: A commitment that a person says they will keep.

contexts.paragraph_english: The writer's note below the draft says: I want the invitation to write, but I am not ready to send this whole page. contexts.paragraph_english: Review officer: I have the present configuration sheet, not a promise of its outcome. The operator starts Controller C only when the execution output has its current TEST route check. At minute five, we retain an intermediate observation. At minute ten, we retain the final result. The controller clock advances when you take those declared observations; the reader does not have to hurry.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 复核员：我持当前配置页，不是结果承诺。执行机输出取得当前TEST检查后，操作员才启动C。第5分钟留中间观察，第10分钟留末次结果。取声明观察时控制器钟才推进，阅读者不用赶。

contexts.paragraph_english: The trial ground has six covered beds available for this work segment. The growers propose two arrangements. These are estimates for the fictional local trial, not a forecast for every winter or a promise of a fixed harvest. Both keep one walkway open and use the same existing tools.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本工作段试种地有六个覆棚床位，两种配置均保留通道、使用既有工具。数字是虚构地方试种估算，不代表每年预测或保证固定收成。

contexts.paragraph_english: The records themselves need suitable access. A public finding can describe the batch, incomplete function and signed decision while unnecessary household details remain protected. A controlled reviewer may need the full technical fields and a route to the original. These arrangements should specify a recipient, purpose and version. They should also explain how a challenge can reach the reviewer. A promise that evidence exists is of little help if the promised source cannot be inspected or if an old permission has been stretched to cover a new use.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 记录需要合适访问范围。公共结论可以说明批次、未完成功能与签章决定，同时保护无关住户信息。受控复核人也许需要完整技术字段及查原稿的通路。这些安排应注明接收方、用途、版本，并说明如何提出质疑。若承诺来源无法查阅，或把旧许可扩成新用途，仅声称有证据并没有多大帮助。

entries.english_definition: A person's freely given agreement to a particular action.

contexts.paragraph_english: Record a disagreement between sources as a disagreement. A voluntary conversation at the public porch can establish present residence for this check. It cannot establish someone's location throughout the intervening years, the whereabouts of another family member, or consent to release a protected attachment.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 不同来源的矛盾应按矛盾记录。公共门廊的自愿交谈可以确认本次查验的当前居住情况，不能说明此前多年每一阶段去向、其他亲属位置或公开受保护附页的同意。

contexts.paragraph_english: Please separate a decision about a person's identity from a decision about those claims. If the person gives explicit consent for a particular identity field to be published to a particular recipient, record that scope and version. Do not treat an archive reading permit or a custodian's signature as personal consent. If the requested permission is missing, revise the fields or request another scope before sending. The basic reading room will remain open while you do that.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 请把个人身份决定与这些公共陈述分开。本人若明确同意向特定接收方公开某项身份字段，应记录范围与版本。阅读许可或保管人签字不能代替个人同意。缺少所需许可时，发送前修改字段或申请新范围；基础阅览室仍开放。

contexts.paragraph_english: For a restricted attachment, name the record version, the fields required, the recipient and the intended use. June acts as custodian of the room. Consent to publish a person's identity must be given by that person for the specified recipient and use.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 申请受限附页时，请说明版本、必要字段、接收方和用途。琼是阅览室保管人，可以安排受控查验、记录获准交付，但持有钥匙并未使她有权代所有当事人同意。公开某人的身份须由本人对具体接收方与用途明确同意。

contexts.paragraph_english: The retained outputs do not establish safe permanent service for six towers. Each tower still needs its actual base changes, transition supply, common protocol and field trial. Moving a coupler at this installed laboratory fixture does not deliver one to a regional work order or grant that district's representative consent.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 保留输出不证明六塔永久安全供给。各塔仍需实际基础改造、过渡供给、共同协议及现场试运行。移动此实验器材上的耦合件，不会向地区工作单交付一件，也不会取得代表同意。

entries.english_definition: An ongoing connection between people.

contexts.paragraph_english: The arrival condition was entered at the receiving end of the handover. A departure copy attached later records the same transfer from the sending end, but the two sheets do not establish any observation after D−1. The archive desk has checked the record identifier, the dated handover and the relationship between the extract and its restricted original. A custodian can arrange a controlled recheck without distributing the identity attachment.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 接收端记录了交接时状态。后来附上的出发副本记录同一次转移的发送端；两张记录都没有D−1之后的观察。阅览台核对了记录编号、日期以及摘录与受限原稿关系。保管人可安排受控复核，无需分发身份附页。

contexts.paragraph_english: If the local load has changed since the record was made, keep both the old observation settings and the current configuration. Do not alter the earlier numbers to make the package look consistent. Say which relationship is being tested and which questions remain. The present data can direct a technical inquiry without pretending that it has already found the whole cause.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 记录完成后地方负荷若变动，请同时保留旧观察设置与当前配置。不要为资料看起来一致而修改旧数值。说明待试验的关系与余下问题；当前数据可以引导技术调查，无需假装已经查明全部原因。

contexts.paragraph_english: Records travel farther than their writers expect. A room code on a kitchen sheet may be harmless among people who already know the building. Add a private address, a family relationship and a public announcement, and the same account can expose someone to attention they never agreed to receive. Removing those details need not remove the events. A review can still retain an observation date, the duty of the observer, the version of a record and a route to the protected original. These fields let a reader ask whether the account has support.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 记录会传得比作者预想更远。厨房页的房间代码，在熟悉建筑的人之间可能没有什么风险。加上私人住址、亲属关系和公共通告，同一陈述却可能让人受到从未同意的关注。去掉这些细节，无需去掉事件。审查仍可保留观察日期、记录员职能、版本及通向受保护原稿的查验路径，让读者判断陈述有无支持。

contexts.paragraph_english: The proposed technical package contains the MC-2 instrument reference, retained-copy chain and formal acceptance version, with the current environment readings and their settings. Label the sample with the same observation stage and a lawful receiving purpose: academic verification of the recorded load, extraction and disturbance relationship. Include the known limits and any changed configuration.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 拟送技术包包括MC-2仪表索引、留存抄录链、正式验收版本，以及当前环境读数与设置。样本注明同一观察阶段，并列合法接收用途：学城核验所记录负荷、抽取和扰动关系。保留已知限制及变更配置。
