contexts.paragraph_english: Custodian: The supervision record needs three functions: operation, resident review and evidence oversight. They are different duties even where people agree on an outcome. Our local operator cannot be replaced by the patrol’s companion simply because that person is on the battle roster. Ada has accepted resident review here; I will retain evidence oversight. We must record the acceptance of each post and keep it separate from a broad statement of support. Before the next phase, confirm the return passage as well. A safe tower does not help someone who has no registered safe way back.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 保管人：监督需操作、住民复核、证据监督三功能，即使意见相同仍不同。出战同伴不能自动替当地操作员。阿妲接受此处住民复核，我留证据监督，逐岗明确接受，不用笼统支持替代。还需检查返程；无安全回程的人不会仅因塔安全便受益。

contexts.paragraph_english: Inspect the external dead circuit before opening the old case. The debris enclosure must be controlled through the actual encounter. For the reserve segment, either use the isolated manual service procedure—open, clear, secure and inspect—or control its separate maintenance threat. The physical result must be recorded before the connection is checked. Read instructions from the protected work stand; no action requires a rare talent or a particular companion.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 打开旧外壳前，从外侧检查断路。残件围护须实际遭遇制止。备用段可以用隔离手动步骤：打开、清理、固定、检查；也可处理其独立维护威胁。核对连接前须记录物理结果。在安全工作站读说明，无需稀有天赋或特定同伴。

contexts.paragraph_english: People still live behind the names missing from your chart. Twelve years ago subsidence closed the central bridge span; later the district was removed from the current place register. The residents remember the streets and have maintained other passages. Ada can confirm local routes, not the present condition of a person inside a locked detention room. The mission desk supplies one basic inspection kit, one lamp and one safety line for this local work. They are mission equipment, not personal upgrade parts or six-tower supplies. Either current credential checking or the existing service tunnel can reach the duty hall. No named companion is required.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 航图上消失的名字背后仍住着人。十二年前沉降封闭中央桥跨，后来地区被从现行名录移除；住民仍记得道路并维护其他通路。阿妲能确认地方路线，不能证实扣押室内某人的当前状态。当地委托提供一套基础检修工具、一盏灯和一条安全索，均为任务装备，不是个人零件或六塔物资。当前证件核查与既有隧道均可到值守厅，不要求指定同伴。

entries.english_definition: Someone who comes to a place temporarily.

contexts.paragraph_english: The chart on the ferry gave the district a single name: abandoned. From the landing, however, a visitor could see a laundry line, a repaired roof and smoke rising behind a closed public office. None of those observations proved that every street was safe. They did make the label inadequate as an account of who was still living there. A navigation chart can simplify space for a particular journey. Trouble begins when that simplification is treated as permission to ignore the people outside its categories.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 渡船航图只给地区一个名字：废弃。渡口却能看见晾衣绳、修过的屋顶和关闭公署后方的炊烟。这不证明每条街安全，却说明标签不足以交代仍住着谁。航图可以为某次行程简化空间；把简化当成忽略分类之外住民的许可，问题便开始了。

contexts.paragraph_english: Ada: And the map? Custodian: The historical sheet stays historical. Ada: Good. Let it show what used to be here without telling a visitor to walk across a broken span. Let the present sign show that people still live here without promising the street can never change. That is the kind of record we need from this hearing too: a dated account that can be checked, challenged and corrected. It will not make everyone agree about the future, but it can stop the future from being decided by documents nobody else is allowed to see.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 阿妲：地图呢？保管人：旧纸仍作历史。阿妲：好，让它记过去，却不叫访客走断桥；现牌显示还有人，不保证街永不变化。审查记录亦需有日期、可核验反驳纠正；不会让大家未来意见一致，却可阻止未来被无人可看的文书决定。

contexts.paragraph_english: The old city was damaged by subsidence twelve years before the present accident. Most residents were moved, and the central bridge was closed. In the records that followed, an affected district became an unlisted district. These changes belonged to different kinds of evidence. Damage concerned the ground and buildings; relocation concerned particular people; removal from a register concerned an administrative decision. One did not automatically establish the extent of the others. A careful visitor therefore needs both historical records and current observation, rather than choosing whichever sheet looks more official.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 旧都在当前事故前十二年遭沉降，大部分人迁出、中央桥关闭。后续记录把受损区变成除名区；这是不同证据：损坏涉及地面建筑，迁移涉及具体人，除名涉及行政决定，不能互证全部范围。访客需历史记录与当前观察，不是选最像官方的纸。

contexts.paragraph_english: Visitor: We will register the checkpoint and keep the source references. If the corridor cannot be accepted now, we will check the maintenance shaft rather than insist that a political preference opens the door. That route still requires its own physical checks. Reaching the takeover floor will establish our approach; it will not establish that Rook's command relay is released or that the central loop has stopped.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 访客：我们登记检查点并保留来源索引。走廊暂不接受时，就核验检修竖井，而不要求政治偏好开门。另路仍需实体检查。到接管层只建立接近结果，没有证明鲁克转接已解除或中央循环已停。

entries.english_definition: A traveller being carried by a vehicle or vessel.

contexts.paragraph_english: When the town of Alder introduced a new evening bus service, the announcement promised a better connection between its railway station and three residential districts. The published timetable showed a bus leaving ten minutes after each of the main evening trains. For passengers who had previously faced a long walk or an expensive taxi journey, the arrangement appeared straightforward. Yet during the first month, complaints arrived from people who had missed their connection even though their train had reached the station on time.

The transport office initially looked for mistakes in the timetable. None were found. The difficulty was that the ten-minute connection had been measured from the arrival of the train at the platform to the departure of the bus from its stop. It did not include the time passengers might need to leave a crowded carriage, reach the footbridge and collect a bicycle or a large bag. What looked like a generous interval on paper was not necessarily a usable interval for everyone.

To investigate, staff observed the route between the platform and the bus stop over five evenings. They also invited passengers to describe their journeys. The two sources did not provide identical information. Observation showed where groups slowed down, whereas the written accounts explained why some people needed to stop. A parent reported waiting for a child to use the station facilities; another passenger avoided the footbridge because the lift was unreliable. These were not errors in reading the timetable. They were conditions that the timetable alone did not reveal.

One proposal was simply to delay every bus by another ten minutes. Several passengers supported it, but the bus operators raised a practical concern. The same vehicles continued beyond the three districts to serve a small college. A later departure from the station could make those passengers late for the final class of the evening. Changing one connection could improve a journey for one group while making another journey less reliable. The question was therefore not whether additional waiting time was useful, but where and under what conditions it should be introduced.

entries.english_definition: A person doing assigned practical work.

contexts.paragraph_english: Pera's assignment covers the public mine route, the damaged drainage equipment, the three workers awaiting rescue and the checks needed to bring them back safely. The workers are identified on the work board as W1, W2 and W3. These are local rescue codes, not permission to publish their addresses or medical details. Record who has actually reached the receiving point.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 佩拉的委托包括矿井公共通路、受损排水设备、三名待救工人与安全返程检查。工作板以W1、W2、W3标记三人。这些是救援代号，公开住址或病情另需范围。应记录谁实际到了接收点。

contexts.paragraph_english: Worker W2: We are together in the marked shelter. W1 can walk with assistance, and W3 is keeping the return packs ready. The rail route was blocked when we came here. We have heard the pump fall quiet, but none of us has inspected its wet controls. Please check the water and the feed before asking us to move.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 工人W2：我们都在标记避护处。W1在帮助下能够行走，W3正整理返程用品。我们到这里时轨道受阻。听见泵停下来，但没人检查过潮湿控制器。请先查水位与线路，再安排我们移动。

contexts.paragraph_english: Bring back the current instrument sheet as well as the workers. It can establish what was observed in the mine today. Keep the sampling stage, load setting and limitations in the report. The mine is operating at a high extraction setting and dangerous changes have been observed. The present rescue does not establish the full cause of those changes.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 除接回工人，也要带回当前仪表记录，说明今日矿内所见。报告保留取样阶段、负荷设置与限制。矿井目前以高强度抽取，现场出现危险变化；本次救援尚不能证明变化的完整原因。

contexts.paragraph_english: Visitors must receive the mine safety briefing and the available basic kit before entering. The fixed ladder is listed separately from the powered lift. Tell the surface desk which route has been checked, and leave its access clear while any worker remains below.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 访客进入前应取得矿井安全说明与可领取的基础装备。固定梯道与电动升降机分列登记。请向地面台说明实际检查的通路；地下仍有人时保持出口畅通。

entries.english_definition: A person trained to maintain or operate technical equipment.

contexts.paragraph_english: This relay records signals locally even when its outgoing link is unavailable. The independent recorder and the outgoing transmitter are separate parts of the station. Before touching the displaced outgoing lead, switch the local transmitter off and isolate it. Seat the lead, restore the station's own reserve and run a link check. The test confirms this lead and power configuration only. If either changes, repeat it before requesting a boat. A successful link test is not evidence that a distant tower is safe. The postal locker may be opened for the named technician after the shore rescue has been completed. Its contents are correspondence, not a certificate about the sender's present whereabouts. The rear latch can be opened from this room to provide a shorter route back to the rescue shelter.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 中继站外发链路中断时仍可本地记录；独立记录器与外发设备是两个部件。检修移位接线前关闭并隔离本地发送设备，再落座接线，恢复本站储备，做当前配置链路检查。改变接线或电源须重新检查；成功不证明远方塔站安全。救援完成后，具名检修员才可领取邮务柜通信，它不证明寄信人目前所在或状态。后门内闩可从站内打开，缩短返回救援棚的路线。

contexts.paragraph_english: Coast team to the stranded crew. We first marked the south steps as a possible receiving point. That instruction is withdrawn: a fresh inspection found the lower steps separated from their support. Use the northern reach beyond the low wall instead. There are four survivors waiting for assistance, apart from the technician carrying this message. Keep the rescue line clear of the broken steps. Once everyone is under shelter, send your position, the number of people needing collection and the approach restriction. Do not ask the boat to follow the southern marker merely because it is easier to see. We will acknowledge the request through the coast relay.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 海岸队更正原先南台阶方案：现场复查发现下段台阶脱离支承，撤回旧指示。改用矮墙外的北段。有四名幸存者需要接应，不含传递消息的检修员。索具避开破损台阶。人员进入棚内后，发送位置、接应人数和进路限制，接应船不会因南标记显眼就改走那里。通过海岸中继确认求援。

contexts.paragraph_english: To the new technician, from Mara. If a record is marked for destruction, first ask who issued the instruction, which version it concerns and what other record can be used to check it. A tidy report may leave out the circumstances that made its conclusion seem convincing. I have enclosed a request to compare the public maintenance record with an independent source. Deal with immediate rescue work before following it. This letter was placed in the inspection post before your journey; it cannot tell you where I am when you read it. Do not treat my concerns as proof. Preserve what you actually find, including anything that does not support the explanation you expected.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 玛拉给新检修员的留言：遇到要求销毁的记录，先核对指令签发者、所指版本和可独立核验的来源。整齐报告可能省略形成结论的条件。附上公共检修记录比对请求，但眼前救援优先。信件在旅程前寄存，不能说明阅读时玛拉所在。疑虑不是证明，应保留实际找到的资料，包括不支持预期解释的部分。

contexts.paragraph_english: Coast pickup acknowledgement. Four people registered at the sheltered assembly point will be collected, together with the technician. The receiving route is the northern reach; the southern steps remain unavailable. Wait at the shelter's marked boarding point. The receiving crew will carry everyone to the public arrival berth at Saltmist Harbour. This acknowledgement permits that rescue passage only. It is not a general sailing licence, a maintenance commission or the handover of a patrol vessel. Take the coast records with you, keeping their source and time labels.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 接应回执：接走避风棚登记的四名幸存者和检修员，经北段上船，南台阶仍不可用。在棚外登记登船点等接应，前往盐雾港公共接应泊位。这只允许本次救援通行，不是一般航行许可、检修委托或巡灯船移交。带走资料并保留来源、时间标签。

entries.english_definition: A person responsible for technical design or engineering work.

contexts.paragraph_english: This file concerns transfer M-12, not the detained engineer. Personal names are held in a restricted attachment and are unnecessary for establishing the sequence below. All times on these sheets refer to the same local day.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本文件记录转移M-12，并非被扣押的工程师。私人姓名保存在受限附页中，确定以下顺序不需要姓名。这些记录中的时间均指同一个地方日。

contexts.paragraph_english: Rescuing Mara changes what can be said about her present condition. It does not change the dates on earlier records, and her testimony does not replace them. She can explain why an engineer accepted a compromise, identify a limitation in an incomplete proposal and challenge a mistaken reading. Those contributions should remain distinguishable from the verified design and command records. A review that calls the rescued person either the final authority or the hidden author of every harm would reproduce the same dependence on a single voice that the investigation was meant to question.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 救出玛拉改变当前状况可说之事，不改旧日期，其证言不替代文献。她可解释妥协理由、指出未完整方案限制、反驳误读；贡献须与经核原设计和命令分开。若让获救者成为最终权威或所有伤害幕后作者，审查便复造调查原欲质疑的单一声音依赖。

entries.english_definition: A person who processes records or administrative requests.

contexts.paragraph_english: Leave the Glimmer at the marked berth while the landing clerk checks your vessel record and the cross-district commission. Registering here establishes an arrival and a route back to this landing. It does not give access to private rooms or restricted names.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 请把微光号停在标记泊位，由接驳员核对船只记录与跨区核查委托。此处登记记录一次实际到港，并建立返回这个接驳站的路线。私人房间与受限姓名另有访问范围。

contexts.paragraph_english: Archive clerk: We have laid out the local M-12 papers on two stands. Start with either one, but keep the references attached when you make your notes. The departure officer's page and the receiving officer's page describe different observations. The ledger was prepared from those records later. If the departure entry appears twice, count its source once. The second copy is useful when a page cannot be handled; it does not add another person who saw the vehicle leave.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 阅览台员：M-12地方文件摆在两个站位，可以从任一处开始，但记笔记时要保留来源编号。出发记录员和接收员记的是不同观察，总账稍后由这些记录编成。出发条目即使出现两次，来源也只算一次。另一份副本有助于无法触摸原页时查阅，没有增加看到车辆离开的人。

contexts.paragraph_english: The receiving desk recorded the vehicle’s arrival at 14:40. The entry was made by the receiving officer when the vehicle reached the site. At 16:05 the same day, an archive clerk copied the movement and arrival entries into the central ledger. The later ledger stamp marks the copying, not a second journey or a later physical arrival.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 接收台记录车辆于14:40到达。这条记录由接收员在车辆抵达现场时写下。同日下午16:05，档案员把行程与到达条目抄入中央总账。较晚总账戳记标记的是抄录，并非第二次旅程或较晚的实际到达。

contexts.paragraph_english: Berth the Glimmer at the marked landing and let the freight clerk check the vessel-use record, the completed priory handover and your commission. Register the arrival here before entering the mine. This desk keeps the route back to the vessel available; it does not issue permission to operate underground machinery.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 请把微光号停在标记泊位，让货运员核对船只使用记录、已完成的修院交接与核查委托。进入矿井前在此登记到港。此台保留返回船只的通路；地下设备操作另需许可。

entries.english_definition: A person entrusted with an official duty or authority.

contexts.paragraph_english: Arrival record — rescue passage from the stranded coast. The public arrival berth receives the technician and four registered survivors. Record their arrival before requesting further harbour work; a person carried here is not automatically signed onto another vessel's crew. Two different berths are shown on the quay plan. The civil ferry is awaiting maintenance and a safe departure arrangement. The stored patrol boat has no handover authorisation on this arrival record. A harbour officer may review a limited maintenance request at the public dispatch desk. Bring the rescue acknowledgement and your inspection appointment, and consult the current closure order rather than assuming that rescue passage suspends it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 搁浅海岸救援入港记录：接应泊位接收检修员和四名已登记幸存者。先登记到港，再申请后续港口工作；接应入港不自动成为另一船的船员。码头显示不同泊位：民用渡轮待检修与安全撤离方案；封存巡灯船没有在此记录中授权移交。公共调度台可审查有限检修申请，须携救援回执及任职凭证，并查现行封港令。

contexts.paragraph_english: Archive clerk: We have laid out the local M-12 papers on two stands. Start with either one, but keep the references attached when you make your notes. The departure officer's page and the receiving officer's page describe different observations. The ledger was prepared from those records later. If the departure entry appears twice, count its source once. The second copy is useful when a page cannot be handled; it does not add another person who saw the vehicle leave.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 阅览台员：M-12地方文件摆在两个站位，可以从任一处开始，但记笔记时要保留来源编号。出发记录员和接收员记的是不同观察，总账稍后由这些记录编成。出发条目即使出现两次，来源也只算一次。另一份副本有助于无法触摸原页时查阅，没有增加看到车辆离开的人。

contexts.paragraph_english: Inspection appointment. The bearer is a trainee technician assigned to public navigation maintenance. The appointment establishes a role, not unrestricted access to every power installation. Local harbour work must be commissioned by the officer responsible for the site. Follow the conditions on that commission and keep separate records for each device. A civil ferry's navigation lamp, a workshop's independent controller and the harbour main generator are not interchangeable authorisations. This appointment was carried on the inspection vessel. It does not certify language performance, membership of a faction or the present location of the technician's mentor.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 随检修船携带的任职凭证：持有人为公共导航检修见习员。身份不等于任意电力设施访问权；地方工作须由现场负责人委托，并按设备分别记录。民用渡轮导航灯、工坊独立控制器、港口主发电机不是通用授权。凭证不证明英语表现、组织成员身份或导师目前位置。

contexts.paragraph_english: Limited maintenance exception. Havel, the dispatch officer, may commission inspection and repair of the civil ferry's navigation equipment and the local workshop arrangements needed to obtain its replacement parts. State that the purpose is evacuation assistance and identify those work areas in the request. Harbour main-generator operation is outside this exception: its safety isolation has not been confirmed. A commission allows local preparation; the ferry remains at the quay until a tested current configuration and an explicitly confirmed departure plan are available. Neither a fee nor a language score is required to request the commission. Crew recruitment, patrol-boat use and access to retained accident records are separate decisions and must not be inferred from this document.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 有限检修例外：调度负责人哈文可委托民用渡轮导航设备检修及为取替换件所需的本地工坊操作。申请写明协助撤离及这些范围。主发电机安全隔离尚未确认，操作它不在例外内。委托只允许准备；当前配置测试与明确离港方案确认完成前，渡轮留港。申请不需费用或英语分数；招募、巡灯船及事故记录调阅均另行授权。

entries.english_definition: A person authorised to speak or act for a group.

contexts.paragraph_english: Oren may give a statement, undertake supervised repair or join a travelling crew after the batch finding. Those choices do not appoint him to two simultaneous posts. A local replacement must be accepted before a duty occupant departs. The later ROLE-R3-OP and ROLE-R3-REP protocol mandates also have separate operating and representative scopes; this current shift does not sign them automatically.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 批次核查后，奥伦可作证、承担监督维修或加入出行队伍。这些选择不能同时占两岗。值守人员离开前须有获准接替。后来ROLE-R3-OP与ROLE-R3-REP协议又有独立操作和代表范围，本班不会自动签署那些委托。

contexts.paragraph_english: Resident representative: The warmer shelter matters now, but so does the transfer which some households are waiting for. I would like the proposal to say which work is postponed under each distribution. If we choose the transition, when will the materials used for production support become unavailable for shelter improvement? If we reduce immediately, who will replace the expected output in the transfer plan? We should be able to disagree about those costs without losing the meals and wage cover already agreed. Please record the conditions, rather than writing that every resident shares one preference.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 住民代表：更暖的安置处现在重要，一些住户等待的转移也重要。我希望提案说明各分配推迟什么工作。选择过渡后，生产支持物资何时不再可用于安置？立刻减产时，转移计划的预期产出由什么替代？讨论这些代价不应失去已约定暖食和工资保障。请记条件，不写所有住民同一偏好。

contexts.paragraph_english: The retained outputs do not establish safe permanent service for six towers. Each tower still needs its actual base changes, transition supply, common protocol and field trial. Moving a coupler at this installed laboratory fixture does not deliver one to a regional work order or grant that district's representative consent.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 保留输出不证明六塔永久安全供给。各塔仍需实际基础改造、过渡供给、共同协议及现场试运行。移动此实验器材上的耦合件，不会向地区工作单交付一件，也不会取得代表同意。

contexts.paragraph_english: Protocol-d3-v1 preserves essential local protection, bounded contact, mutual aid and independent review. Every region supplies two different current appointment instances: its operator and representative. ROLE-Rn-OP acts within operate:Rn; ROLE-Rn-REP within represent:Rn. Neither appointment signs for another district or decides the player’s final policy. Local trial permission may be issued before final common acceptance, so testing and agreement do not wait for each other in a circle. Changed holders or terms require a current signature.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: protocol-d3-v1保留地方基本保护、受限联络、互助及独立复核。每地提供操作方与代表方两个不同的现行任职实例。ROLE-Rn-OP只在operate:Rn范围，ROLE-Rn-REP只在represent:Rn范围任职；不为其他地区签字，也不替玩家选终局政策。地方试验许可可先于最终共同接受，避免试验和协议互等。人员或条款改变须重新取得当前签名。

entries.english_definition: A person who directly observed an event.

contexts.paragraph_english: The collection sheet was written at the kitchen desk. A copy filed in the reading room has the same source. It may replace an unavailable copy for access, but it does not supply a second witness.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 领取页原稿写于厨房台。阅览室存档副本与它同源，可以作为查阅副本，不能增加一名证人。

contexts.paragraph_english: Serving witness: I remember the first meal because we had to borrow another pan. I served people from A and B, and I thought the whole group had arrived before the new labels appeared. That is how it felt at the time. I was not at the receiving desk, though. Someone else collected the portions for C, so I cannot say that I saw everyone that evening.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 值餐人：我记得第一顿饭，因为我们还借了一个锅。我给A、B区的人分了饭，当时以为整组人都在新标签出现前到了。我那时确实这样想，但我不在接收台。C区的饭由别人代领，所以我不能说当晚见过每个人。

contexts.paragraph_english: Receiving witness: I wrote the room assignments as each group came through the porch. A and B were already using their rooms when the kitchen began serving. C was assigned later in that work stage. I heard someone say the group was complete at the first meal, but I think they were counting portions. I kept the room sheet beside me, and that is the record I can check again.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 接应人：每组人经过门廊时，我记下房间安排。厨房开始供餐时，A、B区已经使用房间，C区在这个工作阶段稍后才获分配。我听见有人说第一顿饭时“整组齐了”，但我认为对方是在数口粮。我把房间页放在身边，可以拿原记录再次核对。

contexts.paragraph_english: The later assignment does not tell us why an official entry says moved away. Those labels came from another register. I can let the custodian check my room codes and this observation for the local inquiry. Please keep the exact record version with the statement. A retelling of what I said will still come from me; it will not become another independent witness.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 较晚分配房间不能解释官方记录为何写迁出；那些标签来自另一份名册。我可以让保管人为地方调查核对房间代码与这次观察。请把准确版本和陈述保存在一起。别人转述我的话，来源仍是我，不会变成另一个独立证人。

entries.english_definition: A person who examines work or evidence for a stated purpose.

contexts.paragraph_english: A delegated review is another arrangement. The package goes to a specified desk for a stated purpose, and the receipt records the fields and versions that were delivered. This can allow a detailed check without immediately distributing personal details to everyone. It has costs. The reviewer may work slowly, or the public may have less opportunity to challenge an error. Keeping a short public account alongside a controlled package can make the process easier to question, provided neither account pretends that a pending review has already resolved the matter.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 受托审查是另一种安排：资料交给指定工作台用于约定用途，回执记清交付字段与版本。这能支持详细核查，无需立即把私人细节分给所有人。它也有代价：审阅可能较慢，公众纠错机会可能较少。受控包旁保留简短公共说明，有助于对过程提出问题；两者均应保留审查尚未结束的状态。

contexts.paragraph_english: Oren: I signed that final form. I had seen the unfinished entries, and I should have refused to accept the bypass as complete. There was pressure to release the equipment for the next shift. I can give an account of that pressure and the instructions I received, but I will keep it separate from my signature. I cannot make the earlier check complete by repairing the device today. If I undertake a repair now, its parts, test and reviewer must be entered as new work, while the signed form remains available.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 奥伦：最终表是我签的。我看到了未完成条目，本该拒绝把旁路验收为完成。当时受到放行设备给下一班的压力。我会说明压力与收到的指示，但要把这些与本人签名分开。今天修理不能完成早先检查。若现在承接维修，应把零件、测试和复核人记成新工作，同时保留旧签章表。

contexts.paragraph_english: A separate present repair line may be added when a repair is actually carried out. It must name the new work stage, parts and reviewer. Preserve the retained copy as the earlier version. Do not cross out the incomplete entries, replace the old signature, or call an intended repair a completed check.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 实际维修后，可以另加当前维修条目，注明新阶段、零件与复核人。保留副本仍代表早版本；不能涂掉未完成条目、替换旧签名，或把拟做维修写成完成检查。

contexts.paragraph_english: The records themselves need suitable access. A public finding can describe the batch, incomplete function and signed decision while unnecessary household details remain protected. A controlled reviewer may need the full technical fields and a route to the original. These arrangements should specify a recipient, purpose and version. They should also explain how a challenge can reach the reviewer. A promise that evidence exists is of little help if the promised source cannot be inspected or if an old permission has been stretched to cover a new use.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 记录需要合适访问范围。公共结论可以说明批次、未完成功能与签章决定，同时保护无关住户信息。受控复核人也许需要完整技术字段及查原稿的通路。这些安排应注明接收方、用途、版本，并说明如何提出质疑。若承诺来源无法查阅，或把旧许可扩成新用途，仅声称有证据并没有多大帮助。

entries.english_definition: A person responsible for overseeing other people's work.

contexts.paragraph_english: A repaired warning device changes what people can safely do tomorrow. It may allow a worker to hear a signal from another room, or let a supervisor repeat a check without standing beside the machine. That practical value should be recorded clearly. The repair also leaves a question about yesterday. If the earlier form said that the device had passed a check which was never completed, the new result cannot tell us that the old form was accurate. A useful account has room for both the present improvement and the earlier disagreement.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 修好的警报装置会改变明日能够安全做的事。工人也许能在另一个房间听到信号，主管也许能在机器旁之外重复检查，这些实用价值应记清。维修同时留下关于昨日的问题：早表若写着通过一项从未完成的检查，新结果无法证明早表准确。可用记录应容纳当前改善与早先差异。

contexts.paragraph_english: A signature also has a scope. It can identify the person who accepted a particular version, without showing that this person invented every instruction attached to the wider system. Equally, uncertainty about wider instructions does not make the signature disappear. A signatory can explain a deadline, a shortage or pressure from a supervisor, and that explanation may help a review. It should remain separate from the check of what was signed. Otherwise an account of difficult circumstances can quietly replace the evidence of an action which still needs to be addressed.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 签名也有范围：它可识别某一版本的验收者，未必说明此人设计了整个系统的所有指示。对于广泛指示的未知，也不会让签名消失。签章人可以说明期限、短缺或主管压力，帮助核查；这些说明应与签了什么分开。否则，关于困难处境的叙述可能悄悄替换仍需处理的行动证据。

entries.english_definition: An experienced person who guides another's learning or work.

contexts.paragraph_english: Inspection appointment. The bearer is a trainee technician assigned to public navigation maintenance. The appointment establishes a role, not unrestricted access to every power installation. Local harbour work must be commissioned by the officer responsible for the site. Follow the conditions on that commission and keep separate records for each device. A civil ferry's navigation lamp, a workshop's independent controller and the harbour main generator are not interchangeable authorisations. This appointment was carried on the inspection vessel. It does not certify language performance, membership of a faction or the present location of the technician's mentor.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 随检修船携带的任职凭证：持有人为公共导航检修见习员。身份不等于任意电力设施访问权；地方工作须由现场负责人委托，并按设备分别记录。民用渡轮导航灯、工坊独立控制器、港口主发电机不是通用授权。凭证不证明英语表现、组织成员身份或导师目前位置。

contexts.paragraph_english: Harbour loan and cross-region inspection terms. Once the Tidegate local safety record has been verified, return to the receiving berth to acknowledge the loan of the sealed inspection vessel Glimmer. Its watch officer maintains the basic ship service; accepting a companion invitation is not a condition of using the vessel. The deck, archive cabin and shared maintenance compartment are three spaces of this one ship, not separate ships at each harbour. The loan does not transfer the civil ferry or its installed equipment. The next inspection commission points to the grove receiving records. It does not certify the current whereabouts of the missing mentor. Basic sailing along an opened route does not require a fuel ticket. The vessel still needs its ordinary gradual repairs; the handover does not turn it into a fully upgraded ship.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 塔站实际安全核验后回接应泊位明确接收封存旧巡灯船微光号及跨区核查委托。船务值守不依赖接受莉娜邀请，三空间是同一船。民用渡轮及船上设备不转移，不证明导师当前去向，不收死锁燃料门票。

entries.english_definition: The person or entity entitled to possess an item.

contexts.paragraph_english: Six extra packages, LOCAL-R3-01 to LOCAL-R3-06, are held in the dispatch store for this assignment. They contain local work supplies rather than personal upgrade parts. Each package must have one recorded owner or receiving work group at a time. Reserving a package for an agreed arrangement does not deliver it, and the same package cannot be listed against both shelter and production.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 六个额外工包LOCAL-R3-01至06由调度库为本委托保管，内为地方作业用品，不是个人改件零件。每包同一时刻只有一项归属或接收工作组。为约定安排预留尚未交付，同包不能同时列于安置和生产。

contexts.paragraph_english: The account must include wages without confusing them with a traveller's reward. Local wage protection belongs to the town's emergency arrangement. The coins or equipment parts earned for a completed commission have another owner and purpose. Asking a resident to wait for food until an investigator writes a better paragraph would confuse these responsibilities. Equally, an investigator cannot solve the shortage by listing imaginary stock. A receipt from the actual store and receiving group provides a firmer basis for discussion than either a polished promise or a large number written without a source.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 记录须包含工资，并与出行者奖励分清。本地工资保障属于矿镇应急安排，完成委托取得的刻币和装备零件有另一归属与用途。让住民等调查者写好段落才领食物，会混淆职责；调查者也不能靠列虚构库存解决短缺。实际库存与接收组的回执，比漂亮承诺或没有来源的大数字更能支持讨论。

contexts.paragraph_english: The owner invites a repair of the music box and permits inspection of its mechanism. A note supplied with this box specifies a twelve-tooth replacement wheel, MBOX-12. The store also holds a fourteen-tooth wheel for another device. Read the specification before asking the owner to approve the chosen part. The small box belongs to the owner; it is not a reward item or a main-line key.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 主人邀请修音乐盒，允许检查机构。随盒说明要求十二齿替换轮MBOX-12，铺内另有给别装置用的十四齿轮。请求主人批准选件前，请核对规格。盒子属于主人，不是奖励物品或主线钥匙。

contexts.paragraph_english: The owner remembers hearing it at a family meal and may choose to describe that memory privately. Their permission to repair the mechanism does not publish the memory. Ask separately before copying a personal account into a notice. The repair can be paused if permission changes, and the owner may keep the original note without telling the story.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 主人记得家庭聚餐时听过它，可以选择私下讲回忆。维修机构许可不会公开回忆。把个人叙述抄进告示前需另问。许可改变时可以暂停维修，主人也能保留原便条、不讲故事。

entries.english_definition: The person or organisation to whom something is sent.

contexts.paragraph_english: Basic archive access may be registered for this check. Names in protected attachments require a separate request, a stated purpose and a permitted recipient. Keep the public room codes in your working summary. No resident has agreed to publication merely by accepting a meal or answering a question.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本次查验可以登记基础档案访问。受保护附页中的姓名须另外申请，说明用途与接收方。工作摘要使用公开房间代码。领取饭食或回答问题均未构成同意公开身份。

contexts.paragraph_english: Please separate a decision about a person's identity from a decision about those claims. If the person gives explicit consent for a particular identity field to be published to a particular recipient, record that scope and version. Do not treat an archive reading permit or a custodian's signature as personal consent. If the requested permission is missing, revise the fields or request another scope before sending. The basic reading room will remain open while you do that.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 请把个人身份决定与这些公共陈述分开。本人若明确同意向特定接收方公开某项身份字段，应记录范围与版本。阅读许可或保管人签字不能代替个人同意。缺少所需许可时，发送前修改字段或申请新范围；基础阅览室仍开放。

contexts.paragraph_english: For a restricted attachment, name the record version, the fields required, the recipient and the intended use. June acts as custodian of the room. She can arrange controlled inspection and record an authorised handover. Holding the key to an attachment does not make her the person entitled to consent on behalf of every individual named there. Consent to publish a person's identity must be given by that person for the specified recipient and use.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 申请受限附页时，请说明版本、必要字段、接收方和用途。琼是阅览室保管人，可以安排受控查验、记录获准交付，但持有钥匙并未使她有权代所有当事人同意。公开某人的身份须由本人对具体接收方与用途明确同意。

contexts.paragraph_english: You may argue for wider public scrutiny, a controlled review, or a combination with a public summary and retained originals. State the practical benefits, the risks and the arrangement you intend to carry out. I will not infer that choice from a saved essay. At this desk, you will confirm the fields, the recipient, the purpose and the version, inspect the proposed handover, then explicitly send it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 你可以主张更广公开、受控审查，或公共摘要与保留原稿结合。请说明实际益处、风险与所选安排。保存文章不会让我推断交付选择。你须在此确认字段、接收方、用途和版本，查看交接预览，再明确发送。

entries.english_definition: People living together as one domestic unit.

contexts.paragraph_english: The local inspection assignment permits this batch comparison. It does not permit the release of unrelated household details or the alteration of priory records. If the original instrument remains temporarily inaccessible, the retained copy can guide preparation, while the final finding keeps the missing inspection explicit.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本地查验委托允许这项批次比较，没有许可发布无关住户细节或改写修院记录。原仪表暂时无法到达时，可用副本准备工作；最终结论仍明确缺少哪项现场查验。

contexts.paragraph_english: Pera: I am willing to discuss that new work, but it must have an end we can inspect. Naming a repairer is not enough. Tell us which device is included, where its supplies come from and who can repeat the check. The household auxiliary alarm may be a suitable separate job. It is not the flooded pump room again. I also want the town's wage cover and meals recorded before extra packages are allocated. A person asked to bear the cost of a shutdown needs to know what is actually waiting at the receiving desk.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 佩拉：我愿意谈新工作，但它要有可检查的终点。仅列维修人不足，还应说明设备、物资来源与复查者。住区辅助警报器可以成为另一项工作，不是再次把泵房注满。额外分配前，也要记清矿镇工资保障与暖食。被要求承担停产代价的人，需要知道接收台究竟准备了什么。

contexts.paragraph_english: Workers have practical reasons to want a repair accepted quickly. A closed route may stop wages, delay a meal delivery or leave a household waiting for someone to return. Treating every request for continued production as greed misses those conditions. Accepting an unsafe system without a limit can expose the same people to another danger. A responsible repair plan therefore needs more than a declaration of good intention: it needs a usable exit, a real supply arrangement, people assigned to the work and a point at which its conditions will be checked again.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 工人有实际理由希望迅速完成验收。通路关闭可能影响工资、拖延供餐，也让住户等不到家人回来。把每项继续生产请求都解释为贪婪，会漏掉这些条件；无限制接受不安全系统，又会把同一批人置于危险。负责的维修方案需要可用出口、实际供给、明确人员和再次核查边界，而非只有善意宣言。

contexts.paragraph_english: The records themselves need suitable access. A public finding can describe the batch, incomplete function and signed decision while unnecessary household details remain protected. A controlled reviewer may need the full technical fields and a route to the original. These arrangements should specify a recipient, purpose and version. They should also explain how a challenge can reach the reviewer. A promise that evidence exists is of little help if the promised source cannot be inspected or if an old permission has been stretched to cover a new use.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 记录需要合适访问范围。公共结论可以说明批次、未完成功能与签章决定，同时保护无关住户信息。受控复核人也许需要完整技术字段及查原稿的通路。这些安排应注明接收方、用途、版本，并说明如何提出质疑。若承诺来源无法查阅，或把旧许可扩成新用途，仅声称有证据并没有多大帮助。

entries.english_definition: A defined area within a town or region.

contexts.paragraph_english: Leave the Glimmer at the marked berth while the landing clerk checks your vessel record and the cross-district commission. Registering here establishes an arrival and a route back to this landing. It does not give access to private rooms or restricted names.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 请把微光号停在标记泊位，由接驳员核对船只记录与跨区核查委托。此处登记记录一次实际到港，并建立返回这个接驳站的路线。私人房间与受限姓名另有访问范围。

contexts.paragraph_english: Ada: I want the residents to see why a place full of people was treated as an empty district. But I do not want their private papers spread around as proof that we matter. Put the authorisations and their limits before us. Keep the people who appear only in unrelated files out of the public extract. Some of our neighbours will prefer the protected session; that preference is not support for hiding the orders. Others want an emergency public record. Both routes must leave a way to correct a mistaken account after today.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 阿妲：居民应看清住满人的地方为何被当成空区，但不愿用四散私纸证明存在。公开授权及限制，无关档里的人不进摘录。有人偏受保护场，并非支持藏命令；有人要应急公开，两种都须留下今日后纠错路径。

contexts.paragraph_english: The priory index names maintenance batch MC-2. Its destination is this district's workshop. Pera, the mine forewoman, can define a local inspection and rescue assignment. The documents already carried from the priory remain useful as references, but they do not contain the workshop's original checks or a completed finding about its signatory.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 修院索引指向检修批次MC-2，目的地是本区工坊。矿区领班佩拉可说明本地查验与救援工作范围。带来的修院文件可以作为索引，却没有工坊原始检查，也没有关于签章人的完整核查结论。

contexts.paragraph_english: Extraction and disturbance rose together in this short record. Pump operation, nearby machines and sampling conditions also need checking. The sheet provides a traceable question for the academic review: which factors can explain the pattern, and under what conditions could it be reproduced? It cannot by itself show that mining created the mist, that every district has the same response, or that a shutdown will clear the weather immediately.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 这份短记录里，抽取与扰动同时上升。泵房运作、附近机械和采样条件也需核查。资料为学城提出可追查问题：哪些因素能够解释此模式，怎样的条件下可以复现？仅凭它尚不能说明开采创造了雾海、每个地区反应相同，或停机会立即放晴。

entries.english_definition: A settlement smaller than a large city.

contexts.paragraph_english: When the town of Alder introduced a new evening bus service, the announcement promised a better connection between its railway station and three residential districts. The published timetable showed a bus leaving ten minutes after each of the main evening trains. For passengers who had previously faced a long walk or an expensive taxi journey, the arrangement appeared straightforward. Yet during the first month, complaints arrived from people who had missed their connection even though their train had reached the station on time.

Before sending anyone through, tell us which return route was inspected and whether the wet pump area has a current safety check. If a check fails, keep the group at the safe shelter and repair the local fault. There is no reason to erase the town's earlier receipts or ask people to return below after they have already been received.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 派人通过前，请说明哪条返程路已检查、潮湿泵房区域是否有当前安全记录。检查失败时，让人员留在安全避护处，修复本地故障。无需删除矿镇先前回执，也不能要求已接收的人重新下井。

contexts.paragraph_english: The town tried a more limited change. For six weeks, the first bus after the busiest train waited an additional five minutes. The other services kept their published departure times. Staff placed signs along the walking route and asked the station to check the lift before the evening peak. This trial combined a timetable change with improvements to the connection itself. Consequently, a reduction in missed buses would not, on its own, show which part of the trial had produced the improvement.

The town's emergency stock provides twelve meal portions, three first-aid packs and one declared shift of wage cover. Take and deliver these local supplies through the receiving desk; a draft request cannot create them. Their use is part of basic protection. Extra workshop packages will be allocated separately after the rescue. Personal equipment parts and the six-tower engineering cargo remain in their own accounts.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 矿镇应急库存提供十二份暖食、三包急救用品与一班工资保障凭据。应通过接收台实际领取和交付，写申请不能生成物资。这是基本保障；救援后另行分配额外工包。个人装备零件和六塔工程货仍在各自账内。

entries.english_definition: Land surrounded by water.

contexts.paragraph_english: The records custodian can grant a bounded review of the retained manuscript, issued report and circulation register. Access depends on the purpose and necessary fields, not on agreeing with a political position. Keep any unfavourable result. The old trial hall is a separate physical assignment. You may pursue that work while preparing your data overview; the small island trial will require both work streams.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 记录保管人可按范围开放留存原稿、发行稿及流转册。访问取决于用途和必要字段，不取决于政治观点。应保留不利结果。旧试验厅是另一项实体工作，可在准备数据概览时并行推进；小规模孤网试验需要两边完成。

contexts.paragraph_english: Dispatch officer: The dangerous programme has a current safe-stop receipt, and this desk now has the actual decision-node permission. We will show the sealed preparation and every missing qualification before you choose. Restricted central and orderly island arrangements depend on base preservation and current safety. Distribution needs the additional actual work that has been visible since the glass city. A statement of support cannot complete that work.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 调度值守：危险程序有当前安全停止回执，此台也已有实际决策节点许可。选择前显示封存准备及每项缺项。受限中央与有序孤网需基础保全和当前安全，分布需学城起已公开的额外实体工作，表态支持不能完成工作。

contexts.paragraph_english: The calibration room contains the installed island-trial controller C, a local reserve module and two labelled channels. Channel Z is the zero reference; channel R is the fixed reference mark. Check Z at 0 and R at 10 before recording a calibration. These are local instrument marks, not tower operating units. Both checks must belong to the current instrument revision. Changing the channel connection or bypassing its isolation invalidates the previous check.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 校准间已装孤网控制器C、本地储备模块和两标记通道。Z为零参考，R为固定参考标。记录校准前，Z应为0、R应为10；它们是本地仪表标记，不是塔运行单位。两检查都应属于当前仪表版本，改连接或绕隔离令旧检查失效。

contexts.paragraph_english: Before the live island arrangement, control the calibration defence from the external stand, inspect the isolation, seat the labelled reserve connector and secure both guards. The checked reserve is the room's installed reserve, not the Glimmer's battery. Declare a local duty officer and a review officer for the bounded current window. These are trial posts only; they do not occupy or grant permanent six-tower operator posts.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 带载孤网准备前，从外侧站位制止校准防卫，检查隔离、座好带标储备连接头并固定护罩。受检储备属于此室，不是微光号电池。为当前有限窗口明确试验操作员与复核员；这些是试验岗位，没有占用或授予六塔永久岗位。

entries.english_definition: A place where minerals are extracted from the ground.

contexts.paragraph_english: The index links local interlock plate IL-2 to maintenance batch MC-2 at the bell-mine workshop. It records a destination for checking the batch's original instrument sheets and acceptance versions. The priory copy contains the batch reference and a dispatch acknowledgement, not the workshop's complete technical file.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本地联锁标牌IL-2在索引中关联沉钟矿区工坊检修批次MC-2，指明应到何处核对该批次原始仪表页与验收版本。修院副本只有批次索引与发件确认，没有工坊完整技术档案。

contexts.paragraph_english: The historical signature page also needs its limit recorded. Its early version is evidence of a connection to examine, and the missing change history remains part of the question. The mining batch index gives the next destination for checking that history. Our acknowledgement will state exactly what we received and what is still unverified; it will not report a mine visit that has not happened.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 历史签名页也须保留限制。早期版本提供待查关联，缺失变更史仍是问题的一部分。矿区批次索引给出下一处核查方向。我们的确认会写明收到什么、哪些内容未核实，不会写成尚未发生的矿区访问。

contexts.paragraph_english: Keep the destination as the next inquiry direction. A file reference is not an authority to operate the mine, a delivery of engineering components or proof that the Glimmer has sailed there.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 这是一条下一步方向。档案编号不会赋予矿井操作权，不交付工程组件，也不证明微光号已经航行到那里。

contexts.paragraph_english: Berth the Glimmer at the marked landing and let the freight clerk check the vessel-use record, the completed priory handover and your commission. Register the arrival here before entering the mine. This desk keeps the route back to the vessel available; it does not issue permission to operate underground machinery.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 请把微光号停在标记泊位，让货运员核对船只使用记录、已完成的修院交接与核查委托。进入矿井前在此登记到港。此台保留返回船只的通路；地下设备操作另需许可。

entries.english_definition: A place or collection where written materials are kept for use.

contexts.paragraph_english: Good afternoon. Today I want to explain how our college evaluated a trial of later library opening. You may have seen the announcement saying that the trial was successful. That description needs a little care. The library was used more often in the evening, but that does not answer every question about whether the change should become permanent. I will go through what changed, what we measured and what we still need to find out.

First, the practical arrangement. Before the trial, the library closed at six on weekdays. During the trial it stayed open until eight, but only on Tuesdays and Thursdays. We did not add weekend hours. The original proposal had included Monday as well, and some early notices referred to three evenings. However, there were not enough trained staff to cover all three. Anyone using those early notices would have had the wrong information, so the final timetable was placed beside the entrance and sent to students.

The most common reason given on the forms was the need for a quiet place to work. Access to specialist materials was mentioned less often. That finding led one member of the team to suggest opening a supervised study room instead of the whole library. It might meet much of the demand at a lower staffing cost. But another member pointed out that a less common need can still be important. A small group may depend on equipment or collections that cannot be moved into an ordinary room.

entries.english_definition: An institution devoted to study or professional training.

contexts.paragraph_english: The reusable preparation issue technical-d3-v1 follows the academy’s retained failures, current bounded successful configuration and public handover. Controller C, checked reserve, local isolation and qualified duty supported a limited circuit at the tested load. The issue records how to install and inspect that bounded arrangement; it is not a measurement of all six towers. Each district must still inspect its real installation, receive transition supplies, obtain a local trial permit and run the current configuration. Keep the old failed and successful observations.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 可复用准备稿technical-d3-v1继承学城保留反例、当前有限成功配置和公开交接。控制器C、受检备用、当地隔离及合格岗位支持已测试负荷下的有限回路。该稿说明如何安装检查这个受限安排，不是六塔全网测量。各地还须检查实际安装、取得过渡供给和地方试验许可，并按当前配置试运行；保留旧成功和失败观察。

contexts.paragraph_english: Technical reviewer: The academy retained unsuccessful runs as well as a bounded successful one. The current preparation issue states the controller, tested load, reserve, isolation and limited contact used in that successful arrangement. It gives us something specific to install and examine. It does not certify six unvisited towers. For an enhanced tower, we still need the actual controller and couplers, transition supply, qualified duty and a current field trial. Replacing an installation makes its old trial historical. Keep the old trial visible, then check the changed arrangement rather than copying its old result.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 技术复核岗：学城保留失败和受限成功。准备稿写成功安排的控制器、负荷、备用、隔离和有限联系，给出可安装检查的具体对象，不认证六处未访塔。增强仍需实物、过渡供给、合格值守和当前现场测试。换安装后旧测试成为历史，要保留但重检，不复制结果。

contexts.paragraph_english: The academy's bounded successful experiment supports a preparation scheme, while its preserved failures describe conditions the scheme must avoid. Together they justify a versioned technical issue; they do not measure six unvisited installations. At each tower the operator checks local isolation, backup, the protected service and the actual return arrangement before observing the present output. A changed installation expires the old trial. The local permit concerns a trial under qualified duty. The later common protocol is a separate agreement, so refusing a final policy today does not prevent a necessary current safety check.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 学城受限成功支持准备方案，保留失败说明要避开的条件，二者支持有版本的技术稿，却不是六处未访安装的测量。各塔先核隔离、备用、保护服务和返程，再观察当前输出。改安装使旧测试失效。地方许可针对合格值守下的试验，共同协议另签，不因今天拒选最终政策就阻止安全检查。

entries.english_definition: A place where meals are prepared.

contexts.paragraph_english: Present-stage kitchen sheet, local group A–C. Room A: eight portions prepared, eight collected. Room B: ten prepared, ten collected. Room C: six prepared, six collected. Total: twenty-four prepared and twenty-four collected. Collection was recorded by the serving desk, using room codes agreed for public work.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本阶段厨房页，地方A—C住区组。A区：准备八份、领取八份；B区：准备十份、领取十份；C区：准备六份、领取六份。总计准备二十四份、领取二十四份。供餐台使用已经约定用于公共工作的房间代码记录领取。

contexts.paragraph_english: When I said the group was complete, I meant that the kitchen had prepared the full number of portions. If you need the order of arrival, please compare the receiving record. I can tell you what happened at this counter. I cannot explain who changed the official labels, and I have not agreed to have my private address placed on a notice.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 我说“组员齐了”时，指的是厨房按全部人数备了饭。要核查抵达次序，请比较接收记录。我能说明这个台前发生的事，不能解释是谁改了官方标签，也没有同意把私人地址写到告示上。

contexts.paragraph_english: The collection sheet was written at the kitchen desk. A copy filed in the reading room has the same source. It may replace an unavailable copy for access, but it does not supply a second witness.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 领取页原稿写于厨房台。阅览室存档副本与它同源，可以作为查阅副本，不能增加一名证人。

contexts.paragraph_english: The greenhouse supplies the priory kitchen and the public wash taps through two small local circuits. Water from the inspection stair has entered the upper transfer floor. Roots have also grown around the stopped conveyor. The public corridor remains usable. The stair may be opened for the locally commissioned inspection once the root-route threat is controlled and the stair boundary has been checked on site.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 温室通过两条小型地方回路供应修院厨房与公共洗水龙头。检修梯的水已流入转供站上层，根系缠住了停转的输送器。公共外廊仍可使用。根道威胁实际处置、检修梯边界现场核对后，地方检修委托可以开放下行。

entries.english_definition: Food served or eaten at a particular time.

contexts.paragraph_english: Basic archive access may be registered for this check. Names in protected attachments require a separate request, a stated purpose and a permitted recipient. Keep the public room codes in your working summary. No resident has agreed to publication merely by accepting a meal or answering a question.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本次查验可以登记基础档案访问。受保护附页中的姓名须另外申请，说明用途与接收方。工作摘要使用公开房间代码。领取饭食或回答问题均未构成同意公开身份。

contexts.paragraph_english: Serving witness: I remember the first meal because we had to borrow another pan. I served people from A and B, and I thought the whole group had arrived before the new labels appeared. That is how it felt at the time. I was not at the receiving desk, though. Someone else collected the portions for C, so I cannot say that I saw everyone that evening.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 值餐人：我记得第一顿饭，因为我们还借了一个锅。我给A、B区的人分了饭，当时以为整组人都在新标签出现前到了。我那时确实这样想，但我不在接收台。C区的饭由别人代领，所以我不能说当晚见过每个人。

contexts.paragraph_english: Receiving witness: I wrote the room assignments as each group came through the porch. A and B were already using their rooms when the kitchen began serving. C was assigned later in that work stage. I heard someone say the group was complete at the first meal, but I think they were counting portions. I kept the room sheet beside me, and that is the record I can check again.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 接应人：每组人经过门廊时，我记下房间安排。厨房开始供餐时，A、B区已经使用房间，C区在这个工作阶段稍后才获分配。我听见有人说第一顿饭时“整组齐了”，但我认为对方是在数口粮。我把房间页放在身边，可以拿原记录再次核对。

contexts.paragraph_english: The town's emergency stock provides twelve meal portions, three first-aid packs and one declared shift of wage cover. Take and deliver these local supplies through the receiving desk; a draft request cannot create them. Their use is part of basic protection. Extra workshop packages will be allocated separately after the rescue. Personal equipment parts and the six-tower engineering cargo remain in their own accounts.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 矿镇应急库存提供十二份暖食、三包急救用品与一班工资保障凭据。应通过接收台实际领取和交付，写申请不能生成物资。这是基本保障；救援后另行分配额外工包。个人装备零件和六塔工程货仍在各自账内。

entries.english_definition: A place provided for someone to sleep.

contexts.paragraph_english: Keep the greenhouse beds intact where a safe sample or mechanical clearance permits work. The kitchen feed will need a later load test from the machine room. Opening the stair establishes a route for inspection; it does not establish local power, tower safety or permission to change the central interlock.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 安全取样或机械清理可以完成工作时，应保留种植床。厨房回路还须由机房完成负荷试验。打开检修梯只建立查验路线，未证明本地供能或塔站安全，也未许可改动中央联锁。

contexts.paragraph_english: Both methods retain the greenhouse beds and leave a checkable result at the valves. Sampling secures the affected root section while its reaction is controlled; mechanical treatment secures the return and clears the external winding. Merely selecting a method does not produce a clearance receipt. The actual encounter or work procedure must reach its safe objective, after which the branch stands can be inspected again.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 两种方法均保留种植床，并在阀处留下可核查结果。取样方法在控制反应时固定根段；机械方法固定回流并清除外部缠绕。选择方法本身不产生回执。实际遭遇或工作程序达到安全目标后，方可重新检查支路。

contexts.paragraph_english: The trial ground has six covered beds available for this work segment. The growers propose two arrangements. These are estimates for the fictional local trial, not a forecast for every winter or a promise of a fixed harvest. Both keep one walkway open and use the same existing tools.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本工作段试种地有六个覆棚床位，两种配置均保留通道、使用既有工具。数字是虚构地方试种估算，不代表每年预测或保证固定收成。

contexts.paragraph_english: Arrangement Leaf uses four beds for quick leaves and two for stored roots. It is expected to provide eight serving-baskets soon and four storage-baskets later. Arrangement Root uses two beds for quick leaves and four for stored roots. It is expected to provide four serving-baskets soon and eight storage-baskets later. The baskets are local planning measures; they do not become personal inventory or tower provision packs.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 叶菜配置：四床快生叶菜、两床耐储根菜，预计较早八筐供餐、较晚四筐储藏。根菜配置：两床叶菜、四床根菜，预计较早四筐供餐、较晚八筐储藏。筐是地方规划单位，不变成个人背包或塔站保障包。

entries.english_definition: Places supplied for people to live.

contexts.paragraph_english: The display label credits the instrument housing to the workshop team and lists one presenter. The contribution book distinguishes construction, calibration and presentation: the workshop built the housing, two students checked reference marks, and the presenter explained the result. The presenter's speaking role is not evidence that the other work was absent. A revised label can name contributions without inventing additional people or changing the trial output.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 展签将仪表外壳归工坊团队，列一介绍人。贡献簿分建造、校准与介绍：工坊制外壳，两学生查参考标，介绍人说明结果。发言角色不证明其他工作没有发生。修订展签可注明贡献，无需新造人或改试验输出。

entries.english_definition: A place arranged for someone to stay.

contexts.paragraph_english: Accommodation index for the same local group: A has eight assigned places, B ten and C six. The index uses public room codes rather than private street addresses. Each assignment states where a place was offered; the porch visit states whether its resident currently confirms living here.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 同一地方住区组的安置索引：A区八个安置位，B区十个，C区六个。索引使用公开房间代码，不列私人街道住址。安置记录说明曾提供的位置；门廊走访说明当事人现在是否确认住在此处。

contexts.paragraph_english: The aim was not simply to increase the total number of visits. Students on placement had told us that they often returned to campus too late to use specialist materials. Other students said their accommodation was too noisy for concentrated work. Those are different needs. A student might require access to a particular collection, or might only need a quiet desk. We wanted to know which need the extra hours were actually meeting before deciding how to use the available staff and space.

entries.english_definition: The place through which someone can enter.

contexts.paragraph_english: The damaged feed supplies the pump-room drive. Identify that feed at the labelled isolation point and separate it from the wet work area. The isolation is local: it does not switch off the town's whole supply or the port generator. Deal with the threat at the pump entrance from the marked safe stand. A cleared entrance and an isolated feed are both required before the drainage controls may be handled.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 损坏线路给泵房驱动供电。应在标记隔离点确认这条线路，将它与潮湿作业区分离。该隔离只针对本地，不关闭整个矿镇供电或港口发电机。从安全站位处置泵房入口威胁；入口安全且线路隔离后才能操作排水控制。

contexts.paragraph_english: First, the practical arrangement. Before the trial, the library closed at six on weekdays. During the trial it stayed open until eight, but only on Tuesdays and Thursdays. We did not add weekend hours. The original proposal had included Monday as well, and some early notices referred to three evenings. However, there were not enough trained staff to cover all three. Anyone using those early notices would have had the wrong information, so the final timetable was placed beside the entrance and sent to students.

For eight weeks, the team recorded entrances during the extra hours. They also asked visitors to complete a short form when they left. I should stress that the entrance figures were visits, not separate individuals. Someone who came on six evenings appeared six times in the total. It would therefore be misleading to report the total as the number of students who had benefited. The forms helped us see patterns of use, although not everyone chose to complete one.

Residents have kept roads usable without restoring the city exactly as it appears on the earlier map. Some passages follow old service lines; others turn around buildings whose foundations have become unreliable. A remembered name may still identify the place where a family once lived, while the usable entrance now faces another lane. Local knowledge is valuable because it connects these changes with everyday use. It also has limits. Someone who repairs a street does not necessarily know the condition of a person behind a guarded door at North Station.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 居民维护道路，并未把城市原样复建。有的沿旧检修线，有的绕开地基不稳的楼。旧名仍指认家庭曾住处，能用入口却转到另一巷。地方知识把变化与日常使用连起，很有价值，但修街者不必知道北站看守门后某人的当前状况。

entries.english_definition: The route or opening used to leave a place.

contexts.paragraph_english: The centre of the cabin floor is cracked. A person may appear to cross it successfully while the damaged boards continue to move underneath. Do not use that as a load test. The emergency cabinet beside the port wall contains a hand tool and a short rescue line; both belong to this vessel's rescue kit. A loose gangboard is stored along the intact side of the cabin. Secure it across the damaged section, keeping its ends on sound supports, before directing anybody towards the shore exit. The reef path begins beyond that exit. This note describes the cabin passage, not the safety of the landing place outside. Check the shore notice before choosing an approach for the rescue boat.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 船舱中央地板已经开裂。有人一度踩过去，不能证明受损板材可承重。左舷救援柜存有手工具和一根救援索，均属于本船救援包。沿完好的侧壁放着一块踏板。先把踏板两端固定在可靠支承上，再安排人员走向岸边出口。出口外才是礁岸路径；本说明不能证明岸上接应点安全，需要另查岸边告示。

contexts.paragraph_english: Signal clerk: I first told the surface desk that the freight lift could carry the return group. Please change that note. The lift branch has not been tested from the cutting-face side, so it is not our present exit. The fixed inspection ladder beside the main lift is the route we can check now. It stays available when the power setting changes.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 信号员：我最初向地面台说，货运升降支路能运送返程人员。请更正这条便条。采掘面一侧尚未完成支路测试，所以它目前不是出口。现在可检查主升降机旁的固定梯道；供电设置变化后，这条路仍在。

contexts.paragraph_english: Start with a return route that remains usable if electrical power is lost. Check the fixed inspection ladder at the lift station. A working lift may save effort, but the ladder is the basic exit. Then clear the rail route, isolate the damaged pump feed and lower the local water level. No one should be sent through an unchecked wet electrical area just because a message says that help is waiting beyond it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 先建立断电后仍可使用的返程路。到升降站检查固定检修梯。可用升降机能省力，梯道才是基本出口。随后清理轨道，隔离损坏的泵房供电并降低局部水位。不能因前方传来求援消息，就把人送进未经检查的潮湿电气区域。

contexts.paragraph_english: Workers have practical reasons to want a repair accepted quickly. A closed route may stop wages, delay a meal delivery or leave a household waiting for someone to return. Treating every request for continued production as greed misses those conditions. Accepting an unsafe system without a limit can expose the same people to another danger. A responsible repair plan therefore needs more than a declaration of good intention: it needs a usable exit, a real supply arrangement, people assigned to the work and a point at which its conditions will be checked again.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 工人有实际理由希望迅速完成验收。通路关闭可能影响工资、拖延供餐，也让住户等不到家人回来。把每项继续生产请求都解释为贪婪，会漏掉这些条件；无限制接受不安全系统，又会把同一批人置于危险。负责的维修方案需要可用出口、实际供给、明确人员和再次核查边界，而非只有善意宣言。

contexts.paragraph_english: Draft contingency notice, prepared on D0 at 20:50. This copy was stored with the evening dispatch papers; its issue box is blank. The text describes a possible interruption of the harbour light and tells receiving crews to wait for a revised route message. A handwritten heading calls it an accident notice, but the heading does not identify a cause. Preparing a notice in advance may indicate planning for a risk. It does not, by itself, show that somebody intended a grounding. Preserve the draft label and the empty issue box when citing this document. The approval and execution records are held separately. Do not replace them with a conclusion drawn from the title.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: D0 20:50准备、尚未签发的应急通知。事故字样不说明原因，预先准备通知不能单独证明故意搁浅；引用时保留草稿标签及空白签发栏，另查批准与执行记录。

contexts.paragraph_english: All departures remain subject to the current navigation restrictions. Route A is closed until further notice. A previous journey through that channel is not evidence that it is safe to use today, and an older chart should not be treated as permission to enter it.

entries.english_definition: A written message addressed to a particular recipient.

contexts.paragraph_english: To the new technician, from Mara. If a record is marked for destruction, first ask who issued the instruction, which version it concerns and what other record can be used to check it. A tidy report may leave out the circumstances that made its conclusion seem convincing. I have enclosed a request to compare the public maintenance record with an independent source. Deal with immediate rescue work before following it. This letter was placed in the inspection post before your journey; it cannot tell you where I am when you read it. Do not treat my concerns as proof. Preserve what you actually find, including anything that does not support the explanation you expected.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 玛拉给新检修员的留言：遇到要求销毁的记录，先核对指令签发者、所指版本和可独立核验的来源。整齐报告可能省略形成结论的条件。附上公共检修记录比对请求，但眼前救援优先。信件在旅程前寄存，不能说明阅读时玛拉所在。疑虑不是证明，应保留实际找到的资料，包括不支持预期解释的部分。

contexts.paragraph_english: Dear friend, your letter reached me after the move. I kept thinking that I should write when I had something definite to say, and the longer I waited, the harder a first sentence became. We have a room now. The roof needs another patch, but the kitchen is serving meals and someone has put a shelf beside the window for returned books. Those are small things I can tell you without promising more than I know.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 亲爱的朋友，搬家之后我才收到你的信。我一直想等有确切消息再写，越等越难写出第一句。我们现在有房间，屋顶还要补一块，厨房已供餐，有人在窗边加了归还书本的书架。这些小事我可以说，不必承诺尚未了解的事。

entries.english_definition: Information communicated to someone.

contexts.paragraph_english: Draft contingency notice, prepared on D0 at 20:50. This copy was stored with the evening dispatch papers; its issue box is blank. The text describes a possible interruption of the harbour light and tells receiving crews to wait for a revised route message. A handwritten heading calls it an accident notice, but the heading does not identify a cause. Preparing a notice in advance may indicate planning for a risk. It does not, by itself, show that somebody intended a grounding. Preserve the draft label and the empty issue box when citing this document. The approval and execution records are held separately. Do not replace them with a conclusion drawn from the title.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: D0 20:50准备、尚未签发的应急通知。事故字样不说明原因，预先准备通知不能单独证明故意搁浅；引用时保留草稿标签及空白签发栏，另查批准与执行记录。

contexts.paragraph_english: Coast team to the stranded crew. We first marked the south steps as a possible receiving point. That instruction is withdrawn: a fresh inspection found the lower steps separated from their support. Use the northern reach beyond the low wall instead. There are four survivors waiting for assistance, apart from the technician carrying this message. Keep the rescue line clear of the broken steps. Once everyone is under shelter, send your position, the number of people needing collection and the approach restriction. Do not ask the boat to follow the southern marker merely because it is easier to see. We will acknowledge the request through the coast relay.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 海岸队更正原先南台阶方案：现场复查发现下段台阶脱离支承，撤回旧指示。改用矮墙外的北段。有四名幸存者需要接应，不含传递消息的检修员。索具避开破损台阶。人员进入棚内后，发送位置、接应人数和进路限制，接应船不会因南标记显眼就改走那里。通过海岸中继确认求援。

contexts.paragraph_english: Dispatcher: Before you collect any parts, there is a correction to the earlier message. We were told that the spare navigation beacon had been destroyed. The inspection does not support that account. The beacon itself still works; the damaged part is the bracket that holds it in place.

This record provides a dated observation. When writing about it, retain the date, the source and the point at which the observation was made. The extract contains no later release, interview or live message from Mara. The facility code is a direction for further investigation, not a verified present location.

contexts.paragraph_english: Comparison envelope for the coast recorder collected after the shore rescue. The original instrument label reports loss of the observed light signal at 21:14:12. Its last routine comparison with the ship clock had an uncertainty of approximately two seconds. The harbour control event is labelled 21:14:10 on a different clock. The handover copy reports a separate control-to-ship comparison within one second. The combined comparisons therefore allow a three-second interval between the two labelled clocks. These readings are consistent within that recorded interval; they are not evidence that every clock displayed an identical second. Together with the approved window and the duty handover, the records support a planned interruption with a required protection removed. Keep the original extract attached. Nothing in this envelope certifies the sender of the inspection mail as currently alive, safe or present at a particular destination.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 救援后实际取得的海岸记录器副本保留原标21:14:12，与船钟最近比对约有两秒不确定。控制钟21:14:10与其在已记不确定范围内相符，不是所有钟秒数完全一致；不证明导师当前存活、安全或去向。 值班记录另证控制钟与船钟相差一秒以内；合并两次比对界限允许两仪器标签有三秒差。

contexts.paragraph_english: The records custodian can grant a bounded review of the retained manuscript, issued report and circulation register. Access depends on the purpose and necessary fields, not on agreeing with a political position. Keep any unfavourable result. The old trial hall is a separate physical assignment. You may pursue that work while preparing your data overview; the small island trial will require both work streams.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 记录保管人可按范围开放留存原稿、发行稿及流转册。访问取决于用途和必要字段，不取决于政治观点。应保留不利结果。旧试验厅是另一项实体工作，可在准备数据概览时并行推进；小规模孤网试验需要两边完成。

contexts.paragraph_english: The custodian will check the requested fields rather than your political preference. Keep the manuscript and the issued copy together. We also need to see the old apparatus fail under its recorded condition. A stopped machine is an observation, not a reason to discard the room as useless. The safer alternative still has to work within a stated load, reserve and duty arrangement.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 保管人检查所申请字段，不检查政治偏好。原稿与发行稿一起保存，还须看旧装置按记录条件失败。机器停止是一项观察，不能据此把房间标为无用。较安全的替代方案仍须在注明的负荷、储备和岗位安排中工作。

contexts.paragraph_english: The original observation remained unchanged when the public report was prepared. To check whether an unfavourable entry was omitted, compare its identifier and publication version with the retained manuscript and issue register. The later report is a presentation of this source. It does not become an independent survey because another office copied it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 形成公开报告时，原观察没有改写。查是否漏去不利条目，应比条目标识、留存原稿和发行册版本。后报告是此来源的呈现，不因另一办公室抄写而成为独立调查。

contexts.paragraph_english: Retained manuscript GH-R7, reporting version 7: the outcome appendix lists T1 stable, T2 stopped, T3 stopped and T4 stable. Each entry names Controller A, ten minutes, isolation checked, load and reserve condition. The four entries are retained as favourable and unfavourable observations. The manuscript's cover identifies the intended issue as reporting version 7.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 留存原稿GH-R7、报告第7版：结果附录列T1稳定、T2停止、T3停止、T4稳定，各注明A控制器、十分钟、已隔离、负荷和储备条件。正反观察四项均保留，封面把拟发行件标为报告第7版。

entries.english_definition: A preliminary version of a piece of writing.

contexts.paragraph_english: A decision can be revised, but revision has physical limits. Before delivery, the team can change the distribution while the packages remain available. After a connection has been installed or supplies used, a new plan must acknowledge that state. Writing a different destination does not return the old package to the store. The same principle applies to duty. A person who leaves for a travelling assignment needs a local replacement before taking a new post. Clear revision rules let people change their minds without pretending that completed work and existing commitments vanish with the previous draft.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 决定可以修改，修改也有物理边界。交付前，物资仍在时可改分配；接线已安装或用品已消耗后，新计划应承认现状。另写目的地不能让旧工包回库。值守同理：某人离开参加出行工作前，需要本地接替。清楚的修订规则允许改变主意，也无需假装完成工作和已有承诺随旧稿消失。

contexts.paragraph_english: When the notice is received, its saved prose and world actions remain separate records. The writer may revise an explanation without changing the instrument, and a configuration change may require a new check without erasing the earlier explanation. Explicit confirmation connects the present meaning to the current draft and source versions. The receiver then verifies the physical work before closing the survey commission. Help with a structured statement makes the intended action clearer; it does not claim that the writer's English has been assessed or that a language examination score has been earned.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 正式接收时，正文与世界行动分别保存。修改解释不改变仪表，改配置需要复检但不删除旧解释。明确确认把意思绑定当前正文和源版本，接收人再检查真实工作后闭合调查。结构化辅助让行动意思清楚，不宣称已评定英语或获得考试分数。

entries.english_definition: A group of sentences developing one part of a text.

contexts.paragraph_english: The account must include wages without confusing them with a traveller's reward. Local wage protection belongs to the town's emergency arrangement. The coins or equipment parts earned for a completed commission have another owner and purpose. Asking a resident to wait for food until an investigator writes a better paragraph would confuse these responsibilities. Equally, an investigator cannot solve the shortage by listing imaginary stock. A receipt from the actual store and receiving group provides a firmer basis for discussion than either a polished promise or a large number written without a source.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 记录须包含工资，并与出行者奖励分清。本地工资保障属于矿镇应急安排，完成委托取得的刻币和装备零件有另一归属与用途。让住民等调查者写好段落才领食物，会混淆职责；调查者也不能靠列虚构库存解决短缺。实际库存与接收组的回执，比漂亮承诺或没有来源的大数字更能支持讨论。

contexts.paragraph_english: Pera: The delivery is the point at which the packages move from the store to the named work. Before that, a draft may be revised while the stock remains. Afterwards we must retain the real destination and whatever has already been used. A new paragraph cannot return installed material. The town's emergency wage voucher is also separate from the travelling commission's reward. I will not ask someone to fund the agreed basic protection from personal upgrade parts, and I will not describe the six-tower cargo as if it were already in this store.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 佩拉：交付使工包从库内转到具名工作。此前，库存仍在时可以改草稿；此后须保留真实去向及已用材料，新段落不能返还已安装物资。矿镇应急工资凭据也与出行委托奖励分开。我不会要求用个人改件零件填已约定基本保障，也不会把六塔货物说成已在本库。

contexts.paragraph_english: Finn: A useful notice names the current risk, the supply we must protect and the boundary of the survey. We can say that current overload amplifies the network's difficulty without claiming that every cause is established. We can restrict unverified additional load without removing a settlement's essential protection. Tell the receiving crew which working stage your observations belong to. Do not introduce a countdown while someone reads the report. The world work changes through declared actions and new observations, not through the number of minutes a person spends considering an English paragraph.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 芬：有效通知写当前风险、必须保护的供给和调查边界。可说过载放大网络困难，不声称全因果成立；可限制未经核验新增负荷，不撤聚落基本保护。写观察的工作阶段，不在阅读时倒数。世界工作通过行动和新观察变化，不通过思考英语段落的现实分钟变化。

entries.english_definition: A grammatical unit expressing a statement or question.

contexts.paragraph_english: Dear friend, your letter reached me after the move. I kept thinking that I should write when I had something definite to say, and the longer I waited, the harder a first sentence became. We have a room now. The roof needs another patch, but the kitchen is serving meals and someone has put a shelf beside the window for returned books. Those are small things I can tell you without promising more than I know.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 亲爱的朋友，搬家之后我才收到你的信。我一直想等有确切消息再写，越等越难写出第一句。我们现在有房间，屋顶还要补一块，厨房已供餐，有人在窗边加了归还书本的书架。这些小事我可以说，不必承诺尚未了解的事。

contexts.paragraph_english: Tess: I will also show you the inner patrol latch. Inspect it from the station and check the two landing stands before registering the return route. That return remains useful after the present hazard is controlled. It is not the same as receiving the ridge cargo later. The four base components will need a manifest, two protected segments and a tower receiving check of their own. I would prefer a report that openly says the cargo has not moved yet to one that combines a safe survey route and an unexecuted delivery in a single cheerful sentence.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 泰丝：还会指出内侧巡检闩，从测站检查并核两个落点，再登记返程。处置后返程有用，却不等于后面的风脊货物收货。四份基础件另需货单、两保护段和塔站接收。我宁可报告明确说货物未走，也不把安全调查路和未执行交付合成一句好听话。

contexts.paragraph_english: The proposed response protects essential supply while restricting unverified load. contexts.paragraph_english: Pera: Then state the chosen policy and the allocation you want confirmed. Explain the costs you accept and the limits you will keep. contexts.paragraph_english: A limited transition may preserve enough output to support a particular transfer. contexts.paragraph_english: Duty officer: Use the installed terminal after the handover is recognised. If a displayed condition changes, stop and check that condition again. contexts.paragraph_english: Finally, set damping, verify the revision and approve controlled stop.
