contexts.paragraph_chinese: 三内部阶段共用本次生命、专注、AP、携带补给、配发、冷却、遗物次数和放置装置。切段没有补满。阅读、写作、翻译、澄清与实际播放音轨暂停计划槽，不提供恢复，也不在返回时补执行排队点击。撤退重试整个声明入口，没有内部阶段免费回满。

contexts.paragraph_english: Duty officer: Use the installed terminal after the handover is recognised. If a displayed condition changes, stop and check that condition again. You can revise your short entry message before submitting it. A translator or a structured confirmation may help us identify the intended action; neither reports that your free English has been independently assessed. This is a written transcript until an actual recording is played through its separate audio entry.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 值守：交接获认可后再使用固定终端。显示条件改变，就停下重查该条件。提交前可改短联络稿。译文或结构化确认可帮助明确动作，两者都没有声称自由英文已独立评估。这是书面脚本，听力需从另一个音轨入口实际播放。

contexts.paragraph_english: Finally, set damping, verify the revision and approve controlled stop. Approval preserves the check because it approves that configuration; an actual subsequent change cancels it. The machine's resistance is not a measure of how much of the tower to demolish. After safe stop, the dispatch desk can present the prepared choices without battle pressure. The record does not choose among them. This script must be read as a transcript unless its actual candidate audio is separately played.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 最后设置阻尼、核版本并批准受控停止。批准同一配置所以保留检查，后续实际改变才撤销。抵抗不衡量应拆掉多少塔。安全停止后，调度台可无战斗压力显示准备好的选择，记录没有替你选。这份脚本是书面稿，除非另行实际播放候选音轨。

entries.english_definition: The act of reproducing recorded sound.

contexts.paragraph_english: All three internal phases share this attempt's life, focus, action points, carried supplies, aid allotment, cooldowns, relic uses and placed devices. A phase transition replenishes none of them. Reading, writing, translation, clarification and actual audio playback pause the plan slots, without providing recovery or executing a queued click on return. Withdrawing retries the whole declared encounter entry, not a free refill between phases.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 三内部阶段共用本次生命、专注、AP、携带补给、配发、冷却、遗物次数和放置装置。切段没有补满。阅读、写作、翻译、澄清与实际播放音轨暂停计划槽，不提供恢复，也不在返回时补执行排队点击。撤退重试整个声明入口，没有内部阶段免费回满。

entries.english_definition: Understanding meaning in written language.

contexts.paragraph_english: To investigate, staff observed the route between the platform and the bus stop over five evenings. They also invited passengers to describe their journeys. The two sources did not provide identical information. Observation showed where groups slowed down, whereas the written accounts explained why some people needed to stop. A parent reported waiting for a child to use the station facilities; another passenger avoided the footbridge because the lift was unreliable. These were not errors in reading the timetable. They were conditions that the timetable alone did not reveal.

Local operator: Before we open the machine-room work zone, show me the upper-floor checks. The isolation handle must still be in the state you inspected. We also need the stopped conveyor record, the fixed external clamp and the dry-route reading. A successful action from an older configuration will not cover a change you made afterwards. We can repeat the affected check without throwing away the clamp or drawing a second unique connector from the cabinet.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 地方检修员：开放机房工作区前，请出示上层检查。隔离手柄必须保持核查时状态，还需要输送器停转记录、固定外部夹具和干燥通路读数。旧配置下的成功动作不能涵盖后来改动。可以重做受影响检查，不必丢掉夹具，也不用从料柜再领唯一连接头。

contexts.paragraph_english: The collection sheet was written at the kitchen desk. A copy filed in the reading room has the same source. It may replace an unavailable copy for access, but it does not supply a second witness.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 领取页原稿写于厨房台。阅览室存档副本与它同源，可以作为查阅副本，不能增加一名证人。

contexts.paragraph_english: The reading room offers a basic set of public records for the registered priory check. It includes room codes, record dates, duties and version references. Permission to read this set is tied to the purpose recorded at the access desk. A later request to publish or to inspect a protected identity is a separate decision.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 阅览室为已登记的修院查验提供一组公共记录，包含房间代码、记录日期、职能和版本来源。阅读许可对应访问台登记的用途。后续公开资料或查看受保护身份，需要另作决定。

entries.english_definition: Producing words in a written form.

contexts.paragraph_english: This record provides a dated observation. When writing about it, retain the date, the source and the point at which the observation was made. The extract contains no later release, interview or live message from Mara. The facility code is a direction for further investigation, not a verified present location.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 这是有日期的现场观察。写作时应保留日期、来源和观察环节。摘录没有玛拉此后的获释记录、访谈或实时消息。设施代码为进一步调查提供方向，尚不能确认目前所在地点。

contexts.paragraph_english: Resident representative: The warmer shelter matters now, but so does the transfer which some households are waiting for. I would like the proposal to say which work is postponed under each distribution. If we choose the transition, when will the materials used for production support become unavailable for shelter improvement? If we reduce immediately, who will replace the expected output in the transfer plan? We should be able to disagree about those costs without losing the meals and wage cover already agreed. Please record the conditions, rather than writing that every resident shares one preference.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 住民代表：更暖的安置处现在重要，一些住户等待的转移也重要。我希望提案说明各分配推迟什么工作。选择过渡后，生产支持物资何时不再可用于安置？立刻减产时，转移计划的预期产出由什么替代？讨论这些代价不应失去已约定暖食和工资保障。请记条件，不写所有住民同一偏好。

contexts.paragraph_english: I have crossed out the sentence saying that I will come next week. I cannot arrange that visit yet, and I do not want you to wait at the landing. What I would like is to begin writing again. If you are willing, send a short reply through the custodian, using the room code on the envelope. I would rather keep the street address off a public notice.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 我划去了“下周来见你”。目前无法安排出行，不希望你在接驳站等候。我想先恢复通信。若你愿意，请经保管人寄一封短回复，信封用房间代码。我希望私人街道住址不出现在公共告示上。

contexts.paragraph_english: Some of the next steps can be agreed before a wider inquiry ends. A local team can isolate a damaged connection, replace a part and ask someone other than the repairer to repeat the test. It can record that result without writing that all previous decisions were justified. A resident may appreciate the new signal and still have questions about the earlier acceptance. Requiring forgiveness as the price of a safety receipt would give that receipt a purpose it cannot serve. The condition tested, the observer and the remaining disagreement can all stay visible.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 广泛核查结束前，仍可商定下一些工作。本地队能隔离损坏接线、换件，并请维修者之外的人重复测试；记录结果时无需宣称此前决定都合理。住民可能感谢新的信号，仍质疑早先验收。若把原谅当安全回执的代价，就赋予回执无法承担的作用。受检状态、观察人和余下分歧可以同时保留。

entries.english_definition: An exchange of views about a subject.

contexts.paragraph_english: Allocation makes the trade-off visible. The district has six extra packages for this work stage, and a package cannot be delivered twice. Giving one to production support means it is unavailable for a shelter improvement during the same stage. Holding one for retrofit may improve a later arrangement, but only if someone can perform that work. Different groups may value those outcomes differently. A useful discussion compares what is delayed, who carries that delay and which conditions can be checked. It need not describe one eligible allocation as the only compassionate choice.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 分配让取舍可见。本阶段有六个额外工包，同包不能交付两次。交给生产支持，就无法在同阶段改善安置；留作改造也须有人实际执行才会改善后来安排。不同群体可能重视不同结果。可用讨论应比较推迟什么、谁承担推迟、哪些条件可检查，不必把某一种合格分配写成唯一有同情心的选择。

contexts.paragraph_english: Pera: The receiving desk has confirmed the three workers and the basic provisions. We can now discuss the extra six packages. I want the discussion to start from what is in the store, rather than what we hope a later shipment may bring. The basic services use seven of the ten load units: drainage two, ventilation two, warm room two and signals one. Keep that line separate. Reducing extraction must leave those services and the inspected ladder available. We are choosing an extra arrangement, not reopening the question of whether rescued people receive first aid.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 佩拉：接收台已确认三名工人与基本物资，现在可以谈六个额外工包。请从实际库存开始，不从希望后来有的船货开始。基本服务占十单位中的七：排水二、通风二、暖房二、信号一。这一行独立保留。减抽取须保留这些服务和受检梯道；现在选择额外安排，不重新争论被救者能否领急救用品。

contexts.paragraph_english: The account must include wages without confusing them with a traveller's reward. Local wage protection belongs to the town's emergency arrangement. The coins or equipment parts earned for a completed commission have another owner and purpose. Asking a resident to wait for food until an investigator writes a better paragraph would confuse these responsibilities. Equally, an investigator cannot solve the shortage by listing imaginary stock. A receipt from the actual store and receiving group provides a firmer basis for discussion than either a polished promise or a large number written without a source.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 记录须包含工资，并与出行者奖励分清。本地工资保障属于矿镇应急安排，完成委托取得的刻币和装备零件有另一归属与用途。让住民等调查者写好段落才领食物，会混淆职责；调查者也不能靠列虚构库存解决短缺。实际库存与接收组的回执，比漂亮承诺或没有来源的大数字更能支持讨论。

contexts.paragraph_english: The repaired old tool frame is a personal-line keepsake, with no combat-stat bonus. Keep the historical signature and remaining questions visible. If the private work invitation is withdrawn before confirmation, pause the private work and its outgoing discussion; the already completed main commission and public evidence remain.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 修好的旧工具框是个人线纪念物，没有战斗属性。保留历史签章和余下问题。私人邀请若在确认前撤回，暂停私人工作及对外谈话；已完成主线与公共证据继续保留。

entries.english_definition: A request for information or explanation.

contexts.paragraph_english: One proposal was simply to delay every bus by another ten minutes. Several passengers supported it, but the bus operators raised a practical concern. The same vehicles continued beyond the three districts to serve a small college. A later departure from the station could make those passengers late for the final class of the evening. Changing one connection could improve a journey for one group while making another journey less reliable. The question was therefore not whether additional waiting time was useful, but where and under what conditions it should be introduced.

Good afternoon. Today I want to explain how our college evaluated a trial of later library opening. You may have seen the announcement saying that the trial was successful. That description needs a little care. The library was used more often in the evening, but that does not answer every question about whether the change should become permanent. I will go through what changed, what we measured and what we still need to find out.

Basic archive access may be registered for this check. Names in protected attachments require a separate request, a stated purpose and a permitted recipient. Keep the public room codes in your working summary. No resident has agreed to publication merely by accepting a meal or answering a question.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本次查验可以登记基础档案访问。受保护附页中的姓名须另外申请，说明用途与接收方。工作摘要使用公开房间代码。领取饭食或回答问题均未构成同意公开身份。

contexts.paragraph_english: The historical signature page also needs its limit recorded. Its early version is evidence of a connection to examine, and the missing change history remains part of the question. The mining batch index gives the next destination for checking that history. Our acknowledgement will state exactly what we received and what is still unverified; it will not report a mine visit that has not happened.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 历史签名页也须保留限制。早期版本提供待查关联，缺失变更史仍是问题的一部分。矿区批次索引给出下一处核查方向。我们的确认会写明收到什么、哪些内容未核实，不会写成尚未发生的矿区访问。

entries.english_definition: A response addressing a question.

contexts.paragraph_english: Oren: I signed the MC-2 acceptance. The check sheet beside it still said that the safety bypass was incomplete. I should have refused to sign it as complete. I can describe the pressure during that handover, and I will answer questions about my own actions. My account should be compared with the instrument, workshop copy and formal version rather than used in their place.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 奥伦：MC-2验收是我签的，旁边的检查页仍写安全旁路未完成。我本该拒绝签为完成。我可以说明交接时受到的压力，也会回答关于本人行动的问题。请把陈述与仪表、工坊副本和正式版本比较，而不要拿它代替那些记录。

contexts.paragraph_english: Good afternoon. Today I want to explain how our college evaluated a trial of later library opening. You may have seen the announcement saying that the trial was successful. That description needs a little care. The library was used more often in the evening, but that does not answer every question about whether the change should become permanent. I will go through what changed, what we measured and what we still need to find out.
Pera: That is a useful repair. It does not answer why the earlier equipment was accepted with the safety check incomplete.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 佩拉：这项维修有用，但它尚未回答，为什么早先设备在安全检查未完成时就按合格验收。

contexts.paragraph_english: The independent field curves and the controller records answer related but different questions. Survey teams observed a pattern across places. Their locations differ in ground conditions, previous operation and available supply. A laboratory run holds a smaller set of declared conditions and permits a specific comparison. Neither dataset alone contains every cause. Combining them responsibly means naming their source roots and scopes, not adding copies until a claim appears certain. An issued report and its retained manuscript may expose a publication difference while still referring to the same original trial.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 独立现场曲线与控制器回答相关而不同问题。调查跨地点看模式，地层、运行历史和供给不同；实验固定较小一组声明条件，可做特定比较。两者均未含全部原因。负责任的结合要注明来源根和范围，不能多添副本便显得确定。发行与留存稿可证明呈现差异，仍指同一原试验。

entries.english_definition: A statement that requires evidence before it is accepted.

contexts.paragraph_english: A public summary is one possible arrangement. It can describe the group checked, the disagreement found and the limits of the check. It can retain source references without reproducing every protected name. Readers then know what is claimed and how a review may be requested. The arrangement works only if the promised review route exists. A notice which says that evidence is available, while no one holds an accessible copy or a valid inspection mandate, offers very little protection against an unsupported claim.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 公共摘要是一种安排，可以说明核查组、所见差异和查验限制，保留来源而不复制所有受保护姓名。读者因此知道主张什么、如何申请复核。但承诺的复核路径须真实存在。若告示声称可查证据，却无人保存可访问副本或有效查验委托，就很难约束缺乏依据的陈述。

contexts.paragraph_english: Sian: Start with what the sheets actually record. Two teams made field visits; a report office copied selected rows. Those are different kinds of source. A curve can guide a question without settling it. I will apply the same test to a claim made by the Authority and to a claim made by you. Please name a condition that your explanation has not yet controlled.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 西安：从纸页实际记录出发。两队做现场访问，报告办公室选抄部分行，两者是不同来源。曲线可以引导问题，无需先定结论。灯署的主张和你的主张遵循同一核验。请列你解释尚未控制的一项条件。

contexts.paragraph_english: The mine comparison has a useful, limited end. It can establish that an unrestored safety bypass was accepted as completed work and connect that decision to a verified signature. It can also preserve the observed changes in extraction and disturbance for further testing. The academic review will need to examine settings, instruments and other possible explanations before making a broader technical claim. Carrying forward those open questions does not weaken the local finding. It gives the next team a clear account of what is supported, what has changed and what still needs evidence.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 矿区比较具有有限而有用的终点：它能核实未修好的安全旁路曾按完成验收，并把决定与已核验签章联系起来，也能保留抽取和扰动变化供进一步试验。学城须查设置、仪表与其他解释，再形成广泛技术主张。带着未解决问题继续调查，不会削弱地方结论，而会让下一队知道哪些有依据、哪些改变了、哪些仍缺证据。

contexts.paragraph_english: At the actual device, inspect the defect, the local workshop repair pack and the agreed scope. Record whether Oren undertakes the work directly or with local help, who will review it and what is still pending. A work list completes this first commitment only when it follows the real inspection. It does not claim that the alarm is repaired or repeat the main mine rescue.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 到真实装置检查缺陷、地方工坊维修包和约定范围。注明奥伦独立承接还是与本地人共同补修、谁复核、哪些仍待做。工作清单须承接真实检查才能形成本节点承诺，尚未宣称警报器修好，也不重复矿井救援。

entries.english_definition: Something established as true by appropriate evidence.

contexts.paragraph_english: Route C remains open, but a vessel may enter it only if its navigation beacon is operational. The beacon must be checked in its installed configuration before departure. Permission to work on a vessel does not remove this requirement, nor does the fact that another vessel has already left the harbour.

Operator: If the load, isolation or duty changes, my earlier test expires. That does not erase the fact that the earlier test occurred. It tells the next team not to mistake history for the present arrangement. The result we can issue today is limited tower safety. Baseline reserve equipment, additional controllers, transition supplies and later field trials remain separate work. Ada: Put that distinction in the onward extract. We have had enough documents that look complete because missing work was described confidently. State what has actually been done and what the frontier team still needs to verify.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 操作员：负荷、隔离、岗位变，旧测试失效，不抹已发生测试，只叫后队别混历史与当前。今日可签有限塔安全，基础备用、额外控制器、过渡补给、现场试运行另属工作。阿妲：摘录写明，缺工作却自信描述的完整文件够多了，写已做与边境仍须核验。

contexts.paragraph_english: There is also a danger in using protection as a reason to keep every difficult fact out of reach. If an official label prevents food from reaching people who are here, a polite assurance that the files are private does not correct the problem. Someone must be able to check the classification and the evidence that challenges it. A custodian therefore has two kinds of work: keep unnecessary personal details within their agreed scope, and maintain a usable route for examining public decisions. The two duties require different records and sometimes different recipients.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 以保护为由封闭所有难以面对的事实，也有危险。官方标签若使在此生活的人收不到食物，礼貌地说“档案私密”不能纠正问题。必须有人能检查分类及与之冲突的证据。保管人的工作包含两项：将不必要私人细节留在约定范围内，也为公共决定保留可用的检查途径。两项职责需要不同记录，有时需要不同接收方。

contexts.paragraph_english: Choose emergency_public_redacted or protected_review. In either form, list the claim, the cited source version, the responding party and the response or explicit decline. Provide Mara, Voss and the station executive channel an opportunity to challenge claims separately. No response is not proof of innocence or guilt. Disputed interpretation remains noted alongside the fixed documents. The custodian checks that confidential identities are excluded and records that all three response opportunities were offered. A submitted essay cannot perform these invitations, overwrite a signature or turn a majority preference into a new historical fact. The resulting summary separates design and delayed correction, known-risk policy and testing, and cancelled review with detention.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 可选 emergency_public_redacted 或 protected_review。两种均逐条列主张、来源版本、回应方以及回应或明确拒绝；玛拉、沃斯、北站执行渠道分别获得反证机会。不回应不是无罪或有罪证明。争议解释与固定文献并存；保管人检查身份脱敏，登记三方均获机会。作文不会自动邀请、改签名或用多数偏好制造历史事实。摘要分开设计及迟延纠正、已知风险政策与测试、取消复核及扣押。

entries.english_definition: Reasons offered to support a particular position.

contexts.paragraph_english: Early reduction has a clear attraction. It removes the extra extraction load immediately and leaves more work supplies available for shelter and retrofit. Residents can see improvements begin, while the mine team checks what a lower setting changes. The cost is also real. Output expected from the current work period will be absent, and a transfer which depended on that output needs another arrangement. A responsible argument for early reduction should explain that substitution. It should not imply that stopping one process automatically provides transport, different employment or every part needed for a future tower conversion.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 尽早降载有明显吸引力：立即撤去额外抽取负荷，留下更多作业物资用于安置和改造。住民可看到改善开始，矿队同时检查低设置的变化。代价也真实：本工作期预期产出缺失，依赖该产出的转移需要替代安排。支持早降载的论证应说明如何替代，不能暗示停一道工序就自动提供运输、新工作和后续塔改造所有部件。

contexts.paragraph_english: We can describe the changes we noticed during work. We cannot say what the instrument measured while we were away from it, or why the accepted repair sheet differs from the check sheet. Bring those sheets to the workshop. Our rescue should not depend on choosing a position in that argument.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 我们能说明工作时注意到的变化，却不能说明离开后仪器测到什么，也不知道为何合格验收页和检查页不同。请把两份记录带到工坊；救援不该取决于我们在争议中选择哪种立场。

contexts.paragraph_english: These local choices do not settle the whole network's future. They create a safer present stage and supply evidence for the next inquiry. The academic team will still need to examine how load, extraction and observed disturbance relate under controlled conditions. Residents should be able to inspect the local costs without being asked to endorse a technical conclusion that has not been tested. A good arrangement leaves them with protection, an accountable receiving chain and an honest explanation of the work which remains. Its value comes from those results, not from the elegance of the argument used to propose it.

The manuscript's cover identifies the intended issue as reporting version 7.

contexts.paragraph_english: Issued report GH-R7, reporting version 7: the displayed appendix contains T1 stable and T4 stable. The outcome rows for T2 and T3 are absent. The issued cover carries the same reporting-version identifier as the retained manuscript. Compare the actual appendix and circulation record; do not rely on a title alone.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 发行报告GH-R7、报告第7版：所示附录只有T1稳定、T4稳定，T2、T3结果行缺失。发行封面与留存原稿使用同一报告版本标识。应比较实际附录与流转册，不能仅依标题。

entries.english_definition: Achievement of the stated objective.

contexts.paragraph_english: The receiving team checks all four base components at R6-S07 and retains their serials. Inspect the isolation position, backup connection, minimum protected supply and return route. The same delivered packet can then be consumed by its registered base conservation order. The local watch must be assigned and the four work stages verified before a sixth base reply is sent. Success against the platform alone establishes neither delivery nor base conservation.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: R6-S07接收组逐件核对四份基础组件并保留序号。检查隔离、备用连接、最低保护供给和返程线；这份已交付工包随后供给登记的基础保全单。必须指派当地岗位并完成四工作阶段核验，才发送第六份基础答复。击退平台本身不成立交付或基础保全。

entries.english_definition: Movement towards completing an objective.

contexts.paragraph_english: Tidegate maintenance procedure. The tower unit is separate from the west workshop machine and from the civil ferry supply. Confirm the local supply indication at the tower base before entering the control level. During the encounter, the left cooling valve is worked from the left front position and the right valve from the right front position. Either valve may be closed first. Local supply isolation is operated from the left rear position after both valves are closed. The interlock refuses an early isolation request without spending its operating allowance. Each person may operate one work point in a personal turn. Reducing the unit to its last reserve of stopping progress does not establish safety: both valves, isolation and a controlled threat are all required. Ordinary shields and cleansing cannot substitute for this sequence.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 潮门塔机械独立于工坊及民用渡轮。进控制层前在塔基查本地供给。左前左阀、右前右阀，次序不限；左后隔离需双阀完成，每人每个人回合最多一个现场操作。打至最低制止进度不等于安全，仍需两阀、隔离和制止。

contexts.paragraph_english: An attempt can be withdrawn to the safe stand and prepared again. Keep the installed brace, the actual feed state and unrelated rescue progress. Returning for a new attempt does not recreate consumed supplies or issue an extra task reward.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 可以撤回安全站位，重新整备尝试。保留已装固定件、真实送料状态与无关救援进展。重试不重新生成已耗物资，也不额外发任务奖励。

contexts.paragraph_english: The bench stops safely when its recorded failure condition is reached. It does not destroy a main-line component. Save the failed run and the configuration before resetting the local apparatus. A reset removes local preparation and current tests; it preserves sources, historical runs, the sample deposit and other districts' progress. No waiting in real time is required: the inspection controls advance the declared simulation clock.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 试验台达到记录的失败条件时安全停止，不毁主线部件。局部复位前，保存失败运行与配置。复位清当前准备和测试，保留来源、历史运行、样本交接及外区进展。无需实时等待，由检查操作推进声明的模拟时钟。

contexts.paragraph_english: The public preparation list puts those obligations within reach before the final decision. It names the verified scheme, six-tower changes, transition supply, common protocol and field trial. Each district can show actual progress, and an unfinished item stays unfinished. This is preferable to discovering a hidden requirement after a long journey. A report can compare options without choosing the final policy today. It should distinguish what has been achieved here, what needs work elsewhere and what the sources cannot yet tell us. That distinction gives the next investigator something useful to test rather than another promise to repeat.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 公开清单在终局前把义务摆明：方案、六塔改造、过渡供给、共同协议、现场试运行。各区显示实际进度，未完成保持未完成，胜于旅程末才发现隐藏要求。报告可比较方案而不今日定终局，区分本地已做、外区待做、来源尚不能告知之处，使下一查验有可检验事项，而非另一承诺。

entries.english_definition: A useful or favourable result.

contexts.paragraph_english: The end of a transition should be an action people can recognise. The duty team hands over, extraction falls to the agreed lower setting and the changed configuration is checked again. There is no benefit in making that boundary a penalty for reading slowly. It belongs to the actual work schedule. Recording its result gives the next shift something more useful than a statement that the plan once sounded reasonable. The safety route stays open, and the basic services continue while the team decides whether further work can be authorised.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 过渡终点应成为人们能辨认的行动：值守组交班，抽取降至约定低设置，再检查变更配置。把边界变成慢读惩罚毫无帮助，它属于实际工作安排。记录结果，才能让下一班获得比“计划曾听来合理”更有用的信息。安全返程继续开放，基本服务继续运行，再决定是否可授权后续工作。

entries.english_definition: A change that makes performance or conditions better.

contexts.paragraph_english: The town tried a more limited change. For six weeks, the first bus after the busiest train waited an additional five minutes. The other services kept their published departure times. Staff placed signs along the walking route and asked the station to check the lift before the evening peak. This trial combined a timetable change with improvements to the connection itself. Consequently, a reduction in missed buses would not, on its own, show which part of the trial had produced the improvement.

Stores clerk: Every extra package has one local identifier. If four go to shelter and two to retrofit, all six are allocated and none remain for production support. That is a feasible early-reduction distribution. Two to shelter, one to retrofit and three to production also meets the allocation limits. It supports a limited transition with less immediate improvement in the other two uses. We can consider a different distribution within the same limits. What I cannot sign is a list of seven packages, or a list which sends the same package to two groups.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 库管员：每个额外工包有独立地方编号。安置四、改造二就用完六包，不剩生产支持，这是一种可行早降载分配。安置二、改造一、生产三也符合限制，可支持有限过渡，但其他两项即时改善较少。还可考虑同限额内的别种分配。我不能签七包清单，也不能把同一包送给两个组。

contexts.paragraph_english: A repaired warning device changes what people can safely do tomorrow. It may allow a worker to hear a signal from another room, or let a supervisor repeat a check without standing beside the machine. That practical value should be recorded clearly. The repair also leaves a question about yesterday. If the earlier form said that the device had passed a check which was never completed, the new result cannot tell us that the old form was accurate. A useful account has room for both the present improvement and the earlier disagreement.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 修好的警报装置会改变明日能够安全做的事。工人也许能在另一个房间听到信号，主管也许能在机器旁之外重复检查，这些实用价值应记清。维修同时留下关于昨日的问题：早表若写着通过一项从未完成的检查，新结果无法证明早表准确。可用记录应容纳当前改善与早先差异。

contexts.paragraph_english: The six extra work packages can support shelter improvement, retrofit work or limited production support. At least two must go to shelter and at least one to retrofit. Production support may receive zero to three, and the three allocations must total six. The packages are counted separately from the twelve basic meals, first aid and wage voucher already delivered.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 六个额外工包可用于安置改善、改造或有限生产支持。安置至少二包，改造至少一包；生产支持可获零至三包，三项合计为六。工包与已交付的十二份基本暖食、急救物资和工资凭据分别计数。

entries.english_definition: A difficulty requiring action or explanation.

contexts.paragraph_english: There is also a danger in using protection as a reason to keep every difficult fact out of reach. If an official label prevents food from reaching people who are here, a polite assurance that the files are private does not correct the problem. Someone must be able to check the classification and the evidence that challenges it. A custodian therefore has two kinds of work: keep unnecessary personal details within their agreed scope, and maintain a usable route for examining public decisions. The two duties require different records and sometimes different recipients.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 以保护为由封闭所有难以面对的事实，也有危险。官方标签若使在此生活的人收不到食物，礼貌地说“档案私密”不能纠正问题。必须有人能检查分类及与之冲突的证据。保管人的工作包含两项：将不必要私人细节留在约定范围内，也为公共决定保留可用的检查途径。两项职责需要不同记录，有时需要不同接收方。

contexts.paragraph_english: A signature is often asked to do too much. Once investigators find a familiar name on an old design, the story can appear to have found its single cause. The simplicity is appealing: remove one author, reject one document, and the problem seems solved. Yet an operating system continues through revisions, authorisations and everyday decisions. Responsibility must follow those particular acts. If all later conduct is attached to the first signature, the people who changed the scheme disappear from view, while the original designer is either condemned for everything or defended against everything.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 人们常让签名承担过多。旧设计找到熟悉名字后，故事仿佛找到唯一原因；除一作者、废一文件，问题似解决。但系统由修订、授权和日常决定延续，责任须对应具体行为。把后来行为全挂最早签名，改方案者便消失，原设计者则被全盘谴责或全盘辩护。

contexts.paragraph_english: Eighteen years before D0, a serious shortage made short emergency synchronisation attractive. Mara helped design that response, and it had genuine benefits during the crisis. The original document nevertheless gave weak protection against indefinite continuation. Its exit conditions and independent review were insufficiently firm. These are design limitations, not merely defects invented after the present accident. A later correction cannot make them disappear. It matters that Mara subsequently acknowledged the weakness, but acknowledging a problem is different from having corrected it when correction was needed.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: D0 前十八年严重短缺使短期同步有吸引力。玛拉参与设计，危机中确有收益；原文防无限延续的保障却薄弱，退出条件及独立复核不足，非当前事故后才造出的缺陷。后来纠正不能消除它们，承认问题也不同于在需要时及时纠正。

entries.english_definition: One choice that is available.

contexts.paragraph_english: This distinction is especially important at the broken bridge checkpoint. The historic central span and the present controlled passage lead towards similar destinations on a small-scale drawing. On the ground they are different routes. The closed span cannot be made safe by presenting a document. The inspected passage does not require crossing that span, but it does require a current credential check. A service tunnel offers a further option once its actual obstruction and hazard are treated. The existence of alternatives should be recorded with their conditions, not reduced to a single arrow marked north.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 断桥检查点尤其如此。旧中央桥跨和当前核查通道在缩略图上指向相近目的地，实体却不同。出示文件不能让断桥安全；核查通道不跨断桥，却要当次查证。既有隧道则须处理真实阻碍及危险。记录替代路线及条件，不能简化成一个向北箭头。

contexts.paragraph_english: Custodian: In either option, we will keep the original versions and append later corrections. A redacted public finding is the minimum public account. The wider redacted option also includes technical conditions and limits, so readers can see how far the current test goes. Neither option releases medical notes, unrelated identities or home addresses. If we prepare a second working copy, its source label must still point to the same originals. A second copy can make access more resilient; it cannot supply an independent witness simply by being stored in another room.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 保管人：都保原版并追加纠正。脱敏结果是最低公开，较宽版本另给技术条件和限制，让读者明白当前测试范围。都不发医疗、无关身份或住址。另作工作副本也标同一原件来源；双副本可增访问韧性，不因另一房保管便成为独立证人。

contexts.paragraph_english: The option display must name each missing qualification now, using the sealed version and current physical safety. Choosing a preferred description does not install a device or make a different protocol current. If the distributed work is incomplete, central and island remain legitimate prepared decisions when the base and central safety conditions hold. Revisiting the protected pre-final adventure later may produce another result, but it cannot change the ending snapshot that has already been committed.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 方案显示应按封存版本和当前实体安全列出每个缺项。选择偏好说明不会安装装置，也不会使另一协议成为当前。分布工作未齐时，只要基础及中央安全成立，中央与孤网仍是正当准备方向。后来回访终局前冒险可另产结果，不能改已提交结局快照。

entries.english_definition: A choice made after considering possibilities.

contexts.paragraph_english: The reading room offers a basic set of public records for the registered priory check. It includes room codes, record dates, duties and version references. Permission to read this set is tied to the purpose recorded at the access desk. A later request to publish or to inspect a protected identity is a separate decision.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 阅览室为已登记的修院查验提供一组公共记录，包含房间代码、记录日期、职能和版本来源。阅读许可对应访问台登记的用途。后续公开资料或查看受保护身份，需要另作决定。

contexts.paragraph_english: Our recommendation is to keep the two late evenings for one more term while testing a supervised study room on another day. This is a proposed next step, not an approved timetable, so students should not arrive next Monday expecting the new room to be open. Before it starts, the college needs to confirm staffing and access arrangements. We will compare costs, types of use and the experience of students who need specialist resources. We also plan to ask people who did not attend the trial, because a service can look popular while still failing to reach some of those it was intended to help. That wider review should give us a better basis for a permanent decision.

Please separate a decision about a person's identity from a decision about those claims. If the person gives explicit consent for a particular identity field to be published to a particular recipient, record that scope and version. Do not treat an archive reading permit or a custodian's signature as personal consent. If the requested permission is missing, revise the fields or request another scope before sending. The basic reading room will remain open while you do that.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 请把个人身份决定与这些公共陈述分开。本人若明确同意向特定接收方公开某项身份字段，应记录范围与版本。阅读许可或保管人签字不能代替个人同意。缺少所需许可时，发送前修改字段或申请新范围；基础阅览室仍开放。

contexts.paragraph_english: Sometimes a person wants to be named. Their decision deserves the same care as a decision to remain private. Ask what they agree to release, to whom, for what use and in which version. A broad permission inferred from an earlier conversation may not fit a new publication. Equally, choosing the smallest possible package in every situation can remove the very detail that the person wants included or that the authorised review needs. Appropriate scope depends on the purpose and the permission, as well as on the risk of disclosure.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 有时本人希望具名。这个决定与保持私密同样需要认真对待。请问清允许发布什么、给谁、为何使用及对应版本。旧交谈推断出的宽泛许可可能不适合新发布。每次都机械选择最少字段，也可能删去本人希望保留的内容，或获准审查真正需要的细节。适当范围取决于用途、许可和公开风险。

entries.english_definition: An arrangement describing intended future actions.

contexts.paragraph_english: Arrival record — rescue passage from the stranded coast. The public arrival berth receives the technician and four registered survivors. Record their arrival before requesting further harbour work; a person carried here is not automatically signed onto another vessel's crew. Two different berths are shown on the quay plan. The civil ferry is awaiting maintenance and a safe departure arrangement. The stored patrol boat has no handover authorisation on this arrival record. A harbour officer may review a limited maintenance request at the public dispatch desk. Bring the rescue acknowledgement and your inspection appointment, and consult the current closure order rather than assuming that rescue passage suspends it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 搁浅海岸救援入港记录：接应泊位接收检修员和四名已登记幸存者。先登记到港，再申请后续港口工作；接应入港不自动成为另一船的船员。码头显示不同泊位：民用渡轮待检修与安全撤离方案；封存巡灯船没有在此记录中授权移交。公共调度台可审查有限检修申请，须携救援回执及任职凭证，并查现行封港令。

contexts.paragraph_english: Our recommendation is to keep the two late evenings for one more term while testing a supervised study room on another day. This is a proposed next step, not an approved timetable, so students should not arrive next Monday expecting the new room to be open. Before it starts, the college needs to confirm staffing and access arrangements. We will compare costs, types of use and the experience of students who need specialist resources. We also plan to ask people who did not attend the trial, because a service can look popular while still failing to reach some of those it was intended to help. That wider review should give us a better basis for a permanent decision.

Limited maintenance exception. Havel, the dispatch officer, may commission inspection and repair of the civil ferry's navigation equipment and the local workshop arrangements needed to obtain its replacement parts. State that the purpose is evacuation assistance and identify those work areas in the request. Harbour main-generator operation is outside this exception: its safety isolation has not been confirmed. A commission allows local preparation; the ferry remains at the quay until a tested current configuration and an explicitly confirmed departure plan are available. Neither a fee nor a language score is required to request the commission. Crew recruitment, patrol-boat use and access to retained accident records are separate decisions and must not be inferred from this document.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 有限检修例外：调度负责人哈文可委托民用渡轮导航设备检修及为取替换件所需的本地工坊操作。申请写明协助撤离及这些范围。主发电机安全隔离尚未确认，操作它不在例外内。委托只允许准备；当前配置测试与明确离港方案确认完成前，渡轮留港。申请不需费用或英语分数；招募、巡灯船及事故记录调阅均另行授权。

contexts.paragraph_english: A separate notice at the dispatch desk sets out the conditions for Route B. Crews should compare those conditions with the particulars of their own vessel rather than assume that a channel available to one boat is available to every boat. The departure plan must identify the chosen route and explain any equipment arrangements on which it depends.

entries.english_definition: The result an activity is intended to achieve.

contexts.paragraph_english: Both methods retain the greenhouse beds and leave a checkable result at the valves. Sampling secures the affected root section while its reaction is controlled; mechanical treatment secures the return and clears the external winding. Merely selecting a method does not produce a clearance receipt. The actual encounter or work procedure must reach its safe objective, after which the branch stands can be inspected again.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 两种方法均保留种植床，并在阀处留下可核查结果。取样方法在控制反应时固定根段；机械方法固定回流并清除外部缠绕。选择方法本身不产生回执。实际遭遇或工作程序达到安全目标后，方可重新检查支路。

contexts.paragraph_english: At the branch valves, we will identify the two blocked returns before choosing a procedure. The sample procedure and the mechanical procedure both have a safe objective. I will work with the local crew if your travelling companions stay outside. Please read the visible hazard plan before entering. A method written in your notebook is a proposal until the actual work is carried out and its result is accepted.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 在支路阀处，我们先识别两处受阻回流，再选择程序。取样和机械程序均有安全目标。若旅行同伴留在外面，我会与地方班组协作。进入前请读可见危险计划。笔记里选了方法，仍只是提案；须实际执行，取得被接受的结果。

entries.english_definition: A stated requirement governing what can happen.

contexts.paragraph_english: You may deliberately inspect the high-load or missing-reserve variants to retain counterexamples. Load 70, reserve absent, isolation bypassed or missing duty causes a safe stop under the authored finite rule. Load 55 is not in this protocol's validated set; the console will refuse to invent a result. Changing configuration expires the current acceptance. Historical successful and failed runs remain available after a local reset.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 可以主动检查高负荷或缺储备变体，保留反例。70负荷、缺储备、绕隔离或缺岗位均按作者有限规则安全停止。55不在此规程的已验证集合，控制台拒绝编造结果。改配置使当前接受过期，局部复位保留历史成功与失败。

contexts.paragraph_english: OC-D14.revision@2 records later higher limits and the gradual replacement of local interlocks by central control. It is a later policy revision, not the eighteen-year-old design sheet. OC-D30.correction@1 records Mara’s review thirty days before D0: she acknowledged the weak exit rule and the years in which she had not secured a timely correction. Her proposed local-control reconstruction remained incomplete and had not established full-network safety. The dated correction note does not erase her earlier responsibility. Nor does her failure to correct make her the author of every later executive order. Compare the actual version and scope of each signature instead of counting all papers as one continuous personal promise.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: OC-D14.revision@2 记载后来提高限额、逐步用中央控制替代本地联锁，是后来的政策修订，不是十八年前设计纸。OC-D30.correction@1 是 D0 前三十天玛拉复查，承认退出规则薄弱和多年未及时落实纠正；本地控制重建仍不完整，未证明全网安全。迟来的纠正不抹去旧责任；未及时纠正也不让她成为每份后续执行令作者。逐版比对签名范围，不把所有纸当成同一个不断延长的承诺。

entries.english_definition: Permitted under the relevant authority or rules.

contexts.paragraph_english: The displayed comparison becomes available after a lawful inspection of the original instrument, retained copy and formal form. A written summary should state its local scope, compare the main patterns and identify the records needed to examine a discrepancy. Preserve the counts as recorded; explain an uncertainty rather than filling it with an assumed event.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 依法检查原始仪表、留存副本与正式表后，才提供此比较。书面摘要应注明本地范围、比较主要模式，并说明检查差异需要哪些记录。保留所记数值；解释未知，不用假定事件填空。

contexts.paragraph_english: Station channel: The orders were issued as emergency protection. Custodian: You may contest a reading of the order. Please identify the version and the field you dispute. The station register records detention being carried out, and the override removes independent review during the test window. The present rescue is separately recorded. Station channel: I do not have an instruction to accept a transfer of command. Ada: Then record that reply without pretending it answers every claim. We have to make the local facility safe, and people must be able to leave this review without losing lawful evidence.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 北站渠道：这些令以应急保护签发。保管人：可反驳解释，请指版本字段。北站登记记录扣押实施，取消令撤测试窗口独立复核，当前救援另记。渠道：我没有接受指挥权移交的指示。阿妲：记录回覆，别假装它回答所有主张；设施须安全，退出审查不应丧合法证据。

contexts.paragraph_english: Before confirmation, an allocation can be revised while the packages remain in the store. After actual delivery, record their current destination and any work already done. Revising a draft cannot pull installed material back out or print a second copy of a spent package. An arrangement that needs a package no longer available must be changed or supplied through a lawful new source.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 确认前，工包仍在库内时可以修改分配。实际交付后，要保留当前位置及已做工作。改草稿不能拔回安装材料，或复制已使用工包。新安排若需要已不存在的工包，须修改方案或通过合法新来源补足。

contexts.paragraph_english: The proposed technical package contains the MC-2 instrument reference, retained-copy chain and formal acceptance version, with the current environment readings and their settings. Label the sample with the same observation stage and a lawful receiving purpose: academic verification of the recorded load, extraction and disturbance relationship. Include the known limits and any changed configuration.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 拟送技术包包括MC-2仪表索引、留存抄录链、正式验收版本，以及当前环境读数与设置。样本注明同一观察阶段，并列合法接收用途：学城核验所记录负荷、抽取和扰动关系。保留已知限制及变更配置。

entries.english_definition: Concerned with laws or recognised rights.

contexts.paragraph_english: Keep the finding at the location level until the next investigation has direct access. Knowing where a facility is does not authorise its rescue in advance, make a returned person appear here, or settle the designer's historical part in the network. Follow the next commission through actual travel and legal entry.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 下一查验直接进入前，把核查限于地点。知道设施位置不会提前完成救援，不会令被接回者出现在这里，也没有裁定设计者历史作用。下一委托仍需实际旅行与合法进入。

contexts.paragraph_english: The controlled passage accepts the patrol technician named in the current Glasshaven regional commission. Check the commission basis Q-404:resolution, its destination R5 and its purpose verify_north_station_and_legal_access against the actual landing register. Check the physical passage separately: the signed inspection identifies CHECKPOINT-DUTY-PASSAGE and explicitly excludes HIST-CENTRAL-SPAN. The checkpoint officer may verify these fields without granting detention-room access. If checking cannot be completed, use the basic service route. A copied historical credential or an unrelated action receipt cannot substitute for this current local check.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 核查通道接受当前学城跨区委托中的巡灯检修人。比对 Q-404:resolution、R5、verify_north_station_and_legal_access 与实际登陆登记；另检查实体通道，明确 CHECKPOINT-DUTY-PASSAGE 不含 HIST-CENTRAL-SPAN。核查员可验证这些字段，却不授扣押室权限。暂不能完成核查时有基础隧道解法。历史证件副本和无关动作回执不能代替当次检查。

contexts.paragraph_english: The workshop is replacing one public sign at the street junction, not renaming the whole city. Some residents request the historic name Reed Lane; others use the newer name Lantern Turn. Both groups remember the earlier street, but disagree about which name helps visitors today. The keeper offers either name with a second explanatory line if the proposal records local consultation and names the existing sign crew as maintainer. The sample boards are two alternatives for one installation, not two rewards. The choice does not change the verified subsidence date, property records or legal route conditions. This candidate has no registered experience entitlement.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 工坊只换街口一块公共牌，不给全城改名。有人要历史名 Reed Lane，有人用新名 Lantern Turn；都记得旧街，分歧在当下导航。经地方询议、指定既有路牌队维护，可选任一并添解释行。两样板是同一安装替代，不是双奖励，不改沉降日期、产权或路线门禁；该候选无登记经验权益。

entries.english_definition: The recognised right to give instructions or permission.

contexts.paragraph_english: Keep the destination as the next inquiry direction. A file reference is not an authority to operate the mine, a delivery of engineering components or proof that the Glimmer has sailed there.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 这是一条下一步方向。档案编号不会赋予矿井操作权，不交付工程组件，也不证明微光号已经航行到那里。

contexts.paragraph_english: Sian: Start with what the sheets actually record. Two teams made field visits; a report office copied selected rows. Those are different kinds of source. A curve can guide a question without settling it. I will apply the same test to a claim made by the Authority and to a claim made by you. Please name a condition that your explanation has not yet controlled.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 西安：从纸页实际记录出发。两队做现场访问，报告办公室选抄部分行，两者是不同来源。曲线可以引导问题，无需先定结论。灯署的主张和你的主张遵循同一核验。请列你解释尚未控制的一项条件。

contexts.paragraph_english: This request specifies a technical purpose and an official receiving route. It does not replace the local batch finding, erase a verified signature or give authority to rewrite the source numbers. The record desk must retain the actual fields and custody versions. A formal request may shape how an inquiry proceeds; its existence is not evidence that every question has been settled.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 要求列明技术用途与正式接收路线，不替代地方批次结论，不抹去已核验签章，也不授权重写来源数值。记录台应保留实际字段与保管版本。正式要求可以影响调查推进方式，其存在尚未证明所有问题已经解决。

contexts.paragraph_english: Sian Lune will define the public verification work in the courtyard. Safe return registration belongs to the landing desk. Neither a sample deposit nor an invitation to discuss findings gives authority to start an old experimental machine, enter a protected personal record, or publish an identity.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 西安·卢恩会在中庭说明公共核验工作。安全返程在登陆台登记。交样本或接受讨论邀请，都没有授予启动旧实验机、查阅受保护私人记录或发布身份的权限。

entries.english_definition: A recognised entitlement to act or receive something.

contexts.paragraph_english: Tidegate maintenance procedure. The tower unit is separate from the west workshop machine and from the civil ferry supply. Confirm the local supply indication at the tower base before entering the control level. During the encounter, the left cooling valve is worked from the left front position and the right valve from the right front position. Either valve may be closed first. Local supply isolation is operated from the left rear position after both valves are closed. The interlock refuses an early isolation request without spending its operating allowance. Each person may operate one work point in a personal turn. Reducing the unit to its last reserve of stopping progress does not establish safety: both valves, isolation and a controlled threat are all required. Ordinary shields and cleansing cannot substitute for this sequence.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 潮门塔机械独立于工坊及民用渡轮。进控制层前在塔基查本地供给。左前左阀、右前右阀，次序不限；左后隔离需双阀完成，每人每个人回合最多一个现场操作。打至最低制止进度不等于安全，仍需两阀、隔离和制止。

contexts.paragraph_english: Service record: A stop request by itself did not prevent reconnection. We marked the left and right forced-link branches, the finite renewal components and the damping check as separate objects. First isolate both forced-link branches and verify the current configuration. Either branch may be isolated first. Before verification, force against the main resistance meter has no effect. Do not interpret this as an instruction to attack a different, unlabelled facility.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 检修记录：单独停止请求没有阻止重连。我们分别标明左右强制联络支路、有限续启组件与阻尼检查。先隔离两支路并核当前配置，左右先后可换。核验前对主抵抗计量施力无效，不能据此攻击另一未标设施。

contexts.paragraph_english: Do not isolate every labelled circuit. Use SH-M, the shaft approach circuit, and check the local indicator after the sentry has been controlled. The action does not isolate the central machine's left and right branches. Keep the shaft result when moving back to the landing; it is a completed local operation rather than a universal tower permission.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 不能隔离每个带标牌回路。使用SH-M竖井接近回路，制止哨卫后查本地指示器。这动作没有隔离机组左右支路。返回登陆时保留竖井结果，它是完成的本地操作，而非全塔通行权。

contexts.paragraph_english: CMD-L and CMD-R carry Rook's local combat orders at the takeover floor. Shut each named transfer point, then control Rook and the two guards. These points do not carry the city's rescue communication. The left point is reachable from the front-left ally station; the right point from front-right. Each operation costs one action point and occupies that actor's control allowance for the current personal turn.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: CMD-L与CMD-R传递接管层鲁克本地作战命令。分别关闭标明转接点，再制止鲁克和两护卫。这两点不承载城市救援联络。左点由友方前左站位操作，右点由前右操作，各耗1AP并占本角色当前个人回合控制额度。

entries.english_definition: The recognised entitlement to possess an item.

contexts.paragraph_english: Harbour closure order — current copy. General departures are suspended while the navigation restrictions are reviewed. Rescue arrivals continue at the public receiving berth. An arrival under that provision does not grant a vessel permission to depart. The dispatch office may issue a limited local maintenance commission where the work supports a specific safe evacuation arrangement. The commission must name its work area and power boundary. It does not itself clear a route, approve an untested navigation lamp or transfer ownership of a vessel. A later departure instruction must be checked against the route notices and the vessel's current configuration. The public consultation desk remains accessible during the closure; restricted records and equipment require their own authorisation.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 现行封港令：一般出港暂停，公共泊位仍接收救援入港；允许入港不等于允许出港。调度室可为明确安全撤离工作签发有限地方检修委托，写明作业范围和供电边界。委托本身不开放航道、不认可未经测试导航灯、不移交船产权。出港另需按航道资料及船舶当前配置核对。公共咨询区开放，受限记录与设备需各自授权。

contexts.paragraph_english: Stores clerk: I have one further correction to the draft. It says the auxiliary alarm parts will come out of these six packages. They will not. The workshop offers a separate repair pack for that invited job, and the engineering ledger holds different tower components. Please keep the three accounts named. A repair can be useful without being a tower upgrade. If the proposed recipients change before delivery, show me the new distribution and check the stock again. If the packages have already moved, start from their actual current ownership instead of the old reservation.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 库管员：草稿还需更正一处：它说辅助警报器零件来自这六包，实际并非如此。工坊为获邀工作另备维修包，工程账又有不同塔部件，请分列三账。维修可以有用，无需把它叫成塔升级。交付前接收方改变时，请带新分配复查库存；已经转移后，从当前归属开始，不从旧预留开始。

contexts.paragraph_english: A brass cooking pot and a wrapped family sketch are stored separately. The pot claimant can describe its repaired handle and maker’s stamp; that permits a supervised object check, not access to another family’s sketch. The sketch remains under an individual reading permission that can be withdrawn. Public inventory descriptions do not include a hidden rescue key or a detention-room location. An uncertain ownership claim stays pending rather than becoming an accusation. Record the object identity and the permitted recipient before release; do not create another object for a second claimant. This optional candidate has no mainline gate or registered reward.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 黄铜锅与包好的家庭速写分开保管。认锅者描述修柄和制作者印记，允许受监督实物核对，不准读另家速写。速写需本人可撤回阅读许可；公开清单不藏唯一救援钥匙或扣押位置。不确定认领保持待定，不变指控；交物先登记唯一身份和获准接收人，不给第二认领者复制物。可选候选不锁主线，无登记奖励。

entries.english_definition: An agreement defining obligations between parties.

contexts.paragraph_english: Write a formal inquiry that names the two notices, the relevant time and the question you need answered. You may save it before deciding whether to send. This local activity is about ordinary study arrangements. It does not hide a network order or supply an essential ending condition. Its independent optional contract and reward remain to be approved; saving an inquiry alone will not issue a completion receipt.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 正式询问信注明两通知、相关时间与待答问题，可先保存再决定交付。这是普通学习安排，未藏网络命令或必需结局条件。独立可选合同及奖励待核定，存询问本身不出完成回执。

contexts.paragraph_english: Finn: Let us begin with what the six places need to preserve, rather than with a policy slogan. Every tower has a local contract for an isolator, a backup and two base provisions, with two qualified watches and one installation crew. Their owners and serials are available at the real worksite. A visiting technician must inspect them there. The shared account will then show accepted supplies, but its numbers do not erase their source records. Personal marks, spare parts and the Glimmer's battery belong to different accounts and cannot silently replace these protected components.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 芬：先说六地要保全什么，不先喊政策。每塔地方合同含隔离套、备用组、两保全包，两合格值守和一安装班组。归属序号在真实工位，技术员须到场。共同账显示验收供给，却不抹来源。个人刻币零件和船电池另账，不偷偷替保护件。

contexts.paragraph_english: Compare the retained book with the proposed wording before suggesting a revision. Unverified claims may remain questions for the organiser. This display activity is not a trial-safety approval or a reward source for copying the main report. The independent optional contract, delivery recipient and budget allocation are still pending. The original label and your saved proposal remain available together.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 提出修订前，比留存簿与拟用文字。未经核验主张可留给组织者作问题。展示活动不是试验安全批准，也不是复制主报告领奖来源。独立可选合同、接收方和预算分配仍待完成，原签及已存提议一起保留。

contexts.paragraph_english: Each tower needs one base isolator, one local backup, two base provisions and two qualified local watch posts. These come from that district’s inspected facility-conservation contract. Baseline work does not consume the player’s marks, personal parts or the Glimmer’s battery. Enhanced work separately needs one controller, two couplers, three transition crates and a reusable trial fixture per tower. Six public finite contracts supply six controllers, twelve couplers, eighteen crates and six fixtures. Reading this list grants none of them. The six local crews have capacity one each; optional companions and combat auxiliaries are separate people.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 每塔需要一隔离套、一当地备用组、两基础保全包及两个合格地方值守岗位，来自对应地区受检设施保全合同。基础工作不消费玩家刻币、个人零件或微光号电池。增强每塔另需一控制器、两联络组件、三过渡箱及一可复用试验夹具。六个公开有限合同供六控制器、十二组件、十八箱、六夹具，阅读清单不入账。六地班组各有同期容量一；可选同伴和战斗援勤另行登记。

entries.english_definition: An undertaking that a person is expected to keep.

contexts.paragraph_english: Private work invitation, auxiliary alarm A2. The alarm serves two workshop residential rooms. After the main batch finding, Oren may invite help to inspect its damaged connection and define a repair commitment. Accept, decline or pause the invitation; it may later be withdrawn. Accepting an invitation is distinct from permission to publish a conversation or from a decision to recruit him.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 私人工作邀请：辅助警报器A2，服务工坊住区两房。主线批次核查后，奥伦可邀请协助检查损坏接线，并界定维修承诺。可接受、拒绝或暂缓，后来也可撤回；接受邀请与发布谈话许可、招募决定各不相同。

contexts.paragraph_english: At the actual device, inspect the defect, the local workshop repair pack and the agreed scope. Record whether Oren undertakes the work directly or with local help, who will review it and what is still pending. A work list completes this first commitment only when it follows the real inspection. It does not claim that the alarm is repaired or repeat the main mine rescue.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 到真实装置检查缺陷、地方工坊维修包和约定范围。注明奥伦独立承接还是与本地人共同补修、谁复核、哪些仍待做。工作清单须承接真实检查才能形成本节点承诺，尚未宣称警报器修好，也不重复矿井救援。

contexts.paragraph_english: After Q-304 and the agreed A2 commitment, the workshop can release repair pack AUX-R3-A2 for the invited job. Its connection part is held for this auxiliary device and is separate from personal upgrade parts, the six local extra packages and the tower engineering cargo. The part must actually move from its pack to the device. A saved promise cannot install it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: Q-304及A2约定承诺之后，工坊可为获邀工作释放AUX-R3-A2维修包。接线件归此辅助设备专用，与个人改件零件、六地方工包和塔工程货分开。零件须实际从包转到装置；保存承诺不能安装。

contexts.paragraph_english: The current register includes every accepted on-site commitment and every transport segment in this world branch. A segment with cargo still moving must be actually delivered or deposited safely; a required on-site promise needs safe handover or explicit suspension. Ordinary unaccepted optional work does not block departure. Review the register after any new commitment. An old empty list cannot prove that the present branch has none.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 当前登记包含本世界分支全部已承接现场承诺和运输段。正在运输的货物须真实交付或安全托管；必须到场的承诺须安全交接或明确暂缓。普通未接受可选工作不阻止起航。新增承诺后重新核对登记，旧空清单不能证明当前分支无事。

entries.english_definition: Something a person is required to do.

contexts.paragraph_english: The public preparation list puts those obligations within reach before the final decision. It names the verified scheme, six-tower changes, transition supply, common protocol and field trial. Each district can show actual progress, and an unfinished item stays unfinished. This is preferable to discovering a hidden requirement after a long journey. A report can compare options without choosing the final policy today. It should distinguish what has been achieved here, what needs work elsewhere and what the sources cannot yet tell us. That distinction gives the next investigator something useful to test rather than another promise to repeat.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 公开清单在终局前把义务摆明：方案、六塔改造、过渡供给、共同协议、现场试运行。各区显示实际进度，未完成保持未完成，胜于旅程末才发现隐藏要求。报告可比较方案而不今日定终局，区分本地已做、外区待做、来源尚不能告知之处，使下一查验有可检验事项，而非另一承诺。

contexts.paragraph_english: For the patrol, the immediate obligation is narrower: compare the old layer with the present streets, verify one lawful route and preserve a safe return. A second route may be explored later, but completing both is not a test of moral seriousness. Nor should choosing the basic tunnel make the work less worthy than passing an official check. The result depends on whether the declared conditions were met. Beyond that result, the maps remain open to correction. A city is better represented by a dated, revisable account of its roads and residents than by a confident label that cannot be questioned.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 巡灯人的当次职责更窄：比对旧图及现实街道，核验一条合法路线，保留安全返程。另一条可后来探索，走完两条不是道德考试，基础隧道也不低于官方核查。结果取决于公开条件是否满足。地图仍可纠错；有日期、可修订的道路住民记录，胜过不容质疑的自信标签。

entries.english_definition: Required to explain and answer for a decision or action.

contexts.paragraph_english: The current shift has two duty posts. Their presence in today's register describes today's coverage. Future operation under a changed protocol requires a separate mandate, reservation and accountable handover. Inspection visitors cannot assign those posts by signing their own worksheet.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本班有两个值守岗位。今日到岗登记仅描述今日覆盖。改换协议后的运行另需委托、岗位预留与可问责交接，访客不能自行签字便分配岗位。

contexts.paragraph_english: These local choices do not settle the whole network's future. They create a safer present stage and supply evidence for the next inquiry. The academic team will still need to examine how load, extraction and observed disturbance relate under controlled conditions. Residents should be able to inspect the local costs without being asked to endorse a technical conclusion that has not been tested. A good arrangement leaves them with protection, an accountable receiving chain and an honest explanation of the work which remains. Its value comes from those results, not from the elegance of the argument used to propose it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 地方选择尚未决定整个网络未来，而是建立更安全的当前阶段，并为下一调查提供证据。学城仍需在受控条件下核查负荷、抽取和扰动的关系。住民应能查地方代价，无需被要求认可尚未试验的技术结论。好的安排留下保障、可追责接收链，以及对未完成工作的诚实说明；价值来自结果，而非提案论证的漂亮程度。

entries.english_definition: Giving people's relevant needs and rights due consideration.

contexts.paragraph_english: A fair emergency procedure therefore records opportunities for contrary evidence. Each claim needs a source and scope, and each affected party needs a channel to answer. Silence must be entered as silence, not converted into proof. Confidential identities can remain protected while the relevant authorisations and findings are shared in redacted form. An emergency public review and a protected review can both meet these conditions. They differ in audience and immediate exposure, not in whether the evidence is allowed to be questioned. The patrol’s writing organises that process; it does not create the response opportunities by itself.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 公正应急程序因此记录反证机会。每条主张需来源及范围，各方需回应渠道；沉默按沉默登记，不化证明。身份可保护，相关授权和结果脱敏共享。紧急公开与受保护审查都能满足，差别是受众及暴露，不是是否容许质疑。巡灯人写作组织过程，不会自动创造回应机会。

entries.english_definition: Usual rather than enhanced or exceptional.

contexts.paragraph_english: Tidegate maintenance procedure. The tower unit is separate from the west workshop machine and from the civil ferry supply. Confirm the local supply indication at the tower base before entering the control level. During the encounter, the left cooling valve is worked from the left front position and the right valve from the right front position. Either valve may be closed first. Local supply isolation is operated from the left rear position after both valves are closed. The interlock refuses an early isolation request without spending its operating allowance. Each person may operate one work point in a personal turn. Reducing the unit to its last reserve of stopping progress does not establish safety: both valves, isolation and a controlled threat are all required. Ordinary shields and cleansing cannot substitute for this sequence.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 潮门塔机械独立于工坊及民用渡轮。进控制层前在塔基查本地供给。左前左阀、右前右阀，次序不限；左后隔离需双阀完成，每人每个人回合最多一个现场操作。打至最低制止进度不等于安全，仍需两阀、隔离和制止。

contexts.paragraph_english: The most common reason given on the forms was the need for a quiet place to work. Access to specialist materials was mentioned less often. That finding led one member of the team to suggest opening a supervised study room instead of the whole library. It might meet much of the demand at a lower staffing cost. But another member pointed out that a less common need can still be important. A small group may depend on equipment or collections that cannot be moved into an ordinary room.

Harbour loan and cross-region inspection terms. Once the Tidegate local safety record has been verified, return to the receiving berth to acknowledge the loan of the sealed inspection vessel Glimmer. Its watch officer maintains the basic ship service; accepting a companion invitation is not a condition of using the vessel. The deck, archive cabin and shared maintenance compartment are three spaces of this one ship, not separate ships at each harbour. The loan does not transfer the civil ferry or its installed equipment. The next inspection commission points to the grove receiving records. It does not certify the current whereabouts of the missing mentor. Basic sailing along an opened route does not require a fuel ticket. The vessel still needs its ordinary gradual repairs; the handover does not turn it into a fully upgraded ship.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 塔站实际安全核验后回接应泊位明确接收封存旧巡灯船微光号及跨区核查委托。船务值守不依赖接受莉娜邀请，三空间是同一船。民用渡轮及船上设备不转移，不证明导师当前去向，不收死锁燃料门票。

contexts.paragraph_english: A limited transition may preserve enough output to support a particular transfer. It can be useful when the equipment and people must move in an order that cannot be changed at once. Its conditions are more demanding than the words 'for a short time' suggest. The load must have a cap, the window must have an end and two real people must accept the operating and safety-watch posts. There must also be a usable response when a check fails. Without those details, the temporary arrangement can quietly become ordinary production under a more reassuring name.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 有限过渡可能保留完成特定转移所需的产出，适用于设备与人员必须按难以立即改变的顺序移动时。其条件比“短时间”四个字更严格：负荷有上限，窗口有终点，两名真实人员承接操作与安全观察岗，检查失败时也有可用处置。缺少这些细节，临时安排可能悄悄以更令人放心的名称变为日常生产。

entries.english_definition: Containing the essential level of function or provision.

If the person gives explicit consent for a particular identity field to be published to a particular recipient, record that scope and version. Do not treat an archive reading permit or a custodian's signature as personal consent. If the requested permission is missing, revise the fields or request another scope before sending. The basic reading room will remain open while you do that.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 请把个人身份决定与这些公共陈述分开。本人若明确同意向特定接收方公开某项身份字段，应记录范围与版本。阅读许可或保管人签字不能代替个人同意。缺少所需许可时，发送前修改字段或申请新范围；基础阅览室仍开放。

contexts.paragraph_english: Basic archive access may be registered for this check. Names in protected attachments require a separate request, a stated purpose and a permitted recipient. Keep the public room codes in your working summary. No resident has agreed to publication merely by accepting a meal or answering a question.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本次查验可以登记基础档案访问。受保护附页中的姓名须另外申请，说明用途与接收方。工作摘要使用公开房间代码。领取饭食或回答问题均未构成同意公开身份。

Permission to read this set is tied to the purpose recorded at the access desk. A later request to publish or to inspect a protected identity is a separate decision.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 阅览室为已登记的修院查验提供一组公共记录，包含房间代码、记录日期、职能和版本来源。阅读许可对应访问台登记的用途。后续公开资料或查看受保护身份，需要另作决定。

entries.english_definition: Necessary for the stated purpose.

contexts.paragraph_english: This local note is separate from the chapter's essential evidence. Mira has offered a private invitation to consider the arrangement after the main archive agreement. The offer may be declined or left for another visit. The main transfer inquiry remains available.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 这份便条与章节必需证据分开。米拉在主线档案协议完成后提供私人邀请，讨论该安排。可以拒绝或留待回访，主线转移核查仍可继续。

contexts.paragraph_english: Finn: We have the old city's handover, including the direct confirmation of Mara's rescue. Keep that with the earlier responsibility findings. Today's station visit has a narrower job: find out what the present overload is doing to essential service and whether our return route can remain usable. I do not want a report that promises to explain every fog bank. If you use an earlier observation, identify its place and instrument. Similar-looking trouble in two places is a reason to compare the records carefully, rather than a reason to replace one record with the other.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 芬：旧都交接已到，包括玛拉获救直接确认，与早前责任核查一起保留。今天任务更窄：查看当前过载对基本服务的影响和返程能否保留，不要承诺解释所有雾。引用旧观察要写地点仪表；两地问题相似是认真比较的理由，不是互换记录的理由。

contexts.paragraph_english: The present tower duty has four declared local load units. Two are essential protection, one is public calibration service and one is a deferrable demonstration. Preserve the two protection units while reducing the demonstration load to zero; the calibration service may remain at one or be deferred with a recorded handover. This bounded current-duty reduction is separate from the laboratory load scale. Do not turn the tower off merely because a small controller was stable.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 塔当前班负荷四个本地单位：两个必需保护、一个公共校准服务、一个可延后展示。保留两保护单位，把展示降至零；校准可留一或有记录交接后延后。此当前班降载与实验负荷尺度不同，不能因小控制器稳定就关闭塔。

contexts.paragraph_english: Reducing excess extraction is therefore necessary work, but it does not promise an immediate clear sky. The mist existed before the present overloading, and past damage does not vanish when a selector moves. Essential protection and genuine cross-region help still matter. The Prism duty sheet separates protection, calibration service and a deferrable display. Preserving protection while reducing an unnecessary load is a current safety action. It does not transfer the tower into a permanent local scheme or deliver future equipment. Its result should be recorded alongside the trial rather than confused with it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 降低超额抽取需做，却不承诺立刻晴空。雾原已存在，选择器一动不会抹去过去损伤。必需保护及真实跨区互助仍重要。棱镜班表分保护、校准和可延展示，保保护并降非必需负荷是当前安全行动，没有把塔转成永久本地方案，也未交未来设备。其结果与试验并列，不能混同。

entries.english_definition: Required for something to happen or be valid.

contexts.paragraph_english: Copies are often necessary. An instrument sheet may remain underground while a surface team needs to arrange supplies. A carefully referenced transcription lets that team work without carrying away the only original. Yet two copies of a single observation do not make the observation independent. Counting documents can conceal this weakness. A stronger comparison identifies the original, follows the copying path and then seeks a genuinely different record, such as the acceptance decision. The purpose is to understand what each source contributes, rather than to collect the largest pile of paper.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 副本常有必要：仪表页可能留在井下，地面人员却要安排供给。有清楚索引的抄录让团队开展工作，也避免拿走唯一原稿。不过，同一观察的两份副本没有使观察变为独立。数文件容易掩盖这一点。更稳妥的比较会识别原稿、追溯抄录路径，再查真正不同的记录，例如验收决定；目的在于理解各来源的作用。

contexts.paragraph_english: A comparison note may propose what another observer should record next, such as the instrument, pump state and stage. Do not write that this extra sheet proves the final cause of the mist or unlocks a hidden ending condition. The necessary chapter samples and instrument evidence remain on the main route whether this point is visited or not.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 比较便条可以提出下一观察要记录什么，例如仪表、泵状态与阶段。不能写这页证明雾的最终原因或开启隐藏结局条件。无论访问此点与否，必需章节样本和仪表证据均在主路。

contexts.paragraph_english: The records custodian can grant a bounded review of the retained manuscript, issued report and circulation register. Access depends on the purpose and necessary fields, not on agreeing with a political position. Keep any unfavourable result. The old trial hall is a separate physical assignment. You may pursue that work while preparing your data overview; the small island trial will require both work streams.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 记录保管人可按范围开放留存原稿、发行稿及流转册。访问取决于用途和必要字段，不取决于政治观点。应保留不利结果。旧试验厅是另一项实体工作，可在准备数据概览时并行推进；小规模孤网试验需要两边完成。

contexts.paragraph_english: For public-data verification, the custodian permits review of report GH-R7 version 7, including observation identifiers, tested conditions, outcome entries, the issue version and circulation dates. Ask for those necessary fields and state the receiving technician and purpose. Political agreement is not an access condition. Household addresses, personal correspondence and unrelated medical fields remain outside this permission.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 公共数据核验可调阅GH-R7报告第7版，范围包括观察标识、受试条件、结果、发行版本与流转日期。应申请必要字段，说明接收技术员和用途。政治赞同不是调阅条件。住址、私人通信和无关医疗字段不在许可内。

entries.english_definition: Enough to meet a stated need or requirement.

contexts.paragraph_english: Evening duty handover, retained copy. At 21:05 on D0, a later work instruction removed the second traffic check from this test. The receiving operator recorded the change rather than marking the check as completed. A routine comparison at 20:40 placed the control clock within one second of the ship clock. The local control event copy lists the output interruption at 21:14:10, on the control clock. The instruction identifier and its issuing office are retained for further examination. This copy is not sufficient to establish what every officer knew or intended. The output event and the removed check should be recorded as separate findings: one concerns what the equipment did, the other concerns which protection was omitted. The independent coast clock was not set from this control clock.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: D0 21:05的后续工作指令移除了第二次人船复核，接班者没有把它标作已做。控制钟记录21:14:10断供；签发标识保留待后续核验，不能据此判定所有人员的知情与意图。 20:40常规比对记控制钟与船钟相差不超过一秒。

contexts.paragraph_english: This charged battery has sufficient reserve for the beacon during the planned evacuation. It is not intended to restore the harbour supply or power workshop machinery. Connect it to the repaired beacon and check the installed equipment before departure. If the connection is changed after that check, test the equipment again. The battery remains with the ferry once the evacuation begins.

entries.english_definition: Restricted in amount, time, or scope.

contexts.paragraph_english: Arrival record — rescue passage from the stranded coast. The public arrival berth receives the technician and four registered survivors. Record their arrival before requesting further harbour work; a person carried here is not automatically signed onto another vessel's crew. Two different berths are shown on the quay plan. The civil ferry is awaiting maintenance and a safe departure arrangement. The stored patrol boat has no handover authorisation on this arrival record. A harbour officer may review a limited maintenance request at the public dispatch desk. Bring the rescue acknowledgement and your inspection appointment, and consult the current closure order rather than assuming that rescue passage suspends it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 搁浅海岸救援入港记录：接应泊位接收检修员和四名已登记幸存者。先登记到港，再申请后续港口工作；接应入港不自动成为另一船的船员。码头显示不同泊位：民用渡轮待检修与安全撤离方案；封存巡灯船没有在此记录中授权移交。公共调度台可审查有限检修申请，须携救援回执及任职凭证，并查现行封港令。

contexts.paragraph_english: Stores clerk: Every extra package has one local identifier. If four go to shelter and two to retrofit, all six are allocated and none remain for production support. contexts.paragraph_english: At the dispatch duty stand, close_transition_shift performs the handover and sets extraction back to zero before the next shift. contexts.paragraph_english: Safety watcher: I can accept the separate watch post and record the checks for the current configuration. contexts.paragraph_english: Controlled extract, temporary supply scheme TS-18, initial signature page. The page bears the name and signature reference of Mara Venn among its contributors. The title describes a temporary compulsory synchronisation arrangement during an earlier supply crisis. contexts.paragraph_english: First, the practical arrangement. Before the trial, the library closed at six on weekdays. During the trial it stayed open until eight, but only on Tuesdays and Thursdays. Anyone using those early notices would have had the wrong information, so the final timetable was placed beside the entrance and sent to students.

Comparison envelope for the coast recorder collected after the shore rescue. The original instrument label reports loss of the observed light signal at 21:14:12. Its last routine comparison with the ship clock had an uncertainty of approximately two seconds. The harbour control event is labelled 21:14:10 on a different clock. The handover copy reports a separate control-to-ship comparison within one second. The combined comparisons therefore allow a three-second interval between the two labelled clocks. These readings are consistent within that recorded interval; they are not evidence that every clock displayed an identical second. Together with the approved window and the duty handover, the records support a planned interruption with a required protection removed. Keep the original extract attached. Nothing in this envelope certifies the sender of the inspection mail as currently alive, safe or present at a particular destination.

contexts.paragraph_english: Workshop custodian: The source reference on the copy leads back to the instrument sheet, MC-2.instrument.I@1. Its retained-copy identity is MC-2.retained.I@1. contexts.paragraph_english: A brass cooking pot and a wrapped family sketch are stored separately. contexts.paragraph_english: Your short final instruction should identify the chosen prepared direction and acknowledge its operating boundary. entries.english_definition: Not currently supported by available knowledge.

contexts.paragraph_english: Copies help when an original is fragile or a room is closed. Their source still matters. Two copies of the same departure note show that an account has been preserved in two places; they do not show that two officers independently observed a departure. A receiving officer's entry can contribute a different observation. The comparison should identify who recorded what and when, rather than treating the number of pages as the strength of the evidence. Unknown details should stay visible. A later copying stamp may explain when a ledger was updated without explaining why it was updated then.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 原稿脆弱或房间关闭时，副本便于查阅，来源仍然重要。同一出发便条的两副本说明记录保存在两处，未证明两名记录员各自看见出发。接收员记录能够提供另一观察。应比较谁在何时记录了什么，不应以页数代表证据强度。未知细节应保留可见；较晚抄录戳记可以说明更新总账的时间，未必解释为何那时更新。

contexts.paragraph_english: Keep to the marked observation stand unless a separate safe sampling assignment is given. A note can be useful even when no additional sample is taken. Retain the sheet's place, stage and instrument reference so that a later reviewer can compare conditions. contexts.paragraph_chinese: 另有安全取样委托前，请留在标记观察站位。没有追加样本，便条仍可有用。保留此页地点、阶段与仪表索引，让后来复核者能比较条件。条件未知时保留未知，不把主采点设置抄来填入此记录。

contexts.paragraph_english: The shaft's ordinary maintenance handle is installed at the marked stand. entries.english_definition: Missing one or more required parts.
