entries.english_definition: Distinct and not automatically treated as one thing.

contexts.paragraph_english: The shore winch has its own small reserve; it is not supplied by the harbour generator or by a ship battery. Switch its local power off and isolate the drive before seating the displaced cable. Secure the rescue line at the marked anchor, then set the receiving direction. The cable and line may be prepared in either order while the drive is isolated. Restore local power only after both are secure. Run the tension check with no people on the line. A check belongs to that configuration: moving the receiving direction, reseating the cable or changing power cancels its validity. The nearby animals must be kept away from the receiving path before the line carries people. If a check fails, keep people in the protected assembly area and inspect the preparation again; taking time to read this card does not change the number of survivors. The shelter retains a working short-range distress set for the shore receiving team. It can send the registered rescue request before the separate coast-to-harbour relay is restored. Harbour pickup is confirmed through that relay later; a saved draft at the shelter has not yet sent a request.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 岸边绞盘使用自己的储备，和港口发电机、船电池无关。关闭本地电源并隔离驱动后，重新落座移位的钢缆。救援索固定在标记锚点，设置接应方向；隔离状态下，钢缆与索具可按任意先后准备。两者固定后才能恢复本地电源，先空载检查张力。证书只对应当次配置；改方向、缆线或电源均使旧检查失效。承载前须制止接应路径附近的动物威胁。检查失败时人员留在保护集合处，阅读不会减少幸存者。 救援棚有可用的短距求援台，能先向岸上接应队发送已登记求援；海岸至港口的独立中继另行恢复，之后才能确认港口接应。发送台保存稿件还没有发送请求。

contexts.paragraph_english: Electrician: Keep it off. The inspection team has not finished isolating the flooded cables. The ferry has its own charged backup battery, with enough reserve for the beacon during this evacuation. That supply is separate from the workshop equipment. Once the new bracket is fitted and the battery connected, check the beacon on the boat. A working light on a bench is not the same as a checked installation.

This relay records signals locally even when its outgoing link is unavailable. The independent recorder and the outgoing transmitter are separate parts of the station. Before touching the displaced outgoing lead, switch the local transmitter off and isolate it. Seat the lead, restore the station's own reserve and run a link check. The test confirms this lead and power configuration only. If either changes, repeat it before requesting a boat. A successful link test is not evidence that a distant tower is safe. The postal locker may be opened for the named technician after the shore rescue has been completed. Its contents are correspondence, not a certificate about the sender's present whereabouts. The rear latch can be opened from this room to provide a shorter route back to the rescue shelter.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 中继站外发链路中断时仍可本地记录；独立记录器与外发设备是两个部件。检修移位接线前关闭并隔离本地发送设备，再落座接线，恢复本站储备，做当前配置链路检查。改变接线或电源须重新检查；成功不证明远方塔站安全。救援完成后，具名检修员才可领取邮务柜通信，它不证明寄信人目前所在或状态。后门内闩可从站内打开，缩短返回救援棚的路线。

contexts.paragraph_english: Inspection appointment. The bearer is a trainee technician assigned to public navigation maintenance. The appointment establishes a role, not unrestricted access to every power installation. Local harbour work must be commissioned by the officer responsible for the site. Follow the conditions on that commission and keep separate records for each device. A civil ferry's navigation lamp, a workshop's independent controller and the harbour main generator are not interchangeable authorisations. This appointment was carried on the inspection vessel. It does not certify language performance, membership of a faction or the present location of the technician's mentor.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 随检修船携带的任职凭证：持有人为公共导航检修见习员。身份不等于任意电力设施访问权；地方工作须由现场负责人委托，并按设备分别记录。民用渡轮导航灯、工坊独立控制器、港口主发电机不是通用授权。凭证不证明英语表现、组织成员身份或导师目前位置。

entries.english_definition: Used or held by more than one person or system.

contexts.paragraph_english: Harbour loan and cross-region inspection terms. Once the Tidegate local safety record has been verified, return to the receiving berth to acknowledge the loan of the sealed inspection vessel Glimmer. Its watch officer maintains the basic ship service; accepting a companion invitation is not a condition of using the vessel. The deck, archive cabin and shared maintenance compartment are three spaces of this one ship, not separate ships at each harbour. The loan does not transfer the civil ferry or its installed equipment. The next inspection commission points to the grove receiving records. It does not certify the current whereabouts of the missing mentor. Basic sailing along an opened route does not require a fuel ticket. The vessel still needs its ordinary gradual repairs; the handover does not turn it into a fully upgraded ship.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 塔站实际安全核验后回接应泊位明确接收封存旧巡灯船微光号及跨区核查委托。船务值守不依赖接受莉娜邀请，三空间是同一船。民用渡轮及船上设备不转移，不证明导师当前去向，不收死锁燃料门票。

contexts.paragraph_english: Tess: The apparatus uses Z for the zero channel and R for the reference channel. Isolate the local drive, check zero at Z and ten at R, and retain the configuration revision. Those are the apparatus marks, not storm hours and not a shared currency for every district's load figures. If someone reconnects the drive, the earlier check becomes an earlier check. It stays in the archive, but we inspect the present condition again. This is how the next watch distinguishes a retained observation from a current permission to use the instrument.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 泰丝：装置Z是零点，R是参考。隔离驱动，核Z零与R十，保留配置版本。这是装置刻度，不是风暴钟点，也不是各地负荷的共同货币。重接后旧检查成为历史，档案还在，但要重检当前情况，让接班人区分旧观察与现行许可。

contexts.paragraph_english: Inspect the two branch valves from their marked outer stands. The root core surrounds their shared return and may move when the conveyor restarts. Before entering the treatment zone, keep the conveyor isolated, identify both blocked branches and choose the stated sample or mechanical procedure. The local crew can assist under the inspection commission whether or not Mira has joined your travelling party.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 在标记外侧站位检查两条支路阀。缠根核心围住共同回流处，输送器重启时可能活动。进入处置区前应保持输送器隔离，识别两条受阻支路，并选用告示列明的取样或机械程序。地方委托可以提供协作，米拉是否加入旅行队伍均不影响这项协作。

entries.english_definition: Carried out by several responsible parties together.

contexts.paragraph_english: The original case OC-MASTER-01 is one physical case. Choose public_archive_bounded with the local archive custodian holding it under Ada’s witnessed register, or joint_sealed with Ada and the custodian requiring joint access. Neither choice destroys originals or creates a second original. Public scope can be redacted_findings or redacted_findings_and_conditions; both exclude names of unrelated cases, addresses and medical details. The latter also releases the technical conditions and limits. Supervision requires one local operation post ROLE-R5-OPERATOR, Ada’s resident review and ROLE-R5-ARCHIVE-CUSTODIAN’s evidence oversight. Technical participation by Voss may be supervised or suspended; her agreement with the final policy is not a qualification test. All three future policy routes remain open.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: OC-MASTER-01 是一个真实原件箱。可选 public_archive_bounded，由地方档案保管人持有、阿妲见证登记；或 joint_sealed，阿妲与保管人共同准入。都不毁原件或复制第二原件。公开 redacted_findings 或 redacted_findings_and_conditions，均排除无关身份、地址、医疗细节，后者另公开技术条件与限制。共同监督须 ROLE-R5-OPERATOR 操作岗位、阿妲住民复核、ROLE-R5-ARCHIVE-CUSTODIAN 证据监督。沃斯可受监督参与或停职，与最终政策意见不当资格考试，三条未来政策仍开放。

contexts.paragraph_english: Ada: The case on the table contains originals. We cannot make it safer by deciding that it no longer exists. The question is who holds that one case, who can inspect it and how the public receives a useful account without seeing everybody’s private record. The local archive custodian has offered bounded custody with my witnessed register, or a joint seal that requires both of us for access. Neither arrangement gives me authority over another region’s private records. I represent this neighbourhood in this emergency, not all six regions for every future decision.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 阿妲：桌上是原件箱，宣布它不存在不能更安全。问题是唯一箱谁保管、谁可看、公众如何得到有用说明而非全部私档。地方档案保管人提供其保管我见证，或双方共同准入封签。我不因此管别地区私档，只代表该社区的此次应急，不为六地区所有未来决定作主。

contexts.paragraph_english: The declared local load capacity is four internal units. Keep protection at three, archive preservation at one and discretionary reproduction at zero during emergency takeover. These figures are local apparatus units, not a real electrical calculation. Obtain joint work permission, isolate the relay drive, secure the rack and deal with ENC-R5-04 before testing. Appoint the actual operator, record resident and archive oversight and check the return passage. Any load, isolation or duty change invalidates the previous configuration test. Safe means this tower’s present limited protection is verified. Future basic work requires one base isolator, one local backup, two base provisions and two actual operating posts. Enhanced work requires one controller, two couplers, three transition crates and one trial fixture. These are requirements, not granted stock or completed work.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 当地负荷容量四个内部单位：应急接管保留保护三、档案保存一、非必要复制零。数字为当地装置单位，不是现实电工计算。先有共同许可，隔离继电、固定架、处置独立防卫再测试，实际任操作员，记录住民及档案监督，检查返程。负荷、隔离、岗位变使旧测试失效。Safe 仅当下有限保护；未来基础需一隔离件、一备用、二基础供给、两个实际操作岗位；增强需一控制器、二耦合件、三过渡箱、一试验器材。这些是需求，不是库存或完成工作。

contexts.paragraph_english: Send the bounded transfer demand to Rook’s executive channel and preserve the recorded reply. contexts.paragraph_chinese: 较晚分配房间不能解释官方记录为何写迁出；那些标签来自另一份名册。我可以让保管人为地方调查核对房间代码与这次观察。请把准确版本和陈述保存在一起。别人转述我的话，来源仍是我，不会变成另一个独立证人。

contexts.paragraph_english: This relay records signals locally even when its outgoing link is unavailable. The independent recorder and the outgoing transmitter are separate parts of the station. Before touching the displaced outgoing lead, switch the local transmitter off and isolate it. Seat the lead, restore the station's own reserve and run a link check. The test confirms this lead and power configuration only. If either changes, repeat it before requesting a boat. A successful link test is not evidence that a distant tower is safe. The postal locker may be opened for the named technician after the shore rescue has been completed. Its contents are correspondence, not a certificate about the sender's present whereabouts. The rear latch can be opened from this room to provide a shorter route back to the rescue shelter.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 中继站外发链路中断时仍可本地记录；独立记录器与外发设备是两个部件。检修移位接线前关闭并隔离本地发送设备，再落座接线，恢复本站储备，做当前配置链路检查。改变接线或电源须重新检查；成功不证明远方塔站安全。救援完成后，具名检修员才可领取邮务柜通信，它不证明寄信人目前所在或状态。后门内闩可从站内打开，缩短返回救援棚的路线。

contexts.paragraph_english: Inspection appointment. The bearer is a trainee technician assigned to public navigation maintenance. The appointment establishes a role, not unrestricted access to every power installation. Local harbour work must be commissioned by the officer responsible for the site. Follow the conditions on that commission and keep separate records for each device. A civil ferry's navigation lamp, a workshop's independent controller and the harbour main generator are not interchangeable authorisations. This appointment was carried on the inspection vessel. It does not certify language performance, membership of a faction or the present location of the technician's mentor.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 随检修船携带的任职凭证：持有人为公共导航检修见习员。身份不等于任意电力设施访问权；地方工作须由现场负责人委托，并按设备分别记录。民用渡轮导航灯、工坊独立控制器、港口主发电机不是通用授权。凭证不证明英语表现、组织成员身份或导师目前位置。

entries.english_definition: Concerned with a larger area made of several local places.

contexts.paragraph_english: You may request a public statement within an agreed scope, a supervised period of specific repair followed by a statement, or a regional review. None of those arrangements deletes the signed record. If you ask me to repair something, identify the equipment, supplies, person checking it and end of the assignment. An apology cannot fill those fields.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 可以要求在约定范围公开证言，安排有监督的具体限期维修后补交说明，或交由地区核查。这些安排均不删除签章记录。若让我修理，应列设备、物资、复核人和工作结束边界；一句道歉填不出这些条件。

contexts.paragraph_english: Oren: If a public statement is requested, agree its fields and purpose with me. I can speak about my own action, including the signature, without guessing the intentions of people whose later decisions I did not see. A supervised repair followed by a statement is another arrangement, and a regional review is also possible. Please do not call a delayed statement a missing signature. The verified record remains. Joining a travelling crew is a further decision, and I can decline that invitation without taking the workshop file away from the inquiry.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 奥伦：若要求公共证言，请与我商定字段和用途。我能说明本人行动，包括签名，不能猜测后来未亲见决定的动机。也可以先做监督维修再补证言，或交地区核查。请勿把延后陈述说成签名不存在。已核验记录仍在；加入出行队是另一决定，我拒绝邀请也不会拿走工坊档案。

contexts.paragraph_english: Run T1 used load 40 with the reserve connected and remained stable. T2 used load 70 with the reserve connected and stopped. T3 used load 40 without the reserve and stopped. T4 repeated the T1 configuration and remained stable. No run tested load 55, and none tested full-scale operation across the six regional towers.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: T1负荷40、接储备，稳定；T2负荷70、接储备，停止；T3负荷40、无储备，停止；T4重复T1，稳定。没有测试55，也没有六塔全规模运行。

contexts.paragraph_english: The retained outputs do not establish safe permanent service for six towers. Each tower still needs its actual base changes, transition supply, common protocol and field trial. entries.english_definition: Located at or responsible for a system's main coordination point.

contexts.paragraph_english: June also requests inspection of the greenhouse supply stair. contexts.paragraph_english: Safety watcher: I can accept the separate watch post and record the checks for the current configuration. If a connection or load setting changes, the earlier pass does not remain current. A fault needs a safe response, and the fixed return route must stay usable. The written handover should identify me and the operator, the setting tested and the window's end. It can acknowledge uncertainty about the wider disturbance pattern. Our work establishes a local bounded operation; it does not certify the cause of every mine hazard or authorise a future central-network policy.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 安全观察员：我可承接独立观察岗，记录当前配置检查。接线或负荷变化后，旧通过不能继续算当前有效。故障须有安全处置，固定返程保持可用。书面交接应列我与操作员、受检设置和窗口终点，也可说明广泛扰动模式仍不确定。我们建立本地有界运行，尚未认证所有危险原因，也未授权未来中央政策。

contexts.paragraph_english: Keep the greenhouse beds intact where a safe sample or mechanical clearance permits work. The kitchen feed will need a later load test from the machine room. contexts.paragraph_english: Later interlock plate, inspection version IL-2. The tower outlet passes through central locking equipment added after the local drawing was made. contexts.paragraph_chinese: 后加联锁标牌，查验版IL-2。塔站出口经过旧图制作后增设的中央锁定设备。本次范围包括地方备用源座、厨房支路和温室洗水支路，未包括塔站出口。

entries.english_definition: Spread across several places or parts.

contexts.paragraph_english: The bounded island result makes a wider proposal worth preparing; it does not complete that preparation. A distributed route requires the verified scheme, actual six-tower changes, transition supplies, a common protocol and on-site trial receipts. contexts.paragraph_chinese: 有限孤网结果使广泛方案值得准备，没有完成准备。分布式路线需验证方案、实际六塔改造、过渡供给、共同协议和现场试运行回执，各有当前权威、版本及完成条件。条件现在公开，不会日后变成隐藏可选剧情要求。

contexts.paragraph_english: Finn: Six actual baselines preserve the two base directions. The distributed list has additional current work. Look at every missing item and choose whether to continue preparing or proceed with the established base directions. A private invitation is not a hidden condition.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 芬：六真实基础保留两个方向，分布式另有当前工作。逐项看缺失，选继续或按基础方向出发，个人邀请不是隐藏条件。

contexts.paragraph_english: Send the bounded transfer demand to Rook’s executive channel and preserve the recorded reply. He refuses to transfer command and enters the Seventh Tower to start forced normalisation. This fixed event moves the inquiry into crisis work; a favourable relationship does not prevent it, and sending the demand is not stopping the central machinery. The temporary joint emergency authority permits travel to the frontier for current network risk, basic preservation and preparation. It does not select central limited operation, orderly disconnection or a distributed system. The region R6 must still be reached by the same vessel through an actual verified route and berth. Keep the original case in its selected custody, with a redacted working extract for onward inquiry.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 向鲁克执行渠道发送限定移交要求并保留回覆；他拒交指挥权，先入第七塔启动强制归一。固定事件让调查进入危机，关系良好不避免；发送要求也不停止中央机组。临时共同应急授权允许前往边境核当前网络风险、基础保全与准备，不选中央受限、有序断联或分布式政策。仍须同一船、真实核验航路和泊位实际到 R6。原件箱保留所选保管，后续仅带脱敏工作摘录。

contexts.paragraph_english: Finn authorises the present survey from the distribution desk. The declared basic protective kit, guide markers and return-line notes belong to this field commission. Nobody needs to endorse a distributed policy to get a safe route or a necessary record.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 芬在集散台签发本次调查。基础防护包、向导标记和返程说明属于这项现场委托，出发前核对实物并取得预报。泰丝可以作为当地向导提供帮助，正式同行邀请在测站核查后提出。获得安全路和必要记录不要求赞成分布式政策。

entries.english_definition: Situated away from the immediate place of operation.

contexts.paragraph_english: Oren’s further testimony must retain the MC-2-05 and MC-2-06 unrepaired-bypass acceptance and the auxiliary alarm’s separate repair and independent review. Choose rotation_local_maintenance with a declared safe reassignment window, or supervised_remote_answers with the local team doing physical installation. Accepting a repair does not require forgiveness. For this candidate window the local receiving team is ROLE-R3-LOCAL-MAINTENANCE, the supervised remote desk ROLE-R3-REMOTE-REVIEW and the interval next_safe_reassignment. A person committed to either work post cannot also occupy an active battle seat or another current duty. End or hand off the post explicitly before rejoining; no real week-long disappearance is required. The post is optional and supplies no main evidence or tower conversion by itself.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 奥伦后续证言保留 MC-2-05/06 未修旁路验收责任及辅助警报独立修复复核。可 rotation_local_maintenance 并明确安全重编队窗口，或 supervised_remote_answers、实际安装由当地队承担。接受修复不等于原谅。候选接收队 ROLE-R3-LOCAL-MAINTENANCE，远程监督 ROLE-R3-REMOTE-REVIEW，时段 next_safe_reassignment。承担任一岗位者不可同时占出战席或另一值守；须明确结束或交班才能归队，不要求现实失踪一周。可选岗位本身不供主线证据或塔转型。

contexts.paragraph_english: Each district retains a facility-conservation contract beside its real tower worksite. The visiting technician matches its current version, the four component serials and the two separate watch posts. R1's isolator cannot be described as R2's local backup, even if both are eventually entered in the shared engineering accounts. The frontier packet has an additional physical journey: inspection at the transfer shed, protection through two escort segments and receipt at the ridge tower. Reading a remote contract list gives a traveller the information needed for a visit; it cannot stand in for that visit.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 各地在真实塔站工位保留地方保全合同。技术员核现行版本、四件序号和两个独立岗位。即使最终记入共同工程账，R1隔离套也不能写作R2备用组。边境工包还需中转棚检查、两段护送保护和风脊接收。读远程清单为到访提供信息，不能代替到访。

entries.english_definition: Without an intervening source or indirect inference.

contexts.paragraph_english: The public path leads to the priory courtyard. June can arrange a meeting there and direct visitors to the residential porches. Please use the public room codes when making notes. Residents may speak for themselves, ask a custodian to relay a request, or decline an interview.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 公共通路通往修院庭院。琼可在那里安排会面，并引导访客前往住区门廊。做笔记时请使用公开房间代码。住民可以亲自说明、请保管人转达请求，也可以拒绝访谈。

contexts.paragraph_english: We also compared the two evenings. Thursday was usually busier than Tuesday, but the difference became smaller after the deadline for a major course assignment had passed. We cannot assume that students always prefer Thursday. Nor can we say that later opening improved examination results: the trial did not measure them. Increased use is useful evidence about access, not direct evidence about academic achievement. When you read the short report, keep that distinction in mind.

If the local load has changed since the record was made, keep both the old observation settings and the current configuration. Do not alter the earlier numbers to make the package look consistent. Say which relationship is being tested and which questions remain. The present data can direct a technical inquiry without pretending that it has already found the whole cause.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 记录完成后地方负荷若变动，请同时保留旧观察设置与当前配置。不要为资料看起来一致而修改旧数值。说明待试验的关系与余下问题；当前数据可以引导技术调查，无需假装已经查明全部原因。

contexts.paragraph_english: The public location summary may name the facility and the record versions. It must not attach unrelated personal addresses or present the shipment as a direct witness of Mara today. The next district will still require actual access, on-site inquiry and rescue work.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 公开地点摘要可注明设施和记录版本，不能附无关住址，也不能把货运写成今日亲见玛拉。下一区仍需实际进入、现场查验与救援。

entries.english_definition: Remaining within an acceptable range over time.

contexts.paragraph_english: The rear work point is available for recording future preservation requirements. Its labels list one base isolator, one local backup pack and two base provision packs for this tower. These labels describe required supplies, not items already delivered. contexts.paragraph_chinese: 后部工作点可登记以后保全需求：一个基础隔离件、一个本地备用包、两个基础保障包。这是需求，不是已交付库存。安全通路与地方晚餐回路均未填充此工作点或工程账。

contexts.paragraph_english: Please draw the process with calibration before entry, physical output preparation before execution, and observations before acceptance. If the configuration changes, we check it again. We keep previous runs as previous runs. A safe stop is a recorded failure in that condition, and a stable interval is evidence for that interval. Neither is a referendum on every future policy.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 流程图把校准放在进入前、实体输出准备放在执行前、观察放在接受前。配置变更须重查，旧运行仍是旧运行。安全停止是该条件下的失败，稳定时段是该时段证据，两者都不是关于未来所有政策的公投。

contexts.paragraph_english: Retained manuscript GH-R7, reporting version 7: the outcome appendix lists T1 stable, T2 stopped, T3 stopped and T4 stable. Each entry names Controller A, ten minutes, isolation checked, load and reserve condition. The four entries are retained as favourable and unfavourable observations. The manuscript's cover identifies the intended issue as reporting version 7.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 留存原稿GH-R7、报告第7版：结果附录列T1稳定、T2停止、T3停止、T4稳定，各注明A控制器、十分钟、已隔离、负荷和储备条件。正反观察四项均保留，封面把拟发行件标为报告第7版。

contexts.paragraph_english: Issued report GH-R7, reporting version 7: the displayed appendix contains T1 stable and T4 stable. The outcome rows for T2 and T3 are absent. The issued cover carries the same reporting-version identifier as the retained manuscript. Compare the actual appendix and circulation record; do not rely on a title alone.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 发行报告GH-R7、报告第7版：所示附录只有T1稳定、T4稳定，T2、T3结果行缺失。发行封面与留存原稿使用同一报告版本标识。应比较实际附录与流转册，不能仅依标题。

entries.english_definition: Able to be used for the stated purpose.

contexts.paragraph_english: Two markers are visible from the reef path. The southern marker stands near the broken steps. It identifies the old landing place but does not confirm that the steps remain usable after a surge. The northern reach is beyond the low stone wall. Its approach is narrow, so a rescue boat must wait for a clear signal rather than following the first moving light it sees. The winch line can guide people towards either marker. Choose the receiving direction before loading the line, and repeat the tension check whenever that direction changes. A raised hand lamp may help people find the path; it does not replace the line or repair the steps.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 礁岸可见两个标记。南标记位于破损台阶旁，标出旧接应点，并不保证浪涌后台阶仍能用。北段在矮石墙外，入口狭窄，救援船应等明确接应信号。绞盘索可朝两边接应；承载前须选方向，改向后须重新检查张力。手灯帮助辨路，不替代救援索，也不修复台阶。

contexts.paragraph_english: When the small station runs within its recorded limit, the kitchen crew can check their feed. We can then request an onsite visit to the tower duty layer. You will inspect the tower there, with its operator. Leave the return passage usable and record the equipment and load boundaries on the final receipt.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 小站在记录限制内运行后，厨房人员可以验收回路。随后可申请到塔站值守层现场查验，须与塔站操作员一起在那里检查。保持返程通路，最终回执记清设备与负荷边界。

contexts.paragraph_english: The transport office initially looked for mistakes in the timetable. None were found. The difficulty was that the ten-minute connection had been measured from the arrival of the train at the platform to the departure of the bus from its stop. It did not include the time passengers might need to leave a crowded carriage, reach the footbridge and collect a bicycle or a large bag. What looked like a generous interval on paper was not necessarily a usable interval for everyone.

The greenhouse supplies the priory kitchen and the public wash taps through two small local circuits. Water from the inspection stair has entered the upper transfer floor. Roots have also grown around the stopped conveyor. The public corridor remains usable. The stair may be opened for the locally commissioned inspection once the root-route threat is controlled and the stair boundary has been checked on site.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 温室通过两条小型地方回路供应修院厨房与公共洗水龙头。检修梯的水已流入转供站上层，根系缠住了停转的输送器。公共外廊仍可使用。根道威胁实际处置、检修梯边界现场核对后，地方检修委托可以开放下行。

entries.english_definition: Able to carry out its intended working function.

contexts.paragraph_english: Route C remains open, but a vessel may enter it only if its navigation beacon is operational. The beacon must be checked in its installed configuration before departure. Permission to work on a vessel does not remove this requirement, nor does the fact that another vessel has already left the harbour.

entries.english_definition: Harmed so that condition or performance is reduced.

contexts.paragraph_english: The centre of the cabin floor is cracked. A person may appear to cross it successfully while the damaged boards continue to move underneath. Do not use that as a load test. The emergency cabinet beside the port wall contains a hand tool and a short rescue line; both belong to this vessel's rescue kit. A loose gangboard is stored along the intact side of the cabin. Secure it across the damaged section, keeping its ends on sound supports, before directing anybody towards the shore exit. The reef path begins beyond that exit. This note describes the cabin passage, not the safety of the landing place outside. Check the shore notice before choosing an approach for the rescue boat.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 船舱中央地板已经开裂。有人一度踩过去，不能证明受损板材可承重。左舷救援柜存有手工具和一根救援索，均属于本船救援包。沿完好的侧壁放着一块踏板。先把踏板两端固定在可靠支承上，再安排人员走向岸边出口。出口外才是礁岸路径；本说明不能证明岸上接应点安全，需要另查岸边告示。

contexts.paragraph_english: Dispatcher: Before you collect any parts, there is a correction to the earlier message. We were told that the spare navigation beacon had been destroyed. The inspection does not support that account. The beacon itself still works; the damaged part is the bracket that holds it in place.

The navigation beacon is present, but its mounting bracket is damaged. The boat also carries a charged backup battery reserved for the beacon. Repairs and connections must be completed before the installed beacon is tested. A check made before the configuration changes cannot certify the new configuration.

You asked whether I could give you an exact minute for the authorisation. I can show you the sheet, including the damaged part of its time box, and the statement that it was checked before departure. I cannot read a reliable issue minute from that box. A report may state that a detail remains unknown. There is no need to fill the gap with a plausible-looking number.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 你问能否给出授权的准确分钟。我可以展示时间框破损的原页，以及出发前核查过授权的陈述；无法从时间框读出可靠分钟。报告可以写某项细节仍未知，不必用貌似合理的数字填空。

entries.english_definition: No longer working or physically intact.

Choose the receiving direction before loading the line, and repeat the tension check whenever that direction changes. A raised hand lamp may help people find the path; it does not replace the line or repair the steps.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 礁岸可见两个标记。南标记位于破损台阶旁，标出旧接应点，并不保证浪涌后台阶仍能用。北段在矮石墙外，入口狭窄，救援船应等明确接应信号。绞盘索可朝两边接应；承载前须选方向，改向后须重新检查张力。手灯帮助辨路，不替代救援索，也不修复台阶。

contexts.paragraph_english: Coast team to the stranded crew. We first marked the south steps as a possible receiving point. That instruction is withdrawn: a fresh inspection found the lower steps separated from their support. Use the northern reach beyond the low wall instead. There are four survivors waiting for assistance, apart from the technician carrying this message. Keep the rescue line clear of the broken steps. Once everyone is under shelter, send your position, the number of people needing collection and the approach restriction. Do not ask the boat to follow the southern marker merely because it is easier to see. We will acknowledge the request through the coast relay.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 海岸队更正原先南台阶方案：现场复查发现下段台阶脱离支承，撤回旧指示。改用矮墙外的北段。有四名幸存者需要接应，不含传递消息的检修员。索具避开破损台阶。人员进入棚内后，发送位置、接应人数和进路限制，接应船不会因南标记显眼就改走那里。通过海岸中继确认求援。

contexts.paragraph_english: Ada: Start with the street people use now, not the straight line on the old sheet. At the checkpoint you have two choices. The inspected passage avoids the broken span, although both appear to lead north. Have your present commission checked there. Or go through the service tunnel with the basic kit; isolate the drive, secure the panel and inspect the cleared route. Neither choice tells us whether Mara is alive today. I know where the duty hall is and where the residents can receive someone coming back. I will not turn an old movement record into a current medical report. Bring the rescue team to the street when the inner return passage is open.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 阿妲：从大家现在走的街开始，别只看旧纸上的直线。检查点有两种选择：核查通道绕开断桥，须查当次委托；或者用基础工具走隧道，隔离驱动、固定面板、清路检查。两种路线都不能说明玛拉今天是否活着。我知道值守厅位置和住民接应处，不会把旧转移记录当成当前医疗报告。内侧便道打开后，把救援队带回街区。

contexts.paragraph_english: This distinction is especially important at the broken bridge checkpoint. The historic central span and the present controlled passage lead towards similar destinations on a small-scale drawing. On the ground they are different routes. The closed span cannot be made safe by presenting a document. The inspected passage does not require crossing that span, but it does require a current credential check. A service tunnel offers a further option once its actual obstruction and hazard are treated. The existence of alternatives should be recorded with their conditions, not reduced to a single arrow marked north.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 断桥检查点尤其如此。旧中央桥跨和当前核查通道在缩略图上指向相近目的地，实体却不同。出示文件不能让断桥安全；核查通道不跨断桥，却要当次查证。既有隧道则须处理真实阻碍及危险。记录替代路线及条件，不能简化成一个向北箭头。

entries.english_definition: Absent from where it is expected or required.

contexts.paragraph_english: Controlled copy of the interruption schedule. Approval was entered on D-1 at 18:00. The specified window begins at 21:14 on D0 and lasts only for the locally declared interval. The schedule requires a second check of traffic still within the affected approach before the output is interrupted. A completion box records whether that check was carried out; it is not a decorative signature. This schedule establishes that an interruption had been planned before the accident. It does not establish which later instruction was followed. Compare the actual control log, the duty handover and the independent instrument record. Keep the scheduled window distinct from the time at which the coast instrument first recorded a missing signal.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: D-1 18:00批准，D0 21:14开始的局部断供测试计划，要求断供前第二次检查受影响进场区的人船。计划证明动作预定，不独自证明后来实际执行何种指令。

contexts.paragraph_english: Please separate a decision about a person's identity from a decision about those claims. If the person gives explicit consent for a particular identity field to be published to a particular recipient, record that scope and version. Do not treat an archive reading permit or a custodian's signature as personal consent. If the requested permission is missing, revise the fields or request another scope before sending. The basic reading room will remain open while you do that.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 请把个人身份决定与这些公共陈述分开。本人若明确同意向特定接收方公开某项身份字段，应记录范围与版本。阅读许可或保管人签字不能代替个人同意。缺少所需许可时，发送前修改字段或申请新范围；基础阅览室仍开放。

contexts.paragraph_english: Harbour loan and cross-region inspection terms. Once the Tidegate local safety record has been verified, return to the receiving berth to acknowledge the loan of the sealed inspection vessel Glimmer. Its watch officer maintains the basic ship service; accepting a companion invitation is not a condition of using the vessel. The deck, archive cabin and shared maintenance compartment are three spaces of this one ship, not separate ships at each harbour. The loan does not transfer the civil ferry or its installed equipment. The next inspection commission points to the grove receiving records. It does not certify the current whereabouts of the missing mentor. Basic sailing along an opened route does not require a fuel ticket. The vessel still needs its ordinary gradual repairs; the handover does not turn it into a fully upgraded ship.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 塔站实际安全核验后回接应泊位明确接收封存旧巡灯船微光号及跨区核查委托。船务值守不依赖接受莉娜邀请，三空间是同一船。民用渡轮及船上设备不转移，不证明导师当前去向，不收死锁燃料门票。

contexts.paragraph_english: There are people eating here whose current official entries say that they have died or moved away. A label in the register has affected deliveries, although the kitchens still have to serve the people who arrive. June requests a limited check of the difference. The work covers this priory's twenty-four-person residential group during the present chapter stage; it is not a census of the forest or proof that every missing person has been found.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 这里有人正在吃饭，现行官方名册却给他们标注了死亡或迁出。名册标签影响配送，厨房仍须为实际来到的人供餐。琼请求核查两者的差异。范围限于本章节阶段住在修院的二十四人住区组；这不是全林人口普查，也不能证明所有失踪者都已找到。

entries.english_definition: Kept out of ordinary view.

contexts.paragraph_english: A comparison note may propose what another observer should record next, such as the instrument, pump state and stage. Do not write that this extra sheet proves the final cause of the mist or unlocks a hidden ending condition. The necessary chapter samples and instrument evidence remain on the main route whether this point is visited or not.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 比较便条可以提出下一观察要记录什么，例如仪表、泵状态与阶段。不能写这页证明雾的最终原因或开启隐藏结局条件。无论访问此点与否，必需章节样本和仪表证据均在主路。

contexts.paragraph_english: Finn: Six actual baselines preserve the two base directions. The distributed list has additional current work. Look at every missing item and choose whether to continue preparing or proceed with the established base directions. A private invitation is not a hidden condition.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 芬：六真实基础保留两个方向，分布式另有当前工作。逐项看缺失，选继续或按基础方向出发，个人邀请不是隐藏条件。

contexts.paragraph_english: The bounded island result makes a wider proposal worth preparing; it does not complete that preparation. A distributed route requires the verified scheme, actual six-tower changes, transition supplies, a common protocol and on-site trial receipts. Each item has a current owner, version and completion condition. These conditions are public now. They will not be introduced later as a hidden optional story requirement.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 有限孤网结果使广泛方案值得准备，没有完成准备。分布式路线需验证方案、实际六塔改造、过渡供给、共同协议和现场试运行回执，各有当前权威、版本及完成条件。条件现在公开，不会日后变成隐藏可选剧情要求。

contexts.paragraph_english: The public preparation list puts those obligations within reach before the final decision. It names the verified scheme, six-tower changes, transition supply, common protocol and field trial. Each district can show actual progress, and an unfinished item stays unfinished. This is preferable to discovering a hidden requirement after a long journey. A report can compare options without choosing the final policy today. It should distinguish what has been achieved here, what needs work elsewhere and what the sources cannot yet tell us. That distinction gives the next investigator something useful to test rather than another promise to repeat.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 公开清单在终局前把义务摆明：方案、六塔改造、过渡供给、共同协议、现场试运行。各区显示实际进度，未完成保持未完成，胜于旅程末才发现隐藏要求。报告可比较方案而不今日定终局，区分本地已做、外区待做、来源尚不能告知之处，使下一查验有可检验事项，而非另一承诺。

entries.english_definition: Able to be seen in the current view.

contexts.paragraph_english: Two markers are visible from the reef path. The southern marker stands near the broken steps. It identifies the old landing place but does not confirm that the steps remain usable after a surge. The northern reach is beyond the low stone wall. Its approach is narrow, so a rescue boat must wait for a clear signal rather than following the first moving light it sees. The winch line can guide people towards either marker. Choose the receiving direction before loading the line, and repeat the tension check whenever that direction changes. A raised hand lamp may help people find the path; it does not replace the line or repair the steps.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 礁岸可见两个标记。南标记位于破损台阶旁，标出旧接应点，并不保证浪涌后台阶仍能用。北段在矮石墙外，入口狭窄，救援船应等明确接应信号。绞盘索可朝两边接应；承载前须选方向，改向后须重新检查张力。手灯帮助辨路，不替代救援索，也不修复台阶。

contexts.paragraph_english: At the branch valves, we will identify the two blocked returns before choosing a procedure. The sample procedure and the mechanical procedure both have a safe objective. I will work with the local crew if your travelling companions stay outside. Please read the visible hazard plan before entering. A method written in your notebook is a proposal until the actual work is carried out and its result is accepted.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 在支路阀处，我们先识别两处受阻回流，再选择程序。取样和机械程序均有安全目标。若旅行同伴留在外面，我会与地方班组协作。进入前请读可见危险计划。笔记里选了方法，仍只是提案；须实际执行，取得被接受的结果。

contexts.paragraph_english: Copies retain the source reference of their original. A departure entry copied into a ledger remains the departure officer's record. An arrival written by the receiving officer at the receiving site has its own source. Keep the two references visible when describing what has been checked.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 副本沿用原稿来源。出发记录抄入总账后仍是出发记录员的记录；接收员在接收现场写下的到达记录另有来源。说明查验结果时，应保留两个来源标识。

contexts.paragraph_english: Copies help when an original is fragile or a room is closed. Their source still matters. Two copies of the same departure note show that an account has been preserved in two places; they do not show that two officers independently observed a departure. A receiving officer's entry can contribute a different observation. The comparison should identify who recorded what and when, rather than treating the number of pages as the strength of the evidence. Unknown details should stay visible. A later copying stamp may explain when a ledger was updated without explaining why it was updated then.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 原稿脆弱或房间关闭时，副本便于查阅，来源仍然重要。同一出发便条的两副本说明记录保存在两处，未证明两名记录员各自看见出发。接收员记录能够提供另一观察。应比较谁在何时记录了什么，不应以页数代表证据强度。未知细节应保留可见；较晚抄录戳记可以说明更新总账的时间，未必解释为何那时更新。

entries.english_definition: Able to be reached or used by the relevant person.

contexts.paragraph_english: Harbour closure order — current copy. General departures are suspended while the navigation restrictions are reviewed. Rescue arrivals continue at the public receiving berth. An arrival under that provision does not grant a vessel permission to depart. The dispatch office may issue a limited local maintenance commission where the work supports a specific safe evacuation arrangement. The commission must name its work area and power boundary. It does not itself clear a route, approve an untested navigation lamp or transfer ownership of a vessel. A later departure instruction must be checked against the route notices and the vessel's current configuration. The public consultation desk remains accessible during the closure; restricted records and equipment require their own authorisation.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 现行封港令：一般出港暂停，公共泊位仍接收救援入港；允许入港不等于允许出港。调度室可为明确安全撤离工作签发有限地方检修委托，写明作业范围和供电边界。委托本身不开放航道、不认可未经测试导航灯、不移交船产权。出港另需按航道资料及船舶当前配置核对。公共咨询区开放，受限记录与设备需各自授权。

contexts.paragraph_english: A public summary is one possible arrangement. It can describe the group checked, the disagreement found and the limits of the check. It can retain source references without reproducing every protected name. Readers then know what is claimed and how a review may be requested. The arrangement works only if the promised review route exists. A notice which says that evidence is available, while no one holds an accessible copy or a valid inspection mandate, offers very little protection against an unsupported claim.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 公共摘要是一种安排，可以说明核查组、所见差异和查验限制，保留来源而不复制所有受保护姓名。读者因此知道主张什么、如何申请复核。但承诺的复核路径须真实存在。若告示声称可查证据，却无人保存可访问副本或有效查验委托，就很难约束缺乏依据的陈述。

contexts.paragraph_english: Scrap and an active feeder obstruct the lower track. Check the marked work area from the safe platform before engaging the threat. The rail clearance is a separate work result from the later escort: removing the obstruction does not mean that the waiting workers have travelled through the route. Keep the fixed ladder and its landing accessible throughout both jobs.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 下层轨道有废料和活动送料装置阻挡。处置威胁前，从安全平台检查标记区域。清障与稍后的护送是不同工作结果；清除障碍尚不表示工人已经通过。两项工作期间均保留固定梯道和平台通路。

entries.english_definition: Allowed only within stated limits or to stated people.

contexts.paragraph_english: Harbour closure order — current copy. General departures are suspended while the navigation restrictions are reviewed. Rescue arrivals continue at the public receiving berth. An arrival under that provision does not grant a vessel permission to depart. The dispatch office may issue a limited local maintenance commission where the work supports a specific safe evacuation arrangement. The commission must name its work area and power boundary. It does not itself clear a route, approve an untested navigation lamp or transfer ownership of a vessel. A later departure instruction must be checked against the route notices and the vessel's current configuration. The public consultation desk remains accessible during the closure; restricted records and equipment require their own authorisation.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 现行封港令：一般出港暂停，公共泊位仍接收救援入港；允许入港不等于允许出港。调度室可为明确安全撤离工作签发有限地方检修委托，写明作业范围和供电边界。委托本身不开放航道、不认可未经测试导航灯、不移交船产权。出港另需按航道资料及船舶当前配置核对。公共咨询区开放，受限记录与设备需各自授权。

contexts.paragraph_english: Electrician: That distinction matters. Do not look for a replacement beacon when what you need is a replacement bracket. There is a suitable bracket in the west workshop. Access to the workshop has to be dealt with locally, so this recording is not permission to walk through a restricted work area.

Leave the Glimmer at the marked berth while the landing clerk checks your vessel record and the cross-district commission. Registering here establishes an arrival and a route back to this landing. It does not give access to private rooms or restricted names.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 请把微光号停在标记泊位，由接驳员核对船只记录与跨区核查委托。此处登记记录一次实际到港，并建立返回这个接驳站的路线。私人房间与受限姓名另有访问范围。

contexts.paragraph_english: For a restricted attachment, name the record version, the fields required, the recipient and the intended use. June acts as custodian of the room. She can arrange controlled inspection and record an authorised handover. Holding the key to an attachment does not make her the person entitled to consent on behalf of every individual named there. Consent to publish a person's identity must be given by that person for the specified recipient and use.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 申请受限附页时，请说明版本、必要字段、接收方和用途。琼是阅览室保管人，可以安排受控查验、记录获准交付，但持有钥匙并未使她有权代所有当事人同意。公开某人的身份须由本人对具体接收方与用途明确同意。

entries.english_definition: Unable to be obtained or used at present.

contexts.paragraph_english: This relay records signals locally even when its outgoing link is unavailable. The independent recorder and the outgoing transmitter are separate parts of the station. Before touching the displaced outgoing lead, switch the local transmitter off and isolate it. Seat the lead, restore the station's own reserve and run a link check. The test confirms this lead and power configuration only. If either changes, repeat it before requesting a boat. A successful link test is not evidence that a distant tower is safe. The postal locker may be opened for the named technician after the shore rescue has been completed. Its contents are correspondence, not a certificate about the sender's present whereabouts. The rear latch can be opened from this room to provide a shorter route back to the rescue shelter.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 中继站外发链路中断时仍可本地记录；独立记录器与外发设备是两个部件。检修移位接线前关闭并隔离本地发送设备，再落座接线，恢复本站储备，做当前配置链路检查。改变接线或电源须重新检查；成功不证明远方塔站安全。救援完成后，具名检修员才可领取邮务柜通信，它不证明寄信人目前所在或状态。后门内闩可从站内打开，缩短返回救援棚的路线。

contexts.paragraph_english: Resident representative: The warmer shelter matters now, but so does the transfer which some households are waiting for. I would like the proposal to say which work is postponed under each distribution. If we choose the transition, when will the materials used for production support become unavailable for shelter improvement? If we reduce immediately, who will replace the expected output in the transfer plan? We should be able to disagree about those costs without losing the meals and wage cover already agreed. Please record the conditions, rather than writing that every resident shares one preference.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 住民代表：更暖的安置处现在重要，一些住户等待的转移也重要。我希望提案说明各分配推迟什么工作。选择过渡后，生产支持物资何时不再可用于安置？立刻减产时，转移计划的预期产出由什么替代？讨论这些代价不应失去已约定暖食和工资保障。请记条件，不写所有住民同一偏好。

contexts.paragraph_english: Coast pickup acknowledgement. Four people registered at the sheltered assembly point will be collected, together with the technician. The receiving route is the northern reach; the southern steps remain unavailable. Wait at the shelter's marked boarding point. The receiving crew will carry everyone to the public arrival berth at Saltmist Harbour. This acknowledgement permits that rescue passage only. It is not a general sailing licence, a maintenance commission or the handover of a patrol vessel. Take the coast records with you, keeping their source and time labels.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 接应回执：接走避风棚登记的四名幸存者和检修员，经北段上船，南台阶仍不可用。在棚外登记登船点等接应，前往盐雾港公共接应泊位。这只允许本次救援通行，不是一般航行许可、检修委托或巡灯船移交。带走资料并保留来源、时间标签。

contexts.paragraph_english: The collection sheet was written at the kitchen desk. A copy filed in the reading room has the same source. It may replace an unavailable copy for access, but it does not supply a second witness.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 领取页原稿写于厨房台。阅览室存档副本与它同源，可以作为查阅副本，不能增加一名证人。

entries.english_definition: Having the recognised skill or authority needed for a task.

contexts.paragraph_english: Test the repaired signal in both rooms, then ask another qualified person to repeat the check. Pera may perform or designate that independent review; Oren cannot review his own repair as the second person. Record the actual reviewer and result under the current device version. If the check finds a fault, retain the work done and reopen the remaining defect. Residents may accept the useful repair and still dispute the earlier acceptance.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 在两房测试修复信号，再请另一名合格人员重复检查。佩拉可亲自或指定独立复核；奥伦不能作为第二人复核自己的维修。记录实际复核人与当前装置版本下的结果。检查发现故障时，保留已做工作，继续处理余下缺陷。住民可以接受有用维修，仍质疑早验收。

contexts.paragraph_english: Pera: My response to a repair can stay narrower than forgiveness. I can accept a tested alarm and still object to the way the old equipment was delivered. Another qualified person can repeat the test if the arrangement is agreed; the repairer cannot sign both the work and its independent review. We should give residents a result they can use and a way to report a new fault. No one has to write that everyone is satisfied before the safety work can be recorded. The disagreement deserves its own line.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 佩拉：我对维修的回应可以小于原谅。我能接受受检警报器，仍反对早先交付方式。安排获准后，可请另一合格人员重复测试；维修者不能同时签工作及独立复核。住民应得到可用结果和报告新故障的途径。安全工作登记无需先写所有人满意；分歧自有一栏。

contexts.paragraph_english: Each tower needs one base isolator, one local backup, two base provisions and two qualified local watch posts. These come from that district’s inspected facility-conservation contract. Baseline work does not consume the player’s marks, personal parts or the Glimmer’s battery. Enhanced work separately needs one controller, two couplers, three transition crates and a reusable trial fixture per tower. Six public finite contracts supply six controllers, twelve couplers, eighteen crates and six fixtures. Reading this list grants none of them. The six local crews have capacity one each; optional companions and combat auxiliaries are separate people.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 每塔需要一隔离套、一当地备用组、两基础保全包及两个合格地方值守岗位，来自对应地区受检设施保全合同。基础工作不消费玩家刻币、个人零件或微光号电池。增强每塔另需一控制器、两联络组件、三过渡箱及一可复用试验夹具。六个公开有限合同供六控制器、十二组件、十八箱、六夹具，阅读清单不入账。六地班组各有同期容量一；可选同伴和战斗援勤另行登记。

contexts.paragraph_english: The local conservation contracts identify BASE-TWR-Rn-base_isolator, BASE-TWR-Rn-local_backup and BASE-TWR-Rn-base_provision for R1 through R6. Inspect the original depot manifest at the actual tower worksite, match its current contract version, serials and qualified watch posts, then inspect and deliver the specified items. The ridge packet is inspected at the frontier transfer shed and delivered only at the tower after its real escort. Signed intentions do not count as stock. The published functional crews and their two separate posts are limited local authoring details, not newly recruited core characters.

I can issue it when the enhanced installation, baseline protection and two local watches are checked. It is not a vote for a final network policy. The common protocol later requires both an operator and a representative in every region. We have different scopes and appointment instances. We will read the same terms on essential protection, bounded contact, mutual aid and independent review. An organisation's general position cannot stand in for six current regional signatures, and an old appointment cannot keep signing as the current one.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 地方操作岗：试验许可针对本塔当前配置，在增强、基础保护与两值守核实后签发，不是最终政策投票。共同协议每地另需操作方、代表方，范围任职不同，同阅基本保护、有限联系、互助、独立复核。组织立场不代六地签字，旧任职不继续充现任。

contexts.paragraph_english: Harbour closure order — current copy. General departures are suspended while the navigation restrictions are reviewed. Rescue arrivals continue at the public receiving berth. An arrival under that provision does not grant a vessel permission to depart. The dispatch office may issue a limited local maintenance commission where the work supports a specific safe evacuation arrangement. The commission must name its work area and power boundary. It does not itself clear a route, approve an untested navigation lamp or transfer ownership of a vessel. A later departure instruction must be checked against the route notices and the vessel's current configuration. The public consultation desk remains accessible during the closure; restricted records and equipment require their own authorisation.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 现行封港令：一般出港暂停，公共泊位仍接收救援入港；允许入港不等于允许出港。调度室可为明确安全撤离工作签发有限地方检修委托，写明作业范围和供电边界。委托本身不开放航道、不认可未经测试导航灯、不移交船产权。出港另需按航道资料及船舶当前配置核对。公共咨询区开放，受限记录与设备需各自授权。

contexts.paragraph_english: W-04 agrees to let the priory review desk check the observation time, the witness's duty and the version reference for a local note. The purpose is to verify that note's account. The agreement is for version W04-v1. It does not include a private address or general publication of identity.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: W-04同意修院审查台核对一份地方便条的观察时间、证人职能和版本索引，用途为核验陈述。协议限定版本W04-v1，未包括私人地址或普遍公开身份。

entries.english_definition: Referring to one identified person, thing, or case.

contexts.paragraph_english: Comparison envelope for the coast recorder collected after the shore rescue. The original instrument label reports loss of the observed light signal at 21:14:12. Its last routine comparison with the ship clock had an uncertainty of approximately two seconds. The harbour control event is labelled 21:14:10 on a different clock. The handover copy reports a separate control-to-ship comparison within one second. The combined comparisons therefore allow a three-second interval between the two labelled clocks. These readings are consistent within that recorded interval; they are not evidence that every clock displayed an identical second. Together with the approved window and the duty handover, the records support a planned interruption with a required protection removed. Keep the original extract attached. Nothing in this envelope certifies the sender of the inspection mail as currently alive, safe or present at a particular destination.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 救援后实际取得的海岸记录器副本保留原标21:14:12，与船钟最近比对约有两秒不确定。控制钟21:14:10与其在已记不确定范围内相符，不是所有钟秒数完全一致；不证明导师当前存活、安全或去向。 值班记录另证控制钟与船钟相差一秒以内；合并两次比对界限允许两仪器标签有三秒差。

contexts.paragraph_english: The aim was not simply to increase the total number of visits. Students on placement had told us that they often returned to campus too late to use specialist materials. Other students said their accommodation was too noisy for concentrated work. Those are different needs. A student might require access to a particular collection, or might only need a quiet desk. We wanted to know which need the extra hours were actually meeting before deciding how to use the available staff and space.

An instruction to start the pump therefore concerns the operation of the facilities, not permission for a particular vessel to enter the channel. For this evacuation, use the vessel particulars recorded for the approved load. A change to that load is not an authorised alternative within the present operation. Keep this restriction with the departure record.

Begin at the public porches for rooms A, B and C. Record the people who voluntarily confirm that they live there. The ration sheet reports portions prepared and collected. The room index reports where this group is accommodated. Neither sheet alone proves that a particular person is present. Compare them with the witnessed visits and the current register, retaining the date and purpose of each record.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 请到A、B、C区公共门廊，记录自愿确认居住于此的人。口粮页记的是准备和领取份数，房间索引记的是这组人被安置在哪里。任何一张表都不能单独证明某人实际在场。把两表、现场走访和现行名册相互比较，并保留各记录日期和用途。

entries.english_definition: Connected to the question or purpose being considered.

contexts.paragraph_english: At the dispatch duty stand, close_transition_shift performs the handover and sets extraction back to zero before the next shift. This is a world-work boundary, not a countdown while someone reads or writes. A load change invalidates the previous configuration test. Recheck the actual new setting. The tower handover needs a current bounded policy, real duty records and the relevant test; saving the policy text alone does none of those jobs.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 在调度值守站位，close_transition_shift实际交班，并在下一班前把抽取降回零。这是世界工作边界，不是阅读或写作时的倒计时。负荷变更使旧配置测试失效，应复查新设置。塔站交接需要当前受限政策、真实值守和对应测试；仅保存政策文字没有完成这些工作。

contexts.paragraph_english: At the end of that shift, close_transition_shift at the dispatch duty stand records a real handover and returns extraction to zero before the next shift. Reading, translating, composing or using the dictionary does not advance that work boundary. Every change in feed, securing state or load creates a new configuration that needs its own relevant test.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 该班结束时，在调度值守站位执行close_transition_shift，记录真实交班，在下一班前把抽取降回零。阅读、翻译、写作或查词典不推进这项工作边界。送料、固定状态或负荷变化均形成新配置，需要对应测试。

contexts.paragraph_english: Formal request through the Beacon Office, authorised by Voss: send the local instrument versions, extraction settings and associated disturbance observations to the academic receiving desk for verification. Retain the current safety conditions while the relationship is examined. The receiving inquiry should distinguish an observed association from a tested explanation, and preserve relevant counterexamples or alternative conditions.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 灯署正式渠道要求，由沃斯授权：将地方仪表版本、抽取设置及对应扰动观察送到学城接收台核验。关系核查期间保留当前安全条件。接收调查应区分所见关联与经过试验的解释，并保留相关反例或其他条件。

contexts.paragraph_english: Write a formal inquiry that names the two notices, the relevant time and the question you need answered. You may save it before deciding whether to send. This local activity is about ordinary study arrangements. It does not hide a network order or supply an essential ending condition. Its independent optional contract and reward remain to be approved; saving an inquiry alone will not issue a completion receipt.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 正式询问信注明两通知、相关时间与待答问题，可先保存再决定交付。这是普通学习安排，未藏网络命令或必需结局条件。独立可选合同及奖励待核定，存询问本身不出完成回执。

entries.english_definition: Having no justified connection to the matter being considered.

contexts.paragraph_english: For the controlled batch records, apply at the workshop comparison stand to the local record desk, R3-local-record-desk. The available fields are check_status, acceptance_status, signatory_scope and version_source. The recipient is patrol_technician; the purpose is verify_original_instruments_and_acceptance; the requested source set is MC2-current-source-set. The desk must issue this actual scoped permission before the protected pages are opened. A mine work assignment does not grant unrelated names or a private interview.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 受控批次记录须到工坊比较站位向地方记录台R3-local-record-desk申请。可用字段为check_status、acceptance_status、signatory_scope、version_source；接收方patrol_technician，用途verify_original_instruments_and_acceptance，请求来源集合MC2-current-source-set。保护页开启前，记录台须实际签发这项有限许可；矿井委托不会开放无关姓名或私人访谈。

contexts.paragraph_english: Custodian: Before we start, this is a bounded review, not an election for the future system. We have the old design, the later revision and correction note, the policy and test authorisations, the executive orders and the station register. The copies remain labelled as copies. Personal addresses and unrelated identities are excluded. Each claim will have a source version and each responding party will have a chance to challenge its scope. If a channel declines to answer, I will record the decline. It will not become an admission simply because someone in this room wishes it were.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 保管人：这是一场有限审查，不是未来制度选举。已有旧设计、后续修订和纠正、政策及测试授权、执行令、北站登记；副本标副本，住址和无关身份排除。每条主张有来源版、各方有质疑范围机会。拒答按拒答登记，不因厅里有人希望便成认罪。

contexts.paragraph_english: When drainage and the present safety check are complete, the route to the cutting face can open. Retreat through the checked rail-and-ladder path if a new fault is found. A failed attempt leaves the people already received in the town safe and preserves any unrelated repair; it does not refill the pump room so that the same rescue can pay again.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 排水与当前安全复查完成后，可开放前往采掘面的通路。发现新故障时，沿已检查轨道和梯道退回。尝试失败不会危及已接到矿镇的人，也不撤去无关修复，更不会重新注满泵房来重复领取救援奖励。

contexts.paragraph_english: The local inspection assignment permits this batch comparison. It does not permit the release of unrelated household details or the alteration of priory records. If the original instrument remains temporarily inaccessible, the retained copy can guide preparation, while the final finding keeps the missing inspection explicit.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本地查验委托允许这项批次比较，没有许可发布无关住户细节或改写修院记录。原仪表暂时无法到达时，可用副本准备工作；最终结论仍明确缺少哪项现场查验。

entries.english_definition: Provided beyond what is already included.

contexts.paragraph_english: One proposal was simply to delay every bus by another ten minutes. Several passengers supported it, but the bus operators raised a practical concern. The same vehicles continued beyond the three districts to serve a small college. A later departure from the station could make those passengers late for the final class of the evening. Changing one connection could improve a journey for one group while making another journey less reliable. The question was therefore not whether additional waiting time was useful, but where and under what conditions it should be introduced.

Operator: If the load, isolation or duty changes, my earlier test expires. That does not erase the fact that the earlier test occurred. It tells the next team not to mistake history for the present arrangement. The result we can issue today is limited tower safety. Baseline reserve equipment, additional controllers, transition supplies and later field trials remain separate work. Ada: Put that distinction in the onward extract. We have had enough documents that look complete because missing work was described confidently. State what has actually been done and what the frontier team still needs to verify.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 操作员：负荷、隔离、岗位变，旧测试失效，不抹已发生测试，只叫后队别混历史与当前。今日可签有限塔安全，基础备用、额外控制器、过渡补给、现场试运行另属工作。阿妲：摘录写明，缺工作却自信描述的完整文件够多了，写已做与边境仍须核验。

contexts.paragraph_english: The town tried a more limited change. For six weeks, the first bus after the busiest train waited an additional five minutes. The other services kept their published departure times. Staff placed signs along the walking route and asked the station to check the lift before the evening peak. This trial combined a timetable change with improvements to the connection itself. Consequently, a reduction in missed buses would not, on its own, show which part of the trial had produced the improvement.

The two incomplete checks describe a safety function that had not been restored at stage I. Keep that scope in a finding. This sheet alone does not name every decision maker, explain the later supply quota, or resolve the wider cause of dangerous changes. Those questions require additional records and technical review.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 两项未完成检查说明，阶段I的安全功能尚未恢复。核查结论保留这个范围。仅此页尚未识别全部决策者，无法解释后来供给配额，也未解决危险变化的广泛原因；那些问题需要更多记录与技术核验。

entries.english_definition: Serving as supporting equipment rather than the main system.

contexts.paragraph_english: Route B may be used only while the auxiliary pump is running and only by vessels with a draught of no more than 1.2 metres. Both conditions apply. The pump controls water in the dock facilities; it does not alter the draught limit printed in this notice.

Pera: I am willing to discuss that new work, but it must have an end we can inspect. Naming a repairer is not enough. Tell us which device is included, where its supplies come from and who can repeat the check. The household auxiliary alarm may be a suitable separate job. It is not the flooded pump room again. I also want the town's wage cover and meals recorded before extra packages are allocated. A person asked to bear the cost of a shutdown needs to know what is actually waiting at the receiving desk.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 佩拉：我愿意谈新工作，但它要有可检查的终点。仅列维修人不足，还应说明设备、物资来源与复查者。住区辅助警报器可以成为另一项工作，不是再次把泵房注满。额外分配前，也要记清矿镇工资保障与暖食。被要求承担停产代价的人，需要知道接收台究竟准备了什么。
