contexts.paragraph_chinese: 六塔工程账有不同货物和后续工单。地方工包不能满足TWR-R3隔离器、备用源、供给或增强控制需求；辅助警报器又使用自己的工坊零件。可行方案应保留这三项独立账目。

contexts.paragraph_english: Stores clerk: I have one further correction to the draft. It says the auxiliary alarm parts will come out of these six packages. They will not. The workshop offers a separate repair pack for that invited job, and the engineering ledger holds different tower components. Please keep the three accounts named. A repair can be useful without being a tower upgrade. If the proposed recipients change before delivery, show me the new distribution and check the stock again. If the packages have already moved, start from their actual current ownership instead of the old reservation.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 库管员：草稿还需更正一处：它说辅助警报器零件来自这六包，实际并非如此。工坊为获邀工作另备维修包，工程账又有不同塔部件，请分列三账。维修可以有用，无需把它叫成塔升级。交付前接收方改变时，请带新分配复查库存；已经转移后，从当前归属开始，不从旧预留开始。

entries.english_definition: Kept available to replace an item when needed.

contexts.paragraph_english: Voss's questions about a transition week deserve specific answers. Goods need a source and a destination, duties need people and a handover, and a common protocol needs the actual participants' acceptance. These requirements can be examined without accepting her request to delay independent scrutiny. Agreement with a concern is not agreement with every measure proposed in its name. Retain the unfavourable appendix and the limits of the new result. The choice to keep central coordination later will not erase a person's documented responsibility; a preference for distribution will not create a missing spare or excuse an unsafe operation.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 沃斯关于过渡周的问题需具体答：货物有来源与去处，岗位有人员与交接，共同协议需实际参与者接受。查这些条件不必接受延后独立复核。赞同担忧不等于赞同以其名义所有措施。保留不利附录及新结果边界，日后保留中央不会抹去已记录责任，偏好分布也不会生成零件或使危险操作免责。

contexts.paragraph_english: Dispatcher: Before you collect any parts, there is a correction to the earlier message. We were told that the spare navigation beacon had been destroyed. The inspection does not support that account. The beacon itself still works; the damaged part is the bracket that holds it in place.
Oren: The signal now reaches both rooms. I replaced the damaged connection, and the spare parts are listed here. Someone other than me should test it before the residents rely on it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 奥伦：信号现在能到两间房。我替换了损坏接线，备用零件列在这里。住民依赖它之前，应该由我之外的人测试。

contexts.paragraph_english: The public work list distinguishes conservation of an existing service from enhancement of its future capacity. A tower can be safe to approach while still lacking either kind of completed work. Its base packet contains one isolator, one local backup and two provisions for protected service. Two qualified watch posts and one local installation crew belong to the same conservation arrangement. These are practical requirements with actual owners. They do not become completed work because a diagram contains six tower names, or because the player has acquired enough personal money and spare parts.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 公开清单区分现有服务保全与未来容量增强。塔可安全接近，却仍缺完成的工作。基础包含一隔离套、一备用组、两保全包，同一安排还需要两名合格值守和一个安装班组。这些要求都有真实归属，不因图上有六塔名或玩家钱与零件足够就成为完成结果。

entries.english_definition: An extra copy or system available if the main one fails.

contexts.paragraph_english: The navigation beacon is present, but its mounting bracket is damaged. The boat also carries a charged backup battery reserved for the beacon. Repairs and connections must be completed before the installed beacon is tested. A check made before the configuration changes cannot certify the new configuration.

Electrician: Keep it off. The inspection team has not finished isolating the flooded cables. The ferry has its own charged backup battery, with enough reserve for the beacon during this evacuation. That supply is separate from the workshop equipment. Once the new bracket is fitted and the battery connected, check the beacon on the boat. A working light on a bench is not the same as a checked installation.

The repair cabinet contains one tagged clamp set and one fixed reserve connector for this station. Record their tags when collecting them. These are local maintenance items. The reserve connector fits the station's existing backup seat; it is not a tower backup pack, the Glimmer's battery or personal crafting scrap. The clamp is kept for this inspection and may be repositioned while the conveyor remains isolated.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 检修料柜有一套带标签夹具和一个本站固定备用连接头。领取时记录标签。二者均是地方检修物件。连接头适配本站既有备用源座，不是塔站备用包、微光号电池或个人制作零件。夹具留给这次检修，输送器隔离时可以重置位置。

contexts.paragraph_english: The rear work point is available for recording future preservation requirements. Its labels list one base isolator, one local backup pack and two base provision packs for this tower. These labels describe required supplies, not items already delivered. Stable access and a local dinner feed do not fill the work point or the engineering ledger.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 后部工作点可登记以后保全需求：一个基础隔离件、一个本地备用包、两个基础保障包。这是需求，不是已交付库存。安全通路与地方晚餐回路均未填充此工作点或工程账。

entries.english_definition: An item used instead of the existing one.

contexts.paragraph_english: Limited maintenance exception. Havel, the dispatch officer, may commission inspection and repair of the civil ferry's navigation equipment and the local workshop arrangements needed to obtain its replacement parts. State that the purpose is evacuation assistance and identify those work areas in the request. Harbour main-generator operation is outside this exception: its safety isolation has not been confirmed. A commission allows local preparation; the ferry remains at the quay until a tested current configuration and an explicitly confirmed departure plan are available. Neither a fee nor a language score is required to request the commission. Crew recruitment, patrol-boat use and access to retained accident records are separate decisions and must not be inferred from this document.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 有限检修例外：调度负责人哈文可委托民用渡轮导航设备检修及为取替换件所需的本地工坊操作。申请写明协助撤离及这些范围。主发电机安全隔离尚未确认，操作它不在例外内。委托只允许准备；当前配置测试与明确离港方案确认完成前，渡轮留港。申请不需费用或英语分数；招募、巡灯船及事故记录调阅均另行授权。

contexts.paragraph_english: Electrician: That distinction matters. Do not look for a replacement beacon when what you need is a replacement bracket. There is a suitable bracket in the west workshop. Access to the workshop has to be dealt with locally, so this recording is not permission to walk through a restricted work area.

The freight-lift branch can be repaired from this side and tested before use. Keep its repair and test records distinct. This creates an optional quicker loop to the lift station; the fixed inspection ladder remains available even if production is reduced. A repaired branch carries the same people, not a replacement group or a second rescue reward.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 货运升降支路可从此侧修复并在使用前测试。修复与测试各留记录；支路形成返回升降站的较短回环，减产后固定检修梯仍可使用。回环运送同一批人，不产生替代工人或第二份救援奖励。

contexts.paragraph_english: A decision can be revised, but revision has physical limits. Before delivery, the team can change the distribution while the packages remain available. After a connection has been installed or supplies used, a new plan must acknowledge that state. Writing a different destination does not return the old package to the store. The same principle applies to duty. A person who leaves for a travelling assignment needs a local replacement before taking a new post. Clear revision rules let people change their minds without pretending that completed work and existing commitments vanish with the previous draft.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 决定可以修改，修改也有物理边界。交付前，物资仍在时可改分配；接线已安装或用品已消耗后，新计划应承认现状。另写目的地不能让旧工包回库。值守同理：某人离开参加出行工作前，需要本地接替。清楚的修订规则允许改变主意，也无需假装完成工作和已有承诺随旧稿消失。

entries.english_definition: The act of extending or restoring an arrangement.

contexts.paragraph_english: At the relay isolation layer, control the field projector before isolating the two local feed selectors. Check this layer's current indicators after both selectors are placed. This establishes safe access to the machine hall. It does not perform the hall's separate branch verification, disable its two internal renewal components, or authorise controlled stop. Configuration changes invalidate the check for the changed object.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 继电隔离层先制止护场投射器，再隔离两个本地供给选择器，两者放好后查本层当前指示。这建立到机组大厅安全通行，没有完成大厅独立支路核验、停用两续启组件或批准受控停止。改变对象配置，使该对象原检查失效。

contexts.paragraph_english: Service record: A stop request by itself did not prevent reconnection. We marked the left and right forced-link branches, the finite renewal components and the damping check as separate objects. First isolate both forced-link branches and verify the current configuration. Either branch may be isolated first. Before verification, force against the main resistance meter has no effect. Do not interpret this as an instruction to attack a different, unlabelled facility.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 检修记录：单独停止请求没有阻止重连。我们分别标明左右强制联络支路、有限续启组件与阻尼检查。先隔离两支路并核当前配置，左右先后可换。核验前对主抵抗计量施力无效，不能据此攻击另一未标设施。

contexts.paragraph_english: Place ISO-L and ISO-R in their isolated positions, then inspect the current revision at the separate check stand. They control the corridor feed for this layer. Reconnecting either selector cancels the corridor isolation check until it is performed again. A preserved earlier check remains a historical record but cannot authorise entry under a changed configuration. The internal renewal relays are different components in the next hall.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 将ISO-L/R置隔离位，再在独立检查站核当前版本。它们控制本层通道供给。任一重连会取消通道隔离有效检查，须重查；旧检查仍是历史记录，不能许可变配置后进入。内部续启继电器是下一厅另两组件。

contexts.paragraph_english: After the verified link work, control can reduce resistance to seventy per cent of this encounter's actual starting capacity. Any excess in that action is discarded at this boundary. The phase changes only at the complete action's end. Existing damaging intentions are replaced by a visible non-damaging recalibration, and two finite renewal components are scheduled for the next round. They do not act immediately in this decision slot.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 联络工作核验后，可将抵抗降到本次实际起始容量70%。此动作超出边界部分舍弃，仅完整动作末切段。旧伤害意图换为可见无伤害重校准，两有限续启组件排到下一轮，不在当前决策槽立刻行动。

entries.english_definition: A change intended to improve equipment or capability.

contexts.paragraph_english: Six extra packages, LOCAL-R3-01 to LOCAL-R3-06, are held in the dispatch store for this assignment. They contain local work supplies rather than personal upgrade parts. Each package must have one recorded owner or receiving work group at a time. Reserving a package for an agreed arrangement does not deliver it, and the same package cannot be listed against both shelter and production.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 六个额外工包LOCAL-R3-01至06由调度库为本委托保管，内为地方作业用品，不是个人改件零件。每包同一时刻只有一项归属或接收工作组。为约定安排预留尚未交付，同包不能同时列于安置和生产。

contexts.paragraph_english: Pera: The delivery is the point at which the packages move from the store to the named work. Before that, a draft may be revised while the stock remains. Afterwards we must retain the real destination and whatever has already been used. A new paragraph cannot return installed material. The town's emergency wage voucher is also separate from the travelling commission's reward. I will not ask someone to fund the agreed basic protection from personal upgrade parts, and I will not describe the six-tower cargo as if it were already in this store.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 佩拉：交付使工包从库内转到具名工作。此前，库存仍在时可以改草稿；此后须保留真实去向及已用材料，新段落不能返还已安装物资。矿镇应急工资凭据也与出行委托奖励分开。我不会要求用个人改件零件填已约定基本保障，也不会把六塔货物说成已在本库。

contexts.paragraph_english: Stores clerk: I have one further correction to the draft. It says the auxiliary alarm parts will come out of these six packages. They will not. The workshop offers a separate repair pack for that invited job, and the engineering ledger holds different tower components. Please keep the three accounts named. A repair can be useful without being a tower upgrade. If the proposed recipients change before delivery, show me the new distribution and check the stock again. If the packages have already moved, start from their actual current ownership instead of the old reservation.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 库管员：草稿还需更正一处：它说辅助警报器零件来自这六包，实际并非如此。工坊为获邀工作另备维修包，工程账又有不同塔部件，请分列三账。维修可以有用，无需把它叫成塔升级。交付前接收方改变时，请带新分配复查库存；已经转移后，从当前归属开始，不从旧预留开始。

contexts.paragraph_english: After Q-304 and the agreed A2 commitment, the workshop can release repair pack AUX-R3-A2 for the invited job. Its connection part is held for this auxiliary device and is separate from personal upgrade parts, the six local extra packages and the tower engineering cargo. The part must actually move from its pack to the device. A saved promise cannot install it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: Q-304及A2约定承诺之后，工坊可为获邀工作释放AUX-R3-A2维修包。接线件归此辅助设备专用，与个人改件零件、六地方工包和塔工程货分开。零件须实际从包转到装置；保存承诺不能安装。

entries.english_definition: A changed version of a document or plan.

contexts.paragraph_english: Record which branch was tested, the selector revision and the observed load. A successful test supports operation at that configuration and scope. Changing the selector or reserve connection requires a fresh test. The drawing demonstrates a local arrangement that can be inspected; it does not list the equipment, crew or supply needed to convert the modern tower.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 记录所测试支路、选择器修订状态与实际负荷。成功试验只支持对应配置与范围；改动档位或备用接线后须重新试验。旧图提供地方运行结构，没有列出现代塔站改造所需设备、人员与供给。

contexts.paragraph_english: Custodian: Before we start, this is a bounded review, not an election for the future system. We have the old design, the later revision and correction note, the policy and test authorisations, the executive orders and the station register. The copies remain labelled as copies. Personal addresses and unrelated identities are excluded. Each claim will have a source version and each responding party will have a chance to challenge its scope. If a channel declines to answer, I will record the decline. It will not become an admission simply because someone in this room wishes it were.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 保管人：这是一场有限审查，不是未来制度选举。已有旧设计、后续修订和纠正、政策及测试授权、执行令、北站登记；副本标副本，住址和无关身份排除。每条主张有来源版、各方有质疑范围机会。拒答按拒答登记，不因厅里有人希望便成认罪。

contexts.paragraph_english: The kitchen would welcome early leaves, while the store keeper wants a stronger later reserve. Neither request removes the other need. The group may choose either complete arrangement and record the trade-off, or ask for an agreed revision before planting. A proposal which uses more than six beds is not yet a feasible allocation.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 厨房希望早有叶菜，仓管希望增强晚期储备。两类需求同时存在。可选任一完整配置并记录取舍，也可种植前申请共识修改。超过六床的提议尚不可执行。

contexts.paragraph_english: A decision can be revised, but revision has physical limits. Before delivery, the team can change the distribution while the packages remain available. After a connection has been installed or supplies used, a new plan must acknowledge that state. Writing a different destination does not return the old package to the store. The same principle applies to duty. A person who leaves for a travelling assignment needs a local replacement before taking a new post. Clear revision rules let people change their minds without pretending that completed work and existing commitments vanish with the previous draft.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 决定可以修改，修改也有物理边界。交付前，物资仍在时可改分配；接线已安装或用品已消耗后，新计划应承认现状。另写目的地不能让旧工包回库。值守同理：某人离开参加出行工作前，需要本地接替。清楚的修订规则允许改变主意，也无需假装完成工作和已有承诺随旧稿消失。

entries.english_definition: Messages exchanged between people or organisations.

contexts.paragraph_english: This relay records signals locally even when its outgoing link is unavailable. The independent recorder and the outgoing transmitter are separate parts of the station. Before touching the displaced outgoing lead, switch the local transmitter off and isolate it. Seat the lead, restore the station's own reserve and run a link check. The test confirms this lead and power configuration only. If either changes, repeat it before requesting a boat. A successful link test is not evidence that a distant tower is safe. The postal locker may be opened for the named technician after the shore rescue has been completed. Its contents are correspondence, not a certificate about the sender's present whereabouts. The rear latch can be opened from this room to provide a shorter route back to the rescue shelter.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 中继站外发链路中断时仍可本地记录；独立记录器与外发设备是两个部件。检修移位接线前关闭并隔离本地发送设备，再落座接线，恢复本站储备，做当前配置链路检查。改变接线或电源须重新检查；成功不证明远方塔站安全。救援完成后，具名检修员才可领取邮务柜通信，它不证明寄信人目前所在或状态。后门内闩可从站内打开，缩短返回救援棚的路线。

contexts.paragraph_english: For public-data verification, the custodian permits review of report GH-R7 version 7, including observation identifiers, tested conditions, outcome entries, the issue version and circulation dates. Ask for those necessary fields and state the receiving technician and purpose. Political agreement is not an access condition. Household addresses, personal correspondence and unrelated medical fields remain outside this permission.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 公共数据核验可调阅GH-R7报告第7版，范围包括观察标识、受试条件、结果、发行版本与流转日期。应申请必要字段，说明接收技术员和用途。政治赞同不是调阅条件。住址、私人通信和无关医疗字段不在许可内。

entries.english_definition: Information that makes an unclear point easier to understand.

contexts.paragraph_english: The shared study room has two course notices for the same afternoon. The original notice places instrument practice in room Cedar at 14:00. A dated correction moves that practice to room Birch at 14:00 because Cedar is reserved for the archive workshop. Keep both notices, identify what the correction changes and ask the course desk for clarification if you intend to attend both. The correction concerns a room, not cancellation of a course.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 共学室有同日下午两课程通知。原通知仪表练习14:00在Cedar，标日期更正改为14:00在Birch，因为Cedar留给档案工作坊。应保留两件，说明更正哪项，想参加两课则向课程台澄清。更正的是房间，不是取消课程。

contexts.paragraph_english: Electrician: Exactly. The route still has to be selected from the current notices and the ferry particulars. I am confirming the equipment arrangement, not saying that every channel is suitable. Write down the route, the restrictions that ruled out the alternatives, and what the crew must do before leaving. If you are not sure what an instruction means, ask for clarification rather than treating a guess as approval.

All three internal phases share this attempt's life, focus, action points, carried supplies, aid allotment, cooldowns, relic uses and placed devices. A phase transition replenishes none of them. Reading, writing, translation, clarification and actual audio playback pause the plan slots, without providing recovery or executing a queued click on return. Withdrawing retries the whole declared encounter entry, not a free refill between phases.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 三内部阶段共用本次生命、专注、AP、携带补给、配发、冷却、遗物次数和放置装置。切段没有补满。阅读、写作、翻译、澄清与实际播放音轨暂停计划槽，不提供恢复，也不在返回时补执行排队点击。撤退重试整个声明入口，没有内部阶段免费回满。

entries.english_definition: A difference between records that should agree.

contexts.paragraph_english: MC-2 has two incomplete on-site checks although its acceptance form marks all six accepted. MC-3 leaves one official acceptance open alongside an incomplete check. To explain the MC-2 discrepancy, inspect its particular fields, source versions and signature. The aggregate table helps locate a disagreement; it cannot identify the cause of every accident from a total alone.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: MC-2有两项现场未完成，验收表却把六项全部列为合格。MC-3的一项正式验收与未完成检查均仍待处理。解释MC-2差异须查具体字段、来源版本和签章。汇总表帮助定位冲突，不能仅凭总数识别每次事故的原因。

contexts.paragraph_english: The displayed comparison becomes available after a lawful inspection of the original instrument, retained copy and formal form. A written summary should state its local scope, compare the main patterns and identify the records needed to examine a discrepancy. Preserve the counts as recorded; explain an uncertainty rather than filling it with an assumed event.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 依法检查原始仪表、留存副本与正式表后，才提供此比较。书面摘要应注明本地范围、比较主要模式，并说明检查差异需要哪些记录。保留所记数值；解释未知，不用假定事件填空。

entries.english_definition: A relevant difference between two things.

contexts.paragraph_english: This distinction matters when an inspection has several stages. One person observes the instrument, another makes a workshop copy, and a signatory accepts the delivered work. Those actions are connected, but they have different responsibilities. The observer records a condition under stated settings. The copy preserves that observation and its source. The acceptance records a decision about whether the work meets a requirement. Placing the three pages together makes it possible to ask where their claims agree and where a decision went beyond the evidence available at that stage.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 检查有多个阶段时，这一区分格外有用。一人观察仪表，另一人抄成工坊副本，签章人验收交付。行动相连，职责各异：观察者在注明设置下记状态；副本保存观察及来源；验收页记录工作是否符合要求的判断。并列三页，就能比较主张在哪些地方一致、何处决定超出了当时证据。

contexts.paragraph_english: Electrician: That distinction matters. Do not look for a replacement beacon when what you need is a replacement bracket. There is a suitable bracket in the west workshop. Access to the workshop has to be dealt with locally, so this recording is not permission to walk through a restricted work area.

We also compared the two evenings. Thursday was usually busier than Tuesday, but the difference became smaller after the deadline for a major course assignment had passed. We cannot assume that students always prefer Thursday. Nor can we say that later opening improved examination results: the trial did not measure them. Increased use is useful evidence about access, not direct evidence about academic achievement. When you read the short report, keep that distinction in mind.

The first distinction is between basic protection and the extra choices which remain afterwards. A person needing first aid should not compete with a workshop project for the same promised packet. The checked exit, meals, warm room and agreed wage cover belong to the basic arrangement. Once those are actually provided, the extra packages can be discussed. Keeping separate records helps people see whether a proposal improves something additional or merely renames a service that should already be present. It also makes a shortage harder to hide behind a broad description of support.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 第一项区分是基本保障与后来额外选择。需要急救的人不该与工坊项目争夺同一份已承诺用品。受检出口、暖食、暖房和约定工资保障属于基本安排，实际落实后才谈额外工包。独立记录让人看清提案是新增改善，还是换名描述本就应提供的服务，也更难用宽泛支持措辞掩盖短缺。

entries.english_definition: An explanation of what information means.

contexts.paragraph_english: The columns describe different measures: an administrative classification and a dated residence check. The figures do not explain the original reasons for classification. Record the mismatch, the scope of this group and the limit on interpretation. Preserve the evidence references for later review.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 两列衡量不同对象：行政分类与有日期的居住核查。数字没有解释最初分类原因。应记录差异、住区组范围和解释限制，并保留证据来源。

contexts.paragraph_english: Our present work has a limited end. The residence check can support a correction to local planning. A dated handover can support a statement about a person's condition at that handover. A small-station test can support a particular local load arrangement. Each result is useful when its scope is preserved. When we send the next package, we should leave its recipient able to inspect what happened, question our interpretation and see what remains open. That is how a record can carry an inquiry forward without carrying every part of a person's life with it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本次工作有有限终点。居住查验可以支持更正地方规划；有日期交接可以支持交接时状态；小支站试验可以支持特定地方负荷配置。保留范围时，每项结果都有用。下一资料包应让接收方能够查验发生的事、质疑解释，并看见仍待解决的部分。这样，记录才带着调查前进，同时为个人生活保留空间。

contexts.paragraph_english: Choose emergency_public_redacted or protected_review. In either form, list the claim, the cited source version, the responding party and the response or explicit decline. Provide Mara, Voss and the station executive channel an opportunity to challenge claims separately. No response is not proof of innocence or guilt. Disputed interpretation remains noted alongside the fixed documents. The custodian checks that confidential identities are excluded and records that all three response opportunities were offered. A submitted essay cannot perform these invitations, overwrite a signature or turn a majority preference into a new historical fact. The resulting summary separates design and delayed correction, known-risk policy and testing, and cancelled review with detention.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 可选 emergency_public_redacted 或 protected_review。两种均逐条列主张、来源版本、回应方以及回应或明确拒绝；玛拉、沃斯、北站执行渠道分别获得反证机会。不回应不是无罪或有罪证明。争议解释与固定文献并存；保管人检查身份脱敏，登记三方均获机会。作文不会自动邀请、改签名或用多数偏好制造历史事实。摘要分开设计及迟延纠正、已知风险政策与测试、取消复核及扣押。

contexts.paragraph_english: Your short final instruction should identify the chosen prepared direction and acknowledge its operating boundary. You may write freely and then explicitly confirm the action that the system proposes. A structured fallback is available when language interpretation is uncertain or unavailable. It records a deliberate choice while leaving the writing assessment pending. Word count, subtitles, translation, hints, companions, combat difficulty and political vocabulary do not add or remove a technical qualification.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 最后短指令须明确准备好的方向及运行边界。可自由写后逐项确认系统呈现的动作，语言解释不确定或不可用时有结构化后备。它记录明确选择，写作评价仍待审。字数、字幕、翻译、提示、同伴、战斗难度或政治用词都不会增减技术资格。

entries.english_definition: The limits of what can currently be established.

contexts.paragraph_english: Comparison envelope for the coast recorder collected after the shore rescue. The original instrument label reports loss of the observed light signal at 21:14:12. Its last routine comparison with the ship clock had an uncertainty of approximately two seconds. The harbour control event is labelled 21:14:10 on a different clock. The handover copy reports a separate control-to-ship comparison within one second. The combined comparisons therefore allow a three-second interval between the two labelled clocks. These readings are consistent within that recorded interval; they are not evidence that every clock displayed an identical second. Together with the approved window and the duty handover, the records support a planned interruption with a required protection removed. Keep the original extract attached. Nothing in this envelope certifies the sender of the inspection mail as currently alive, safe or present at a particular destination.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 救援后实际取得的海岸记录器副本保留原标21:14:12，与船钟最近比对约有两秒不确定。控制钟21:14:10与其在已记不确定范围内相符，不是所有钟秒数完全一致；不证明导师当前存活、安全或去向。 值班记录另证控制钟与船钟相差一秒以内；合并两次比对界限允许两仪器标签有三秒差。

contexts.paragraph_english: Safety watcher: I can accept the separate watch post and record the checks for the current configuration. If a connection or load setting changes, the earlier pass does not remain current. A fault needs a safe response, and the fixed return route must stay usable. The written handover should identify me and the operator, the setting tested and the window's end. It can acknowledge uncertainty about the wider disturbance pattern. Our work establishes a local bounded operation; it does not certify the cause of every mine hazard or authorise a future central-network policy.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 安全观察员：我可承接独立观察岗，记录当前配置检查。接线或负荷变化后，旧通过不能继续算当前有效。故障须有安全处置，固定返程保持可用。书面交接应列我与操作员、受检设置和窗口终点，也可说明广泛扰动模式仍不确定。我们建立本地有界运行，尚未认证所有危险原因，也未授权未来中央政策。

contexts.paragraph_english: The displayed comparison becomes available after a lawful inspection of the original instrument, retained copy and formal form. A written summary should state its local scope, compare the main patterns and identify the records needed to examine a discrepancy. Preserve the counts as recorded; explain an uncertainty rather than filling it with an assumed event.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 依法检查原始仪表、留存副本与正式表后，才提供此比较。书面摘要应注明本地范围、比较主要模式，并说明检查差异需要哪些记录。保留所记数值；解释未知，不用假定事件填空。

contexts.paragraph_english: A signature also has a scope. It can identify the person who accepted a particular version, without showing that this person invented every instruction attached to the wider system. Equally, uncertainty about wider instructions does not make the signature disappear. A signatory can explain a deadline, a shortage or pressure from a supervisor, and that explanation may help a review. It should remain separate from the check of what was signed. Otherwise an account of difficult circumstances can quietly replace the evidence of an action which still needs to be addressed.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 签名也有范围：它可识别某一版本的验收者，未必说明此人设计了整个系统的所有指示。对于广泛指示的未知，也不会让签名消失。签章人可以说明期限、短缺或主管压力，帮助核查；这些说明应与签了什么分开。否则，关于困难处境的叙述可能悄悄替换仍需处理的行动证据。

entries.english_definition: Checking a claim against appropriate evidence.

contexts.paragraph_english: This is a historical document. It contains no present message from its signatories and gives no current location for Mara. Include its version and the remaining verification in any factual summary sent for review.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 这是历史文书，没有签名人的当前消息，也没有玛拉目前的位置。提交事实摘要时应保留版本和待核查范围。

contexts.paragraph_english: Sian: Supply concerns are real, but they do not justify removing unfavourable results or denying an independent review. We can record the limits and practical preparation while retaining public scrutiny. You may agree with a technical concern and refuse the proposed information restriction. Those decisions are separate. The location records should also pass through their bounded verification; a holding-facility code does not tell us Mara's present condition.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 西安：供给担忧确实存在，但不能据此删除不利结果或拒绝独立复核。可以记录限制及实际准备，同时保留公共查验。你可赞同技术担忧并拒绝信息限制，两决定分别保存。地点记录也按限定范围核验；扣押设施代码不说明玛拉目前情况。

contexts.paragraph_english: The proposed technical package contains the MC-2 instrument reference, retained-copy chain and formal acceptance version, with the current environment readings and their settings. Label the sample with the same observation stage and a lawful receiving purpose: academic verification of the recorded load, extraction and disturbance relationship. Include the known limits and any changed configuration.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 拟送技术包包括MC-2仪表索引、留存抄录链、正式验收版本，以及当前环境读数与设置。样本注明同一观察阶段，并列合法接收用途：学城核验所记录负荷、抽取和扰动关系。保留已知限制及变更配置。

contexts.paragraph_english: Formal request through the Beacon Office, authorised by Voss: send the local instrument versions, extraction settings and associated disturbance observations to the academic receiving desk for verification. Retain the current safety conditions while the relationship is examined. The receiving inquiry should distinguish an observed association from a tested explanation, and preserve relevant counterexamples or alternative conditions.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 灯署正式渠道要求，由沃斯授权：将地方仪表版本、抽取设置及对应扰动观察送到学城接收台核验。关系核查期间保留当前安全条件。接收调查应区分所见关联与经过试验的解释，并保留相关反例或其他条件。

entries.english_definition: Checking or adjusting a measurement against a reference.

contexts.paragraph_english: The old controller remains available for a later bounded positive check. Keeping a failed result does not force you to reject every local-control arrangement. Conversely, a later stable result cannot delete T2 or T3. Before a broader trial, carry the retained conditions to the calibration room and check its own isolation, reserve and instruments. Old settings do not certify that new configuration.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 旧控制器仍可供后来有限正例核验。保留失败结果不强迫你排除所有本地控制，后来稳定也不能删除T2或T3。较广试验前，携条件到校准间，检查该处隔离、储备与仪表；旧设置不会认证新配置。

contexts.paragraph_english: Please draw the process with calibration before entry, physical output preparation before execution, and observations before acceptance. If the configuration changes, we check it again. We keep previous runs as previous runs. A safe stop is a recorded failure in that condition, and a stable interval is evidence for that interval. Neither is a referendum on every future policy.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 流程图把校准放在进入前、实体输出准备放在执行前、观察放在接受前。配置变更须重查，旧运行仍是旧运行。安全停止是该条件下的失败，稳定时段是该时段证据，两者都不是关于未来所有政策的公投。

contexts.paragraph_english: The calibration room contains the installed island-trial controller C, a local reserve module and two labelled channels. Channel Z is the zero reference; channel R is the fixed reference mark. Check Z at 0 and R at 10 before recording a calibration. These are local instrument marks, not tower operating units. Both checks must belong to the current instrument revision. Changing the channel connection or bypassing its isolation invalidates the previous check.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 校准间已装孤网控制器C、本地储备模块和两标记通道。Z为零参考，R为固定参考标。记录校准前，Z应为0、R应为10；它们是本地仪表标记，不是塔运行单位。两检查都应属于当前仪表版本，改连接或绕隔离令旧检查失效。

contexts.paragraph_english: Before the live island arrangement, control the calibration defence from the external stand, inspect the isolation, seat the labelled reserve connector and secure both guards. The checked reserve is the room's installed reserve, not the Glimmer's battery. Declare a local duty officer and a review officer for the bounded current window. These are trial posts only; they do not occupy or grant permanent six-tower operator posts.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 带载孤网准备前，从外侧站位制止校准防卫，检查隔离、座好带标储备连接头并固定护罩。受检储备属于此室，不是微光号电池。为当前有限窗口明确试验操作员与复核员；这些是试验岗位，没有占用或授予六塔永久岗位。

entries.english_definition: A value obtained by a defined measuring method.

contexts.paragraph_english: The pump-room inspection passage branches from this track. The bypass label is readable from the maintenance stand, but handling its machinery needs the local assignment. A copy of the gauge sheet placed here retains the gauge's source reference. It does not become a second independent measurement just because it has been moved to this board.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 泵房检修通路从轨道分出。可从维护站位读取旁路标签，操作设备需要本地委托。此板上的仪表页副本保留仪表来源；放到另一块板上，不会成为第二次独立测量。

contexts.paragraph_english: The local observation sheet records three successive work stages. At stages A, B and C, the extraction settings were 1, 2 and 3 load units. The associated disturbance readings were 4, 7 and 9 on the same local indicator. The indicator's numbers are relative readings for comparison, not a medical scale or a complete measurement of the mist sea. The instrument and its setting must be recorded with the sample.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 地方观察页记录三个连续工作阶段。A、B、C阶段抽取设置分别为1、2、3负荷单位，同一本地指示器的扰动读数为4、7、9。数值是用于比较的相对读数，并非医疗尺度或对整个雾海的完整测量。样本须附仪器与设置。

contexts.paragraph_english: The reusable preparation issue technical-d3-v1 follows the academy’s retained failures, current bounded successful configuration and public handover. Controller C, checked reserve, local isolation and qualified duty supported a limited circuit at the tested load. The issue records how to install and inspect that bounded arrangement; it is not a measurement of all six towers. Each district must still inspect its real installation, receive transition supplies, obtain a local trial permit and run the current configuration. Keep the old failed and successful observations.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 可复用准备稿technical-d3-v1继承学城保留反例、当前有限成功配置和公开交接。控制器C、受检备用、当地隔离及合格岗位支持已测试负荷下的有限回路。该稿说明如何安装检查这个受限安排，不是六塔全网测量。各地还须检查实际安装、取得过渡供给和地方试验许可，并按当前配置试运行；保留旧成功和失败观察。

contexts.paragraph_english: The frontier station receives reports from places that have faced different problems. A wet workshop, an overloaded pump and a damaged transfer line may all leave interrupted service, but the interruptions are not interchangeable measurements. Before combining them, the survey team records the place, instrument, working stage and protected service involved. The present visit follows the old city's verified handover. It preserves the direct confirmation that Mara was rescued, while retaining the separately examined responsibilities for design, policy and execution. A new measurement cannot quietly rewrite those earlier findings.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 边境测站接收各地不同问题的报告。潮湿工坊、过载泵和损坏线路都可能造成中断，却不能作为同一种测量合并。调查组先记地点、仪表、工作阶段与保护服务。本次继承旧都交接，保留玛拉获救的直接确认及分别核查的设计、政策、执行责任；新测量不能悄悄改写旧结论。

entries.english_definition: Selecting a portion of material or observations for examination.

contexts.paragraph_english: Both methods retain the greenhouse beds and leave a checkable result at the valves. Sampling secures the affected root section while its reaction is controlled; mechanical treatment secures the return and clears the external winding. Merely selecting a method does not produce a clearance receipt. The actual encounter or work procedure must reach its safe objective, after which the branch stands can be inspected again.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 两种方法均保留种植床，并在阀处留下可核查结果。取样方法在控制反应时固定根段；机械方法固定回流并清除外部缠绕。选择方法本身不产生回执。实际遭遇或工作程序达到安全目标后，方可重新检查支路。

contexts.paragraph_english: Custodian: Then the outgoing package should retain the stage-I instrument reference, its copying chain and the acceptance version. Add the current environment readings with their settings and sampling conditions. List what this local comparison establishes and what the academic team still needs to test. The receiving desk must acknowledge the actual package and sample; an address written at the top of a draft does not deliver them. We can carry the inquiry forward while leaving the later cause, wider instructions and current whereabouts of people outside this inspection explicitly open.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 保管人：送出包应保留阶段I仪表索引、抄录链和验收版本，再附当前环境读数、设置与取样条件。列明地方比较核实什么、学城仍需试验什么。接收台应确认实际资料与样本；在草稿顶写地址并未完成交付。调查能够继续，同时把后来原因、广泛指示与此查验之外人物现址保留为未知。

contexts.paragraph_english: Bring back the current instrument sheet as well as the workers. It can establish what was observed in the mine today. Keep the sampling stage, load setting and limitations in the report. The mine is operating at a high extraction setting and dangerous changes have been observed. The present rescue does not establish the full cause of those changes.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 除接回工人，也要带回当前仪表记录，说明今日矿内所见。报告保留取样阶段、负荷设置与限制。矿井目前以高强度抽取，现场出现危险变化；本次救援尚不能证明变化的完整原因。

contexts.paragraph_english: Extraction and disturbance rose together in this short record. Pump operation, nearby machines and sampling conditions also need checking. The sheet provides a traceable question for the academic review: which factors can explain the pattern, and under what conditions could it be reproduced? It cannot by itself show that mining created the mist, that every district has the same response, or that a shutdown will clear the weather immediately.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 这份短记录里，抽取与扰动同时上升。泵房运作、附近机械和采样条件也需核查。资料为学城提出可追查问题：哪些因素能够解释此模式，怎样的条件下可以复现？仅凭它尚不能说明开采创造了雾海、每个地区反应相同，或停机会立即放晴。

entries.english_definition: A selected part used to examine a larger set.

contexts.paragraph_english: Keep the greenhouse beds intact where a safe sample or mechanical clearance permits work. The kitchen feed will need a later load test from the machine room. Opening the stair establishes a route for inspection; it does not establish local power, tower safety or permission to change the central interlock.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 安全取样或机械清理可以完成工作时，应保留种植床。厨房回路还须由机房完成负荷试验。打开检修梯只建立查验路线，未证明本地供能或塔站安全，也未许可改动中央联锁。

contexts.paragraph_english: At the branch valves, we will identify the two blocked returns before choosing a procedure. The sample procedure and the mechanical procedure both have a safe objective. I will work with the local crew if your travelling companions stay outside. Please read the visible hazard plan before entering. A method written in your notebook is a proposal until the actual work is carried out and its result is accepted.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 在支路阀处，我们先识别两处受阻回流，再选择程序。取样和机械程序均有安全目标。若旅行同伴留在外面，我会与地方班组协作。进入前请读可见危险计划。笔记里选了方法，仍只是提案；须实际执行，取得被接受的结果。

contexts.paragraph_english: Inspect the two branch valves from their marked outer stands. The root core surrounds their shared return and may move when the conveyor restarts. Before entering the treatment zone, keep the conveyor isolated, identify both blocked branches and choose the stated sample or mechanical procedure. The local crew can assist under the inspection commission whether or not Mira has joined your travelling party.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 在标记外侧站位检查两条支路阀。缠根核心围住共同回流处，输送器重启时可能活动。进入处置区前应保持输送器隔离，识别两条受阻支路，并选用告示列明的取样或机械程序。地方委托可以提供协作，米拉是否加入旅行队伍均不影响这项协作。

contexts.paragraph_english: The local observation sheet records three successive work stages. At stages A, B and C, the extraction settings were 1, 2 and 3 load units. The associated disturbance readings were 4, 7 and 9 on the same local indicator. The indicator's numbers are relative readings for comparison, not a medical scale or a complete measurement of the mist sea. The instrument and its setting must be recorded with the sample.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 地方观察页记录三个连续工作阶段。A、B、C阶段抽取设置分别为1、2、3负荷单位，同一本地指示器的扰动读数为4、7、9。数值是用于比较的相对读数，并非医疗尺度或对整个雾海的完整测量。样本须附仪器与设置。

entries.english_definition: An organised collection of related measurements or observations.

contexts.paragraph_english: Both teams observed a higher indicator at the mine than at their lower-load comparison station. They did not hold every location condition constant, and their indicator scales share a declared reference rather than identical precision. The dataset supports a testable association. The controlled trial must examine the proposed mechanism and preserve a result that might contradict the proposed replacement scheme.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 两队均观察到矿区指标高于各自低负荷比较站。它们没有固定所有地点条件，指标尺度使用声明参考而非完全相同精度。数据支持可检验关联。受控试验还须检验拟议机制，并保留可能反驳替代方案的结果。

contexts.paragraph_english: The independent field curves and the controller records answer related but different questions. Survey teams observed a pattern across places. Their locations differ in ground conditions, previous operation and available supply. A laboratory run holds a smaller set of declared conditions and permits a specific comparison. Neither dataset alone contains every cause. Combining them responsibly means naming their source roots and scopes, not adding copies until a claim appears certain. An issued report and its retained manuscript may expose a publication difference while still referring to the same original trial.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 独立现场曲线与控制器回答相关而不同问题。调查跨地点看模式，地层、运行历史和供给不同；实验固定较小一组声明条件，可做特定比较。两者均未含全部原因。负责任的结合要注明来源根和范围，不能多添副本便显得确定。发行与留存稿可证明呈现差异，仍指同一原试验。

entries.english_definition: Recorded values or observations used for analysis.

contexts.paragraph_english: The records custodian can grant a bounded review of the retained manuscript, issued report and circulation register. Access depends on the purpose and necessary fields, not on agreeing with a political position. Keep any unfavourable result. The old trial hall is a separate physical assignment. You may pursue that work while preparing your data overview; the small island trial will require both work streams.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 记录保管人可按范围开放留存原稿、发行稿及流转册。访问取决于用途和必要字段，不取决于政治观点。应保留不利结果。旧试验厅是另一项实体工作，可在准备数据概览时并行推进；小规模孤网试验需要两边完成。

contexts.paragraph_english: If the local load has changed since the record was made, keep both the old observation settings and the current configuration. Do not alter the earlier numbers to make the package look consistent. Say which relationship is being tested and which questions remain. The present data can direct a technical inquiry without pretending that it has already found the whole cause.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 记录完成后地方负荷若变动，请同时保留旧观察设置与当前配置。不要为资料看起来一致而修改旧数值。说明待试验的关系与余下问题；当前数据可以引导技术调查，无需假装已经查明全部原因。

contexts.paragraph_english: For public-data verification, the custodian permits review of report GH-R7 version 7, including observation identifiers, tested conditions, outcome entries, the issue version and circulation dates. Ask for those necessary fields and state the receiving technician and purpose. Political agreement is not an access condition. Household addresses, personal correspondence and unrelated medical fields remain outside this permission.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 公共数据核验可调阅GH-R7报告第7版，范围包括观察标识、受试条件、结果、发行版本与流转日期。应申请必要字段，说明接收技术员和用途。政治赞同不是调阅条件。住址、私人通信和无关医疗字段不在许可内。

entries.english_definition: A vertical series of entries in a table.

contexts.paragraph_english: The table concerns the twenty-four entries checked in this priory, not all evacuees. The first column groups entries by the label on the current official roll. The second records voluntary confirmation at the public porches in the present chapter stage. Grouping uses room codes so that the comparison can be reviewed without names.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本表限于修院核查过的二十四项记录，并非所有转移人员。第一列按现行官方名册标签分组，第二列记录本章节阶段在公共门廊自愿确认居住的人数。比较使用房间代码，可以不具名审阅。

entries.english_definition: A quantity formed by combining several separate amounts.

contexts.paragraph_english: MC-2 has two incomplete on-site checks although its acceptance form marks all six accepted. MC-3 leaves one official acceptance open alongside an incomplete check. To explain the MC-2 discrepancy, inspect its particular fields, source versions and signature. The aggregate table helps locate a disagreement; it cannot identify the cause of every accident from a total alone.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: MC-2有两项现场未完成，验收表却把六项全部列为合格。MC-3的一项正式验收与未完成检查均仍待处理。解释MC-2差异须查具体字段、来源版本和签章。汇总表帮助定位冲突，不能仅凭总数识别每次事故的原因。

entries.english_definition: The amount against which a fraction or proportion is compared.

contexts.paragraph_english: Custodian: The four-batch table can help us present the records, as long as we state its denominator. Each batch has six listed checks. The incomplete counts are zero, two, one and zero; the official accepted counts are six, six, five and six. Those are two different measures of the same twenty-four entries. The table makes MC-2 worth examining closely. It does not tell us the history of every machine, or prove that every observed disturbance came from the same cause. The original fields are still needed for the particular finding.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 保管人：四批表可以帮助呈现记录，前提是保留分母。每批六项，未完成数为零、二、一、零；正式合格数为六、六、五、六。两列衡量同一组二十四项的不同方面。表格提示细查MC-2，但没有叙述全部机器历史，也未证明所有扰动来自同一原因。具体结论仍需要原字段。

entries.english_definition: The range or divisions used to express a measurement.

contexts.paragraph_english: The local observation sheet records three successive work stages. At stages A, B and C, the extraction settings were 1, 2 and 3 load units. The associated disturbance readings were 4, 7 and 9 on the same local indicator. The indicator's numbers are relative readings for comparison, not a medical scale or a complete measurement of the mist sea. The instrument and its setting must be recorded with the sample.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 地方观察页记录三个连续工作阶段。A、B、C阶段抽取设置分别为1、2、3负荷单位，同一本地指示器的扰动读数为4、7、9。数值是用于比较的相对读数，并非医疗尺度或对整个雾海的完整测量。样本须附仪器与设置。

contexts.paragraph_english: This comparison changes location as well as load. Ground conditions, prior use and supply connections differ. The curve is a reason to test a hypothesis about load and damage, not a controlled proof that one number explains every difference. The apparatus units used later in Controller A trials are a separate scale; matching the printed number 40 does not make a field station and a laboratory controller the same object.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 这一比较同时改变地点与负荷，地层、既往使用和供给连接均有差异。曲线可提出负荷与损伤的待检假设，不能证明一个数字解释所有差异。后来A控制器的试验单位是另一尺度；同样印着40，不表示现场站与实验控制器是同一对象。

contexts.paragraph_english: Controller A is installed in the old hall. Check isolation, secure its external guard and inspect the labelled reserve socket before changing a load. The failure reconstruction uses the recorded T2 condition: load 70, reserve connected, ten minutes. Confirm the apparatus plate as A. This trial scale is the apparatus's own scale; do not calculate a town's supply from it or replace the record with a different controller.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: A控制器装在旧厅。改负荷前检查隔离、固定外护罩并查看储备插座标记。失败复原使用T2条件：负荷70、连接储备、十分钟；确认装置标牌为A。单位属于此台，不能据此计算城镇供给，也不能换另一控制器冒充同记录。

contexts.paragraph_english: Run T1 used load 40 with the reserve connected and remained stable. T2 used load 70 with the reserve connected and stopped. T3 used load 40 without the reserve and stopped. T4 repeated the T1 configuration and remained stable. No run tested load 55, and none tested full-scale operation across the six regional towers.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: T1负荷40、接储备，稳定；T2负荷70、接储备，停止；T3负荷40、无储备，停止；T4重复T1，稳定。没有测试55，也没有六塔全规模运行。

entries.english_definition: The degree of exactness in a measurement or statement.

contexts.paragraph_english: Both teams observed a higher indicator at the mine than at their lower-load comparison station. They did not hold every location condition constant, and their indicator scales share a declared reference rather than identical precision. The dataset supports a testable association. The controlled trial must examine the proposed mechanism and preserve a result that might contradict the proposed replacement scheme.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 两队均观察到矿区指标高于各自低负荷比较站。它们没有固定所有地点条件，指标尺度使用声明参考而非完全相同精度。数据支持可检验关联。受控试验还须检验拟议机制，并保留可能反驳替代方案的结果。

entries.english_definition: The reference condition against which a change is compared.

contexts.paragraph_english: Inspect the tower return route, present isolation and current duty before issuing the local safety handover. A past test remains readable, but a different configuration cannot use its pass. Local safety here is one limited result. Baseline conversion, enhanced controls and later common operating agreements require their own equipment, posts and work receipts.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 地方安全交接前，检查塔站返程、当前隔离与当班岗位。旧测试可以回看，但另一配置不能沿用其通过。本地安全只是有限结果；基础改造、增强控制和后来共同运行协议，各需自己的设备、岗位与工作回执。

contexts.paragraph_english: Operator: If the load, isolation or duty changes, my earlier test expires. That does not erase the fact that the earlier test occurred. It tells the next team not to mistake history for the present arrangement. The result we can issue today is limited tower safety. Baseline reserve equipment, additional controllers, transition supplies and later field trials remain separate work. Ada: Put that distinction in the onward extract. We have had enough documents that look complete because missing work was described confidently. State what has actually been done and what the frontier team still needs to verify.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 操作员：负荷、隔离、岗位变，旧测试失效，不抹已发生测试，只叫后队别混历史与当前。今日可签有限塔安全，基础备用、额外控制器、过渡补给、现场试运行另属工作。阿妲：摘录写明，缺工作却自信描述的完整文件够多了，写已做与边境仍须核验。

contexts.paragraph_english: The later baseline work order for TWR-R3 requires one base isolator, one local backup source and two base provisions. Enhanced work calls for one controller, two couplers, three transition crates and one trial fixture, with two operator posts and the actual installation crew arrangement. These are engineering-ledger requirements, not items supplied by reading this checklist.

contexts.paragraph_english: The settlement asks for an optional comparison of its forecast and additional needs. Its protected minimum is already included in the main provision plan. contexts.paragraph_english: The proposed response protects essential supply while restricting unverified load. contexts.paragraph_chinese: 应对方案在限制未经核验负荷时保留基本供给，写清保留、延后事项和临时值守。不能因远处聚落资料难取得就撤掉最低保护，也不能为避开讨论承诺无限容量。接班人需检查真实回路，有限说明比安慰话更有用。本报告采用调查工作阶段，不设现实阅读计时。

entries.english_definition: Remaining the same during the relevant period.

entries.english_definition: A device or rule preventing operation until required conditions are met.

contexts.paragraph_english: The shaft's ordinary maintenance handle is installed at the marked stand. Inspect its coupling and the return landing, then secure the handle before approaching the lower coil sentry. A folding lever may provide a declared alternate grip; the ordinary handle and careful cooperation remain available. A route reel can mark a checked return anchor, but it does not reveal an unknown passage or make an unsafe floor safe.

contexts.paragraph_english: The shore winch has its own small reserve; it is not supplied by the harbour generator or by a ship battery. Switch its local power off and isolate the drive before seating the displaced cable. Secure the rescue line at the marked anchor, then set the receiving direction. The cable and line may be prepared in either order while the drive is isolated. Restore local power only after both are secure. Run the tension check with no people on the line. A check belongs to that configuration: moving the receiving direction, reseating the cable or changing power cancels its validity. The nearby animals must be kept away from the receiving path before the line carries people. If a check fails, keep people in the protected assembly area and inspect the preparation again; taking time to read this card does not change the number of survivors. The shelter retains a working short-range distress set for the shore receiving team. It can send the registered rescue request before the separate coast-to-harbour relay is restored. Harbour pickup is confirmed through that relay later; a saved draft at the shelter has not yet sent a request.

contexts.paragraph_chinese: 接应回执：接走避风棚登记的四名幸存者和检修员，经北段上船，南台阶仍不可用。在棚外登记登船点等接应，前往盐雾港公共接应泊位。这只允许本次救援通行，不是一般航行许可、检修委托或巡灯船移交。带走资料并保留来源、时间标签。

contexts.paragraph_english: The bench stops safely when its recorded failure condition is reached. It does not destroy a main-line component. Save the failed run and the configuration before resetting the local apparatus. A reset removes local preparation and current tests; it preserves sources, historical runs, the sample deposit and other districts' progress. No waiting in real time is required: the inspection controls advance the declared simulation clock.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 试验台达到记录的失败条件时安全停止，不毁主线部件。局部复位前，保存失败运行与配置。复位清当前准备和测试，保留来源、历史运行、样本交接及外区进展。无需实时等待，由检查操作推进声明的模拟时钟。

contexts.paragraph_english: Controller A is installed in the old hall. Check isolation, secure its external guard and inspect the labelled reserve socket before changing a load. The failure reconstruction uses the recorded T2 condition: load 70, reserve connected, ten minutes. Confirm the apparatus plate as A. This trial scale is the apparatus's own scale; do not calculate a town's supply from it or replace the record with a different controller.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: A控制器装在旧厅。改负荷前检查隔离、固定外护罩并查看储备插座标记。失败复原使用T2条件：负荷70、连接储备、十分钟；确认装置标牌为A。单位属于此台，不能据此计算城镇供给，也不能换另一控制器冒充同记录。

entries.english_definition: The connected parts or process that produce an effect.

contexts.paragraph_english: Isolate the conveyor at its existing handle before touching the external winding, using the manual drain or removing a guard. Check the stopped mechanism and the water gauge at the marked stands. A page in the archive cannot perform those checks.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 接触外部缠绕、使用手动排水或拆护罩前，应在既有手柄处隔离输送器，并在标记站位检查停转机构与积水表。档案文字不能代替现场检查。

contexts.paragraph_english: The owner invites a repair of the music box and permits inspection of its mechanism. A note supplied with this box specifies a twelve-tooth replacement wheel, MBOX-12. The store also holds a fourteen-tooth wheel for another device. Read the specification before asking the owner to approve the chosen part. The small box belongs to the owner; it is not a reward item or a main-line key.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 主人邀请修音乐盒，允许检查机构。随盒说明要求十二齿替换轮MBOX-12，铺内另有给别装置用的十四齿轮。请求主人批准选件前，请核对规格。盒子属于主人，不是奖励物品或主线钥匙。

contexts.paragraph_english: The owner remembers hearing it at a family meal and may choose to describe that memory privately. Their permission to repair the mechanism does not publish the memory. Ask separately before copying a personal account into a notice. The repair can be paused if permission changes, and the owner may keep the original note without telling the story.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 主人记得家庭聚餐时听过它，可以选择私下讲回忆。维修机构许可不会公开回忆。把个人叙述抄进告示前需另问。许可改变时可以暂停维修，主人也能保留原便条、不讲故事。

contexts.paragraph_english: After fitting an approved part, inspect the turning mechanism and return the same box. A written repair note can state the part used, check performed and limits of the work. The owner can keep that note with the original specification and leave the family memory private. A useful repair does not require a public story.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 安装获准件后，检查旋转机构并归还同一个盒子。书面记录可列所用零件、检查和工作限制。主人可将记录与原规格一同保存，保留家庭回忆私密；有用维修无需一个公开故事。

entries.english_definition: Machines considered together as equipment.

contexts.paragraph_english: This charged battery has sufficient reserve for the beacon during the planned evacuation. It is not intended to restore the harbour supply or power workshop machinery. Receiving officer: Control and custody remain separate from the historical archive. The reviewed records from the old capital remain unchanged by this confrontation. We will record that Rook's command authority is released when the actual points and combat condition are met. We will not record that the central machinery has stopped merely because a person has been restrained. Its indicator is still visible from the audit stand.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 接收值守：制止与看管和历史档案分开。旧都已审记录不会因这次对峙改变。实际转接和战斗条件成立后，登记鲁克指挥权解除；不会因一人受约束就登记中央机组停止。核验台仍能看到机组指示。

contexts.paragraph_english: Berth the Glimmer at the marked landing and let the freight clerk check the vessel-use record, the completed priory handover and your commission. contexts.paragraph_chinese: 请把微光号停在标记泊位，让货运员核对船只使用记录、已完成的修院交接与核查委托。进入矿井前在此登记到港。此台保留返回船只的通路；地下设备操作另需许可。

contexts.paragraph_english: The pump-room inspection passage branches from this track. The bypass label is readable from the maintenance stand, but handling its machinery needs the local assignment. A copy of the gauge sheet placed here retains the gauge's source reference. It does not become a second independent measurement just because it has been moved to this board.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 泵房检修通路从轨道分出。可从维护站位读取旁路标签，操作设备需要本地委托。此板上的仪表页副本保留仪表来源；放到另一块板上，不会成为第二次独立测量。

entries.english_definition: An object designed to perform a particular function.

contexts.paragraph_english: Inspection appointment. The bearer is a trainee technician assigned to public navigation maintenance. The appointment establishes a role, not unrestricted access to every power installation. Local harbour work must be commissioned by the officer responsible for the site. A civil ferry's navigation lamp, a workshop's independent controller and the harbour main generator are not interchangeable authorisations. This appointment was carried on the inspection vessel. contexts.paragraph_chinese: 随检修船携带的任职凭证：持有人为公共导航检修见习员。身份不等于任意电力设施访问权；地方工作须由现场负责人委托，并按设备分别记录。民用渡轮导航灯、工坊独立控制器、港口主发电机不是通用授权。凭证不证明英语表现、组织成员身份或导师目前位置。

contexts.paragraph_english: Oren: I signed that final form. I had seen the unfinished entries, and I should have refused to accept the bypass as complete. There was pressure to release the equipment for the next shift. I can give an account of that pressure and the instructions I received, but I will keep it separate from my signature. I cannot make the earlier check complete by repairing the device today. If I undertake a repair now, its parts, test and reviewer must be entered as new work, while the signed form remains available.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 奥伦：最终表是我签的。我看到了未完成条目，本该拒绝把旁路验收为完成。当时受到放行设备给下一班的压力。我会说明压力与收到的指示，但要把这些与本人签名分开。今天修理不能完成早先检查。若现在承接维修，应把零件、测试和复核人记成新工作，同时保留旧签章表。

contexts.paragraph_english: A repaired warning device changes what people can safely do tomorrow. It may allow a worker to hear a signal from another room, or let a supervisor repeat a check without standing beside the machine. That practical value should be recorded clearly. The repair also leaves a question about yesterday. If the earlier form said that the device had passed a check which was never completed, the new result cannot tell us that the old form was accurate. A useful account has room for both the present improvement and the earlier disagreement.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 修好的警报装置会改变明日能够安全做的事。工人也许能在另一个房间听到信号，主管也许能在机器旁之外重复检查，这些实用价值应记清。维修同时留下关于昨日的问题：早表若写着通过一项从未完成的检查，新结果无法证明早表准确。可用记录应容纳当前改善与早先差异。

contexts.paragraph_english: Pera: I am willing to discuss that new work, but it must have an end we can inspect. Naming a repairer is not enough. contexts.paragraph_chinese: 佩拉：我愿意谈新工作，但它要有可检查的终点。仅列维修人不足，还应说明设备、物资来源与复查者。住区辅助警报器可以成为另一项工作，不是再次把泵房注满。额外分配前，也要记清矿镇工资保障与暖食。被要求承担停产代价的人，需要知道接收台究竟准备了什么。

contexts.paragraph_chinese: 旧图画出一个地方备用源，经手动选择器为两支路供能。A支路服务厨房照明与供餐台，B支路服务温室洗水泵。备用源保留原有地方切断装置，源座上的运行标签须在机房现场核对后才能试验。

Read the load labels and trace the later interlock plate as well as the old drawing. We are not changing the tower outlet under this commission. contexts.paragraph_chinese: 试验备用源时，应在隔离状态下座好连接头。选择器有厨房、洗水泵和交替档。阅读负荷标签，同时对照后加联锁牌与旧图。委托不包括改变塔站出口。试验被拒时，恢复隔离、修正档位再试。备用源是固定地方设施，本程序不从工程账扣塔站保障包。

contexts.paragraph_english: For the present local work segment, the cabinet notice rates the tested reserve at six load units. The kitchen branch needs four units and the wash pump three.
