contexts.paragraph_english: The drawing's former tower outlet is crossed out on the inspection copy. The later interlock plate identifies that outlet as outside the current local work scope. Trace both drawings at the actual selector; choose only the local branches authorised for this inspection. A correct sketch does not change the physical selector.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 查验副本中旧塔站出口已划去。后加联锁标牌将它列在本次范围之外。应在实际选择器处对照两图，仅选择获准的地方支路。画对草图不会改变真实档位。

entries.english_definition: A panel containing controls and displays.

contexts.paragraph_english: Start from the field console and inspect at minute 5 and minute 10 of the declared simulation clock. Under this recorded configuration the local output meets the declared criterion at both observations. The finite result supports this controller, load, reserve, contact and duty arrangement for this window. Keep a process diagram showing preparation, execution, observation and acceptance as different stages. There is no reading race or real-time countdown.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 从场内控制台启动，在声明的模拟钟第5与第10分钟检查。此记录配置下，本地输出两次符合准则。有限结果支持该控制器、负荷、储备、联络与岗位在此窗口的安排。流程图把准备、执行、观察和接受分开，没有阅读竞速或实时倒计时。

contexts.paragraph_english: You may deliberately inspect the high-load or missing-reserve variants to retain counterexamples. Load 70, reserve absent, isolation bypassed or missing duty causes a safe stop under the authored finite rule. Load 55 is not in this protocol's validated set; the console will refuse to invent a result. Changing configuration expires the current acceptance. Historical successful and failed runs remain available after a local reset.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 可以主动检查高负荷或缺储备变体，保留反例。70负荷、缺储备、绕隔离或缺岗位均按作者有限规则安全停止。55不在此规程的已验证集合，控制台拒绝编造结果。改配置使当前接受过期，局部复位保留历史成功与失败。

contexts.paragraph_english: Controller C adds a practical test of the proposed alternative. Its local circuit operates at a finite load, with checked isolation, reserve, limited contact and assigned duty. The execution machine is first made safe and its output physically returned through the test route. Observations at five and ten minutes then record that arrangement. This sequence matters: a configured console is not a running circuit, and controlling an enemy device does not measure the trial output. The accepted interval belongs to the current revision. Changing a connector requires another check even if the earlier run remains a valid historical observation.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: C增加替代方案实体核验：有限负荷、受检隔离、储备、有限联络与岗位。先制止执行机，将输出实际送回测试环，再以五及十分钟观察记录安排。顺序重要：控制台配置不是运行回路，制止敌装置没有测实验输出。接受时段属于当前版本；改连接须重查，即使早运行仍是有效历史观察。

contexts.paragraph_english: Route F leads through the duty desk and formal corridor. The desk first checks the intervention's actual authorisation; the corridor stop must then be released at its own terminal. Route M uses the maintenance shaft, its installed handle and a checked return path. A coil sentry still controls the lower approach. Neither route leads straight to the dispatch console.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: F路经值守台与正式走廊，值守先核实际处置授权，走廊阻拦再由本地终端解除。M路经检修竖井、固定手柄与已查返程，下段仍有线圈哨卫。两路均不能直达调度台。

entries.english_definition: A flat board containing controls or forming part of a structure.

contexts.paragraph_english: Use the supplied basic kit and safety line. Isolate the tunnel maintenance drive at its local switch; this switch does not control the city or North Station. Brace the loose service panel before clearing the obstruction. The tunnel hazard can be dealt with by physical isolation, removal of the loose feed and a zero-motion check, or by the registered local encounter followed by the same passage inspection. A brace is still needed after a fight. Verify the dry stepping strip and mark the return line at the exit. No timed reading, rare key or strength threshold is required. The opened service passage remains available for safe return.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 使用已提供的基础工具和安全索。在当地开关隔离隧道维护驱动，它不控制城市或北站；先固定松动面板，再清理阻碍。可通过隔离、移除松动送料件并核验零运动处置危险，也可完成登记遭遇后检查通路；战斗后仍须固定。出口检查干燥踏步带并标返程线。不要求限时阅读、稀有钥匙或力量门槛；打开的检修通道保留安全返程。

contexts.paragraph_english: Ada: Start with the street people use now, not the straight line on the old sheet. At the checkpoint you have two choices. The inspected passage avoids the broken span, although both appear to lead north. Have your present commission checked there. Or go through the service tunnel with the basic kit; isolate the drive, secure the panel and inspect the cleared route. Neither choice tells us whether Mara is alive today. I know where the duty hall is and where the residents can receive someone coming back. I will not turn an old movement record into a current medical report. Bring the rescue team to the street when the inner return passage is open.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 阿妲：从大家现在走的街开始，别只看旧纸上的直线。检查点有两种选择：核查通道绕开断桥，须查当次委托；或者用基础工具走隧道，隔离驱动、固定面板、清路检查。两种路线都不能说明玛拉今天是否活着。我知道值守厅位置和住民接应处，不会把旧转移记录当成当前医疗报告。内侧便道打开后，把救援队带回街区。

entries.english_definition: An instrument measuring an amount or rate.

contexts.paragraph_english: The forced-link stage shields the central progress meter until both branches are isolated and the current configuration is verified. The left branch stand is front-left; the right branch is front-right. Verification belongs to the rear-left station. Operations cost one action point each. You may isolate left or right first. Reconnecting a branch changes the revision and cancels the old verification.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 强制联络段在两支路隔离且当前配置核验前锁护中央进度。左支路站为前左，右为前右，核验为后左。每项1AP，左右先后可换。重连支路改变版本，撤销旧核验。

contexts.paragraph_english: Service record: A stop request by itself did not prevent reconnection. We marked the left and right forced-link branches, the finite renewal components and the damping check as separate objects. First isolate both forced-link branches and verify the current configuration. Either branch may be isolated first. Before verification, force against the main resistance meter has no effect. Do not interpret this as an instruction to attack a different, unlabelled facility.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 检修记录：单独停止请求没有阻止重连。我们分别标明左右强制联络支路、有限续启组件与阻尼检查。先隔离两支路并核当前配置，左右先后可换。核验前对主抵抗计量施力无效，不能据此攻击另一未标设施。

contexts.paragraph_english: The renewal phase has exactly two declared relay components. Each has its own resistance meter and next-round arrival. Control both actual components before latching the bypass from front-left. Then verify the current bypass revision from rear-left. A finite schedule is not a completed relay result, and a component that has not arrived cannot be reported stopped. No extra component replaces an already declared participant.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 续启段恰有两台声明组件，各有抵抗计量并在下一轮加入。先制止两实体，再由前左扣旁路锁，后左核当前版本。有限排程不是组件完成结果，未到场组件不能报告停用。没有新组件替代已声明参与者。

entries.english_definition: A visible presentation of information.

contexts.paragraph_english: Reducing excess extraction is therefore necessary work, but it does not promise an immediate clear sky. The mist existed before the present overloading, and past damage does not vanish when a selector moves. Essential protection and genuine cross-region help still matter. The Prism duty sheet separates protection, calibration service and a deferrable display. Preserving protection while reducing an unnecessary load is a current safety action. It does not transfer the tower into a permanent local scheme or deliver future equipment. Its result should be recorded alongside the trial rather than confused with it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 降低超额抽取需做，却不承诺立刻晴空。雾原已存在，选择器一动不会抹去过去损伤。必需保护及真实跨区互助仍重要。棱镜班表分保护、校准和可延展示，保保护并降非必需负荷是当前安全行动，没有把塔转成永久本地方案，也未交未来设备。其结果与试验并列，不能混同。

contexts.paragraph_english: The display label credits the instrument housing to the workshop team and lists one presenter. The contribution book distinguishes construction, calibration and presentation: the workshop built the housing, two students checked reference marks, and the presenter explained the result. The presenter's speaking role is not evidence that the other work was absent. A revised label can name contributions without inventing additional people or changing the trial output.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 展签将仪表外壳归工坊团队，列一介绍人。贡献簿分建造、校准与介绍：工坊制外壳，两学生查参考标，介绍人说明结果。发言角色不证明其他工作没有发生。修订展签可注明贡献，无需新造人或改试验输出。

contexts.paragraph_english: Compare the retained book with the proposed wording before suggesting a revision. Unverified claims may remain questions for the organiser. This display activity is not a trial-safety approval or a reward source for copying the main report. The independent optional contract, delivery recipient and budget allocation are still pending. The original label and your saved proposal remain available together.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 提出修订前，比留存簿与拟用文字。未经核验主张可留给组织者作问题。展示活动不是试验安全批准，也不是复制主报告领奖来源。独立可选合同、接收方和预算分配仍待完成，原签及已存提议一起保留。

contexts.paragraph_english: The option display must name each missing qualification now, using the sealed version and current physical safety. Choosing a preferred description does not install a device or make a different protocol current. If the distributed work is incomplete, central and island remain legitimate prepared decisions when the base and central safety conditions hold. Revisiting the protected pre-final adventure later may produce another result, but it cannot change the ending snapshot that has already been committed.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 方案显示应按封存版本和当前实体安全列出每个缺项。选择偏好说明不会安装装置，也不会使另一协议成为当前。分布工作未齐时，只要基础及中央安全成立，中央与孤网仍是正当准备方向。后来回访终局前冒险可另产结果，不能改已提交结局快照。

entries.english_definition: A label used to distinguish one item from others.

contexts.paragraph_english: Evening duty handover, retained copy. At 21:05 on D0, a later work instruction removed the second traffic check from this test. The receiving operator recorded the change rather than marking the check as completed. A routine comparison at 20:40 placed the control clock within one second of the ship clock. The local control event copy lists the output interruption at 21:14:10, on the control clock. The instruction identifier and its issuing office are retained for further examination. This copy is not sufficient to establish what every officer knew or intended. The output event and the removed check should be recorded as separate findings: one concerns what the equipment did, the other concerns which protection was omitted. The independent coast clock was not set from this control clock.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: D0 21:05的后续工作指令移除了第二次人船复核，接班者没有把它标作已做。控制钟记录21:14:10断供；签发标识保留待后续核验，不能据此判定所有人员的知情与意图。 20:40常规比对记控制钟与船钟相差不超过一秒。

contexts.paragraph_english: The D−1 custody extract is a separate file. We will inspect its identifier and its dated receiving entry under the scope you requested. It records Mara's condition at that handover and uses a facility code for the destination. Later files would be needed to establish what happened after that point. None are included in this extract.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: D−1看管摘录是另一文件。我们会按所申请范围核查编号和有日期的接收条目。它记录玛拉在那次交接时的状态，以设施代码表示目的地。此后发生什么需要后续文件，本摘录不含那些记录。

contexts.paragraph_english: The arrival condition was entered at the receiving end of the handover. A departure copy attached later records the same transfer from the sending end, but the two sheets do not establish any observation after D−1. The archive desk has checked the record identifier, the dated handover and the relationship between the extract and its restricted original. A custodian can arrange a controlled recheck without distributing the identity attachment.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 接收端记录了交接时状态。后来附上的出发副本记录同一次转移的发送端；两张记录都没有D−1之后的观察。阅览台核对了记录编号、日期以及摘录与受限原稿关系。保管人可安排受控复核，无需分发身份附页。

contexts.paragraph_english: Sending-end record, custody transfer TR-D1-7, version 1. On D−1 the sending officer handed the person identified by protected reference MV to the named receiving duty. The sending observation records Mara Venn as alive at departure. The destination field contains facility code F-17. The public extract carries the transfer identifier and record version; the identity comparison is available under controlled review.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 发送端记录，看管转移TR-D1-7，第1版。D−1，发送员将受保护索引MV指明的人移交给具名接收岗位。发送观察记录玛拉·维恩出发时活着，目的地字段为设施代码F-17。公共摘录保留转移编号与版本，身份比对可按受控范围查验。

entries.english_definition: A short text attached to identify an object or field.

contexts.paragraph_english: Draft contingency notice, prepared on D0 at 20:50. This copy was stored with the evening dispatch papers; its issue box is blank. The text describes a possible interruption of the harbour light and tells receiving crews to wait for a revised route message. A handwritten heading calls it an accident notice, but the heading does not identify a cause. Preparing a notice in advance may indicate planning for a risk. It does not, by itself, show that somebody intended a grounding. Preserve the draft label and the empty issue box when citing this document. The approval and execution records are held separately. Do not replace them with a conclusion drawn from the title.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: D0 20:50准备、尚未签发的应急通知。事故字样不说明原因，预先准备通知不能单独证明故意搁浅；引用时保留草稿标签及空白签发栏，另查批准与执行记录。

contexts.paragraph_english: Custodian: In either option, we will keep the original versions and append later corrections. A redacted public finding is the minimum public account. The wider redacted option also includes technical conditions and limits, so readers can see how far the current test goes. Neither option releases medical notes, unrelated identities or home addresses. If we prepare a second working copy, its source label must still point to the same originals. A second copy can make access more resilient; it cannot supply an independent witness simply by being stored in another room.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 保管人：都保原版并追加纠正。脱敏结果是最低公开，较宽版本另给技术条件和限制，让读者明白当前测试范围。都不发医疗、无关身份或住址。另作工作副本也标同一原件来源；双副本可增访问韧性，不因另一房保管便成为独立证人。

contexts.paragraph_english: Comparison envelope for the coast recorder collected after the shore rescue. The original instrument label reports loss of the observed light signal at 21:14:12. Its last routine comparison with the ship clock had an uncertainty of approximately two seconds. The harbour control event is labelled 21:14:10 on a different clock. The handover copy reports a separate control-to-ship comparison within one second. The combined comparisons therefore allow a three-second interval between the two labelled clocks. These readings are consistent within that recorded interval; they are not evidence that every clock displayed an identical second. Together with the approved window and the duty handover, the records support a planned interruption with a required protection removed. Keep the original extract attached. Nothing in this envelope certifies the sender of the inspection mail as currently alive, safe or present at a particular destination.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 救援后实际取得的海岸记录器副本保留原标21:14:12，与船钟最近比对约有两秒不确定。控制钟21:14:10与其在已记不确定范围内相符，不是所有钟秒数完全一致；不证明导师当前存活、安全或去向。 值班记录另证控制钟与船钟相差一秒以内；合并两次比对界限允许两仪器标签有三秒差。

contexts.paragraph_english: There are people eating here whose current official entries say that they have died or moved away. A label in the register has affected deliveries, although the kitchens still have to serve the people who arrive. June requests a limited check of the difference. The work covers this priory's twenty-four-person residential group during the present chapter stage; it is not a census of the forest or proof that every missing person has been found.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 这里有人正在吃饭，现行官方名册却给他们标注了死亡或迁出。名册标签影响配送，厨房仍须为实际来到的人供餐。琼请求核查两者的差异。范围限于本章节阶段住在修院的二十四人住区组；这不是全林人口普查，也不能证明所有失踪者都已找到。

entries.english_definition: An identifying or authorising mark placed on a document.

contexts.paragraph_english: The receiving desk recorded the vehicle’s arrival at 14:40. The entry was made by the receiving officer when the vehicle reached the site. At 16:05 the same day, an archive clerk copied the movement and arrival entries into the central ledger. The later ledger stamp marks the copying, not a second journey or a later physical arrival.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 接收台记录车辆于14:40到达。这条记录由接收员在车辆抵达现场时写下。同日下午16:05，档案员把行程与到达条目抄入中央总账。较晚总账戳记标记的是抄录，并非第二次旅程或较晚的实际到达。

contexts.paragraph_english: Workshop custodian: The source reference on the copy leads back to the instrument sheet, MC-2.instrument.I@1. Its retained-copy identity is MC-2.retained.I@1. Both record checks zero five and zero six as incomplete. I checked that the transcription preserves those fields. That is a copying check, rather than a new observation of the machine. The final form, MC-2.acceptance@3, marks all six accepted. We should compare the exact fields and the work they describe, rather than treating a large stamp as more reliable than a small handwritten line.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 工坊保管人：副本来源指向MC-2.instrument.I@1，留存副本身份为MC-2.retained.I@1。两页均把05、06项列为未完成。我核对抄录保留了这些字段；这是抄录检查，并非对机器的新观察。最终表MC-2.acceptance@3把六项全部列为合格。应比较具体字段与对应工作，不能因大印章就认为比小手写条目可靠。

contexts.paragraph_english: Copies help when an original is fragile or a room is closed. Their source still matters. Two copies of the same departure note show that an account has been preserved in two places; they do not show that two officers independently observed a departure. A receiving officer's entry can contribute a different observation. The comparison should identify who recorded what and when, rather than treating the number of pages as the strength of the evidence. Unknown details should stay visible. A later copying stamp may explain when a ledger was updated without explaining why it was updated then.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 原稿脆弱或房间关闭时，副本便于查阅，来源仍然重要。同一出发便条的两副本说明记录保存在两处，未证明两名记录员各自看见出发。接收员记录能够提供另一观察。应比较谁在何时记录了什么，不应以页数代表证据强度。未知细节应保留可见；较晚抄录戳记可以说明更新总账的时间，未必解释为何那时更新。

contexts.paragraph_english: A brass cooking pot and a wrapped family sketch are stored separately. The pot claimant can describe its repaired handle and maker’s stamp; that permits a supervised object check, not access to another family’s sketch. The sketch remains under an individual reading permission that can be withdrawn. Public inventory descriptions do not include a hidden rescue key or a detention-room location. An uncertain ownership claim stays pending rather than becoming an accusation. Record the object identity and the permitted recipient before release; do not create another object for a second claimant. This optional candidate has no mainline gate or registered reward.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 黄铜锅与包好的家庭速写分开保管。认锅者描述修柄和制作者印记，允许受监督实物核对，不准读另家速写。速写需本人可撤回阅读许可；公开清单不藏唯一救援钥匙或扣押位置。不确定认领保持待定，不变指控；交物先登记唯一身份和获准接收人，不给第二认领者复制物。可选候选不锁主线，无登记奖励。

entries.english_definition: A closure or mark showing that access is controlled or verified.

contexts.paragraph_english: Bring the sealed MC-2 sample and the mine's actual handover receipt to this desk. We will check the seal, batch, source versions and receiving purpose before registering custody. The sample has travelled; a voyage record does not establish its contents or a technical result. The original mine sheets remain with their custodians. Their references accompany the sample, and a copy retains its original source root.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 请把密封MC-2样本和矿区实际移交回执带到此台。登记保管前，核对封签、批次、来源版本和接收用途。样本已运来，航行记录却不证明样本内容或技术结论。矿区原件留在原保管处，索引随样本交接，副本保留原来源根。

contexts.paragraph_english: Ada: The case on the table contains originals. We cannot make it safer by deciding that it no longer exists. The question is who holds that one case, who can inspect it and how the public receives a useful account without seeing everybody’s private record. The local archive custodian has offered bounded custody with my witnessed register, or a joint seal that requires both of us for access. Neither arrangement gives me authority over another region’s private records. I represent this neighbourhood in this emergency, not all six regions for every future decision.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 阿妲：桌上是原件箱，宣布它不存在不能更安全。问题是唯一箱谁保管、谁可看、公众如何得到有用说明而非全部私档。地方档案保管人提供其保管我见证，或双方共同准入封签。我不因此管别地区私档，只代表该社区的此次应急，不为六地区所有未来决定作主。

contexts.paragraph_english: At the frontier communication desk, save the proposed handover, review missing preparations and preserve a named protected pre-final checkpoint. Seal the actual preparation receipts and installed supplies. Then walk aboard the same Glimmer and confirm the current chart station, frontier berth and destination landing. The final launch closes Q604, moves that one vessel and the actor to the seventh-tower sea-cliff entry, and records one actual departure. Outside travel pauses after this confirmation. The central program and final policy remain unfinished.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 在边境通信台保存交接提议，核对缺项并保留明确命名的终章前保护存档，封存实际准备回执与已安装供给。然后走上同一微光号，在当前航图站核对边境泊位和目的落点。最终起航一次关闭Q604，并将同一船和玩家实际移到第七塔海崖入口，留下唯一实际出发。确认后暂停外区旅行；中央程序和最终政策尚未完成。

contexts.paragraph_english: Tess: Current moving cargo must arrive or be safely deposited. Accepted attendance promises need a real handover or explicit suspension. Preserve the protected checkpoint, seal the actual supplies and walk to the same Glimmer chart. Our final policy remains unselected, and the seventh tower still has dangerous work ahead.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 泰丝：现移动货须到或安全托管，到场承诺要交接或暂缓。留保护档、封实供、走同一微光海图。最终政策未选，第七塔危险工作仍在前方。

entries.english_definition: A document formally stating a qualification or verified condition.

contexts.paragraph_english: This relay records signals locally even when its outgoing link is unavailable. The independent recorder and the outgoing transmitter are separate parts of the station. Before touching the displaced outgoing lead, switch the local transmitter off and isolate it. Seat the lead, restore the station's own reserve and run a link check. The test confirms this lead and power configuration only. If either changes, repeat it before requesting a boat. A successful link test is not evidence that a distant tower is safe. The postal locker may be opened for the named technician after the shore rescue has been completed. Its contents are correspondence, not a certificate about the sender's present whereabouts. The rear latch can be opened from this room to provide a shorter route back to the rescue shelter.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 中继站外发链路中断时仍可本地记录；独立记录器与外发设备是两个部件。检修移位接线前关闭并隔离本地发送设备，再落座接线，恢复本站储备，做当前配置链路检查。改变接线或电源须重新检查；成功不证明远方塔站安全。救援完成后，具名检修员才可领取邮务柜通信，它不证明寄信人目前所在或状态。后门内闩可从站内打开，缩短返回救援棚的路线。

entries.english_definition: A document or fact showing a person's identity or authority.

contexts.paragraph_english: The greenhouse corridor is open to visitors. The inspection stair below it remains a work area. A patrol credential identifies your role; the local maintenance request specifies the equipment you may handle. Ask for that scope before entering the stair.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 温室外廊向访客开放，其下方的检修梯仍是工作区域。巡灯凭证说明职业身份；地方检修请求说明允许操作的设备。进入检修梯前请先取得这项范围。

contexts.paragraph_english: People still live behind the names missing from your chart. Twelve years ago subsidence closed the central bridge span; later the district was removed from the current place register. The residents remember the streets and have maintained other passages. Ada can confirm local routes, not the present condition of a person inside a locked detention room. The mission desk supplies one basic inspection kit, one lamp and one safety line for this local work. They are mission equipment, not personal upgrade parts or six-tower supplies. Either current credential checking or the existing service tunnel can reach the duty hall. No named companion is required.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 航图上消失的名字背后仍住着人。十二年前沉降封闭中央桥跨，后来地区被从现行名录移除；住民仍记得道路并维护其他通路。阿妲能确认地方路线，不能证实扣押室内某人的当前状态。当地委托提供一套基础检修工具、一盏灯和一条安全索，均为任务装备，不是个人零件或六塔物资。当前证件核查与既有隧道均可到值守厅，不要求指定同伴。

contexts.paragraph_english: The controlled passage accepts the patrol technician named in the current Glasshaven regional commission. Check the commission basis Q-404:resolution, its destination R5 and its purpose verify_north_station_and_legal_access against the actual landing register. Check the physical passage separately: the signed inspection identifies CHECKPOINT-DUTY-PASSAGE and explicitly excludes HIST-CENTRAL-SPAN. The checkpoint officer may verify these fields without granting detention-room access. If checking cannot be completed, use the basic service route. A copied historical credential or an unrelated action receipt cannot substitute for this current local check.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 核查通道接受当前学城跨区委托中的巡灯检修人。比对 Q-404:resolution、R5、verify_north_station_and_legal_access 与实际登陆登记；另检查实体通道，明确 CHECKPOINT-DUTY-PASSAGE 不含 HIST-CENTRAL-SPAN。核查员可验证这些字段，却不授扣押室权限。暂不能完成核查时有基础隧道解法。历史证件副本和无关动作回执不能代替当次检查。

contexts.paragraph_english: This distinction is especially important at the broken bridge checkpoint. The historic central span and the present controlled passage lead towards similar destinations on a small-scale drawing. On the ground they are different routes. The closed span cannot be made safe by presenting a document. The inspected passage does not require crossing that span, but it does require a current credential check. A service tunnel offers a further option once its actual obstruction and hazard are treated. The existence of alternatives should be recorded with their conditions, not reduced to a single arrow marked north.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 断桥检查点尤其如此。旧中央桥跨和当前核查通道在缩略图上指向相近目的地，实体却不同。出示文件不能让断桥安全；核查通道不跨断桥，却要当次查证。既有隧道则须处理真实阻碍及危险。记录替代路线及条件，不能简化成一个向北箭头。

entries.english_definition: A formal permission to carry out a regulated activity.

contexts.paragraph_english: Coast pickup acknowledgement. Four people registered at the sheltered assembly point will be collected, together with the technician. The receiving route is the northern reach; the southern steps remain unavailable. Wait at the shelter's marked boarding point. The receiving crew will carry everyone to the public arrival berth at Saltmist Harbour. This acknowledgement permits that rescue passage only. It is not a general sailing licence, a maintenance commission or the handover of a patrol vessel. Take the coast records with you, keeping their source and time labels.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 接应回执：接走避风棚登记的四名幸存者和检修员，经北段上船，南台阶仍不可用。在棚外登记登船点等接应，前往盐雾港公共接应泊位。这只允许本次救援通行，不是一般航行许可、检修委托或巡灯船移交。带走资料并保留来源、时间标签。

contexts.paragraph_english: Compare retained and issued copies only when the register shows that they belong to the same reporting version. A normal update at another date is not automatically a deletion. A reading permission allows this inspection and a bounded factual finding; it is not a general licence to publish protected identities.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 只有流转册说明留存与发行件属于同一报告版本，才比较删改。另一日期的正常更新不自动成为删除。阅读许可允许本次检查及有限事实核查，没有授予公开受保护身份的一般权限。

entries.english_definition: A list of goods or people carried on a vessel.

contexts.paragraph_english: The local conservation contracts identify BASE-TWR-Rn-base_isolator, BASE-TWR-Rn-local_backup and BASE-TWR-Rn-base_provision for R1 through R6. Inspect the original depot manifest at the actual tower worksite, match its current contract version, serials and qualified watch posts, then inspect and deliver the specified items. The ridge packet is inspected at the frontier transfer shed and delivered only at the tower after its real escort. Signed intentions do not count as stock. The published functional crews and their two separate posts are limited local authoring details, not newly recruited core characters.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: R1至R6的地方保全合同分别登记BASE-TWR-Rn-base_isolator、BASE-TWR-Rn-local_backup、BASE-TWR-Rn-base_provision。到该塔实际工程工位核对原仓单，匹配现行合同版本、序号及合格岗位，再检查交付规定实物。风脊工包在中转棚受检，真实护送后到塔站交付。签署意愿不算库存。公开班组和两个不同岗位是有范围的地方候选细节，不是新招募核心人物。

contexts.paragraph_english: Finn: Match the four protected serials against the manifest. The cart driver and cargo watch travel under this local commission. A recruited guide may help, but does not create another component.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 芬：对四件保护序号。车司机与货守依本次地方委托执行。同伴向导可以帮助，却不创造另一件组件。

contexts.paragraph_english: For this private local coordination task, the existing transfer-shed receiver ROLE-R6-SHED-RECEIVER accepts complete labelled boxes against the present manifest; the ridge receiver ROLE-R6-RIDGE-RECEIVER accepts them after a safe segment arrival and checks the same version. Confirm both contacts and those receiving conditions with Tess’s current invitation. These are two existing main-route receiving functions, not hidden settlements needed for an ending. The task can be deferred without taking their protected basic supplies away.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本人邀请下的地方协调涉及既有中转棚接收岗ROLE-R6-SHED-RECEIVER和风脊接收岗ROLE-R6-RIDGE-RECEIVER。前者依现行货单接受整箱标记货物，后者在安全段抵达后核同一版本。明确两名联系人及收货条件；它们是两处已有主线路径岗位，不是结局必须隐藏聚落。暂缓此项不撤走基础供给。

contexts.paragraph_english: Tess: I will also show you the inner patrol latch. Inspect it from the station and check the two landing stands before registering the return route. That return remains useful after the present hazard is controlled. It is not the same as receiving the ridge cargo later. The four base components will need a manifest, two protected segments and a tower receiving check of their own. I would prefer a report that openly says the cargo has not moved yet to one that combines a safe survey route and an unexecuted delivery in a single cheerful sentence.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 泰丝：还会指出内侧巡检闩，从测站检查并核两个落点，再登记返程。处置后返程有用，却不等于后面的风脊货物收货。四份基础件另需货单、两保护段和塔站接收。我宁可报告明确说货物未走，也不把安全调查路和未执行交付合成一句好听话。

entries.english_definition: The act of sending something or someone on an assigned journey.

contexts.paragraph_english: Arrival record — rescue passage from the stranded coast. The public arrival berth receives the technician and four registered survivors. Record their arrival before requesting further harbour work; a person carried here is not automatically signed onto another vessel's crew. Two different berths are shown on the quay plan. The civil ferry is awaiting maintenance and a safe departure arrangement. The stored patrol boat has no handover authorisation on this arrival record. A harbour officer may review a limited maintenance request at the public dispatch desk. Bring the rescue acknowledgement and your inspection appointment, and consult the current closure order rather than assuming that rescue passage suspends it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 搁浅海岸救援入港记录：接应泊位接收检修员和四名已登记幸存者。先登记到港，再申请后续港口工作；接应入港不自动成为另一船的船员。码头显示不同泊位：民用渡轮待检修与安全撤离方案；封存巡灯船没有在此记录中授权移交。公共调度台可审查有限检修申请，须携救援回执及任职凭证，并查现行封港令。

contexts.paragraph_english: Finally, set damping, verify the revision and approve controlled stop. Approval preserves the check because it approves that configuration; an actual subsequent change cancels it. The machine's resistance is not a measure of how much of the tower to demolish. After safe stop, the dispatch desk can present the prepared choices without battle pressure. The record does not choose among them. This script must be read as a transcript unless its actual candidate audio is separately played.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 最后设置阻尼、核版本并批准受控停止。批准同一配置所以保留检查，后续实际改变才撤销。抵抗不衡量应拆掉多少塔。安全停止后，调度台可无战斗压力显示准备好的选择，记录没有替你选。这份脚本是书面稿，除非另行实际播放候选音轨。

contexts.paragraph_english: Harbour closure order — current copy. General departures are suspended while the navigation restrictions are reviewed. Rescue arrivals continue at the public receiving berth. An arrival under that provision does not grant a vessel permission to depart. The dispatch office may issue a limited local maintenance commission where the work supports a specific safe evacuation arrangement. The commission must name its work area and power boundary. It does not itself clear a route, approve an untested navigation lamp or transfer ownership of a vessel. A later departure instruction must be checked against the route notices and the vessel's current configuration. The public consultation desk remains accessible during the closure; restricted records and equipment require their own authorisation.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 现行封港令：一般出港暂停，公共泊位仍接收救援入港；允许入港不等于允许出港。调度室可为明确安全撤离工作签发有限地方检修委托，写明作业范围和供电边界。委托本身不开放航道、不认可未经测试导航灯、不移交船产权。出港另需按航道资料及船舶当前配置核对。公共咨询区开放，受限记录与设备需各自授权。

contexts.paragraph_english: Limited maintenance exception. Havel, the dispatch officer, may commission inspection and repair of the civil ferry's navigation equipment and the local workshop arrangements needed to obtain its replacement parts. State that the purpose is evacuation assistance and identify those work areas in the request. Harbour main-generator operation is outside this exception: its safety isolation has not been confirmed. A commission allows local preparation; the ferry remains at the quay until a tested current configuration and an explicitly confirmed departure plan are available. Neither a fee nor a language score is required to request the commission. Crew recruitment, patrol-boat use and access to retained accident records are separate decisions and must not be inferred from this document.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 有限检修例外：调度负责人哈文可委托民用渡轮导航设备检修及为取替换件所需的本地工坊操作。申请写明协助撤离及这些范围。主发电机安全隔离尚未确认，操作它不在例外内。委托只允许准备；当前配置测试与明确离港方案确认完成前，渡轮留港。申请不需费用或英语分数；招募、巡灯船及事故记录调阅均另行授权。

entries.english_definition: A consignment of goods sent together.

contexts.paragraph_english: The public location summary may name the facility and the record versions. It must not attach unrelated personal addresses or present the shipment as a direct witness of Mara today. The next district will still require actual access, on-site inquiry and rescue work.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 公开地点摘要可注明设施和记录版本，不能附无关住址，也不能把货运写成今日亲见玛拉。下一区仍需实际进入、现场查验与救援。

contexts.paragraph_english: Pera: The receiving desk has confirmed the three workers and the basic provisions. We can now discuss the extra six packages. I want the discussion to start from what is in the store, rather than what we hope a later shipment may bring. The basic services use seven of the ten load units: drainage two, ventilation two, warm room two and signals one. Keep that line separate. Reducing extraction must leave those services and the inspected ladder available. We are choosing an extra arrangement, not reopening the question of whether rescued people receive first aid.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 佩拉：接收台已确认三名工人与基本物资，现在可以谈六个额外工包。请从实际库存开始，不从希望后来有的船货开始。基本服务占十单位中的七：排水二、通风二、暖房二、信号一。这一行独立保留。减抽取须保留这些服务和受检梯道；现在选择额外安排，不重新争论被救者能否领急救用品。

entries.english_definition: Goods entrusted for delivery to a recipient.

contexts.paragraph_english: Tess: The ridge packet has only four base components. The first escort starts at the transfer shed after the actual manifest is checked. The outer escort begins through the paired route after its first segment is controlled. At the tower we control the field device, protect the present cargo and deal with the platform, then perform isolation and receipt. Pressure against the platform does not sign the receiving sheet. The optional five-box supplement is a different consignment. If it is declined, those choices must not take the basic packet or an eventual ending direction away.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 泰丝：风脊基础只有四件，中转棚核实货单后首段护送，处置首段后沿配对路进入外线。到塔先制护场器、护货、制平台，再隔离和收货。平台压强不签收货表。可选五箱另批，拒绝不能撤基础工包或后续结局方向。

entries.english_definition: Goods carried commercially by a vessel or vehicle.

contexts.paragraph_english: Berth the Glimmer at the marked landing and let the freight clerk check the vessel-use record, the completed priory handover and your commission. Register the arrival here before entering the mine. This desk keeps the route back to the vessel available; it does not issue permission to operate underground machinery.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 请把微光号停在标记泊位，让货运员核对船只使用记录、已完成的修院交接与核查委托。进入矿井前在此登记到港。此台保留返回船只的通路；地下设备操作另需许可。

contexts.paragraph_english: Signal clerk: I first told the surface desk that the freight lift could carry the return group. Please change that note. The lift branch has not been tested from the cutting-face side, so it is not our present exit. The fixed inspection ladder beside the main lift is the route we can check now. It stays available when the power setting changes.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 信号员：我最初向地面台说，货运升降支路能运送返程人员。请更正这条便条。采掘面一侧尚未完成支路测试，所以它目前不是出口。现在可检查主升降机旁的固定梯道；供电设置变化后，这条路仍在。

contexts.paragraph_english: A later freight-lift repair can create a shorter return loop from the cutting face. It supplements this route. Reducing extraction power must not lock the ladder or remove its verified access. If the lift is unavailable, the checked ladder remains the safe route back.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 后来修复采掘面的货运升降支路，可形成更短回环，它补充此路。降低抽取供电不能锁梯或撤去已核查通路。升降机不可用时，已检查梯道继续提供安全返程。

contexts.paragraph_english: The freight-lift branch can be repaired from this side and tested before use. Keep its repair and test records distinct. This creates an optional quicker loop to the lift station; the fixed inspection ladder remains available even if production is reduced. A repaired branch carries the same people, not a replacement group or a second rescue reward.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 货运升降支路可从此侧修复并在使用前测试。修复与测试各留记录；支路形成返回升降站的较短回环，减产后固定检修梯仍可使用。回环运送同一批人，不产生替代工人或第二份救援奖励。

entries.english_definition: The organisation of movement, storage, and supply.

contexts.paragraph_english: The machine's safety record and the experiment's output record have separate owners. Record this route revision before starting the controller. Changing a route later invalidates the current test, and a failed test does not erase the earlier machine control. When the declared observations are saved, open the field's logistics latch from the inside. It adds a return loop to the courtyard while leaving the calibration route usable.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 机械安全与实验输出分别记录。启动前记录通路版本，后来改通路使当前测试失效；失败测试不删除早机械制止。声明观察保存后，从内侧打开后勤门，增加回中庭环路，校准通路仍可用。

entries.english_definition: A record of items held and their locations or owners.

contexts.paragraph_english: Arrangement Leaf uses four beds for quick leaves and two for stored roots. It is expected to provide eight serving-baskets soon and four storage-baskets later. Arrangement Root uses two beds for quick leaves and four for stored roots. It is expected to provide four serving-baskets soon and eight storage-baskets later. The baskets are local planning measures; they do not become personal inventory or tower provision packs.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 叶菜配置：四床快生叶菜、两床耐储根菜，预计较早八筐供餐、较晚四筐储藏。根菜配置：两床叶菜、四床根菜，预计较早四筐供餐、较晚八筐储藏。筐是地方规划单位，不变成个人背包或塔站保障包。

contexts.paragraph_english: A brass cooking pot and a wrapped family sketch are stored separately. The pot claimant can describe its repaired handle and maker’s stamp; that permits a supervised object check, not access to another family’s sketch. The sketch remains under an individual reading permission that can be withdrawn. Public inventory descriptions do not include a hidden rescue key or a detention-room location. An uncertain ownership claim stays pending rather than becoming an accusation. Record the object identity and the permitted recipient before release; do not create another object for a second claimant. This optional candidate has no mainline gate or registered reward.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 黄铜锅与包好的家庭速写分开保管。认锅者描述修柄和制作者印记，允许受监督实物核对，不准读另家速写。速写需本人可撤回阅读许可；公开清单不藏唯一救援钥匙或扣押位置。不确定认领保持待定，不变指控；交物先登记唯一身份和获准接收人，不给第二认领者复制物。可选候选不锁主线，无登记奖励。

entries.english_definition: A place where supplies or vehicles are kept for distribution.

contexts.paragraph_english: The local conservation contracts identify BASE-TWR-Rn-base_isolator, BASE-TWR-Rn-local_backup and BASE-TWR-Rn-base_provision for R1 through R6. Inspect the original depot manifest at the actual tower worksite, match its current contract version, serials and qualified watch posts, then inspect and deliver the specified items. The ridge packet is inspected at the frontier transfer shed and delivered only at the tower after its real escort. Signed intentions do not count as stock. The published functional crews and their two separate posts are limited local authoring details, not newly recruited core characters.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: R1至R6的地方保全合同分别登记BASE-TWR-Rn-base_isolator、BASE-TWR-Rn-local_backup、BASE-TWR-Rn-base_provision。到该塔实际工程工位核对原仓单，匹配现行合同版本、序号及合格岗位，再检查交付规定实物。风脊工包在中转棚受检，真实护送后到塔站交付。签署意愿不算库存。公开班组和两个不同岗位是有范围的地方候选细节，不是新招募核心人物。

entries.english_definition: A small secure storage compartment.

contexts.paragraph_english: This relay records signals locally even when its outgoing link is unavailable. The independent recorder and the outgoing transmitter are separate parts of the station. Before touching the displaced outgoing lead, switch the local transmitter off and isolate it. Seat the lead, restore the station's own reserve and run a link check. The test confirms this lead and power configuration only. If either changes, repeat it before requesting a boat. A successful link test is not evidence that a distant tower is safe. The postal locker may be opened for the named technician after the shore rescue has been completed. Its contents are correspondence, not a certificate about the sender's present whereabouts. The rear latch can be opened from this room to provide a shorter route back to the rescue shelter.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 中继站外发链路中断时仍可本地记录；独立记录器与外发设备是两个部件。检修移位接线前关闭并隔离本地发送设备，再落座接线，恢复本站储备，做当前配置链路检查。改变接线或电源须重新检查；成功不证明远方塔站安全。救援完成后，具名检修员才可领取邮务柜通信，它不证明寄信人目前所在或状态。后门内闩可从站内打开，缩短返回救援棚的路线。

entries.english_definition: A storage unit with enclosed shelves or compartments.

contexts.paragraph_english: The centre of the cabin floor is cracked. A person may appear to cross it successfully while the damaged boards continue to move underneath. Do not use that as a load test. The emergency cabinet beside the port wall contains a hand tool and a short rescue line; both belong to this vessel's rescue kit. A loose gangboard is stored along the intact side of the cabin. Secure it across the damaged section, keeping its ends on sound supports, before directing anybody towards the shore exit. The reef path begins beyond that exit. This note describes the cabin passage, not the safety of the landing place outside. Check the shore notice before choosing an approach for the rescue boat.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 船舱中央地板已经开裂。有人一度踩过去，不能证明受损板材可承重。左舷救援柜存有手工具和一根救援索，均属于本船救援包。沿完好的侧壁放着一块踏板。先把踏板两端固定在可靠支承上，再安排人员走向岸边出口。出口外才是礁岸路径；本说明不能证明岸上接应点安全，需要另查岸边告示。

contexts.paragraph_english: Local operator: Before we open the machine-room work zone, show me the upper-floor checks. The isolation handle must still be in the state you inspected. We also need the stopped conveyor record, the fixed external clamp and the dry-route reading. A successful action from an older configuration will not cover a change you made afterwards. We can repeat the affected check without throwing away the clamp or drawing a second unique connector from the cabinet.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 地方检修员：开放机房工作区前，请出示上层检查。隔离手柄必须保持核查时状态，还需要输送器停转记录、固定外部夹具和干燥通路读数。旧配置下的成功动作不能涵盖后来改动。可以重做受影响检查，不必丢掉夹具，也不用从料柜再领唯一连接头。

contexts.paragraph_english: June also requests inspection of the greenhouse supply stair. This permits the local handles, fixed repair cabinet and transfer-station circuits described in the maintenance notice. It does not authorise changing the tower's central interlock. Bring back a factual difference report and the equipment boundary before asking the local desk to issue the next work scope.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 琼还请求检查温室供给检修梯。允许范围是告示列明的地方手柄、固定料柜和转供站回路，未包括改动塔站中央联锁。请把实际差异与设备边界带回地方工作台，再申请下一步工作范围。

contexts.paragraph_english: The repair cabinet contains one tagged clamp set and one fixed reserve connector for this station. Record their tags when collecting them. These are local maintenance items. The reserve connector fits the station's existing backup seat; it is not a tower backup pack, the Glimmer's battery or personal crafting scrap. The clamp is kept for this inspection and may be repositioned while the conveyor remains isolated.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 检修料柜有一套带标签夹具和一个本站固定备用连接头。领取时记录标签。二者均是地方检修物件。连接头适配本站既有备用源座，不是塔站备用包、微光号电池或个人制作零件。夹具留给这次检修，输送器隔离时可以重置位置。

entries.english_definition: A horizontal surface used to store objects.

contexts.paragraph_english: Dear friend, your letter reached me after the move. I kept thinking that I should write when I had something definite to say, and the longer I waited, the harder a first sentence became. We have a room now. The roof needs another patch, but the kitchen is serving meals and someone has put a shelf beside the window for returned books. Those are small things I can tell you without promising more than I know.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 亲爱的朋友，搬家之后我才收到你的信。我一直想等有确切消息再写，越等越难写出第一句。我们现在有房间，屋顶还要补一块，厨房已供餐，有人在窗边加了归还书本的书架。这些小事我可以说，不必承诺尚未了解的事。

entries.english_definition: A framework holding or organising items.

contexts.paragraph_english: The declared local load capacity is four internal units. Keep protection at three, archive preservation at one and discretionary reproduction at zero during emergency takeover. These figures are local apparatus units, not a real electrical calculation. Obtain joint work permission, isolate the relay drive, secure the rack and deal with ENC-R5-04 before testing. Appoint the actual operator, record resident and archive oversight and check the return passage. Any load, isolation or duty change invalidates the previous configuration test. Safe means this tower’s present limited protection is verified. Future basic work requires one base isolator, one local backup, two base provisions and two actual operating posts. Enhanced work requires one controller, two couplers, three transition crates and one trial fixture. These are requirements, not granted stock or completed work.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 当地负荷容量四个内部单位：应急接管保留保护三、档案保存一、非必要复制零。数字为当地装置单位，不是现实电工计算。先有共同许可，隔离继电、固定架、处置独立防卫再测试，实际任操作员，记录住民及档案监督，检查返程。负荷、隔离、岗位变使旧测试失效。Safe 仅当下有限保护；未来基础需一隔离件、一备用、二基础供给、两个实际操作岗位；增强需一控制器、二耦合件、三过渡箱、一试验器材。这些是需求，不是库存或完成工作。

contexts.paragraph_english: Operator: I need a current work permit before entering the control layer. The rack must be secured and the relay drive isolated. There is an independent defence unit there; settling the custody question will not switch it off. After that work, the local load is four internal units: three for protection, one for preservation and none for discretionary reproduction. These units belong to this apparatus. They are not crates that can be moved from the six-tower preparation store. I can make an actual configuration check only when the declared load and my duty post match the record.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 操作员：入控制层要当前许可，须固定架、隔离继电驱动；保管决定不关闭独立防卫单元。之后当地负荷四内部单位：保护三、保存一、非必要复制零，不能当六塔储备箱搬走。实际配置检查须负荷与本人岗位同记录。

entries.english_definition: An object designed to hold or transport contents.

contexts.paragraph_english: Execution orders add a third layer. Rook cancelled independent review during the authorised test period and expanded detention. An instruction described as protection must still be compared with the restrictions it actually imposed. The local station register helps establish implementation independently of the command paper. Rook cannot be made a convenient container for all earlier failures. At the same time, the existence of policy approval does not excuse every executive act as inevitable. The review needs a distinct account of what he ordered, what was carried out and where that conduct exceeded the permitted scope.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 执行令增加第三层：鲁克在授权测试期取消独立复核并扩大扣押。“保护”描述仍须比对实际限制，北站登记独立于命令证明执行。鲁克不能包下所有早期失败，政策批准也不让每次执行都必然无责。审查须分别交代命令、实施及越出许可之处。

entries.english_definition: The items or information held inside something.

contexts.paragraph_english: This relay records signals locally even when its outgoing link is unavailable. The independent recorder and the outgoing transmitter are separate parts of the station. Before touching the displaced outgoing lead, switch the local transmitter off and isolate it. Seat the lead, restore the station's own reserve and run a link check. The test confirms this lead and power configuration only. If either changes, repeat it before requesting a boat. A successful link test is not evidence that a distant tower is safe. The postal locker may be opened for the named technician after the shore rescue has been completed. Its contents are correspondence, not a certificate about the sender's present whereabouts. The rear latch can be opened from this room to provide a shorter route back to the rescue shelter.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 中继站外发链路中断时仍可本地记录；独立记录器与外发设备是两个部件。检修移位接线前关闭并隔离本地发送设备，再落座接线，恢复本站储备，做当前配置链路检查。改变接线或电源须重新检查；成功不证明远方塔站安全。救援完成后，具名检修员才可领取邮务柜通信，它不证明寄信人目前所在或状态。后门内闩可从站内打开，缩短返回救援棚的路线。

contexts.paragraph_english: Bring the sealed MC-2 sample and the mine's actual handover receipt to this desk. We will check the seal, batch, source versions and receiving purpose before registering custody. The sample has travelled; a voyage record does not establish its contents or a technical result. The original mine sheets remain with their custodians. Their references accompany the sample, and a copy retains its original source root.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 请把密封MC-2样本和矿区实际移交回执带到此台。登记保管前，核对封签、批次、来源版本和接收用途。样本已运来，航行记录却不证明样本内容或技术结论。矿区原件留在原保管处，索引随样本交接，副本保留原来源根。

entries.english_definition: The act or condition of retaining an item or person.

contexts.paragraph_english: For a restricted attachment, name the record version, the fields required, the recipient and the intended use. June acts as custodian of the room. She can arrange controlled inspection and record an authorised handover. Holding the key to an attachment does not make her the person entitled to consent on behalf of every individual named there. Consent to publish a person's identity must be given by that person for the specified recipient and use.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 申请受限附页时，请说明版本、必要字段、接收方和用途。琼是阅览室保管人，可以安排受控查验、记录获准交付，但持有钥匙并未使她有权代所有当事人同意。公开某人的身份须由本人对具体接收方与用途明确同意。

contexts.paragraph_english: Sian: Supply concerns are real, but they do not justify removing unfavourable results or denying an independent review. We can record the limits and practical preparation while retaining public scrutiny. You may agree with a technical concern and refuse the proposed information restriction. Those decisions are separate. The location records should also pass through their bounded verification; a holding-facility code does not tell us Mara's present condition.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 西安：供给担忧确实存在，但不能据此删除不利结果或拒绝独立复核。可以记录限制及实际准备，同时保留公共查验。你可赞同技术担忧并拒绝信息限制，两决定分别保存。地点记录也按限定范围核验；扣押设施代码不说明玛拉目前情况。

contexts.paragraph_english: Allocation makes the trade-off visible. The district has six extra packages for this work stage, and a package cannot be delivered twice. Giving one to production support means it is unavailable for a shelter improvement during the same stage. Holding one for retrofit may improve a later arrangement, but only if someone can perform that work. Different groups may value those outcomes differently. A useful discussion compares what is delayed, who carries that delay and which conditions can be checked. It need not describe one eligible allocation as the only compassionate choice.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 分配让取舍可见。本阶段有六个额外工包，同包不能交付两次。交给生产支持，就无法在同阶段改善安置；留作改造也须有人实际执行才会改善后来安排。不同群体可能重视不同结果。可用讨论应比较推迟什么、谁承担推迟、哪些条件可检查，不必把某一种合格分配写成唯一有同情心的选择。

contexts.paragraph_english: To compare the recorded effect of changing load while holding the listed configuration constant, compare T1 and T2. T1 and T3 address a different change. A careful report should describe which conditions have actually been observed and leave untested combinations open. Further trials and field checks remain necessary before any wider operating proposal can be accepted.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 比较负荷变化且保持所列配置相同，可比T1/T2。T1/T3讨论另一种变化。报告说明实际观察条件，未测组合保持开放；较广方案还须更多试验与现场检查。

entries.english_definition: A recognised claim to receive or use something.

contexts.paragraph_english: The workshop is replacing one public sign at the street junction, not renaming the whole city. Some residents request the historic name Reed Lane; others use the newer name Lantern Turn. Both groups remember the earlier street, but disagree about which name helps visitors today. The keeper offers either name with a second explanatory line if the proposal records local consultation and names the existing sign crew as maintainer. The sample boards are two alternatives for one installation, not two rewards. The choice does not change the verified subsidence date, property records or legal route conditions. This candidate has no registered experience entitlement.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 工坊只换街口一块公共牌，不给全城改名。有人要历史名 Reed Lane，有人用新名 Lantern Turn；都记得旧街，分歧在当下导航。经地方询议、指定既有路牌队维护，可选任一并添解释行。两样板是同一安装替代，不是双奖励，不改沉降日期、产权或路线门禁；该候选无登记经验权益。

entries.english_definition: A person who asserts a right to an item or benefit.

contexts.paragraph_english: A brass cooking pot and a wrapped family sketch are stored separately. The pot claimant can describe its repaired handle and maker’s stamp; that permits a supervised object check, not access to another family’s sketch. The sketch remains under an individual reading permission that can be withdrawn. Public inventory descriptions do not include a hidden rescue key or a detention-room location. An uncertain ownership claim stays pending rather than becoming an accusation. Record the object identity and the permitted recipient before release; do not create another object for a second claimant. This optional candidate has no mainline gate or registered reward.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 黄铜锅与包好的家庭速写分开保管。认锅者描述修柄和制作者印记，允许受监督实物核对，不准读另家速写。速写需本人可撤回阅读许可；公开清单不藏唯一救援钥匙或扣押位置。不确定认领保持待定，不变指控；交物先登记唯一身份和获准接收人，不给第二认领者复制物。可选候选不锁主线，无登记奖励。

entries.english_definition: An item or amount left with someone for safe keeping or later use.

contexts.paragraph_english: Sian Lune will define the public verification work in the courtyard. Safe return registration belongs to the landing desk. Neither a sample deposit nor an invitation to discuss findings gives authority to start an old experimental machine, enter a protected personal record, or publish an identity.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 西安·卢恩会在中庭说明公共核验工作。安全返程在登陆台登记。交样本或接受讨论邀请，都没有授予启动旧实验机、查阅受保护私人记录或发布身份的权限。

contexts.paragraph_english: Tess: The outer segment needs its own actual result before the paired tower entrance opens. If we cannot continue, use the present safe return or deposit the packet with its named cart keeper. Do not take a moving cargo group into ordinary sea travel.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 泰丝：外线要自己的结果才开配对塔口。不能继续时走安全返程或交指定车守托管，不能把移动货组带入普通航海。

contexts.paragraph_english: The bench stops safely when its recorded failure condition is reached. It does not destroy a main-line component. Save the failed run and the configuration before resetting the local apparatus. A reset removes local preparation and current tests; it preserves sources, historical runs, the sample deposit and other districts' progress. No waiting in real time is required: the inspection controls advance the declared simulation clock.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 试验台达到记录的失败条件时安全停止，不毁主线部件。局部复位前，保存失败运行与配置。复位清当前准备和测试，保留来源、历史运行、样本交接及外区进展。无需实时等待，由检查操作推进声明的模拟时钟。

contexts.paragraph_english: Tess: Review the current promises as carefully as the supplies. Cargo still moving needs actual receipt or safe deposit. An accepted promise that requires attendance needs a safe handover or explicit suspension. A previous empty register cannot describe a branch where new work was accepted. Save the handover and preserve the named pre-final checkpoint before sealing preparation. Then reach the chart aboard the same Glimmer and confirm the frontier berth and destination landing. The final departure moves that vessel once; it does not finish the central program or choose the final policy for us.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 泰丝：核供给也核现承诺。运输货要真实收货或安全托管，须到场承诺需安全交接或明确暂缓。旧空表不能描述后来接新工作的分支。保存交接、保留命名保护档、封存准备，再到同船海图核边境泊位与目的落点。最终出发只移同一船一次，不完成中央程序或替我们选政策。

entries.english_definition: A document showing a right to a specified provision or payment.

contexts.paragraph_english: The emergency receiving desk holds twelve meal portions, three first-aid packs and a voucher covering one declared wage shift. The mine briefing also makes a basic safety kit available: a helmet, lamp and assistance line for the inspected route. These belong to the local rescue assignment. Collect them at the desk and record their actual delivery; listing them in a request is not a receipt.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 应急接收台有十二份暖食、三包急救物资和保障一班工资的凭据。矿井说明另提供基本安全包：用于受检通路的头盔、照明和辅助绳。这些属地方救援委托；应到台领取、登记实际交付，申请清单不是回执。

contexts.paragraph_english: Pera: The delivery is the point at which the packages move from the store to the named work. Before that, a draft may be revised while the stock remains. Afterwards we must retain the real destination and whatever has already been used. A new paragraph cannot return installed material. The town's emergency wage voucher is also separate from the travelling commission's reward. I will not ask someone to fund the agreed basic protection from personal upgrade parts, and I will not describe the six-tower cargo as if it were already in this store.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 佩拉：交付使工包从库内转到具名工作。此前，库存仍在时可以改草稿；此后须保留真实去向及已用材料，新段落不能返还已安装物资。矿镇应急工资凭据也与出行委托奖励分开。我不会要求用个人改件零件填已约定基本保障，也不会把六塔货物说成已在本库。

contexts.paragraph_english: The six extra work packages can support shelter improvement, retrofit work or limited production support. At least two must go to shelter and at least one to retrofit. Production support may receive zero to three, and the three allocations must total six. The packages are counted separately from the twelve basic meals, first aid and wage voucher already delivered.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 六个额外工包可用于安置改善、改造或有限生产支持。安置至少二包，改造至少一包；生产支持可获零至三包，三项合计为六。工包与已交付的十二份基本暖食、急救物资和工资凭据分别计数。

entries.english_definition: Payment owed for a person's work.

contexts.paragraph_english: The town's emergency stock provides twelve meal portions, three first-aid packs and one declared shift of wage cover. Take and deliver these local supplies through the receiving desk; a draft request cannot create them. Their use is part of basic protection. Extra workshop packages will be allocated separately after the rescue. Personal equipment parts and the six-tower engineering cargo remain in their own accounts.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 矿镇应急库存提供十二份暖食、三包急救用品与一班工资保障凭据。应通过接收台实际领取和交付，写申请不能生成物资。这是基本保障；救援后另行分配额外工包。个人装备零件和六塔工程货仍在各自账内。

contexts.paragraph_english: Pera: I am willing to discuss that new work, but it must have an end we can inspect. Naming a repairer is not enough. Tell us which device is included, where its supplies come from and who can repeat the check. The household auxiliary alarm may be a suitable separate job. It is not the flooded pump room again. I also want the town's wage cover and meals recorded before extra packages are allocated. A person asked to bear the cost of a shutdown needs to know what is actually waiting at the receiving desk.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 佩拉：我愿意谈新工作，但它要有可检查的终点。仅列维修人不足，还应说明设备、物资来源与复查者。住区辅助警报器可以成为另一项工作，不是再次把泵房注满。额外分配前，也要记清矿镇工资保障与暖食。被要求承担停产代价的人，需要知道接收台究竟准备了什么。

entries.english_definition: The money used within a particular economy.

contexts.paragraph_english: The local supply has a capacity of ten load units. Basic protection uses seven: two for drainage, two for ventilation, two for the warm room and one for signals. Keep those services available after the rescue. Extraction uses a separate setting of zero to three additional units. At three, the combined load reaches ten. The unit is a local planning measure, not an engineering component or a currency.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 地方供电容量为十负荷单位。基本保障用七：排水二、通风二、暖房二、信号一。救援后继续保留这些服务。抽取设置另为零至三附加单位；设为三时总负荷达十。单位用于地方规划，并非工程组件或货币。

contexts.paragraph_english: Tess: The apparatus uses Z for the zero channel and R for the reference channel. Isolate the local drive, check zero at Z and ten at R, and retain the configuration revision. Those are the apparatus marks, not storm hours and not a shared currency for every district's load figures. If someone reconnects the drive, the earlier check becomes an earlier check. It stays in the archive, but we inspect the present condition again. This is how the next watch distinguishes a retained observation from a current permission to use the instrument.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 泰丝：装置Z是零点，R是参考。隔离驱动，核Z零与R十，保留配置版本。这是装置刻度，不是风暴钟点，也不是各地负荷的共同货币。重接后旧检查成为历史，档案还在，但要重检当前情况，让接班人区分旧观察与现行许可。

entries.english_definition: Money or resources set aside for a particular purpose.
