entries.english_definition: Concerned with public power and collective decisions.

contexts.paragraph_english: The records custodian can grant a bounded review of the retained manuscript, issued report and circulation register. Access depends on the purpose and necessary fields, not on agreeing with a political position. Keep any unfavourable result. The old trial hall is a separate physical assignment. You may pursue that work while preparing your data overview; the small island trial will require both work streams.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 记录保管人可按范围开放留存原稿、发行稿及流转册。访问取决于用途和必要字段，不取决于政治观点。应保留不利结果。旧试验厅是另一项实体工作，可在准备数据概览时并行推进；小规模孤网试验需要两边完成。

contexts.paragraph_english: The custodian will check the requested fields rather than your political preference. Keep the manuscript and the issued copy together. We also need to see the old apparatus fail under its recorded condition. A stopped machine is an observation, not a reason to discard the room as useless. The safer alternative still has to work within a stated load, reserve and duty arrangement.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 保管人检查所申请字段，不检查政治偏好。原稿与发行稿一起保存，还须看旧装置按记录条件失败。机器停止是一项观察，不能据此把房间标为无用。较安全的替代方案仍须在注明的负荷、储备和岗位安排中工作。

contexts.paragraph_english: For public-data verification, the custodian permits review of report GH-R7 version 7, including observation identifiers, tested conditions, outcome entries, the issue version and circulation dates. Ask for those necessary fields and state the receiving technician and purpose. Political agreement is not an access condition. Household addresses, personal correspondence and unrelated medical fields remain outside this permission.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 公共数据核验可调阅GH-R7报告第7版，范围包括观察标识、受试条件、结果、发行版本与流转日期。应申请必要字段，说明接收技术员和用途。政治赞同不是调阅条件。住址、私人通信和无关医疗字段不在许可内。

contexts.paragraph_english: For the common protocol, every region needs a current operator and a current representative. Their scopes differ, and their appointment instances must remain distinct. They review protection of essential service, bounded contact, mutual aid and independent review under the same published terms. Five organisations appearing in a political summary do not replace six regions' signatures. An old signature remains part of the history after an appointment changes, but it no longer supplies the current mandate. This lets a receiving team see both the previous decision and the actual person now authorised to speak for the role.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 共同协议每地需要现任操作方与代表方，范围和任职实例不同。二者按同版条款审阅基本保护、有限联系、互助与独立复核。政治摘要中的五组织不代替六地区签字。任职改变后旧签名保留在历史，却不继续充当前授权，使接收组同时看旧决定和现任职能。

entries.english_definition: Concerned with ordinary public administration or citizens.

contexts.paragraph_english: Arrival record — rescue passage from the stranded coast. The public arrival berth receives the technician and four registered survivors. Record their arrival before requesting further harbour work; a person carried here is not automatically signed onto another vessel's crew. Two different berths are shown on the quay plan. The civil ferry is awaiting maintenance and a safe departure arrangement. The stored patrol boat has no handover authorisation on this arrival record. A harbour officer may review a limited maintenance request at the public dispatch desk. Bring the rescue acknowledgement and your inspection appointment, and consult the current closure order rather than assuming that rescue passage suspends it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 搁浅海岸救援入港记录：接应泊位接收检修员和四名已登记幸存者。先登记到港，再申请后续港口工作；接应入港不自动成为另一船的船员。码头显示不同泊位：民用渡轮待检修与安全撤离方案；封存巡灯船没有在此记录中授权移交。公共调度台可审查有限检修申请，须携救援回执及任职凭证，并查现行封港令。

contexts.paragraph_english: Inspection appointment. The bearer is a trainee technician assigned to public navigation maintenance. The appointment establishes a role, not unrestricted access to every power installation. Local harbour work must be commissioned by the officer responsible for the site. Follow the conditions on that commission and keep separate records for each device. A civil ferry's navigation lamp, a workshop's independent controller and the harbour main generator are not interchangeable authorisations. This appointment was carried on the inspection vessel. It does not certify language performance, membership of a faction or the present location of the technician's mentor.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 随检修船携带的任职凭证：持有人为公共导航检修见习员。身份不等于任意电力设施访问权；地方工作须由现场负责人委托，并按设备分别记录。民用渡轮导航灯、工坊独立控制器、港口主发电机不是通用授权。凭证不证明英语表现、组织成员身份或导师目前位置。

contexts.paragraph_english: Limited maintenance exception. Havel, the dispatch officer, may commission inspection and repair of the civil ferry's navigation equipment and the local workshop arrangements needed to obtain its replacement parts. State that the purpose is evacuation assistance and identify those work areas in the request. Harbour main-generator operation is outside this exception: its safety isolation has not been confirmed. A commission allows local preparation; the ferry remains at the quay until a tested current configuration and an explicitly confirmed departure plan are available. Neither a fee nor a language score is required to request the commission. Crew recruitment, patrol-boat use and access to retained accident records are separate decisions and must not be inferred from this document.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 有限检修例外：调度负责人哈文可委托民用渡轮导航设备检修及为取替换件所需的本地工坊操作。申请写明协助撤离及这些范围。主发电机安全隔离尚未确认，操作它不在例外内。委托只允许准备；当前配置测试与明确离港方案确认完成前，渡轮留港。申请不需费用或英语分数；招募、巡灯船及事故记录调阅均另行授权。

contexts.paragraph_english: Tidegate maintenance procedure. The tower unit is separate from the west workshop machine and from the civil ferry supply. Confirm the local supply indication at the tower base before entering the control level. During the encounter, the left cooling valve is worked from the left front position and the right valve from the right front position. Either valve may be closed first. Local supply isolation is operated from the left rear position after both valves are closed. The interlock refuses an early isolation request without spending its operating allowance. Each person may operate one work point in a personal turn. Reducing the unit to its last reserve of stopping progress does not establish safety: both valves, isolation and a controlled threat are all required. Ordinary shields and cleansing cannot substitute for this sequence.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 潮门塔机械独立于工坊及民用渡轮。进控制层前在塔基查本地供给。左前左阀、右前右阀，次序不限；左后隔离需双阀完成，每人每个人回合最多一个现场操作。打至最低制止进度不等于安全，仍需两阀、隔离和制止。

entries.english_definition: Recognised as coming from an authorised public role.

contexts.paragraph_english: There are people eating here whose current official entries say that they have died or moved away. A label in the register has affected deliveries, although the kitchens still have to serve the people who arrive. June requests a limited check of the difference. The work covers this priory's twenty-four-person residential group during the present chapter stage; it is not a census of the forest or proof that every missing person has been found.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 这里有人正在吃饭，现行官方名册却给他们标注了死亡或迁出。名册标签影响配送，厨房仍须为实际来到的人供餐。琼请求核查两者的差异。范围限于本章节阶段住在修院的二十四人住区组；这不是全林人口普查，也不能证明所有失踪者都已找到。

contexts.paragraph_english: When I said the group was complete, I meant that the kitchen had prepared the full number of portions. If you need the order of arrival, please compare the receiving record. I can tell you what happened at this counter. I cannot explain who changed the official labels, and I have not agreed to have my private address placed on a notice.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 我说“组员齐了”时，指的是厨房按全部人数备了饭。要核查抵达次序，请比较接收记录。我能说明这个台前发生的事，不能解释是谁改了官方标签，也没有同意把私人地址写到告示上。

contexts.paragraph_english: In the official register, three entries in this group carry a death label and five a moved-away label. Sixteen have no such label. The administrative labels were copied into the current roll before this visit. The index does not establish why those labels were applied.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 官方名册中，这组人有三项死亡标签、五项迁出标签，其余十六项没有这两类标签。行政标签在本次走访前抄入了现行名册。索引没有记载为什么加上这些标签。

contexts.paragraph_english: The table concerns the twenty-four entries checked in this priory, not all evacuees. The first column groups entries by the label on the current official roll. The second records voluntary confirmation at the public porches in the present chapter stage. Grouping uses room codes so that the comparison can be reviewed without names.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本表限于修院核查过的二十四项记录，并非所有转移人员。第一列按现行官方名册标签分组，第二列记录本章节阶段在公共门廊自愿确认居住的人数。比较使用房间代码，可以不具名审阅。

entries.english_definition: The conditions defining an agreement.

contexts.paragraph_english: Harbour loan and cross-region inspection terms. Once the Tidegate local safety record has been verified, return to the receiving berth to acknowledge the loan of the sealed inspection vessel Glimmer. Its watch officer maintains the basic ship service; accepting a companion invitation is not a condition of using the vessel. The deck, archive cabin and shared maintenance compartment are three spaces of this one ship, not separate ships at each harbour. The loan does not transfer the civil ferry or its installed equipment. The next inspection commission points to the grove receiving records. It does not certify the current whereabouts of the missing mentor. Basic sailing along an opened route does not require a fuel ticket. The vessel still needs its ordinary gradual repairs; the handover does not turn it into a fully upgraded ship.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 塔站实际安全核验后回接应泊位明确接收封存旧巡灯船微光号及跨区核查委托。船务值守不依赖接受莉娜邀请，三空间是同一船。民用渡轮及船上设备不转移，不证明导师当前去向，不收死锁燃料门票。

contexts.paragraph_english: Local operator: Our trial permission concerns this tower's present configuration. I can issue it when the enhanced installation, baseline protection and two local watches are checked. It is not a vote for a final network policy. The common protocol later requires both an operator and a representative in every region. We have different scopes and appointment instances. We will read the same terms on essential protection, bounded contact, mutual aid and independent review. An organisation's general position cannot stand in for six current regional signatures, and an old appointment cannot keep signing as the current one.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 地方操作岗：试验许可针对本塔当前配置，在增强、基础保护与两值守核实后签发，不是最终政策投票。共同协议每地另需操作方、代表方，范围任职不同，同阅基本保护、有限联系、互助、独立复核。组织立场不代六地签字，旧任职不继续充现任。

contexts.paragraph_english: Protocol-d3-v1 preserves essential local protection, bounded contact, mutual aid and independent review. Every region supplies two different current appointment instances: its operator and representative. ROLE-Rn-OP acts within operate:Rn; ROLE-Rn-REP within represent:Rn. Neither appointment signs for another district or decides the player’s final policy. Local trial permission may be issued before final common acceptance, so testing and agreement do not wait for each other in a circle. Changed holders or terms require a current signature.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: protocol-d3-v1保留地方基本保护、受限联络、互助及独立复核。每地提供操作方与代表方两个不同的现行任职实例。ROLE-Rn-OP只在operate:Rn范围，ROLE-Rn-REP只在represent:Rn范围任职；不为其他地区签字，也不替玩家选终局政策。地方试验许可可先于最终共同接受，避免试验和协议互等。人员或条款改变须重新取得当前签名。

contexts.paragraph_english: For the common protocol, every region needs a current operator and a current representative. Their scopes differ, and their appointment instances must remain distinct. They review protection of essential service, bounded contact, mutual aid and independent review under the same published terms. Five organisations appearing in a political summary do not replace six regions' signatures. An old signature remains part of the history after an appointment changes, but it no longer supplies the current mandate. This lets a receiving team see both the previous decision and the actual person now authorised to speak for the role.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 共同协议每地需要现任操作方与代表方，范围和任职实例不同。二者按同版条款审阅基本保护、有限联系、互助与独立复核。政治摘要中的五组织不代替六地区签字。任职改变后旧签名保留在历史，却不继续充当前授权，使接收组同时看旧决定和现任职能。

entries.english_definition: A limit placed on an action or access.

contexts.paragraph_english: An instruction to start the pump therefore concerns the operation of the facilities, not permission for a particular vessel to enter the channel. For this evacuation, use the vessel particulars recorded for the approved load. A change to that load is not an authorised alternative within the present operation. Keep this restriction with the departure record.

Coast team to the stranded crew. We first marked the south steps as a possible receiving point. That instruction is withdrawn: a fresh inspection found the lower steps separated from their support. Use the northern reach beyond the low wall instead. There are four survivors waiting for assistance, apart from the technician carrying this message. Keep the rescue line clear of the broken steps. Once everyone is under shelter, send your position, the number of people needing collection and the approach restriction. Do not ask the boat to follow the southern marker merely because it is easier to see. We will acknowledge the request through the coast relay.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 海岸队更正原先南台阶方案：现场复查发现下段台阶脱离支承，撤回旧指示。改用矮墙外的北段。有四名幸存者需要接应，不含传递消息的检修员。索具避开破损台阶。人员进入棚内后，发送位置、接应人数和进路限制，接应船不会因南标记显眼就改走那里。通过海岸中继确认求援。

contexts.paragraph_english: Sian: Supply concerns are real, but they do not justify removing unfavourable results or denying an independent review. We can record the limits and practical preparation while retaining public scrutiny. You may agree with a technical concern and refuse the proposed information restriction. Those decisions are separate. The location records should also pass through their bounded verification; a holding-facility code does not tell us Mara's present condition.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 西安：供给担忧确实存在，但不能据此删除不利结果或拒绝独立复核。可以记录限制及实际准备，同时保留公共查验。你可赞同技术担忧并拒绝信息限制，两决定分别保存。地点记录也按限定范围核验；扣押设施代码不说明玛拉目前情况。

contexts.paragraph_english: NORTH-DUTY-D0@1 records a detention-room door kept under station control, a local guard group and an internal evacuation passage whose bolt can be opened from the detention side. Names and medical notes remain outside the public route sheet. The patrol may inspect door status, watch arrangement, return-route status and the source version for the rescue purpose only. Read the signed local restriction, isolate the door drive and clear the duty-hall obstruction. These checks grant a bounded safe approach to the guard work stand. They do not release anyone. The residents have agreed to receive the rescue party at the street reception point; the actual arrival there must still be recorded.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: NORTH-DUTY-D0@1 记载扣押门受北站控制、当地看守组和须内侧开闩的撤离便道。身份及医疗记录不进公开路线纸。救援用途只允许核验门、值守、返程通路及来源版本。读当地限制，隔离门驱动，清值守厅阻碍；这仅让看守操作点可安全到达，不释放任何人。住民同意在街区接应，但仍须实际抵达并登记。

entries.english_definition: Left to a person's authorised judgement rather than automatically required.

contexts.paragraph_english: The declared local load capacity is four internal units. Keep protection at three, archive preservation at one and discretionary reproduction at zero during emergency takeover. These figures are local apparatus units, not a real electrical calculation. Obtain joint work permission, isolate the relay drive, secure the rack and deal with ENC-R5-04 before testing. Appoint the actual operator, record resident and archive oversight and check the return passage. Any load, isolation or duty change invalidates the previous configuration test. Safe means this tower’s present limited protection is verified. Future basic work requires one base isolator, one local backup, two base provisions and two actual operating posts. Enhanced work requires one controller, two couplers, three transition crates and one trial fixture. These are requirements, not granted stock or completed work.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 当地负荷容量四个内部单位：应急接管保留保护三、档案保存一、非必要复制零。数字为当地装置单位，不是现实电工计算。先有共同许可，隔离继电、固定架、处置独立防卫再测试，实际任操作员，记录住民及档案监督，检查返程。负荷、隔离、岗位变使旧测试失效。Safe 仅当下有限保护；未来基础需一隔离件、一备用、二基础供给、两个实际操作岗位；增强需一控制器、二耦合件、三过渡箱、一试验器材。这些是需求，不是库存或完成工作。

contexts.paragraph_english: Operator: I need a current work permit before entering the control layer. The rack must be secured and the relay drive isolated. There is an independent defence unit there; settling the custody question will not switch it off. After that work, the local load is four internal units: three for protection, one for preservation and none for discretionary reproduction. These units belong to this apparatus. They are not crates that can be moved from the six-tower preparation store. I can make an actual configuration check only when the declared load and my duty post match the record.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 操作员：入控制层要当前许可，须固定架、隔离继电驱动；保管决定不关闭独立防卫单元。之后当地负荷四内部单位：保护三、保存一、非必要复制零，不能当六塔储备箱搬走。实际配置检查须负荷与本人岗位同记录。

entries.english_definition: The ability to make decisions within one's own legitimate scope.

contexts.paragraph_english: Base protection is also required whichever final route is chosen. A promise of autonomy cannot create goods or a trained shift. Central coordination may provide real help, and keeping it does not clear officials of responsibility for suppressed evidence. District operators and representatives accept their own actual clauses. A laboratory technician cannot sign for every region, and five organisations are not six district signatures.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 无论终局路线，基础保护都需成立。自治承诺造不出货物或受训班次，中央协调确有作用，保留中央也不会抹去压制证据责任。地区操作方与代表确认本地实际条款，实验技术员不能代签各区，五组织不等于六地区签字。

entries.english_definition: A difference of view between people.

contexts.paragraph_english: Record a disagreement between sources as a disagreement. A voluntary conversation at the public porch can establish present residence for this check. It cannot establish someone's location throughout the intervening years, the whereabouts of another family member, or consent to release a protected attachment.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 不同来源的矛盾应按矛盾记录。公共门廊的自愿交谈可以确认本次查验的当前居住情况，不能说明此前多年每一阶段去向、其他亲属位置或公开受保护附页的同意。

contexts.paragraph_english: Pera: My response to a repair can stay narrower than forgiveness. I can accept a tested alarm and still object to the way the old equipment was delivered. Another qualified person can repeat the test if the arrangement is agreed; the repairer cannot sign both the work and its independent review. We should give residents a result they can use and a way to report a new fault. No one has to write that everyone is satisfied before the safety work can be recorded. The disagreement deserves its own line.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 佩拉：我对维修的回应可以小于原谅。我能接受受检警报器，仍反对早先交付方式。安排获准后，可请另一合格人员重复测试；维修者不能同时签工作及独立复核。住民应得到可用结果和报告新故障的途径。安全工作登记无需先写所有人满意；分歧自有一栏。

contexts.paragraph_english: If a present-stage visit disagrees with this classification, retain both records and state their purposes. The extract has no recorded explanation of motive. A request to correct delivery planning may cite the disagreement without releasing the protected attachment.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 当前走访若与分类冲突，应保留两记录并说明用途。摘录未记录动机解释。申请更正配送规划可以引用差异，无需公开受保护附页。

contexts.paragraph_english: The first list on our kitchen wall was made to count meals. It had room letters and the number of portions to prepare. When a resident asked why the public register still said she had moved away, that kitchen list became useful for a different purpose. It showed a practical disagreement worth investigating. It did not tell us the whole history of her movements, and it did not turn a request for supper into an agreement to publish her name.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 厨房墙上最初的名单用来数饭食，写着房间字母和应准备的份数。一位住民问，为什么公共名册仍说她迁出了，这张厨房名单便对另一用途有了帮助：它指出值得核查的实际差异。它没有叙述她全部迁移经历，也没有把领晚饭的请求变成同意公开姓名。

entries.english_definition: A matter over which parties make conflicting claims.

contexts.paragraph_english: Test the repaired signal in both rooms, then ask another qualified person to repeat the check. Pera may perform or designate that independent review; Oren cannot review his own repair as the second person. Record the actual reviewer and result under the current device version. If the check finds a fault, retain the work done and reopen the remaining defect. Residents may accept the useful repair and still dispute the earlier acceptance.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 在两房测试修复信号，再请另一名合格人员重复检查。佩拉可亲自或指定独立复核；奥伦不能作为第二人复核自己的维修。记录实际复核人与当前装置版本下的结果。检查发现故障时，保留已做工作，继续处理余下缺陷。住民可以接受有用维修，仍质疑早验收。

contexts.paragraph_english: Station channel: The orders were issued as emergency protection. Custodian: You may contest a reading of the order. Please identify the version and the field you dispute. The station register records detention being carried out, and the override removes independent review during the test window. The present rescue is separately recorded. Station channel: I do not have an instruction to accept a transfer of command. Ada: Then record that reply without pretending it answers every claim. We have to make the local facility safe, and people must be able to leave this review without losing lawful evidence.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 北站渠道：这些令以应急保护签发。保管人：可反驳解释，请指版本字段。北站登记记录扣押实施，取消令撤测试窗口独立复核，当前救援另记。渠道：我没有接受指挥权移交的指示。阿妲：记录回覆，别假装它回答所有主张；设施须安全，退出审查不应丧合法证据。

contexts.paragraph_english: The local record custodian offers the rescued patrol a bounded review of OC-D18.design@1, OC-D14.revision@2, OC-D30.correction@1, VQ-D90.policy@1, VT-D7.authorization@1 and RK-D6.override@2 with RK-D3.detention@1. The fields are design_limits, correction_history, policy_authorization, execution_order and version_source. Recipient: patrol_technician. Purpose: distinguish_design_policy_execution_responsibility. Scope version: OC-responsibility-set@1. Personal addresses and unrelated case identities stay sealed. A protected review or an emergency public review can use the same redacted evidence and give each affected party a recorded opportunity to dispute a cited claim. Presence in this hall does not itself grant the scope.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 当地保管人向获救后的巡灯人提供限定审阅：OC-D18.design@1、OC-D14.revision@2、OC-D30.correction@1、VQ-D90.policy@1、VT-D7.authorization@1、RK-D6.override@2、RK-D3.detention@1。字段为 design_limits、correction_history、policy_authorization、execution_order、version_source；接收人 patrol_technician，用途 distinguish_design_policy_execution_responsibility，版本 OC-responsibility-set@1。住址和无关身份封存。受保护或紧急公开审查都使用脱敏证据，给各方记录反证机会；进入厅不等于获得范围。

contexts.paragraph_english: The controlled result places Rook under custody and releases his command authority. It does not kill him or settle a different historical dispute. The running machine must still be examined independently. Use the safe preparation stand after the command encounter; the machine's internal stages later share one attempt and do not have this refill boundary.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 制止结果把鲁克置于看管并解除指挥权，没有杀死他或裁定别的历史争议。仍运行机组需独立检查。指挥遭遇后可用安全整备站；后续机组内部各阶段共用一次尝试，没有这个回满边界。

entries.english_definition: An arrangement in which parties accept limits to resolve a disagreement.

contexts.paragraph_english: Rescuing Mara changes what can be said about her present condition. It does not change the dates on earlier records, and her testimony does not replace them. She can explain why an engineer accepted a compromise, identify a limitation in an incomplete proposal and challenge a mistaken reading. Those contributions should remain distinguishable from the verified design and command records. A review that calls the rescued person either the final authority or the hidden author of every harm would reproduce the same dependence on a single voice that the investigation was meant to question.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 救出玛拉改变当前状况可说之事，不改旧日期，其证言不替代文献。她可解释妥协理由、指出未完整方案限制、反驳误读；贡献须与经核原设计和命令分开。若让获救者成为最终权威或所有伤害幕后作者，审查便复造调查原欲质疑的单一声音依赖。

entries.english_definition: People working together towards a shared purpose.

contexts.paragraph_english: VQ-D90.policy@1 records Voss retaining high quotas about ninety days before D0 after the long-term risk had entered internal discussion. The circulation instruction restricted unfavourable findings. VT-D7.authorization@1 records the authorised branch supply test between D-7 and D-4. These are her policy and authorisation decisions; the claimed need to avoid immediate loss of supply explains her argument but does not remove the known-risk or information-suppression responsibility. The retained report and issued report share an underlying research source, while the policy instruction is a separate decision record. Support for limited central cooperation does not require declaring these decisions harmless.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: VQ-D90.policy@1 记载沃斯在长期风险已进入内部讨论后，于 D0 前约九十天保留高配额，传播令限制不利结果。VT-D7.authorization@1 记载 D-7 至 D-4 支路断供测试授权。这是她的政策和授权决定；避免近期失供可解释其论辩，不取消已知风险与信息压制责任。保留稿及发行稿研究同源，政策指示是另一决定记录。支持中央受限合作不要求认定这些决定无害。

contexts.paragraph_english: The practical outcome is not a declaration that cooperation was always wrong or that technical expertise should be discarded. It is a more exact basis for the next arrangement. Mara retains responsibility for design weakness and delayed correction. Voss retains responsibility for known-risk policy, test authorisation and information suppression. Rook retains responsibility for cancelled review, detention and refusal to transfer control. These can all be true at once. Preserving that distinction allows supervised technical help without restoring exclusive authority, and permits a future policy choice without rewriting the past to make the preferred choice look innocent.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 结果不是宣布合作从来错误或丢弃技术知识，而是为下一安排提供精确依据：玛拉设计不足及迟延纠正；沃斯已知风险政策、测试授权、压制信息；鲁克取消复核、扣押及拒移交。这些可同时成立。分开它们，可用受监督技术帮助却不恢复独占，也可选择未来政策而不改写历史替偏好脱责。

contexts.paragraph_english: The shaft's ordinary maintenance handle is installed at the marked stand. Inspect its coupling and the return landing, then secure the handle before approaching the lower coil sentry. A folding lever may provide a declared alternate grip; the ordinary handle and careful cooperation remain available. A route reel can mark a checked return anchor, but it does not reveal an unknown passage or make an unsafe floor safe.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 竖井常规手柄固定在标记站位。先查连接与返程落台，再固定手柄，随后接近下段线圈哨卫。折叠撬柄可提供声明的替代握点，普通手柄和协作仍可用。路径绳盘可标已查返程锚点，不能发现未知通道或使危险地面安全。

contexts.paragraph_english: A distributed arrangement keeps bounded assistance while placing local control, fault isolation and shared review under the accepted protocol. It uses the actual enhanced equipment and trained duties through the verified transition. The seventh tower becomes a constrained hub rather than an unlimited command source. This preparation is expensive and can temporarily reduce service during changeover. Maintenance, standards and disputes continue to require cooperation. A passed field trial supports its stated conditions, not a promise that every later failure has been removed.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 分布安排在已接受协议下结合本地控制、故障隔离和共同复核，保留有限互助。转换使用实际增强设备与受训岗位，第七塔成为受约束枢纽，而非无限命令源。准备成本高，切换暂减部分服务，维护、标准及争议仍需合作。试运行支持声明条件，没有承诺今后永无失败。

entries.english_definition: Organising separate activities so they work together.

contexts.paragraph_english: Base protection is also required whichever final route is chosen. A promise of autonomy cannot create goods or a trained shift. Central coordination may provide real help, and keeping it does not clear officials of responsibility for suppressed evidence. District operators and representatives accept their own actual clauses. A laboratory technician cannot sign for every region, and five organisations are not six district signatures.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 无论终局路线，基础保护都需成立。自治承诺造不出货物或受训班次，中央协调确有作用，保留中央也不会抹去压制证据责任。地区操作方与代表确认本地实际条款，实验技术员不能代签各区，五组织不等于六地区签字。

contexts.paragraph_english: Voss's questions about a transition week deserve specific answers. Goods need a source and a destination, duties need people and a handover, and a common protocol needs the actual participants' acceptance. These requirements can be examined without accepting her request to delay independent scrutiny. Agreement with a concern is not agreement with every measure proposed in its name. Retain the unfavourable appendix and the limits of the new result. The choice to keep central coordination later will not erase a person's documented responsibility; a preference for distribution will not create a missing spare or excuse an unsafe operation.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 沃斯关于过渡周的问题需具体答：货物有来源与去处，岗位有人员与交接，共同协议需实际参与者接受。查这些条件不必接受延后独立复核。赞同担忧不等于赞同以其名义所有措施。保留不利附录及新结果边界，日后保留中央不会抹去已记录责任，偏好分布也不会生成零件或使危险操作免责。

contexts.paragraph_english: For this private local coordination task, the existing transfer-shed receiver ROLE-R6-SHED-RECEIVER accepts complete labelled boxes against the present manifest; the ridge receiver ROLE-R6-RIDGE-RECEIVER accepts them after a safe segment arrival and checks the same version. Confirm both contacts and those receiving conditions with Tess’s current invitation. These are two existing main-route receiving functions, not hidden settlements needed for an ending. The task can be deferred without taking their protected basic supplies away.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本人邀请下的地方协调涉及既有中转棚接收岗ROLE-R6-SHED-RECEIVER和风脊接收岗ROLE-R6-RIDGE-RECEIVER。前者依现行货单接受整箱标记货物，后者在安全段抵达后核同一版本。明确两名联系人及收货条件；它们是两处已有主线路径岗位，不是结局必须隐藏聚落。暂缓此项不撤走基础供给。

contexts.paragraph_english: Restricted central coordination retains cross-region balancing and much of the existing transport capacity. It can help a weaker district through a difficult period without requiring immediate full conversion. It must retain a checked limit, disable unlimited renewal and identify continuing supervision. Some services will still be rationed, and the old equipment requires maintenance. Concentrated authority remains a practical risk. A new person at the desk does not by itself prevent the next temporary exception from becoming permanent.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 受限中央协调保留跨区调峰及较多现有运输能力，可使较弱地区渡过困难，不要求立刻全转换。须保受检上限、禁无限续启并明确持续监督。仍需轮流限供，旧设备也需维护，集权仍有现实风险。换一位值守，不能自行阻止下次临时例外变永久。

entries.english_definition: Shared or exchanged by the people involved.

contexts.paragraph_english: Protocol-d3-v1 preserves essential local protection, bounded contact, mutual aid and independent review. Every region supplies two different current appointment instances: its operator and representative. ROLE-Rn-OP acts within operate:Rn; ROLE-Rn-REP within represent:Rn. Neither appointment signs for another district or decides the player’s final policy. Local trial permission may be issued before final common acceptance, so testing and agreement do not wait for each other in a circle. Changed holders or terms require a current signature.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: protocol-d3-v1保留地方基本保护、受限联络、互助及独立复核。每地提供操作方与代表方两个不同的现行任职实例。ROLE-Rn-OP只在operate:Rn范围，ROLE-Rn-REP只在represent:Rn范围任职；不为其他地区签字，也不替玩家选终局政策。地方试验许可可先于最终共同接受，避免试验和协议互等。人员或条款改变须重新取得当前签名。

contexts.paragraph_english: Local operator: Our trial permission concerns this tower's present configuration. I can issue it when the enhanced installation, baseline protection and two local watches are checked. It is not a vote for a final network policy. The common protocol later requires both an operator and a representative in every region. We have different scopes and appointment instances. We will read the same terms on essential protection, bounded contact, mutual aid and independent review. An organisation's general position cannot stand in for six current regional signatures, and an old appointment cannot keep signing as the current one.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 地方操作岗：试验许可针对本塔当前配置，在增强、基础保护与两值守核实后签发，不是最终政策投票。共同协议每地另需操作方、代表方，范围任职不同，同阅基本保护、有限联系、互助、独立复核。组织立场不代六地签字，旧任职不继续充现任。

contexts.paragraph_english: For the common protocol, every region needs a current operator and a current representative. Their scopes differ, and their appointment instances must remain distinct. They review protection of essential service, bounded contact, mutual aid and independent review under the same published terms. Five organisations appearing in a political summary do not replace six regions' signatures. An old signature remains part of the history after an appointment changes, but it no longer supplies the current mandate. This lets a receiving team see both the previous decision and the actual person now authorised to speak for the role.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 共同协议每地需要现任操作方与代表方，范围和任职实例不同。二者按同版条款审阅基本保护、有限联系、互助与独立复核。政治摘要中的五组织不代替六地区签字。任职改变后旧签名保留在历史，却不继续充当前授权，使接收组同时看旧决定和现任职能。

entries.english_definition: Taking part in an activity or decision.

contexts.paragraph_english: The original case OC-MASTER-01 is one physical case. Choose public_archive_bounded with the local archive custodian holding it under Ada’s witnessed register, or joint_sealed with Ada and the custodian requiring joint access. Neither choice destroys originals or creates a second original. Public scope can be redacted_findings or redacted_findings_and_conditions; both exclude names of unrelated cases, addresses and medical details. The latter also releases the technical conditions and limits. Supervision requires one local operation post ROLE-R5-OPERATOR, Ada’s resident review and ROLE-R5-ARCHIVE-CUSTODIAN’s evidence oversight. Technical participation by Voss may be supervised or suspended; her agreement with the final policy is not a qualification test. All three future policy routes remain open.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: OC-MASTER-01 是一个真实原件箱。可选 public_archive_bounded，由地方档案保管人持有、阿妲见证登记；或 joint_sealed，阿妲与保管人共同准入。都不毁原件或复制第二原件。公开 redacted_findings 或 redacted_findings_and_conditions，均排除无关身份、地址、医疗细节，后者另公开技术条件与限制。共同监督须 ROLE-R5-OPERATOR 操作岗位、阿妲住民复核、ROLE-R5-ARCHIVE-CUSTODIAN 证据监督。沃斯可受监督参与或停职，与最终政策意见不当资格考试，三条未来政策仍开放。

contexts.paragraph_english: Rook: This floor has two combat transfer points. They are local to my command chain. Do not pretend that taking them down is the same as operating the city network. My guards will act with me when the combined intention is declared. You can see which guard participates and who is targeted before choosing your response. There will be no replacement strike from a guard whose participation was already removed.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 鲁克：本层有两个作战转接点，属于我的本地指挥链。别把关闭它们等同于操作城市网络。合击意图公布时，护卫会参与；你在选择回应前可看到谁参与、目标是谁。已经移除参与的护卫不会再补一次替代攻击。

entries.english_definition: Something a person adds to a shared effort or resource.

contexts.paragraph_english: The display label credits the instrument housing to the workshop team and lists one presenter. The contribution book distinguishes construction, calibration and presentation: the workshop built the housing, two students checked reference marks, and the presenter explained the result. The presenter's speaking role is not evidence that the other work was absent. A revised label can name contributions without inventing additional people or changing the trial output.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 展签将仪表外壳归工坊团队，列一介绍人。贡献簿分建造、校准与介绍：工坊制外壳，两学生查参考标，介绍人说明结果。发言角色不证明其他工作没有发生。修订展签可注明贡献，无需新造人或改试验输出。

contexts.paragraph_english: Until both points are confirmed closed, force can reduce resistance but cannot bypass the remaining command chain. The combined attack announces its participants and targets. Controlling a named guard removes only that guard's announced contribution. A stability break on Rook weakens his next attack and cancels the current interruptible combination; it does not remove a complete boss stage or trigger an unannounced substitute attack.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 两点未共同确认关闭前，打击可降抵抗，不能跳过残余指挥链。合击公布参与者和目标，制止某护卫仅移除其已声明部分。鲁克失衡减弱下次攻击并取消当前可中断合击，没有删除整段首领阶段，也不触发未公布替补攻击。

entries.english_definition: A decision not to accept or permit something.

contexts.paragraph_english: The statement that an interval was stable is useful without being universal. It does not settle load 55, a scale absent from the validated set, or permanent six-tower service. A refusal to invent a reading is an honest limit of the apparatus, not an assertion that the missing condition would certainly fail. Similarly, a high-load safe stop does not imply that every local arrangement is impossible. A careful report preserves supported, contradicted and untested claims separately. It can recommend a bounded next step while leaving a larger question open.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 稳定时段有用，无需普遍化。它没有裁定验证集合未含的55，也没有证明六塔永久供给。拒绝编读数是器材诚实边界，不是断言未测条件必败；高负荷停止也不表示一切本地安排不可能。报告分别保留支持、矛盾和未测主张，可推荐有限下一步并开放较广问题。

contexts.paragraph_english: Custodian: Once these local conditions are met, send the transfer demand through the executive channel and preserve its actual answer. Discussing a possible refusal is not proof that it has occurred. If command refuses and moves to the Seventh Tower, the joint authority will permit the patrol to seek current risk and preparation information at the frontier. That is travel permission and a bounded commission, not a final decision on central operation, disconnection or distribution. The ferry must still make the voyage. We cannot write the next region as reached just because the destination has been agreed.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 保管人：满足当地条件后，实际向执行渠道发移交要求并保回覆；讨论可能拒绝不证明已发生。若拒交并转第七塔，共同授权让巡灯人去边境核当前风险准备。这是行程许可及有限委托，不是中央运行、断联、分布式最终决定。渡船仍须真航行，不因定目的地便记已到。

contexts.paragraph_english: The practical outcome is not a declaration that cooperation was always wrong or that technical expertise should be discarded. It is a more exact basis for the next arrangement. Mara retains responsibility for design weakness and delayed correction. Voss retains responsibility for known-risk policy, test authorisation and information suppression. Rook retains responsibility for cancelled review, detention and refusal to transfer control. These can all be true at once. Preserving that distinction allows supervised technical help without restoring exclusive authority, and permits a future policy choice without rewriting the past to make the preferred choice look innocent.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 结果不是宣布合作从来错误或丢弃技术知识，而是为下一安排提供精确依据：玛拉设计不足及迟延纠正；沃斯已知风险政策、测试授权、压制信息；鲁克取消复核、扣押及拒移交。这些可同时成立。分开它们，可用受监督技术帮助却不恢复独占，也可选择未来政策而不改写历史替偏好脱责。

entries.english_definition: A person's decision to stop holding a wrong against another.

contexts.paragraph_english: Some of the next steps can be agreed before a wider inquiry ends. A local team can isolate a damaged connection, replace a part and ask someone other than the repairer to repeat the test. It can record that result without writing that all previous decisions were justified. A resident may appreciate the new signal and still have questions about the earlier acceptance. Requiring forgiveness as the price of a safety receipt would give that receipt a purpose it cannot serve. The condition tested, the observer and the remaining disagreement can all stay visible.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 广泛核查结束前，仍可商定下一些工作。本地队能隔离损坏接线、换件，并请维修者之外的人重复测试；记录结果时无需宣称此前决定都合理。住民可能感谢新的信号，仍质疑早先验收。若把原谅当安全回执的代价，就赋予回执无法承担的作用。受检状态、观察人和余下分歧可以同时保留。

contexts.paragraph_english: Pera: My response to a repair can stay narrower than forgiveness. I can accept a tested alarm and still object to the way the old equipment was delivered. Another qualified person can repeat the test if the arrangement is agreed; the repairer cannot sign both the work and its independent review. We should give residents a result they can use and a way to report a new fault. No one has to write that everyone is satisfied before the safety work can be recorded. The disagreement deserves its own line.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 佩拉：我对维修的回应可以小于原谅。我能接受受检警报器，仍反对早先交付方式。安排获准后，可请另一合格人员重复测试；维修者不能同时签工作及独立复核。住民应得到可用结果和报告新故障的途径。安全工作登记无需先写所有人满意；分歧自有一栏。

contexts.paragraph_english: Oren’s further testimony must retain the MC-2-05 and MC-2-06 unrepaired-bypass acceptance and the auxiliary alarm’s separate repair and independent review. Choose rotation_local_maintenance with a declared safe reassignment window, or supervised_remote_answers with the local team doing physical installation. Accepting a repair does not require forgiveness. For this candidate window the local receiving team is ROLE-R3-LOCAL-MAINTENANCE, the supervised remote desk ROLE-R3-REMOTE-REVIEW and the interval next_safe_reassignment. A person committed to either work post cannot also occupy an active battle seat or another current duty. End or hand off the post explicitly before rejoining; no real week-long disappearance is required. The post is optional and supplies no main evidence or tower conversion by itself.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 奥伦后续证言保留 MC-2-05/06 未修旁路验收责任及辅助警报独立修复复核。可 rotation_local_maintenance 并明确安全重编队窗口，或 supervised_remote_answers、实际安装由当地队承担。接受修复不等于原谅。候选接收队 ROLE-R3-LOCAL-MAINTENANCE，远程监督 ROLE-R3-REMOTE-REVIEW，时段 next_safe_reassignment。承担任一岗位者不可同时占出战席或另一值守；须明确结束或交班才能归队，不要求现实失踪一周。可选岗位本身不供主线证据或塔转型。

entries.english_definition: Restoring a workable relationship after a disagreement or harm.

contexts.paragraph_english: Historical responsibility remains attached to the reviewed actions. Retaining coordination does not erase Voss's responsibility, and a distributed preference does not excuse a missing supply or unsafe operation. Rook's custody is not a replacement for the old-capital review. Keep the provenance and access limits of earlier records. A private name or an uncompleted companion reconciliation cannot be added to the public account merely to make an ending scene more satisfying.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 历史责任仍附已审行为。保协调不会抹去沃斯责任，偏好分布也不会使缺供给或危险操作免责。鲁克看管不替代旧都审查。保留较早记录来源与范围，不能只为尾声更圆满就向公共档案添私人身份或未完成同伴和解。

entries.english_definition: A statement acknowledging wrongdoing and regret.

contexts.paragraph_english: You may request a public statement within an agreed scope, a supervised period of specific repair followed by a statement, or a regional review. None of those arrangements deletes the signed record. If you ask me to repair something, identify the equipment, supplies, person checking it and end of the assignment. An apology cannot fill those fields.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 可以要求在约定范围公开证言，安排有监督的具体限期维修后补交说明，或交由地区核查。这些安排均不删除签章记录。若让我修理，应列设备、物资、复核人和工作结束边界；一句道歉填不出这些条件。

entries.english_definition: Confidence that someone will act reliably or honestly.

contexts.paragraph_english: Sian's brief asks you to compare observations before proposing an explanation. The mine has documented dangerous changes and a high extraction setting. Those observations matter, but an association does not alone identify the mechanism or establish that a replacement control scheme is safe. The same requirement applies to the Lamp Authority and to visitors who favour local control. Personal trust in a designer cannot replace the missing checks.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 西安要求先比较观察，再提出解释。矿区记录了危险变化及高抽取设置，这些观察有意义，但关联不能单独识别机制，也不能证明替代控制方案安全。灯署和支持本地控制的访客遵循同一要求。对设计者的私人信任不能替代缺少的检查。

entries.english_definition: Restricted because disclosure requires specific permission.

contexts.paragraph_english: Choose emergency_public_redacted or protected_review. In either form, list the claim, the cited source version, the responding party and the response or explicit decline. Provide Mara, Voss and the station executive channel an opportunity to challenge claims separately. No response is not proof of innocence or guilt. Disputed interpretation remains noted alongside the fixed documents. The custodian checks that confidential identities are excluded and records that all three response opportunities were offered. A submitted essay cannot perform these invitations, overwrite a signature or turn a majority preference into a new historical fact. The resulting summary separates design and delayed correction, known-risk policy and testing, and cancelled review with detention.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 可选 emergency_public_redacted 或 protected_review。两种均逐条列主张、来源版本、回应方以及回应或明确拒绝；玛拉、沃斯、北站执行渠道分别获得反证机会。不回应不是无罪或有罪证明。争议解释与固定文献并存；保管人检查身份脱敏，登记三方均获机会。作文不会自动邀请、改签名或用多数偏好制造历史事实。摘要分开设计及迟延纠正、已知风险政策与测试、取消复核及扣押。

contexts.paragraph_english: A fair emergency procedure therefore records opportunities for contrary evidence. Each claim needs a source and scope, and each affected party needs a channel to answer. Silence must be entered as silence, not converted into proof. Confidential identities can remain protected while the relevant authorisations and findings are shared in redacted form. An emergency public review and a protected review can both meet these conditions. They differ in audience and immediate exposure, not in whether the evidence is allowed to be questioned. The patrol’s writing organises that process; it does not create the response opportunities by itself.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 公正应急程序因此记录反证机会。每条主张需来源及范围，各方需回应渠道；沉默按沉默登记，不化证明。身份可保护，相关授权和结果脱敏共享。紧急公开与受保护审查都能满足，差别是受众及暴露，不是是否容许质疑。巡灯人写作组织过程，不会自动创造回应机会。

entries.english_definition: Making previously restricted information known.

contexts.paragraph_english: Sometimes a person wants to be named. Their decision deserves the same care as a decision to remain private. Ask what they agree to release, to whom, for what use and in which version. A broad permission inferred from an earlier conversation may not fit a new publication. Equally, choosing the smallest possible package in every situation can remove the very detail that the person wants included or that the authorised review needs. Appropriate scope depends on the purpose and the permission, as well as on the risk of disclosure.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 有时本人希望具名。这个决定与保持私密同样需要认真对待。请问清允许发布什么、给谁、为何使用及对应版本。旧交谈推断出的宽泛许可可能不适合新发布。每次都机械选择最少字段，也可能删去本人希望保留的内容，或获准审查真正需要的细节。适当范围取决于用途、许可和公开风险。

entries.english_definition: Having sensitive portions removed before sharing.

contexts.paragraph_english: The public work register remains open if an identity request is declined. You may request a redacted copy, arrange an inspection through the custodian, or pause the identity request and continue the public inquiry. Reviewers must still be able to check material public facts and the records supporting them. Private details should be separated from that route rather than used to prevent all scrutiny.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 身份申请被拒后，公共工作记录仍开放。可以申请脱敏副本、经保管人安排查验，或暂缓身份申请后继续公共调查。必要公共事实及支持记录仍须能被审查；私人细节应与这条核查路径分开。

contexts.paragraph_english: Custodian: We will not count silence as proof. The three opportunities to respond are now recorded, with the answers and their limits attached. The summary will retain Mara’s design and delayed-correction responsibility, Voss’s policy, testing and suppression responsibility, and Rook’s review cancellation and detention responsibility. The transfer question is a next-stage action, not an event that has already happened because we discussed it. The originals will remain available under the temporary custody arrangement. A redacted summary can travel onward, but its readers must still know which claims rest on independent records and which reproduce the same source.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 保管人：沉默不计证明。三方反证机会及回应限制已记录；摘要保留玛拉设计与迟延纠正、沃斯政策测试压制、鲁克取消复核扣押责任。移交是下一阶段动作，不因讨论便发生。原件留临时保管，脱敏摘要可继续送，但读者须知道哪些独立、哪些同源复制。

contexts.paragraph_english: The local record custodian offers the rescued patrol a bounded review of OC-D18.design@1, OC-D14.revision@2, OC-D30.correction@1, VQ-D90.policy@1, VT-D7.authorization@1 and RK-D6.override@2 with RK-D3.detention@1. The fields are design_limits, correction_history, policy_authorization, execution_order and version_source. Recipient: patrol_technician. Purpose: distinguish_design_policy_execution_responsibility. Scope version: OC-responsibility-set@1. Personal addresses and unrelated case identities stay sealed. A protected review or an emergency public review can use the same redacted evidence and give each affected party a recorded opportunity to dispute a cited claim. Presence in this hall does not itself grant the scope.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 当地保管人向获救后的巡灯人提供限定审阅：OC-D18.design@1、OC-D14.revision@2、OC-D30.correction@1、VQ-D90.policy@1、VT-D7.authorization@1、RK-D6.override@2、RK-D3.detention@1。字段为 design_limits、correction_history、policy_authorization、execution_order、version_source；接收人 patrol_technician，用途 distinguish_design_policy_execution_responsibility，版本 OC-responsibility-set@1。住址和无关身份封存。受保护或紧急公开审查都使用脱敏证据，给各方记录反证机会；进入厅不等于获得范围。

contexts.paragraph_english: Choose emergency_public_redacted or protected_review. In either form, list the claim, the cited source version, the responding party and the response or explicit decline. Provide Mara, Voss and the station executive channel an opportunity to challenge claims separately. No response is not proof of innocence or guilt. Disputed interpretation remains noted alongside the fixed documents. The custodian checks that confidential identities are excluded and records that all three response opportunities were offered. A submitted essay cannot perform these invitations, overwrite a signature or turn a majority preference into a new historical fact. The resulting summary separates design and delayed correction, known-risk policy and testing, and cancelled review with detention.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 可选 emergency_public_redacted 或 protected_review。两种均逐条列主张、来源版本、回应方以及回应或明确拒绝；玛拉、沃斯、北站执行渠道分别获得反证机会。不回应不是无罪或有罪证明。争议解释与固定文献并存；保管人检查身份脱敏，登记三方均获机会。作文不会自动邀请、改签名或用多数偏好制造历史事实。摘要分开设计及迟延纠正、已知风险政策与测试、取消复核及扣押。

entries.english_definition: The act of making a text or findings available to an audience.

contexts.paragraph_english: Basic archive access may be registered for this check. Names in protected attachments require a separate request, a stated purpose and a permitted recipient. Keep the public room codes in your working summary. No resident has agreed to publication merely by accepting a meal or answering a question.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本次查验可以登记基础档案访问。受保护附页中的姓名须另外申请，说明用途与接收方。工作摘要使用公开房间代码。领取饭食或回答问题均未构成同意公开身份。

contexts.paragraph_english: W-04 agrees to let the priory review desk check the observation time, the witness's duty and the version reference for a local note. The purpose is to verify that note's account. The agreement is for version W04-v1. It does not include a private address or general publication of identity.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: W-04同意修院审查台核对一份地方便条的观察时间、证人职能和版本索引，用途为核验陈述。协议限定版本W04-v1，未包括私人地址或普遍公开身份。

contexts.paragraph_english: Sometimes a person wants to be named. Their decision deserves the same care as a decision to remain private. Ask what they agree to release, to whom, for what use and in which version. A broad permission inferred from an earlier conversation may not fit a new publication. Equally, choosing the smallest possible package in every situation can remove the very detail that the person wants included or that the authorised review needs. Appropriate scope depends on the purpose and the permission, as well as on the risk of disclosure.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 有时本人希望具名。这个决定与保持私密同样需要认真对待。请问清允许发布什么、给谁、为何使用及对应版本。旧交谈推断出的宽泛许可可能不适合新发布。每次都机械选择最少字段，也可能删去本人希望保留的内容，或获准审查真正需要的细节。适当范围取决于用途、许可和公开风险。

contexts.paragraph_english: Two independent survey teams kept separate field records during the stated comparison window. Read their locations, load bands, instruments and limitations. A report copied from a field sheet is useful for checking publication; it does not add another observer. The public table keeps measurements in local indicator units, so you need no outside electrical calculation. Compare like conditions where the records permit it, and state what remains uncontrolled.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 两支独立调查队在注明比较窗口各留现场记录。请读地点、负荷档、仪表与限制。由现场页抄成的报告有助于查发行过程，没有增加一名观察者。公开表使用本地指标单位，无需外部电气计算。材料允许时比较相近条件，注明尚未控制的变量。

entries.english_definition: The movement of documents among permitted recipients.

contexts.paragraph_english: The records custodian can grant a bounded review of the retained manuscript, issued report and circulation register. Access depends on the purpose and necessary fields, not on agreeing with a political position. Keep any unfavourable result. The old trial hall is a separate physical assignment. You may pursue that work while preparing your data overview; the small island trial will require both work streams.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 记录保管人可按范围开放留存原稿、发行稿及流转册。访问取决于用途和必要字段，不取决于政治观点。应保留不利结果。旧试验厅是另一项实体工作，可在准备数据概览时并行推进；小规模孤网试验需要两边完成。

contexts.paragraph_english: Voss: My policy kept the high quota after the long-term warning entered internal discussion. The circulation limit was also my decision. I considered immediate interruption more dangerous than the risk of continuing, but the patrol has shown why that comparison was not enough to close review. I authorised the branch test. The executive cancellation of review was a distinct act, and the distinction should remain in the record. Custodian: We will keep both levels. Separating an executive order does not remove your responsibility for authorisation, known risk or suppression of unfavourable information.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 沃斯：长期警报进入内部讨论后，我仍保高配额，限制传播也是我的决定。我认为即刻中断更危险，巡灯人证明该比较不足以取消复核。我授权支路测试，但执行层取消复核是另一行为，记录应分开。保管人：两层均保留，分开执行令不除授权、已知风险、压制不利信息责任。

contexts.paragraph_english: For public-data verification, the custodian permits review of report GH-R7 version 7, including observation identifiers, tested conditions, outcome entries, the issue version and circulation dates. Ask for those necessary fields and state the receiving technician and purpose. Political agreement is not an access condition. Household addresses, personal correspondence and unrelated medical fields remain outside this permission.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 公共数据核验可调阅GH-R7报告第7版，范围包括观察标识、受试条件、结果、发行版本与流转日期。应申请必要字段，说明接收技术员和用途。政治赞同不是调阅条件。住址、私人通信和无关医疗字段不在许可内。

contexts.paragraph_english: Issued report GH-R7, reporting version 7: the displayed appendix contains T1 stable and T4 stable. The outcome rows for T2 and T3 are absent. The issued cover carries the same reporting-version identifier as the retained manuscript. Compare the actual appendix and circulation record; do not rely on a title alone.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 发行报告GH-R7、报告第7版：所示附录只有T1稳定、T4稳定，T2、T3结果行缺失。发行封面与留存原稿使用同一报告版本标识。应比较实际附录与流转册，不能仅依标题。

entries.english_definition: Making another copy of a document or work.

contexts.paragraph_english: The declared local load capacity is four internal units. Keep protection at three, archive preservation at one and discretionary reproduction at zero during emergency takeover. These figures are local apparatus units, not a real electrical calculation. Obtain joint work permission, isolate the relay drive, secure the rack and deal with ENC-R5-04 before testing. Appoint the actual operator, record resident and archive oversight and check the return passage. Any load, isolation or duty change invalidates the previous configuration test. Safe means this tower’s present limited protection is verified. Future basic work requires one base isolator, one local backup, two base provisions and two actual operating posts. Enhanced work requires one controller, two couplers, three transition crates and one trial fixture. These are requirements, not granted stock or completed work.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 当地负荷容量四个内部单位：应急接管保留保护三、档案保存一、非必要复制零。数字为当地装置单位，不是现实电工计算。先有共同许可，隔离继电、固定架、处置独立防卫再测试，实际任操作员，记录住民及档案监督，检查返程。负荷、隔离、岗位变使旧测试失效。Safe 仅当下有限保护；未来基础需一隔离件、一备用、二基础供给、两个实际操作岗位；增强需一控制器、二耦合件、三过渡箱、一试验器材。这些是需求，不是库存或完成工作。

contexts.paragraph_english: Operator: I need a current work permit before entering the control layer. The rack must be secured and the relay drive isolated. There is an independent defence unit there; settling the custody question will not switch it off. After that work, the local load is four internal units: three for protection, one for preservation and none for discretionary reproduction. These units belong to this apparatus. They are not crates that can be moved from the six-tower preparation store. I can make an actual configuration check only when the declared load and my duty post match the record.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 操作员：入控制层要当前许可，须固定架、隔离继电驱动；保管决定不关闭独立防卫单元。之后当地负荷四内部单位：保护三、保存一、非必要复制零，不能当六塔储备箱搬走。实际配置检查须负荷与本人岗位同记录。

entries.english_definition: A reproduction of a source document or object.

contexts.paragraph_english: Bridge observation copy — times use the same ship clock. 21:14:10: the tower light disappeared from view while the heading indicator still showed the assigned course. 21:16:00: the helmsman reported a course deviation. 21:17:40: contact with the reef was felt. The entries describe what the crew observed; they do not identify a switch operator or establish the reason for the loss of light. The ship clock has not yet been compared with a shore instrument. Preserve this copy and compare it with an independent record when the rescue work allows it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 桥台抄记使用同一船钟。21:14:10，塔灯消失，当时航向指示仍显示规定航向。21:16:00，舵手报告偏航。21:17:40，船体触礁。记录只说明船员观察到的先后，不识别开关操作者，也不证明熄灯原因。船钟尚未与岸上仪器核对；先保留副本，完成救援后再找独立记录。

contexts.paragraph_english: Archive clerk: We have laid out the local M-12 papers on two stands. Start with either one, but keep the references attached when you make your notes. The departure officer's page and the receiving officer's page describe different observations. The ledger was prepared from those records later. If the departure entry appears twice, count its source once. The second copy is useful when a page cannot be handled; it does not add another person who saw the vehicle leave.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 阅览台员：M-12地方文件摆在两个站位，可以从任一处开始，但记笔记时要保留来源编号。出发记录员和接收员记的是不同观察，总账稍后由这些记录编成。出发条目即使出现两次，来源也只算一次。另一份副本有助于无法触摸原页时查阅，没有增加看到车辆离开的人。

contexts.paragraph_english: Coast recorder extract. Instrument clock: 21:14:12, light signal lost at the observed tower channel. Further gaps occur in the same recording window, but the extract does not contain a complete network diagnosis. The shore clock and ship clock differ by approximately two seconds in their last routine comparison. Taken with the ship observation copy, this extract supports the order of light loss followed by course deviation. It does not name the person responsible, explain why every gap occurred or establish that the outage was deliberate. Keep the original time labels attached when making a later comparison.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 海岸记录器摘录：仪器钟21:14:12，所观测塔台信号消失；同一窗口还有其他缺口，摘录并非完整网络诊断。最近一次常规比对中，岸钟与船钟相差约两秒。结合船上抄记，资料支持先熄灯后偏航，不识别责任人，不解释每个缺口，也不证明故意断供。后续比对保留原始时间标签。

contexts.paragraph_english: Harbour closure order — current copy. General departures are suspended while the navigation restrictions are reviewed. Rescue arrivals continue at the public receiving berth. An arrival under that provision does not grant a vessel permission to depart. The dispatch office may issue a limited local maintenance commission where the work supports a specific safe evacuation arrangement. The commission must name its work area and power boundary. It does not itself clear a route, approve an untested navigation lamp or transfer ownership of a vessel. A later departure instruction must be checked against the route notices and the vessel's current configuration. The public consultation desk remains accessible during the closure; restricted records and equipment require their own authorisation.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 现行封港令：一般出港暂停，公共泊位仍接收救援入港；允许入港不等于允许出港。调度室可为明确安全撤离工作签发有限地方检修委托，写明作业范围和供电边界。委托本身不开放航道、不认可未经测试导航灯、不移交船产权。出港另需按航道资料及船舶当前配置核对。公共咨询区开放，受限记录与设备需各自授权。

entries.english_definition: The recorded origin and history of an item or source.

contexts.paragraph_english: Historical responsibility remains attached to the reviewed actions. Retaining coordination does not erase Voss's responsibility, and a distributed preference does not excuse a missing supply or unsafe operation. Rook's custody is not a replacement for the old-capital review. Keep the provenance and access limits of earlier records. A private name or an uncompleted companion reconciliation cannot be added to the public account merely to make an ending scene more satisfying.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 历史责任仍附已审行为。保协调不会抹去沃斯责任，偏好分布也不会使缺供给或危险操作免责。鲁克看管不替代旧都审查。保留较早记录来源与范围，不能只为尾声更圆满就向公共档案添私人身份或未完成同伴和解。

entries.english_definition: Able to be followed back to an identified source or action.

contexts.paragraph_english: Extraction and disturbance rose together in this short record. Pump operation, nearby machines and sampling conditions also need checking. The sheet provides a traceable question for the academic review: which factors can explain the pattern, and under what conditions could it be reproduced? It cannot by itself show that mining created the mist, that every district has the same response, or that a shutdown will clear the weather immediately.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 这份短记录里，抽取与扰动同时上升。泵房运作、附近机械和采样条件也需核查。资料为学城提出可追查问题：哪些因素能够解释此模式，怎样的条件下可以复现？仅凭它尚不能说明开采创造了雾海、每个地区反应相同，或停机会立即放晴。

entries.english_definition: A systematic check of records against stated requirements.

contexts.paragraph_english: The local audit indicator distinguishes CMD-L / CMD-R from the maintained central loop. Closing both command points releases the combat chain. The loop's current status must still be read after the encounter. A custody receipt is evidence about a person's command authority; it is not a measurement of the machine. Preserve both records without changing earlier evidence.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本地核验指示区分CMD-L/R与中央维护循环。两转接关闭解除作战链，遭遇后仍需实际读循环当前状态。看管回执证明人物指挥权限，不是机器测量。两记录并存，不改较早证据。

contexts.paragraph_english: Receiving officer: Control and custody remain separate from the historical archive. The reviewed records from the old capital remain unchanged by this confrontation. We will record that Rook's command authority is released when the actual points and combat condition are met. We will not record that the central machinery has stopped merely because a person has been restrained. Its indicator is still visible from the audit stand.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 接收值守：制止与看管和历史档案分开。旧都已审记录不会因这次对峙改变。实际转接和战斗条件成立后，登记鲁克指挥权解除；不会因一人受约束就登记中央机组停止。核验台仍能看到机组指示。

entries.english_definition: Close and critical examination.

contexts.paragraph_english: The public work register remains open if an identity request is declined. You may request a redacted copy, arrange an inspection through the custodian, or pause the identity request and continue the public inquiry. Reviewers must still be able to check material public facts and the records supporting them. Private details should be separated from that route rather than used to prevent all scrutiny.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 身份申请被拒后，公共工作记录仍开放。可以申请脱敏副本、经保管人安排查验，或暂缓身份申请后继续公共调查。必要公共事实及支持记录仍须能被审查；私人细节应与这条核查路径分开。

contexts.paragraph_english: You may argue for wider public scrutiny, a controlled review, or a combination with a public summary and retained originals. State the practical benefits, the risks and the arrangement you intend to carry out. I will not infer that choice from a saved essay. At this desk, you will confirm the fields, the recipient, the purpose and the version, inspect the proposed handover, then explicitly send it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 你可以主张更广公开、受控审查，或公共摘要与保留原稿结合。请说明实际益处、风险与所选安排。保存文章不会让我推断交付选择。你须在此确认字段、接收方、用途和版本，查看交接预览，再明确发送。

contexts.paragraph_english: Sian: Supply concerns are real, but they do not justify removing unfavourable results or denying an independent review. We can record the limits and practical preparation while retaining public scrutiny. You may agree with a technical concern and refuse the proposed information restriction. Those decisions are separate. The location records should also pass through their bounded verification; a holding-facility code does not tell us Mara's present condition.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 西安：供给担忧确实存在，但不能据此删除不利结果或拒绝独立复核。可以记录限制及实际准备，同时保留公共查验。你可赞同技术担忧并拒绝信息限制，两决定分别保存。地点记录也按限定范围核验；扣押设施代码不说明玛拉目前情况。

contexts.paragraph_english: Voss's questions about a transition week deserve specific answers. Goods need a source and a destination, duties need people and a handover, and a common protocol needs the actual participants' acceptance. These requirements can be examined without accepting her request to delay independent scrutiny. Agreement with a concern is not agreement with every measure proposed in its name. Retain the unfavourable appendix and the limits of the new result. The choice to keep central coordination later will not erase a person's documented responsibility; a preference for distribution will not create a missing spare or excuse an unsafe operation.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 沃斯关于过渡周的问题需具体答：货物有来源与去处，岗位有人员与交接，共同协议需实际参与者接受。查这些条件不必接受延后独立复核。赞同担忧不等于赞同以其名义所有措施。保留不利附录及新结果边界，日后保留中央不会抹去已记录责任，偏好分布也不会生成零件或使危险操作免责。

entries.english_definition: A judgement made using stated evidence and criteria.

contexts.paragraph_english: Your short final instruction should identify the chosen prepared direction and acknowledge its operating boundary. You may write freely and then explicitly confirm the action that the system proposes. A structured fallback is available when language interpretation is uncertain or unavailable. It records a deliberate choice while leaving the writing assessment pending. Word count, subtitles, translation, hints, companions, combat difficulty and political vocabulary do not add or remove a technical qualification.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 最后短指令须明确准备好的方向及运行边界。可自由写后逐项确认系统呈现的动作，语言解释不确定或不可用时有结构化后备。它记录明确选择，写作评价仍待审。字数、字幕、翻译、提示、同伴、战斗难度或政治用词都不会增减技术资格。

entries.english_definition: A stated standard used to judge a case.

contexts.paragraph_english: Start from the field console and inspect at minute 5 and minute 10 of the declared simulation clock. Under this recorded configuration the local output meets the declared criterion at both observations. The finite result supports this controller, load, reserve, contact and duty arrangement for this window. Keep a process diagram showing preparation, execution, observation and acceptance as different stages. There is no reading race or real-time countdown.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 从场内控制台启动，在声明的模拟钟第5与第10分钟检查。此记录配置下，本地输出两次符合准则。有限结果支持该控制器、负荷、储备、联络与岗位在此窗口的安排。流程图把准备、执行、观察和接受分开，没有阅读竞速或实时倒计时。

entries.english_definition: A recognised condition or ability required for a role.

contexts.paragraph_english: The original case OC-MASTER-01 is one physical case. Choose public_archive_bounded with the local archive custodian holding it under Ada’s witnessed register, or joint_sealed with Ada and the custodian requiring joint access. Neither choice destroys originals or creates a second original. Public scope can be redacted_findings or redacted_findings_and_conditions; both exclude names of unrelated cases, addresses and medical details. The latter also releases the technical conditions and limits. Supervision requires one local operation post ROLE-R5-OPERATOR, Ada’s resident review and ROLE-R5-ARCHIVE-CUSTODIAN’s evidence oversight. Technical participation by Voss may be supervised or suspended; her agreement with the final policy is not a qualification test. All three future policy routes remain open.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: OC-MASTER-01 是一个真实原件箱。可选 public_archive_bounded，由地方档案保管人持有、阿妲见证登记；或 joint_sealed，阿妲与保管人共同准入。都不毁原件或复制第二原件。公开 redacted_findings 或 redacted_findings_and_conditions，均排除无关身份、地址、医疗细节，后者另公开技术条件与限制。共同监督须 ROLE-R5-OPERATOR 操作岗位、阿妲住民复核、ROLE-R5-ARCHIVE-CUSTODIAN 证据监督。沃斯可受监督参与或停职，与最终政策意见不当资格考试，三条未来政策仍开放。

contexts.paragraph_english: Dispatch officer: The dangerous programme has a current safe-stop receipt, and this desk now has the actual decision-node permission. We will show the sealed preparation and every missing qualification before you choose. Restricted central and orderly island arrangements depend on base preservation and current safety. Distribution needs the additional actual work that has been visible since the glass city. A statement of support cannot complete that work.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 调度值守：危险程序有当前安全停止回执，此台也已有实际决策节点许可。选择前显示封存准备及每项缺项。受限中央与有序孤网需基础保全和当前安全，分布需学城起已公开的额外实体工作，表态支持不能完成工作。

contexts.paragraph_english: The option display must name each missing qualification now, using the sealed version and current physical safety. Choosing a preferred description does not install a device or make a different protocol current. If the distributed work is incomplete, central and island remain legitimate prepared decisions when the base and central safety conditions hold. Revisiting the protected pre-final adventure later may produce another result, but it cannot change the ending snapshot that has already been committed.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 方案显示应按封存版本和当前实体安全列出每个缺项。选择偏好说明不会安装装置，也不会使另一协议成为当前。分布工作未齐时，只要基础及中央安全成立，中央与孤网仍是正当准备方向。后来回访终局前冒险可另产结果，不能改已提交结局快照。

contexts.paragraph_english: Your short final instruction should identify the chosen prepared direction and acknowledge its operating boundary. You may write freely and then explicitly confirm the action that the system proposes. A structured fallback is available when language interpretation is uncertain or unavailable. It records a deliberate choice while leaving the writing assessment pending. Word count, subtitles, translation, hints, companions, combat difficulty and political vocabulary do not add or remove a technical qualification.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 最后短指令须明确准备好的方向及运行边界。可自由写后逐项确认系统呈现的动作，语言解释不确定或不可用时有结构化后备。它记录明确选择，写作评价仍待审。字数、字幕、翻译、提示、同伴、战斗难度或政治用词都不会增减技术资格。

entries.english_definition: Advice proposing a course of action.

contexts.paragraph_english: The final recommendation retained the extra wait after the busiest train and made responsibility for the lift checks explicit. It also proposed another review during the college term, when travel patterns might differ. Some residents regarded the continued review as unnecessary caution; others welcomed the acknowledgement that a useful arrangement could still need adjustment. The case suggests that a timetable is best understood as a statement of an intended service, rather than a guarantee that every person can make every connection. Assessing that service requires attention to the journey around the scheduled departure as well as to the time printed beside it.

Our recommendation is to keep the two late evenings for one more term while testing a supervised study room on another day. This is a proposed next step, not an approved timetable, so students should not arrive next Monday expecting the new room to be open. Before it starts, the college needs to confirm staffing and access arrangements. We will compare costs, types of use and the experience of students who need specialist resources. We also plan to ask people who did not attend the trial, because a service can look popular while still failing to reach some of those it was intended to help. That wider review should give us a better basis for a permanent decision.

entries.english_definition: A plan offered for discussion or approval.

contexts.paragraph_english: One proposal was simply to delay every bus by another ten minutes. Several passengers supported it, but the bus operators raised a practical concern. The same vehicles continued beyond the three districts to serve a small college. A later departure from the station could make those passengers late for the final class of the evening. Changing one connection could improve a journey for one group while making another journey less reliable. The question was therefore not whether additional waiting time was useful, but where and under what conditions it should be introduced.

First, the practical arrangement. Before the trial, the library closed at six on weekdays. During the trial it stayed open until eight, but only on Tuesdays and Thursdays. We did not add weekend hours. The original proposal had included Monday as well, and some early notices referred to three evenings. However, there were not enough trained staff to cover all three. Anyone using those early notices would have had the wrong information, so the final timetable was placed beside the entrance and sent to students.

At the branch valves, we will identify the two blocked returns before choosing a procedure. The sample procedure and the mechanical procedure both have a safe objective. I will work with the local crew if your travelling companions stay outside. Please read the visible hazard plan before entering. A method written in your notebook is a proposal until the actual work is carried out and its result is accepted.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 在支路阀处，我们先识别两处受阻回流，再选择程序。取样和机械程序均有安全目标。若旅行同伴留在外面，我会与地方班组协作。进入前请读可见危险计划。笔记里选了方法，仍只是提案；须实际执行，取得被接受的结果。

contexts.paragraph_english: The kitchen would welcome early leaves, while the store keeper wants a stronger later reserve. Neither request removes the other need. The group may choose either complete arrangement and record the trade-off, or ask for an agreed revision before planting. A proposal which uses more than six beds is not yet a feasible allocation.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 厨房希望早有叶菜，仓管希望增强晚期储备。两类需求同时存在。可选任一完整配置并记录取舍，也可种植前申请共识修改。超过六床的提议尚不可执行。

entries.english_definition: Formal permission or agreement to proceed.

contexts.paragraph_english: Draft contingency notice, prepared on D0 at 20:50. This copy was stored with the evening dispatch papers; its issue box is blank. The text describes a possible interruption of the harbour light and tells receiving crews to wait for a revised route message. A handwritten heading calls it an accident notice, but the heading does not identify a cause. Preparing a notice in advance may indicate planning for a risk. It does not, by itself, show that somebody intended a grounding. Preserve the draft label and the empty issue box when citing this document. The approval and execution records are held separately. Do not replace them with a conclusion drawn from the title.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: D0 20:50准备、尚未签发的应急通知。事故字样不说明原因，预先准备通知不能单独证明故意搁浅；引用时保留草稿标签及空白签发栏，另查批准与执行记录。

contexts.paragraph_english: Electrician: Exactly. The route still has to be selected from the current notices and the ferry particulars. I am confirming the equipment arrangement, not saying that every channel is suitable. Write down the route, the restrictions that ruled out the alternatives, and what the crew must do before leaving. If you are not sure what an instruction means, ask for clarification rather than treating a guess as approval.

entries.english_definition: A decision not to accept a proposal or item.

contexts.paragraph_chinese: 佩拉：请注明要确认的政策与分配，说明接受的代价及保留限制。提交前会查真实库存、接收组、负荷和值守。保存稿件保留推理，另行确认和交付才形成结果。过渡结束时，登记交班并复查低负荷。下一队应接到可用通路和诚实记录，而非条件已与设备不符的安心措辞。

contexts.paragraph_english: Before confirmation, an allocation can be revised while the packages remain in the store. contexts.paragraph_chinese: 确认前，工包仍在库内时可以修改分配。实际交付后，要保留当前位置及已做工作。改草稿不能拔回安装材料，或复制已使用工包。新安排若需要已不存在的工包，须修改方案或通过合法新来源补足。

entries.english_definition: A response showing that a message or delivery has been received.

contexts.paragraph_english: Coast pickup acknowledgement. Four people registered at the sheltered assembly point will be collected, together with the technician. contexts.paragraph_chinese: 接应回执：接走避风棚登记的四名幸存者和检修员，经北段上船，南台阶仍不可用。在棚外登记登船点等接应，前往盐雾港公共接应泊位。这只允许本次救援通行，不是一般航行许可、检修委托或巡灯船移交。带走资料并保留来源、时间标签。

contexts.paragraph_english: The historical signature page also needs its limit recorded. contexts.paragraph_english: The final recommendation retained the extra wait after the busiest train and made responsibility for the lift checks explicit. It also proposed another review during the college term, when travel patterns might differ. Some residents regarded the continued review as unnecessary caution; others welcomed the acknowledgement that a useful arrangement could still need adjustment. The case suggests that a timetable is best understood as a statement of an intended service, rather than a guarantee that every person can make every connection. Assessing that service requires attention to the journey around the scheduled departure as well as to the time printed beside it.

entries.english_definition: A statement made to inform an audience.

contexts.paragraph_english: When the town of Alder introduced a new evening bus service, the announcement promised a better connection between its railway station and three residential districts. The published timetable showed a bus leaving ten minutes after each of the main evening trains. For passengers who had previously faced a long walk or an expensive taxi journey, the arrangement appeared straightforward. Yet during the first month, complaints arrived from people who had missed their connection even though their train had reached the station on time.

Good afternoon. Today I want to explain how our college evaluated a trial of later library opening. You may have seen the announcement saying that the trial was successful. That description needs a little care. The library was used more often in the evening, but that does not answer every question about whether the change should become permanent. I will go through what changed, what we measured and what we still need to find out.

Records travel farther than their writers expect. A room code on a kitchen sheet may be harmless among people who already know the building. Add a private address, a family relationship and a public announcement, and the same account can expose someone to attention they never agreed to receive. Removing those details need not remove the events. A review can still retain an observation date, the duty of the observer, the version of a record and a route to the protected original. These fields let a reader ask whether the account has support.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 记录会传得比作者预想更远。厨房页的房间代码，在熟悉建筑的人之间可能没有什么风险。加上私人住址、亲属关系和公共通告，同一陈述却可能让人受到从未同意的关注。去掉这些细节，无需去掉事件。审查仍可保留观察日期、记录员职能、版本及通向受保护原稿的查验路径，让读者判断陈述有无支持。

entries.english_definition: A direction telling someone what to do.

contexts.paragraph_english: To the new technician, from Mara. A tidy report may leave out the circumstances that made its conclusion seem convincing. I have enclosed a request to compare the public maintenance record with an independent source. There are four survivors waiting for assistance, apart from the technician carrying this message. Keep the rescue line clear of the broken steps. Once everyone is under shelter, send your position, the number of people needing collection and the approach restriction. Do not ask the boat to follow the southern marker merely because it is easier to see. We will acknowledge the request through the coast relay.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 海岸队更正原先南台阶方案：现场复查发现下段台阶脱离支承，撤回旧指示。改用矮墙外的北段。有四名幸存者需要接应，不含传递消息的检修员。索具避开破损台阶。人员进入棚内后，发送位置、接应人数和进路限制，接应船不会因南标记显眼就改走那里。通过海岸中继确认求援。

entries.english_definition: Advice helping someone choose or perform an action.

contexts.paragraph_english: Finn authorises the present survey from the distribution desk. The declared basic protective kit, guide markers and return-line notes belong to this field commission. entries.english_definition: A defined set of procedures for communication or work.

entries.english_definition: A list of required checks used to avoid omissions.

entries.english_definition: A page used to record calculations or organise a task.

contexts.paragraph_english: M-12, the separate local transfer used in the ordering exercise, has its own reference and receiving desk. It concerns another transfer. entries.english_definition: Supporting material added at the end of a document.

contexts.paragraph_english: Issued report GH-R7, reporting version 7: the displayed appendix contains T1 stable and T4 stable. The outcome rows for T2 and T3 are absent. contexts.paragraph_english: For a restricted attachment, name the record version, the fields required, the recipient and the intended use. June acts as custodian of the room. entries.english_definition: Additional material that extends an existing account.
