Tools and fittings must arrive in a trip earlier than lighting; the panels and archives have no fixed order. Both qualified arrangements are accepted. This independent supplement is optional, earns no second parent reward and supplies neither protected base components nor enhanced transition crates. Declining it preserves the base route.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 可选PZ-Q603-LOAD共有两趟，每趟六格。整箱体积为tools三、fittings一、lighting四、wind_panels二、archives二。工具和安装件须在早于照明的一趟到达；面板与档案顺序不限。两种合格安排均接受。补充运输独立且可选，不重复发父任务奖励，不供基础组件或增强过渡箱，拒绝后基础路径仍完整。

contexts.paragraph_english: Tess: The ridge packet has only four base components. The first escort starts at the transfer shed after the actual manifest is checked. The outer escort begins through the paired route after its first segment is controlled. At the tower we control the field device, protect the present cargo and deal with the platform, then perform isolation and receipt. Pressure against the platform does not sign the receiving sheet. The optional five-box supplement is a different consignment. If it is declined, those choices must not take the basic packet or an eventual ending direction away.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 泰丝：风脊基础只有四件，中转棚核实货单后首段护送，处置首段后沿配对路进入外线。到塔先制护场器、护货、制平台，再隔离和收货。平台压强不签收货表。可选五箱另批，拒绝不能撤基础工包或后续结局方向。

contexts.paragraph_english: Refer to the original supplement receipts if the two trips were accepted and actually delivered. Record which complete boxes arrived first and why that choice suited the local plan. If no supplement was promised, record not_committed rather than inventing arrival. This node cites existing work; it does not reserve a second batch, repeat the journey or grant experience, marks or parts.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 承接且实际送达两趟补充货载后，引用原回执说明哪些整箱先到及其理由。未承诺运输时写not_committed，不虚构抵达。本节点只引用既有工作，不另留一批、不重复旅程、不发经验刻币零件。

contexts.paragraph_english: The enhanced arrangement adds a controller and two couplers to each tower, alongside three transition crates. A reusable test fixture supports its local trial. Published finite contracts describe where these components come from and what acceptance work remains. Retained laboratory apparatus and a sealed investigation sample are evidence, not unclaimed stock for this list. Likewise, the optional two-trip supplement carries its own boxes for its own receiving purpose. Taking a box from that account would break the record of both arrangements, rather than making preparation cheaper through a harmless substitution.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 增强每塔另加控制器、两联络组件和三过渡箱，并由可复用夹具支持地方测试。有限合同公开来源与验收步骤。保留的实验装置和封存调查样本是证据，不是待取库存。可选两趟补充也有自己的箱件和接收用途；挪走会破坏两份记录，不是无害省料。

entries.english_definition: To set aside a normal control by a higher-priority instruction.

contexts.paragraph_english: The local record custodian offers the rescued patrol a bounded review of OC-D18.design@1, OC-D14.revision@2, OC-D30.correction@1, VQ-D90.policy@1, VT-D7.authorization@1 and RK-D6.override@2 with RK-D3.detention@1. The fields are design_limits, correction_history, policy_authorization, execution_order and version_source. Recipient: patrol_technician. Purpose: distinguish_design_policy_execution_responsibility. Scope version: OC-responsibility-set@1. Personal addresses and unrelated case identities stay sealed. A protected review or an emergency public review can use the same redacted evidence and give each affected party a recorded opportunity to dispute a cited claim. Presence in this hall does not itself grant the scope.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 当地保管人向获救后的巡灯人提供限定审阅：OC-D18.design@1、OC-D14.revision@2、OC-D30.correction@1、VQ-D90.policy@1、VT-D7.authorization@1、RK-D6.override@2、RK-D3.detention@1。字段为 design_limits、correction_history、policy_authorization、execution_order、version_source；接收人 patrol_technician，用途 distinguish_design_policy_execution_responsibility，版本 OC-responsibility-set@1。住址和无关身份封存。受保护或紧急公开审查都使用脱敏证据，给各方记录反证机会；进入厅不等于获得范围。

contexts.paragraph_english: Station channel: The orders were issued as emergency protection. Custodian: You may contest a reading of the order. Please identify the version and the field you dispute. The station register records detention being carried out, and the override removes independent review during the test window. The present rescue is separately recorded. Station channel: I do not have an instruction to accept a transfer of command. Ada: Then record that reply without pretending it answers every claim. We have to make the local facility safe, and people must be able to leave this review without losing lawful evidence.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 北站渠道：这些令以应急保护签发。保管人：可反驳解释，请指版本字段。北站登记记录扣押实施，取消令撤测试窗口独立复核，当前救援另记。渠道：我没有接受指挥权移交的指示。阿妲：记录回覆，别假装它回答所有主张；设施须安全，退出审查不应丧合法证据。

contexts.paragraph_english: RK-D6.override@2 is Rook’s execution order cancelling the independent review and suppressing the attached warning during the authorised test window. RK-D3.detention@1 authorises the expanded detention operation under an investigation-protection description. Compare these commands with the permitted test scope; cancelling review and expanding detention are distinct executive acts. Voss’s authorisation does not make every subsequent order hers, and Rook’s conduct does not absorb the earlier policy responsibility. The station custody register is an independent local record of the detention being carried out, not a second copy of the command. Today’s rescue gives direct evidence of Mara’s current condition without changing the original order dates.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: RK-D6.override@2 是鲁克取消测试窗口独立复核、压下警告的执行令；RK-D3.detention@1 以调查保护描述扩大扣押。须比对授权测试范围，取消复核与扩大扣押是另行执行行为。沃斯授权不让每份后续令都由她承担；鲁克行为也不吸收先前政策责任。北站扣押登记是当地执行独立记录，不是命令副本。今日救援直接核验导师现状，不改旧令日期。

entries.english_definition: To use one item or method in place of another.

contexts.paragraph_english: Tidegate maintenance procedure. The tower unit is separate from the west workshop machine and from the civil ferry supply. Confirm the local supply indication at the tower base before entering the control level. During the encounter, the left cooling valve is worked from the left front position and the right valve from the right front position. Either valve may be closed first. Local supply isolation is operated from the left rear position after both valves are closed. The interlock refuses an early isolation request without spending its operating allowance. Each person may operate one work point in a personal turn. Reducing the unit to its last reserve of stopping progress does not establish safety: both valves, isolation and a controlled threat are all required. Ordinary shields and cleansing cannot substitute for this sequence.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 潮门塔机械独立于工坊及民用渡轮。进控制层前在塔基查本地供给。左前左阀、右前右阀，次序不限；左后隔离需双阀完成，每人每个人回合最多一个现场操作。打至最低制止进度不等于安全，仍需两阀、隔离和制止。

contexts.paragraph_english: The controlled passage accepts the patrol technician named in the current Glasshaven regional commission. Check the commission basis Q-404:resolution, its destination R5 and its purpose verify_north_station_and_legal_access against the actual landing register. Check the physical passage separately: the signed inspection identifies CHECKPOINT-DUTY-PASSAGE and explicitly excludes HIST-CENTRAL-SPAN. The checkpoint officer may verify these fields without granting detention-room access. If checking cannot be completed, use the basic service route. A copied historical credential or an unrelated action receipt cannot substitute for this current local check.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 核查通道接受当前学城跨区委托中的巡灯检修人。比对 Q-404:resolution、R5、verify_north_station_and_legal_access 与实际登陆登记；另检查实体通道，明确 CHECKPOINT-DUTY-PASSAGE 不含 HIST-CENTRAL-SPAN。核查员可验证这些字段，却不授扣押室权限。暂不能完成核查时有基础隧道解法。历史证件副本和无关动作回执不能代替当次检查。

contexts.paragraph_english: Until both points are confirmed closed, force can reduce resistance but cannot bypass the remaining command chain. The combined attack announces its participants and targets. Controlling a named guard removes only that guard's announced contribution. A stability break on Rook weakens his next attack and cancels the current interruptible combination; it does not remove a complete boss stage or trigger an unannounced substitute attack.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 两点未共同确认关闭前，打击可降抵抗，不能跳过残余指挥链。合击公布参与者和目标，制止某护卫仅移除其已声明部分。鲁克失衡减弱下次攻击并取消当前可中断合击，没有删除整段首领阶段，也不触发未公布替补攻击。

entries.english_definition: A change made to an existing item or arrangement.

contexts.paragraph_english: The local inspection assignment permits this batch comparison. It does not permit the release of unrelated household details or the alteration of priory records. If the original instrument remains temporarily inaccessible, the retained copy can guide preparation, while the final finding keeps the missing inspection explicit.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本地查验委托允许这项批次比较，没有许可发布无关住户细节或改写修院记录。原仪表暂时无法到达时，可用副本准备工作；最终结论仍明确缺少哪项现场查验。

entries.english_definition: A difference from the specified route, value, or procedure.

contexts.paragraph_english: Bridge observation copy — times use the same ship clock. 21:14:10: the tower light disappeared from view while the heading indicator still showed the assigned course. 21:16:00: the helmsman reported a course deviation. 21:17:40: contact with the reef was felt. The entries describe what the crew observed; they do not identify a switch operator or establish the reason for the loss of light. The ship clock has not yet been compared with a shore instrument. Preserve this copy and compare it with an independent record when the rescue work allows it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 桥台抄记使用同一船钟。21:14:10，塔灯消失，当时航向指示仍显示规定航向。21:16:00，舵手报告偏航。21:17:40，船体触礁。记录只说明船员观察到的先后，不识别开关操作者，也不证明熄灯原因。船钟尚未与岸上仪器核对；先保留副本，完成救援后再找独立记录。

contexts.paragraph_english: Coast recorder extract. Instrument clock: 21:14:12, light signal lost at the observed tower channel. Further gaps occur in the same recording window, but the extract does not contain a complete network diagnosis. The shore clock and ship clock differ by approximately two seconds in their last routine comparison. Taken with the ship observation copy, this extract supports the order of light loss followed by course deviation. It does not name the person responsible, explain why every gap occurred or establish that the outage was deliberate. Keep the original time labels attached when making a later comparison.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 海岸记录器摘录：仪器钟21:14:12，所观测塔台信号消失；同一窗口还有其他缺口，摘录并非完整网络诊断。最近一次常规比对中，岸钟与船钟相差约两秒。结合船上抄记，资料支持先熄灯后偏航，不识别责任人，不解释每个缺口，也不证明故意断供。后续比对保留原始时间标签。

entries.english_definition: A case allowed to depart from a general rule.

contexts.paragraph_english: Limited maintenance exception. Havel, the dispatch officer, may commission inspection and repair of the civil ferry's navigation equipment and the local workshop arrangements needed to obtain its replacement parts. State that the purpose is evacuation assistance and identify those work areas in the request. Harbour main-generator operation is outside this exception: its safety isolation has not been confirmed. A commission allows local preparation; the ferry remains at the quay until a tested current configuration and an explicitly confirmed departure plan are available. Neither a fee nor a language score is required to request the commission. Crew recruitment, patrol-boat use and access to retained accident records are separate decisions and must not be inferred from this document.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 有限检修例外：调度负责人哈文可委托民用渡轮导航设备检修及为取替换件所需的本地工坊操作。申请写明协助撤离及这些范围。主发电机安全隔离尚未确认，操作它不在例外内。委托只允许准备；当前配置测试与明确离港方案确认完成前，渡轮留港。申请不需费用或英语分数；招募、巡灯船及事故记录调阅均另行授权。

contexts.paragraph_english: Restricted central coordination retains cross-region balancing and much of the existing transport capacity. It can help a weaker district through a difficult period without requiring immediate full conversion. It must retain a checked limit, disable unlimited renewal and identify continuing supervision. Some services will still be rationed, and the old equipment requires maintenance. Concentrated authority remains a practical risk. A new person at the desk does not by itself prevent the next temporary exception from becoming permanent.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 受限中央协调保留跨区调峰及较多现有运输能力，可使较弱地区渡过困难，不要求立刻全转换。须保受检上限、禁无限续启并明确持续监督。仍需轮流限供，旧设备也需维护，集权仍有现实风险。换一位值守，不能自行阻止下次临时例外变永久。

entries.english_definition: An arrangement for a possible future difficulty.

contexts.paragraph_english: Draft contingency notice, prepared on D0 at 20:50. This copy was stored with the evening dispatch papers; its issue box is blank. The text describes a possible interruption of the harbour light and tells receiving crews to wait for a revised route message. A handwritten heading calls it an accident notice, but the heading does not identify a cause. Preparing a notice in advance may indicate planning for a risk. It does not, by itself, show that somebody intended a grounding. Preserve the draft label and the empty issue box when citing this document. The approval and execution records are held separately. Do not replace them with a conclusion drawn from the title.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: D0 20:50准备、尚未签发的应急通知。事故字样不说明原因，预先准备通知不能单独证明故意搁浅；引用时保留草稿标签及空白签发栏，另查批准与执行记录。

entries.english_definition: An alternative used when the preferred option cannot work.

contexts.paragraph_english: This protected base packet contains one R6 isolator, one local backup and two base provisions. Finn coordinates its local cart; the two declared escort posts are ROLE-R6-CART-DRIVER and ROLE-R6-CARGO-WATCH. Tess may assist as a guide but recruitment is unnecessary. Confirm the actual packet, destination R6-S07, current segment and fallback previous_safe_segment. Packets from optional two-trip transport and enhanced transition crates remain in separate accounts. The cart does not move while a document is open.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 受保护基础工包含R6隔离套一、当地备用组一、基础保全包二。芬协调地方货车，两个护送岗位为ROLE-R6-CART-DRIVER、ROLE-R6-CARGO-WATCH。泰丝可作为向导帮助，招募并非必要。确认实物、R6-S07目的地、本段与previous_safe_segment备用方案。可选两趟货载和增强过渡箱分别记账；打开文献时货车不走。

contexts.paragraph_english: Your short final instruction should identify the chosen prepared direction and acknowledge its operating boundary. You may write freely and then explicitly confirm the action that the system proposes. A structured fallback is available when language interpretation is uncertain or unavailable. It records a deliberate choice while leaving the writing assessment pending. Word count, subtitles, translation, hints, companions, combat difficulty and political vocabulary do not add or remove a technical qualification.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 最后短指令须明确准备好的方向及运行边界。可自由写后逐项确认系统呈现的动作，语言解释不确定或不可用时有结构化后备。它记录明确选择，写作评价仍待审。字数、字幕、翻译、提示、同伴、战斗难度或政治用词都不会增减技术资格。

entries.english_definition: A break in an activity before it is finished.

contexts.paragraph_english: Draft contingency notice, prepared on D0 at 20:50. This copy was stored with the evening dispatch papers; its issue box is blank. contexts.paragraph_chinese: D0 20:50准备、尚未签发的应急通知。事故字样不说明原因，预先准备通知不能单独证明故意搁浅；引用时保留草稿标签及空白签发栏，另查批准与执行记录。

contexts.paragraph_english: Voss: My policy kept the high quota after the long-term warning entered internal discussion. The circulation limit was also my decision. I considered immediate interruption more dangerous than the risk of continuing, but the patrol has shown why that comparison was not enough to close review. I authorised the branch test. The executive cancellation of review was a distinct act, and the distinction should remain in the record. Custodian: We will keep both levels. Separating an executive order does not remove your responsibility for authorisation, known risk or suppression of unfavourable information.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 沃斯：长期警报进入内部讨论后，我仍保高配额，限制传播也是我的决定。我认为即刻中断更危险，巡灯人证明该比较不足以取消复核。我授权支路测试，但执行层取消复核是另一行为，记录应分开。保管人：两层均保留，分开执行令不除授权、已知风险、压制不利信息责任。

contexts.paragraph_english: Controlled copy of the interruption schedule. Approval was entered on D-1 at 18:00. The specified window begins at 21:14 on D0 and lasts only for the locally declared interval. The schedule requires a second check of traffic still within the affected approach before the output is interrupted. A completion box records whether that check was carried out; it is not a decorative signature. This schedule establishes that an interruption had been planned before the accident. It does not establish which later instruction was followed. Compare the actual control log, the duty handover and the independent instrument record. Keep the scheduled window distinct from the time at which the coast instrument first recorded a missing signal.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: D-1 18:00批准，D0 21:14开始的局部断供测试计划，要求断供前第二次检查受影响进场区的人船。计划证明动作预定，不独自证明后来实际执行何种指令。

contexts.paragraph_english: Evening duty handover, retained copy. At 21:05 on D0, a later work instruction removed the second traffic check from this test. The receiving operator recorded the change rather than marking the check as completed. A routine comparison at 20:40 placed the control clock within one second of the ship clock. The local control event copy lists the output interruption at 21:14:10, on the control clock. The instruction identifier and its issuing office are retained for further examination. This copy is not sufficient to establish what every officer knew or intended. The output event and the removed check should be recorded as separate findings: one concerns what the equipment did, the other concerns which protection was omitted. The independent coast clock was not set from this control clock.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: D0 21:05的后续工作指令移除了第二次人船复核，接班者没有把它标作已做。控制钟记录21:14:10断供；签发标识保留待后续核验，不能据此判定所有人员的知情与意图。 20:40常规比对记控制钟与船钟相差不超过一秒。

entries.english_definition: A period when a supply or service is unavailable.

contexts.paragraph_english: Coast recorder extract. Instrument clock: 21:14:12, light signal lost at the observed tower channel. Further gaps occur in the same recording window, but the extract does not contain a complete network diagnosis. The shore clock and ship clock differ by approximately two seconds in their last routine comparison. Taken with the ship observation copy, this extract supports the order of light loss followed by course deviation. It does not name the person responsible, explain why every gap occurred or establish that the outage was deliberate. Keep the original time labels attached when making a later comparison.

entries.english_definition: A loss of light or electrical supply in an area.

contexts.paragraph_english: Transfer TR-D1-7, version 1. Controlled extract from the receiving officer's custody handover record. The record is dated D−1 relative to the opening blackout. It identifies Mara Venn by the protected identification reference checked at the archive desk. The receiving officer recorded her as alive when custody was handed over. The destination is written as facility code F-17. No public site name or current address is supplied on this extract.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 转移TR-D1-7，第1版。接收员看管交接原稿的受控摘录，日期为开场熄灯前一天D−1。摘录用阅览台核对过的受保护身份索引识别玛拉·维恩。接收员记下她在看管交接时仍然活着。目的地写作设施代码F-17，本摘录没有公开地点名称或现行地址。

entries.english_definition: The controlled stopping of equipment or a system.

contexts.paragraph_english: Extraction and disturbance rose together in this short record. Pump operation, nearby machines and sampling conditions also need checking. The sheet provides a traceable question for the academic review: which factors can explain the pattern, and under what conditions could it be reproduced? It cannot by itself show that mining created the mist, that every district has the same response, or that a shutdown will clear the weather immediately.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 这份短记录里，抽取与扰动同时上升。泵房运作、附近机械和采样条件也需核查。资料为学城提出可追查问题：哪些因素能够解释此模式，怎样的条件下可以复现？仅凭它尚不能说明开采创造了雾海、每个地区反应相同，或停机会立即放晴。

contexts.paragraph_english: Pera: I am willing to discuss that new work, but it must have an end we can inspect. Naming a repairer is not enough. Tell us which device is included, where its supplies come from and who can repeat the check. The household auxiliary alarm may be a suitable separate job. It is not the flooded pump room again. I also want the town's wage cover and meals recorded before extra packages are allocated. A person asked to bear the cost of a shutdown needs to know what is actually waiting at the receiving desk.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 佩拉：我愿意谈新工作，但它要有可检查的终点。仅列维修人不足，还应说明设备、物资来源与复查者。住区辅助警报器可以成为另一项工作，不是再次把泵房注满。额外分配前，也要记清矿镇工资保障与暖食。被要求承担停产代价的人，需要知道接收台究竟准备了什么。

entries.english_definition: Beginning operation again after a stop.

contexts.paragraph_english: The local devices are different objects. A corridor release is not the command relay at the takeover floor. A shaft isolation is not the central machine's restart bypass. Follow the labels and keep the completed result of each operation. Retracing a safe route does not collect another reward or refill the same battle attempt.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 这些是不同实体。走廊放行不是接管层指挥转接，竖井隔离也不是机组续启旁路。请按标牌保存每个操作结果。回走安全路线不会再发奖励，也不会回满同一战斗尝试。

contexts.paragraph_english: Rook: A warning is not a cancellation instruction. The maintained loop has its own fixed clauses and physical inertia. You will need the restart log and the local control instructions. If you choose the formal corridor or the shaft, this condition is the same. Receiving officer: We will keep that attributed statement with the independent indicator record. Neither speaker supplies all missing facts simply by appearing in this exchange.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 鲁克：警告不是取消指令，维护循环有固化条款及硬件惯性。你还需续启日志与本地操作说明。无论经正式走廊或竖井，这条件相同。接收值守：此说法注明发言者，与独立指示记录并存。两位说话者都不会仅因参与对话而提供全部缺失事实。

contexts.paragraph_english: Until ready, the machine retains at least one unit of resistance. If one remains when controlled stop is approved, that operation can safely conclude the encounter; do not strike the facility merely to satisfy an empty attack requirement. A safe-stop receipt states that automatic restart is disabled and the dangerous programme is stable. It leaves the policy decision to the dispatch desk.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 未就绪时机组至少留1抵抗。批准时若仅剩1，该操作即可安全收束，不要为满足空攻击要求打设施。安全停止回执说明自动续启禁用、危险程序稳定，政策方向留给调度台。

entries.english_definition: Restoring a link that was previously disconnected.

contexts.paragraph_english: The survey instrument has a labelled zero channel Z and reference channel R. Check Z at 0 and R at 10 after isolating the local drive; these are instrument marks, not the load units used in other districts. Control the station defence, then verify the readings at the present revision. A reconnection or configuration change expires the check. The report concerns current overload risk and bounded essential supply in this survey window. It does not predict an exact storm hour or prove that all fog was created by the towers.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 测站仪表有零点Z通道和参考R通道。隔离本地驱动后，核对Z为0、R为10；这些是仪表标记，不与其他地区负荷单位通兑。处置测站防卫后按当前版本核验读数。连接或配置变动会使旧检查过期。报告说明本窗口的过载风险和受限基本供给，不预测准确风暴钟点，也不证明所有雾来自灯塔。

contexts.paragraph_english: Service record: A stop request by itself did not prevent reconnection. We marked the left and right forced-link branches, the finite renewal components and the damping check as separate objects. First isolate both forced-link branches and verify the current configuration. Either branch may be isolated first. Before verification, force against the main resistance meter has no effect. Do not interpret this as an instruction to attack a different, unlabelled facility.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 检修记录：单独停止请求没有阻止重连。我们分别标明左右强制联络支路、有限续启组件与阻尼检查。先隔离两支路并核当前配置，左右先后可换。核验前对主抵抗计量施力无效，不能据此攻击另一未标设施。

entries.english_definition: Returning to usable condition after a failure or loss.

contexts.paragraph_english: All three internal phases share this attempt's life, focus, action points, carried supplies, aid allotment, cooldowns, relic uses and placed devices. A phase transition replenishes none of them. Reading, writing, translation, clarification and actual audio playback pause the plan slots, without providing recovery or executing a queued click on return. Withdrawing retries the whole declared encounter entry, not a free refill between phases.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 三内部阶段共用本次生命、专注、AP、携带补给、配发、冷却、遗物次数和放置装置。切段没有补满。阅读、写作、翻译、澄清与实际播放音轨暂停计划槽，不提供恢复，也不在返回时补执行排队点击。撤退重试整个声明入口，没有内部阶段免费回满。

contexts.paragraph_english: The mist was present before the present overload. Reducing extraction and preventing dangerous forced renewal will not clear the sea at once or remove accumulated damage. Six months is a limited follow-up window, with different benefits, costs and continuing duties under each decision. The result can show whether people have kept records, supplied a shift and managed a fault. It cannot certify permanent recovery or a learner's English ability simply because the final command has been executed.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 雾原在本轮超载前已存在。降抽取、防危险强制续启，不会立刻清雾或消除累积损伤。六个月是有限跟进窗，各方向所得、代价及持续岗位不同。结果可显示人们是否保记录、供班次、管故障，不能因最后命令执行便认证永久恢复或学习者英语能力。

entries.english_definition: Work that returns an earlier function or condition.

contexts.paragraph_english: Residents disagree about how names should return. Some want the earlier street names restored because those names connect public space to the lives omitted from the current register. Others have used new names for years and would find a complete restoration confusing. Ada argues that neither view should be dismissed as a failure to remember. The community has not collectively lost its past. It has lived through change. A small sign workshop can compare proposals and identify who will maintain a chosen sign, but it cannot settle every property claim or speak for all six regions.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 居民对恢复名称有分歧。有人希望恢复旧名，把公共空间连回现行名录遗漏的生活；有人多年使用新名，全面恢复反而混乱。阿妲认为两者都不是记忆失败。社区没有集体遗忘，而是经历变化。小路牌工坊可比较提案和维护人，却不解决所有产权，也不代表六地区。

entries.english_definition: The ability to remain within acceptable operating limits.

contexts.paragraph_english: Until both points are confirmed closed, force can reduce resistance but cannot bypass the remaining command chain. The combined attack announces its participants and targets. Controlling a named guard removes only that guard's announced contribution. A stability break on Rook weakens his next attack and cancels the current interruptible combination; it does not remove a complete boss stage or trigger an unannounced substitute attack.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 两点未共同确认关闭前，打击可降抵抗，不能跳过残余指挥链。合击公布参与者和目标，制止某护卫仅移除其已声明部分。鲁克失衡减弱下次攻击并取消当前可中断合击，没有删除整段首领阶段，也不触发未公布替补攻击。

entries.english_definition: Demand greater than the system can safely handle.

contexts.paragraph_english: The survey instrument has a labelled zero channel Z and reference channel R. Check Z at 0 and R at 10 after isolating the local drive; these are instrument marks, not the load units used in other districts. Control the station defence, then verify the readings at the present revision. A reconnection or configuration change expires the check. The report concerns current overload risk and bounded essential supply in this survey window. It does not predict an exact storm hour or prove that all fog was created by the towers.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 测站仪表有零点Z通道和参考R通道。隔离本地驱动后，核对Z为0、R为10；这些是仪表标记，不与其他地区负荷单位通兑。处置测站防卫后按当前版本核验读数。连接或配置变动会使旧检查过期。报告说明本窗口的过载风险和受限基本供给，不预测准确风暴钟点，也不证明所有雾来自灯塔。

contexts.paragraph_english: Finn: We have the old city's handover, including the direct confirmation of Mara's rescue. Keep that with the earlier responsibility findings. Today's station visit has a narrower job: find out what the present overload is doing to essential service and whether our return route can remain usable. I do not want a report that promises to explain every fog bank. If you use an earlier observation, identify its place and instrument. Similar-looking trouble in two places is a reason to compare the records carefully, rather than a reason to replace one record with the other.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 芬：旧都交接已到，包括玛拉获救直接确认，与早前责任核查一起保留。今天任务更窄：查看当前过载对基本服务的影响和返程能否保留，不要承诺解释所有雾。引用旧观察要写地点仪表；两地问题相似是认真比较的理由，不是互换记录的理由。

contexts.paragraph_english: A current overload can amplify the network's difficulty in keeping essential circuits stable. This is a useful risk statement, but it has a limited object. The survey does not establish that the towers created every fog bank, nor does it predict the hour of a storm. Conditions beyond the tested local apparatus remain open to further investigation. The notice should name that boundary plainly, so a receiving crew can act on the observed danger without mistaking the notice for a complete explanation of the region's weather or the entire network's history.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 当前过载可能放大全网保持基本回路稳定的困难。这是有用但有限的风险判断，不能证明灯塔制造每片雾，也不预测风暴钟点。受检装置以外的条件仍待查。通知应明确边界，让接收班处理观察到的危险，而不会把它当作天气或网络历史的完整解释。

contexts.paragraph_english: Finn: A useful notice names the current risk, the supply we must protect and the boundary of the survey. We can say that current overload amplifies the network's difficulty without claiming that every cause is established. We can restrict unverified additional load without removing a settlement's essential protection. Tell the receiving crew which working stage your observations belong to. Do not introduce a countdown while someone reads the report. The world work changes through declared actions and new observations, not through the number of minutes a person spends considering an English paragraph.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 芬：有效通知写当前风险、必须保护的供给和调查边界。可说过载放大网络困难，不声称全因果成立；可限制未经核验新增负荷，不撤聚落基本保护。写观察的工作阶段，不在阅读时倒数。世界工作通过行动和新观察变化，不通过思考英语段落的现实分钟变化。

entries.english_definition: A sudden rise in a flow or load.

contexts.paragraph_english: Two markers are visible from the reef path. The southern marker stands near the broken steps. It identifies the old landing place but does not confirm that the steps remain usable after a surge. The northern reach is beyond the low stone wall. Its approach is narrow, so a rescue boat must wait for a clear signal rather than following the first moving light it sees. The winch line can guide people towards either marker. Choose the receiving direction before loading the line, and repeat the tension check whenever that direction changes. A raised hand lamp may help people find the path; it does not replace the line or repair the steps.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 礁岸可见两个标记。南标记位于破损台阶旁，标出旧接应点，并不保证浪涌后台阶仍能用。北段在矮石墙外，入口狭窄，救援船应等明确接应信号。绞盘索可朝两边接应；承载前须选方向，改向后须重新检查张力。手灯帮助辨路，不替代救援索，也不修复台阶。

entries.english_definition: An event that disrupts normal operation.

contexts.paragraph_english: The local observation sheet records three successive work stages. At stages A, B and C, the extraction settings were 1, 2 and 3 load units. The associated disturbance readings were 4, 7 and 9 on the same local indicator. The indicator's numbers are relative readings for comparison, not a medical scale or a complete measurement of the mist sea. The instrument and its setting must be recorded with the sample.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 地方观察页记录三个连续工作阶段。A、B、C阶段抽取设置分别为1、2、3负荷单位，同一本地指示器的扰动读数为4、7、9。数值是用于比较的相对读数，并非医疗尺度或对整个雾海的完整测量。样本须附仪器与设置。

contexts.paragraph_english: Custodian: The four-batch table can help us present the records, as long as we state its denominator. Each batch has six listed checks. The incomplete counts are zero, two, one and zero; the official accepted counts are six, six, five and six. Those are two different measures of the same twenty-four entries. The table makes MC-2 worth examining closely. It does not tell us the history of every machine, or prove that every observed disturbance came from the same cause. The original fields are still needed for the particular finding.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 保管人：四批表可以帮助呈现记录，前提是保留分母。每批六项，未完成数为零、二、一、零；正式合格数为六、六、五、六。两列衡量同一组二十四项的不同方面。表格提示细查MC-2，但没有叙述全部机器历史，也未证明所有扰动来自同一原因。具体结论仍需要原字段。

contexts.paragraph_english: Extraction and disturbance rose together in this short record. Pump operation, nearby machines and sampling conditions also need checking. The sheet provides a traceable question for the academic review: which factors can explain the pattern, and under what conditions could it be reproduced? It cannot by itself show that mining created the mist, that every district has the same response, or that a shutdown will clear the weather immediately.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 这份短记录里，抽取与扰动同时上升。泵房运作、附近机械和采样条件也需核查。资料为学城提出可追查问题：哪些因素能够解释此模式，怎样的条件下可以复现？仅凭它尚不能说明开采创造了雾海、每个地区反应相同，或停机会立即放晴。

contexts.paragraph_english: The mine comparison has a useful, limited end. It can establish that an unrestored safety bypass was accepted as completed work and connect that decision to a verified signature. It can also preserve the observed changes in extraction and disturbance for further testing. The academic review will need to examine settings, instruments and other possible explanations before making a broader technical claim. Carrying forward those open questions does not weaken the local finding. It gives the next team a clear account of what is supported, what has changed and what still needs evidence.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 矿区比较具有有限而有用的终点：它能核实未修好的安全旁路曾按完成验收，并把决定与已核验签章联系起来，也能保留抽取和扰动变化供进一步试验。学城须查设置、仪表与其他解释，再形成广泛技术主张。带着未解决问题继续调查，不会削弱地方结论，而会让下一队知道哪些有依据、哪些改变了、哪些仍缺证据。

entries.english_definition: An action taken to change or stabilise a situation.

contexts.paragraph_english: This landing receives the vessel and the preparation sealed before departure. Match the vessel instance, checkpoint reference and current assignment to the actual arrival receipt. The receiving work concerns entry to the seventh tower and a bounded intervention in its dangerous programme. It does not select a permanent policy. Keep the six districts' preparation records attached; a local officer cannot replace a district's operator or representative signature.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 此登陆台接收船与出发前封存的准备。请按实际抵达回执核对船实例、检查点与当前任务。本次接收涉及进入第七塔及对危险程序的有限处置，没有选定永久政策。六地准备记录随附，本地值守不能替代某地区操作方或代表的签字。

contexts.paragraph_english: Duty officer: Before we release the corridor, please identify the vessel and the scope of this visit. I can receive the temporary intervention authorisation and its actual preparation references. I cannot sign for all six districts or choose what they should operate after the dangerous programme is stopped. The corridor release covers this passage only. It is not an instruction to disconnect the city's rescue communication.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 值守：放开走廊前，请确认船和本次范围。我可接收临时处置授权及实际准备索引，不能代六地签字，也不能决定停止危险程序后的运行安排。走廊放行仅覆盖这条通道，不是断开城市救援通信的命令。

contexts.paragraph_english: The formal passage and maintenance shaft meet at the takeover floor. A recognised temporary authorisation can change how you reach it, but it cannot settle the machine's operating condition. If a formal handover is unavailable, inspect the basic maintenance path. Access must not depend on expressing support for a faction, an English grade, or having recruited a particular companion. External travel remains suspended during this intervention.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 正式通道和检修竖井在接管层汇合。获认可的临时授权可改变进入方法，不能裁定机器状态。正式交接暂不可用时，请查基础检修路径。进入不能取决于阵营立场、英语分数或某位同伴是否招募。本次处置期间暂停外区旅行。

contexts.paragraph_english: Route F leads through the duty desk and formal corridor. The desk first checks the intervention's actual authorisation; the corridor stop must then be released at its own terminal. Route M uses the maintenance shaft, its installed handle and a checked return path. A coil sentry still controls the lower approach. Neither route leads straight to the dispatch console.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: F路经值守台与正式走廊，值守先核实际处置授权，走廊阻拦再由本地终端解除。M路经检修竖井、固定手柄与已查返程，下段仍有线圈哨卫。两路均不能直达调度台。

entries.english_definition: An action reducing or preventing an effect.

contexts.paragraph_english: VQ-D90.policy@1 records Voss retaining high quotas about ninety days before D0 after the long-term risk had entered internal discussion. The circulation instruction restricted unfavourable findings. VT-D7.authorization@1 records the authorised branch supply test between D-7 and D-4. These are her policy and authorisation decisions; the claimed need to avoid immediate loss of supply explains her argument but does not remove the known-risk or information-suppression responsibility. The retained report and issued report share an underlying research source, while the policy instruction is a separate decision record. Support for limited central cooperation does not require declaring these decisions harmless.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: VQ-D90.policy@1 记载沃斯在长期风险已进入内部讨论后，于 D0 前约九十天保留高配额，传播令限制不利结果。VT-D7.authorization@1 记载 D-7 至 D-4 支路断供测试授权。这是她的政策和授权决定；避免近期失供可解释其论辩，不取消已知风险与信息压制责任。保留稿及发行稿研究同源，政策指示是另一决定记录。支持中央受限合作不要求认定这些决定无害。

contexts.paragraph_english: Voss: My policy kept the high quota after the long-term warning entered internal discussion. The circulation limit was also my decision. I considered immediate interruption more dangerous than the risk of continuing, but the patrol has shown why that comparison was not enough to close review. I authorised the branch test. The executive cancellation of review was a distinct act, and the distinction should remain in the record. Custodian: We will keep both levels. Separating an executive order does not remove your responsibility for authorisation, known risk or suppression of unfavourable information.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 沃斯：长期警报进入内部讨论后，我仍保高配额，限制传播也是我的决定。我认为即刻中断更危险，巡灯人证明该比较不足以取消复核。我授权支路测试，但执行层取消复核是另一行为，记录应分开。保管人：两层均保留，分开执行令不除授权、已知风险、压制不利信息责任。

contexts.paragraph_english: The practical outcome is not a declaration that cooperation was always wrong or that technical expertise should be discarded. It is a more exact basis for the next arrangement. Mara retains responsibility for design weakness and delayed correction. Voss retains responsibility for known-risk policy, test authorisation and information suppression. Rook retains responsibility for cancelled review, detention and refusal to transfer control. These can all be true at once. Preserving that distinction allows supervised technical help without restoring exclusive authority, and permits a future policy choice without rewriting the past to make the preferred choice look innocent.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 结果不是宣布合作从来错误或丢弃技术知识，而是为下一安排提供精确依据：玛拉设计不足及迟延纠正；沃斯已知风险政策、测试授权、压制信息；鲁克取消复核、扣押及拒移交。这些可同时成立。分开它们，可用受监督技术帮助却不恢复独占，也可选择未来政策而不改写历史替偏好脱责。

contexts.paragraph_english: Custodian: We will not count silence as proof. The three opportunities to respond are now recorded, with the answers and their limits attached. The summary will retain Mara’s design and delayed-correction responsibility, Voss’s policy, testing and suppression responsibility, and Rook’s review cancellation and detention responsibility. The transfer question is a next-stage action, not an event that has already happened because we discussed it. The originals will remain available under the temporary custody arrangement. A redacted summary can travel onward, but its readers must still know which claims rest on independent records and which reproduce the same source.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 保管人：沉默不计证明。三方反证机会及回应限制已记录；摘要保留玛拉设计与迟延纠正、沃斯政策测试压制、鲁克取消复核扣押责任。移交是下一阶段动作，不因讨论便发生。原件留临时保管，脱敏摘要可继续送，但读者须知道哪些独立、哪些同源复制。

entries.english_definition: Measures that reduce a specified danger or harm.

contexts.paragraph_english: Evening duty handover, retained copy. At 21:05 on D0, a later work instruction removed the second traffic check from this test. The receiving operator recorded the change rather than marking the check as completed. A routine comparison at 20:40 placed the control clock within one second of the ship clock. The local control event copy lists the output interruption at 21:14:10, on the control clock. The instruction identifier and its issuing office are retained for further examination. This copy is not sufficient to establish what every officer knew or intended. The output event and the removed check should be recorded as separate findings: one concerns what the equipment did, the other concerns which protection was omitted. The independent coast clock was not set from this control clock.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: D0 21:05的后续工作指令移除了第二次人船复核，接班者没有把它标作已做。控制钟记录21:14:10断供；签发标识保留待后续核验，不能据此判定所有人员的知情与意图。 20:40常规比对记控制钟与船钟相差不超过一秒。

contexts.paragraph_english: Pera: The delivery is the point at which the packages move from the store to the named work. Before that, a draft may be revised while the stock remains. Afterwards we must retain the real destination and whatever has already been used. A new paragraph cannot return installed material. The town's emergency wage voucher is also separate from the travelling commission's reward. I will not ask someone to fund the agreed basic protection from personal upgrade parts, and I will not describe the six-tower cargo as if it were already in this store.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 佩拉：交付使工包从库内转到具名工作。此前，库存仍在时可以改草稿；此后须保留真实去向及已用材料，新段落不能返还已安装物资。矿镇应急工资凭据也与出行委托奖励分开。我不会要求用个人改件零件填已约定基本保障，也不会把六塔货物说成已在本库。

contexts.paragraph_english: Comparison envelope for the coast recorder collected after the shore rescue. The original instrument label reports loss of the observed light signal at 21:14:12. Its last routine comparison with the ship clock had an uncertainty of approximately two seconds. The harbour control event is labelled 21:14:10 on a different clock. The handover copy reports a separate control-to-ship comparison within one second. The combined comparisons therefore allow a three-second interval between the two labelled clocks. These readings are consistent within that recorded interval; they are not evidence that every clock displayed an identical second. Together with the approved window and the duty handover, the records support a planned interruption with a required protection removed. Keep the original extract attached. Nothing in this envelope certifies the sender of the inspection mail as currently alive, safe or present at a particular destination.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 救援后实际取得的海岸记录器副本保留原标21:14:12，与船钟最近比对约有两秒不确定。控制钟21:14:10与其在已记不确定范围内相符，不是所有钟秒数完全一致；不证明导师当前存活、安全或去向。 值班记录另证控制钟与船钟相差一秒以内；合并两次比对界限允许两仪器标签有三秒差。

contexts.paragraph_english: There is also a danger in using protection as a reason to keep every difficult fact out of reach. If an official label prevents food from reaching people who are here, a polite assurance that the files are private does not correct the problem. Someone must be able to check the classification and the evidence that challenges it. A custodian therefore has two kinds of work: keep unnecessary personal details within their agreed scope, and maintain a usable route for examining public decisions. The two duties require different records and sometimes different recipients.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 以保护为由封闭所有难以面对的事实，也有危险。官方标签若使在此生活的人收不到食物，礼貌地说“档案私密”不能纠正问题。必须有人能检查分类及与之冲突的证据。保管人的工作包含两项：将不必要私人细节留在约定范围内，也为公共决定保留可用的检查途径。两项职责需要不同记录，有时需要不同接收方。

entries.english_definition: Moving people away from danger to a safe place.

contexts.paragraph_english: Harbour closure order — current copy. General departures are suspended while the navigation restrictions are reviewed. Rescue arrivals continue at the public receiving berth. An arrival under that provision does not grant a vessel permission to depart. The dispatch office may issue a limited local maintenance commission where the work supports a specific safe evacuation arrangement. The commission must name its work area and power boundary. It does not itself clear a route, approve an untested navigation lamp or transfer ownership of a vessel. A later departure instruction must be checked against the route notices and the vessel's current configuration. The public consultation desk remains accessible during the closure; restricted records and equipment require their own authorisation.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 现行封港令：一般出港暂停，公共泊位仍接收救援入港；允许入港不等于允许出港。调度室可为明确安全撤离工作签发有限地方检修委托，写明作业范围和供电边界。委托本身不开放航道、不认可未经测试导航灯、不移交船产权。出港另需按航道资料及船舶当前配置核对。公共咨询区开放，受限记录与设备需各自授权。

contexts.paragraph_english: Electrician: Keep it off. The inspection team has not finished isolating the flooded cables. The ferry has its own charged backup battery, with enough reserve for the beacon during this evacuation. That supply is separate from the workshop equipment. Once the new bracket is fitted and the battery connected, check the beacon on the boat. A working light on a bench is not the same as a checked installation.

Limited maintenance exception. Havel, the dispatch officer, may commission inspection and repair of the civil ferry's navigation equipment and the local workshop arrangements needed to obtain its replacement parts. State that the purpose is evacuation assistance and identify those work areas in the request. Harbour main-generator operation is outside this exception: its safety isolation has not been confirmed. A commission allows local preparation; the ferry remains at the quay until a tested current configuration and an explicitly confirmed departure plan are available. Neither a fee nor a language score is required to request the commission. Crew recruitment, patrol-boat use and access to retained accident records are separate decisions and must not be inferred from this document.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 有限检修例外：调度负责人哈文可委托民用渡轮导航设备检修及为取替换件所需的本地工坊操作。申请写明协助撤离及这些范围。主发电机安全隔离尚未确认，操作它不在例外内。委托只允许准备；当前配置测试与明确离港方案确认完成前，渡轮留港。申请不需费用或英语分数；招募、巡灯船及事故记录调阅均另行授权。

contexts.paragraph_english: An instruction to start the pump therefore concerns the operation of the facilities, not permission for a particular vessel to enter the channel. For this evacuation, use the vessel particulars recorded for the approved load. A change to that load is not an authorised alternative within the present operation. Keep this restriction with the departure record.

entries.english_definition: Accompanying someone along a route to ensure safe arrival.

contexts.paragraph_english: Scrap and an active feeder obstruct the lower track. Check the marked work area from the safe platform before engaging the threat. The rail clearance is a separate work result from the later escort: removing the obstruction does not mean that the waiting workers have travelled through the route. Keep the fixed ladder and its landing accessible throughout both jobs.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 下层轨道有废料和活动送料装置阻挡。处置威胁前，从安全平台检查标记区域。清障与稍后的护送是不同工作结果；清除障碍尚不表示工人已经通过。两项工作期间均保留固定梯道和平台通路。

contexts.paragraph_english: Receiver: I need the same four serials that left the shed, the two safe escort results and the actual present receiving stand. The platform battle is one of the safety results, not my signature.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 接收岗：要棚出发的同四序号、两安全护送结果和当前真实接收站。平台战是一个安全结果，不是我的签字。

contexts.paragraph_english: W1, W2 and W3 are waiting at the cutting-face shelter. Locate each person and agree the return arrangement at the work stand. The shelter call describes where help is needed; it does not confirm a surface arrival. The lower-track escort must actually bring the group to the receiving route, and the town desk must receive them before the rescue report can be closed.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: W1、W2、W3在采掘面避护处等候。到工作站位逐一确认，并商定返程。求援呼叫说明哪里需要帮助，没有确认地面到达。下层轨道护送应实际把三人带到接收路线，矿镇台接收后，救援报告才能收束。

contexts.paragraph_english: W1, W2 and W3 must be received after the real escort. Confirm the checked exit, receiving person and basic provisions. Extra work packages remain unallocated until this protection is in place. A later change in production may alter the extra arrangement, but it does not withdraw meals or send received workers below again.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: W1、W2、W3须在实际护送后接收。核对受检出口、接收人和基本物资。保障成立前，额外工包仍待分配；后来生产变更可以改变额外安排，但不能撤回暖食或让已接收工人再次下井。

entries.english_definition: Unable to leave a place without outside help.

contexts.paragraph_english: Arrival record — rescue passage from the stranded coast. The public arrival berth receives the technician and four registered survivors. Record their arrival before requesting further harbour work; a person carried here is not automatically signed onto another vessel's crew. Two different berths are shown on the quay plan. The civil ferry is awaiting maintenance and a safe departure arrangement. The stored patrol boat has no handover authorisation on this arrival record. A harbour officer may review a limited maintenance request at the public dispatch desk. Bring the rescue acknowledgement and your inspection appointment, and consult the current closure order rather than assuming that rescue passage suspends it.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 搁浅海岸救援入港记录：接应泊位接收检修员和四名已登记幸存者。先登记到港，再申请后续港口工作；接应入港不自动成为另一船的船员。码头显示不同泊位：民用渡轮待检修与安全撤离方案；封存巡灯船没有在此记录中授权移交。公共调度台可审查有限检修申请，须携救援回执及任职凭证，并查现行封港令。

contexts.paragraph_english: Coast team to the stranded crew. We first marked the south steps as a possible receiving point. That instruction is withdrawn: a fresh inspection found the lower steps separated from their support. Use the northern reach beyond the low wall instead. There are four survivors waiting for assistance, apart from the technician carrying this message. Keep the rescue line clear of the broken steps. Once everyone is under shelter, send your position, the number of people needing collection and the approach restriction. Do not ask the boat to follow the southern marker merely because it is easier to see. We will acknowledge the request through the coast relay.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 海岸队更正原先南台阶方案：现场复查发现下段台阶脱离支承，撤回旧指示。改用矮墙外的北段。有四名幸存者需要接应，不含传递消息的检修员。索具避开破损台阶。人员进入棚内后，发送位置、接应人数和进路限制，接应船不会因南标记显眼就改走那里。通过海岸中继确认求援。

entries.english_definition: Kept in custody and prevented from leaving freely.

contexts.paragraph_english: This file concerns transfer M-12, not the detained engineer. Personal names are held in a restricted attachment and are unnecessary for establishing the sequence below. All times on these sheets refer to the same local day.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本文件记录转移M-12，并非被扣押的工程师。私人姓名保存在受限附页中，确定以下顺序不需要姓名。这些记录中的时间均指同一个地方日。

entries.english_definition: Freed from a restriction or confinement.

contexts.paragraph_english: Route F leads through the duty desk and formal corridor. The desk first checks the intervention's actual authorisation; the corridor stop must then be released at its own terminal. Route M uses the maintenance shaft, its installed handle and a checked return path. A coil sentry still controls the lower approach. Neither route leads straight to the dispatch console.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: F路经值守台与正式走廊，值守先核实际处置授权，走廊阻拦再由本地终端解除。M路经检修竖井、固定手柄与已查返程，下段仍有线圈哨卫。两路均不能直达调度台。

contexts.paragraph_english: Visitor: We will register the checkpoint and keep the source references. If the corridor cannot be accepted now, we will check the maintenance shaft rather than insist that a political preference opens the door. That route still requires its own physical checks. Reaching the takeover floor will establish our approach; it will not establish that Rook's command relay is released or that the central loop has stopped.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 访客：我们登记检查点并保留来源索引。走廊暂不接受时，就核验检修竖井，而不要求政治偏好开门。另路仍需实体检查。到接管层只建立接近结果，没有证明鲁克转接已解除或中央循环已停。

contexts.paragraph_english: Receiving officer: Control and custody remain separate from the historical archive. The reviewed records from the old capital remain unchanged by this confrontation. We will record that Rook's command authority is released when the actual points and combat condition are met. We will not record that the central machinery has stopped merely because a person has been restrained. Its indicator is still visible from the audit stand.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 接收值守：制止与看管和历史档案分开。旧都已审记录不会因这次对峙改变。实际转接和战斗条件成立后，登记鲁克指挥权解除；不会因一人受约束就登记中央机组停止。核验台仍能看到机组指示。

entries.english_definition: Living at the time being directly checked.

contexts.paragraph_english: Comparison envelope for the coast recorder collected after the shore rescue. The original instrument label reports loss of the observed light signal at 21:14:12. Its last routine comparison with the ship clock had an uncertainty of approximately two seconds. The harbour control event is labelled 21:14:10 on a different clock. The handover copy reports a separate control-to-ship comparison within one second. The combined comparisons therefore allow a three-second interval between the two labelled clocks. These readings are consistent within that recorded interval; they are not evidence that every clock displayed an identical second. Together with the approved window and the duty handover, the records support a planned interruption with a required protection removed. Keep the original extract attached. Nothing in this envelope certifies the sender of the inspection mail as currently alive, safe or present at a particular destination.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 救援后实际取得的海岸记录器副本保留原标21:14:12，与船钟最近比对约有两秒不确定。控制钟21:14:10与其在已记不确定范围内相符，不是所有钟秒数完全一致；不证明导师当前存活、安全或去向。 值班记录另证控制钟与船钟相差一秒以内；合并两次比对界限允许两仪器标签有三秒差。

contexts.paragraph_english: Ada: Start with the street people use now, not the straight line on the old sheet. At the checkpoint you have two choices. The inspected passage avoids the broken span, although both appear to lead north. Have your present commission checked there. Or go through the service tunnel with the basic kit; isolate the drive, secure the panel and inspect the cleared route. Neither choice tells us whether Mara is alive today. I know where the duty hall is and where the residents can receive someone coming back. I will not turn an old movement record into a current medical report. Bring the rescue team to the street when the inner return passage is open.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 阿妲：从大家现在走的街开始，别只看旧纸上的直线。检查点有两种选择：核查通道绕开断桥，须查当次委托；或者用基础工具走隧道，隔离驱动、固定面板、清路检查。两种路线都不能说明玛拉今天是否活着。我知道值守厅位置和住民接应处，不会把旧转移记录当成当前医疗报告。内侧便道打开后，把救援队带回街区。

contexts.paragraph_english: Transfer TR-D1-7, version 1. Controlled extract from the receiving officer's custody handover record. The record is dated D−1 relative to the opening blackout. It identifies Mara Venn by the protected identification reference checked at the archive desk. The receiving officer recorded her as alive when custody was handed over. The destination is written as facility code F-17. No public site name or current address is supplied on this extract.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 转移TR-D1-7，第1版。接收员看管交接原稿的受控摘录，日期为开场熄灯前一天D−1。摘录用阅览台核对过的受保护身份索引识别玛拉·维恩。接收员记下她在看管交接时仍然活着。目的地写作设施代码F-17，本摘录没有公开地点名称或现行地址。

contexts.paragraph_english: Sending-end record, custody transfer TR-D1-7, version 1. On D−1 the sending officer handed the person identified by protected reference MV to the named receiving duty. The sending observation records Mara Venn as alive at departure. The destination field contains facility code F-17. The public extract carries the transfer identifier and record version; the identity comparison is available under controlled review.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 发送端记录，看管转移TR-D1-7，第1版。D−1，发送员将受保护索引MV指明的人移交给具名接收岗位。发送观察记录玛拉·维恩出发时活着，目的地字段为设施代码F-17。公共摘录保留转移编号与版本，身份比对可按受控范围查验。

entries.english_definition: The place where a person currently is.

contexts.paragraph_english: This relay records signals locally even when its outgoing link is unavailable. The independent recorder and the outgoing transmitter are separate parts of the station. Before touching the displaced outgoing lead, switch the local transmitter off and isolate it. Seat the lead, restore the station's own reserve and run a link check. The test confirms this lead and power configuration only. If either changes, repeat it before requesting a boat. A successful link test is not evidence that a distant tower is safe. The postal locker may be opened for the named technician after the shore rescue has been completed. Its contents are correspondence, not a certificate about the sender's present whereabouts. The rear latch can be opened from this room to provide a shorter route back to the rescue shelter.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 中继站外发链路中断时仍可本地记录；独立记录器与外发设备是两个部件。检修移位接线前关闭并隔离本地发送设备，再落座接线，恢复本站储备，做当前配置链路检查。改变接线或电源须重新检查；成功不证明远方塔站安全。救援完成后，具名检修员才可领取邮务柜通信，它不证明寄信人目前所在或状态。后门内闩可从站内打开，缩短返回救援棚的路线。

contexts.paragraph_english: Custodian: Then the outgoing package should retain the stage-I instrument reference, its copying chain and the acceptance version. Add the current environment readings with their settings and sampling conditions. List what this local comparison establishes and what the academic team still needs to test. The receiving desk must acknowledge the actual package and sample; an address written at the top of a draft does not deliver them. We can carry the inquiry forward while leaving the later cause, wider instructions and current whereabouts of people outside this inspection explicitly open.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 保管人：送出包应保留阶段I仪表索引、抄录链和验收版本，再附当前环境读数、设置与取样条件。列明地方比较核实什么、学城仍需试验什么。接收台应确认实际资料与样本；在草稿顶写地址并未完成交付。调查能够继续，同时把后来原因、广泛指示与此查验之外人物现址保留为未知。

contexts.paragraph_english: Harbour loan and cross-region inspection terms. Once the Tidegate local safety record has been verified, return to the receiving berth to acknowledge the loan of the sealed inspection vessel Glimmer. Its watch officer maintains the basic ship service; accepting a companion invitation is not a condition of using the vessel. The deck, archive cabin and shared maintenance compartment are three spaces of this one ship, not separate ships at each harbour. The loan does not transfer the civil ferry or its installed equipment. The next inspection commission points to the grove receiving records. It does not certify the current whereabouts of the missing mentor. Basic sailing along an opened route does not require a fuel ticket. The vessel still needs its ordinary gradual repairs; the handover does not turn it into a fully upgraded ship.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 塔站实际安全核验后回接应泊位明确接收封存旧巡灯船微光号及跨区核查委托。船务值守不依赖接受莉娜邀请，三空间是同一船。民用渡轮及船上设备不转移，不证明导师当前去向，不收死锁燃料门票。

contexts.paragraph_english: Record a disagreement between sources as a disagreement. A voluntary conversation at the public porch can establish present residence for this check. It cannot establish someone's location throughout the intervening years, the whereabouts of another family member, or consent to release a protected attachment.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 不同来源的矛盾应按矛盾记录。公共门廊的自愿交谈可以确认本次查验的当前居住情况，不能说明此前多年每一阶段去向、其他亲属位置或公开受保护附页的同意。

entries.english_definition: A witness's account of what they observed.

contexts.paragraph_english: Rescuing Mara changes what can be said about her present condition. It does not change the dates on earlier records, and her testimony does not replace them. She can explain why an engineer accepted a compromise, identify a limitation in an incomplete proposal and challenge a mistaken reading. Those contributions should remain distinguishable from the verified design and command records. A review that calls the rescued person either the final authority or the hidden author of every harm would reproduce the same dependence on a single voice that the investigation was meant to question.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 救出玛拉改变当前状况可说之事，不改旧日期，其证言不替代文献。她可解释妥协理由、指出未完整方案限制、反驳误读；贡献须与经核原设计和命令分开。若让获救者成为最终权威或所有伤害幕后作者，审查便复造调查原欲质疑的单一声音依赖。

contexts.paragraph_english: Oren’s further testimony must retain the MC-2-05 and MC-2-06 unrepaired-bypass acceptance and the auxiliary alarm’s separate repair and independent review. Choose rotation_local_maintenance with a declared safe reassignment window, or supervised_remote_answers with the local team doing physical installation. Accepting a repair does not require forgiveness. For this candidate window the local receiving team is ROLE-R3-LOCAL-MAINTENANCE, the supervised remote desk ROLE-R3-REMOTE-REVIEW and the interval next_safe_reassignment. A person committed to either work post cannot also occupy an active battle seat or another current duty. End or hand off the post explicitly before rejoining; no real week-long disappearance is required. The post is optional and supplies no main evidence or tower conversion by itself.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 奥伦后续证言保留 MC-2-05/06 未修旁路验收责任及辅助警报独立修复复核。可 rotation_local_maintenance 并明确安全重编队窗口，或 supervised_remote_answers、实际安装由当地队承担。接受修复不等于原谅。候选接收队 ROLE-R3-LOCAL-MAINTENANCE，远程监督 ROLE-R3-REMOTE-REVIEW，时段 next_safe_reassignment。承担任一岗位者不可同时占出战席或另一值守；须明确结束或交班才能归队，不要求现实失踪一周。可选岗位本身不供主线证据或塔转型。

entries.english_definition: Something that produces or contributes to an event.

contexts.paragraph_english: Draft contingency notice, prepared on D0 at 20:50. This copy was stored with the evening dispatch papers; its issue box is blank. The text describes a possible interruption of the harbour light and tells receiving crews to wait for a revised route message. A handwritten heading calls it an accident notice, but the heading does not identify a cause. Preparing a notice in advance may indicate planning for a risk. It does not, by itself, show that somebody intended a grounding. Preserve the draft label and the empty issue box when citing this document. The approval and execution records are held separately. Do not replace them with a conclusion drawn from the title.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: D0 20:50准备、尚未签发的应急通知。事故字样不说明原因，预先准备通知不能单独证明故意搁浅；引用时保留草稿标签及空白签发栏，另查批准与执行记录。

contexts.paragraph_english: Custodian: The four-batch table can help us present the records, as long as we state its denominator. Each batch has six listed checks. The incomplete counts are zero, two, one and zero; the official accepted counts are six, six, five and six. Those are two different measures of the same twenty-four entries. The table makes MC-2 worth examining closely. It does not tell us the history of every machine, or prove that every observed disturbance came from the same cause. The original fields are still needed for the particular finding.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 保管人：四批表可以帮助呈现记录，前提是保留分母。每批六项，未完成数为零、二、一、零；正式合格数为六、六、五、六。两列衡量同一组二十四项的不同方面。表格提示细查MC-2，但没有叙述全部机器历史，也未证明所有扰动来自同一原因。具体结论仍需要原字段。

contexts.paragraph_english: Bring back the current instrument sheet as well as the workers. It can establish what was observed in the mine today. Keep the sampling stage, load setting and limitations in the report. The mine is operating at a high extraction setting and dangerous changes have been observed. The present rescue does not establish the full cause of those changes.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 除接回工人，也要带回当前仪表记录，说明今日矿内所见。报告保留取样阶段、负荷设置与限制。矿井目前以高强度抽取，现场出现危险变化；本次救援尚不能证明变化的完整原因。

contexts.paragraph_english: The two incomplete checks describe a safety function that had not been restored at stage I. Keep that scope in a finding. This sheet alone does not name every decision maker, explain the later supply quota, or resolve the wider cause of dangerous changes. Those questions require additional records and technical review.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 两项未完成检查说明，阶段I的安全功能尚未恢复。核查结论保留这个范围。仅此页尚未识别全部决策者，无法解释后来供给配额，也未解决危险变化的广泛原因；那些问题需要更多记录与技术核验。

entries.english_definition: A change produced by an action or event.

contexts.paragraph_english: Service record: A stop request by itself did not prevent reconnection. entries.english_definition: A proposed explanation that can be checked against evidence.

entries.english_definition: A statement about an outcome expected under specified conditions.

contexts.paragraph_english: Advance the inspection clock through two five-minute observations. The final safe stop belongs to the configured run, not to the observer's preference. entries.english_definition: An estimate of future conditions based on available information.

entries.english_definition: An outcome someone considers likely or appropriate.

contexts.paragraph_english: We need a route, a receiving person and the supplies at the far end. A faster lift would help if its present test is complete. entries.english_definition: Lacking relevant evidence for the claim being made.

contexts.paragraph_english: A public summary is one possible arrangement. It can describe the group checked, the disagreement found and the limits of the check. contexts.paragraph_chinese: 公共摘要是一种安排，可以说明核查组、所见差异和查验限制，保留来源而不复制所有受保护姓名。读者因此知道主张什么、如何申请复核。但承诺的复核路径须真实存在。若告示声称可查证据，却无人保存可访问副本或有效查验委托，就很难约束缺乏依据的陈述。

entries.english_definition: Not yet checked against adequate sources.

contexts.paragraph_english: Compare the retained book with the proposed wording before suggesting a revision. Unverified claims may remain questions for the organiser. contexts.paragraph_chinese: 应对方案在限制未经核验负荷时保留基本供给，写清保留、延后事项和临时值守。不能因远处聚落资料难取得就撤掉最低保护，也不能为避开讨论承诺无限容量。接班人需检查真实回路，有限说明比安慰话更有用。本报告采用调查工作阶段，不设现实阅读计时。

contexts.paragraph_english: Finn: A useful notice names the current risk, the supply we must protect and the boundary of the survey. contexts.paragraph_chinese: 芬：有效通知写当前风险、必须保护的供给和调查边界。可说过载放大网络困难，不声称全因果成立；可限制未经核验新增负荷，不撤聚落基本保护。写观察的工作阶段，不在阅读时倒数。世界工作通过行动和新观察变化，不通过思考英语段落的现实分钟变化。

entries.english_definition: Concerned with information that can be checked as true or false.

entries.english_definition: Able to be obtained again under the stated conditions.

entries.english_definition: Carried out as a trial to examine a possibility.

entries.english_definition: A practical check conducted under stated conditions.

contexts.paragraph_english: The town tried a more limited change. For six weeks, the first bus after the busiest train waited an additional five minutes. The other services kept their published departure times. Staff placed signs along the walking route and asked the station to check the lift before the evening peak. This trial combined a timetable change with improvements to the connection itself. Consequently, a reduction in missed buses would not, on its own, show which part of the trial had produced the improvement.

Good afternoon. Today I want to explain how our college evaluated a trial of later library opening. You may have seen the announcement saying that the trial was successful. That description needs a little care. The library was used more often in the evening, but that does not answer every question about whether the change should become permanent. I will go through what changed, what we measured and what we still need to find out.

At the end of the trial, fewer complaints had been received. The transport office treated this as encouraging rather than decisive. A complaint count depends not only on the number of problems but also on whether passengers know where to report them and believe that reporting is worthwhile. The number of rail passengers had also varied during the trial. The office therefore compared complaints with observed missed connections and passenger numbers. It did not publish the lower complaint count as proof that every user had benefited.

First, the practical arrangement. Before the trial, the library closed at six on weekdays. During the trial it stayed open until eight, but only on Tuesdays and Thursdays. We did not add weekend hours. The original proposal had included Monday as well, and some early notices referred to three evenings. However, there were not enough trained staff to cover all three. Anyone using those early notices would have had the wrong information, so the final timetable was placed beside the entrance and sent to students.

entries.english_definition: A planned procedure testing a proposed explanation or effect.

contexts.paragraph_english: This safe observation point is optional. Its sheet records a sheltered side-well stage with extraction at one local unit and disturbance reading five. contexts.paragraph_chinese: 学城受限成功支持准备方案，保留失败说明要避开的条件，二者支持有版本的技术稿，却不是六处未访安装的测量。各塔先核隔离、备用、保护服务和返程，再观察当前输出。改安装使旧测试失效。地方许可针对合格值守下的试验，共同协议另签，不因今天拒选最终政策就阻止安全检查。

entries.english_definition: A modelled situation used to examine behaviour.

contexts.paragraph_english: The bench stops safely when its recorded failure condition is reached. It does not destroy a main-line component. A reset removes local preparation and current tests; it preserves sources, historical runs, the sample deposit and other districts' progress. No waiting in real time is required: the inspection controls advance the declared simulation clock.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 试验台达到记录的失败条件时安全停止，不毁主线部件。局部复位前，保存失败运行与配置。复位清当前准备和测试，保留来源、历史运行、样本交接及外区进展。无需实时等待，由检查操作推进声明的模拟时钟。

contexts.paragraph_english: Start from the field console and inspect at minute 5 and minute 10 of the declared simulation clock. Under this recorded configuration the local output meets the declared criterion at both observations. The finite result supports this controller, load, reserve, contact and duty arrangement for this window. Keep a process diagram showing preparation, execution, observation and acceptance as different stages. There is no reading race or real-time countdown.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 从场内控制台启动，在声明的模拟钟第5与第10分钟检查。此记录配置下，本地输出两次符合准则。有限结果支持该控制器、负荷、储备、联络与岗位在此窗口的安排。流程图把准备、执行、观察和接受分开，没有阅读竞速或实时倒计时。

entries.english_definition: Explicitly prepared test data or equipment for a bounded check.

contexts.paragraph_chinese: 可以复原高负荷停止而不丢已装器材。五分钟取第一观察，十分钟取第二次。记录配置与末次结果。后来复位仍把失败运行留档；之后正例可支持另一条件，不能令早停止从历史消失。

entries.english_definition: A proposed item still requiring relevant review or approval.

contexts.paragraph_english: Oren’s further testimony must retain the MC-2-05 and MC-2-06 unrepaired-bypass acceptance and the auxiliary alarm’s separate repair and independent review. entries.english_definition: Waiting for a required action or decision.

contexts.paragraph_english: A delegated review is another arrangement. The package goes to a specified desk for a stated purpose, and the receipt records the fields and versions that were delivered. contexts.paragraph_english: To the new technician, from Mara. These sheets do not identify Mara's current condition, every person responsible for a network decision, or an approved permanent operating limit. Questions about those matters require the appropriate records and their own review.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 第二台仪表不会提供记录窗口以外的信息。这些页没有确定玛拉当前情况、每位网络决策责任人，也没有批准永久运行上限。这些问题需相应记录另行核验。

contexts.paragraph_english: Good afternoon. Today I want to explain how our college evaluated a trial of later library opening. You may have seen the announcement saying that the trial was successful. That description needs a little care. The library was used more often in the evening, but that does not answer every question about whether the change should become permanent. I will go through what changed, what we measured and what we still need to find out.

Our recommendation is to keep the two late evenings for one more term while testing a supervised study room on another day. This is a proposed next step, not an approved timetable, so students should not arrive next Monday expecting the new room to be open. Before it starts, the college needs to confirm staffing and access arrangements. We will compare costs, types of use and the experience of students who need specialist resources. We also plan to ask people who did not attend the trial, because a service can look popular while still failing to reach some of those it was intended to help. That wider review should give us a better basis for a permanent decision.

Local operator: I can take the operating post for the declared transition shift, if another person accepts the safety-watch post. Those must be different occupants. Extraction can be set from one to three units while the basic seven remain. Three reaches the total capacity of ten; four would exceed it. My acceptance covers this shift, not a permanent permission to keep the machine at the highest setting. At handover we will close the window and lower extraction to zero before the next shift begins. The changed setting will require a new test.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 地方操作员：若另一人承接安全观察岗，我可承担这班明确过渡的操作岗，两岗须是不同人员。保留基本七单位时，抽取可以为一至三；三恰达总容量十，四就超量。我的承诺只覆盖本班，没有永久允许机器保持最高设置。交班时我们结束窗口，在下一班前把抽取降到零，并重新测试变更设置。
