contexts.paragraph_english: The North Station guard group consists of one commander and two guards. Controlling them ends the local threat without creating an execution decision. It does not open the cell. Inspect the real detention door, release the mechanical latch with the basic kit and meet Mara directly. Only that contact can establish her present condition. Open the inner evacuation bolt and inspect the existing route to the inhabited street. Escort her over that opened route, then hand her to Ada and the local receiver. Do not drag her back through an uncleared high-risk approach. A failed attempt returns to the station checkpoint; time spent reading does not kill her in the background.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 北站看守组由一名指挥者和两名护卫组成，制服他们只解除当地威胁，不新增处决选择，也不开扣押门。须检查实体门，用基础工具开机械闩并直接见玛拉；只有此接触能核验当前状况。打开内侧撤离闩，检查通往住民街区的既有便道，实际护送后交阿妲与当地接应人。不能拖她反复走未清高危路。失败回北站检查点，阅读耗时不会在后台害死她。

contexts.paragraph_english: Receiver: We have prepared the street shelter, but preparation is not arrival. Do not enter Mara as received while she is still behind the station door. Ada: The inner evacuation passage comes out here. After the bolt and stepping strip have been checked, bring her through that passage. Receiver: I will record the direct handover and her present condition. Keep the older D-1 record dated D-1; today’s contact does not change what that earlier paper meant. Ada: If the guard attempt fails, return to the station work point and try again. The shelter and your documents remain available. There is no need to hurry through the instructions to keep someone alive.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 接应人：街区棚已准备好，但准备不等于到达，她还在扣押门后时不能登记接收。阿妲：内侧撤离便道出口在这里，开闩、核验踏步带后从便道带她回来。接应人：我会记录直接交接及当前状况；D-1 仍是 D-1 的旧记录，今日接触不改变旧纸含义。阿妲：看守尝试失败可回操作点重试，棚和文献保留；不必抢读说明来保命。

contexts.paragraph_english: For this private local coordination task, the existing transfer-shed receiver ROLE-R6-SHED-RECEIVER accepts complete labelled boxes against the present manifest; the ridge receiver ROLE-R6-RIDGE-RECEIVER accepts them after a safe segment arrival and checks the same version. Confirm both contacts and those receiving conditions with Tess’s current invitation. These are two existing main-route receiving functions, not hidden settlements needed for an ending. The task can be deferred without taking their protected basic supplies away.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本人邀请下的地方协调涉及既有中转棚接收岗ROLE-R6-SHED-RECEIVER和风脊接收岗ROLE-R6-RIDGE-RECEIVER。前者依现行货单接受整箱标记货物，后者在安全段抵达后核同一版本。明确两名联系人及收货条件；它们是两处已有主线路径岗位，不是结局必须隐藏聚落。暂缓此项不撤走基础供给。

contexts.paragraph_english: Receiver: I need the same four serials that left the shed, the two safe escort results and the actual present receiving stand. The platform battle is one of the safety results, not my signature.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 接收岗：要棚出发的同四序号、两安全护送结果和当前真实接收站。平台战是一个安全结果，不是我的签字。

entries.english_definition: Bringing separate clocks or processes into agreement.

contexts.paragraph_english: Controlled extract, temporary supply scheme TS-18, initial signature page. The page bears the name and signature reference of Mara Venn among its contributors. The title describes a temporary compulsory synchronisation arrangement during an earlier supply crisis. The preserved page is an early version; the archive also holds later references which have not yet been assembled into a complete change history here.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 临时供给方案TS-18初始签名页的受控摘录。参与者列含玛拉·维恩姓名与签名索引。标题说明这是早期供给危机期间的临时强制同步安排。保留页面属于早期版本；档案还有后续索引，本地尚未整理出完整变更历史。

contexts.paragraph_english: Mara: My signature is on the eighteen-year-old design. I will not ask you to replace the sheet with my memory of it. The shortage was real, and the synchronisation helped at the time. The exit test was too weak, and independent review was not secured strongly enough. I also failed to obtain timely correction in the years that followed. The note from thirty days before D0 records part of that failure. It is a correction proposal, not evidence that every tower was ready for another system. You should compare it with the actual later revisions.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 玛拉：十八年前设计有我的签名，别用我记忆替原纸。短缺真实，同步当时有用；退出检验薄弱，独立复核保障不足，多年也未及时取得纠正。D0 前三十天笔记记录部分失败，是纠正提案，不证明每塔能换制度，须比对后续实际修订。

contexts.paragraph_english: OC-D18.design@1 bears Mara Venn’s verified design signature eighteen years before D0. It authorised short emergency synchronisation during a severe supply crisis. The measure helped services survive that crisis, but the written exit and independent-review safeguards were weak: continuation could be approved without a firm stopping test or a separately scheduled review. The signed limits did not authorise every later increase in quota or an indefinite detention. An execution copy labelled OC-D18.execution-copy@1 reproduces this design; it is not another independent witness. Preserve both identities and their common source root. A useful original can still contain a serious design fault.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: OC-D18.design@1 经核验有玛拉于 D0 前十八年的设计签名，在严重供给危机中授权短期强制同步；它帮助服务渡过危机，但退出和独立复核保障薄弱，继续运行缺坚定停止检验及另排复核。原限制不授权后来全部配额提高或无限扣押。OC-D18.execution-copy@1 复制该设计，不是第二独立证人。保留两份身份和同源关系；有用的原方案仍可有严重设计缺陷。

contexts.paragraph_english: Eighteen years before D0, a serious shortage made short emergency synchronisation attractive. Mara helped design that response, and it had genuine benefits during the crisis. The original document nevertheless gave weak protection against indefinite continuation. Its exit conditions and independent review were insufficiently firm. These are design limitations, not merely defects invented after the present accident. A later correction cannot make them disappear. It matters that Mara subsequently acknowledged the weakness, but acknowledging a problem is different from having corrected it when correction was needed.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: D0 前十八年严重短缺使短期同步有吸引力。玛拉参与设计，危机中确有收益；原文防无限延续的保障却薄弱，退出条件及独立复核不足，非当前事故后才造出的缺陷。后来纠正不能消除它们，承认问题也不同于在需要时及时纠正。

entries.english_definition: A decreasing count indicating time or actions remaining.

contexts.paragraph_english: At the dispatch duty stand, close_transition_shift performs the handover and sets extraction back to zero before the next shift. This is a world-work boundary, not a countdown while someone reads or writes. A load change invalidates the previous configuration test. Recheck the actual new setting. The tower handover needs a current bounded policy, real duty records and the relevant test; saving the policy text alone does none of those jobs.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 在调度值守站位，close_transition_shift实际交班，并在下一班前把抽取降回零。这是世界工作边界，不是阅读或写作时的倒计时。负荷变更使旧配置测试失效，应复查新设置。塔站交接需要当前受限政策、真实值守和对应测试；仅保存政策文字没有完成这些工作。

contexts.paragraph_english: Finn: A useful notice names the current risk, the supply we must protect and the boundary of the survey. We can say that current overload amplifies the network's difficulty without claiming that every cause is established. We can restrict unverified additional load without removing a settlement's essential protection. Tell the receiving crew which working stage your observations belong to. Do not introduce a countdown while someone reads the report. The world work changes through declared actions and new observations, not through the number of minutes a person spends considering an English paragraph.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 芬：有效通知写当前风险、必须保护的供给和调查边界。可说过载放大网络困难，不声称全因果成立；可限制未经核验新增负荷，不撤聚落基本保护。写观察的工作阶段，不在阅读时倒数。世界工作通过行动和新观察变化，不通过思考英语段落的现实分钟变化。

contexts.paragraph_english: Start from the field console and inspect at minute 5 and minute 10 of the declared simulation clock. Under this recorded configuration the local output meets the declared criterion at both observations. The finite result supports this controller, load, reserve, contact and duty arrangement for this window. Keep a process diagram showing preparation, execution, observation and acceptance as different stages. There is no reading race or real-time countdown.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 从场内控制台启动，在声明的模拟钟第5与第10分钟检查。此记录配置下，本地输出两次符合准则。有限结果支持该控制器、负荷、储备、联络与岗位在此窗口的安排。流程图把准备、执行、观察和接受分开，没有阅读竞速或实时倒计时。

entries.english_definition: A limited period during which an action is allowed or valid.

contexts.paragraph_english: Coast recorder extract. Instrument clock: 21:14:12, light signal lost at the observed tower channel. Further gaps occur in the same recording window, but the extract does not contain a complete network diagnosis. The shore clock and ship clock differ by approximately two seconds in their last routine comparison. Taken with the ship observation copy, this extract supports the order of light loss followed by course deviation. It does not name the person responsible, explain why every gap occurred or establish that the outage was deliberate. Keep the original time labels attached when making a later comparison.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 海岸记录器摘录：仪器钟21:14:12，所观测塔台信号消失；同一窗口还有其他缺口，摘录并非完整网络诊断。最近一次常规比对中，岸钟与船钟相差约两秒。结合船上抄记，资料支持先熄灯后偏航，不识别责任人，不解释每个缺口，也不证明故意断供。后续比对保留原始时间标签。

contexts.paragraph_english: Local operator: I can take the operating post for the declared transition shift, if another person accepts the safety-watch post. Those must be different occupants. Extraction can be set from one to three units while the basic seven remain. Three reaches the total capacity of ten; four would exceed it. My acceptance covers this shift, not a permanent permission to keep the machine at the highest setting. At handover we will close the window and lower extraction to zero before the next shift begins. The changed setting will require a new test.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 地方操作员：若另一人承接安全观察岗，我可承担这班明确过渡的操作岗，两岗须是不同人员。保留基本七单位时，抽取可以为一至三；三恰达总容量十，四就超量。我的承诺只覆盖本班，没有永久允许机器保持最高设置。交班时我们结束窗口，在下一班前把抽取降到零，并重新测试变更设置。

contexts.paragraph_english: Controlled copy of the interruption schedule. Approval was entered on D-1 at 18:00. The specified window begins at 21:14 on D0 and lasts only for the locally declared interval. The schedule requires a second check of traffic still within the affected approach before the output is interrupted. A completion box records whether that check was carried out; it is not a decorative signature. This schedule establishes that an interruption had been planned before the accident. It does not establish which later instruction was followed. Compare the actual control log, the duty handover and the independent instrument record. Keep the scheduled window distinct from the time at which the coast instrument first recorded a missing signal.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: D-1 18:00批准，D0 21:14开始的局部断供测试计划，要求断供前第二次检查受影响进场区的人船。计划证明动作预定，不独自证明后来实际执行何种指令。

contexts.paragraph_english: Comparison envelope for the coast recorder collected after the shore rescue. The original instrument label reports loss of the observed light signal at 21:14:12. Its last routine comparison with the ship clock had an uncertainty of approximately two seconds. The harbour control event is labelled 21:14:10 on a different clock. The handover copy reports a separate control-to-ship comparison within one second. The combined comparisons therefore allow a three-second interval between the two labelled clocks. These readings are consistent within that recorded interval; they are not evidence that every clock displayed an identical second. Together with the approved window and the duty handover, the records support a planned interruption with a required protection removed. Keep the original extract attached. Nothing in this envelope certifies the sender of the inspection mail as currently alive, safe or present at a particular destination.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 救援后实际取得的海岸记录器副本保留原标21:14:12，与船钟最近比对约有两秒不确定。控制钟21:14:10与其在已记不确定范围内相符，不是所有钟秒数完全一致；不证明导师当前存活、安全或去向。 值班记录另证控制钟与船钟相差一秒以内；合并两次比对界限允许两仪器标签有三秒差。

entries.english_definition: One participant's opportunity to act in an ordered sequence.

contexts.paragraph_english: Tidegate maintenance procedure. The tower unit is separate from the west workshop machine and from the civil ferry supply. Confirm the local supply indication at the tower base before entering the control level. During the encounter, the left cooling valve is worked from the left front position and the right valve from the right front position. Either valve may be closed first. Local supply isolation is operated from the left rear position after both valves are closed. The interlock refuses an early isolation request without spending its operating allowance. Each person may operate one work point in a personal turn. Reducing the unit to its last reserve of stopping progress does not establish safety: both valves, isolation and a controlled threat are all required. Ordinary shields and cleansing cannot substitute for this sequence.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 潮门塔机械独立于工坊及民用渡轮。进控制层前在塔基查本地供给。左前左阀、右前右阀，次序不限；左后隔离需双阀完成，每人每个人回合最多一个现场操作。打至最低制止进度不等于安全，仍需两阀、隔离和制止。

contexts.paragraph_english: Ada: Start with the street people use now, not the straight line on the old sheet. At the checkpoint you have two choices. The inspected passage avoids the broken span, although both appear to lead north. Have your present commission checked there. Or go through the service tunnel with the basic kit; isolate the drive, secure the panel and inspect the cleared route. Neither choice tells us whether Mara is alive today. I know where the duty hall is and where the residents can receive someone coming back. I will not turn an old movement record into a current medical report. Bring the rescue team to the street when the inner return passage is open.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 阿妲：从大家现在走的街开始，别只看旧纸上的直线。检查点有两种选择：核查通道绕开断桥，须查当次委托；或者用基础工具走隧道，隔离驱动、固定面板、清路检查。两种路线都不能说明玛拉今天是否活着。我知道值守厅位置和住民接应处，不会把旧转移记录当成当前医疗报告。内侧便道打开后，把救援队带回街区。

contexts.paragraph_english: Harbour loan and cross-region inspection terms. Once the Tidegate local safety record has been verified, return to the receiving berth to acknowledge the loan of the sealed inspection vessel Glimmer. Its watch officer maintains the basic ship service; accepting a companion invitation is not a condition of using the vessel. The deck, archive cabin and shared maintenance compartment are three spaces of this one ship, not separate ships at each harbour. The loan does not transfer the civil ferry or its installed equipment. The next inspection commission points to the grove receiving records. It does not certify the current whereabouts of the missing mentor. Basic sailing along an opened route does not require a fuel ticket. The vessel still needs its ordinary gradual repairs; the handover does not turn it into a fully upgraded ship.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 塔站实际安全核验后回接应泊位明确接收封存旧巡灯船微光号及跨区核查委托。船务值守不依赖接受莉娜邀请，三空间是同一船。民用渡轮及船上设备不转移，不证明导师当前去向，不收死锁燃料门票。

contexts.paragraph_english: The first list on our kitchen wall was made to count meals. It had room letters and the number of portions to prepare. When a resident asked why the public register still said she had moved away, that kitchen list became useful for a different purpose. It showed a practical disagreement worth investigating. It did not tell us the whole history of her movements, and it did not turn a request for supper into an agreement to publish her name.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 厨房墙上最初的名单用来数饭食，写着房间字母和应准备的份数。一位住民问，为什么公共名册仍说她迁出了，这张厨房名单便对另一用途有了帮助：它指出值得核查的实际差异。它没有叙述她全部迁移经历，也没有把领晚饭的请求变成同意公开姓名。

entries.english_definition: A complete cycle of participants' turns.

contexts.paragraph_english: After the verified link work, control can reduce resistance to seventy per cent of this encounter's actual starting capacity. Any excess in that action is discarded at this boundary. The phase changes only at the complete action's end. Existing damaging intentions are replaced by a visible non-damaging recalibration, and two finite renewal components are scheduled for the next round. They do not act immediately in this decision slot.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 联络工作核验后，可将抵抗降到本次实际起始容量70%。此动作超出边界部分舍弃，仅完整动作末切段。旧伤害意图换为可见无伤害重校准，两有限续启组件排到下一轮，不在当前决策槽立刻行动。

contexts.paragraph_english: At the first boundary, the full action ends before the next stage begins. The old damaging intention becomes a visible recalibration with no damage. Two renewal components can arrive in the next round. When they are actually stopped, latch the bypass and verify it. If you have already reached the second boundary, that verification is enough to move on. Excess force is not stored for the next phase. These stages preserve the same party resources and temporary devices.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 首边界在完整动作结束后进入下一段，旧伤害意图成为可见无伤害重校准。两续启组件下一轮可到场。实际停用后扣旁路锁并核验，若已达第二边界，这次核验便可推进。超量施力没有留给下一段。各段保留同一队伍资源与临时装置。

contexts.paragraph_english: The renewal phase has exactly two declared relay components. Each has its own resistance meter and next-round arrival. Control both actual components before latching the bypass from front-left. Then verify the current bypass revision from rear-left. A finite schedule is not a completed relay result, and a component that has not arrived cannot be reported stopped. No extra component replaces an already declared participant.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 续启段恰有两台声明组件，各有抵抗计量并在下一轮加入。先制止两实体，再由前左扣旁路锁，后左核当前版本。有限排程不是组件完成结果，未到场组件不能报告停用。没有新组件替代已声明参与者。

entries.english_definition: A defined place in a sequence or schedule.

contexts.paragraph_english: After the verified link work, control can reduce resistance to seventy per cent of this encounter's actual starting capacity. Any excess in that action is discarded at this boundary. The phase changes only at the complete action's end. Existing damaging intentions are replaced by a visible non-damaging recalibration, and two finite renewal components are scheduled for the next round. They do not act immediately in this decision slot.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 联络工作核验后，可将抵抗降到本次实际起始容量70%。此动作超出边界部分舍弃，仅完整动作末切段。旧伤害意图换为可见无伤害重校准，两有限续启组件排到下一轮，不在当前决策槽立刻行动。

entries.english_definition: One distinct stage within a longer process.

contexts.paragraph_english: After the verified link work, control can reduce resistance to seventy per cent of this encounter's actual starting capacity. Any excess in that action is discarded at this boundary. The phase changes only at the complete action's end. Existing damaging intentions are replaced by a visible non-damaging recalibration, and two finite renewal components are scheduled for the next round. They do not act immediately in this decision slot.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 联络工作核验后，可将抵抗降到本次实际起始容量70%。此动作超出边界部分舍弃，仅完整动作末切段。旧伤害意图换为可见无伤害重校准，两有限续启组件排到下一轮，不在当前决策槽立刻行动。

contexts.paragraph_english: Custodian: The supervision record needs three functions: operation, resident review and evidence oversight. They are different duties even where people agree on an outcome. Our local operator cannot be replaced by the patrol’s companion simply because that person is on the battle roster. Ada has accepted resident review here; I will retain evidence oversight. We must record the acceptance of each post and keep it separate from a broad statement of support. Before the next phase, confirm the return passage as well. A safe tower does not help someone who has no registered safe way back.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 保管人：监督需操作、住民复核、证据监督三功能，即使意见相同仍不同。出战同伴不能自动替当地操作员。阿妲接受此处住民复核，我留证据监督，逐岗明确接受，不用笼统支持替代。还需检查返程；无安全回程的人不会仅因塔安全便受益。

contexts.paragraph_english: The renewal phase has exactly two declared relay components. Each has its own resistance meter and next-round arrival. Control both actual components before latching the bypass from front-left. Then verify the current bypass revision from rear-left. A finite schedule is not a completed relay result, and a component that has not arrived cannot be reported stopped. No extra component replaces an already declared participant.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 续启段恰有两台声明组件，各有抵抗计量并在下一轮加入。先制止两实体，再由前左扣旁路锁，后左核当前版本。有限排程不是组件完成结果，未到场组件不能报告停用。没有新组件替代已声明参与者。

contexts.paragraph_english: Before that work is complete, attacks may reduce central resistance only to thirty-five per cent of the actual starting capacity. The boundary is visible. If resistance is already at the boundary, completing the current verification changes the phase at that action's end; an empty extra attack is unnecessary. Releasing the bypass invalidates its old check. The ordinary stop request is still insufficient here.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 工作齐备前，攻击只能降中央抵抗到实际起始容量35%，边界可见。若已到边界，补齐当前核验即在动作末切段，无需再空打一拳。放开旁路会使旧检查失效。此段普通停止请求仍不足。

entries.english_definition: A defined part of a sequence of work.

contexts.paragraph_english: There are people eating here whose current official entries say that they have died or moved away. A label in the register has affected deliveries, although the kitchens still have to serve the people who arrive. June requests a limited check of the difference. The work covers this priory's twenty-four-person residential group during the present chapter stage; it is not a census of the forest or proof that every missing person has been found.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 这里有人正在吃饭，现行官方名册却给他们标注了死亡或迁出。名册标签影响配送，厨房仍须为实际来到的人供餐。琼请求核查两者的差异。范围限于本章节阶段住在修院的二十四人住区组；这不是全林人口普查，也不能证明所有失踪者都已找到。

contexts.paragraph_english: Receiving witness: I wrote the room assignments as each group came through the porch. A and B were already using their rooms when the kitchen began serving. C was assigned later in that work stage. I heard someone say the group was complete at the first meal, but I think they were counting portions. I kept the room sheet beside me, and that is the record I can check again.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 接应人：每组人经过门廊时，我记下房间安排。厨房开始供餐时，A、B区已经使用房间，C区在这个工作阶段稍后才获分配。我听见有人说第一顿饭时“整组齐了”，但我认为对方是在数口粮。我把房间页放在身边，可以拿原记录再次核对。

contexts.paragraph_english: Present-stage kitchen sheet, local group A–C. Room A: eight portions prepared, eight collected. Room B: ten prepared, ten collected. Room C: six prepared, six collected. Total: twenty-four prepared and twenty-four collected. Collection was recorded by the serving desk, using room codes agreed for public work.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本阶段厨房页，地方A—C住区组。A区：准备八份、领取八份；B区：准备十份、领取十份；C区：准备六份、领取六份。总计准备二十四份、领取二十四份。供餐台使用已经约定用于公共工作的房间代码记录领取。

contexts.paragraph_english: The table concerns the twenty-four entries checked in this priory, not all evacuees. The first column groups entries by the label on the current official roll. The second records voluntary confirmation at the public porches in the present chapter stage. Grouping uses room codes so that the comparison can be reviewed without names.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 本表限于修院核查过的二十四项记录，并非所有转移人员。第一列按现行官方名册标签分组，第二列记录本章节阶段在公共门廊自愿确认居住的人数。比较使用房间代码，可以不具名审阅。

entries.english_definition: A place or condition where progress or access is checked.

contexts.paragraph_english: OC-MAP-HIST@1 shows the former central bridge from the checkpoint towards North Station. Its route identity is HIST-CENTRAL-SPAN. That span is closed and has no present navigation port. OC-PASSAGE-CURRENT@1 identifies CHECKPOINT-DUTY-PASSAGE, a different route with similar large-scale endpoints. It remains available after current inspection credentials are checked. TUNNEL-SERVICE-PASSAGE runs from the checkpoint through the existing tunnel to the duty hall once its obstruction and local hazard are dealt with. Drawing either line does not perform the work. Both current routes end at the duty hall, not the detention rooms. Retain the old map as historical evidence rather than deleting its inconvenient line.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: OC-MAP-HIST@1 的 HIST-CENTRAL-SPAN 是昔日中央桥跨，已经关闭，没有现行导航端口。OC-PASSAGE-CURRENT@1 的 CHECKPOINT-DUTY-PASSAGE 与旧桥大尺度端点相近，却是另一条路线，须核验当前检修身份。TUNNEL-SERVICE-PASSAGE 经既有隧道到值守厅，须实际处理阻碍和危险。画线不能代替工作，两条当前路线都不直接进入扣押室。保留旧图作为历史证据，不删除不方便的旧桥线。

contexts.paragraph_english: Ada: Start with the street people use now, not the straight line on the old sheet. At the checkpoint you have two choices. The inspected passage avoids the broken span, although both appear to lead north. Have your present commission checked there. Or go through the service tunnel with the basic kit; isolate the drive, secure the panel and inspect the cleared route. Neither choice tells us whether Mara is alive today. I know where the duty hall is and where the residents can receive someone coming back. I will not turn an old movement record into a current medical report. Bring the rescue team to the street when the inner return passage is open.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 阿妲：从大家现在走的街开始，别只看旧纸上的直线。检查点有两种选择：核查通道绕开断桥，须查当次委托；或者用基础工具走隧道，隔离驱动、固定面板、清路检查。两种路线都不能说明玛拉今天是否活着。我知道值守厅位置和住民接应处，不会把旧转移记录当成当前医疗报告。内侧便道打开后，把救援队带回街区。

contexts.paragraph_english: The controlled passage accepts the patrol technician named in the current Glasshaven regional commission. Check the commission basis Q-404:resolution, its destination R5 and its purpose verify_north_station_and_legal_access against the actual landing register. Check the physical passage separately: the signed inspection identifies CHECKPOINT-DUTY-PASSAGE and explicitly excludes HIST-CENTRAL-SPAN. The checkpoint officer may verify these fields without granting detention-room access. If checking cannot be completed, use the basic service route. A copied historical credential or an unrelated action receipt cannot substitute for this current local check.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 核查通道接受当前学城跨区委托中的巡灯检修人。比对 Q-404:resolution、R5、verify_north_station_and_legal_access 与实际登陆登记；另检查实体通道，明确 CHECKPOINT-DUTY-PASSAGE 不含 HIST-CENTRAL-SPAN。核查员可验证这些字段，却不授扣押室权限。暂不能完成核查时有基础隧道解法。历史证件副本和无关动作回执不能代替当次检查。

contexts.paragraph_english: The North Station guard group consists of one commander and two guards. Controlling them ends the local threat without creating an execution decision. It does not open the cell. Inspect the real detention door, release the mechanical latch with the basic kit and meet Mara directly. Only that contact can establish her present condition. Open the inner evacuation bolt and inspect the existing route to the inhabited street. Escort her over that opened route, then hand her to Ada and the local receiver. Do not drag her back through an uncleared high-risk approach. A failed attempt returns to the station checkpoint; time spent reading does not kill her in the background.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 北站看守组由一名指挥者和两名护卫组成，制服他们只解除当地威胁，不新增处决选择，也不开扣押门。须检查实体门，用基础工具开机械闩并直接见玛拉；只有此接触能核验当前状况。打开内侧撤离闩，检查通往住民街区的既有便道，实际护送后交阿妲与当地接应人。不能拖她反复走未清高危路。失败回北站检查点，阅读耗时不会在后台害死她。

entries.english_definition: A condition that must be met before proceeding.

contexts.paragraph_english: The fixed ladder links the lift station and the lower rail landing. Its support brackets and resting platform require a physical check. This inspection uses the installed ladder and the mine's basic safety kit; the optional portable clamp is not needed to reach the mine. Close the gate beside the moving lift while checking, and keep the ladder entry open to returning workers.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 固定梯道连接升降站和下层轨道平台，应现场检查支架及休息台。检查使用已装梯道和矿区基础安全装备，无需可选便携固定钳才能进入。检查时关闭活动升降机旁的门，给返程工人保留梯道入口。

contexts.paragraph_english: A brass cooking pot and a wrapped family sketch are stored separately. The pot claimant can describe its repaired handle and maker’s stamp; that permits a supervised object check, not access to another family’s sketch. The sketch remains under an individual reading permission that can be withdrawn. Public inventory descriptions do not include a hidden rescue key or a detention-room location. An uncertain ownership claim stays pending rather than becoming an accusation. Record the object identity and the permitted recipient before release; do not create another object for a second claimant. This optional candidate has no mainline gate or registered reward.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 黄铜锅与包好的家庭速写分开保管。认锅者描述修柄和制作者印记，允许受监督实物核对，不准读另家速写。速写需本人可撤回阅读许可；公开清单不藏唯一救援钥匙或扣押位置。不确定认领保持待定，不变指控；交物先登记唯一身份和获准接收人，不给第二认领者复制物。可选候选不锁主线，无登记奖励。

entries.english_definition: To make a complete transaction persistent.

contexts.paragraph_english: Dispatch officer: On confirmation, we commit the actual decision and an ending snapshot together. Later presentations read that snapshot rather than rewriting the six districts. A six-month card is a bounded account, not a guarantee. Earlier responsibility and the natural mist remain part of the result. You may skip the presentation without losing the committed ending, and you are not required to write another long essay to finish. Companion letters must match what actually happened in their own stories.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 调度值守：确认把实际决定与结局快照一同提交，后续表现读快照，没有重写六地。六个月卡是有限记录，并非保证。较早责任与自然雾仍在结果中。可跳过表现而不丢已提交结局，不需另写长作文才算完成。同伴信件必须符合各自实际故事。

entries.english_definition: A recorded view of state at a particular moment.

contexts.paragraph_english: The protected pre-final checkpoint belongs to the actual sealed preparation and departure. Register its reference at the landing desk, without replacing it with an empty save made after arrival. Inside the tower, encounter retries restore their declared entry state and retain source-reading and draft history. They do not reopen regional shipping or rewrite an earlier ending snapshot.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 受保护终局前检查点对应实际封存准备与出发。在登陆台登记索引，不能以抵达后空白保存替代。塔内重试按遭遇入口恢复，保留材料接触与草稿历史，没有重开地区航运，也没有改写较早结局快照。

contexts.paragraph_english: Dispatch officer: On confirmation, we commit the actual decision and an ending snapshot together. Later presentations read that snapshot rather than rewriting the six districts. A six-month card is a bounded account, not a guarantee. Earlier responsibility and the natural mist remain part of the result. You may skip the presentation without losing the committed ending, and you are not required to write another long essay to finish. Companion letters must match what actually happened in their own stories.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 调度值守：确认把实际决定与结局快照一同提交，后续表现读快照，没有重写六地。六个月卡是有限记录，并非保证。较早责任与自然雾仍在结果中。可跳过表现而不丢已提交结局，不需另写长作文才算完成。同伴信件必须符合各自实际故事。

contexts.paragraph_english: The option display must name each missing qualification now, using the sealed version and current physical safety. Choosing a preferred description does not install a device or make a different protocol current. If the distributed work is incomplete, central and island remain legitimate prepared decisions when the base and central safety conditions hold. Revisiting the protected pre-final adventure later may produce another result, but it cannot change the ending snapshot that has already been committed.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 方案显示应按封存版本和当前实体安全列出每个缺项。选择偏好说明不会安装装置，也不会使另一协议成为当前。分布工作未齐时，只要基础及中央安全成立，中央与孤网仍是正当准备方向。后来回访终局前冒险可另产结果，不能改已提交结局快照。

contexts.paragraph_english: The immediate action, six regional follow-up cards, compatible companion notes and public archive account read the committed ending snapshot. A companion who did not join, or whose private work was not completed, receives only a note compatible with the recorded facts. It does not invent a reunion or disclose a private identity. The archive keeps responsibility and current access limits under every direction.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 即时动作、六地区跟进卡、兼容同伴近况和公共档案读已提交快照。未招募或私人工作未完成的同伴，仅显示符合记录事实的近况，不编团聚或公开私人身份。各方向均保留责任和当前访问范围。

entries.english_definition: The removal of stored information.

contexts.paragraph_english: Compare retained and issued copies only when the register shows that they belong to the same reporting version. A normal update at another date is not automatically a deletion. A reading permission allows this inspection and a bounded factual finding; it is not a general licence to publish protected identities.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 只有流转册说明留存与发行件属于同一报告版本，才比较删改。另一日期的正常更新不自动成为删除。阅读许可允许本次检查及有限事实核查，没有授予公开受保护身份的一般权限。

entries.english_definition: An additional instance of an item already present.

contexts.paragraph_english: A duplicate of the departure entry was attached to the ledger. It is a copy of the departure officer’s record, not another observer’s account. Nothing in these documents states what the central office knew before departure or why its ledger was updated later.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 总账附有一份出发条目副本。它复制出发记录员记录，并非另一位观察者陈述。这些文件没有说明中央办公室在出发前知道什么，也没有解释为何较晚更新总账。

contexts.paragraph_english: The extract reproduces the administrative status that this roll currently carries. Its issue date precedes the present porch visits. It has no field confirming who is at the priory today. A duplicate in the room index has the same register source.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 摘录复制的是名册当前行政状态，签发日期在本次门廊走访之前，没有确认今日谁在修院的字段。住区索引中的重复内容仍与名册同源。

entries.english_definition: A defined way through which people or systems interact.

contexts.paragraph_english: The uncontrolled extraction machine has a moving feed and an unsecured lifting arm. Stop the feed at the marked intake point, then physically secure the arm before dealing with the main machine. Pressure can weaken the machine's impact; it cannot fasten an arm which has not been secured. The portable clamp earned after this commission is not needed to complete it: this work stand provides the declared fixed brace interface and local securing equipment.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 失控开采机有活动送料与未固定吊臂。先在标记入口停送料，再实际固定吊臂，随后制止主机。压力可以减弱冲击，无法自动固定没有固定的吊臂。本委托之后获得的便携固定钳不是完成前置；站位提供已声明的固定接口和本地固定设备。

entries.english_definition: One particular occurrence of a reusable definition.

contexts.paragraph_english: This landing receives the vessel and the preparation sealed before departure. Match the vessel instance, checkpoint reference and current assignment to the actual arrival receipt. The receiving work concerns entry to the seventh tower and a bounded intervention in its dangerous programme. It does not select a permanent policy. Keep the six districts' preparation records attached; a local officer cannot replace a district's operator or representative signature.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 此登陆台接收船与出发前封存的准备。请按实际抵达回执核对船实例、检查点与当前任务。本次接收涉及进入第七塔及对危险程序的有限处置，没有选定永久政策。六地准备记录随附，本地值守不能替代某地区操作方或代表的签字。

entries.english_definition: A group of related materials derived from a shared source or task.

contexts.paragraph_english: Record a disagreement between sources as a disagreement. A voluntary conversation at the public porch can establish present residence for this check. It cannot establish someone's location throughout the intervening years, the whereabouts of another family member, or consent to release a protected attachment.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 不同来源的矛盾应按矛盾记录。公共门廊的自愿交谈可以确认本次查验的当前居住情况，不能说明此前多年每一阶段去向、其他亲属位置或公开受保护附页的同意。

contexts.paragraph_english: Records travel farther than their writers expect. A room code on a kitchen sheet may be harmless among people who already know the building. Add a private address, a family relationship and a public announcement, and the same account can expose someone to attention they never agreed to receive. Removing those details need not remove the events. A review can still retain an observation date, the duty of the observer, the version of a record and a route to the protected original. These fields let a reader ask whether the account has support.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 记录会传得比作者预想更远。厨房页的房间代码，在熟悉建筑的人之间可能没有什么风险。加上私人住址、亲属关系和公共通告，同一陈述却可能让人受到从未同意的关注。去掉这些细节，无需去掉事件。审查仍可保留观察日期、记录员职能、版本及通向受保护原稿的查验路径，让读者判断陈述有无支持。

contexts.paragraph_english: The owner remembers hearing it at a family meal and may choose to describe that memory privately. Their permission to repair the mechanism does not publish the memory. Ask separately before copying a personal account into a notice. The repair can be paused if permission changes, and the owner may keep the original note without telling the story.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 主人记得家庭聚餐时听过它，可以选择私下讲回忆。维修机构许可不会公开回忆。把个人叙述抄进告示前需另问。许可改变时可以暂停维修，主人也能保留原便条、不讲故事。

contexts.paragraph_english: After fitting an approved part, inspect the turning mechanism and return the same box. A written repair note can state the part used, check performed and limits of the work. The owner can keep that note with the original specification and leave the family memory private. A useful repair does not require a public story.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 安装获准件后，检查旋转机构并归还同一个盒子。书面记录可列所用零件、检查和工作限制。主人可将记录与原规格一同保存，保留家庭回忆私密；有用维修无需一个公开故事。

entries.english_definition: The degree to which work is completed without relevant assistance.

contexts.paragraph_english: Team B took its own readings with instrument IB-2 during W-1. At the priory's lower-load station it recorded local load 40 and indicator 3. At the mine's higher-load station it recorded local load 70 and indicator 8. The mine readings come from a second field visit and instrument; they are not a transcription of team A. Keep that independence distinct from agreement between the two numbers.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: B队在W-1窗口以IB-2独立记录。修院较低档为本地负荷40、指标3；矿区较高档为70、指标8。矿区记录来自另一次现场访问与仪表，不是A队抄录。来源独立与两个数字相近是不同事项。

contexts.paragraph_english: An orderly island arrangement removes central forced dispatch and the main cross-region links according to the prepared sequence. It preserves local protection and duty rather than demolishing towers or switching off every supply. Local operators gain more direct control over the limits they accept. The cost is less cross-region balancing and some lost assistance. Certain protection areas may shrink, outer residents may need relocation and shipping may become more expensive. Independence for a wealthy district does not automatically provide resources to a poorer one.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 有序孤网按准备顺序解除中央强制调度与主要跨区联络，保本地保护及值守，而非拆塔或关闭所有供给。地区操作方更直接决定可承受上限。代价为减少跨区调峰与部分互助，有的保护范围收缩，外缘住民需安置，航运成本上升。富裕地区独立不会自动给贫弱地区资源。

entries.english_definition: Already encountered and recognised.

contexts.paragraph_english: A signature is often asked to do too much. Once investigators find a familiar name on an old design, the story can appear to have found its single cause. The simplicity is appealing: remove one author, reject one document, and the problem seems solved. Yet an operating system continues through revisions, authorisations and everyday decisions. Responsibility must follow those particular acts. If all later conduct is attached to the first signature, the people who changed the scheme disappear from view, while the original designer is either condemned for everything or defended against everything.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 人们常让签名承担过多。旧设计找到熟悉名字后，故事仿佛找到唯一原因；除一作者、废一文件，问题似解决。但系统由修订、授权和日常决定延续，责任须对应具体行为。把后来行为全挂最早签名，改方案者便消失，原设计者则被全盘谴责或全盘辩护。

entries.english_definition: Carried out within a stated time period.

contexts.paragraph_english: Use the supplied basic kit and safety line. Isolate the tunnel maintenance drive at its local switch; this switch does not control the city or North Station. Brace the loose service panel before clearing the obstruction. The tunnel hazard can be dealt with by physical isolation, removal of the loose feed and a zero-motion check, or by the registered local encounter followed by the same passage inspection. A brace is still needed after a fight. Verify the dry stepping strip and mark the return line at the exit. No timed reading, rare key or strength threshold is required. The opened service passage remains available for safe return.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 使用已提供的基础工具和安全索。在当地开关隔离隧道维护驱动，它不控制城市或北站；先固定松动面板，再清理阻碍。可通过隔离、移除松动送料件并核验零运动处置危险，也可完成登记遭遇后检查通路；战斗后仍须固定。出口检查干燥踏步带并标返程线。不要求限时阅读、稀有钥匙或力量门槛；打开的检修通道保留安全返程。

entries.english_definition: A task requiring effort under meaningful constraints.

contexts.paragraph_english: A delegated review is another arrangement. The package goes to a specified desk for a stated purpose, and the receipt records the fields and versions that were delivered. This can allow a detailed check without immediately distributing personal details to everyone. It has costs. The reviewer may work slowly, or the public may have less opportunity to challenge an error. Keeping a short public account alongside a controlled package can make the process easier to question, provided neither account pretends that a pending review has already resolved the matter.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 受托审查是另一种安排：资料交给指定工作台用于约定用途，回执记清交付字段与版本。这能支持详细核查，无需立即把私人细节分给所有人。它也有代价：审阅可能较慢，公众纠错机会可能较少。受控包旁保留简短公共说明，有助于对过程提出问题；两者均应保留审查尚未结束的状态。

contexts.paragraph_english: Custodian: Before we start, this is a bounded review, not an election for the future system. We have the old design, the later revision and correction note, the policy and test authorisations, the executive orders and the station register. The copies remain labelled as copies. Personal addresses and unrelated identities are excluded. Each claim will have a source version and each responding party will have a chance to challenge its scope. If a channel declines to answer, I will record the decline. It will not become an admission simply because someone in this room wishes it were.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 保管人：这是一场有限审查，不是未来制度选举。已有旧设计、后续修订和纠正、政策及测试授权、执行令、北站登记；副本标副本，住址和无关身份排除。每条主张有来源版、各方有质疑范围机会。拒答按拒答登记，不因厅里有人希望便成认罪。

contexts.paragraph_english: The records themselves need suitable access. A public finding can describe the batch, incomplete function and signed decision while unnecessary household details remain protected. A controlled reviewer may need the full technical fields and a route to the original. These arrangements should specify a recipient, purpose and version. They should also explain how a challenge can reach the reviewer. A promise that evidence exists is of little help if the promised source cannot be inspected or if an old permission has been stretched to cover a new use.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 记录需要合适访问范围。公共结论可以说明批次、未完成功能与签章决定，同时保护无关住户信息。受控复核人也许需要完整技术字段及查原稿的通路。这些安排应注明接收方、用途、版本，并说明如何提出质疑。若承诺来源无法查阅，或把旧许可扩成新用途，仅声称有证据并没有多大帮助。

contexts.paragraph_english: Choose emergency_public_redacted or protected_review. In either form, list the claim, the cited source version, the responding party and the response or explicit decline. Provide Mara, Voss and the station executive channel an opportunity to challenge claims separately. No response is not proof of innocence or guilt. Disputed interpretation remains noted alongside the fixed documents. The custodian checks that confidential identities are excluded and records that all three response opportunities were offered. A submitted essay cannot perform these invitations, overwrite a signature or turn a majority preference into a new historical fact. The resulting summary separates design and delayed correction, known-risk policy and testing, and cancelled review with detention.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 可选 emergency_public_redacted 或 protected_review。两种均逐条列主张、来源版本、回应方以及回应或明确拒绝；玛拉、沃斯、北站执行渠道分别获得反证机会。不回应不是无罪或有罪证明。争议解释与固定文献并存；保管人检查身份脱敏，登记三方均获机会。作文不会自动邀请、改签名或用多数偏好制造历史事实。摘要分开设计及迟延纠正、已知风险政策与测试、取消复核及扣押。

entries.english_definition: An encounter involving attacks and defensive actions.

contexts.paragraph_english: An invitation to join your travelling crew can be discussed after this batch finding is complete. Accepting, declining or delaying that invitation leaves the documents available under the inspection assignment. I cannot work a local duty post and take a travelling combat position at the same time.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 这项批次核查完成后，可以另谈加入出行队伍的邀请。接受、拒绝或暂缓都保留委托范围内的文件。本人不能同时占用本地当班岗位与出行战斗位置。

contexts.paragraph_english: Rook: This floor has two combat transfer points. They are local to my command chain. Do not pretend that taking them down is the same as operating the city network. My guards will act with me when the combined intention is declared. You can see which guard participates and who is targeted before choosing your response. There will be no replacement strike from a guard whose participation was already removed.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 鲁克：本层有两个作战转接点，属于我的本地指挥链。别把关闭它们等同于操作城市网络。合击意图公布时，护卫会参与；你在选择回应前可看到谁参与、目标是谁。已经移除参与的护卫不会再补一次替代攻击。

contexts.paragraph_english: The repaired old tool frame is a personal-line keepsake, with no combat-stat bonus. Keep the historical signature and remaining questions visible. If the private work invitation is withdrawn before confirmation, pause the private work and its outgoing discussion; the already completed main commission and public evidence remain.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 修好的旧工具框是个人线纪念物，没有战斗属性。保留历史签章和余下问题。私人邀请若在确认前撤回，暂停私人工作及对外谈话；已完成主线与公共证据继续保留。

contexts.paragraph_english: Each tower needs one base isolator, one local backup, two base provisions and two qualified local watch posts. These come from that district’s inspected facility-conservation contract. Baseline work does not consume the player’s marks, personal parts or the Glimmer’s battery. Enhanced work separately needs one controller, two couplers, three transition crates and a reusable trial fixture per tower. Six public finite contracts supply six controllers, twelve couplers, eighteen crates and six fixtures. Reading this list grants none of them. The six local crews have capacity one each; optional companions and combat auxiliaries are separate people.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 每塔需要一隔离套、一当地备用组、两基础保全包及两个合格地方值守岗位，来自对应地区受检设施保全合同。基础工作不消费玩家刻币、个人零件或微光号电池。增强每塔另需一控制器、两联络组件、三过渡箱及一可复用试验夹具。六个公开有限合同供六控制器、十二组件、十八箱、六夹具，阅读清单不入账。六地班组各有同期容量一；可选同伴和战斗援勤另行登记。

entries.english_definition: A bounded event involving a threat, interaction, or method.

contexts.paragraph_english: Tidegate maintenance procedure. The tower unit is separate from the west workshop machine and from the civil ferry supply. Confirm the local supply indication at the tower base before entering the control level. During the encounter, the left cooling valve is worked from the left front position and the right valve from the right front position. Either valve may be closed first. Local supply isolation is operated from the left rear position after both valves are closed. The interlock refuses an early isolation request without spending its operating allowance. Each person may operate one work point in a personal turn. Reducing the unit to its last reserve of stopping progress does not establish safety: both valves, isolation and a controlled threat are all required. Ordinary shields and cleansing cannot substitute for this sequence.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 潮门塔机械独立于工坊及民用渡轮。进控制层前在塔基查本地供给。左前左阀、右前右阀，次序不限；左后隔离需双阀完成，每人每个人回合最多一个现场操作。打至最低制止进度不等于安全，仍需两阀、隔离和制止。

contexts.paragraph_english: Technician: The controller is isolated at the outer switch. Do not take a silent machine as evidence that its reserve socket is connected. We kept the socket plate and guard inspection separate. Please control the debris enclosure, then use the manual reserve procedure or the separate maintenance encounter. I will keep the return corridor clear while you inspect.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 技术员：控制器在外开关隔离。机器安静不证明储备插座已接，我们分别留插座标记和护罩检查。先制止残件，再用备用段手动步骤或独立维护遭遇，我会在检查时保留返程走廊。

contexts.paragraph_english: Both methods retain the greenhouse beds and leave a checkable result at the valves. Sampling secures the affected root section while its reaction is controlled; mechanical treatment secures the return and clears the external winding. Merely selecting a method does not produce a clearance receipt. The actual encounter or work procedure must reach its safe objective, after which the branch stands can be inspected again.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 两种方法均保留种植床，并在阀处留下可核查结果。取样方法在控制反应时固定根段；机械方法固定回流并清除外部缠绕。选择方法本身不产生回执。实际遭遇或工作程序达到安全目标后，方可重新检查支路。

contexts.paragraph_english: Inspect the external dead circuit before opening the old case. The debris enclosure must be controlled through the actual encounter. For the reserve segment, either use the isolated manual service procedure—open, clear, secure and inspect—or control its separate maintenance threat. The physical result must be recorded before the connection is checked. Read instructions from the protected work stand; no action requires a rare talent or a particular companion.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 打开旧外壳前，从外侧检查断路。残件围护须实际遭遇制止。备用段可以用隔离手动步骤：打开、清理、固定、检查；也可处理其独立维护威胁。核对连接前须记录物理结果。在安全工作站读说明，无需稀有天赋或特定同伴。

entries.english_definition: A participant opposing the player's side in a conflict.

contexts.paragraph_english: Controller C adds a practical test of the proposed alternative. Its local circuit operates at a finite load, with checked isolation, reserve, limited contact and assigned duty. The execution machine is first made safe and its output physically returned through the test route. Observations at five and ten minutes then record that arrangement. This sequence matters: a configured console is not a running circuit, and controlling an enemy device does not measure the trial output. The accepted interval belongs to the current revision. Changing a connector requires another check even if the earlier run remains a valid historical observation.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: C增加替代方案实体核验：有限负荷、受检隔离、储备、有限联络与岗位。先制止执行机，将输出实际送回测试环，再以五及十分钟观察记录安排。顺序重要：控制台配置不是运行回路，制止敌装置没有测实验输出。接受时段属于当前版本；改连接须重查，即使早运行仍是有效历史观察。

entries.english_definition: A participant working on the same side.

contexts.paragraph_english: CMD-L and CMD-R carry Rook's local combat orders at the takeover floor. Shut each named transfer point, then control Rook and the two guards. These points do not carry the city's rescue communication. The left point is reachable from the front-left ally station; the right point from front-right. Each operation costs one action point and occupies that actor's control allowance for the current personal turn.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: CMD-L与CMD-R传递接管层鲁克本地作战命令。分别关闭标明转接点，再制止鲁克和两护卫。这两点不承载城市救援联络。左点由友方前左站位操作，右点由前右操作，各耗1AP并占本角色当前个人回合控制额度。

entries.english_definition: An action intended to damage or hinder an opponent.

contexts.paragraph_english: Until both points are confirmed closed, force can reduce resistance but cannot bypass the remaining command chain. The combined attack announces its participants and targets. Controlling a named guard removes only that guard's announced contribution. A stability break on Rook weakens his next attack and cancels the current interruptible combination; it does not remove a complete boss stage or trigger an unannounced substitute attack.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 两点未共同确认关闭前，打击可降抵抗，不能跳过残余指挥链。合击公布参与者和目标，制止某护卫仅移除其已声明部分。鲁克失衡减弱下次攻击并取消当前可中断合击，没有删除整段首领阶段，也不触发未公布替补攻击。

contexts.paragraph_english: Service record: A stop request by itself did not prevent reconnection. We marked the left and right forced-link branches, the finite renewal components and the damping check as separate objects. First isolate both forced-link branches and verify the current configuration. Either branch may be isolated first. Before verification, force against the main resistance meter has no effect. Do not interpret this as an instruction to attack a different, unlabelled facility.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 检修记录：单独停止请求没有阻止重连。我们分别标明左右强制联络支路、有限续启组件与阻尼检查。先隔离两支路并核当前配置，左右先后可换。核验前对主抵抗计量施力无效，不能据此攻击另一未标设施。

contexts.paragraph_english: Before that work is complete, attacks may reduce central resistance only to thirty-five per cent of the actual starting capacity. The boundary is visible. If resistance is already at the boundary, completing the current verification changes the phase at that action's end; an empty extra attack is unnecessary. Releasing the bypass invalidates its old check. The ordinary stop request is still insufficient here.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 工作齐备前，攻击只能降中央抵抗到实际起始容量35%，边界可见。若已到边界，补齐当前核验即在动作末切段，无需再空打一拳。放开旁路会使旧检查失效。此段普通停止请求仍不足。

contexts.paragraph_english: Until ready, the machine retains at least one unit of resistance. If one remains when controlled stop is approved, that operation can safely conclude the encounter; do not strike the facility merely to satisfy an empty attack requirement. A safe-stop receipt states that automatic restart is disabled and the dangerous programme is stable. It leaves the policy decision to the dispatch desk.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 未就绪时机组至少留1抵抗。批准时若仅剩1，该操作即可安全收束，不要为满足空攻击要求打设施。安全停止回执说明自动续启禁用、危险程序稳定，政策方向留给调度台。

entries.english_definition: An action or capacity protecting against an attack.

contexts.paragraph_english: Before the live island arrangement, control the calibration defence from the external stand, inspect the isolation, seat the labelled reserve connector and secure both guards. The checked reserve is the room's installed reserve, not the Glimmer's battery. Declare a local duty officer and a review officer for the bounded current window. These are trial posts only; they do not occupy or grant permanent six-tower operator posts.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 带载孤网准备前，从外侧站位制止校准防卫，检查隔离、座好带标储备连接头并固定护罩。受检储备属于此室，不是微光号电池。为当前有限窗口明确试验操作员与复核员；这些是试验岗位，没有占用或授予六塔永久岗位。

contexts.paragraph_english: Operator: I need a current work permit before entering the control layer. The rack must be secured and the relay drive isolated. There is an independent defence unit there; settling the custody question will not switch it off. After that work, the local load is four internal units: three for protection, one for preservation and none for discretionary reproduction. These units belong to this apparatus. They are not crates that can be moved from the six-tower preparation store. I can make an actual configuration check only when the declared load and my duty post match the record.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 操作员：入控制层要当前许可，须固定架、隔离继电驱动；保管决定不关闭独立防卫单元。之后当地负荷四内部单位：保护三、保存一、非必要复制零，不能当六塔储备箱搬走。实际配置检查须负荷与本人岗位同记录。

contexts.paragraph_english: The survey instrument has a labelled zero channel Z and reference channel R. Check Z at 0 and R at 10 after isolating the local drive; these are instrument marks, not the load units used in other districts. Control the station defence, then verify the readings at the present revision. A reconnection or configuration change expires the check. The report concerns current overload risk and bounded essential supply in this survey window. It does not predict an exact storm hour or prove that all fog was created by the towers.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 测站仪表有零点Z通道和参考R通道。隔离本地驱动后，核对Z为0、R为10；这些是仪表标记，不与其他地区负荷单位通兑。处置测站防卫后按当前版本核验读数。连接或配置变动会使旧检查过期。报告说明本窗口的过载风险和受限基本供给，不预测准确风暴钟点，也不证明所有雾来自灯塔。

contexts.paragraph_english: Finn: Secure the guide markers before dealing with the pass obstruction. Once that obstruction is controlled, use the actual paired entrance into the station. A map symbol does not move the team there. The station defence is a separate piece of work, and controlling it will not calibrate the instrument. We have deliberately kept these results apart so the receiving watch can identify a missing step. If a fight goes badly, withdraw to its recorded entry. Your source reading and saved explanation remain available; the retreat is not a reason to award a result that did not occur.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 芬：先固定向导标记，再处置山口阻断，随后沿配对入口进测站。地图符号不搬人。测站防卫另算，控制它不校准仪表。分开结果便于接班人查缺步骤。遭遇不利可撤回记录入口，来源阅读和正文保留，撤退不奖励未发生的结果。

entries.english_definition: The capacity to reduce or withstand a specified effect.

contexts.paragraph_english: Until both points are confirmed closed, force can reduce resistance but cannot bypass the remaining command chain. The combined attack announces its participants and targets. Controlling a named guard removes only that guard's announced contribution. A stability break on Rook weakens his next attack and cancels the current interruptible combination; it does not remove a complete boss stage or trigger an unannounced substitute attack.

We marked the left and right forced-link branches, the finite renewal components and the damping check as separate objects. First isolate both forced-link branches and verify the current configuration. Either branch may be isolated first. Before verification, force against the main resistance meter has no effect. Do not interpret this as an instruction to attack a different, unlabelled facility.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 检修记录：单独停止请求没有阻止重连。我们分别标明左右强制联络支路、有限续启组件与阻尼检查。先隔离两支路并核当前配置，左右先后可换。核验前对主抵抗计量施力无效，不能据此攻击另一未标设施。

contexts.paragraph_english: After the verified link work, control can reduce resistance to seventy per cent of this encounter's actual starting capacity. Any excess in that action is discarded at this boundary. The phase changes only at the complete action's end. Existing damaging intentions are replaced by a visible non-damaging recalibration, and two finite renewal components are scheduled for the next round. They do not act immediately in this decision slot.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 联络工作核验后，可将抵抗降到本次实际起始容量70%。此动作超出边界部分舍弃，仅完整动作末切段。旧伤害意图换为可见无伤害重校准，两有限续启组件排到下一轮，不在当前决策槽立刻行动。

contexts.paragraph_english: The renewal phase has exactly two declared relay components. Each has its own resistance meter and next-round arrival. Control both actual components before latching the bypass from front-left. Then verify the current bypass revision from rear-left. A finite schedule is not a completed relay result, and a component that has not arrived cannot be reported stopped. No extra component replaces an already declared participant.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 续启段恰有两台声明组件，各有抵抗计量并在下一轮加入。先制止两实体，再由前左扣旁路锁，后左核当前版本。有限排程不是组件完成结果，未到场组件不能报告停用。没有新组件替代已声明参与者。

entries.english_definition: A condition making a participant vulnerable to a particular effect.

contexts.paragraph_english: Copies are often necessary. An instrument sheet may remain underground while a surface team needs to arrange supplies. A carefully referenced transcription lets that team work without carrying away the only original. Yet two copies of a single observation do not make the observation independent. Counting documents can conceal this weakness. A stronger comparison identifies the original, follows the copying path and then seeks a genuinely different record, such as the acceptance decision. The purpose is to understand what each source contributes, rather than to collect the largest pile of paper.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 副本常有必要：仪表页可能留在井下，地面人员却要安排供给。有清楚索引的抄录让团队开展工作，也避免拿走唯一原稿。不过，同一观察的两份副本没有使观察变为独立。数文件容易掩盖这一点。更稳妥的比较会识别原稿、追溯抄录路径，再查真正不同的记录，例如验收决定；目的在于理解各来源的作用。

contexts.paragraph_english: Eighteen years before D0, a serious shortage made short emergency synchronisation attractive. Mara helped design that response, and it had genuine benefits during the crisis. The original document nevertheless gave weak protection against indefinite continuation. Its exit conditions and independent review were insufficiently firm. These are design limitations, not merely defects invented after the present accident. A later correction cannot make them disappear. It matters that Mara subsequently acknowledged the weakness, but acknowledging a problem is different from having corrected it when correction was needed.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: D0 前十八年严重短缺使短期同步有吸引力。玛拉参与设计，危机中确有收益；原文防无限延续的保障却薄弱，退出条件及独立复核不足，非当前事故后才造出的缺陷。后来纠正不能消除它们，承认问题也不同于在需要时及时纠正。

contexts.paragraph_english: The practical outcome is not a declaration that cooperation was always wrong or that technical expertise should be discarded. It is a more exact basis for the next arrangement. Mara retains responsibility for design weakness and delayed correction. Voss retains responsibility for known-risk policy, test authorisation and information suppression. Rook retains responsibility for cancelled review, detention and refusal to transfer control. These can all be true at once. Preserving that distinction allows supervised technical help without restoring exclusive authority, and permits a future policy choice without rewriting the past to make the preferred choice look innocent.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 结果不是宣布合作从来错误或丢弃技术知识，而是为下一安排提供精确依据：玛拉设计不足及迟延纠正；沃斯已知风险政策、测试授权、压制信息；鲁克取消复核、扣押及拒移交。这些可同时成立。分开它们，可用受监督技术帮助却不恢复独占，也可选择未来政策而不改写历史替偏好脱责。

entries.english_definition: Resistance to a change in a machine's motion or action state.

contexts.paragraph_english: Rook: A warning is not a cancellation instruction. The maintained loop has its own fixed clauses and physical inertia. You will need the restart log and the local control instructions. If you choose the formal corridor or the shaft, this condition is the same. Receiving officer: We will keep that attributed statement with the independent indicator record. Neither speaker supplies all missing facts simply by appearing in this exchange.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 鲁克：警告不是取消指令，维护循环有固化条款及硬件惯性。你还需续启日志与本地操作说明。无论经正式走廊或竖井，这条件相同。接收值守：此说法注明发言者，与独立指示记录并存。两位说话者都不会仅因参与对话而提供全部缺失事实。

entries.english_definition: Directed at a specified participant or object.

contexts.paragraph_english: Rook: This floor has two combat transfer points. They are local to my command chain. Do not pretend that taking them down is the same as operating the city network. My guards will act with me when the combined intention is declared. You can see which guard participates and who is targeted before choosing your response. There will be no replacement strike from a guard whose participation was already removed.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 鲁克：本层有两个作战转接点，属于我的本地指挥链。别把关闭它们等同于操作城市网络。合击意图公布时，护卫会参与；你在选择回应前可看到谁参与、目标是谁。已经移除参与的护卫不会再补一次替代攻击。

entries.english_definition: A retained object providing a particular capability.

contexts.paragraph_english: All three internal phases share this attempt's life, focus, action points, carried supplies, aid allotment, cooldowns, relic uses and placed devices. A phase transition replenishes none of them. Reading, writing, translation, clarification and actual audio playback pause the plan slots, without providing recovery or executing a queued click on return. Withdrawing retries the whole declared encounter entry, not a free refill between phases.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 三内部阶段共用本次生命、专注、AP、携带补给、配发、冷却、遗物次数和放置装置。切段没有补满。阅读、写作、翻译、澄清与实际播放音轨暂停计划槽，不提供恢复，也不在返回时补执行排队点击。撤退重试整个声明入口，没有内部阶段免费回满。

entries.english_definition: How well a person, system, or activity fulfils its purpose.

contexts.paragraph_english: Inspection appointment. The bearer is a trainee technician assigned to public navigation maintenance. The appointment establishes a role, not unrestricted access to every power installation. Local harbour work must be commissioned by the officer responsible for the site. Follow the conditions on that commission and keep separate records for each device. A civil ferry's navigation lamp, a workshop's independent controller and the harbour main generator are not interchangeable authorisations. This appointment was carried on the inspection vessel. It does not certify language performance, membership of a faction or the present location of the technician's mentor.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 随检修船携带的任职凭证：持有人为公共导航检修见习员。身份不等于任意电力设施访问权；地方工作须由现场负责人委托，并按设备分别记录。民用渡轮导航灯、工坊独立控制器、港口主发电机不是通用授权。凭证不证明英语表现、组织成员身份或导师目前位置。

entries.english_definition: A benefit issued for a completed eligible action.

contexts.paragraph_english: The freight-lift branch can be repaired from this side and tested before use. Keep its repair and test records distinct. This creates an optional quicker loop to the lift station; the fixed inspection ladder remains available even if production is reduced. A repaired branch carries the same people, not a replacement group or a second rescue reward.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 货运升降支路可从此侧修复并在使用前测试。修复与测试各留记录；支路形成返回升降站的较短回环，减产后固定检修梯仍可使用。回环运送同一批人，不产生替代工人或第二份救援奖励。

contexts.paragraph_english: Pera: The delivery is the point at which the packages move from the store to the named work. Before that, a draft may be revised while the stock remains. Afterwards we must retain the real destination and whatever has already been used. A new paragraph cannot return installed material. The town's emergency wage voucher is also separate from the travelling commission's reward. I will not ask someone to fund the agreed basic protection from personal upgrade parts, and I will not describe the six-tower cargo as if it were already in this store.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 佩拉：交付使工包从库内转到具名工作。此前，库存仍在时可以改草稿；此后须保留真实去向及已用材料，新段落不能返还已安装物资。矿镇应急工资凭据也与出行委托奖励分开。我不会要求用个人改件零件填已约定基本保障，也不会把六塔货物说成已在本库。

contexts.paragraph_english: The account must include wages without confusing them with a traveller's reward. Local wage protection belongs to the town's emergency arrangement. The coins or equipment parts earned for a completed commission have another owner and purpose. Asking a resident to wait for food until an investigator writes a better paragraph would confuse these responsibilities. Equally, an investigator cannot solve the shortage by listing imaginary stock. A receipt from the actual store and receiving group provides a firmer basis for discussion than either a polished promise or a large number written without a source.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 记录须包含工资，并与出行者奖励分清。本地工资保障属于矿镇应急安排，完成委托取得的刻币和装备零件有另一归属与用途。让住民等调查者写好段落才领食物，会混淆职责；调查者也不能靠列虚构库存解决短缺。实际库存与接收组的回执，比漂亮承诺或没有来源的大数字更能支持讨论。

contexts.paragraph_english: An attempt can be withdrawn to the safe stand and prepared again. Keep the installed brace, the actual feed state and unrelated rescue progress. Returning for a new attempt does not recreate consumed supplies or issue an extra task reward.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 可以撤回安全站位，重新整备尝试。保留已装固定件、真实送料状态与无关救援进展。重试不重新生成已耗物资，也不额外发任务奖励。

entries.english_definition: A specified disadvantage resulting from a rule breach.

contexts.paragraph_english: The end of a transition should be an action people can recognise. The duty team hands over, extraction falls to the agreed lower setting and the changed configuration is checked again. There is no benefit in making that boundary a penalty for reading slowly. It belongs to the actual work schedule. Recording its result gives the next shift something more useful than a statement that the plan once sounded reasonable. The safety route stays open, and the basic services continue while the team decides whether further work can be authorised.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 过渡终点应成为人们能辨认的行动：值守组交班，抽取降至约定低设置，再检查变更配置。把边界变成慢读惩罚毫无帮助，它属于实际工作安排。记录结果，才能让下一班获得比“计划曾听来合理”更有用的信息。安全返程继续开放，基本服务继续运行，再决定是否可授权后续工作。

entries.english_definition: Holding a recognised right to a particular item or benefit.

contexts.paragraph_english: For a restricted attachment, name the record version, the fields required, the recipient and the intended use. June acts as custodian of the room. She can arrange controlled inspection and record an authorised handover. Holding the key to an attachment does not make her the person entitled to consent on behalf of every individual named there. Consent to publish a person's identity must be given by that person for the specified recipient and use.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 申请受限附页时，请说明版本、必要字段、接收方和用途。琼是阅览室保管人，可以安排受控查验、记录获准交付，但持有钥匙并未使她有权代所有当事人同意。公开某人的身份须由本人对具体接收方与用途明确同意。

entries.english_definition: Meeting the stated conditions for a particular opportunity.

contexts.paragraph_english: Allocation makes the trade-off visible. The district has six extra packages for this work stage, and a package cannot be delivered twice. Giving one to production support means it is unavailable for a shelter improvement during the same stage. Holding one for retrofit may improve a later arrangement, but only if someone can perform that work. Different groups may value those outcomes differently. A useful discussion compares what is delayed, who carries that delay and which conditions can be checked. It need not describe one eligible allocation as the only compassionate choice.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 分配让取舍可见。本阶段有六个额外工包，同包不能交付两次。交给生产支持，就无法在同阶段改善安置；留作改造也须有人实际执行才会改善后来安排。不同群体可能重视不同结果。可用讨论应比较推迟什么、谁承担推迟、哪些条件可检查，不必把某一种合格分配写成唯一有同情心的选择。

entries.english_definition: Supported by adequate reasons or evidence.

contexts.paragraph_english: Some of the next steps can be agreed before a wider inquiry ends. A local team can isolate a damaged connection, replace a part and ask someone other than the repairer to repeat the test. It can record that result without writing that all previous decisions were justified. A resident may appreciate the new signal and still have questions about the earlier acceptance. Requiring forgiveness as the price of a safety receipt would give that receipt a purpose it cannot serve. The condition tested, the observer and the remaining disagreement can all stay visible.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 广泛核查结束前，仍可商定下一些工作。本地队能隔离损坏接线、换件，并请维修者之外的人重复测试；记录结果时无需宣称此前决定都合理。住民可能感谢新的信号，仍质疑早先验收。若把原谅当安全回执的代价，就赋予回执无法承担的作用。受检状态、观察人和余下分歧可以同时保留。

entries.english_definition: Likely to lead someone to an inaccurate conclusion.

contexts.paragraph_english: For eight weeks, the team recorded entrances during the extra hours. They also asked visitors to complete a short form when they left. I should stress that the entrance figures were visits, not separate individuals. Someone who came on six evenings appeared six times in the total. It would therefore be misleading to report the total as the number of students who had benefited. The forms helped us see patterns of use, although not everyone chose to complete one.

entries.english_definition: In opposition to the stated expectation or position.

contexts.paragraph_english: A fair emergency procedure therefore records opportunities for contrary evidence. Each claim needs a source and scope, and each affected party needs a channel to answer. Silence must be entered as silence, not converted into proof. Confidential identities can remain protected while the relevant authorisations and findings are shared in redacted form. An emergency public review and a protected review can both meet these conditions. They differ in audience and immediate exposure, not in whether the evidence is allowed to be questioned. The patrol’s writing organises that process; it does not create the response opportunities by itself.
contexts.paragraph_chinese: 公正应急程序因此记录反证机会。每条主张需来源及范围，各方需回应渠道；沉默按沉默登记，不化证明。身份可保护，相关授权和结果脱敏共享。紧急公开与受保护审查都能满足，差别是受众及暴露，不是是否容许质疑。巡灯人写作组织过程，不会自动创造回应机会。
